name: GIF Joggen
description: The GIF Joggen is a challenging yet friendly competition against yourself or others, a popular low-threshold race or a splendid walk in the Gressvik woods. This event is for everyone, from children in strollers to seniors approaching 100 years old. This way, we can fill the day with meaningful activities.
course_highlights: A challenging yet friendly competition against yourself or others.
A popular low-threshold race or a splendid walk in Gressvik forest.
Open to participants of all ages, from children to seniors.

name: VABIK Terrengkarusell
description: The Terrain Carousel 2025 will be held on Wednesdays and Thursdays in Kristiansand, with marked trails and kilometer signs. The trails are marked from Wednesday at 1:00 PM to Thursday at 6:00 PM, and there is registration for completed times on Wednesday from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM. On Thursday, there is a mass start for the short course at 5:30 PM, for the Milsluker at 5:00 PM (not for all races), and for the Children's Race at 5:10 PM (some races). To receive a participant prize, one must complete at least 8 races.
course_highlights: The courses are marked from Wednesday at 1:00 PM to Thursday at 6:00 PM.
Mass start short course at 5:30 PM and children's race at 5:10 PM (some races).
To receive a participant prize, you must complete at least 8 races.

name: Linnatrimmen
description: Linnatrimmen is a recreational race on Solbergfosslinna in Askim, with the start and finish at the Fire Station. The last edition of the spring season was held on June 5, and the next race will take place on August 21. Participants can choose between distances of 5 km and 2 km.
course_highlights: The Linnatrimmen is a recreational run on Solbergfosslinna in Askim, starting and finishing at the Fire Station.
The latest edition of the spring season was held on June 5th.
The next race will take place on August 21.

name: Vom Dogrun - Drammen
description: VOM DOGRUN is for everyone who wants to participate in a pleasant activity with their dog. You can choose to compete with or without timing, and it is a social event for both dogs and their owners. Distances include 7.8 km for the competitive class (2 laps, with timing) and 3.9 km for the open class (without timing). There is also a free VOM PUPPY WALK available, and all participants receive a dog bowl, a sample treat, and a medal, as well as the chance to win great prizes after the race.
course_highlights: Distances include 7.8 km for the competitive class (2 laps, with timing) and 3.9 km for the open class (without timing).
There is also a free VOM PUPPY WALK available.
All participants will receive a dog bowl, a tasting sample, and a medal, and there will be a raffle with great prizes after the race.

name: 5e Duin en Bollen Vierdaagse
description: The Duin en Bollen Vierdaagse is a friendly autumn walking event through the beautiful landscapes of South Holland. Participants can choose from five distances and walk for 1 to 4 days through colourful forests, dunes, villages and along the Dutch coast. Along the way, walkers can enjoy music, theatre, atmospheric chill-out spots and welcoming refreshment stops. The routes pass iconic places such as Keukenhof, the Amsterdamse Waterleidingduinen and historic villages, making this an atmospheric and varied walking adventure for everyone.
course_highlights: Walking routes along the sea, dunes, colourful forests and welcoming villages
Passing through Keukenhof Forest and by Keukenhof Castle
Beautiful natural areas such as the Amsterdamse Waterleidingduinen and historic polders
additional: Collect your starting pack on Wednesday 14 October 2026 between 17:00 and 20:00 at Museum De Zwarte Tulp in Lisse. Start and finish locations vary by day and distance, with start times ranging from 8:00 to 11:45 depending on the distance. Participants who walk all 4 days receive a medal; those who walk 1–3 days or take part over the weekend receive a commemorative pin. Enjoy music, theatre, chill-out spots and treats along the way. Routes pass historic and natural landmarks such as castles, windmills, polders and nature reserves. Information about route facilities, start and finish locations, and medal distribution.

name: Veenendaal City Run
description: The Veenendaal City Run is a fun run full of light and sound right through the shopping city of Veenendaal, organised by Sportservice Veenendaal. The d

name: Geopark Hondsrug Crosscircuit
organizer: Stichting De Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark
description: The Geopark Hondsrug Cross Circuit is a challenging cross-country circuit held in the beautiful Hondsrug area, a unique Ice Age landscape and UNESCO Global Geopark. The circuit consists of several cross-country races organized by different local running groups, where participants can enjoy an active experience in a natural and varied setting. Participants of different ages and ability levels can take part, with special rules for juniors. The circuit promotes sportsmanship and a connection with the landscape.
course_highlights: Run through the unique Ice Age landscape of the Hondsrug
Varied natural areas and challenging cross-country courses
Organized by local running groups, with attention to safety
additional: Participants take part at their own risk and must have adequate insurance. Juniors (ages 12 to 17) may only run the short distance. Entry fees are non-refundable, but participants may be replaced up to one week before the event. Encouragement prizes are awarded at the closing event in Grolloo. The event comprises several cross-country races in the region, with a focus on active movement and discovering the Geopark area.

name: Brabrand Sø Halvmarathon
description: Brabrand Sø Half Marathon offers a scenic route around Brabrand Lake, starting at the parking lot at Søholmvej 80 in Viby J. The race consists of

name: Love Nature Backyard Ultra
description: Love Nature Backyard Ultra 2024 is an exciting running concept where participants set out on a new 6.706 km lap every hour. They only have one hou

name: Växjö Marathon
description: Welcome to the 32nd edition of Växjö Marathon, presented by VLK. The race consists of eight laps around Lake Växjö on what the organizer calls “Sweden’s fastest course.” The course is very flat (approximately 3 m of elevation difference) and mostly paved, with about 300 metres of fine gravel. The lap was officially measured in August 2024. A relay and a children’s race are also offered, and the course is marked with a lead cyclist and flag marshals.
course_highlights: Eight laps around Lake Växjö
Very flat course, approximately 3 m of elevation difference
Mostly paved, with about 300 m of fine gravel; marked with a lead cyclist and flag marshals
additional: The course is not closed to other users, so runners share the pedestrian and cycle paths with walkers and cyclists; motor traffic is encountered at three points along the course. The lap was officially measured in August 2024. Teams can take part in the relay, and the event also includes a children’s race in 2026. The relay consists of four runners, each running two laps. The course remains open to pedestrians and cyclists, and runners share the space with them and with motor traffic at three points.

name: Åhus TrailRun
location: Strandridaregården, Friseboda, Kristianstad Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Åhus TrailRun is a trail race through the coastal forests and along the sea south of Åhus in Skåne, organised by Pan-Kristianstad. The event offers distances of 17 km, 11 km, 6 km and 2.5 km, as well as a children’s race of approximately 350 m with a medal and no timing. The courses are gently undulating and feature a mix of trails, sand dunes, terrain and running on sand along the coast—participants are guaranteed a running experience beyond the ordinary. The race suits both competitive runners and recreational runners, and also includes team competitions. The participant cap is 1,000.
course_highlights: Gently undulating terrain with a mix of trails, sand dunes, challenging hills and sections of running on sand by the sea
17 km: approximately 60% trail, 25% terrain and 15% beach; elevation gain approximately 310 m
Event venue at Strandridaregården, only approximately 100 metres from the sea
additional: Participant cap: 1,000. Start times: 12:30 for 2.5 km and 6 km; 12:40 for 11 km and 17 km; children’s race starts individually from 13:00 to 15:00. Bib distribution from 10:45 (collect your bib at least one hour before your start). Time limit: the finish closes 2 hours 50 minutes after the 17 km start (at 15:30); the final 6 km lap must be started at least 60 minutes before the finish closes. Venue: Strandridaregården in Friseboda; parking is limited and parking is permitted only as directed by officials (carpooling tips are available via the race’s Facebook group). Bag storage is available for a fee (20 kr, cash or Swish). Children’s race with a medal and no entry fee; online registration closes on the Wednesday before the race; late registration is available at the start and finish area; bibs must be collected by 10:45; parking near the venue is limited; refreshments are available at all stations; electronic timing, with times available online.

name: Jönköping 10K/5K
description: Jönköping 10K/5K is a friendly race in central Jönköping, suitable for both elite runners and recreational runners. Starting at Lillsjöplan, the races follow a completely flat, officially measured course, making it ideal for personal bests and seeding. Both 5 km (1 lap) and 10 km (2 laps) are offered. The organizers emphasize a great atmosphere, with pacers for 40, 45 and 50 minutes in the 10K. Team registration gives a 10% discount when three runners sign up together, and group registration is available for larger parties.
course_highlights: Completely flat course in central Jönköping, starting at Lillsjöplan
5 km = 1 lap; 10 km = 2 laps
The course is officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Federation and qualifies for seeding
additional: Start at Lillsjöplan. The 5K is one lap and the 10K is two laps. Pacers carrying flags will be available for 40, 45 and 50 minutes in the 10K. You can register up to 5 runners at a time through the regular registration; group registration is available for more runners. Team registration (three people) gives a 10% discount and the chance to win prizes. Race bibs are not sent out. The course and course profile are shown on the map/course profile page. Date and start time: 17 October 2026, starting at 11:00 at Lillsjöplan; 5K is one lap and 10K is two laps; aid stations will offer UMARA sports drink and water; bag drop at the start/finish; parking garages nearby; start list and pacer information; limited bag-drop facilities and race-bib collection on site.

name: XC-race Linköping
description: Linköping XC-race is an annual cross-country race organised by Linköpings OK in Vidingsjön, Linköping. The race features a marked 5 km loop over varied terrain, including trails and marshland, and is open to both recreational runners and competitive classes. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km for men and women, and a 5 km recreational class; the 10 km races cover two laps. The event is known for its challenging, muddy terrain, and the start and finish are at Vidingsjö Motionscentrum.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with trails and marshland
Distance options for both recreational and competitive runners
Start and finish at Vidingsjö Motionscentrum
additional: Muddy, challenging terrain; registration via the website, with payment by card or Swish on site; parking at Vidingsjön and LOK-gården.

name: Rönninge Backyard Run 2026
location: Rönninge, Salem Municipality, Stockholm County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälan sker på plats och kostar 50 kr.

description: Rönninge Backyard Run is a lap race in Toredal, where each lap is 6,706 metres. The format is built around hourly starts: the first lap starts at 09:00, followed by a new start at the top of every hour, for up to 12 laps in total. Participants must complete a lap in under an hour to start the next one. The competitor who completes the most laps—and is fastest on the final lap—wins the women’s or men’s class. The race suits both competitive runners and those looking to test their endurance on a technical but runnable loop in scenic Garnudden. A shorter MiniBackyard is offered for children and beginners, with on-site registration and a separate afternoon start time.
course_highlights: A 6,706 m lap starting and finishing at Bubblan in Toredal
Approximately 80% asphalt and 20% gravel, partly along the waterfront path around Garnudden
Several longer climbs, a final downhill section, and a flat asphalt stretch toward the finish
additional: Registration for Rönninge Backyard Run opens on 1 March 2026. Rönninge 6h (6 June 2026) starts at 10:00 and runs until 16:00; registration is via RaceID (link on the page). MiniBackyard starts at 14:00, with on-site registration. Registration for the main race is personal and binding; cancellations must be made via info@lopklubb.se by 1 October, with an administrative fee of SEK 45. The race has hourly starts: lap 1 at 09:00, lap 2 at 10:00, and so on; the final start is at 20:00. Laps are recorded with a chip (in the 6-hour race). Refreshments are served at 20:00 for the final lap. Race details: 6,706 m per lap; up to 12 laps over twelve hours; first start at 09:00, final start at 20:00; approximately 80% asphalt and gravel; women’s and men’s classes. Mini Backyard is organised by KIF Toredal, and the on-site fee is SEK 50.

name: Torsdagsløpet
description: The Thursday run in Sarpsborg was a real Easter gem on Maundy Thursday, with brilliant weather and a well-deserved break from the long-anticipated rain. The race, which takes place on Thursdays until mid-October, offers fantastic routes in the rich trail network of Kalnesskogen. Although there were some icy sections, the conditions were generally excellent for both runners and organizers.
course_highlights: The long-anticipated rain took a well-deserved break and stayed far away from the race, much to the delight of both the runners and the organizers.
Experience wonderful trails in the rich network of paths in Kalnesskogen!
The race takes place on Thursdays until mid-October, and then we run on Saturdays.

name: BlåmansLøpene Etappe 2
description: The Mountain Goats organize group training through the courses on the Wednesday before each of this year's Blåmansløp. For Stage 2, the training takes place on Wednesday, November 11, starting at Damen (the mountain road above Varegg's clubhouse) at 6:00 PM. Remember to bring a headlamp, and note that the sessions are open to everyone.
course_highlights: Group training sessions are open to everyone.
All sessions start at Damen (the mountain road above Varegg's clubhouse) at 6:00 PM.
Remember to bring a headlamp.

name: Djupadalten
description: Djupadalten is an annual race organized by Haugesund Idrettslag. The race has become an important part of the sports community and attracts both local and visiting participants. With a distance of 9.3 km, participants can look forward to a varied course that takes them through beautiful natural areas, featuring both challenging sections and stunning views. Race numbers can be picked up on the 2nd floor of DeepOcean Arena on Friday, October 18, and on Saturday, the distribution will move to a tent at the Athletics Stadium.
course_highlights: Djupadalten has become an important part of the sports community and attracts both local and visiting participants.
Participants can look forward to a varied course that takes them through beautiful natural areas.
The distribution of race numbers takes place both at DeepOcean Arena and at the Athletics Stadium.

name: Moaløpet
description: The Moaløpet is a trail run set in beautiful autumn surroundings in Bokemoa, Stokke. This year's race is expanding with a Mix class in the relay, and otherwise, we continue the traditional race as before. Welcome!
course_highlights: Trail running in beautiful autumn surroundings.
Expansion with a Mix class in the relay.
Traditional running continues as before.

images.alt_text: Woman running in workout clothes.

name: Hytteplanmila
description: Hytteplanmila is a 10 km road race held at Svensrudmoen in Hole municipality on Saturday, October 18, 2025. This annual street race, first organized in 2004 by IL Holeværingen, is known for its fast course. In 2019, Jakob Ingebrigtsen set a new Norwegian record for the 10 km road race with a time of 27:54. The race attracts participants from all over the country and offers a professional experience with live results and awards for both elite runners and recreational participants.
course_highlights: Hytteplanmila is an annual 10 km road race in Hole organized by IL Holeværingen.
The race is considered to be set on an easy-to-run course.
Participants can expect a professional experience with live results and awards for both elite athletes and recreational runners.

name: Falke-Rothaarsteigmarathon
location: Schmallenberger Sauerland, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 23rd FALKE Rothaarsteig Marathon takes place on 17 October 2026 in the Schmallenberger Sauerland. The event offers marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking and a 12.5 km AOK run. The course passes through the scenic Rothaar Mountains and is recognised by the DLV as an officially authorised popular race. More than 1,000 runners take part each year, enjoying the varied trails and forest scenery.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the Rothaar Mountains
DLV-recognised, officially authorised popular race
A range of events: marathon, half-marathon, walking, Nordic walking and 12.5 km AOK run
additional: Registration opens on 01.05.2026. Late registration is available until half an hour before the start of the respective event. Start times are staggered: marathon at 11:00, half-marathon at 12:00, walking and Nordic walking at 12:15, and the AOK run at 11:45. The event venue is Latroper-Str. 57392 Fleckenberg in the Schmallenberger Sauerland. Registration opens on 01.05.2026; no dog runs. A detailed course description is available, along with start times and organisational information on the website.

name: Hachenburger Löwenlauf
description: The Hachenburg Löwenlauf is a long-standing race with a family-friendly atmosphere, taking place on October 17, 2026, in Hachenburg. The event offers various distances, including a half marathon, a 10.5 km race, a 6.3 km fun run/team race, and children’s races. The courses pass through the varied landscapes of the Westerwald, with challenging climbs and wonderful views. Since 1989, proceeds from the race have been donated to social projects, giving the event special social significance.
course_highlights: The half marathon reaches its highest point at Gräbersberg (513 m) and features varied climbs and descents.
The 10.5 km race runs mostly along forest paths, with its highest point at 439 m above sea level.
The start and finish area is at the Rundsporthalle in Hachenburg, which has changing rooms and showers.
additional: Electronic timing without a chip; certificates for all finishers; prizes for category winners; special prize for the largest team in the team race. Late registration is available on October 16 from 17:00 and on race day from 09:00. Refreshments including electrolyte drinks, water, tea, cola, and fruit are available on the course and at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Rundsporthalle. Distances include a half marathon, 10.5 km, a 6.3 km team and fun run, and children’s races. The start and finish area is at Lohmühle, Hachenburg. Electronic timing without a chip; certificates for all finishers; prizes for category winners; refreshments on the course and at the finish. Registration is online only.

name: Herbstlauf des LSV Porz
organizer: LSV Porz / Kölner Lauf- und Nordic-Walkingteam
description: The LSV Porz Autumn Run is Cologne’s oldest road race and takes place in the picturesque Leidenhausen recreation area. The event offers distances from 1 km to 10 km, measured in accordance with the German Athletics Association (DLV) regulations and eligible for rankings. Both competitive runners and recreational joggers can enjoy the autumn scenery as they run. The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne and the surrounding area, and is often used by top runners to assess their form.
course_highlights: Running routes through the Leidenhausen recreation area amid autumn scenery
The 5 km loop is one of the fastest running routes in Cologne
Routes measured in accordance with DLV regulations and eligible for rankings
additional: Race numbers must be worn on the chest. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Late registration is possible on the day of the event for a fee of €2; school students are exempt from the fee. No liability is accepted for theft, accidents or other damage. Payment is by SEPA direct debit a few days before the event. No entry fee will be debited if the event is cancelled. Courses measured, registration until 14.10.2025, start times from 11:00, parking nearby, participation in running and Nordic walking events

name: Krummenseelauf
description: The Krummensee Run is a traditional road race in Mittenwalde, Brandenburg, organized by WSG 1981 Königs Wusterhausen since 1980. The course runs around Lake Krummensee, the event’s central feature. Three distances are offered (3.6 km, 7.2 km and 15 km), as well as Nordic walking; all start in the morning. The event typically takes place in autumn and is part of the Oder-Spree Cup, making it appealing to both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Loop around Lake Krummensee
Start on Krummenseer Straße by the sports field in Schenkendorf
Road race with distances of 3.6 km, 7.2 km and 15 km
additional: All races and Nordic walking start in the morning, within a few minutes of one another. The event is part of the Oder-Spree Cup and typically takes place in autumnal weather, with an average temperature of 14 °C. The event takes place in October, with the start and finish in Schenkendorf, Mittenwalde. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and scenic route around Lake Krummensee.

name: Panoramalauf Niedenstein
description: The 24th Niedenstein Panoramic Run takes place on October 17, 2026, in Niedenstein. The event is organized by SG 1898 Chattengau e.V. and Lauftreff Niedenstein. The run features an attractive course around the Hessenturm Stadium and the clubhouse, set amid the beautiful landscape of the region. Participants can look forward to a well-organized running event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Hessenturm Stadium in Niedenstein
Run through the picturesque surroundings of Niedenstein
Event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup
additional: Undulating terrain, family-friendly, children’s and youth races, finish at Hessenturm Stadium

name: Prignitzer Moormeile
description: The Prignitzer Moormeile in Bad Wilsnack is a traditional race taking place for the 26th time on October 17, 2026. The event offers various distances from 1 km to 12.4 km, running through Wilsnack’s forests, the spa gardens and around the Karthanehalle. The races are suitable for children, young people and adults, and are part of the Prignitz Cup and the Brandenburg Cup. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere, good course support and professional timing.
course_highlights: 12.4 km and 7.8 km through Wilsnack’s forests on asphalt and forest trails
3 km route through the spa gardens
1 km circuit in front of the Karthanehalle
additional: Late registration is available on race day from 08:00 to 09:30, provided the maximum of 550 participants has not yet been reached. The late registration fee is an additional 5 euros on top of the entry fee. The start and finish are at the Karthanehalle in Bad Wilsnack, where showers and toilets are also available. Overall winners receive trophies. Dogs are not permitted during the race. There are drink stations on the longer routes. The event offers online registration, refreshments, showers and prizes for the top runners. The Moormeile is also known for famous guests such as Dieter Baumann and high participant numbers.

name: TeutoMarsch
location: Grundschule Hohne, Lengerich-Hohne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Teutomarsch is a unique hiking and running experience through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area. Organized by Turnverein Hohne von 1911 e.V. in Lengerich, the Teutomarsch offers two routes designed to delight participants. The event is very popular, and starting places fill up quickly. The exact route is still being finalized, but promises to be a fantastic and unique course. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and dogs are allowed on a leash.
course_highlights: A unique route through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area
Two different routes for a special experience
A nature experience in the Lengerich-Hohne region
additional: Registration for the 2026 Teutomarsch sold out within 30 minutes, with 500 starting places. There is a waiting list. Participants consent to being photographed and filmed and to the publication of the resulting images and footage. Entry fees are non-refundable. Minimum age: 16. Dogs are allowed on a leash. The organizer accepts no liability for personal injury, property damage, or loss or theft. Trail running, no timekeeping, refreshment stations along the route, start and finish at Grundschule Hohne, participant limit: 500.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail is a trail-running series held on the hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km and 11 km, providing a range of challenges for trail runners. It showcases the beauty of the Kashubian landscape and regional attractions, and participants can look forward to excellent aid stations along the course. The event is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme and organised by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Excellent aid stations along the course
additional: The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km and 11 km, as well as the Junior Trail run of up to 1 km. The races take place at KJ Barłomino. The event promotes regional trails and tourist attractions in Pomerania and is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme. The event is supported by Coconaut and features courses at various difficulty levels, an attractive base in Barłomino and beautiful views of Kashubia.

name: Pomerania Ultra-Trail®
description: Pomerania Ultra-Trail® is a series of trail races held on the hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, providing a range of challenges for trail runners. The races showcase the beauty of the Kashubian landscape and regional attractions, and participants can expect well-stocked aid stations along the course. The event is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme and organised by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Well-stocked aid stations along the course
additional: The event takes place at KJ Barłomino. Five distances are available: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, as well as a Junior race of up to 1 km. The organiser is the Pomerania Sports Association. The event promotes long-distance trail running and Nordic walking. It is supported by the #AktywnaWieś programme. The event features multiple distances, routes through the beautiful Kashubian landscape, support from #AktywnaWieś, and a base at KJ Barłomino.

Run for Kika Amsterdam

name: 50e Jan Koudstaal Dijkloop - Halve Marathon Schoonhoven
description: The 50th Jan Koudstaal Dijkloop in Schoonhoven is a running event with several distances, including 1.5 km, 6 km, 10 km, and the 21.1 km half marathon. The race is affiliated with the Atletiekunie and offers a varied course for both recreational and more experienced runners. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the beautiful surroundings of Schoonhoven. Prices range from €3.00 to €15.00, depending on the distance.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from 1.5 km to 21.1 km (half marathon)
Affiliated with the Atletiekunie
Held in the Schoonhoven area
additional: Registration is available via online forms, and the event is affiliated with the Atletiekunie. Extra amenities such as a DJ and a poffertjes stall add to the festive atmosphere.

name: Bierrun Groningen
description: The Bierrun Groningen on 17 October 2026 is a sociable social fun run of approximately 8 kilometres through the city of Groningen. Along the route, you’ll visit four local breweries, where you can sample five delicious Groningen beers. There is no timekeeping; the focus is on running together, enjoying beer and discovering interesting stories about beer. The start and finish are at Folkingebrew The Pub, and afterwards there’s a get-together for one last drink and a chance to relax.
course_highlights: Route of approximately 8 km passing 4 Groningen breweries
5 tasting glasses of delicious local beers
Start and finish at Folkingebrew The Pub (Boterdiep)
additional: There are 2 start groups: one at 13:00 and one at 13:30. There is no timekeeping; it’s a social run. An exclusive Runners Bier can be ordered in advance and will be ready on the day. After the run, there’s a get-together with more beer. Participants receive a sporty keepsake and a unique medal at the finish. The route starts at Folkingebrew The Pub, where you can order an exclusive Runners Bier. The event focuses on fun, sociability and discovering Groningen beers.

name: A. Vogelloop
description: The A.Vogelloop is a welcoming running event taking place on 17 October 2026 in 't Harde. The race is organised by the Wallenloop and Havenloop together with A.Vogel, and supports the Opkikker Foundation. The route crosses the beautiful Zwaluwenburg estate, with an unpaved 5-kilometre loop through woodland and a start and finish in the attractive A.Vogel Gardens. The event welcomes both recreational and professional runners, and children can take part in special youth distances, with medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Unpaved 5-kilometre loop through the woods and past a woodland pond
Start and finish in the A.Vogel Gardens, among beech trees and rhododendrons
Youth run entirely within the A.Vogel Gardens
additional: Start and finish at the A.Vogel visitor centre. Facilities include a pagoda tent, a water station, coffee, tea and soft drinks for sale, a few product stalls, toilets and a water tap. Prizes for the top three adults and children; medals for all young participants. Parking at Eperweg 3-5; cycling is recommended. The race is organised in collaboration with local clubs and charities, offering a recreational and sporting event for all ages.

name: Boerbos cross
organizer: Stichting De Hondsrug UNESCO Global Geopark
description: The Boerbos Cross in Rolde is a challenging cross-country race through the unique landscape of the Boerbos, part of the UNESCO Global Geopark De Hondsrug. The route follows unpaved paths over hills, heathland and sand drifts, with distances for juniors, seniors and masters. The race is organised by Loopgroep SGO, Gieten and Vomos and is part of the Hondsrug cross circuit. Timing is chip-free, and participant numbers are limited.
course_highlights: Unpaved paths through forest and heathland
Historic sand drift with challenging hills
Varied terrain of sand and hills
additional: There are three categories: juniors (ages 12–17, approx. 5 km), seniors and masters, with a short distance (5 km) and a long distance (approx. 9 km). Timing is chip-free. A waiting list may be available if registration is full. Public transport is available, with a stop within walking distance. The course is approximately 5 or 9 km through forest and sand drifts. Registration is via inschrijven.nl. The maximum is 100 participants for the Boerbos Cross only and 250 for the cross circuit.

name: Dutch Backyard Ultra Zeewolde
description: The Dutch Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarun in which participants start the same 6.706 km loop every hour. There is no set finish; anyone who completes the loop within the hour starts again exactly one hour later. The event lasts as long as the participants can keep going, with just one winner: the last runner to complete a loop, the “last man standing.” The route in Zeewolde runs through Scoutinglandgoed and mainly takes in natural surroundings with little elevation gain.
course_highlights: Each loop is exactly 6.706 km long
Route through Scoutinglandgoed Zeewolde with little elevation gain
Natural area with quiet, unpaved paths
additional: Participants must complete each loop within an hour to be allowed to start the next one. No personal assistance is allowed during a loop; only shared aid stations are permitted. Artificial aids such as poles may not be used. Participants who do not finish within the hour receive a DNF. Each runner’s distance is shared. Participants and crew have access to the base camp, an open field the size of a football pitch where the loop starts and finishes. The race is held at Scoutinglandgoed Zeewolde, where campers are not allowed and tents must be 4x4 metres. Only one participant is expected to reach the finish, making the race particularly challenging.

name: Ørestad Halv Marathon - Verdens hurtigeste rute
description: Ørestad Half Marathon is a new, professionally organized half marathon. The race will be held for the first time on Sunday, October 19, 2025, with the start and finish at Nat

images.alt_text: Ørestad Halv Marathon - Verdens hurtigeste rute

name: Parforcetrailløbet
description: We look forward to the Parforce Trail Run in beautiful Gribskov again in autumn 2025. There will be a Night Run on 18 October and a regular trail run on Sunday

name: TRAILS - Køge Marina
description: Køge Marina is an exciting trail destination with a central location and a lovely harbour setting that makes it truly unique. Køge Marina Trail finde

name: Täljemilen
description: Enhörna IF presents Täljemilen — perhaps the fastest officially measured 10 km race of the autumn, at Geneta Sportfält in Södertälje. The course is 100% on cycle and pedestrian paths and fully paved, making it very fast and suitable for runners chasing a personal best. Water is available at 5 km and at the finish. Instead of medals, the organizer donates an amount to Barncancerfonden for every registered runner. Prizes are awarded to the top three in the women’s and men’s categories, and there is also a draw for approximately 20 prizes.
course_highlights: Officially measured course (approved by a course measurer from the Swedish Athletics Federation)
100% paved cycle and pedestrian paths — a very fast course
Water station at 5 km and at the finish
additional: Changing rooms are available on site, but the organizer recommends that participants arrive changed. On-the-day registration is possible if the race is not full. The organizer does not award medals and instead donates an amount to Barncancerfonden for each registered runner. Prizes for the top three in the women’s and men’s categories, plus a draw for approximately 20 prizes. Names and photos from race day may be published on the club’s website and social media. Contact details: Henrik Kvarnlöt 073-0400790 and Peter Ness 070-3791299. Registration deadline: 15 October; on-the-day registration is possible if places are available; water at 5 km and at the finish; no medals will be awarded this year; approximately 20 prizes will be drawn among all participants; contact details are provided in the text on the event page.

name: Skövdeloppet
description: Skövdeloppet returns in 2026 with a new, city-side course that mainly follows walking and cycling paths through several of Skövde’s residential areas. Race day is 18 October, and the routes are designed to be easy-running urban courses suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Three distances are offered (21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km), with a shared start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde.
course_highlights: A new route that mostly follows walking and cycling paths through residential areas
Passes the Södra Ryd church ruins, Vadsboleden, Aspö, Havstena and Billingen/Dälderna
Start and finish at the small car park by the tennis hall at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde
additional: All distances start and finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde (the small car park by the tennis hall). The race office can accept late entries subject to availability until 30 minutes before the start; entries may be accepted from 08:30 on race day. Parking is available at Billingehov’s large car park. Valuables can be handed in at bib collection and reclaimed by showing your race bib. Terrain: a city-side course on walking and cycling paths. Start/finish at Lillegårdens Fritidsområde. Distances: 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km. Parking at Billingehov’s large car park. GPX files are available. Course information may change.

name: Tjurruset (Haningen)
location: Rudans friluftsområde, Haninge, Stockholm County, Sweden
description: Tjurruset is a challenging and fun cross-country race through overgrown woodland with natural obstacles in the Rudan Outdoor Recreation Area in Haninge. The race offers 5- and 10-kilometre distances, with muddy sections, trail paths and challenging terrain. Tjurruset is known for its fighting spirit and is open to both experienced runners and beginners who don’t mind getting dirty and muddy. Showers and rinse-off facilities are available after the race. The event is organised by Marathongruppen, with any surplus going back to sport.
course_highlights: Overgrown woodland and natural obstacles
Muddy sections and challenging terrain
Trail paths in the Rudan Outdoor Recreation Area, Haninge
additional: Race bibs are mailed to participants who register before 2 September; otherwise, they can be collected at the venue from 08:30. Race bibs are personal and must be worn with the timing chip. After the race, warm showers are available in tents, along with basic rinse-off facilities. There are collection points for clothes that cannot be taken home. Travel by commuter train to Handen station is recommended. Transfer of a starting place to another person is possible for a fee until 24 September. The event also includes children’s races and often takes place alongside other cross-country races. Information about registration, parking and start times is available.

name: Rådalunken
description: Rådalunken is an annual running race held in Råda, starting and finishing at Rådåsgården in Lidköping. The races take place on scenic exercise trails in Rådaskogen and offer several distances of up to 16.7 km, suited to different age groups and recreational categories. Umara sports drink is served during the race to give runners extra energy. Paprikaloppet for the youngest children is held earlier in the autumn in collaboration with Ica Hjertberg. Join us for an enjoyable, well-organised running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Scenic exercise trails in Rådaskogen
Start and finish at Rådåsgården in Lidköping
Umara sports drink served during the race
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Saturday 11/10 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 7:30. Timing is provided by C-time. Registration is through RaceID until 9:30 on race day; there is no separate on-site late registration. Distances for runners in the Västsvenska Löparcupen vary according to age and category. The race takes place on exercise trails in Rådaskogen; registration is through RaceID; Umara sports drink is served; registration is open until 11 October; the start and finish are at Rådåsgården.

name: Ekeberg Dogrun
description: The Vom Dogrun is for everyone who wants to take part in a pleasant activity with their dog. Participants can choose to compete with or without timing, and everyone is welcome to run or walk. In the competitive class, there is only one dog and one person per bib number with timing, while two dogs per person are allowed in the open class. This is a social activity for the whole family, perfect for those who want to walk, jog, or run with their dog.
course_highlights: You can choose with or without timing.
The competition class consists of only one dog and one person per bib number with timing.
In the open class, two dogs per person are allowed.

images.alt_text: Participants with dogs at Vom Dogrun. People and dogs walk and run together on the grass.
Participants in the Vom Dogrun run with dogs in the forest. The logo and event name are visible.
Woman running with dog on gravel path in park.
Participants run the Vom Dogrun with dogs in nature.

name: Lierløpet 14
description: Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses. The race takes place on a wide pathway and is well-used by runners and fitness enthusiasts in the Drammen area. This event offers distances of 5K, 10K, and half marathon, making it accessible for both experienced runners and beginners.
course_highlights: Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses.
The race takes place on a wide pathway.
The race is well-utilized by runners and recreational athletes in the Drammen area.

images.alt_text: Runners in the Lierløpet 14 on the walkway, with bib numbers and sponsors along the course.
Trail runners in the forest.
Lier station, finish line for Lierløpet 14. Train station with platform, tracks, and tunnel.
Map of the course for the Lierløpet 14, with start and finish points and distances.

name: Neskollen Ultra
description: Neskollen Frontyard is a unique Ultra race organized by Hvam IL Athletics, taking place on a relatively flat 3 km loop. Runners must complete the first lap within 30 minutes, with time requirements becoming stricter for each subsequent lap. This event is designed for the whole family, featuring a special competition for families where we crown the "Ultra Family" based on the number of completed laps. Participants who finish the first lap receive a medal, and rankings are determined by the number of completed laps within the time limit.
course_highlights: The runners must complete the first lap within 30 minutes, with stricter time requirements for each subsequent lap.
There is a special competition for families, where up to 4 members can participate together.
15 laps or more constitute an Ultra distance, and everyone who completes the first lap receives a medal.

images.alt_text: Trail runners in a race.
Runner in the Neskollen Frontyard Ultra.
Runner with a bib number at a race, tent and Mizuno arch in the background.

name: Borredalsmila
description: Borredalsmila is an exciting race that offers varied terrain and challenging hills. The courses stretch through beautiful nature in Fredrikstadmarka, and participants get to experience both challenges and natural beauty. It is designed for both beginners and experienced runners, with distances suitable for everyone. The race has been organized since 1988, and in 2014 it became the first race to run in the opposite direction.
course_highlights: The courses stretch through beautiful nature, and participants get to experience both challenges and natural wonders.
It is designed for both beginners and experienced runners, with distances that suit everyone.
The 10 km races take place on gravel roads, and partly on mountains, in Fredrikstadmarka.

images.alt_text: Cyclists on a trail in the woods.
Runners and spectators enjoy themselves around a campfire after or before the race.

name: Bygdøymila
description: Bygdøymila is a fantastic race that takes you around the entire Bygdøy peninsula in Oslo, consisting of 50 percent asphalt and 50 percent gravel on a gently undulating course. The race was first held in the 1980s before it was discontinued, but it has been revived and organized in the last couple of years. This year, there were nearly 1500 registered participants, spread across the distances of 10 km, 6 km, 3 km, and the mini race, with the most participants in the main distance of 10 km.
course_highlights: The race takes you around the entire Bygdøy peninsula in Oslo, with a course that consists of 50 percent asphalt and 50 percent gravel.
Bygdøymila has experienced a significant resurgence and has become a very popular race in recent years.
A total of nearly 1500 participants registered, with 681 lining up for the main distance of 10 km.

images.alt_text: Runners in Bygdøymila. The race takes place on a gravel road along the sea. Several runners with bib numbers.
Runners in the Bygdøy Mile ran, wearing race numbers, on a path with autumn leaves in the background.
Runners at the starting line for Bygdøymila.
Map of the Bygdøy Mile course in Bygdøy, Oslo.

name: UM/NM Terrengløp, lang løype
description: We welcome you to the Norwegian Championships in cross-country running long course at Nordbytjernet, Jessheim! The course is planned as a loop of 1.5 km that will be run several times depending on the distance. There will also be an opportunity to participate in the recreational class, where you can add a loop up Grønlivegen for a total distance of 8 km. Remember that the deadline for regular registration ends at midnight on October 3rd.
course_highlights: The course follows a developed gravel path around the idyllic Igltjønna in Rindal Center.
It will be a 1.5 km loop that will be run several times depending on the distance.
The recreational class can, if desired, add a loop up Grønlivegen to Elshaug and back via Landsem along the old Grønlivegen, resulting in a total distance of 8 km.

name: 20. Müggelsee-Halbmarathon
price_range: 15 EUR bis 47 EUR je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Müggelsee Half Marathon is a scenic race in southeastern Berlin that takes runners all the way around the Großer Müggelsee. The event offers three distances: half marathon, 10 kilometers and 5 kilometers, each available as an out-and-back route or a loop. The course passes through the historic Spreetunnel and offers idyllic views of Berlin’s largest lake and the surrounding Müggelberge. The race is suitable for runners aiming for a personal best as well as those who simply want to enjoy the community and nature. The start and finish are at Müggelseeperle, and the race takes place on October 18, 2026.
course_highlights: Loop route all the way around the Großer Müggelsee
Passage through the historic Spreetunnel Friedrichshagen
Idyllic scenery with views of the Müggelberge and Berlin’s skyline
additional: Race bib collection on October 17, 2026, from 12:30 to 16:00 and on October 18, 2026, from 07:30 at Müggelseeperle. Late registration is available only on October 17, 2026, with a late fee of 3 EUR; no race-day registration. Free boat shuttle to the start on October 18, 2026, at 8:30 from Friedrichshagen/Spreetunnel. Bag drop available; changing tent provided. Optional T-shirt, personalized bib number and boat escort tickets for spectators can be booked. Terrain: lakeside and waterfront paths; online registration; shuttle service; start/finish in the Müggelsee area; various race distances.

description: The Stadtwerke Lübeck Marathon on 18 October 2026 offers runners a varied choice of distances in the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck. In addition to the classic marathon, the event includes a duo marathon, half marathon, relay and other shorter races suitable for all ages and ability levels. The course runs through the picturesque city and offers a sporting challenge with regional championship scoring. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and emphasizes community and a passion for sport.
course_highlights: Marathon with Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring
Duo marathon relay point in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea
Course through the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck
additional: Free medal engraving is available for registrations by 31.01.2026, with name, distance and finish time. A preferred race number can be selected free of charge during the early registration phases, subject to availability. Relay event with 10 x 4.2 km. Handbike half marathon on the same course as the runners’ half marathon. Duo marathon relay point in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea. On-course refreshments include honey gels; Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring. Registration by 30.09.2026. Various race number and medal options.

name: Almetal-Marathon
description: The Almetal Marathon 2026 takes place on October 18 and offers runners a scenic route from Büren-Ringelstein to the Ahorn-Sportpark in Paderborn. In addition to the classic marathon distance, there are two half-marathon options and a relay race over four legs. The event is shaped by the volunteer commitment of numerous sports clubs and offers a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere as well as an impressive experience of nature in the Almetal.
course_highlights: Scenic route along the Almetal
Marathon from Büren-Ringelstein to Paderborn
Two half-marathon options and a relay race with 4 x 10.5 km
additional: The event is organized by twelve sports clubs along the route, all working on a voluntary basis. District Administrator Christopher Rüther is the event’s patron. Participants and spectators appreciate the welcoming, accessible atmosphere. The route runs from Büren-Ringelstein to Paderborn and includes half-marathon options and a relay race. Registration via my.raceresult.com

name: Hambacher Herbstwaldlauf
description: The Hambach Autumn Forest Run is a traditional race in Niederzier-Hambach, held every year in autumn. In autumnal weather, runners enjoy the beautiful atmosphere and the forest’s vibrant colors. Around 200 participants take part across various age groups and distances. The event is organized by DJK "Löwe" Hambach e.V. and offers a friendly, community-minded and athletic atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Run through the autumn forest amid colorful foliage
A range of distances for children, young people and adults
A traditional event with a friendly club atmosphere
additional: The event attracts around 200 runners. Results from the previous year are available online, with certificates available to print. The event is organized by DJK "Löwe" Hambach e.V. The website provides no explicit information about start times, pricing tiers or registration options. Forest trail; online registration possible; start and finish at the Sophienhöhe parking lot; event in October 2026

name: Müngstener Brückenlauf
description: The Müngsten Bridge Run is a traditional race in Solingen that takes runners through picturesque landscapes. The route starts on the narrow Schäfchenweg and features a final climb before the finish, passing meadows and fields. The race is organized by Solinger Leichtathletik-Club 1951 e.V. and attracts runners from the region.
course_highlights: Start on the narrow, picturesque Schäfchenweg
Final climb before the finish, passing meadows and fields
Race through the scenic surroundings of Solingen
additional: Results from previous years are available in the archive. Photos from past races can be viewed in the SLC gallery. The route crosses the Müngsten Bridge and includes picturesque paths and climbs; the event is held annually in October. Certificates can be downloaded online.

name: Traditioneller Sparkassen-Herbstwaldlauf
location: Sportzentrum Harberstadion Neubeckum, Beckum, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Traditional Sparkasse Autumn Forest Run in Beckum is a popular running event taking place on October 18, 2026, at the Harberstadion Neubeckum Sports Center. The event offers various races for all age groups, including a Bambini run, a schoolchildren’s run, a 5 km everyone’s race, 5 km walking, and the 10 km main race. Participants receive medals, certificates, and trophies, making the run a motivating experience for recreational and competitive runners. Late registration is possible until approximately 30 minutes before the start, offering flexibility for last-minute entrants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Harberstadion Neubeckum Sports Center
Races for all age groups, from Bambini to the main race
Trophies for the fastest runners and certificates for all participants
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event until approximately 30 minutes before the start, for an additional fee of €2. All participants in the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races receive medals; certificates are awarded for the 5 km everyone’s race and 5 km walking, and trophies for the three fastest runners in the 10 km main race, as well as certificates for all participants. Forest running event; registration and results on the website.

name: 52.Maraton Dębno 2026
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dębnie
description: The 52nd Dębno Marathon is the oldest and one of the fastest marathons in Poland, taking place on 18 October 2026. The 42.195 km course, certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA), runs through the streets of Dębno and the surrounding area, offering good conditions for personal bests. The event has a rich tradition dating back to 1966 and attracts both amateur and professional runners from Poland and abroad. Participants can expect professional organisation, numerous refreshment stations and enthusiastic crowd support. The marathon is also an opportunity for the running community to come together and a sporting celebration for the whole family.
course_highlights: A 42.195 km course certified by PZLA
4 laps — two on the Dębno–Dargomyśl–Cychry–Dębno route and two through the streets of Dębno
Surface: asphalt (98%) and cobblestones (2%)
additional: The race starts on J. Słowackiego Street in Dębno. There are timing points every 5 km. The race office is located in the Sports and Rehabilitation Hall at 10 Piłsudskiego Street. The programme includes accompanying events, including concerts and a Holy Mass for the marathon runners. The marathon is part of the “Orły Biegowe” series. Registration is online, and the event also includes races over various distances, on-course support and activities for participants.

name: XVII Półmaraton Ziemi Puckiej
location: Stadion Miejski w Pucku, Puck, Puck County, Poland
description: The 17th Puck Land Half Marathon is a well-known running event in Pomerania, returning in 2026 in a refreshed format under the STONE TRI & RUN banner. The event takes place on an updated course in an autumn setting, making it an ideal way to round off the running season. It features a half marathon, a 5 km run, and a 5 km Nordic walking event, all with individual starts. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the beautiful Kashubian region and experience the sporting atmosphere of the Puck Running Triad.
course_highlights: Updated half-marathon course through the scenic Kashubian region
Autumn conditions that are ideal for runners
Final event in the Puck Running Triad
additional: The event features three competitions: a half marathon, a 5 km run, and a 5 km Nordic walking event, all with individual starts. The organizers ensure the courses are professionally prepared, clearly marked, and secured. The event is part of the STONE TRI & RUN series, which promotes an active lifestyle and a family-friendly sporting atmosphere in Kashubia. Asphalt course; start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Puck; final event in the Puck Running Triad; registration from 12 December 2025 to 12 October 2026.

name: TCS Amsterdam Marathon 2026
location: Olympisch Stadion, Amsterdam, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The TCS Amsterdam Marathon takes place on Sunday, 18 October 2026, and is known for its fast, flat course and rich historical background. The start and finish are at the iconic Olympic Stadium, with a route along the Amstel, past stately townhouses and windmills, and through the green Vondelpark. The event attracts thousands of runners every year and offers an unforgettable experience, with enthusiastic supporters lining the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Olympic Stadium
Course along the Amstel with beautiful views of townhouses and windmills
Through the city’s green heart: Vondelpark
additional: The marathon is a World Athletics Platinum Label race with a fast course. An official Mizuno race shirt can be ordered, and an international pasta party is held for participants. The 7.5K run takes place on Saturday, finishing at the Olympic Stadium. There are also special business runs and kids’ runs. Globalrunning.com offers travel packages including an entry place, accommodation, and transport. The event also includes a Kids Run, Heroes Run, and charity runs; travel packages are available; registrations and ticket resales are handled through the official websites.

name: MOLENHOEKS MAKKIE running the hills
location: Molenhoek, Rijk van Nijmegen, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: Molenhoeks Makkie is a trail run in October starting in Molenhoek, located in the Rijk van Nijmegen. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 15 kilometres, with all routes offering a hilly course rather than a flat road race. With a maximum of 1,400 participants, it offers a more intimate running experience than large city events. The organiser, Stichting Molenhoeks Makkie, provides extensive facilities such as public transport, parking, changing rooms, first aid, AEDs, a supervised cloakroom and massage services.
course_highlights: Hilly course instead of a flat road
Start and finish in Molenhoek, Rijk van Nijmegen
Distances of 5, 10 and 15 kilometres
additional: Maximum of 1,400 participants. No on-the-day registration is available. Facilities include public transport, parking, changing rooms, first aid, an AED, a supervised cloakroom and massage. Typical October weather is cool and crisp, with an average temperature of 14°C, a minimum of 6°C and 40mm of rainfall. Make sure to register in advance; late registrations are not possible. Facilities such as parking, changing rooms, first aid and massage are available. The event is easily accessible by public transport and offers a friendly, local atmosphere.

name: Herfstloop Twente
location: Atletiek Club TION, Enschede, Overijssel, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16 km, 8 km, 5 km, 1 km
description: The Herfstloop Twente is one of the oldest running events in the east of the Netherlands, organised since 1976 by Atletiek Club TION in Enschede. The race takes runners through the beautiful countryside near Rutbeek and offers a suitable distance for every runner. In 2026, the 5-mile, 10-mile and half-marathon routes return to their original courses. The 2-mile race, introduced in 2024, is a popular distance for beginner runners and young people. The atmosphere is professional yet informal, with strong involvement from volunteers and sponsors.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful natural area near Rutbeek
Original courses for the 5-mile, 10-mile and half-marathon races
The 2-mile distance is suitable for beginner and returning runners, as well as young people
additional: The start and finish are on the track at AC TION. Participation in the 2-mile race is open from age 11. The organising committee consists of 7 people, with more than 50 volunteers on the day. Participants give the Herfstloop an average score of 8. Registration is via the website. Facilities include free parking, with a medal available for €1.50. The event takes place in the natural surroundings of Enschede.

name: Turfveld Wintercross 5, 10, en 15 km, Texel
location: De Dennen, Den Burg, Texel, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Turfveld Winter Cross in Den Burg on Texel is a challenging cross-country running series in the wooded De Dennen area near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld. The first race, on 18 October 2026, offers several distances, including 14.9 km, 9.8 km, 4.91 km and 0.75 km, with the start at Nattevlakweg. The route follows scenic, winding forest paths and is suitable for both young runners and adults. The race is part of a five-race competition; taking part in at least three races is required to qualify for the standings. The start times are 10:30 for children aged 12 and under and 10:50 for all other participants.
course_highlights: Wooded De Dennen area with winding paths
The longest distance on 18 October is approximately 14.7 km, divided into 3 laps
Sheltered start location near Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld
additional: Registration opens at 9:45 at 't Bospaviljoen Turfveld, Nattevlakweg 2. Cash payment, preferably with the exact amount, is appreciated; otherwise, a payment request will be sent. Children aged 12 and under run 750 metres and start at 10:30; all other distances start at 10:50. The cross is part of a five-race competition; taking part in at least three races is required to qualify for the standings. 2026–2027 season, several distances, courses from 2 km to 14.7 km, registration from 9:45, location: 't Turfveld, Den Burg.

name: Bunkercross
location: Landgoed De Haere, Olst, Overijssel, Netherlands

description: The Bunkercross in Olst is a unique and challenging cross-country race, celebrating its 17th edition as the sporting opening of the Sallands Cross Circuit. The entirely unpaved course takes you over historic command bunkers and through the woods of the De Haere estate, an area rich in nature and history. The race attracts a broad field, from regional top runners to enthusiastic recreational runners, and offers a challenging, atmospheric start to the cross-country season. Race numbers are handed out at the impressive De Haere Castle, where runners can also enjoy a friendly chat after the race.
course_highlights: Entirely unpaved course across the De Haere estate
Passes over historic command bunkers and an emergency hospital bunker
Varied, wooded terrain with challenging climbs
additional: Race numbers are handed out at De Haere Castle, where runners can also enjoy a friendly chat after the race. The Bunkercross is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit, which features 10 cross-country races. Start times for the Bunkercross on 18 October 2026 are: 1 km at 10:45, 2 km at 11:15, 5.5 km at 12:00 and 11 km at 13:00. The course is 100% unpaved and runs over historic bunkers and through woods. Entirely unpaved course, historic bunkers, woods, distances from 1 km to 11 km, registration via mijninschrijving.nl

name: Zeezichtloop Petten
description: The Zeezichtloop Petten takes place on 18 October 2026, starting and finishing at Plein 1945 in the heart of Petten. The event offers various distances for runners and walkers, including a relaxed 10- or 15-kilometre walk, a challenging 5 km running route completed twice, and a festive Kids Run for the youngest participants. The course passes through the village centre, along the dike with beautiful sea views, and through dunes and woodland. Steep climbs and loose sand have been avoided to make the course more accessible. The day concludes with prize-giving and the presentation of the Erik ten Velden trophy to the fastest Pettemer in the 10 km.
course_highlights: Route through the village centre and along the dike with sea views, through dunes and woodland
Steep climbs and loose sand have been avoided
A warm encouragement point at Plein 1945 midway through the second 5 km lap
additional: Online registration is open until 17 October 2026 at 17:00. The Kids Run is divided into age categories with different numbers of laps (ages 2–4: 1 lap, approximately 350 m; ages 5–8: 2 laps, approximately 700 m; ages 9–12: 3 laps, approximately 1,100 m). The Erik ten Velden trophy is awarded to the fastest Pettemer in the 10 km. Results and photos are available via the website and social media channels. Walkers can choose 10 or 15 km and go at their own pace, without the pressure of competition. Routes along the sea, through woodland and along the dike; registration until 17 October 2026; free parking; rainproof fairground run

name: Rode Loper Run
description: The Rode Loper Run is a friendly and inclusive running event held in the beautiful Vledderbos in Stadskanaal. The route has been carefully mapped using GPS and offers an enjoyable experience for young and old, whether running fast or at an easy pace. There is no official timekeeping, but every participant receives a medal and refreshments at the finish. The atmosphere is central, and the organizers welcome everyone to enjoy exercising in nature together.
course_highlights: Route through the beautiful Vledderbos
GPS-mapped paths with accurate distances
Sanitary facilities available; no showers or changing rooms
additional: Start times: 13:00 Kidsrun, 13:45 Framerunners/wheelchair users, 14:00 Canicross, 14:30 5 and 10 km. On arrival, register at the desk and receive a wristband matching your distance (white/red for Framerunners 2 km, blue for 5 km, yellow for 10 km). No official timekeeping. Medal and refreshments at the finish. The road between Veendam and Stadskanaal will be closed from 05:00 to 16:00 on race day. No official timekeeping, medal at the finish, sanitary facilities available; no showers or changing rooms. In Oosterwolde, Invictus and Rotaryclub are organizing a short schoolchildren’s race, free for schoolchildren.

name: Mjitte Run
description: The Mjitte Run in Boazum is a running event taking place on 18 October 2026. Participants can choose from distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, partly along scenic country roads and paths. The event offers a friendly atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners alike and takes place between 11:30 and 18:00. The Mjitte Run is an annual event that brings the local community together.
course_highlights: Distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km
Partly along country roads and paths
Friendly atmosphere in Boazum
additional: The event takes place from 11:30 to 18:00. Several distances are available: 5 km, 10 km and 15 km. The route partly follows country roads and paths. The race is held on 18 October 2026, and the event is actively promoted on social media such as Facebook and Instagram.

name: Renna Rundt Borredalen
description: The race starts and finishes where Borredalen Rundt starts and finishes. A few hundred meters from the start is on a gravel road, before the rest of the course continues on a trail. There is a steep and rugged hill after the section with the gravel road, and then it is relatively flat, except for a downhill stretch leading into the finish.
course_highlights: The start and finish are where Borredalen Rundt has its start and finish.
The course starts with a few hundred meters on a gravel road.
After the gravel road, there is a steep and rugged slope.

name: Snøkuten Nordhagarunden
description: The Snøkuten Nordhagarunden takes place on October 17, 2023, and has a distance of 9.5 km. The race is part of the Snøkuten series and offers participants the opportunity to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings. The Nordhagarunden is quite demanding, and participants experience a varied course with both uphill and downhill sections. This race is a great opportunity for both experienced runners and beginners to test their limits.
course_highlights: The race is part of the Snøkuten series and gives participants the opportunity to challenge themselves in beautiful surroundings.
The Nordhagarunden is 9.5 kilometers long and quite challenging, with varied obstacles along the course.
Only 24 raced the Nordhagarunden for time, but there were plenty of joggers with reflectors along the course.

name: Hjerteløpet 5K
description: The Heart Run 5K was held on Thursday, October 24, in Holmenkollen by the pharmaceutical company Boehringer Ingelheim, to benefit Adults with Congenital Heart Defects (VMH) and the Organ Donation Foundation. Nearly 300 people participated in the event, where they could choose to walk or run 3 or 5 km in Norway's ski arena at the top of Oslo. This was the first time the race was held in Holmenkollen, and the course was steep.
course_highlights: Participants could choose to walk or run 3 or 5 km in Norway's ski arena at the top of Oslo.
The Heart Race 5K is a refreshing fun run that starts and finishes at the Ski Arena in Holmenkollen.
Everyone is welcome, and it's free!

images.alt_text: The Heart Race 5k in Holmenkollen. People gathered in front of the ski jump.
People gathered at the Holmenkollen ski jump in brilliant sunshine.
Runners participating in a race, with start bibs and spectators in the background.
Participants at the start banner for the Heart Run 5k, featuring the logo from Boehringer Ingelheim.

name: Lommedalen Rundt
description: Lommedalen Rundt is a race on the hills around Lommedalen in Bærum, first organized in 2015. The course is 19 km and mainly runs on trails and through forests, starting and finishing at Bærum Golf Club. There is also a separate 3 km race for children, and the 19 km distance caters to all levels of ambition. Each year, a few dozen runners complete more than 2 laps.
course_highlights: The course is 19 km and mainly runs on trails and through the forest.
The start and finish are at Bærum Golf Club.
A separate 3 km race for children and 19 km caters to all levels of ambition.

name: Kvalheimmila - Bislett
description: Kvalheimmila is a track race where everyone is welcome to participate. The race is held at Bislett Stadium, providing you with a great opportunity for a personal best in the 5 km or 10 km. The waves are divided according to desired finish times, and all waves receive pacers to help guide you to the finish line. But remember, you still have to run!
course_highlights: Kvalheimmila is Oslo's flattest and most even fun run!
The race takes place at Bislett Stadium, also known as the world record track in international athletics.
The arena is set up with a screen for passing times, upbeat music, and drink stations to ensure a great environment for fast races.

images.alt_text: Kvalheimmila ran at Bislett Stadium. Runners on the track with floodlights and an audience. 5 km and 10 km races.

Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C
location: Yxbackens slalombacke, Norrköpings kommun, Östergötland, Sweden
description: Yxbacken Extreme Challenge by E2C is a hill race held at Norrköping’s own ski slope. The race is described as challenging—in 2024, participants completed five tough laps of the hill—and is aimed at both competitive runners and families, with a separate children’s race. E2C is the title partner, and the event combines competition, children’s activities, and award and photo ceremonies afterwards.
course_highlights: Held at Norrköping’s ski slope (Yxbacken)
In 2024, consisted of five challenging laps of the hill
The children’s race “Lilla Yxbackenloppet” was introduced in 2024
additional: The 2024 race took place on October 19, and E2C was the title partner for the fourth year. Around 50 children took part in the 2024 children’s race and received medals at the finish; the winners received wreaths at the award ceremony. Magnus Media took photos, which were published on the race’s Facebook page. Around 300 participants in the first edition; in 2023, the event was photographed by Magnus Andersson (Magnusmedia.nu); the children’s race Lilla Yxbackenloppet by E2C was added in 2024.

name: Fredrikstad Maraton
description: The Fredrikstad Multiconsult Marathon is run in 3 equal laps of 14 km, with an additional 195 meters run first, so that the kilometer markers on all 3 laps are in the same place. The first half of the course is on asphalt, while the rest is on gravel and forest roads in Fredrikstadmarka. The course has been the same since the start of the Fredrikstad Marathon in 2001, and both the start and finish are at the FIF house at Ilaveien 132 in Fredrikstad. The lap takes the runners south towards the city, before they turn around and run back through scenic areas to the FIF house.
course_highlights: The course is on asphalt in the first half, while the rest of the loop consists of gravel and forest roads.
The course has been the same since the start of the Fredrikstad Marathon in 2001.
The start and finish are located at the FIF house at Ilaveien 132 in Fredrikstad.

name: Bergen Maraton
description: The Bergen City Marathon offers several distances for participants, including the Sport 1 Marathon (42 km), Jæger Half Marathon (21 km), BT Relay, Oris Dental 5 km, and Vestkanten Children's Race (2 km). The course is designed to be inclusive and suitable for various skill levels, with an elevation profile that provides a diverse experience for the runners. Race day starts with a group warm-up at 7:15 AM and concludes with Bryggen reopening to traffic at 4 PM. Bergen is the marathon city number 1 in Norway.
course_highlights: The Bergen City Marathon offers several distances for participants, including the Sport 1 Marathon (42 km) and the Jæger Half Marathon (21 km).
The course is designed to be inclusive and adaptable to different skill levels, with an elevation profile that provides a varied experience for the runners.
Race day starts with a group warm-up at 07:15 and concludes with Bryggen reopening for traffic at 16:00.

name: Lillomarka Rundt
description: Lillomarka Rundt is a 50-kilometer loop on trails in Lillomarka, featuring 2500 meters of elevation gain and technical trails with a bit of gravel. The route passes through Sinober, which is the northernmost point, and participants are advised to bring their own food due to the length. The start is at Skytta kindergarten, and the race takes you through rolling terrain, with beautiful views from heights of 400 meters above sea level.
course_highlights: The course has an elevation gain of 2500 meters and consists of technical trail with a little bit of gravel.
We start at Skytta kindergarten, and the first leg goes over to Steinbruvann.
Well arrived at Sinober, we are at about 400 meters altitude, almost at the top of Lillomarka.

name: Hinnaløpet
description: The Hinnaløpet is an annual running competition held for the 39th time in Stavanger, Rogaland. There are two course options: Hinnaløpet, a challenging loop course of 9.3 km starting from Hinna Stadium into Sørmarka, where 70% of the route is on gravel and the rest on asphalt, and "Hinnaberget 5980," a shorter and less demanding variant of 5.98 km. The courses provide participants with a unique experience of the region's beautiful natural areas, featuring stage climbs up the hills in Sørmarka.
course_highlights: The Hinnaløpet offers a challenging loop course of 9.3 km, where 70% of the route is on gravel.
"Hinnaberget 5980" is a shorter and less demanding variant of the Hinnaløpet, with the same start and finish.
The race starts at 2:00 PM at Hinna Sports Park, which is also the finish area.

name: Checkpoint Melshei
description: Checkpoint Melshei is a low-threshold trail run that stands out because there is no fixed route. Participants must visit three checkpoints in Melsheia, but they choose their own path between them. You can opt to run on fast surfaces like gravel or asphalt, but that means a longer distance, or you can aim for a shorter route with rougher terrain off the trails. The race is held simultaneously with Hardhausens, creating a great atmosphere and a "full house" at the SI cabin on this day, complete with a kiosk, announcer, changing rooms, and lots of people.
course_highlights: What makes the race special is that there is no fixed course you have to follow.
Participants must pass through three locations in Melsheia, which are called checkpoints.
The race is held simultaneously with Hardhausen, so there will be a great atmosphere and a "full house" at the SI cabin on this day!

images.alt_text: Logo for Checkpoint Melshei with nature and buildings in the background.

name: Checkpoint Melshei 2026
description:
Checkpoint Melshei is a low-threshold trail run in Melsheia in Sandnes. The start and finish are at the SI cabin.

The course runs between three checkpoints that the runners must visit. Participants can choose their own route to the checkpoints. The checkpoints are announced in advance so that runners can plan their race.

The terrain depends on the route choice and will vary from fast surfaces like asphalt and gravel to trails and rougher terrain with varying elevation.

You can expect to run between 7 and 10 km.

Prizes for winners in each category, in addition to random draw prizes.

Kiosk and speaker at the venue. Restrooms and changing rooms at the SI cabin.
additional: See also https://www.sandnes-idrettslag.no/orientering/arrangement/checkpoint-melshei/
course_highlights: Checkpoint Melshei is an accessible trail run.
Participants choose their own route between three checkpoints in Melsheia.

name: Helberhäuser HauBerg-Lauf
description: The Helberhäuser HauBerg Run is a long-standing event taking place for the 29th time on October 24, 2026. Organized by TSG Helberhausen, it features a revised course that follows two laps of the well-known route. The race is part of the Rothaar Running Series and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in the Hilchenbach region. TSG Helberhausen is a multi-sport club with a wide range of activities, and organizes the race as one of its many popular events.
course_highlights: Two laps of the well-known HauBerg Run course
Part of the Rothaar Running Series
A long-standing race in the Hilchenbach region
additional: The course was revised for 2025. The event is part of TSG Helberhausen’s diverse sports program; the club has more than 20 departments and offers a wide range of sports. The 2026 anniversary edition features a special course layout, with all runners completing the routes in reverse. The event offers a range of competitions, including children’s races and Nordic walking, on a challenging, hilly course.

name: Nordwalder Laufspektakel
description: The Nordwalde Running Spectacle is a popular running event with various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon, as well as children’s races. It takes place annually in Nordwalde and attracts numerous runners looking forward to a sporting challenge. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good organisation. It offers suitable running options for competitive runners, families and children alike.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon
Children’s races over 1 km and 2 km
Participant and course records for the 5 km and half marathon
additional: The event takes place annually and offers children’s races alongside the main distances. It combines a sporting challenge with a family-friendly atmosphere. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. The event takes place in Nordwalde, with more than 800 participants at the last edition, including record-breaking times and food and drink.
