description: The Veluwe Winter Competition 2026-2027 is an accessible mountain bike competition held on a variety of challenging and varied courses in the Veluwe region, including Nunspeet, Soest, Oldebroek, Apeldoorn, Deventer, Harderwijk, Ede/Lunteren and Zutphen. Races are timed and consist of multiple laps, making them suitable for experienced recreational mountain bikers. The competition comprises up to 9 races and is open to participants with a KNWU or NTFU licence, with enjoyment and sportsmanship at its heart.
course_highlights: Varied courses in and around the Veluwe
Timed races with 5 to 10 laps
An easier B-line is available on difficult sections
additional: The races begin with a draw to determine the first starting rows at Nunspeet and Soest; from Oldebroek onwards, riders are lined up according to the current standings. The starting order of categories 8 & 9 and 10 & 11 alternates from race to race. A transponder is required and is attached to the handlebar plate. Races are timed rather than distance-based and last 5 to 10 laps. The best 5 results count towards the overall standings. A day licence is no longer required; participation without a licence is at your own risk. Registration is via inschrijven.nl and is also possible on-site, with mobile payment or cash. The competition includes several events in autumn and winter at locations such as Nunspeet, Soest, Oldebroek, Apeldoorn, Deventer, Harderwijk, Ede / Lunteren and Zutphen. Registration is handled via email, and detailed route information is available. Live results are displayed on the website.

name: All4running Crosscircuit
description: The All4running Crosscircuit is a series of five challenging cross-country races held in North Holland at various locations, including Hoorn, Wieringerwerf, Den Helder and Spierdijk. The races vary in distance and are suitable for a range of age categories, from juniors to seniors. Participants can register for the entire circuit or for individual races. The circuit offers a sporty and friendly atmosphere, with a ranking and attractive prizes for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Varied courses in wooded areas and sports park settings
A range of distances for juniors and adults, from 1,000 metres to 10,000 metres
Races at various locations in North Holland, including Risdammerhout and Dijkgatbos
additional: You can register for the entire circuit or for an individual race. Participants must return their chip after the race to avoid additional costs. A points system determines the final ranking, with the best four results counting and bonus points awarded for taking part in all five races. Found items are kept for 14 days by the organising club. Final prize categories are divided by age and gender. Cross-country races in Hoorn, Wieringermeer and Spierdijk; registration available on race day; return your chip and prizes awarded to top finishers.

name: Battle of the Zekskes
description: The Battle of the Zekskes is the very first Cornhole tournament in Velden, an accessible and sociable game in which teams of at least four people throw beanbags at a wooden board to score points. The event takes place on 18 October 2025 and is organized by Sportvereniging Velden. Alongside the sporting competition, an evening celebration is also planned, making it a fun combination of competition and socializing for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Accessible cornhole game with beanbags and wooden boards
Teams of at least 4 people
Held at Theo Lommen Sportpark in Velden
additional: The minimum age to participate is 16. An evening celebration is planned after the tournament. Teams consist of at least 4 people. Cornhole game, teams of at least 4 people, evening celebration after the tournament

name: Nacht van de Nacht wandeling
description: The Night of the Night walk in Breda is a special experience where you walk in silence through the darkness and enjoy the natural nighttime surroundings. During the walk, you can experience the peace and quiet and, weather permitting, a beautiful starry sky. The activity highlights the importance of darkness and combating light pollution, and is suitable for a broad audience who enjoy nature and quiet.
course_highlights: Walk in complete darkness
Experience silence and nature at night
Possibility of seeing stars in clear skies
additional: The Night of the Night includes various activities such as walks, boat trips, stargazing and lectures. Some activities are wheelchair-friendly and suitable for children. Participants can sign up via an online form. The campaign aims to raise awareness of light pollution and the importance of darkness for nature and health. Various activities include stargazing, walks, boat trips and lectures, focusing on darkness and the nighttime experience.

name: Sønderjysk Crossløb 2026/27 - Cup tilmelding alle løb
Yddingeloppet
description: Yddingeloppet is one of Skåne’s largest cross-country races, organised by Heleneholms IF in the autumn-coloured Bokskogen forest in Torup. The race starts and finishes at Torups Friluftsgård and traditionally takes place on the last Sunday in October (2026-10-25). The course runs through forest terrain and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational runners who want to experience nature in autumn. All practical information and the race invitation are available on the event’s information pages.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in Bokskogen (Torup)
Start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård
Autumn scenery and trails — traditionally held on the last Sunday in October
additional: Registration is via AnmälMigNu (see the registration page). The invitation, race categories, entry fees, course description, race information, start list and practical information are available in the tabs on the left-hand side of the event page. Race contact: tavling@heleneholmsif.se. Heleneholms IF office: kansli@heleneholmsif.se, tel. 040-19 42 20. Cross-country race in Bokskogen, Torup; two distances (12 km and 6 km); start/finish at Torups Friluftsgård; course map available; registration via AnmälMigNu; contact tavling@heleneholmsif.se.

name: Kilterrängen
description: Are you one of those who prefer trails to asphalt? Whether you’re a curious beginner, a recreational runner or an elite runner, Kilterrängen is for you. The 16 or 6 km trail race takes place in autumnal Kil, with a few tough final kilometres full of hills, including the notorious ski slope.

images.alt_text: Deltagare i terrängloppet Kilterrängen löper längs en sjö under hösten.
Löpare i terränglopp med sjö och höstlöv i bakgrunden.

name: Sjögarpslunken 2026
description: Sjögarpslunken is an annual running event celebrating its 50th anniversary in 2026. It takes place on Sunday, 25 October 2026. The event website shows that the race has offered several distances (2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km, according to a previous registration form), and that the organiser publishes the invitation, race information, start list, map and results on the website. The website describes the course as scenic and the 14 km route as challenging. More information and course details are available via links on the event page.
course_highlights: Scenic course (linked from the event page)
Challenging 14 km course profile
Several distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 14 km (according to a previous registration form)
additional: The race celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026. The website includes links to the map and course profile, as well as race information, invitations, start lists and provisional results from previous years. A previous registration form (2020) offered a choice of distance and a choice of which day to run (23/10, 24/10 or 25/10). Content includes the invitation, race information, start lists, course map, results and course profile; 14 km course. The race traditionally takes place during the last weekend of October and celebrates its 50th anniversary in 2026.

name: Mærraskallen Terrengløp
description: Mærraskallen – Trail running for the whole family takes place at Fossum on Saturday, October 22. Mærraskallen 15 km is a challenging course (approximately 15.7 km) where the first two-thirds involve a lot of elevation gain with running on trails and in marshland, while the last third is mostly downhill and on gravel roads. It is recommended that the youngest participants run together with an adult. Mærraskallen 4.2 km is a loop on the illuminated trail at Fossum, and Mærraskallen Mini 1.5 km is a race for the youngest with an open class for everyone under 12 years old, without timing.
course_highlights: The Mærraskallen 15 km features a challenging course with significant elevation gain and varied terrain.
It is recommended that the youngest runners participate alongside an adult to ensure a safe experience.
Mærraskallen Mini 1.5 km is an informal race for children under 12 years old, without timing.

images.alt_text: Children are running cross country. Runners on the trail with race numbers in the woods.
Children run cross-country on trails.
Map of Mærraskallen Trail Run with course and logo.
Map of the 4.2 km course for the Mærraskallen Trail Run.

name: Norgestesten Løp 7
description: The Norway Test is organized by volunteers from the Jessheim Running Group and Ull/Kisa Athletics, and the proceeds go towards promoting sports for children and youth. The race takes place in Jessheim with a mass start, and the course is 3,146 meters long and flat. Simple logistics make the race efficient, with the option to take the train or park 300 meters from the start. There are also many experienced pacers to help participants find the right pace, as well as a great children's race and distances ranging from 3 km to half marathon.
course_highlights: Mass start and many experienced pace setters who help you find the right pace.
The course is 3,146 m long and flat, making it accessible for all levels.
Great children's race and distances from 3 km to half marathon.

Children and adults are running a street race. It is an event in Jessheim.

name: Glesværløpet
description: Welcome to the annual Glesvær Race in autumn splendor and great atmosphere! You can participate in the competitive class or the recreational class with Turtipp, and there is a beautiful course of 4.5 km. For a 3 km longer route, you can take the Coastal Path to Gløpsa. The Glesvær Race is a collaboration between Glesnes Youth and Sports Club, Sotra Øygarden Hiking Club, and the Trading Town of Glesvær, and the race is sponsored by local businesses.
course_highlights: You can participate in the competition class or the recreational class with Turtipp.
Great course of 4.5 km.
Participant prizes and drawing of prizes.

Trail runners.
Runner on the track.

name: Ottestad Løpsfestival
description: The race festival in Ottestad consists of three races: HOKA Ottestad Rundt 17 kilometers (with and without timing) and the Spenst race 5 kilometers (with and without timing). Additionally, there is a children's race, the Sport1 sprint, with distances of 400 m, 1 km, and 1.8 km.
course_highlights: HOKA Ottestad Round 17 kilometers (with and without timing).
The Spenst Run 5 kilometers (with and without timing).
Children's race, Sport1 Sprint, with distances of 400 m, 1 km, and 1.8 km.

Runner jumps in cross country, Ottestad running festival.
Runners on a gravel path in the terrain, with a beautiful view of the landscape.
Trail runners in the woods, perfect for cross-country running.

name: Svalandsgubben
description: Svalandsgubben Skauløp has become a term among both elite runners and recreational athletes. Every year since its inception in 1974, the last Sunday in October is the day everyone talks about. When the traditional event kicks off with a bang on Sunday, October 31, 2021, it will be for the 48th time, still in the prime of life for those enduring tough challenges. The race covers 27 kilometers of mud, marsh, and hardship, and despite the challenges, 973 participants lined up at the starting line.
course_highlights: Svalandsgubben has become a popular event among both elite runners and recreational runners since 1974.
The race takes place on the last Sunday in October, a tradition that has lasted for nearly 50 years.
Participants must navigate through 27 kilometers of challenging terrain consisting of mud and marsh.

Runner jumps over stone wall in cross country running.
Runners in cross country, Svalandsgubben.
Exhausted runners at the finish line of the Svalandsgubben trail run.
Man after Svalandsgubben with child.

name: 24. Röntgenlauf
description: The Röntgenlauf in Remscheid is a traditional cross-country race with various distances, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, marathon and ultramarathon. The half marathon is especially popular, attracting up to 1,500 participants, and is considered one of Germany’s largest cross-country races. The routes pass through varied natural scenery, with forest trails and paved sections; the half marathon covers about one third of the Röntgenweg. A shuttle service takes half marathon participants from the finish back to the start. The event also places emphasis on environmental protection by recommending reusable drinking cups.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races on a loop between Hackenberg and Wuppersperre, with approximately 95 m and 190 m of elevation gain, respectively
Half marathon with approximately 405 m of ascent and 560 m of descent; part of the ultramarathon route
Route along forest trails and paved sections; not suitable for spiked shoes
additional: The half marathon has a minimum age of 16; the marathon and ultramarathon have a minimum age of 18. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian. There is a clothing transport service from the start to the finish and a bus transfer from the finish back to the start. Participants are asked to bring their own reusable drinking cups to help protect the environment. The entry fee includes a race bib, finisher’s medal and refreshments. Distances range from 5 km to the ultramarathon (63.3 km), including children’s races and cross-country races; registration is open until 25 October 2026.

name: 26. Dresden-Marathon / DRESDEN-MARATHON
description: The DRESDEN-MARATHON has been held regularly in late October since 1999. It offers a flat, fast course through the Saxon state capital, passing its famous sights. The route goes through the historic Old Town, including Brühl’s Terrace, the Semper Opera House and other Baroque buildings, as well as the lively Neustadt district. More than 300 musicians and numerous bands create a special atmosphere along the course. The second half of the marathon runs through the Blasewitz district, with views of the palaces on the Loschwitz Elbe slope and the villas along Goetheallee, before returning to the Old Town along the Elbe.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Dresden’s historic Old Town and Neustadt district
Illuminated Waldschlößchen Tunnel and bridge, and the Großer Garten
Atmosphere created by more than 300 musicians and bands along the course
additional: More than 300 musicians and numerous bands create an atmosphere along the course. There is a marathon expo, race-pack collection and a SPARKASSEN pacemaker service. After the race, medal engraving, a photo service, showers, changing rooms and toilets, as well as award ceremonies, are available. The evening before the race, an anniversary party takes place in the marquee behind Heinz Steyer Stadium (€25 admission; limited capacity). Several race distances, online registration, health questionnaire, event on 24 and 25 October 2026

name: 35. Ricklinger Volkslauf / Ricklinger Volkslauf
location: Meisenwinkel 9, Hannover-Ricklingen, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Ricklingen Volkslauf is a local race day in Hannover-Ricklingen, organized by TuS Ricklingen. It offers flat races for adults over approximately 5.5 to 5.7 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking over the same distance. The main race is the 10 km Lothar-Mayer-Lauf. There is also a 400 m Bambini race for the youngest participants and a 1 km students’ race, allowing families and club runners to take part together, with participants grouped by age category.
course_highlights: Flat courses in Hannover-Ricklingen
Races for adults and children, plus walking and Nordic walking
Finish at Meisenwinkel 9 in Hannover-Ricklingen
additional: Running and walking events are grouped by distance and age category. There is a 400 m Bambini race and a 1 km students’ race. All races finish at the same location. The event takes place in Hannover-Ricklingen, with the start and finish at Meisenwinkel 9. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a range of events, including walking and children’s races.

name: 44. Zerbster Rolandlauf
description: The 44th Zerbst Roland Run is a traditional fun run in Zerbst, Saxony-Anhalt, starting and finishing at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium. The event takes place on a Sunday in October and is organized by the athletics department of TSV Rot-Weiß Zerbst. Various distances are offered for all age groups, from short children’s races to 10 kilometers for adults. The course is a flat 5-kilometer loop on paved and mixed surfaces that also passes through the stadium. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km loop on paved and mixed surfaces
Course passes through the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Separate categories for children, teenagers, adults, and seniors. Winners receive special 3D medals, and certificates are awarded to the top three in each category. Typical October weather: around 14 °C, mostly cloudy, with about 40 mm of precipitation. The race also supports Anhalt Hospice Zerbst and is organized as a community fun run with medals and certificates.

name: Oldenburg Marathon / Oldenburg Marathon 2026
price_range: 35 Euro für das Sportshirt (zusätzliche Startgebühren nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon on 25 October 2026 offers a wide range of races: the EWE Marathon, public half marathon, AZO Half Marathon Relay, 10 km Volksbank City Run, 5 km Müller & Egerer Run, and Decathlon Children’s Mile Run. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to take part in different disciplines. The course runs through the city of Oldenburg and offers a great running experience for participants of all abilities. Registered participants can also purchase a high-quality, sustainable long-sleeved shirt.
course_highlights: A wide range of distances, from the marathon to the children’s run
Course through the city of Oldenburg
10:00 a.m. start time for the shorter races
additional: Race packets can be collected on 11 October from 11 a.m. at the Schlosshöfe. Saturday’s pre-race check-in, from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m., is recommended. Group registration is available. A high-quality, sustainable long-sleeved shirt by Wijld is available for €35 only when registering. Race numbers may also be collected by family members. Multiple race distances, start locations in Oldenburg, special medals, event merchandise, and information about race numbers and registration.

name: Gütersloher DJK Halbmarathon
description: The Gütersloh DJK Half Marathon is an established running event in Gütersloh, taking place on 25 October 2026. The event offers a half marathon as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The courses are officially measured by the DLV and are therefore eligible for rankings. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with awards for the fastest runners in various age categories and overall standings.
course_highlights: DLV-measured half-marathon course to IAAF/AIMS standards
5 km and 10 km road races as additional events
Awards for places 1–6 in the overall standings
additional: Certificates can be downloaded from the timekeeper’s website, www.timeteam-jung.de. Awards ceremonies will take place in the tent as soon as possible after the races. Parking is available at Hauptschule Nord, Ahornallee. DJK Gütersloh accepts no liability for accidents, theft or other damage. Measurement to DLV/IAAF/AIMS standards, online registration, parking at Hauptschule Nord, disclaimer of liability, certificates via www.timeteam-jung.de

name: Oeventroper Volks- und Straßenlauf
location: Sportplatz 'In den Oeren', Arnsberg-Oeventrop, Arnsberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Oeventrop Volks- und Straßenlauf is a local road race in Arnsberg-Oeventrop, held at the “In den Oeren” sports ground. The main event is a flat 10 km race for adults, which starts in the morning. There is also a 5 km youth race and several 1.1 km children’s races, divided by age and gender. The start and finish are centrally located at the sports ground, making the event family-friendly and easy to navigate. The event is hosted by TuS 1896 Oeventrop e.V. and is part of the Lauf Cup standings.
course_highlights: Flat 10 km circuit
5 km youth race on a flat loop
1.1 km children’s races divided by age and gender
additional: The start and finish are at the “In den Oeren” sports ground, bringing everything together in one place for runners and families. There is a three-person team classification for the 5 km race. The children’s races have separate starts for different age and gender groups. Race in Arnsberg-Oeventrop, Lauf Cup standings, parking at REWE and ALDI Widayweg

name: Oldenburg Marathon
price_range: 35 Euro für Sportshirt (genaue Startgebühr nicht spezifiziert)
description: The Oldenburg Marathon on October 25, 2026, offers runners a varied programme featuring a marathon, half marathon, half-marathon relay, 10 km city run, 5 km run and children’s mile run. The course goes through Oldenburg and Wardenburg and is known for its good refreshments and friendly atmosphere. The event welcomes runners of all abilities and also offers a public race series with additional competitions during the year. Participants receive high-quality long-sleeved shirts, and extensive services are available on site.
course_highlights: Refreshment stations every 5 km on courses of 10 km or longer, with water, sports drinks and fruit
Showers in the sports hall at Graf Anton Günther School, approximately 300 m from the start/finish area
Changing facilities and baggage drop-off on Level 1 of the Schlosshöfe car park
additional: Race packs will be handed out on October 11 from 11 a.m. at the Schlosshöfe. On race day, collection opens at 7 a.m. for marathon runners and at 8 a.m. for everyone else. Group registration is available. After the race, extensive refreshments will be provided, including drinks, fruit, coffee, tea, pastries and non-alcoholic wheat beer. Physiotherapy students will offer free massages. Portable toilets and changing facilities are available. Multiple race distances, start in Wardenburg, road closures in the city centre, finisher medals, online registration available

name: Birkhahnlauf
location: Schneeren, Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Birkhahnlauf in Schneeren is a traditional race that has been held annually on the last Sunday in October for over 50 years. The event offers distances for all age groups, from short children’s races starting at 500 metres to challenging 5 km and 10 km races for adults. The routes run through the pine forest on firm forest paths with a slightly sandy surface and no significant elevation gain, making the race a special experience surrounded by nature. New this year is a 2.3 km distance for age group U12 and above. The friendly atmosphere and promptly held award ceremonies with certificates and medals round off the event.
course_highlights: Routes through the pine forest on firm forest paths
Distances from 500 m to 10.2 km for all age groups
Kilometre markers on the 5.1 km and 10.2 km routes, with no significant elevation gain
additional: Start times: children’s 500 m at 10:30, 1,000 m at 10:45, 2.3 km at 11:10, and 5.1 km and 10.2 km at 11:40. Award ceremonies take place promptly after the respective races. Parking is available nearby and signposted. Online registration is preferred from 01.08.2026; the entry fee must be paid on site no later than 20 minutes before the race starts. Forest race, distances from 0.5 km to 10 km, children’s races, online registration from 01.08.2026, start on 25.10.2026

name: Glauchauer Herbstlauf
organizer: Turn- und Sportgemeinschaft Glauchau e.V. und Kreissportbund Zwickau
description: The Glauchau Autumn Run is a long-standing running event in Glauchau, held annually in autumn since 1986. The event offers courses for runners of all ages and ability levels, including a half marathon, 10 km, 3.2 km and 1.1 km races, as well as walking and Nordic walking. The routes pass through the scenic surrounding area on asphalt and paved paths, including sections alongside the reservoir and the castle pond. The event is a sporting highlight for the region and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running to experience autumn actively.
course_highlights: 21.1 km flat scenic run with 75% asphalt and 25% paved paths
10 km course with 25% asphalt and 75% paved paths around the reservoir and castle pond
3.2 km and 1.1 km loops around the grounds of the Sachsenlandhalle Glauchau
additional: Half-marathon time limit: 2:45 h. Intermediate checkpoint at km 14.3 (reservoir pavilion) must be passed by 12:00; otherwise, disqualification with a shortened course to the finish. Race number includes a baggage tag and a raffle ticket. Recommended parking: Kaufland, Grenayer Straße. Late registration/changes possible on 24.10.2026 from 13:00 to 14:30, with a late registration fee of 5 euros. Registration opens on 01.08.2026. Race numbers include chips; age-group rankings, team and special rankings. No refunds. Limits apply to the company and family runs and Special Olympics. Participation includes shipping of the entry fee.

description: The Ottenstein Wottellauf is a long-standing running event held annually in Ottenstein near Ahaus. The event offers various races for children and adults, including 10 km, 5 km, and several shorter children’s races. The races start at Sportplatz 1, 48683 Ahaus-Ottenstein, and are known for their friendly atmosphere and well-organized event. All participants receive certificates, medals, and trophies, making the race especially appealing to runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportplatz 1 in Ahaus-Ottenstein
A range of distances from 200 m to 10 km
Friendly atmosphere with awards for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective start. Showers and changing rooms are available at the venue. An unattended bag drop is available. Certificates are provided online. Trophies are awarded to places 1–3 in the 5 km and 10 km races. Every child receives a medal. Prizes are awarded to the largest group. Photos and videos are taken during the event and used for press and social media. Registration until 23.10.2025, start times from 11:05, showers and changing rooms available, photos and videos during the event

name: Porzellinerlauf
location: Sportplatz Am Dohlenstein, Kahla, Thüringen, Germany
description: The Porzellinerlauf Kahla is a traditional autumn road race starting and finishing at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground in Kahla, Thuringia. The 13 km race is the main event, alongside shorter children’s and youth races, making the day appealing to both families and regular runners. Organised by SV 1910 Kahla e.V. since 1971, the race combines a sporting challenge with the local porcelain tradition. Regional timekeepers oversee the course, which receives particularly positive feedback for its route.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Am Dohlenstein sports ground
13 km main race, with shorter children’s and youth races
Route through Kahla with a connection to its porcelain tradition
additional: The field is modest, with around 101 to 300 runners and more than one hundred finishers in recent editions. Typical November weather in Kahla is around 7 °C, with frequent rain. Timing is provided by regional timekeepers. The race has been established since 1971 and regularly attracts between 101 and 300 participants. The course is known for its good condition and attractive surroundings. The event also includes refreshments, showers and an awards ceremony.

name: Volkswaldlauf des MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt
description: The MTV Borstel-Sangenstedt Volkswaldlauf takes place on 25 October 2026 in Winsen-Borstel. The event offers distances ranging from short children’s races to a challenging 20.3 km course, making it ideal for families as well as runners looking for a longer distance. The start and finish are at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground on Heidlandsweg, which serves as the central meeting point. The race is part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup and promises a varied route through natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.5 km to 20.3 km
Start and finish at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground
Event as part of the Sparkassen Heidjer Cup
additional: The event is aimed at families and runners of all ages. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The Am Habichtshorst sports ground is the central meeting point for runners. Distances: 0.5 km to 20.3 km, including children’s races; central meeting point at the Am Habichtshorst sports ground; October weather: approx. 14°C, 6°C low, 40mm of precipitation, cloudy

name: VR Bank Westküsten Herbstlauf Schafstedt
description: The VR Bank Westküsten Autumn Run Schafstedt is an autumn running event in Schafstedt, Schleswig-Holstein, taking place for the 38th time in 2026. Distances include 3 km, 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as a 5 km walking route. The event welcomes adults and younger participants and fosters a family-friendly atmosphere with children’s and youth races. The routes pass through the autumn landscape in the fresh air and offer an alternative to city runs.
course_highlights: The 3 km route is flat
The 5 km run and 5 km walk include some hills
All races finish at the same finish line
additional: Children’s and youth races are part of the event. Typical October weather in Schafstedt is around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event also includes walking options and is aimed at families and young people. October weather is generally mild, with temperatures around 6–14 °C, creating ideal conditions for an autumn run.

name: 16 Nocna Ściema
description: Nocna Ściema is a unique night marathon and half marathon held in Koszalin, known for its excellent atmosphere and distinctive nighttime ambience. The course consists of laps of approximately 7 kilometres, completed multiple times depending on the chosen distance. The race has official PZLA certification, which verifies the course distance and makes it possible to set world records. This is the sixteenth edition of the event, attracting runners who want to improve their personal bests in the one-of-a-kind conditions of a night race.
course_highlights: The course consists of laps of approximately 7 km, completed 3 or 6 times
Official PZLA certification confirms the course distance
Views of the stadium along the course and Koszalin’s undulating terrain
additional: The race office for children and young people opens at around 19:00, with a limited number of places (20). The race office for adults is located in the Koszalin University of Technology Sports Hall at ul. Racławicka, about 300 m from the stadium, and remains open until 30 minutes before the start. Participants must show a photo ID when collecting their race number. The course runs along the streets of Koszalin, with views of exhibits at the aviation museum. The medal and merchandise are updated each year and are an important part of the event. The event offers different distances, including a marathon and half marathon, with reports, photo and video galleries, and options to register online or at the race office. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes and the chance to compete in various themed categories.

name: Sopot Półmaraton
description: Sopot Half Marathon is an annual half-marathon held in the picturesque seaside city of Sopot. Participants can run a route through charming parts of the city, finishing at ERGO Arena, which offers a unique atmosphere and comfort. The event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering professional organization and attractive race packs. It’s a great opportunity to experience the excitement of sport in the Pearl of the Baltic and earn a commemorative medal and T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades
The finish is located at ERGO Arena
Picturesque views of the Baltic Sea and Sopot’s iconic pier
additional: The race pack includes an official T-shirt and medal. The half-marathon route is certified and passes through central Sopot and the seaside promenades. The finish is inside ERGO Arena, providing comfortable conditions for runners after the race. Race packs available from 10 February 2026; participant limit: 3,500; discounts for holders of the Sopot Card; the event is part of the Korona Półmaratonów Pomorza 2026–2030 series.

name: XIV Bieg Nadwiślański Szlakiem Doliny D... (Tczew)
price_range: Półmaraton: od 50 PLN do 180 PLN, Maraton: od 60 PLN do 220 PLN
description: The 14th Vistula River Run along the Lower Vistula Valley Trail is an annual race held in Tczew County. Participants can choose between two distances: a certified 42.195 km marathon and an uncertified 21.097 km half marathon. The routes pass through the scenic Lower Vistula Valley and feature a mix of asphalt and gravel surfaces. The race takes place with restricted vehicle traffic. The marathon starts in Tczew at 9:00, and the half marathon starts in Małe Walichnowy at 11:00. Both finish in Tczew.
course_highlights: PZLA-certified 42.195 km marathon through Tczew and nearby towns
21.097 km half marathon on an asphalt-and-gravel route
The route is marked every 1 km with painted markings and yellow signs
additional: The limit is 400 paid participants. The start line closes 15 minutes after the start. The marathon route is PZLA-certified; the half marathon is not. The finish is at the School Complex of Construction and Clothing in Tczew, ul. Bałdowska 19. The routes have varied surfaces. The participant limit is 400, registration is online, and the event includes a half marathon and a marathon.

name: Out of Office Coffee x Running Amsterdam x ADE
description: Out of Office Coffee x Running Amsterdam x ADE is a social running clinic held on the last Sunday of October, starting and finishing at Out Of Office Coffee in Westergas, Amsterdam. The event begins at 11:00 with running drills focusing on technique and speed, followed by a group run accompanied by music. This event celebrates the final day of 30 years of the Amsterdam Dance Event, combining sport and music in a unique and enjoyable way.
course_highlights: Starts and finishes at Out Of Office Coffee, Westergas
Includes running drills focusing on technique and speed
Group run with music accompaniment
additional: The event is a running clinic open to everyone, emphasizing social participation and enjoyment. It is part of the Amsterdam Dance Event festival program and celebrates the event's 30th anniversary. The venue Out Of Office Coffee is open Fri - Sun 10 - 17 and Tue - Thu 09 - 16. Participants can enjoy a relaxed run combined with music and a convivial atmosphere, perfect for both recreational runners and fans of the dance festival.

name: Dobbeloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 1500 meter, 0.8 km

name: Duinentrail Schoorl
description: The DYNAFIT Duinentrail Schoorl 2026 is a challenging trail run through the beautiful dune area around Schoorl, Bergen, Hargen and Camperduin, featuring the highest dune peaks in the Netherlands. The trails range from 12 km to 50 km and include a swim trail and various kids’ trails. All routes start and finish at Laguna Beach. The combination of dunes and coast makes for a unique and varied running experience, with October weather conditions adding an extra challenge. This 14th edition offers a perfect location for both runners and supporters.
course_highlights: Trail through the highest dune area in the Netherlands
Varied terrain with hills, narrow paths and mud
Start and finish at Laguna Beach, right on the beach
additional: There is a test run/course preview on 17 September. The start and finish location is ideal for runners and supporters. Participants should have experience with off-road terrain and be in good physical condition. Participation is at your own risk. Trail, Swim Trail, beach activities, two-day programme, various distances, start and finish at Laguna Beach Schoorl

name: Heemstedeloop
location: Sportparklaan and Landgoed Groenendaal, Heemstede, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Heemstede Loop takes place on 25 October 2026 in Heemstede and offers an atmospheric running experience through the beautiful Groenendaalse Bos and lively Heemstede. Participants are cheered on by enthusiastic spectators and entertained along the way by live music from bands and DJs, creating a festive atmosphere. Several distances are available, including a 1 km FamilyRun for children, a 5 km, and a 10 km route that covers the 5 km loop twice. Organiser SportSupport Kennemerland ensures a well-organised and enjoyable event, with timing and unique medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Route through the beautiful Groenendaalse Bos and lively Heemstede
The 10 km route consists of two laps of the 5 km loop
Live music from bands and DJs along the course
additional: The Les Petits 1 km FamilyRun is suitable for children aged 4 and up, with two start groups: groups 1–4 start at 10:00 and groups 5–8 at 10:30. One parent or guardian may run for free with children in groups 1–4. Timing is provided by Chronorace. Registration includes a unique medal, refreshments along the route and after the finish, and changing facilities. Registration is via a digital module. Race numbers are sent by post or handed out on the day. Facilities include changing and shower rooms and a supervised cloakroom.

name: Parkcross Hoorn
location: De Blauwe Berg, Hoorn, Noord-Holland, Netherlands
description: The Parkcross in Hoorn, organized by A.V. Hollandia, is an annual cross-country race held at the De Blauwe Berg sports complex. The race is part of the All4running Crosscircuit and attracts both youth and senior runners. The Parkcross offers a challenging course in a park-like setting, suitable for runners of different levels. The organizers are known for their hospitality and good facilities for participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in a park-like setting
Challenging terrain with natural features
Suitable for youth, juniors, seniors, and masters
additional: Registration is via Atletiek.nu. The race is part of the All4running Crosscircuit. The event takes place at the De Blauwe Berg sports complex in Hoorn. The cross-country race is held in Risdammerhout neighborhood park; registration is available on the day. The course features mud and hills, and the location is near Sportpark de Blauwe Berg.

name: Zeemijlenloop Delfzijl
description: The Zeemijlenloop Delfzijl is a unique running event held annually in October, and in 2026 it will celebrate its fourteenth edition. The main distance is 4 nautical miles (7.408 km), taking runners past green spaces, the sea, the harbour, the beach and historic sites in Delfzijl. The race starts at the athletics track and finishes at Molen Adam in the town centre. In addition to the individual 4 Zeemijlenloop, there is a corporate run and a kids’ run, making the event suitable for a range of participants. The race has a strong regional character but attracts participants from across the Netherlands. The course is wide, varied and distinctive because its distance is measured in nautical miles.
course_highlights: 7.408 km route past the sea, harbour, beach and green spaces
Starts at the Burgemeester Boeremalaan athletics track and finishes at Molen Adam in central Delfzijl
Passes historic sites such as the statue of Maigret and the Damsterdiep
additional: Race numbers can be collected on Saturday evening and Sunday morning at the AV Fivelstreek clubhouse and in central Delfzijl. Late registration is not available for the 4 Zeemijlenloop. The prize-giving takes place after the races. There is a party tent and a post-race gathering after the corporate run. The event takes place in October, with start and registration points at the athletics track and in central Delfzijl, and includes various race categories.

name: Jan de Vos Najaarscross
location: Kralingse Bos, Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Jan de Vos Autumn Cross is a challenging cross-country race held in Kralingse Bos in Rotterdam. It is organised by PAC Rotterdam, the oldest athletics club in the Netherlands. The course runs along natural paths with hills, bushes and tree trunks, making for a varied and demanding running experience. The cross is suitable for participants of all ages and attracts many enthusiastic runners each year.
course_highlights: Start at the Beachhouse by the beach in Kralingse Bos
Includes a hill behind the petting zoo
Natural obstacles such as bushes, tree trunks and slippery paths
additional: The cross consists of two laps of approximately 4 kilometres. The race is suitable for participants aged 17 to 70 and over. After the race, there is an awards ceremony and an opportunity to chat over a drink. The aim for next year is to also offer a shorter distance of approximately 4 km for younger athletes. The event takes place in the Kralingse Bos area, a popular location for running races in Rotterdam.

name: Het Achtje van Atledo
description: The Achtje van Atledo is a running event organised by Atletiek- en Trimvereniging Atledo in Dongen. Atledo is a large and active club with a modern athletics track and a wide range of training sessions for all ages and levels. The event takes place in a green sports area alongside the canal and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere for both competitive and recreational runners. The club is known for its expert guidance and focus on injury prevention.
course_highlights: Modern athletics track with good grip and cushioning
Located in a green sports area alongside the canal
Facilities for various athletics disciplines in addition to running
additional: Atledo offers training for all levels and ages, including a 'Run for Fun' programme for beginner runners and an 'Older Adults in Motion' programme. The club has a clubhouse with a sports café and extensive facilities for technical athletics events. Running or walking, date 25 October 2026, starts from 10:00.

name: Strand TIEN cross
description: The Strand TIEN Cross on Sunday, October 25, 2026, is the first race in the AV Oss '78 Cross Competition 2026–2027, a series of six small-scale, accessible running races on unpaved courses in and around Oss. The cross offers both a long distance of approximately 10 km and a short distance of approximately 5 km, as well as special youth cross races over shorter distances. The races are suitable for runners of all levels and ages, giving participants the chance to measure themselves against others, pursue personal goals, and enjoy running in nature. Anyone who takes part in at least four races has a chance to place in the overall standings.
course_highlights: Unpaved courses in and around Oss
Distances of approximately 5 km and 10 km
Special youth cross races over shorter distances
additional: The cross competition consists of six races. Taking part in at least four races in the same category qualifies participants for a place in the overall standings. The races take place on Sunday mornings and are small-scale and accessible. There is a youth race for younger runners. You can get in touch via WhatsApp or SMS at 06 37 30 12 02. The race is part of a series of six small-scale, accessible running races in Oss, with registration via www.inschrijven.nl.

name: Craft x Luyckx Sport Oercross
location: Former US Military Terrain, Havelterberg, Netherlands
description: The Craft x Luyckx Sport OER Cross is a challenging cross-country race, organised for the seventh time by AV De Sprinter on 25 October 2026. The race takes place on the wooded, hilly training grounds of the former American base in Havelterberg. The OER Cross is part of the prestigious Athletics Union Cross Country Series and serves as a qualifying race for the European Cross Country Championships. There are various distances for youth and adults, divided by age category.
course_highlights: Wooded, hilly training grounds of the Ministry of Defence’s Havelte-West site
Located at the former American base in Havelterberg
Part of the Cross Country Series and a European Cross Country Championships qualifying race
additional: Parking is permitted only at the car park of Darper Football and Sports Association; parking on the Ministry of Defence training grounds is prohibited. Flying a drone during the event is strictly prohibited. Test runs are organised in collaboration with Craft and Luyckx Sport to try out the course and new shoes. The OER Cross is one of four top races that count towards the national cross-country ranking. The event takes place at the former American base in Havelterberg, with registration via Inschrijven.nl. The site is known for its challenging, hilly and wooded setting. Parking is available at the grounds of Darper Football and Sports Association. Drone use is not permitted during the event.

description: The Hartekind Run and Social Run is being organized for the third time by Rotary Club Voorburg-Vliet in collaboration with Sparta Voorburg Athletics Club. The event offers several distances: 1 km and 2.5 km junior runs, an 800-meter Social Run, and 5 km and 10 km adult runs. The start is on the athletics track at Sparta Voorburg, and the course runs along Westvlietweg, Schrepelpad, the cycle bridge, the ADO stadium, and cycle tunnels. All proceeds are donated to Stichting Hartekind, giving the event a social and sporting character.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the athletics track at Sparta Voorburg
Course along Westvlietweg, Schrepelpad, the cycle bridge, the ADO stadium, and cycle tunnels
10 km participants run two laps; 5 km participants run one lap
additional: The Social Run consists of two 400-meter laps on the athletics track. The 2.5 km junior run starts at 10:15, the Social Run at 10:00, and the adult runs (5 km and 10 km) at 10:45. All event proceeds go to Stichting Hartekind. The exact course and distances are not specified; the event focuses on social and inclusive participation.

name: Nightrun Trondheim
description: Nightrun Trondheim is an exciting running experience that takes you through scenic surroundings. The first 2 kilometers around the lake are relatively flat, while for about 1.5 kilometers, it gradually rises towards the end of Baklidammen. After that, it descends towards the finish line for the last 1.5 kilometers. The terrain is mostly gravel paths, but there are also sections with forest trails and forest floor. The route starts at the playground in the woods, across the road from Ferista parking, and you run counterclockwise.
course_highlights: The first 2 kilometers around the lake are relatively flat.
The course steadily rises towards the end of Baklidammen.
The surface is mostly gravel path, with some sections of forest trail and forest floor.

images.alt_text: Runners on a forest trail.
Women run in cross country races. The course is marked with white lines.
Runners at the starting line. Several runners are ready for the race.
Runners with headlamps in the Ledlenser Nightrun Trondheim.

name: Kullamannen by UTMB
description: Set along the rocky shores of Sweden's Kullaberg, Kullamannen by UTMB® offers trail courses that range from a fast 20 km to a challenging 100-mile test of endurance. Runners traverse rocky headlands, beech and pine forests, and coastal paths with dramatic ocean views, making it an adventure-focused event for trail runners of varying ambitions. The event weekend combines technical coastal terrain, well-supported aid stations and organised race services to welcome both international and local participants.
course_highlights: Rocky coastal trails and cliffs along Kullaberg with ocean views
Runs through beechwood and pine forest singletrack and compact dirt trails
North Shore 20K features narrow beachside paths and a night start (headlamp required)
additional: Minimum ages: North Shore open to runners born in 2010 or before. Registration sales windows: UTMB Index holders 18 - 20 Nov 2025 (exclusive), open to all from 20 Nov 2025 until 10 Oct 2026 or until sold out. Registration includes race bib, access to aid stations, baggage transport depending on distance, medical assistance and after-race services. Transfer to a shorter distance allowed until 3 weeks before the event (deadline: 2026-10-10). Bib distribution and expo in Båstad on the event weekend. Races range from 22 km to 100 miles; start in Höganäs, via Mölle and Kullaberg, finish in Båstad; November weather can be tough; DNF rate 40-60% for 100-milers; Running Stone lottery and direct qualification for the UTMB World Series Finals.

name: Halloweenloppet
description: Trail race in the dark.

Deltagare springer på en stig i mörker med pannlampor på Halloweenloppet.

name: Finalloppet Göteborg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Parvelbanan, ca 250 m, anmälan endast på plats tävlingsdagen. 40 kr

description: Finalloppet is western Sweden’s largest cross-country race. It has been organised by Göteborgs Skidklubb since 1968 and is held at Skatås Motionscentrum in Gothenburg. The event offers several distances (19 km, 10 km, 5.3 km, 2.3 km and 1.9 km, as well as Paraloppet and Parvelbanan) for both competitive and recreational runners. The courses alternate between technical trail sections and wider forest roads, and are marked with clear arrows and kilometre markers. The organiser brings the finish area and services together at the event venue at Skatås and provides water stations, medical care and a sweep crew on all courses.
course_highlights: The 19 km course has an advanced trail section of approximately 2,500 metres
The 10 km course includes a trail section just over 500 metres long that is often wet, muddy and rocky
The courses are marked with orange arrows and coloured kilometre markers; the leading groups are guided by a cyclist
additional: Registration is handled via RaceID (payment by card, Swish or Google Pay and Mobile BankID). You can register several people at the same time and buy gift cards via RaceID. The organiser offers Startklar insurance as an optional add-on, which reimburses the entry fee in the event of illness, injury or pregnancy. The event venue is at Skatås Motionscentrum, with finish and service tents, a medical tent at the finish, and medical staff at certain water stations (Ugglemossen and Svarttjärn). The sweep crew sets off after the last start for each course and is responsible for runners still on the course. Donate 50 kronor to Jontefonden when registering; a GPX file is available to download for the 19 km course.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
location: Huskvarna, Jönköping Municipality, Jönköping County, Sweden
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, very hilly trail race held in Huskvarna, near Lake Vättern. The event offers several distances for adults and children, including 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, and children’s and youth classes. The courses run partly on trails and partly off-trail, with challenging hills such as Strutsabacken, where the Bergatroll title is awarded to the fastest runner up the hill. The event is family-friendly, with changing rooms, showers, refreshments, and safety staff along the course.
course_highlights: A tough, very hilly trail race, partly on trails and partly off-trail
Strutsabacken (the ski slope), a challenging hill with the Bergatroll competition
Aid stations with water, sports drinks, and bananas on the longer distances
additional: Race bibs with timing chips can be collected on race day by 11:15 at the latest and must be worn visibly on the front of your shirt. Chip timing records both finish time and the time taken to run up Strutsabacken. Aid stations on various distances provide water, sports drinks, and bananas. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the IKHP lodge. Valuables can be handed in and collected at race-bib pickup. Safety staff and Red Cross medical personnel will be on site. Children’s and youth classes start at 10:45, adult classes at 11:30, and the 400 m Knattetrollen has a free start time between 10:00 and 12:00. Trail race with hilly terrain, on-site registration, medals for all participants, prizes for top finishers and the Bergatroll, and safety measures including medical support.

name: RunRudskogen
description: A 10-kilometer race on the very main track of Rudskogen, where the perfect asphalt usually belongs to screeching tires and roaring engines. RunRudskogen is a unique opportunity to run in the footsteps of motorsport, surrounded by the vibrant energy of Norway's most famous racetrack. Here, you can test your limits whether you are an experienced runner looking for a race event you have never experienced before, or looking for a fun activity for friends or the work crew!
course_highlights: The race takes place at Rudskogen's main track, known for its perfect asphalt.
RunRudskogen offers a unique opportunity to run in the footsteps of motorsport.
The event is suitable for both experienced runners and those looking for a fun activity with friends.

images.alt_text: Runners on the way.
Rudskogen racetrack, a running track for RunRudskogen.
Runners at Rudskogen racetrack during a race.
Rudskogen racetrack map. Red lines mark the course.

name: Kondisløpet Langdistanse
description: Set yourself a training goal for the running season and sign up for the Kondisløpet long distance event. Here you can choose between the distances of 10 kilometers and half marathon. The race will take place in Elverum on November 1st, and the organizer, Kondtreninga Elverum, also offers a virtual option for those who wish to run wherever they want during the period of November 1st to 9th. When you sign up, you will receive a link to a page where you will enter your time, and timing during the physical event will be conducted via Strava.
course_highlights: Choose between the distances of 10 kilometers and half marathon.
Physical event in Elverum on November 1st.
Virtual solution available from November 1st to 9th.

images.alt_text: Runners participating in a road race. Winter weather, runners on paved road.
Runners at the starting line in a forested area.
Runners on a path alongside a road on a sunny day.
Banner for kondis.no with runners.

name: Hålandsheia Rundt
description: Hålandsheia Rundt is a popular running event in Mandal, combining trail and road over a distance of 11 km. The race starts and finishes at Frøyland School, taking participants through the beautiful and hilly landscape of Hålandsheia. The route goes around the entire Hålandsheia, offering fantastic views of the town and the sea, and includes a trip down to Buøya.
course_highlights: Hålandsheia is one of Mandal's most popular hiking areas, known for its varied terrain with marshes, forests, and bare mountains.
The route is 11 km long and goes around the entire Hålandsheia, with the option to climb up to Flovarden for an even better view.
The terrain offers open nature with pine forests, deciduous forests, and spruce forests, as well as historical sites like "The Scout Cabin."

images.alt_text: Running on a road with a beautiful view of the landscape.
Runners in the starting pit for a cross-country race.
Runners who start a trail race on paved road.
View over landscape with people and a dog on the mountain, possibly from the trail.

name: 34. Mündener Altstadtlauf
description: The 34th Mündener Altstadtlauf takes place on October 31, 2026, in Hann. Münden and offers suitable distances for runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini and schoolchildren’s races, as well as 5 km and 10 km races for recreational and competitive runners. The course is measured by the Lower Saxony Athletics Association and is therefore eligible for record times. In addition to individual rankings, there are group and team rankings, making the race particularly appealing to teams. The organizing team places great importance on professional delivery and continually improving the event.
course_highlights: Course measured by the athletics association and eligible for record times
500 m Bambini course and 1,000 m schoolchildren’s race for young runners
5 km course with a group ranking and 10 km course with a team ranking (at least one woman per team)
additional: The 5 km course offers a so-called combined ranking for groups. The 10 km course has a team ranking for teams of three, including at least one woman. Around 40 volunteers help with setup and dismantling and secure the race routes. Various local institutions, including the fire department, police, and city administration, are involved. Commentator Frank Neumann hosts the event. Courses for Bambini, schoolchildren, 5 km, and 10 km; team and group rankings; courses measured to be eligible for record times

name: 6. Halloween Run
description: The Halloween Run Bremen 2026 takes place on October 31 at Werdersee in Bremen and offers runners a spooky running experience with various distances from 1 km to the marathon. The courses are measured in accordance with German Athletics Association rules and are eligible for record lists, underscoring the competitive nature of the event. Alongside the sporting event, participants can look forward to a spooky atmosphere with costumes, lights and fog, as well as a spectacular fireworks display to close the event. The event is open to all age groups and ability levels, and includes relay races and a children’s run.
course_highlights: 8.333 km loop, measured by the German Athletics Association and eligible for record lists
Distances from 1 km to the marathon (42.195 km) in a spooky atmosphere
Start and finish area at Werdersee, with fireworks from 18:00
additional: Relay races for men’s, women’s and mixed teams with RFID bibs. Costumes are expressly encouraged, but regular sportswear is also allowed. The award ceremony takes place immediately after the Spooky Run and later for the other distances. Fireworks from 18:00 bring the event to a close. The start and finish area is between the Finnbahn at Werdersee and the Grillwiese/DLRG lifeguard station. Several running distances, including the marathon, take place on measured loops; costumes are encouraged; the event concludes with fireworks.

name: Halloween-Run-Bremen
description: The Halloween Run Bremen 2026 takes place on October 31 and offers runners a spooky race experience around Werdersee. With five different distances, from 1 km to the 42.195 km marathon, there is something for every ability level. The courses are measured in accordance with German Athletics Association rules and are eligible for record lists, underscoring the competitive nature of the event. Alongside the sporting event, participants can look forward to a spooky atmosphere with costumes, lights and fog, as well as an awards ceremony and a closing fireworks display.
course_highlights: 8.333 km loop course, measured by the German Athletics Association and eligible for record lists
Distances from 1 km (Spuklauf) to the marathon (Splatterthon), with a spooky atmosphere
Start and finish area at Werdersee, between the Finnbahn and the barbecue area
additional: The awards ceremony for the Spuklauf takes place immediately after the finish; awards for the other distances are presented later. A spectacular fireworks display at 18:00 rounds off the event. There are also relay competitions for the marathon (5-person relay). The race bib with RFID chip serves as the relay baton and must be brought by the team. Costumes are expressly encouraged but are not compulsory. Participants can register online. There are various distances and relay options; the event takes place at night and offers a spooky atmosphere.

name: Bredstedt-Cross
description: The 39th Bredstedt Cross takes place on 31 October 2026 at Sportpark Bredstedt and is hosted by Bredstedter TSV. The event offers cross-country races for a wide range of ages, from children and young people to senior competitors and numerous masters categories. There are short and long cross-country races for men and women, as well as separate age categories from M6/W6 to M75/W75, including youth and U18/U20. The event is listed as category 6.5.1, an event held away from a stadium, and offers a varied competition format for all age groups.
course_highlights: Cross-country races for children, youth, senior competitors and masters
Short and long cross-country races for men and women
Age categories from M6/W6 to M75/W75, as well as youth and U18/U20
additional: The entry deadline is 28 October 2026; online registration is open until 23:59. The event is listed as category 6.5.1, an event held away from a stadium. No detailed course distances or other practical information are provided on the page. The entry deadline is 28 October 2026; October weather is typically around 14°C with about 40 mm of precipitation, making the cross-country race a challenging, nature-oriented experience.

name: Kreismeisterschaft und 3. Halloween-Crosslauf im Örtzetal zu Munster
location: Sportpark Osterberg, Munster, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The District Championships and 3rd Halloween Cross-Country Run in the Örtzetal in Munster is a cross-country event taking place on October 31, 2026, at Sportpark Osterberg in Munster. The event combines the District Cross-Country Championships with the third Halloween Cross-Country Run and is open to children, young people, open categories and masters. Distances range from 500 metres to 10 kilometres, offering a local, club-oriented atmosphere rather than the feel of a major city race. The race takes place in the autumnal Örtzetal region and is a popular seasonal event organised by Eintracht Munster.
course_highlights: Cross-country running in the Örtzetal on varied terrain
Distances from 500 m to 10 km for different age and ability categories
Event at Sportpark Osterberg in Munster
additional: The event was postponed due to bad weather and incorporates the District Championships into the Halloween Cross-Country Run. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event uses a cross-country race format, has a local character, is open to children, young people, adults and masters, and takes place on Halloween with weather-dependent adjustments.

name: Köstritzer Parklauf
location: Köstritzer Park, Bad Köstritz, Thuringia, Germany
description: The Köstritzer Parklauf is a cross-country race held in late October in Bad Köstritz, Germany. The course runs through and around Köstritzer Park, away from the usual running tracks. The event offers short races for children and young people, as well as longer distances for adults and masters, from 500 m to the 12 km main race. It attracts numerous local and regional clubs, mainly from Thuringia, but also from Saxony and Bavaria. The 27th edition of the race is known for its strong regional turnout.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through and around Köstritzer Park
Start in the park with views of dahlias in bloom in autumn
A range of distances from 500 m to 12 km
additional: Typical October weather: around 14 °C maximum and 6 °C minimum, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event includes races for children and young people, as well as main races for adults and masters. It takes place in late October, with various race distances and categories for children, young people, active runners, and masters. Registration is possible until shortly before the event.

name: Nordhessische Crosslaufmeisterschaften
description: The North Hesse Cross-Country Championships are a regional club and regional cross-country championship held in various locations across North Hesse. The event is aimed primarily at club runners from the region competing for regional and district titles. Course distances range from short youth races of 1.2 km to longer senior races of 8 km. The races take place on cross-country terrain, not on closed roads, and are organized by various athletics districts and clubs.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain rather than a road race
Distances from 1.2 km to 8 km
Held at sports facilities in various locations across North Hesse
additional: The event is geared strongly toward club runners. Depending on the course, runners are advised to choose suitable shoes carefully, such as spikes. Results are published as web and PDF listings. Typical October weather is cool and mostly cloudy, with a daytime high of about 14°C and a low of 6°C. October weather: about 14°C, low of 6°C, 40 mm of precipitation, cloudy; races take place at sports facilities in the region, online registration is possible, and results are published as web and PDF listings.

name: TEAG – Legend of Cross
price_range: 30 € (Fun- und Nachwuchsläufe), 15 € (JUNIOR), Preise für Hauptrennen nicht explizit genannt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: SUPERSPRINT (4 km, ab 15 Jahre, Start: 14:00 Uhr, 30 €)

description: The TEAG - LEGEND OF CROSS is Thuringia’s toughest and warmest-hearted cross-country race, taking place on 31 October and 1 November 2026 in Mühlberg at the Drei Gleichen. The event features challenging trails, more than 30 natural and man-made obstacles, and a unique setting with three castles. Whether running solo or as part of a team, recreational runners can become legends in a strong community. The event offers various distances and levels of difficulty suitable for all age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: Three courses of different lengths, each with its own obstacles and difficulty level
More than 30 natural and man-made obstacles, including water obstacles at the Wechmar Reservoir
Start and finish at the Mühlberg sports ground, set against the historic backdrop of the Drei Gleichen
additional: The Fun and junior races start on Saturday, and the main races take place on Sunday. There are individual and team rankings. The 4 km SPECIAL CROSS is available for Special Olympics athletes with intellectual disabilities. Changes and late registrations are free until mid-October; after that, a €5 fee applies. Double-start offer for both LEGEND OF CROSS events in 2026 for €99. Several course distances, obstacles, junior races, team rankings, start and finish at the Mühlberg sports ground, water obstacle on the 30 km course.

name: Botaniczna Piątka – Bydgoszcz, edycja jesienna
location: Botanical Garden of the Kazimierz Wielki University, Bydgoszcz, Poland

name: Vestingstadloop Woudrichem

name: Kempenland Trail

name: 11strandentocht
description: The 11strandentocht is a walking event taking place on Saturday, 31 October 2026, along the Dutch coast. Participants can choose from four distances: 50 km, 25 km, 12.5 km and 5 km. Each route passes different beaches, with the sea on the left. The finish is always in the centre of Zandvoort. The event supports the Dutch Heart Foundation in its fight against cardiovascular disease and combines a sporting challenge with a good cause.
course_highlights: Routes run entirely over sand and unpaved paths along 11 beaches
The 50 km distance starts early in the morning (06:30 and 07:00), with a light to help participants before sunrise
There are checkpoint posts, rest stops and medical assistance along the way, including first aid and an AED
additional: Each distance has a different starting location, but the finish is always in the heart of Zandvoort. The 50 km route starts at Deltaplein, The Hague, and is a loop over the beach and boulevard. The 5 km Heroes Route is suitable for walkers setting their own pace. There are 11 checkpoint posts along the way for the long distance and 5 checkpoint posts for the 12.5 km route. The number of entry tickets is limited to ensure personal attention and safety. Distances range from 5 km to 50 km; starting locations vary; the event supports a good cause; the beach route has the sea on the left.

name: Backyard Ultra de Langstraat
description: The Backyard Ultra de Langstraat takes place in Waalwijk on Saturday, October 31, 2026. The race consists of a distance of 7 kilometers and offers runners a challenging and unique running experience in the Brabant region. This ultramarathon is ideal for runners who want to test their endurance in a friendly and sporty atmosphere.
course_highlights: 7 kilometers per lap
Location in Waalwijk, Brabant
Unique Backyard Ultra format
additional: The race is held in a friendly and sporty atmosphere, with a focus on endurance and perseverance.

name: Dalli-run
description: Athletics club De Gemzen organizes the Dalli-Run every autumn, one of the most beautiful running events of the year, on October 31, 2026. The race takes place in Heerde on the Veluwe and offers a beautiful undulating course past some of the area’s loveliest spots. The Dalli-Run is popular in the region and offers several distances, from short youth races to 15 kilometers for adults. The routes follow paved roads and cycle paths, with starts between 10:00 and 11:00.
course_highlights: A beautiful undulating course past some of Heerde’s loveliest spots
Paved roads and cycle paths
Several distances: 700m, 1400m, 5km, 10km and 15km
additional: Start times between 10:00 and 11:00. Youth distances: 700 and 1400 meters; adult distances: 5, 10 and 15 kilometers. The course follows paved roads and cycle paths. Organized by Athletics club De Gemzen. The Dalli-Run is an event for runners of all levels, with activities for children and adults. It is organized by a local athletics club and attracts many participants from the region each year.

name: Haarlerbergtrail
description: The Haarlerbergtrail takes place on Saturday, 31 October 2026, and offers challenging trail runs over distances of 11, 16, 22 and 30 kilometres. The routes pass through a large part of Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park, where runners can enjoy beautiful scenery and varied terrain. The organisers aim to make the event climate-neutral and ask participants to bring their own drinking cup. There is no prize ceremony, but every participant receives a medal as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Routes through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park
Varied terrain, with some paths closed during the bird-breeding season
Beautiful scenery and challenging trail distances
additional: Maximum of 349 participants. Online registration only. Start times: 30 km and 22 km at 12:00, 16 km at 12:15, and 11 km at 12:30. Bringing your own drinking cup is compulsory; a reusable cup is available to buy for €4. No prize ceremony, but every participant receives a medal. Start and finish at Molenweg in Haarle, near café De Droadnagel. No on-the-day registration. Registration closes on 31 October at 11:30, or earlier if the event is full. The organisers may cancel the event up to 30 October at 20:00. Cycling alongside participants on the course is not permitted. Trail through Sallandse Heuvelrug National Park; organised as a climate-neutral event. Bringing your own drinking cup is compulsory. Maximum of 349 participants; online registration. Race numbers can be collected at De Veldkamp. Limited shower facilities.

description: The Pheidippides Run is a unique relay marathon held annually at Maarschalkerweerd Athletics Track in Utrecht. Teams of seven runners cover the distance of a full marathon together, inspired by the legendary run of Pheidippides. The event is ideal for companies, groups of friends and running clubs looking to enjoy an active and sociable day together. The race starts on Saturday, 31 October 2026 at 11:00 and offers a great combination of competition and team spirit.
course_highlights: Relay marathon with 7 participants per team
Distances of 2 × 4.1 km and 5 × 6.8 km per team
Start, changeover point and finish at Maarschalkerweerd Athletics Track
additional: Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available free of charge at the athletics track. The pavilion is open, serving refreshments such as coffee, hot chocolate, bitterballen and beer. The athletics track is easy to reach by bike, public transport and car, but parking is limited and parking is prohibited on Mytylweg. The lineup and running order can be changed on race day. Relay marathon with multiple legs, starting at Maarschalkerweerd Athletics Track. Participants can register from 1 May to 28 October. The event highlights team spirit and social interaction.

name: Vechtdaltrail
distance_verbose: 60 km, Marathon, 30 km, Halve marathon, 15 km
description: The VechtdalTrail takes place on 31 October 2026 in Ommen and offers challenging trail-running routes of 15, 22, 30, 42 and 60 kilometres. The trails feature little asphalt, plenty of singletrack and varied terrain, including forest and sandy paths and rough grassland. The longer distances include several short climbs, especially in the ‘Beerze Bulten’ area, making the 60 km route a true ultra trail. The organisers aim to make the event sustainable, with no disposable cups, and provide individual timing via a chip in the bib number. Registration is only available in advance, and the longest distance has an 8-hour time limit.
course_highlights: Little asphalt, plenty of singletrack
Varied terrain: forest paths, sandy paths and rough grassland
Short climbs in the Beerze Bulten on the 30, 42 and 60 km routes
additional: The VechtdalTrail is a disposable-cup-free event; participants must bring their own collapsible cup or hydration bladder. The 60 km distance has an 8-hour time limit, with cut-off times at aid stations. Timing is provided via a chip in the bib number, which is personalised and may be kept after the event. There is no race-day registration; registration must be completed in advance. A unique event shirt can be ordered during registration. Disposable-cup-free event, advance registration required, no medals, time limits and cut-off times, participants must have their own insurance, safety measures at hazardous locations

name: Veldhoven 10 Miles
description: The Veldhoven 10 Miles is a popular running event in the Veldhoven area. The event is known as one of the most enjoyable runs in the region and attracts many participants every year. The race offers a challenging 10-mile course through the beautiful landscape around Veldhoven. The atmosphere is sporty and sociable, making it suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.
course_highlights: A 10-mile course through the Veldhoven landscape
A varied route with beautiful scenery
A popular, sociable running event in the region

description: The Snertcross is an annual running race in the Warandebos in Tilburg, organized by T.S.A.V. Parcival. The race is part of the Regio 13 Cross Circuit and the Tilburg Triple. The Snertcross offers several categories and distances, including junior races, a short cross, a women’s long cross, a men’s 55+ long cross, and a men’s long cross. The race features a challenging course with multiple laps, depending on the distance.
course_highlights: Junior cross: 2 laps
Short cross: 1 lap
Women’s and men’s 55+ long cross: 3 laps; men’s long cross: 4 laps
additional: Race-day registration is available until one hour before the start of the respective race. Payment is accepted only in cash or via a payment request using a QR code. The Snertcross is part of the Tilburg Triple, where participants who take part in three or more events receive an exclusive medal. Registration is open until a few days before the race, with race-day registration also available. The race takes place in the Warandebos, with parking available on the university campus. There are no changing facilities at the start, but facilities are available at Tilburg University’s sports centre.

name: Lage Vuursche Ultra
description: The Lage Vuursche Ultra is a challenging 50 km trail run through historic forests around Baarn, with a varied course through deciduous and coniferous forests, heathland and open stretches. The route is followed using a GPX file and offers a great mix of singletrack, forest paths and avenues. There is good support along the way, with no more than 15 km between aid stations, and participants receive a UTMB Index at the finish. This event is part of the Dutch Ultra Series 2026 and is known for its natural beauty and challenging character.
course_highlights: 50 km through historic forests of deciduous and coniferous trees
Varied course with singletrack, forest paths and heathland
No more than 15 km between aid stations; no disposable cups
additional: Start and finish at Natuurcamping De Zeven Linden, with parking available. Pick up your race number and tracker from 08:30 at race headquarters. Time limit: 8 hours; finish by 17:00 at the latest. No disposable cups at aid stations; participants must bring their own race cup or buy one at race headquarters. Participants will receive detailed information by email two days before the event. Maximum 300 participants; no cups at aid stations; start and finish at Kampeerterrein de Zeven Linden.

name: Halloween Citywalk
description: The Halloween City Walk in Veghel is a spooky walk of approximately 3 kilometres through the centre of Veghel, organised on Halloween evening, 31 October 2026. It is not a running race, but a frightening experience for the whole family, with various scary characters along the route who will give participants a fright. The walk starts between 19:00 and 20:00 at the Markt, near Matteucci ice cream parlour. Participants must be at least 16 years old; younger participants may join only when accompanied by an adult.
course_highlights: A route of approximately 3 kilometres through the centre of Veghel
A spooky, eerie atmosphere, with ominous characters along the route
Start at the Markt, near Matteucci ice cream parlour
additional: Individuals may participate from age 16; younger participants may join only when accompanied by a parent or adult. Start time is between 19:00 and 20:00. The walk is not a race, but an event with a spooky atmosphere. Registration for the Krollenloop itself is sold out, but registration for the Halloween City Walk is still open. Start at 19:00; registration via the website. Participants aged 16 and over may take part independently; younger participants must be accompanied by an adult.
