name: Bovenboerloop
description: The Bovenboerloop is an annual running event in Nijeveen, organised by triathlon club TZT'86. It offers a half marathon and an 11.4 km race, starting at the Tussenboerslanden sports complex. Participants can make use of facilities including medical care, hot showers, changing rooms and refreshment stations every 5 km. The event is known for its sporting atmosphere, and every participant receives a keepsake.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 11.4 km race
Refreshment stations every 5 km
Start and finish at the Tussenboerslanden sports complex in Nijeveen
additional: Collect your race number on 5 December between 11:00 and 12:30 at the Dos'46 canteen. Medical care and hot showers are available. You can cancel up to 2 days before the event via info@tzt86.nl. Every participant receives a keepsake. Running course, registration opens on 1 October, event on 5 December 2026

name: Sinterklaasloop Katwijk
description: The Sinterklaasloop Katwijk is part of the Duinloopcircuit, a unique running series along the most beautiful parts of the Dutch coast. The race offers a varied course with challenging dune trails and fast beach sections, suitable for both competitive and recreational runners. The atmosphere is always great, and the event is open to all ages. Join in and experience running at its best in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: Varied course with dune trails and beach sections
Unique running series along the Dutch coast
Suitable for all ages and levels
additional: Start times by distance: 500 m Kidsrun at 09:30, 1 km Kidsrun at 09:35, 2 km Kidsrun at 09:45, and 5 km and 10 km at 10:00. Rankings are kept for all distances, separately for girls/women and boys/men, based on the best four results in the circuit. The event offers various distances and categories, with GPX routes and results available.

description: The Sint-Nicolaasloop is an annual race through the beautiful Eempolder between Bunschoten and Eemdijk, with distances of 5, 10 and 15 km. The start and finish are at the athletics track at Quo Vadis. The 10 and 15 km courses run counterclockwise, with 15 km runners completing an extra loop on Gasthuisweg. Younger runners up to age 12 can take part in a 1.2 km kids’ run. The first, second and third place finishers in each distance receive a prize, for both women and men.
course_highlights: Race through the Eempolder between Bunschoten and Eemdijk
The 10 and 15 km courses run counterclockwise, with an extra loop on Gasthuisweg for the 15 km
Start and finish at the athletics track at Quo Vadis

Participants are encouraged to read the general information page; prizes are awarded to the top three in each distance and category.

name: Lierløpet 13
description: The Lierløpet is an exciting race series that offers various distances for both men and women of all ages. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21.1 km, with categories for all age groups from 11 years and up. The race takes place in scenic surroundings and follows the well-known Linnesrunden, an easy-to-run route suitable for everyone. There are also prizes for the top runners, as well as opportunities to set personal records.
course_highlights: The Lierløpet takes place on a wide walkway and is well-used by recreational runners in the Drammen area.
Participation is possible by jogging or walking 5, 10, or 21 km, and for the little ones, there is a children's race with ice cream for all participants.
The race starts at 12:00, and race numbers are purchased at Lier Station.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Lage is a traditional running event organized by the running division of TG Lage. The course runs through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park and features well-maintained forest trails, partly along the famous Hermann Trail. The run is suitable for runners of all ability levels and takes place annually in December. The event is part of TG Lage’s varied running and walking program, which also offers beginner courses and training opportunities.
course_highlights: Course through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park
Well-maintained, easy-to-run forest trails
Sections along the famous Hermann Trail
additional: TG Lage’s running division also offers a Nordic walking beginner course that covers the basics in 4 sessions of 60 minutes each. Walking poles are available to borrow. There is also a 10-session pass for time-limited training participation, valid for 6 months and 10 training sessions. The office is open on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Run on forest and field paths in the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park, on the 2nd Sunday of Advent; easy to reach, with a festive atmosphere in the gym.

name: Fischteiche Cross
description: The Fischteiche Cross is a traditional cross-country race in the Langenberger Forst near Leck, organised by SV Enge-Sande. It marks the end of the Cross-Cup series and offers races for different age groups and distances, from 0.8 km for the youngest children to 9.6 km for adults and seniors. The event features a varied woodland course and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments on site.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Langenberger Forst
Distances from 0.8 km to 9.6 km, depending on age group
Varied woodland course with typical December weather
additional: Starts are organised by age group and suitable distance; registration and results via myraceresult; coffee, cake and other refreshments available on site; awards ceremony after the race. Cross-country race in the Langenberger Forst, with distances for all age groups and registration via myraceresult. Weather-dependent, with possible winter conditions, and refreshments including coffee and cake.

name: Heeslinger Nikolauscross
description: The Heeslingen Nikolaus Cross-Country Run is a popular cross-country race held annually in Heeslingen, Lower Saxony. The event attracts athletes and families from the region and is known for its high-level sporting challenges. The races also determine the district champions of Rotenburg/W. The organizer, Heeslinger SC, is an established point of contact for sports enthusiasts and volunteers from the surrounding communities.
course_highlights: Cross-country run through varied terrain
Determination of the district champions of Rotenburg/W.
Event in the Heeslingen region with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Courses and participation conditions are available in the relevant event announcement; no entry fee is required. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children, young people, adults and masters.

name: Klausdorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Klausdorf St. Nicholas Run is a longstanding running event on the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord, taking place on December 6, 2026, in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district. This will be the 41st edition of the event, attracting runners from the region. The event offers a festive pre-Christmas atmosphere and is a sporting highlight for all age groups. Official registration is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays.
course_highlights: Run along the eastern shore of Kiel Fjord
Traditional running event with a festive atmosphere
Event in Schwentinental, Klausdorf district
additional: The official registration page is expected to open after the 2026 summer holidays. Course maps are available as images on the website. Registration is expected to be available on the official website after the 2026 summer holidays; the event is known for its good value for money and family-friendly atmosphere.

description: The Cologne St. Nicholas Run is a traditional fun run, taking place for the 29th time on December 6, 2026. The event offers three different races: the competitive 10 km TopRun, the FunRun with a variable distance of 3.4 km to 10 km for all running enthusiasts, and the KidsRun, a 3.4 km race for children. The races follow a course through the beautiful Cologne City Forest on a DLV-measured loop, creating a festive, athletic atmosphere for the whole family. The event is organized by the athletics team of the German Sport University Cologne and emphasizes community and the joy of running.
course_highlights: Loop course through the Cologne City Forest
DLV-measured course with a course certificate
Three laps for the 10 km TopRun; variable distance for the FunRun
additional: Start times: TopRun 10:00, KidsRun 11:30, FunRun 11:35. FunRun participants can choose between 3.4 km, 6.7 km, or 10 km. A preferred bib number is available for an additional €3. Race bibs include B-tags for timing; registration is closed, late registration is possible, and race packet pickup is in Cologne.

name: Melsunger Adventslauf Rund um die Koppe
description: The Melsungen Advent Run is a traditional running event held every year on the second Sunday of Advent in Melsungen. Various distances are offered: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km. The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course. The event attracts runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with special appreciation for children and recreational runners. It is organised by the running group of Melsunger Turngemeinde 1861 e.V. and is a fixture in the North Hesse popular running calendar.
course_highlights: Various distances: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
Family-friendly event with special care for children
additional: Results and certificates are provided via My Race Result. The event takes place every year on the second Sunday of Advent. Children receive a small treat (e.g. chocolate wafers) and a medal at the finish, as well as a certificate at the awards ceremony. The event is organised by the MT Melsungen organising team / recreational sports department / running group. Course distances: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km and 10 km; registration and results via My Race Result; winter weather is possible.

name: Oelder Nikolauslauf
location: Oelder Jahnstadion, Oelde, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 52nd Oelde St. Nicholas Run takes place on December 6, 2026, at Oelde’s Jahnstadion and invites children, young people, and adults to enjoy a varied running experience. With four different running distances and a Nordic walking and walking distance recognized as a performance course for the German Sports Badge, the event offers a suitable challenge for every age and ability level. The routes pass through the stadium and the surrounding countryside, including challenging climbs in Limberger Forst. The event is a popular St. Nicholas Day tradition and promotes recreational sport in the region.
course_highlights: 0.6 km loop in the stadium for children up to age 7
3 km fitness run on paved farm roads through the Bergeler farming community
11.5 km cross-country run with climbs in Limberger Forst
additional: The 7.5 km walking and Nordic walking route is accessible and also easy to navigate by wheelchair. Age-group rankings are offered for walking. The event is recognized as a performance course for the German Sports Badge. Various running and walking routes, including Nordic walking; accessible routes; performance courses for the German Sports Badge; children’s and youth races

name: Saalfelder Winterlauf
description: The Winter Run Around the Katze in Saalfeld an der Saale is a traditional 15 km road race held in winter since 1982. The course starts at the Langenschader Straße sports field, loops around the local landmark “Katze,” passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm, and returns to the start. The race is officially measured and scored in DLV age groups, making it especially appealing to club runners of all ages. The event is small, usually attracting fewer than 100 participants, and offers straightforward organization with online registration, changing rooms, and showers on site.
course_highlights: Officially measured 15 km road-race course
Loop around the “Katze” landmark in Saalfeld
Course passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the Langenschader Straße sports field. The event usually has fewer than 100 runners. Results are scored in DLV age groups. December weather is typically cold, averaging 3 °C, with frequent snowfall. The race offers online registration, changing rooms, and showers at the venue, and results are scored by age group.

name: Werdener Crosslauf
description: The 12th Werden Cross-Country Run is a local cross-country event organized by the athletics department of the Werden Gymnastics Club, a multi-sport club with numerous sections. The event takes place in Essen and offers two distances: 570 m and 5.1 km. The course is officially measured and is especially popular with club runners and running enthusiasts from the region. The event relies on the commitment of volunteer helpers and is part of Germany’s popular running calendar.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on an officially measured course
Distances: 570 m and 5.1 km
Event in the countryside around Essen
additional: Typical December weather conditions: around 3 °C, mostly snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The start is in Essen. The event relies on volunteer support. A December cross-country run, weather-dependent, and more suited to club and recreational runners.

name: Nijverdalsebergcross
location: Manege 't Oale Spoor, Hellendoorn, Overijssel, Netherlands
description: The Nijverdalsebergcross is a challenging cross-country race held at Manege 't Oale Spoor, right next to the Sallandse Heuvelrug. The race is part of the Atletiekunie’s national Cross Country Series and offers several fully unpaved laps, ideal for runners who enjoy a tough course. Race numbers can be collected from 8:30 a.m. The event attracts both recreational runners and licensed competitive runners. The atmosphere is sporty, and the event is supported by many volunteers.
course_highlights: Start location at Manege 't Oale Spoor, next to the Sallandse Heuvelrug
Several laps that are 100% unpaved
Course suitable for spikes
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 8:30 a.m. at the race office in the riding school’s canteen. Young people aged 13 to 16 start at the same time as the competitive runners. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners across different distances and age groups. The race is part of the Cross Country Series, which has 4 events in 2026. There is ample parking, and traffic marshals will be present. Various distances; registration opens on 29 August 2026 via inschrijven.nl and mijninschrijving.nl; prizes for the top three in each category; course suitable for spikes; location at Manege 't Oale Spoor in Hellendoorn.

price_range: € 11,00 voor 5,3 km en 9,6 km, gratis voor jeugd t/m 15 jaar
description: The 40th edition of the Snertloop takes place on Sunday, December 6, 2026, in De Lutte. This winter classic has been a much-loved event for runners from the region and beyond for four decades. The Snertloop offers challenging and varied routes through the hilly, wooded Twente countryside, with distances for both competitive and recreational runners. Young runners can also take part in special youth races on safe courses. After the event, all participants receive a traditional bowl of snert at the atmospheric event grounds.
course_highlights: Routes through the varied, hilly Twente countryside
Start and finish between De Elfterborgh and Bassischool
Safe and challenging youth course through Kerkebos
additional: Registration is limited to a maximum of 500 participants for the 5.3 km and 600 participants for the 9.6 km. There is a group warm-up before the youth races. After finishing, all participants receive a traditional bowl of snert. The youth distances are 1.2 km for children aged 5 to 8, 1.2 km for children aged 9 to 12, and 2.4 km for young people aged 13 to 15. Youth races and timekeeping with an Ipico chip; registration via the website; 2026 anniversary edition with more than 1,200 participants

description: The All4running Cross Circuit is a series of five challenging cross-country races held at various locations across the Netherlands, including the Duincross in Den Helder. The races are suitable for a range of age categories, from youth to seniors, and offer a great mix of courses through woods, dunes and sports complexes. Participants can register for the entire circuit or for individual races, with the standings determined by their best four results. The circuit is known for its friendly atmosphere, good organisation and great prizes for the top finishers.

Various distances for youth and adults
Beautiful natural surroundings and challenging terrain

If you are not present at the prize-giving, your prize will not be awarded. The race takes place at Sportcomplex De Streepjesberg in Den Helder, with information about registration and parking facilities available. name: Adventscrosslauf
description: The Wilscher Advent Cross-Country Run Gifhorn is a traditional cross-country race held during Advent in Gifhorn, Lower Saxony. The main distance is 7.5 km and runs through the winter landscape of the Wilsche district. The race starts at 14:00 at the meeting point at An der Masch 4. The event is organised by VfR Wilsche/Neubokel, and the entry fee is 7 euros.

Main distance: 7.5 km
Start and meeting point at An der Masch 4
additional: The meeting point and start are at An der Masch 4 in the Wilsche district of Gifhorn. Typical December weather includes temperatures around 3 °C and snow cover on most days. The race starts at 14:00, with the meeting point at An der Masch 4 in Gifhorn. Registration is via the club website. The event is a lovely opportunity to enjoy the Advent season in an active and sociable way.

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 2. Event
description: The Alten-Buseck Winter Running Series is a traditional running event organised by TSG Alten-Buseck. It includes several races over different distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and the half marathon (21.1 km). The races take place during the colder months and offer a great opportunity to enjoy the winter landscape around Alten-Buseck together with other runners. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, with special races for children and young people. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy refreshments, followed by an awards ceremony for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km and 21.1 km
Start and finish at Harbig Halle in Alten-Buseck
Winter running routes; the course may be changed because of construction work

Parking at Harbig Halle is limited. The Bambini run starts at approximately 14:15 (December only). Distance options: 700 m and 15 km; the event is expected to take place in winter conditions; start location: Alten-Buseck, Buseck.

The event is family-friendly and supported by a dedicated organizing team. It gives runners of all ages the opportunity to get active and enjoy the Advent season together.

The routes pass through the scenic Dreiteichs, Dammbachs and Kohlgrund areas on paved, gravel and forest roads. It is open to all running enthusiasts and is organized by the sports club Spielvereinigung Bad Berka e.V.

name: Ameland Adventurerun
description: The Ameland Adventurerun is an adventurous running event held in December on the Wadden Sea island of Ameland. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, as well as special children’s distances of 1 and 2 kilometres. The event combines a sporting challenge with the island’s unique natural surroundings and winter elements. It is a welcoming event with a finish party and a warm reception for runners and supporters.
course_highlights: Run between the Wadden Sea and the North Sea amid unspoilt nature
Distances of 5, 10 and 21 kilometres, plus children’s distances
Winter elements and a lively finish party with Christmas tunes
additional: After the finish, participants in the 5, 10 and 21.1 km races receive a medal and a special Ameland Adventurerun bandana. The race office is at Sporthal Nes, where participants can collect their race pack. The organisers promote sustainability by minimising the use of cups at aid stations and offering ECO cups. Participants must book their own ferry crossing through Wagenborg Passenger Services. First aid is provided by professionals. A shirt for the Kidsrun is available through Eilandverhuur Ameland. location: Speelvijver Peddelpoel, Velsen, North Holland, Netherlands
description: Spaarnwoude Park Ultra is a unique running event in Velsen-Zuid where participants run laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve. Each lap must be completed within 30 minutes to continue to the next lap. Participants can choose on the day which distance they run. The event takes place at the Peddelpoel recreational lake and is limited to 150 participants. It is organised by volunteers from Loopmeesters and RunX Haarlem. The start and rest area has facilities including toilets and picnic tables. After the event, all runners receive hot chocolate as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km through a nature reserve
30-minute time limit per lap
Start and finish at the Peddelpoel recreational lake, with facilities
additional: A maximum of 150 participants per edition. Participants bring their own food and drinks. There are transition cups for the fastest runners in the final lap, one per distance. The start and rest area has space for tents, chairs and support crews. All participants receive a keepsake and hot chocolate before they leave. Laps of 3.6 km or 4.6 km, a 30-minute time limit per lap, participants bring their own food and drinks, keepsake and hot chocolate after the event.

name: Bootsgym RUN TEGEN KANKER
description: Bootsgym RUN TEGEN KANKER is a running race taking place in Tuitjenhorn on 12 December 2026. The race is listed on Inschrijven.nl, where participants can register and find more details. The event is presented on the WeTri platform, which supports a wide range of triathlon and running events in the Netherlands. The race invites runners to take on a sporting challenge while also raising awareness of cancer.
course_highlights: Supporting cancer research
Location in Tuitjenhorn
Registration via Inschrijven.nl
additional: The event focuses on charity and running, with an emphasis on supporting cancer research. No specific distance or course information is available.

name: KNRM West Coast Challenge
location: Hoek van Holland, Rotterdam, South Holland, Netherlands

price_tiers.distance: Duo - hele of halve challenge (halve prijs + sponsoractie)

description: The KNRM West Coast Challenge is a unique one-day endurance event in which teams of two take turns running and cycling over 130 kilometres from Hoek van Holland to Den Helder, almost entirely along the beach. There is also a 62-kilometre Half Challenge for pairs and solo entrants; solo entrants may be accompanied by a cyclist. The event raises funds for the KNRM, with all proceeds going towards its rescue work. The Full Challenge starts on 12 December 2026 at 04:30 and the Half Challenge at 11:00. The atmosphere is friendly, and participants are encouraged to strengthen their connection with the KNRM.
course_highlights: 130 kilometres, almost entirely along the beach, passing twelve KNRM coastal stations
The course is unmarked, so participants find their own way
The crossing at IJmuiden on KNRM lifeboats and the changing tides are important
additional: Participants must find their own route because the course is unmarked. Front and rear bicycle lights are mandatory in the dark (04:30–08:00 and from 17:00). If beach conditions are poor, the cyclist may ride through the dunes. There is a reserve date of 16 January 2027 in case of bad weather. The Half Challenge starts at 11:00 at restaurant Sea You in Velsen-Noord. Teams can choose to pay the full fee or pay half price by organising a fundraising campaign through samenvoorknrm.nl. Registration is confirmed after payment or after reaching the fundraising target. The event follows a run-bike-run format and has a strong focus on fundraising for the KNRM. Details about registration and participation fees are not specified.

name: Rotary Santa Run Bussum
description: The Rotary Santa Run in Bussum takes place on Saturday, December 12, 2026, and is a fun running event for the whole family, teams, friends, and neighbors. The event starts at 15:30 and combines sport with fun and support for a good cause, Stichting Hulphond. After the run, there is an awards ceremony and a get-together in Kapelstraat. The Santa Run is a festive event that brings people together in the center of Bussum.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the center of Bussum
Festive atmosphere with a warm-up and medal ceremony
Drinks in Kapelstraat after the event
additional: Schedule: 15:00 gathering, 15:15 warm-up, 15:30 run starts, 16:00–16:45 medal ceremony, 16:15–17:00 drinks for runners in Kapelstraat. On the day, organizers can be reached through identifiable Rotary members wearing yellow vests. The event includes fun runs for families, classmates, teams, friends, and neighborhoods; several Rotary Clubs in the Netherlands organize similar events; in 2026, participation will expand to include extensive nationwide involvement.

name: Sørlandstesten
description: The Sørlandstest is a low-threshold fun run for everyone who wants a positive running experience, regardless of ambition level. Whether you are training for a bigger goal, feeling the competitive nerves, or just want a social and active day – this is the race for you! With us, there is room for both beginners and experienced runners, and the most important thing is that you show up with a good mood and a desire to run. We cheer just as much for the one who crosses the finish line first as for the one who completes their very first race.
course_highlights: The Sørlandstest gives you the opportunity to test your running form in a friendly atmosphere.
The start and finish are on the other side of the road from Gumpens Auto, along Setesdalsveien in Kristiansand.
The participants follow a flat and fast course up Setesdalsveien to Strai, turn around, and run back the same way.

name: Adventslauf
price_range: 10,00 € bis 16,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Advent Run in Hamm is a traditional winter race on officially measured out-and-back courses through the Lippeaue nature conservation area and the Kurpark in Bad Hamm. The start and finish are on the tartan track at Jahnstadion, creating a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with chip-based net and gun timekeeping. Alongside the sporting challenge, charity is also a key focus, with a donation collected for the support association of the hospice in Hamm.
course_highlights: Officially measured out-and-back courses
Lippeaue nature conservation area
Kurpark in Bad Hamm
additional: Young people and young adults up to age group U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding the donation and deposit). An additional €3.00 deposit is charged for the race bib (refunded when returned), along with a €1.00 donation for the support association of the hospice in Hamm. Timing is provided using Race Result systems via a chip in the race bib. The timing is eligible for best-list results and is forwarded to the DLV federation. Headphones, dogs and jogging strollers are prohibited during the race. The awards ceremony takes place approximately 45 minutes after the first runner finishes. Discounted admission is available at the neighboring Maximare adventure swimming pool. Courses are timed using Race Result; race bibs contain a chip; the awards ceremony is approximately 45 minutes after the finish; admission to Maximare is available.

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series associated with the traditional Rund um Wellen. The event is organized by the local running community, which also organizes the Wellen Marathon, and offers a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere away from large city events. The course includes several distances and runs through the rural surroundings, supported by local volunteers, sponsors, and the fire brigade. The series preserves its traditional character and offers runners a challenging, authentic winter running experience.
course_highlights: Rural course with a traditional character
Event with a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere
Support from local volunteers and the fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather conditions: around 7 °C, mostly rainy; start location: Beverstedt-Wellen; the event is part of a series with several distances (3 km and 11 km). Distances: 3 km, 11 km; traditional, community-oriented; December weather is usually cool and rainy.

name: Sparkassen Advents-Cross der LG Nordheide
location: Jahnplatz, Schützengehölz, Winsen (Luhe), Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: U10-U16 2,50 Euro, U18-U20 3,00 Euro, Erwachsene 5,00 Euro
description: The Sparkassen Advent Cross-Country Run hosted by LG Nordheide takes place on December 13, 2026, in Winsen (Luhe), at Schützengehölz by Jahnplatz. The event is open to participants from across the state and offers races for all age groups from U10 to seniors, including age groups up to M/W 95. The races cover various distances of approximately 1,400 meters to 9 kilometers. Team rankings are held separately for male and female participants. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available, as well as signposted parking nearby.
course_highlights: Various distances from approx. 1,400 m to 9 km
Races from U10 through senior age groups, including M/W 95
Venue in Schützengehölz, with a signposted walking route
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a 50% surcharge. Entries submitted by email incur a surcharge of EUR 1.00 per start. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available. Parking is available behind the Stadthalle and at the Stadthalle car park; the venue is about a 300-meter walk through Schützengehölz along a signposted route. Registration constitutes consent to the publication of the participant’s name, year of birth, club, and photo and video material in results lists and the media. Distances range from approximately 1,400 m to longer distances; registration is open until December 6, 2026. Late entries are possible for an additional fee. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available; parking is behind the Stadthalle.

price_range: Inschrijving via inschrijven.nl, korting voor verzekerden van Zorg en Zekerheid
description: The Ter Specke Loop takes place in the beautiful, wooded surroundings of Sportpark Ter Specke in Lisse. The distinctive course is flat and sheltered, with the start on Spekkelaan and the finish on the athletics track. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, with runners completing one to three laps. Families and the youngest participants can take part in the free 1 km GeZZinsloop, with a medal for everyone afterward. After the finish, runners are welcomed at the Health Square with fruit and water, provided by the Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit.
course_highlights: Flat, sheltered course in a wooded setting
Start on Spekkelaan, finish on the athletics track
Distances of 1 km (GeZZinsloop), 5 km, 10 km and 15 km
additional: Registration takes place in the sports hall, with card payment. Separate changing rooms are available for women and men. Valuables can be left in a tent on the track. Massage may be available in the sports hall afterward. Parking is available on Spekkelaan, at the cycling track and on van Lyndenweg, as directed by parking attendants. Circuit participants can switch between the short and middle distances as often as they like via the information desk; switching to the long distance is only possible through individual registration. Various distances (5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 1 km kids' run), start and finish at Sportpark Ter Specke, on-site registration with card payment, free kids' run, massage available afterward

name: Urban City Run 053
description: The Urban City Run 053 takes place on December 13, 2026, in Enschede and offers participants a unique 5 km or 7.5 km exploratory run through the city centre. The start and finish are at Performance Factory, and the course takes you past attractive squares, streets and various buildings. This is not a race and there is no timekeeping, so you can enjoy the special moments along the way and take selfies. All participants receive a unique running shirt, which serves as their entry pass and must be worn. After the finish, you can chat together over food and drinks.
course_highlights: Varied course through Enschede city centre, including asphalt, carpet and grass
Run through various buildings and climb several staircases
Start and finish at Performance Factory
additional: Maximum of 2,000 participants. Start waves between 09:00 and 10:00; choose your start time when registering. Minimum age: 12. The running shirt is mandatory and serves as your entry pass. No race number. Parking is available at Performance Factory and Irenegarage (limited and paid). Bicycle parking at Performance Factory is limited. Changing facilities are available; there are no showers. Luggage storage is in the gymnasium and is at your own risk. No timekeeping and no minimum time. Start and finish at Performance Factory, start waves between 09:00 and 10:00, minimum age 12, no showers, luggage storage at your own risk.

name: Wintercross ASV Eibergen
description: The Wintercross ASV Eibergen is a challenging cross-country running event that is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie. The race takes place in the beautiful natural area around Eibergen and offers distances ranging from 1 km to 10 km, suitable for different age groups and ability levels. The competition encourages runners of all ages to enjoy athletics in a welcoming and sporting environment. The event is organised jointly by six athletics clubs, ensuring a professional and friendly experience.
course_highlights: Distances ranging from 1 km to 10 km
A natural and challenging cross-country course in Eibergen
Races for youth, seniors and masters
additional: The races start at 10:30 with the 10 km for seniors and masters. This is followed by various youth distances from 1 km to 5 km. The age reference date for youth and masters is the final race and the first race of the competition, respectively. The event is organised jointly by six athletics clubs from the region. Registration is available via inschrijven.nl, with on-site registration also possible; the event is part of the Twentse Cross Competitie.

name: Flevo Fun Run
location: RCN Camping Zeewolde, Zeewolde, Flevoland, Netherlands
description: The Flevo Fun Run is a popular regional running event held at RCN campsite Zeewolde. It offers several distances, including 1, 2, 5 and 10 kilometres, with the longer distances consisting of multiple laps. The run is open to both beginners and experienced runners and is organised by TVZ Zeewolde, a sports club with a rich history in multisport and triathlon. The atmosphere is sporty and sociable, with an emphasis on having fun and enjoying the event together.
course_highlights: Routes of 1, 2, 5 and 10 km, with multiple laps for the longer distances
Start and finish at RCN campsite Zeewolde
Varied course suitable for recreational and competitive runners
additional: The 2 km route consists of 2 laps. The 10 km route consists of 2 laps of 5 km. Photos and results from previous editions are available on the organiser’s Facebook page and photo page. Registration is required; the event takes place during the winter months and is suitable for the whole family.

name: Santa Run
description: The Rotary Santa Run is a fun run where participants dress as Santa Claus and run or walk a course of approximately 3 kilometres for charity. The event was launched in 2008 by Rotary Club Gorinchem and has since grown into a nationwide phenomenon, with dozens of editions in the Netherlands and a few abroad. In 2019, Santa Runs were held in 58 cities, raising a combined total of more than €450,000 for over 100 good causes. The Rotary Santa Run aims for a uniform look and a powerful mass start on the Saturday before Christmas.
course_highlights: Short and simple course of approximately 3 km
Participants dressed as Santa Claus
Uniform nationwide look with simultaneous starts
additional: The Rotary Santa Run is organised by local Rotary Clubs, with support from a starter package that includes Santa suits, medals, race numbers, promotional materials and an online registration module. Each location has a minimum of 240 participants, and the event is preferably held on the Saturday before Christmas. The organisation is a turnkey concept, with an operations manual, an emergency plan and a uniform look. Participants dress as Santa Claus and support good causes; the event takes place in multiple cities and has a strong focus on charity and community spirit.

name: Hamarkarusellen Vinter Løp 3
description: The Hamarkarusellen Winter is the winter edition of the Hamarkarusellen, where all races take place on the same 5-kilometer course on illuminated walking and cycling paths in the Prestrud area of Hamar. The event warmly welcomes all ambitions, whether you walk or run, with or without a time, and it’s an excellent opportunity to use as a test race. There are a total of 6 races throughout the winter, so bring your running shoes and join in on the fun!
course_highlights: We maintain the same controlled 5 kilometers in all the races; this is an excellent opportunity to use it as a test run.
The event warmly welcomes all ambitions: walking (without time/with time), running (without time/with time), "compete with myself," "beat the neighbor," and active super runners.
There are 6 races during the winter.

name: Adventsmila Kjølnes
description: In collaboration with the Church City Mission in Grenland, we invite you to the Advent Mile at Kjølnes. Join us for an atmospheric race on December 17th at 6 PM, where one lap is 3.3 km. For those running the 10 km with timed results, you will complete 3 laps, while participants in the non-timed fitness class can choose to complete 1, 2, or 3 laps. Support the Church City Mission and bring joy to someone who is dreading Christmas!
course_highlights: Run, jog, or walk - You choose.
The proceeds go to the Church City Mission's "Bring Joy to Those Who Dread Christmas."
Anyone over 15 years old can register right up until the starting gun goes off.

name: Gaasterlân Run
description: The Gaasterlân Run is a running event in Balk, Friesland, taking place on Saturday, December 19, 2026. The race offers four distances: 7.5 km, 12 km, a half marathon, and a full marathon. The routes pass through the beautiful, flat Gaasterland countryside, with the start and finish at Voetbal Vereniging Balk. The organizers provide aid stations along the course and use chip timing for accurate results. The Gaasterlân Run is a popular event that offers a rewarding challenge for runners of various levels.
course_highlights: Routes through the flat, wooded Gaasterland countryside
Start and finish at Voetbal Vereniging Balk
Aid stations: 1 for the 12 km, 2 for the half marathon, 4 for the full marathon
additional: Race bibs with timing chips. Bib transfers and distance changes are possible via the dashboard. Changing rooms and showers are available at vv Balk. The course is not closed to traffic; participants run at their own risk. Participants must follow the regulations and wear their race bib clearly visible. Morning start; GPS interference may occur in wooded areas. Several distances are available, including a marathon.

name: Capelse Tweedaagse
location: Capelle aan den IJssel, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Capelle Two-Day Walk 2026 is being organised for the 31st time by the Rotterdam Walking Association. The event takes place on Saturday 19 and Sunday 20 December in the beautiful surroundings of Capelle aan den IJssel. A range of distances is available, from 5 to 35 kilometres, with different routes each day. The walk is a great opportunity to get some fresh air and enjoy nature in December. The start is at the canteen of korfball club KCC, which opens at 8:00 a.m.; the walk starts from 9:00 a.m.
course_highlights: Different routes each day, ranging from 5 to 35 km
Rest stops are included on all routes
Special ferry across the Hollandse IJssel (subject to change)
additional: The canteen of korfball club KCC accepts PIN payments only. Groups of 10 or more receive a 10% discount. Members of the national association and members of other clubs receive a discount on the entry fee. The start office closes at 4:30 p.m. Walking booklets will be stamped and given a coloured sticker. There is a special medal with a pin for participants in both days. Discounts are available for groups and members; starts from 8:00 a.m.; start times are between 9:00 a.m. and 1:00 p.m.; routes are available for one or two days; rest stops are included on all routes.

name: Hollands Duin Ultra
description: The Hollands Duin Ultra is a challenging 50 km trail run through the protected Hollands Duin nature reserve on the coast near Noordwijk. The route takes you through dunes and along the beach, with sandy paths and elevation changes that make the course extra challenging. The start and finish are at Vrijstaat Nederzandt, a welcoming venue right on the beach. There are three aid stations during the race, and all participants receive a tracker for live tracking. This ultra is part of the Dutch Ultra Series and offers a wonderful experience of the area’s natural beauty.
course_highlights: Route through dunes and along the beach on sandy paths
Aid stations at 17 km, 29 km, 40 km and 45 km
Start and finish at Vrijstaat Nederzandt by the beach
additional: Participants receive a GPX file three days before the event. No plastic cups are available; participants must bring their own cup/bottle or can purchase a Trail Running Racecup from the organizers. Race registration is open from 08:00 to 09:00. Participants must finish before 17:00. Parking is available in a large car park 200 meters from the start location. Route through dunes and along the beach, unpaved paths, medal, live tracking, participation in Racecup Trailrunning, maximum capacity of 905 participants

name: Int. Weihnachts-Crosslauf
location: Ravensberger Stadion, Borgholzhausen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Int. Christmas Cross-Country Run is a cross-country race held shortly before Christmas at Ravensberger Stadium in Borgholzhausen. The event is organized by LCS Olbä and offers several distances, including 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a 7.5 km walking/Nordic walking course. The 16 km course consists of two laps over partly hilly terrain around Borgholzhausen, including a loop around Barenberg that is completed twice. It is a genuine cross-country challenge with climbs and descents. The start and finish sections are on paved paths, where spikes are not allowed. The race attracts a diverse field, from elite runners to recreational and older runners, as well as walkers.
course_highlights: 16 km course with two laps over hilly terrain
Loop around Borgholzhausen, including the Barenberg loop
Start and finish at Ravensberger Stadium, with paved sections
additional: The event takes place in typical December weather, with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. Various distances are offered, including Nordic walking. Spikes are not allowed on the paved start and finish sections. The event includes several running distances as well as walking options. The course is partly hilly and runs along natural trails; the first and last metres are on paved paths. No spikes are allowed.

name: Weihnachtslauf Lipperreihe
description: The Weihnachtslauf Lipperreihe is a traditional running event held annually on the fourth Sunday of Advent in Lipperreihe, a district of Oerlinghausen. The loop course starts and finishes at Lipperreihe Primary School and is precisely measured, with a hilly, moderately challenging profile. The scenic route is timed using the professional race|result timing system. The event is for adults and young people and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Precisely measured course with a hilly profile
Moderately challenging route through scenic surroundings
Start and finish at Lipperreihe Primary School
additional: Online registration is available until 7 a.m. on the day of the event. Late entries are possible until 30 minutes before the start, with a late-entry fee of 5 EUR payable in cash only. Animals are not permitted. An event shirt in French navy can be ordered as an option. Timing uses the race|result system, with a dual transponder in the race number since 2019. Residents are provided with information about traffic restrictions and road closures. Precisely measured; race|result timing; online registration until 7 a.m. on the day of the event; cash payment only; no animals permitted.

description: The Jumbo Kamphuis Crossloop in Hoonhorst is an atmospheric and challenging cross-country race through the beautiful Salland countryside. Organized by V.V. Hoonhorst, the race follows mostly unpaved paths past historic estates and through varied woodland and meadows. With several distances, there is a suitable challenge for every runner, from recreational to competitive. This race is a regular fixture in the Sallands Cross Circuit and offers a sporty, sociable way to run toward the end of the year.
course_highlights: 90% unpaved paths
Course passes the historic estates Den Aalshorst (1644) and Havezate Den Berg (1705)
A mix of meadows, woodland, and natural elevation changes
additional: Race bibs are assigned personally for the entire season; day runners collect their bib on race day and return it afterward. Spikes are not allowed because they could damage the timing mats. The cross is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit, which has 10 races; you can take part through packages or by registering for individual races. The start location is Sportpark de Potkamp, Kerkstraat 24, Dalfsen. Various distances, registration available, a sociable atmosphere and nature, event in Hoonhorst near Dalfsen.

name: Kerstloop Dronten
description: The Starke Kerstloop Dronten is an atmospheric running event held annually in the run-up to Christmas, starting and finishing at Meerpaalplein in Dronten. The race offers distances of 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The half marathon consists of two laps, passing the square twice. The event is organised with the help of service club Tafelronde 168 and athletics club A.V. Flevo Delta, and is open to everyone, including people who are not members of an athletics club. The finish village at Meerpaalplein offers a welcoming place with activities and food and drink for participants and visitors.
course_highlights: Start and finish on De Rede near Meerpaalplein
Finish village with activities and food and drink at Meerpaalplein
The half marathon consists of two laps, passing the square twice
additional: Finish village at Meerpaalplein with activities and food and drink. Half-marathon participants run two laps and pass the square twice. The start and finish are on De Rede near Meerpaalplein. Registration opens from 1 August 2026; includes the Business Run; event held in the run-up to Christmas; lively programme around Meerpaalplein

name: Sylvesterloop Heeze
description: The Sylvester Run is an annual running event in Heeze, held on fully paved roads. With distances of 7 km and 15 km, it is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational runners looking to join in. The event starts at 11:00 and is followed by a friendly get-together with a drink in the Heezerenbosch canteen. It is a sporting tradition for ending the year actively.
course_highlights: Fully paved roads
7 km and 15 km routes through beautiful Heeze
Start and finish at Camping Heezerenbosch
additional: Limited parking is available 300 metres from the start; cyclists can park their bikes at the campsite; volunteers will direct cars to the parking area; after the event, enjoy a drink in the Heezerenbosch canteen. Paved roads, post-race gathering at Heezerenbosch, limited parking nearby, encourage carpooling and cycling.

name: Winter Step One Loop
description: The Winter Step One race takes place on Sunday, December 20, 2026, in Borne and celebrates its 37th edition this year. The event offers distances of 2 km (youth), 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon (21.1 km). The start is at B.V.V. Borne. There is a friendly atmosphere, prizes in various categories, and the option to receive a medal. Pre-registration is available through December 13, with race-day registration also available.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 2 km youth race to a half marathon (21.1 km)
Start and finish at B.V.V. Borne, Twickelerblokweg 75
Medals are available; free for 2 km participants
additional: Race numbers can be collected from December 16 at Step One Borne. On race day, collection is available from 9:00 to 10:30 in the BVV clubhouse. Showers and changing rooms are available. Race-day registration is open until 10:30. There are prizes by category and class, as well as a bonus for improving the course record. Medals and race numbers are available for purchase; registration and start times are listed on the website; the venue is not specifically described.

name: Nisseløpet Lommedalen
description: The Nisseløpet Lommedalen is an exciting race that takes place in Viken and was started by neighbors Harald Krogh and Anders Lindell to spread joy on Christmas Eve. Participants can choose between distances of 6 km and 10 km, and the race is known for its scenic route that goes through beautiful surroundings. This race attracts both recreational runners and experienced athletes, and has become a tradition in Lommedalen.
course_highlights: The race is for everyone and you can choose whether you want to run a distance of ten kilometers or a distance of between six and seven kilometers.
It was free to participate, and after the race, mulled wine and gingerbread cookies were served.
The Nisseløpet Lommedalen offers varied terrain and scenic surroundings, providing participants with a challenging experience.

images.alt_text: Christmas race in Lommedalen. Participants in Santa hats run in the snow.
The Christmas Race in Lommedalen: Runners and riders in festive spirit.
The Santa Race in Lommedalen: Participants on horses in Santa Claus costumes.
The Santa Race in Lommedalen: Runners and riders in Santa costumes. Christmas party!

name: Dalborgløpet
description: The Dalborg Race is organized on December 27th, the third day of Christmas, and offers a refreshing running experience during the holiday season! The course is 5 km long, starting from the sports field at Vind, and follows Dalborgvegen at the top of Gjøvik in gently undulating terrain. The course turns around after 2.5 km and follows the same path back. There is an informal atmosphere surrounding the race, and runners of all levels are warmly welcome to the Christmas workout!
course_highlights: The course record is 17:05, set by Marius Viken Vesterås in 2020.
The race has categories for both men and women, with simple prizes for the winners.
Registration is preferably desired in advance, but it is also possible to sign up before the start.

images.alt_text: Runners in the Dalborg Race 2024.
Runners in the Dalborg Race 2024. Snow and ice on the road.
Runner in a winter landscape. Dalborg Race?

name: Mandals Juledagsløp
description: The Mandal Christmas Day Race takes place on December 26 and offers distances of 3 km and 10 km. This race is part of the running calendar in Agder and provides participants with the opportunity to experience a festive atmosphere during the holiday season. It attracts both experienced and new runners and features a traditional celebration that makes it a popular activity after the Christmas festivities.
course_highlights: Erik U. Pedersen won the 3rd Day of Christmas race in Mandal decisively, which gathered 194 participants.
The race is a fun run without any class divisions, and many families participate together to experience the joy of personal achievement.
Eight-year-old Cecilie Holte Ellingsen ran 10 km with her mother and older brother, finishing with an impressive time of 59:00 minutes.

name: Ribbemaraton
description: Löplabbet's Ribbemarathon is an annual race between Löplabbet's store in Sandvika and Ski Storsenter. The race is an official marathon and counts towards Kondis' awards of all kinds, but it lacks the drive for personal records. The most important thing is to have a nice run, take the time you need, and get to know new runners. It's more important to keep the conversation going than to keep the heart rate up!
course_highlights: The race is an official marathon and counts towards Kondis' awards of all kinds.
The most important thing is to have a nice run, take the time you need, and get to know new runners.
The route will be the same this year as before.

images.alt_text: Runners are smiling and enjoying themselves during the Ribbemarathon.
Runners in Ribbemarathon, a pleasant run along the water.
Happy runner at the Ribbemarathon! Beautiful winter day.
Runners at the Ribbemarathon after the race. Nice atmosphere!

name: Vinterkarusellen 4. løp
description: The results from the 4th race in this year's Necon Winter Series are now in. A data breach at the timing provider led to incorrect data transfer, but now most participants have received their correct times. Conditions were good with no ice or snow, contributing to a great racing experience for the over 1025 finishers. Bjørnar Gangsøy won the 10 km with a time of 36:58, while Sondre Gangsøy and Emil also delivered strong performances with times of 43:40 and 25:04 in the 5 km, respectively.
course_highlights: The participants received gingerbread cookies and mulled wine, sponsored by REMA 1000 Søreide.
Several milestones were recorded, including that three runners now have over 100 participations.
Four runners have now participated in the carousel over 150 times, demonstrating the strong engagement in this event.

Runners in the Winter Carousel in Jessheim at night. Many participants.

name: 21. Wolfshäger Gänsebraten Fettverbrennungslauf
location: Wolfshagen im Harz, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wolfshäger Gänsebraten Fettverbrennungslauf is a traditional race held annually on December 26 in Wolfshagen im Harz. The event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels and offers a sporting way to round off the Christmas season. It is organized by Laufteam Wolfshagen im Harz e.V., a nonprofit club that promotes running in the region. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the strong sense of community among its runners.
course_highlights: A run through the picturesque Harz countryside
A family-friendly course for all ages
A traditional end-of-year race on December 26
additional: The race is organized by Laufteam Wolfshagen im Harz e.V., a club that also holds charity runs. The event is open to recreational and competitive runners, as well as children and teenagers. No prices or start times are published on the website. The organizer can be contacted by email with questions. Information about distances and registration is available on the website; the event promotes health and community spirit.

name: Schokocross
description: Schokocross is a cross-country running event organized by ATS Buntentor Bremen at the Sportanlage Kuhhirten in Stadtwerder, Bremen. The event features short off-road races for adults over distances of approximately 2.2 km, 4.2 km and 8.2 km, as well as 400 m races for children under 10 and 800 m races for children under 14. This local club race offers competitions for children, young people, women and men, and is particularly family-friendly, with appealing race options for both young and adult runners. It traditionally takes place on December 26 and is known for its winter conditions.
course_highlights: Cross-country course at the Sportanlage Kuhhirten in Stadtwerder
Distances ranging from 400 m to 8.2 km
Competitions for children, young people and adults
additional: Typical December weather: approx. 3 °C, with nighttime temperatures down to -2 °C, an average of 40 mm of precipitation, and usually snow-covered conditions. This local club race has competitions for various age groups, including U8 and U10. Cross-country running in winter weather, with categories for children, young people and adults. Registration deadline: December 22, 2026.

name: RopaTrail Doornse Gat
description: The RopaTrail Doornse Gat is a challenging and beautiful trail run that takes participants through the stunning natural surroundings of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug. He

name: Kerst Cross Opmeer

price_tiers.distance: Jeugd 9 t/m 15 jaar en Toploop >9 jaar

description: The Kerstcross Opmeer is a sporting and atmospheric cross-country running event held annually on Boxing Day in Opmeer. With a rich tradition and more than 2,200 participants, young and old, the Kerstcross offers challenging courses beside the VVS’46 grounds, with the start and finish on the A-field. The race is part of the Noord-Hollands Crosskampioenschap and is known for its warm atmosphere, professional chip timing, and personal touch, with names printed on race numbers. After the event, all participants receive a memento and can watch the finish video online.
course_highlights: Start and finish beside the VVS’46 grounds, with a bridge to the A-field
Various distances for children and adults, including recreational and competitive races
Participants run over land and through a wintry cross-country setting
additional: Race numbers are mailed to participants who register in advance before 1 December, with their names printed on them. On-the-day registration is available from 9:00 until 30 minutes before the start, with card payment only. Timing is provided by a ChronoRace chip in the race number. The prize-giving takes place outdoors immediately after the finish, on the A-field grandstand. All 800-meter runners receive a water bottle at the finish. Hot showers and changing rooms are available. Dogs are not allowed on the land. Distances: 5 km and 10 km, including the Noord-Hollands Crosskampioenschap; the event also includes a walking tour and prize money.

name: De Belte Kerstcrossloop Nieuw Heeten
location: Sportpark De Belte, Nieuw Heeten, Overijssel, Netherlands

description: The Belte Christmas Cross-Country Run in Nieuw Heeten is a welcoming and popular cross-country race, traditionally held on Boxing Day since 1979. The course runs around De Belte sports park and consists of short laps over cornfields, forest paths and grass strips, allowing spectators to cheer on the runners several times. Suitable for all ages, the race offers distances from 1 km to 10 km and provides a sporty, friendly end to the year in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course with 75–80% unpaved paths
Laps over cornfields, forest paths and along ditches
Compact course around De Belte sports park, with multiple opportunities to see the runners pass
additional: Distances: 1 km (10:00), 2.5 km (10:30), 5 km (11:15), 10 km (12:15). Start and finish at De Belte sports park, Zwarteweg 24. The course is compact and easy to follow, making it ideal for spectators to cheer on the runners several times. The race is part of the Sallands Cross Circuit, and a unique running shirt is available. Course on unpaved paths, registration open, festive atmosphere, several distances, family-oriented event.

name: Kangoeroeloop
location: Sportclub Prins Hendrik atletiekbaan, Vught, North Brabant, Netherlands
distance_verbose: 27 km, Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 7 km, 5 km, 3.5 km

description: The Kangoeroeloop is a running and walking event in Vught held on Boxing Day. The start and finish are on the athletics track at sports club Prins Hendrik, in a wooded setting. Participants can choose from various distances from 3.5 km to 27 km, including a special kids’ run and a paraloop for athletes with disabilities. After the finish, enjoy a festive Christmas atmosphere with mulled wine, sausage rolls and a sustainable souvenir made by Cello Zorg.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Prins Hendrik athletics track in a wooded setting
Quiet roads along fields, meadows and forests
The 5 km route is partly unpaved; the other distances are paved, with one lap per distance
additional: Warm-up at 13:15 for distances up to and including 10 km. Refreshments include water, tea, oranges and sports drink at the finish and at aid stations on the 15, 21 and 27 km routes. First aid and masseurs are available. Ample changing and shower facilities, and a supervised cloakroom. Follow the parking attendants’ instructions for parking. Public transport: a 20-minute walk from Vught station. Kids’ run: maximum 500 metres and 50 participants. The 3.5 km paraloop is entirely paved and starts at 13:30. The course follows quiet roads, both paved and unpaved. Registration is available via inschrijven.nl. The event offers facilities including refreshments, first aid, and changing and shower facilities. Registration usually opens a few months before the event.

name: Kasteelloop
description: The Kasteelloop in Horst a/d Maas is a friendly, traditional running event held annually on Boxing Day. It offers a range of distances for different ages, from young children to experienced runners, and attracts a wide audience. The route passes through beautiful Horst and the surrounding area, creating a festive, sporting atmosphere. The organizers provide a warm welcome and a well-run event, with prize-giving ceremonies for all categories.
course_highlights: Distances range from 600 meters for the youngest participants to 10 kilometers for adults
Start and finish in Horst a/d Maas, with a varied route through the surrounding area
Distance sponsors for the 5 km and 10 km help foster additional involvement
additional: Start times: 10:00 600m (ages 0–5), 10:10 1000m (ages 6–9), 10:20 2000m (ages 10–15), 10:45 5000m, 11:30 10000m. Prize-giving ceremonies take place after each distance. Distance sponsors: Vissers Energy Group (5 km), Unique Waterontharders (10 km). Registration for 2026 is closed; sponsors include, among others, Vleeshandel Willems and Eric Heijligers.

name: Juledagsløpet
description: The Christmas Day Race is a traditional event in which many of the world's best orienteers have participated. In 2024, it will be held for the third time, and Einar Engdal has shared photos from the race. Results from the race are available, but unfortunately, several runners were recorded as not finishing.
course_highlights: A traditional race where many of the world's best orienteers have participated.
3. Christmas Day Race 2024 Einar Engdal has kindly shared photos from the race.
You can find the results from the race here.

name: Keiloop
description: The Keiloop is an annual running event organized by Sportclub Meddo, taking place for the 39th time in 2026. The event offers five different distances: 1, 3, 5, 10 and 15 kilometers, suitable for a range of abilities and ages. It takes place in Winterswijk Meddo and is known as a cherished tradition in the local sporting community. The organizers also welcome volunteers to help make the event a success.
course_highlights: Five distances: 1, 3, 5, 10 and 15 km
Organized by Sportclub Meddo in Winterswijk Meddo
Annual event with a long-standing tradition
additional: The race is held annually and has a loyal group of participants. Registration is available via the official website. The event takes place in winter, around Christmas, and offers a great opportunity for a sporting activity in the Achterhoek.

name: Kerstloop Amstelveen
description: The Kerstloop Amstelveen is a festive running race held in the beautiful Amsterdamse Bos. The routes are mostly traffic-free and offer an enjoyable running experience for young and old alike. With distances of 2.5 km for youth, 5 km for fast runners, and a headline distance of 10 km, there is a suitable challenge for everyone. After the race, all participants receive a medal and can enjoy a fresh oliebol. Organizers AV Startbaan and Roda Conditie warmly welcome everyone for an active and enjoyable day.
course_highlights: Routes mostly through the Amsterdamse Bos
Traffic-free course
Free parking at the start
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day from 10:00 at RODA’23. Timing is done using a chip attached to the race number, which must not be folded. After the race, every participant receives a fresh oliebol and a medal. The top three finishers in each distance receive a cup, and there is a €50 prize for breaking the 10 km course record. On-the-day payment is accepted only in exact cash or by QR code; card payments are not accepted. Routes through the Amsterdamse Bos, advance registration recommended, electronic timing, parking at the sports complex, changing and shower facilities

name: 33e Physique 3de Kerstdagloop
description: The Physique Derde Kerstdagloop in Arnhem is a scenic running race held on Sunday, 27 December 2026. The main event is the 21.1 km half marathon, known as one of the most beautiful and toughest half marathons in the Netherlands, with a challenging course through forests and heathland. There are also 14 km and 7 km distances, which run partly on unpaved paths and hilly terrain. The race is organised at Sportcentrum Valkenhuizen and offers facilities such as changing rooms, showers and secure baggage storage. Timing uses the Ipico system, and there are water stations on the longer distances.
course_highlights: 21.1 km half-marathon course with 185 metres of elevation gain through forests and heathland
14 km route with more than 50% unpaved paths and a fast start over hills and avenues
7 km course featuring a forest section, plenty of climbing and descending, and the notorious ‘Geitenbult’
additional: Changing rooms, showers and free secure baggage storage are available. First aid is available. Timing uses an Ipico chip, which must be returned after the race (unreturned chips cost 10 euros). There are water stations at 8 and 17 km for the half marathon and at 10 km for the 14 km race. Volunteers are members of Ciko’66. The finish is on the Ciko’66 track. Routes through forests and heathland, car-free cycle paths, changing rooms, first aid, sports massages, limited parking; public transport is recommended.

name: Oudejaarsloop Blijham
price_range: 8 euro, leden 7 euro, jeugd t/m 17 jaar 4 euro
description: The Oudejaarsloop in Blijham is an annual running event organized by Atletiekvereniging Aquilo. The event attracts more than 1,000 runners and walkers and starts and finishes at the ASVB parking lot. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting challenge at the end of the year. The organizers provide a well-organized and safe race environment for all participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the ASVB parking lot in Blijham
A popular end-of-year running event with more than 1,000 participants
A varied course suitable for runners and walkers
additional: The Oudejaarsloop draws large numbers of runners and walkers. Results from previous editions are available online via an external link. Photos of the event are shared on local news and blog sites. The organization is part of AV Aquilo, which also organizes other running events in the region. Course updates, registration from 10:00 a.m., participation includes prizes, and pacers for different speeds.

name: Drenthe Trail Run
price_range: 7 km: €25,50 + €1 administratiekosten; 18 km: €36,50 + €1 administratiekosten; 26 km: €42,50 + €1 administratiekosten
description: The Drenthe Trail Run is a winter trail run taking place on 29 December 2026 in Norg. Participants can choose from three distances: 7, 18 or 26 kilometres, which wind through the forests, heathland and unpaved trails of Drenthe. The event celebrates experiencing nature, adventure and a friendly atmosphere, with a varied course suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The start and finish are in Norg, and time slots are used to ensure the course remains calm and safe.
course_highlights: A varied course through forests, sandy roads and trails
Routes of 7, 18 and 26 km through Drenthe’s most beautiful natural areas
A winter trail focused on nature and adventure
additional: Time slots are used for each distance to keep the course calm and safe. Participants receive individual timekeeping and have their first name printed on their race bib. Aid stations offer snacks, sports nutrition and water; participants are asked to bring their own cup for sustainability reasons. First aid and technical support are available at the start/finish. After the finish, there will be food, drinks, music and a friendly atmosphere. A bag-drop area is available for dry clothes. Trail shoes are recommended. Registration opens on 17 June 2023 at 08:00, with time slots used to ensure safety and keep the course calm. The event highlights outdoor adventure, respect for nature and a friendly atmosphere.

name: Vaarderhoogt Sylvester By Night

price_tiers.distance: Vaarderhoogt Sylvester by Night Family Run

description: The Vaarderhoogt Sylvester by Night Run is a unique evening race in the atmospherically lit Soester Dunes. Participants can choose to run up to three laps of 1,300 metres each through a beautifully decorated forest and dune area, following the official Sylvestercross course. The finish is at the familiar location, offering a preview of the big Sylvestercross day. Alongside the run, there is also a Family Run for children and a walking tour, making the event suitable for the whole family. Get ready for a magical evening full of fun and a special running experience.
course_highlights: Run through a beautifully lit forest and dune area
Official Sylvestercross course
Finish at the familiar location in the Soester Dunes
additional: Participants can order an LED foam stick when registering and collect it along with their race number. The walking tour starts at 18:30 and is one lap of 1.3 km. The Family Run is specifically for children aged 5 to 15 and starts at 19:00. The course is difficult to navigate with strollers and walkers. The run offers a magical evening, with various experience points along the course. Decorations, optional foam stick, registration with the option to enter the originality prize, start and finish in the dunes, donation to the Prinses Maxima Centrum Foundation.

name: AH Oudejaars Crossloop Vorden
location: Het Grote Veld, Vorden, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: The AH Oudejaars Crossloop in Vorden takes place on Wednesday, December 30, and offers a scenic run along the forest trails and sandy paths of the Het Grote Veld nature reserve. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10, or 15 km, and there is a special 1 km kids’ cross for children aged 4 to 12. The organizers create a friendly atmosphere, with coffee, tea, and oliebollen after the race, and prizes in various categories. Registration is open until December 27 at 18:00, after which participants will receive their race numbers.
course_highlights: Run along forest trails and sandy paths in the Het Grote Veld nature reserve
Distances of 5, 10, and 15 km available
A 1 km kids’ cross for children aged 4–12
additional: The entry fee includes coffee or tea and an oliebol after the race. Kids’ cross participants receive squash drink, an oliebol, and a medal. The race number with a timing chip is emailed the day before the race and can be collected up to half an hour before the start. Registration on race day is not possible. Registration is open from mid-September until December 27 at 18:00. The event attracts many participants from the region and is known for its friendly atmosphere.

name: Sylvesterloppet Kalmar
description: The Sylvester Race in Kalmar is a local running classic organised by Högby IF Friidrott and held on 31 December 2026. Basic information about the race is available on the club’s website. Officials and volunteers register through the club’s login system.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances around Fredriksskans and Lindöfjärden
A medal and a specially designed hat for everyone who registers
A 5 km untimed walking category, as well as various age-group categories
additional: The Kalmar Sylvester Race is described as a running classic. Officials and volunteers register via the website’s registration form (WordPress), which requires a login: https://friidrott.hogbyif.se/wp-login.php?action=register Start times for the different categories include P/F 5–13, 0.4–2.0 km; M/K 5 and 10 km; and the untimed 5 km walking category. Late registration and payment options include card, Swish or bankgiro.

name: Sylvesterloppet Olofström
description: Sylvesterloppet in Olofström is a traditional end-of-year race organised by UF Contact since 1971. The main distance is a quarter marathon (10,549 m), run over two laps on the current course since 2018. There is also a shorter course of approximately 5.3 km. The event has long featured the finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen, providing a welcoming setting for runners and spectators. Its history and ties to the club make the race a festival for both competitive and recreational runners.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon: 10,549 m (run over two laps on the current course since 2018)
A shorter course of approximately 5.3 km is also available
Finish, changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen
additional: Registration is via EasyRecord (as stated in the invitation). The race information and course maps are available as PDF files on the organiser’s pages (invitation, race information, course). The start list is published separately on the organiser’s website. Historically, the event has had changing facilities, refreshments and prize-giving in Idrottshallen. Historical information and course profile, including the start and finish points around Idrottshallen and Nya torget.

name: Nyttårsløpet Tønsberg
description: The New Year's Run in Tønsberg has been organized for many years and is a fun run for absolutely everyone. Here, the atmosphere is relaxed, and the race is a great way to kick off a new year. Whether you are in peak shape or looking for a leisurely jog on the last day of the year, you are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: The New Year's Run is a fun run for absolutely everyone.
Here, the atmosphere is relaxed, and the race is a great start to a new year.
Whether you are in peak shape or just looking for a leisurely run, you are warmly welcome.

Runners in the New Year's Race Tønsberg, 2024. Snow. Start.
The runner approaches the finish line at the New Year's Race in Tønsberg. Snow on the ground.
Runner in the New Year's Race Tønsberg. Snow and winter atmosphere.

name: Nyttårstrimmen
description: The New Year's Run is a 10 km recreational race suitable for all runners. This race has a long tradition and is Norway's oldest currently active recreational race, held every New Year's Eve since 1975. This year, we celebrate the 50th anniversary of the New Year's Run, which attracts hundreds of participants in Grenland. Participants can expect a varied and enjoyable experience, despite challenges such as snow and weather conditions.
course_highlights: The New Year's run has been going strong every New Year's Eve since 1975.
Last year there were over 1100 registrants, and the organizers hope for even more this year.
The race has a special atmosphere, with various distances and activities for all ages.

images.alt_text: Participants in the New Year Run are running through the city.
Participants in the New Year's Run are warming up before the race.
New Year Run logo: Runners and race name.

name: Silvesterlauf Bremen
description: The Silvesterlauf Bremen is a popular running event on December 31 that welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels. The event offers various distances, from 400 m for Bambinis to 10 km for experienced runners, through the beautiful surroundings of Werdersee. Alongside a sporting end to the year, festive music and a New Year’s Eve atmosphere make for a special experience. Participants in costumes are warmly invited to add their own creative touch to the event and run together into the New Year.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the picturesque surroundings of Werdersee
More accessible 2.5 km route for beginners and people with special needs
Festive New Year’s Eve atmosphere with music and medals for all finishers
additional: Start times vary by distance: 5 km run at 12:00, 2.5 km walk at 12:30, 5 km and 10 km walks at 12:50, 400 m Bambini run at 12:55, 1,000 m kids’ run at 13:00, 10 km run at 13:15. Race materials can be shipped for a fee. More accessible 2.5 km route suitable for everyone. Costumes are expressly encouraged for a special New Year’s Eve feeling. Various distances, including children’s and walking options, festive atmosphere, medals for everyone, creative costumes welcome.

name: Silvesterlauf Hannover
description: The Silvesterlauf an der Leine in Hanover is a traditional year-end race held on December 31. The event features a 7.7 km loop, mostly on paved paths through the Steintormasch, to the Wasserkunst and along the Stichkanal to the Ihme. The race starts at 13:00 at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer. After the race, participants can refuel with mulled wine and bratwurst and receive a finisher wheat beer glass as a keepsake. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and mass start.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop on mostly paved paths
The course goes through the Steintormasch to the Wasserkunst and the Stichkanal
Start and finish at the clubhouse of the Hannoverscher Radsportclub on Weddigenufer
additional: Mass start; mulled wine and bratwurst at low prices after the race; every finisher receives a 0.5 l wheat beer glass in the event design. On-the-day registration is possible on site from 12:00 (cash or PayPal). The race takes place on December 31, with online registration open until 31.12.25 at 10:00. There is a mass start and festivities that make the race a sociable way to end the year.

name: Silvesterlauf Wernigerode
description: The 49th Wernigerode New Year's Eve Run is the perfect end to the year in the Harz district for running enthusiasts. The race takes place on December 31, 2026, at Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode and offers a festive atmosphere to close out the year. Organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V., this popular event welcomes runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode
Run through Wernigerode's picturesque old town
Festive end-of-year atmosphere in the Harz district
additional: The course goes around Wernigerode Castle; start and finish at Marstall; no shower facilities; several events, including youth races and training sessions.

name: Silvesterlauf Burgwedel
description: The Burgwedel New Year’s Eve Run is a long-standing running event held annually on December 31 in Burgwedel. The races cover several distances, including 10.6 km, 5.3 km and 2 km for children, and follow a scenic course with the start and finish at the modernised stadium on Ramhorst. The event attracts numerous runners and spectators and is organised by Schwimmverein Burgwedel. It is a popular sporting way to round off the year, with a family-friendly atmosphere and a diverse range of participants.
