description: LOOP Leeuwarden is Fryslân’s largest running and walking event, attracting thousands of participants every year. The routes pass through Leeuwarden’s atmospheric city centre and surrounding natural areas, with the start and finish by the iconic Oldehove. The half marathon is the longest distance and offers a challenging mix of city and countryside running. With a wide range of distances, there is a suitable challenge for every runner, from 5 km to 21.1 km.
course_highlights: Route through Leeuwarden city centre, starting and finishing by the Oldehove
Varied course along waterways, through woodland and across the open Frisian landscape
Safe, closed course with official timing
additional: The start and finish are at Wilhelminaplein and the foot of the Oldehove. Race numbers can be ordered with personalisation until 21 April and delivered to your home until 5 April. Official timing is provided, along with aid stations offering water, sports drinks, fruit and toilets along the route. The course is safe and closed to traffic. There are several waves, with colour codes for the start groups. The event also offers volunteer opportunities and provides information about registration and start times; it is held in Leeuwarden, Friesland.

name: Skärholmsloppet
description: Skärholmsloppet is a family-friendly running festival in Stockholm, with races for all ages. These include a Mini Race for the youngest participants, Lilla Skärholmsloppet for children in preschool class through grade 6, a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and up, and a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages. The event is organised by Löparakademin, a non-profit organisation that supports young people in disadvantaged suburbs through personal development using running. The day features music and entertainment, with DJs along the course, and all participants receive a medal at the finish. Skärholmsloppet is an inclusive, encouraging running experience that promotes physical activity and health equity.
course_highlights: Timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and up
Lilla Skärholmsloppet, approximately 1.6 km, for children in preschool class through grade 6
500-metre Mini Race for children aged 0–6, with the option to run together with parents
additional: Start and finish at Puckelbollplanen. Start times: Mini Race at 10:30; Lilla Skärholmsloppet from 11:30 in different age-group waves; 1.6 km Fun Run at 12:25; 5 km race at 13:00. All participants receive a medal and refreshments at the finish. Registration is free and open until 14 May at 17:00. Late registration may be available at bib collection and on race day, subject to availability. Music and DJs along the course provide extra encouragement. The event takes place at Puckelbollplanen in Stockholm, with music and entertainment along the course, and all participants receive a medal after finishing.

name: Singelloop Leiden
description: The Singelloop Leiden is an atmospheric running event held annually in the centre of Leiden. The race starts and finishes at Lammermarkt, near Molen de Valk, and takes participants along a challenging route beside Leiden’s canals. At approximately 6.5 kilometres, it is an accessible race for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. It is organised by Stichting Singelloop Leiden, which continues the city’s long tradition of sport and community.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lammermarkt, next to Molen de Valk
Route of approximately 6.5 km along Leiden’s canals and historic bridges
Run counter-clockwise via Valkbrug, Rijnsburgersingel, Morspoort and Witte Singel
additional: Race numbers are available from various advance-sale outlets from 20 March to 15 April for 7.50 euros. On race day (16 April), a race number costs 8.50 euros and is available at petit-restaurant De Valk. After the race, participants receive a medal upon presenting their race number. The race is held over a route of approximately 6.5 to 7 km, with registration available via the website. The 2027 edition is scheduled for 16 April at 19:30.

name: Krogsereds Trail Run
location: Krogsereds, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Barn och ungdom (upp till 14 år): 50 kr

description: Krogsereds Trail Run is a scenic trail race organized by Krogsereds Idrottsklubb, offering a fantastic running experience with distances for all ages. The race follows the beautiful hiking trails around Lyngsjön and offers categories ranging from children’s races to the 10 km main race. It is a family-friendly event, with start times spread throughout the morning and prizes raffled among participants.
course_highlights: Scenic hiking trails around Lyngsjön
Several distances suitable for children, young people, and adults
Varied terrain through woodland
additional: Start times: Children 10:00, Youth 10:10, Junior 10:30, Recreational 10:30, Main race 10:30. There are no shower facilities on site. Prizes are raffled among participants. It is recommended that participants arrive at least 30 minutes before their start. Trail running on natural terrain around Lyngsjön; registration via Google Forms; no shower facilities. The race is scheduled from 09:00 to 14:00 on 24 April 2027.

name: Premiärloppet
location: Skatås Motionscentral, Göteborg, Västra Götaland, Sweden
description: Premiärloppet is a running event organized by Sävedalens AIK Friidrott and held at Skatås Motionscentral in Gothenburg. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km; both courses offer gently undulating terrain with gravel surfaces and some trail sections. There is a water station at 6 km, and water and sports drink are served at the finish. All participants receive a medal, and prizes from Löplabbet are awarded.
course_highlights: 10 km: gently undulating gravel course
5 km: gently undulating course with Brudaremossen and some downhill trail sections
Water at 6 km and at the finish
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day between 10:00 and 13:15 at the start/finish area in Skatås. Changing rooms for women and men are available near the event area. Results are published at saik.nu and sent to Friidrottsstatistik. All participants receive medals. The race offers medals to all participants and prizes from Löplabbet. Race bibs can be collected both in advance and on race day, and water is available during the race.

name: Tjust Trail Run
location: Västervik, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Tjust Trail Run is a trail race organised by Tjust Bike & Running Club in Västervik. The race offers a challenging, sweaty competition on winding trails, across beautiful rocky outcrops and through the scenic countryside of Småland. Participants get to experience the Småland forest in a unique way, running on technical, hilly trails. Welcome to an enjoyable running experience in beautiful natural surroundings, with a great atmosphere and dedicated race staff.
course_highlights: Winding trails through the Småland forest
Technical sections with elevation and rocky terrain
A passage through a forest tunnel and muddy sections
additional: You can change your distance by email until 10 April. Cut-off time for the longest distance (The Long Run), with a lap split at 11:45. Your race bib must be clearly visible. Trail shoes and a mobile phone are recommended. If you withdraw, contact race staff or call the phone number provided when collecting your race bib. Transport from aid stations can be arranged if needed.

name: Kalmar Backyard Ultra
description: Kalmar Backyard Ultra is a unique ultrarunning event held on a 6,706-metre loop, with the start at 10:00. The race follows the original format: each lap must be completed within one hour to continue, and the next start is on the hour. The winner is the person who completes one more lap than the others. The 6,706-metre distance was chosen because 24 laps equal 100 miles, a dream distance for many ultrarunners, but everyone is welcome regardless of ambition.
course_highlights: 6,706-metre loop
Starts on the hour; the race continues until one runner remains
24 laps equal 100 miles (161 km)
additional: The original Backyard Ultra format: each lap must be completed within one hour, with the next start on the hour. The loop is 6,706 m on the Stensö exercise trail (a gravel-surfaced trail). 24 laps make 100 miles. Organizer: Högby IF. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02.

images.alt_text: Kalmar Backyard Ultra-logotyp.

name: Kurts Marathon / Kurts 300:e maraton (Hultsfred) — inkl. halvmaraton & Backyard Ultra
description: Kurt's Marathon in Hultsfred is a personal and welcoming marathon and half marathon held to celebrate Kurt Gustavsson's 80th birthday and his 300th marathon. The course is a five-lap park path around Lake Hulingen, with approximately 20% asphalt, and is officially measured and sanctioned. The race offers two refreshment stations with water, sports drink, cola, and energy supplements. After the race, participants are invited to a get-together with food and good company near the start and finish at Knektavallen.
course_highlights: Five-lap course around Lake Hulingen in Hultsfred
20% of the course is asphalt; the rest is park path
Two refreshment stations with sports drink, cola, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the entrance to Knektavallen facing Lake Hulingen. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at Knektavallen. Race numbers are distributed from 08:00. Runners expecting to take more than 5 hours should start at 09:00. After the race, a get-together with food and good company is offered at approximately 14:30, about 1 km from the start. The race is part of a festive event celebrating Kurt Gustavsson and is a unique opportunity for runners to take part in a private but officially sanctioned competition.

name: Amerongse Koploop
distance_verbose: 25 km, 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 meter, 0.75 km
description: The Amerongse Koploop is a friendly and challenging trail run through the forests of Utrechtse Heuvelrug National Park, between Amerongen and Leersum. The event offers several distances for both children and adults, including kids’ runs, trail runs and hiking routes. A portion of the entry fee goes towards nature conservation, and participants receive a voucher for local refreshments. After the event, all participants receive a sustainable medal, and there is a lively square at the start and finish where they can relax and enjoy the atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail through the forests of Utrechtse Heuvelrug National Park
Distances ranging from 750 metres for children to a 25 km trail run
A lively square with local specialities and an included refreshment voucher
additional: Pre-registration closes on Thursday 16 April. On-the-day registration is possible, with an additional administration fee payable at the registration desk. Race numbers can be collected in advance on Friday evening. Timing is electronic; there is no rush at the start. Trail and walking distances vary; registration is available in advance and on the day. The location is Nuytgroep, Amerongen. Local refreshments include beer, coffee and fries. Medal and electronic timing.

name: Pop up Run Kinnekulle

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 300 kr, picknick på Öströö Fårfarm Café ingår

description: Pop up Run Kinnekulle is a trail-running adventure that takes you out into exciting natural surroundings and new experiences. The race offers a fairytale-like run through beech forests, past small lakes and historical sites such as Bexell’s Talking Stones. After the run, a locally produced picnic awaits to round things off. The event is open to runners of different paces and recommends carpooling for participants.
course_highlights: Run through the beech forests of Kinnekulle
Pass small, charming lakes and Bexell’s Talking Stones
Finish with a picnic at a locally producing farm
additional: Meet at 10:00 at Öströö Fårfarm. The distance is approximately 15–17 km, with 2–3 different pace groups. A picnic at Öströö Fårfarm Café is included in the price. Carpooling is recommended, and help coordinating rides is offered. The event is designed to provide a welcoming, nature-focused running experience centred on nature, views and local food.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad
price_range: 350 kr till 2000 kr, gratis för de första 250 i Lilla Blodomloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: NYHET – Spring gratis! Sparbanken Skåne bjuder på startavgiften för de 250 första anmälda

description: Blodomloppet Kristianstad is a fun run featuring a scenic route through Vattenriket, with a varied surface of grass, gravel and asphalt. The 5 km and 10 km routes head west from Tivoliparken, cross the Helge River and continue into the beautiful natural area. Younger participants can take part in Lilla Blodomloppet, with shorter routes inside Tivoliparken for children aged 0–12. Blodomloppet is a social, healthy activity that also highlights the importance of blood donation and ends with a group picnic.
course_highlights: Scenic route through Vattenriket
Varied surfaces: grass, gravel and asphalt
Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 0–12 inside Tivoliparken
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. The deadline to register a team is 12 May. Late registration is available at Tivoliparken from 16:00 on race day. Lilla Blodomloppet distances are 100 m (ages 1–3), 550 m (ages 4–7) and 1,100 m (ages 8–12). The 5 km and 10 km routes have a varied surface of grass, gravel and asphalt. Changing facilities and toilets are available at the event site. Blodomloppet ends with a group picnic. The event includes a blood donor gift, activities on site, the option to participate in a team (up to 5 people), and a choice of distances to suit all participants. The race is part of Sweden’s largest blood donation and exercise campaign.

name: Sportpark 21 Run
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1.1 km, 0.7 km, 0.5 km

name: Cascaderun
description: The Hoogeveense Cascaderun is an annual running race in the centre of Hoogeveen, known as the biggest and best run in Drenthe. The race offers a flat, fast course over 5 and 10 miles, ideal both for running a fast time and for a first race experience. With thousands of enthusiastic runners, plenty of spectators, live music along the route and an iconic finish on Hoofdstraat, it is an atmospheric event for all levels. There are also special events, including the DuoRun, UNICEF Children’s Run and Giga-G for athletes with a disability.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through the centre of Hoogeveen
Officially measured 5- and 10-mile races with plenty of spectators
Iconic finish on Hoofdstraat, with live music and refreshments
additional: Race numbers and shirts can be collected on Saturday 10 April 2027 from 09:00 to 16:00 at Het Klooster, and on Sunday 18 April 2027 from 10:00 to 12:30 at De Tamboer. Official chip timing, refreshments along the route and after the finish, and professional finish photos are available to download free of charge. The Cascaderun awards a medal once every 5 years; the next time will be in 2028. Start areas are on Raadhuisplein and are indicated by letters on the race number. There are separate desks for the 5-mile race, 10-mile race and UNICEF Children’s Run. There are water stations along the route (5-mile race: 5 stations; 10-mile race: 7 stations) and toilets at the start and along the route. The first few kilometres can be crowded; runners are advised to keep right and pass on the left. Registration opens in November 2026, start areas on Raadhuisplein, water stations and refreshments along the route, official timing, festive afterparty

name: PCC Maalwater Run
description: The PCC Maalwater Run and Walk in Heiloo offers a varied running and walking programme with distances for all ages. The start and finish are at the PCC and Trias grounds, where there is also an inflatable play castle for children. By taking part, you support Sport@School, a SportRaad Heiloo project that makes sports lessons at primary schools possible. The event is open to both recreational walkers and runners, with a choice of distances.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the PCC and Trias grounds
Distances range from 1 km to 16 km for walking and running
Inflatable play castle for children in the middle of the athletics track
additional: Children can play on an inflatable play castle under supervision during the event. Participants support Sport@School, a SportRaad Heiloo project that makes sports lessons at primary schools possible. Start and finish at the PCC and Trias grounds in Heiloo, with activities for the whole family.

name: Wetter- en Wille Run
location: Wetter- en Willepark, Burgum, Friesland, Netherlands
description: The Wetter- en Willerun is a race through and around the beautiful Wetter- en Willepark in Burgum, with distances of 5 km and 10.5 km (quarter marathon). The event attracts enthusiastic runners and supports a local charity, with proceeds benefiting the community and promoting a healthy lifestyle. Alongside the races, there is also an ‘eleven cities’ sponsored tour and a new 25 km route. The event is known for its scenic course and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful Wetter- en Willepark in Burgum
Distances of 5 km, 10.5 km (quarter marathon), and a new 25 km course
Includes an ‘eleven cities’ sponsored tour before the race
additional: Proceeds from the race go to a local charity. A new 25 km distance has been added. The race is an annual event with a large group of enthusiastic participants and has sold out in previous years. Routes of 5 km and 10.5 km, an ‘eleven cities’ sponsored tour, proceeds go to local charities, held in Wetter- en Willepark.

name: Ride & Roast
location: Fort aan de Klop, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: Run & Roast Utrecht is an atmospheric running event held at Fort aan de Klop. Participants can choose a 5 or 10 kilometre route, which is flat and fast, with a finish at a beautiful location. After the race, there’s a relaxed get-together with music, drinks and a delicious plant-based Beyond Meat burger—ideal for a quick recovery. There’s also a 1-kilometre kids’ run for the youngest runners. The event combines sport with a summery, laid-back atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat, fast loop finishing at Fort aan de Klop
Beautiful location on an island in northern Utrecht
Kids’ run of approximately 1 kilometre for children up to and including 12 years old
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 13:15 on race day or in advance between 13 and 16 April at All4running Store Utrecht. There is no supervised cloakroom; bicycles can be parked in a temporary bike storage area. Chip timing is provided via the race number, which can be recycled after use. There is an awards ceremony for the kids’ run and the main distances. After the race, a plant-based Beyond Meat burger and drinks will be available. Partners include All4running, Karhu, Virtuoos supplements, Shokz headphones and Runbites sports nutrition. Flat course, registration in advance and on the day, post-race food and drinks, kids’ run, prizes for winners, discount offers for participants.

name: Blodomloppet
location: Västra Marks IP, Karlskrona, Blekinge, Sweden
organizer: Blodcentralerna i Blekinge och KA 2 IF

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Laganmälan 5 och 10km (5 personer) 1750 kr tom 29 april

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Laganmälan 5 och 10km (5 personer) 2000 kr tom 13 maj

description: Blodomloppet in Karlskrona is a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation and promotes a healthy lifestyle. Participants can walk, jog or run the 5 km or 10 km distances, take part in the 800-metre children’s race, or enter a special 5 km walking class. The event is open to both individual participants and teams, and concludes with a shared picnic for all participants. The courses are officially measured and approved for competition, and walkers have a separate route to make it possible for everyone to finish together. Blodomloppet is one of Sweden’s largest public health initiatives and attracts many participants every year.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km running courses
Separate 5 km route for walkers
800-metre children’s race
additional: The event offers individual and team registration (maximum 5 people per team). Team members can take part in different distances. Discounts are available for blood donors and ICA members (SEK 40 per person). Large registrations can be handled using an Excel template and a customer page in the registration system. Walkers set off first on a separate route to make it possible to share a picnic after the race. Facilities include changing rooms, toilets, water stations and medical care, and participants can travel to and from the event free of charge. The race is officially measured and approved by the Swedish Athletics Association. Participants can run at the venue or take part remotely between 17 May and 7 September 2027. Race packs include a T-shirt, medal and bib. Discounts are available for blood donors and ICA members.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten is a relay race starting, with exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping. Teams of four each run a fast-paced four-kilometre leg. The event offers a wonderful team atmosphere, with men’s, women’s and mixed teams, with or without timing. The course stays close to the event centre, with upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish. It’s an evening filled with exercise, community and joy, where children and young people can take part for free thanks to HSB.
course_highlights: Start, exchanges and finish in Folkparken in Norrköping
Each team member runs 4 km on a fast-paced course close to the event centre
Upbeat music along the route and spectators cheering at the exchanges and finish
additional: Leg massages are offered by Helhetshälsan both before the start and after the finish. All participants receive a medal sponsored by Azets. Performance prizes go to the first team in each category, and great prizes are drawn among all participating teams. ICA Smedby provides participants with energy-packed products after the finish. The race takes place in Folkparken, with on-site late registration available; participants can register via the website or on race day. Participants receive energy-packed products after the race.

name: Stafettvarvet
price_range: 1399 kr per lag (tidigare pris), senare pris 1699 kr från 2026-02-01
description: Stafettvarvet is an exciting relay race around the beautiful Slottsskogen park in Gothenburg. Each team consists of four participants, all of whom run the same 3.2-kilometre course, starting and finishing at the historic Slottsskogsvallen. The atmosphere is magical and full of anticipation before, during and after the race, as teammates cheer each other on at the changeover. After crossing the finish line, participants can enjoy a delicious picnic together, included in the entry fee. The race is also a popular activity for companies looking to build team spirit through team-building.
course_highlights: Fast 3.2-kilometre course around Slottsskogen
Start, relay changeover and finish inside Slottsskogsvallen
Route through the new entrance park, with teammates cheering runners on
additional: Each team consists of four runners, all of whom run the same course. The baton is handed over across the relay barrier, which is divided into zones based on bib number. Registration includes a picnic bag from Carotte for teammates to enjoy after the finish. Companies can register several teams and pay by invoice. It is possible to book a tent space in Stafettvarvet’s company village in the entrance park, where teams can gather and encourage one another before, during and after the race. The start uses a friends seeding system, with fast runners at the front. Each team has 4 participants, each running 3.2 km. Registration is via the website; the start is at 18:00, with start groups and options for company bookings and picnics. The event is outdoors and focuses on community and company activities.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Västerås is a women’s fun run offering 2.5 km and 5 km distances through central Västerås, with the start and finish at Lögastrand. The event celebrates the joy of being active and a sense of community, and welcomes everyone regardless of fitness background or ambition. Participants can register individually or as a team; registered teams receive a picnic after finishing. The event has a long tradition dating back to 1989 and aims to promote women’s health and create an inclusive setting for exercise and socialising.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course through central Västerås
Start and finish at Lögastrand
Picnic after the finish for teams of 5
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Intersport in Livli Shopping Centre Erikslund in the days before the race. The event area has supervised bag drop, a water station and toilets. Picnics can be collected using the team leader’s race bib. Recommended ages are 13 for 5 km and 11 for 2.5 km; younger participants may take part accompanied by an adult. Participants can opt out of timing when registering. Training meetups are organised in several locations ahead of the race. Participants receive a race bib, a finish-line bag and a medal; teams consist of 5 people. The event is open to runners, joggers and walkers. Registration is online. The event is part of the national Vårruset series.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
organizer: Blodcentralen i Östergötland och IK Akele samt Blodtappen i Östergötland
description: Blodomloppet in Linköping is one of Sweden’s largest fun runs, highlighting the vital need for blood donation. Participants can walk, jog or run 5 or 10 kilometres, either individually or as part of a team. The blood donation bus will be at the event for anyone who would like to donate blood. The race has strong local roots, with ambassadors and local partnerships. It is a social, healthy activity that ends with a shared picnic, and any surplus supports youth activities.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km distances in Linköping
Opportunity to register as a blood donor on site via the blood donation bus
The race is being held for the twenty-second time, with a local ambassador
additional: Youth teams (five members born in 2009 or later) pay half the entry fee when registered by 30 April. Teams can be brought up to five participants at no extra cost by 30 April. Participants who register by 14 May receive six hours of free public transport within Östergötland on race day via an SMS ticket. Late registration is available when race numbers are distributed in the days before the event. Payment can be made by Swish, card or e-invoice for businesses. The event includes different distances for adults and children, with the option to walk or run, as well as blood donation on site. It is a large community celebration featuring music and social activities.

name: Stallbackamilen 2026
description: Welcome to the inaugural Stallbackamilen in Trollhättan on 21 April 2026! The race is designed to help you run a fast 10 km. The course has been officially measured and follows fast cycle paths around Stallbacka in Trollhättan. It is a 3.3 km loop that runners complete three times, with the start and finish next to the tennis hall. Several pace leaders, ranging from 35 to 60 minutes, are available to help runners at different paces.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km course
Fast cycle paths around Stallbacka
A 3.3 km loop completed three times
additional: Gathering is at 17:00 at Bäckelyckepark. Late registration is available through RaceID until half an hour before the start, with no additional fee. Race bibs can be collected near the start and finish. A course trial run will be held on 25 March 2026 at 18:00, meeting at the tennis hall. You can also register for Digitala Varvetmilen to get seeded for Göteborgsvarvet, but registration is separate and takes place at goteborgsvarvet.se.

name: Kolmården Vertical

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 100 kr per deltagare fram till den 19 april.

description: Kolmården Vertical is a challenging 5 km trail race with 300 metres of elevation gain in beautiful, technical terrain at Hults Bruk in Kolmården. The course features lovely trails and technical sections where strong legs and quick feet are an advantage. The race starts at the old football field and includes steep hills, singletrack and scenic views over Lake Ågelsjön. Welcome to this somewhat classic race, which offers a serious challenge for trail enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 5 km with 300 metres of elevation gain in challenging terrain
Technical sections with singletrack and steep hills
Beautiful views over Lake Ågelsjön and a passage past the hermit’s Jakobs Cave
additional: The race starts at the old football field at Hults Bruk. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, along with raffle prizes. A ball field is located 200 metres from the parking area. Cancellation and accident insurance are available as add-ons. The course’s technical sections include “Koklämman,” with a rope to help runners climb, and the race passes a cosy barbecue area beneath a large rock overhang. Trail running, technical sections, start at Hults Bruk; the course description includes hills and trail sections.

name: Mûzelloop Jirnsum
description: The Mûzelloop Jirnsum is a friendly running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the small river Mûzel in Jirnsum. The routes pass historical and natural landmarks, including the old lower course of the Boarn River and the Sneker Oudvaart. The race offers several distances, including a kids’ run and distances of 5, 8.3 and 10 km, with aid stations along the way. The event is organized by a foundation with the help of volunteers and sponsors. It has a warm local atmosphere, with prizes for the top finishers and special trophies for the best Jirnsummers.
course_highlights: Routes along the small river Mûzel and the old lower course of the Boarn River
Aid stations on the 8.3 and 10 km routes; refreshments at the finish for the 5 km
Historic surroundings, including the Jirnsummersyl lock and a connection to the Sneker Oudvaart
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 18:00 in the large hall of the 2 Gemeenten. No showers are available. Ample parking is available nearby at the 2 Gemeenten, opposite the transmission tower on Rijksweg. The routes are marked with arrow signs and chalk arrows, and traffic marshals are stationed at key points. All children receive a memento. Prizes are awarded to first, second and third place in each distance, with special trophies for the best Jirnsummers. The event is limited to 300 participants, and online advance registration is the only way to enter. The event takes place in April 2027, with distances for children and adults, in a beautiful natural setting for runners.

name: Rondje Vrachelen
location: Atletiekbaan ATV Scorpio, Vrachelen, Oosterhout, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Rondje Vrachelen is a friendly and sporty evening run in the natural surroundings of Oosterhout, starting and finishing on the athletics track at ATV Scorpio. Participants run a varied course with both paved and unpaved paths through the beautiful Vrachelen area. The run is suitable for recreational and competitive runners, with two distances of 6 km and 10 km. Facilities such as changing rooms, showers and first aid are available, and there is ample parking nearby.
course_highlights: A varied course with paved and unpaved paths
Start and finish on the athletics track at ATV Scorpio
Run through the natural surroundings of Vrachelen in Oosterhout
additional: Registration is open from 1 December 2026 until half an hour before the race starts, online only. There is ample parking at Zwembad de Warande and football club TSC. Shower facilities are available after the run. An AED is available for emergencies. Participation is at your own risk. Registration opens on 1 December 2026, the start time is 19:30, and the event takes place near Wilhelminakanaal Zuid 78, Oosterhout.

name: Skrylleloppet
location: Skryllegården, Södra Sandby, Lund Municipality, Sweden
description: Björnstorps IF invites you to the 54th Skrylle Race on 25 April 2026. Races are offered over 3, 5 and 10 km, with a new 3 km recreational class for men and women. The courses follow the recreational loops at Skryllegården through varied forest terrain and have a gravel surface. Here you’ll find practical information about registration, race numbers, parking and race day.
course_highlights: 3, 5 and 10 km on the Skryllegården loop courses
Varied forest terrain with recreational trails
Surface: gravel
additional: Online registration is available until 30 minutes before the start; Early Bird registration is open until 22/2, regular registration until 19/4, and late registration until 25/4. On race day, you can register on site and request a name or class change for an administrative fee of SEK 100; on-site payments can only be made with Swish. Race numbers are emailed during race week and can also be collected at Löplabbet in Lund on the Friday before the race, from 10:00 to 18:00 (20% discount when collecting your race number). Results from the 10 km race can be used for seeding for TCS Lidingöloppet. Participants who cycle to the event can register this at race-number collection to enter a prize draw. Online registration is available until the start; Early Bird prices apply until 22 February, regular prices until 19 April, and late registration is available until the start. On race day, you can register on site, with payment by Swish. Race numbers are emailed or collected at Löplabbet in Lund. Bag drop is available.

name: Skälbyloppet
location: Skälby loge, Kalmar kommun, Kalmar län, Sweden
description: Skälbyloppet is a family-friendly recreational race in Kalmar, organised by Högby IF on 25 April 2026. The event offers two main distances, 4 km and 8 km (1 and 2 laps over the bridge, respectively), as well as youth events from 600 m to approximately 1.9 km. The course runs through the Skälby surroundings on gravel and park paths, with a short stretch of asphalt. Water is available at the lap point and at the finish. All finishers receive a medal, and registration follows the schedule provided by the organiser.
course_highlights: 4 km and 8 km courses (1 and 2 laps over the bridge, respectively)
Youth distances from 600 m to 1.9 km
Easy-to-run gravel and woodland paths with a short stretch of asphalt
additional: Water is available at the lap point on the longer course and at the finish. Race numbers can be collected at Skälby loge; start times follow the schedule, and late registration is available as stated by the organiser. The 4 km and 8 km courses follow the usual route (1 and 2 laps over the bridge, respectively). On-site attendance is required for certain officials’ registrations under RF standards. Race numbers can be collected at Skälby loge on Friday 24 April from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day from 08:30; late registration is accepted at race-number collection up to 1 hour before the start. Water is available at the lap point on the longer course and at the finish; all finishers receive a medal.

name: Munkastigen Trailrun
description: Munkastigen Trailrun is organized by Laxå OK and takes place on Saturday, 25 April 2026, starting in Olshammar. The race page has maps, an elevation profile and a GPX file that can be downloaded to help you plan your run. The race invitation and registration link are published under the current year in the menu on the club’s website. You are welcome to take part and consult the course information before the race.
course_highlights: Start in Olshammar
Maps (Map part 1 and Map part 2) and elevation profile available
GPX file available to download (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx, thanks to Jonas Brännmyr)
additional: The race invitation and registration link are published under the current year in the menu on the website. Course information includes Map part 1 and part 2, as well as an elevation profile. The GPX file (Munkastigen_trailrun.gpx) is available to download. The race runs from Olshammar on the shore of Lake Vättern to Laxå in Tiveden. Teams consist of 2–5 runners, with the changeover at any location along the course. An SI card is recommended or can be rented. Start and finish: start at 11:00 in Olshammar, finish at the Laxå OK clubhouse.

name: Retrovarvet 2026
description: Retrovarvet is a running event held on Saturday, 25 April 2026, at Heden in Gothenburg. Meet at 07:45; the event runs approximately from 07:45 to 09:00. Registration is open to club members and is via the listed email address. More information is available on the club’s website and the Facebook event.
course_highlights: Start and meeting point at Heden in Gothenburg
Approximately 10 km (Trailvarvet trial), preparing participants for Varvet
Part of Göteborgsvarvet’s spring training programme, with a focus on warm-up and camaraderie
additional: Registration is open to club members only. The page gives the registration email as premiarbanan1980@gmail.com and says members should log in to the club’s website. Meet at Heden at 07:45 on 25 April 2026. A Facebook event is linked from the event page. The club office’s contact details are available on the contact page. Retrovarvet serves as a warm-up for Göteborgsvarvet and is connected to the spring training sessions and Varvet training.

name: VXO Ultrafest
location: Trummens södra strand, Växjö, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: VXO Ultrafest is an ultrarunning and race-walking festival held in Växjö on the southern shore of Lake Trummen on 25–26 April 2026. The event includes the Swedish Championships in 24-hour running and 100 km ultrarunning, as well as the Swedish Championships in race walking, with a marathon for men and a half marathon for women. The courses are flat and consist mainly of asphalt, with some gravel sections, providing good conditions for fast and enjoyable races. Växjö Running Club welcomes both returning participants and new runners and race walkers to this annual festive weekend.
course_highlights: Flat loop course for VXO24h, approximately 820 metres, mostly asphalt with some gravel sections
The course for VXO100k and the Swedish Race Walking Championships (42 km and 21 km) runs around Lake Trummen, approximately 3.2 km per lap
The event area is on open grassy grounds on the southern shore of Lake Trummen, with space for tents and the lap area
additional: Pre-race dinner on Friday 24/4. The lap area is at the event venue, where there is space for the organiser’s tents and participants’ own tents. The event includes ultramarathon and race-walking events, and takes place on a flat course of asphalt and gravel, providing good conditions for records and strong performances.

name: Lerumsloppet 2025
description: Lerumsloppet is a traditional spring race organised by Lerum Friidrott, with several distances ranging from 250 m to 10 km and the finish and race centre at Bagges Torg in Lerum. The course is described as hilly and spectator-friendly, and suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. The start and race-number collection are centred around Brobacken/Bagges Torg, and the organiser highlights good services, including water stations, medical care, and changing and shower facilities close to the race area. The welcoming text on the website encourages registration through its partner EQ Timing and recommends registering early for a lower entry fee.
course_highlights: Hilly 10 km course featuring the steep “Kyrkbacken” and a long climb towards Laggarns väg
Mixed surfaces: flat paved sections along Säveån/Aspen and gravel paths around Stamsjön and Laggarns väg
Scenic views along Säveån/Aspen and routes through picturesque residential and rural areas
additional: All races start at Brobacken, next to the race centre at Bagges Torg. Race numbers can be collected on Friday evening (stated hours: 17:00–20:00) at the municipal building on Bagges Torg, or on race morning from 09:30; race information is also sent by text message/email (for example, Friday 2/5 at 12:00 for later registrations). Changing and shower facilities are available in cooperation with Actic Vattenpalatset near the race centre (show your race number at reception). Around 55 course marshals, as well as lead and sweep cyclists, are stationed along the routes. Water stations: Vattenpalatset (~2.5 km / 800 m for the 1.6 km course), Laggarns väg (after ~5 km on the 10 km course), and water immediately after the finish. A medical tent is located at the race centre, and course marshals carry first-aid equipment. Lerumsloppet is a family-friendly community event with several distances for children and adults, with start lists and information available on the relevant platforms and the official website.

pipeline_log.evidence_quote: Varmt välkomna till Lerum och Lerumsloppet lördag 25 april 2026.

name: Lauf Zum Alten vom Müssenberg – VB Sauerland Lauf Cup
PKO Gdynia Półmaraton 35. PZLA Mistrzostwa Polski w Półmaraton
Night Run Wageningen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Het inschrijfgeld van € 85 is inclusief 11 groepstrainingen, loopshirt, startbewijs voor deze wedstrijd en een herinnering bij de finish

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Natuurlijk is het ook mogelijk om zonder Start to run cursus deel te nemen aan deze wedstrijd

description: The Night Run Wageningen is an atmospheric running event held in the centre of Wageningen, with the start and finish on the Markt. Participants run in the dark under atmospheric lighting and take on the challenging Wageningse Berg via the Holleweg. There are several distances, including a kids’ run, a 5 km run and an adventurous 10 km run. Beginners can take a Start to Run course that culminates in taking part in the 5 km. The event is open to all ages and levels and offers a fun, sporty evening in Wageningen.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Markt in the centre of Wageningen
Climb the Wageningse Berg via the Holleweg
Atmospheric lighting while running in the dark
additional: Kids’ run start times: 500 m at 19:15 (ages 3–7), 1,000 m at 19:30 (up to and including age 12). The 5K starts at 20:00, and the 10K starts at 21:00. Limited race-day registration may be available at the Grote Kerk on the Markt; participants will not receive a personalised race number. Awards ceremonies for all distances take place after the event. Registration usually opens around December for the following year, with options for early registration and late registration on site at the Grote Kerk.

name: Bålsta Stadslopp
description: Welcome to Bålsta City Race, held on 26 April 2026 at Gröna Dalens IP in Bålsta. The race is known for its fast, spectator-friendly course, where many runners have set personal bests. Organised by Bålsta IK, it has grown every year since it began in 2019. The race offers the Sparbanksloppet 5 km (one lap) and 10 km (two laps), with the finish inside the athletics track at Gröna Dalens. The organisers highlight speed, enjoyment and a welcoming event atmosphere for both elite and recreational runners.
course_highlights: A 5 km loop that can be run once or twice (for a total of 5 km or 10 km)
Approximately 99% asphalt; the finish is inside the athletics track at Gröna Dalens IP
Known as a fast course where many runners have set personal records, with several course records documented
additional: Race bibs can be collected inside Gröna Dalens IP from 08:00. Late registration may be available online, subject to space, until 1 hour before each start on race day. The start and finish are at Gröna Dalens sports ground (Badhusvägen); Bålsta station, served by commuter train line 43, is approximately an 850 m walk from the venue. Several parking options are available 100–900 metres away; Badhusvägen will be closed on race day. There is a bag drop (please attach the lower part of your race bib to your bag), limited changing and shower facilities, and toilets near the venue. Umara sports drink and water are available at the 5 km lap point. A 5 km team competition (Sparbanksloppet) is being introduced; the course is described as fast and personal-best-friendly.

name: Landsjön runt
price_range: 12,5 km: 250-350 kr; 5,5 km: 150-250 kr; Vista FUN RUN: gratis eller 100 kr efter sista anmälningsdatum

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Herr/Dam 13-99 år 12,5 km 250 kr 350 kr efter 19/4

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Herr/Dam 7-99 år 5,5 km 150 kr 250 kr efter 19/4

price_tiers.distance: Pojke/Flicka Vista FUN RUN ca 1 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pojke/Flicka Vista FUN RUN ca 1 km 7-12 år GRATIS. 100 kr efter 19/4

description: Landsjön Runt is a road race in a scenic setting by Lake Landsjön in Kaxholmen, outside Huskvarna. We offer a family day with races for all ages: 12.5 km and 5.5 km for adults and young people, as well as several children’s races, including the Vista FUN RUN. The race goes around the lake, starting and finishing at Vistavallen, with musicians and water stations along the course adding to the atmosphere. The event welcomes both individual entries and team competitions for teams of four.
course_highlights: A road race in scenic surroundings around Lake Landsjön, starting and finishing at Vistavallen
12.5 km and 5.5 km routes by the lake; the course is run clockwise, so the climbs come early
Music along the course and water stations for participants
additional: Parking is available at Vistavallen (taking public transport or parking at Hunnerydsbadet is recommended). Teams consist of four people, all running the same distance; their combined time is recorded, and teams receive a bag from Rudenstams farm shop. A course record in the 12.5 km race earns SEK 5,000 for the runner’s club. Payment is made via Swish to 123 429 98 22, and no automatic confirmation is sent—you are registered if you have received a six-digit number and paid. IK Vista members participate for free if they register by 20/4 (the website also mentions 19/4 in one line). Registration closes on 25/4 at 17:00, but race-day registration may be available, subject to space, at least one hour before the race. Registration closes on 25 April at 17:00. Payment is made via Swish. IK Vista members participate for free if they register by 20 April; enter IK Vista as your club and do not pay. The start list is published one week before the race. The race includes water stations and music along the course; team registration is available, with a shared finish and result.

name: Kvantumloppet (Kvantumloppet med Trail 7+17km)
description: Kvantumloppet is Huddinge AIS Athletics’ running festival at Källbrinks IP, open to all levels, with both shorter fun runs and technical trail options. The event offers a children’s race, 3 km and 5 km fun runs, and 7 km and 17 km trail races, welcoming both recreational runners and more experienced trail runners. The course runs mostly along narrow forest trails and includes sections of technical terrain with rocks, roots and steep hills, as well as several scenic stretches. Prizes are awarded to the fastest woman and man in several races, and everyone who finishes receives a medal.
course_highlights: Runs mostly along narrow forest trails, with some very technical sections featuring rocks, roots and steep hills
Several scenic stretches along the course
The 17 km course follows Gömmaren’s black-and-white “SKATAN” trail
additional: Date and location: 26 April at Källbrinks IP (Gamla Stockholmsvägen 91, Huddinge). Start times: Children’s 700 m race 11:00; Trail 17 km 11:10; Fun runs 3 km and 5 km 12:00; Trail 7 km 12:00. Prizes: Trophies for the first woman and man to finish in the 3 km, 5 km, Trail 7 km and Trail 17 km races; a medal for everyone who finishes. A large prize pool from ICA Kvantum Kungens Kurva, with race bibs serving as raffle tickets; prize-giving at approximately 13:00; novelty prizes and medals for the children’s race immediately after finishing. Organizer: Huddinge AIS (contact: pelle@huddingeais.se, phone 0706758799). Register by 19 April 2026; team discount for at least 5 participants; race bibs can be collected on race day; results are available at kvantumloppet.se

name: Orion Trail
location: Ådalen, Jämjö, Karlskrona kommun, Blekinge län, Sverige
description: Orion Trail takes place in Ådalen in Jämjö, outside Karlskrona in Blekinge. The race follows scenic trails along the river and passes a waterfall and a sea of wood anemones. It can be run or walked. The organiser, OK Orion, welcomes participants to a scenic trail experience on 26 April 2026. The event features an easy to moderately challenging course in beautiful surroundings near Karlskrona.
course_highlights: Trails along Ådalen and the river, with varied surfaces
A waterfall along the course
Wood anemones in a springtime natural setting
additional: Booking is via the MittLopp link. Trail running on paths in Ådalen; Facebook event: https://fb.me/e/1TyHBrexxh

name: Strömsnäs Trailrun
location: Graalstugan, Strömsnäsbruk, Ljungby kommun, Kronobergs län, Sverige
description: SK Graal invites you to Strömsnäs Trailrun, a trail race taking place on 26 April 2026, with the start and finish at Graalstugan in Strömsnäsbruk. The courses run mainly on trails and forest roads, with some sections of off-trail terrain in the forests around Strömsnäsbruk/Traryd. The event is open to both competitive runners and recreational participants. Timing is electronic, using chips, and everyone who finishes receives a medal. The race director and club provide ongoing updates via the SK Graal website.
course_highlights: Runs mainly on trails and forest roads
Routes through the forests around Strömsnäsbruk/Traryd, with some off-trail sections
Road crossings occur — traffic rules apply
additional: Start and finish at Graalstugan. Register in advance via the website by 23/4 (payment can be made to bankgiro 879-0545; include your name and year of birth as the reference). Late registration is accepted only on race day, from 09:30 until 30 minutes before each start; payment by Swish or cash. The late-registration fee is stated differently on the website (+50 kr and +60 kr on top of the standard fee). Electronic timing uses a chip attached to the race bib (return it at the finish). Prizes for places 1–3 in each category, prizes drawn by lottery, and a medal for everyone who finishes; prize ceremony at approximately 12:30. Changing and shower facilities are limited; a cafeteria is available at the finish. Clubs registering more than 3 participants can send an entry list to info@skgraal.se and be invoiced afterwards. Race director: Jonas Almarsson (phone number and email on the website). Sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation; start times generally between 11:00–14:00. Start lists and results are published via the website. Late registration is accepted on race day until 30 minutes before the start. Changing and shower facilities are limited, and a cafeteria is available at the finish. Participation is at your own risk.

name: Wolfsburg Run powered by VfL Wolfsburg e.V.
Koningsloop Beilen
price_range: Minirun, Kidsrun en Jeugdloop gratis; 5 km en 10 km € 12,50 voorinschrijving, € 15,00 op de dag

description: The Koningsloop Beilen is a friendly running event organized by Loopgroep Beilen, suitable for all ages, with distances ranging from a Minirun for the youngest participants to 5 km and 10 km for adults. The event takes place in Beilen and offers a sporty, festive atmosphere, with medals for younger participants and trophies and prize packages for the top runners. Timing is automatic, using a chip attached to the race bib. Changing rooms and showers are available at Vitesse. Parking is available close to the start, and registration is open until 15 minutes before the start of each distance.
course_highlights: Distances range from a 200 m Minirun to 10 km for adults
Timing with a chip attached to the race bib
Start and facilities near Drenthehal and Vitesse sports park
additional: Registration is open until 15 minutes before the start of the relevant distance. Participants in the Minirun, Kidsrun, and Jeugdloop receive a commemorative medal. The first three men and women in the 5 km and 10 km events receive a trophy and a prize package. Race bibs have a chip and do not need to be returned. Pins are available when registering. Showers and changing facilities are available at Vitesse. Parking is available at Drenthehal and Sportpark Noord-West. The organizers accept no liability for lost clothing. Course: urban route with start and finish in Beilen; registration until 25 April 2025; timing by RaceResult; parking at Drenthehal and Sportpark Noord-West.

name: Koningsloop Hasselt
description: The Koningsloop Hasselt is an annual running event held in the centre of Hasselt. The event offers various distances, including 5 and 10 km for adults and juniors, a Bambino Run for the very youngest, a Kids Run and a Heroes Run. The course passes through picturesque central Hasselt, with lovely views, including along the mill and across the Stenendijk. The Koningsloop is known as a sporting orange-themed celebration where people of all ages come together for an enjoyable and challenging running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the centre of Hasselt
Course passes the mill and crosses the Stenendijk, with beautiful views
Fast 10 km with a second lap on the same course
additional: Adults and juniors run the same course and start at the same time. All participants receive a memento, and participants in the Heroes Run receive a trophy. Changing rooms and bag drop-off are available. The finish is at Burgemeester Royerplein via Justitie Bastion. Young people train on Thursday evenings; adults train on Wednesday evenings. Event photos are available and can be removed on request by email. Registration is via inschrijven.nl; the course starts and finishes in central Hasselt; parking is available at Gemeentehuis Zwartewaterland.

description: Värmlandsstafetten in Karlstad is a two-hour relay in which teams of 5–15 participants pass a baton around Sundstatjärn on a flat loop course approximately 1,270–1,300 metres long. The race starts at 18:00, and the aim is to get the baton to the finish within two hours. The start and finish are at the arena in Karlstad. Teams decide how many laps each person runs and make a changeover after every lap. In their first year, teams buy a logo baton that stays with the team each year. Enter your team and take part in a social, wellness-focused evening that fosters community and team spirit.
course_highlights: Flat loop course around Sundstatjärn, approximately 1,270–1,300 metres per lap
Team event for 5–15 participants, with changeovers after every lap and two hours at the arena
Start and finish at the arena; option to order a logo baton that stays with the team
additional: The course around Sundstatjärn is approximately 1,270 metres per lap (just under 1,300 metres) and is paved. Team tents and parking are available at the arena/Sundstabadet. Start and finish are at the arena; teams have two hours to get the baton to the finish. The course loops around Sundstatjärn in Karlstad, with each lap measuring approximately 1,270 metres. Each team has a minimum of 5 and a maximum of 15 participants. The race starts at 18:00, and teams have two hours to get the baton to the finish.

name: Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Rolfstorp, Varbergs kommun, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pris: 300 kr, picknick på Öströö Fårfarm Café ingår

description: Welcome to Pop up Run Åkulla bokskogar—a guided 15–17 km run through the magical beech-forest landscape near Åkulla. We’ll run past small lakes and Bexell’s “talking” stones, and through dense beech forest, in 2–3 pace groups so everyone can keep up. After the run, we’ll finish with a locally produced picnic at Öströö Fårfarm Café. We recommend carpooling and can help coordinate it.
course_highlights: Run in the beech forests of Åkulla
Pass small, picturesque lakes
Bexell’s “talking” stones along the route
additional: Meet at 10:00 at Öströö Fårfarm. Distance: 15–17 km, with 2–3 different pace groups. A picnic at Öströö Fårfarm Café is included in the price. The organizer recommends carpooling and offers help coordinating it. Carpooling is recommended and can be coordinated; a picnic/meal at Öströö Fårfarm Café follows the run.

name: Växjöloppet
description: Welcome to Växjöloppet on 1 May 2026—a running festival for the whole family, with distances ranging from children’s races to a half marathon. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and Lilla Växjöloppet for younger participants. The start and finish are in Strandbjörket, with the start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen. The course combines forest trails through scenic Bokhultet with paved sections around Växjösjön. The half marathon is run over two laps on largely the same course, offering variety and spectator-friendly finishes.
course_highlights: Start on Värendsgatan outside Strandbjörkshallen
Scenic course passing through Bokhultet (mostly deciduous forest), becoming a forest trail after the first kilometre
The final approximately 3.5 km are paved and run around Växjösjön, with the finish straight at Lagunvallen
additional: Distances: 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and several children’s race distances in Lilla Växjöloppet (children’s races are not individually timed). The 21.1 km race is run over two laps (the first lap is just over 11 km, the second is 10 km). Water stations: the 10 km course has four stations (after 1 km, 3 km, 5.5 km and 6.5 km); on the 21.1 km course, runners can take water eight times (including at 1, 3, 5.5, 6.5, 10, 13, 15.5 and 16.5 km). Lilla Växjöloppet: participants in some children’s races receive a race number, medal and fruit; Tidningslöpet provides a T-shirt and diploma. You can use your wellness allowance to pay the entry fee (register via mittlopp.se and submit the receipt to your employer for reimbursement through the wellness allowance). A team competition is available; start lists and participant information are on the official website. Distances are 5 km, 10 km, 21.1 km and Lilla Växjöloppet; water stations are located along the course (4 on the 10 km course; up to 8 water stops on the 21.1 km course); the Bokhultet station closes at 13:40 and the tunnel/Växjösjön station closes at 14:00; the finish closes at 14:30.

name: Hallandsloppet Trail
description: Hallandsloppet Trail is a family-friendly trail race in scenic areas around Vessigebro, starting and finishing at Gurkbänken at Brovallen. The race offers adult classes at 5 km and 10 km, as well as several children’s classes (1,000 m and 2,000 m). Start times are arranged with families in mind: children start at 10:00, adults at 11:00, and participants with dogs start in waves from 11:30. Registration is via the RaceID app or website, or by emailing the organizer as described on the event page.
course_highlights: The race follows trails and forest paths in scenic areas around Vessigebro
Start and finish at Gurkbänken at Brovallen in central Vessigebro
Adult distances of 5 km and 10 km; children’s classes at 1,000 m and 2,000 m
additional: Children start at 10:00. Adults without dogs start at 11:00; participants with dogs start in waves one minute apart from 11:30. Dogs are allowed—email kontakt@hallandsloppet.se to register for the dog start. You can register via the RaceID app or website, or by email with your personal details if you do not want a RaceID profile. Registration is through RaceID; a Facebook post mentions that the entry fee will increase soon.

name: Sevede Trail Run
description: Sevede Trail Run is a welcoming trail race in Mariannelund, organised by Hässleby SOK. The race offers a challenging course that runs mostly along narrow trails through the beautiful Småland landscape—through dark, fairytale-like forests, along lakes and over long slopes with fast descents. There are men’s and women’s categories over 10 km and 26 km, as well as a children’s race of approximately 1 km. Everyone is welcome to register up to race day; the children’s race is free and participants receive a medal at the finish.
course_highlights: Mostly narrow trails through the Småland landscape
Through dark, fairytale-like forests and along lakes
Long slopes and fast descents
additional: Registration opens at 08:00 at Slättvallen in Mariannelund. To register, email sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com. Payment is accepted via Swish (123-358 26 99). Late registration is available on race day. The children’s race is approximately 1 km; all children run for free and receive a medal and a banana at the finish. A parent may accompany the child around the course. Distance options: 26 km and 10 km; start window: Saturday 10:00–16:00; contact: sevedetrailrun@hotmail.com; 2025 record number of participants: approximately 45; 2024 women’s course record for 26 km: 2:10:07 by Emelie Braf; children’s race with many participants; results and photos are available.

name: Trosa Ultra Backyard 2026
description: Trosa Ultra Backyard is a Backyard Ultra on a fast, easy loop course in central Trosa. Each loop is 6.706 km, and the race continues for as long as participants can complete a loop within one hour. The race starts on 2 May 2026 at 10:00. In the Backyard format, anyone who completes a loop within the hour may start again, until only one participant remains. The event is open to the public and family-friendly, with Mini-TUB for children (starting at 12:15) and awards for the top three men and women. The organiser provides sports drink, fruit and sandwiches at the start/finish area, and holds prize draws throughout the race.
course_highlights: 6.706 km loop (main course)
Runs mostly along the Trosaån and is very easy and flat (approximately <10 metres of elevation gain)
Mini-TUB: approximately 700 m course for children (follows the main course for 700 m before branching off)
additional: Start and finish at Västra hamnplan in Trosa; livestream on the Trosa Ultra Backyard Facebook page; Mini-TUB sponsored by Camfil; team competition in which each club’s three best results count (the club with the three best results receives 20% off next year); tent pitches outside the start area; limited motorhome spaces; no caravan spaces; food and energy supplies available (sweets, sports drink and fruit), plus a Selfie Corner after the race; free silicone cup from Umara for all participants in the main race.

name: Nordens Ark TrailRun
description: Nordens Ark Trailrun is a family-friendly trail race held in the Ecopark at Nordens Ark in Hunnebostrand. The race offers several distances, from 1 km for the youngest participants to 30 km for more experienced runners. The event combines nature experiences with health and outdoor activities in a scenic setting. It is organised by IK Granit and has become a popular tradition for both recreational runners and families.
course_highlights: Trail race in the Ecopark, with distances ranging from 1 km to 30 km
Scenic setting featuring woodland and open landscapes
Family-friendly, with activities for all ages
additional: The race is cancelled in 2026 due to unforeseen circumstances. Nordens Ark is a large outdoor park with approximately 4 km of walking trails in the wildlife park, offering a feel for the terrain. The park is cash-free and offers free parking and electric vehicle charging stations. Participants and visitors are encouraged to respect the animals and follow the park's rules. The event was planned for 2026 but has been cancelled for this year. It was an outdoor event with the start and finish at Zooliden, Nordens Ark, winding through the beautiful countryside of Sotenäs.

description: The AH Abe Hunebedloop is an atmospheric running race organised by AV de Sprinter, held in the beautiful surroundings of Havelte. The course runs mostly along paved paths and passes special sights such as the hunebeds, burial mounds and sheepfold. The start and finish are at Toegangspoort Holtingerveld, which also has facilities including changing rooms and toilets. The race offers several distances and categories, suitable for a range of ages and abilities.
course_highlights: Mostly paved paths through the Havelte nature area
Past the hunebeds and burial mounds
Start and finish at the sheepfold (Toegangspoort Holtingerveld)
additional: Race numbers can be collected from 10:00 at the start/finish. Water and fruit are available after the race. Changing facilities are in the Lammerenkooi of the sheepfold. Registration is open until one hour before the start or until the maximum of 750 participants is reached. Late registration opens on 11 January 2027 and costs an additional € 2,00. Registration via inschrijven.nl; start and finish at Toegangspoort Holtingerveld; maximum 750 participants; part of the Univéloopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe.

name: Kanallöpet
organizer: Borensbergs IF, OK Skogsströvarna och Vreta SoMK
description: Kanallöpet is a welcoming running event along the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg, open to competitive runners, recreational runners and families. In 2026, the event offers a half marathon (competitive and recreational categories) as well as recreational 10 km and 5 km races, and this year’s edition has DM/VDM status for the half marathon. All races start at 13:00 from their respective start locations, and the finish is at Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg. The race is promoted as a competition in beautiful Swedish countryside and also offers team registration.
course_highlights: The route follows the Göta Canal between Ljungsbro and Borensberg
Finish at Bergvallen sports ground in Borensberg
A scenic route through beautiful Swedish countryside along the canal
additional: Transport: Buses are arranged from Borensberg to the respective start locations (the half marathon to Ljungsbro, the 10 km to Sjöbacka, and the 5 km to Brunneby) and must be booked and paid for when registering. No transport is provided after the finish; places may be available on race day, subject to availability. The bus fee listed on the registration pages is 100 kr. Team registration: teams of 5 runners, all in the same category; the price per runner is 20% lower than for individual registration, and team registration is only available online. Race bibs are collected at the respective start locations. Registration is valid only once payment has been received; if payment has not arrived within 10 days, the registration will be cancelled. Further details will be provided later in the race instructions. Start locations: 21 km from Ljungsbro, 10 km from Sjöbacka bridge, and 5 km from Brunneby Musteri; buses to the start from Borensberg; registration via Swish or bankgiro; late registration from 11:30 to 12:30 at an increased price; race bibs are collected at the start location.

name: SäterMaran (inkl. DM i halvmaraton)
description: SäterMaran is organised by Säters IF FIK and welcomes runners to the event in Säter. The association’s website has the invitation with the course route, race information and start list, as well as results from previous years. Information is published by the club on the SäterMaran page and in its news section. The club encourages participants to read the race information and schedule before the event.
course_highlights: Course route published (see invitation/course route)
Race information and start list available on the event page
Results from 2025 and previous years published
additional: The invitation, course route, race information and start list are published on the SäterMaran page; results from previous years are available there as well. The website mentions an attached document with the invitation/registration information. The association’s official hashtag is #sätersfriidrott. Contact the association office at siffriidrott@telia.com; website contacts are listed on the contact page. The 2024 SäterMaran results include information on the half marathon (DM) and marathon competitions, as well as different age categories, indicating that both distances may be offered as part of the event.

name: Sparkassenlauf und Wandertag TuS Bergen von 1867 e.V.
Avloppet
location: Sobacken Energi- och Miljöcenter, Borås, Sweden
description: Avloppet is a short 5 km race held alongside Kretsloppet in Borås and organised in collaboration with Borås Energi och Miljö. Registration and payment are made directly on the organiser’s website up to race day, and the Swedish Athletics Federation’s rules apply. The field is limited (maximum 150 participants), and the organiser offers optional chip timing. Event information and confirmation are sent to the email address you provide when registering.
course_highlights: 5 km distance on a hilly gravel course
A unique theme, with the course heading out towards the sewage pipes at Sobacken Energy and Environment Centre
Limited field (maximum 150 participants), with parking at Sobacken
additional: Chip timing is available as an optional extra; a charge of 200 kr applies if the chip is not returned. Results are published on the Kretsloppet website, and parking is available at Sobacken.

tiers.label: tier_2

description: VAIS-loppet is an enjoyable trail race in the Fylleryd nature reserve, organized by Växjö AIS every spring and autumn. There are two distances, 8.4 km and 4.4 km. The long course follows much of the Trestugespåret and becomes hilly towards the end, while the short course follows the floodlit trail. Both races start together at VAIS-torpet at 18:30, and the event ends with refreshments. The race is free for Växjö AIS members; non-members pay an entry fee of 50 kronor.
course_highlights: Hilly recreational trail through the Fylleryd nature reserve
The long course (8.4 km) follows much of the Trestugespåret and is particularly hilly towards the end
The short course (4.4 km) follows the floodlit trail, and both courses finish with a long hill up to VAIS-torpet
additional: Race information will be published on April 28; a map and course profile are available as a PDF; registration is stated to open via a form (new tab) on the event page; the event ends with refreshments at VAIS-torpet. Trail race in Fylleryd Forest with start and finish at VAIS-torpet; spring and autumn events; membership affects the entry fee.

name: Charity-Lauf des PSV Grün-Weiß Kassel e. V.
Vårruset (Halmstad)
location: Civila flygfältet vid Aleskogen i Halmstad, Sweden
description: Vårruset Halmstad takes place on 6 May 2026 at Civila flygfältet by Aleskogen in Halmstad. The event offers 2.5 km and 5 km distances; the 5 km course is officially measured and includes timing. Individual entries include a medal, finish-line bag and race bib, while team entries include a post-race picnic, a medal and a quiz with prizes. Registration is online, and the deadline is race day, no later than one hour before the first start. Age recommendations depend on the distance and whether children are accompanied by an adult. Vårruset is organised by Marathongruppen in collaboration with several athletics clubs. The event emphasises a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to socialise afterwards.
course_highlights: 2.5 km or 5 km course at Civila flygfältet by Aleskogen
Timing on the 5 km course, plus a medal and race bib
Team entry includes a post-race picnic, Vårruset music quiz and prizes
additional: Online registration; the deadline is race day, no later than one hour before the first start. Age recommendations: 5 km for children up to 13 years old (11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km for children up to 11 years old (7 when accompanied by an adult). Team entry includes the added benefit of a post-finish picnic. Teams of 5 are invited to a picnic after finishing; all entries include a medal and finish-line bag. Timing on the 5 km course is optional and can be declined. Registration is available until race day, one hour before the first start.

name: 6. Pallas 67 Ultrameerdaagse
price_range: tot 450 euro voor 5 dagen, 35 euro voor eerste dag, 15 euro voor volgende dagen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Vooruitbetaling 35 euro voor de eerste dag

description: The Pallas '67 Ultrameerdaagse celebrates its fifth edition with a challenging multi-day ultrarun around Wageningen and Bennekom. The event consists of five days, with four routes of approximately 55 km and one route of over 70 km. The routes pass through beautiful natural areas such as the Veluwe, the Betuwe, the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and the mystical Prattenburgsebos. The base is the grounds of Hoekelum Castle, where luxury accommodation is available. The event starts on Wednesday morning, 13 May, at the Pallas '67 clubhouse in Wageningen, with the remaining starts at the castle grounds in Bennekom.
course_highlights: Routes of approximately 55 km and one route of over 70 km
Natural areas: the Veluwe, the Betuwe, the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and the Prattenburgsebos
Start at the Pallas '67 clubhouse, with Hoekelum Castle as the base
additional: The base is Hoekelum Castle, with luxury accommodation at 'de Schuur' for 4 nights. Participants can also take part for one or more days. People from Wageningen can stay at home overnight. The total cost for 5 days, including 4 nights' accommodation, is expected to be no more than 450 euros. Routes through the Veluwe, the Betuwe, the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and the Prattenburgsebos; starts in Wageningen and Bennekom; 4 routes of approximately 55 km and 1 of over 70 km; 4 nights at Hoekelum Castle.

name: Vårruset Vänersborg
description: Vårruset Vänersborg is part of Sweden’s largest women’s recreational running tour and takes place on Thursday, 7 May 2026, with the start and finish at Sanden along Vassbottenleden. Participants can choose between 2.5 km and a certified 5 km course; timing is optional at registration. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish, making the event social and family-friendly. The event is presented by Marathongruppen in collaboration with Vänersborgs SK and is aimed at recreational runners of all ages, subject to the recommended age limits.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sanden (Vassbottenleden)
Choose between 2.5 km and a certified 5 km course
A fun team atmosphere — teams of five receive a picnic after the finish
additional: What’s included (individual registration): medal, finish-line bag, Vårruset music quiz and prizes, timing for those who opt in, and a race bib. Team registration (5 people): picnic after the finish, medal, finish-line bag, timing (if selected), and race bib. Recommended ages: 2.5 km: 11 years (7 years when accompanied by an adult); 5 km: 13 years (11 years when accompanied by an adult). Registration is online and remains open until race day, up to 1 hour before the first start. Contact Vänersborgs SK: varruset.vbg@gmail.com; Vårruset main switchboard: +46 8 545 66 440 (Tue–Thu 09:00–15:00). The course is partly paved and partly gravel, and is flat and easy to navigate throughout. Distance options: 2.5 km or 5 km (certified 5 km course). Individual registrations include a medal, finish-line bag, and music quiz and prizes; team registrations include a picnic after the finish, a medal, and a finish-line bag. You can register online until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start.

name: Bankvarvet
price_range: 125 kr/vuxen, barn och ungdom upp till 16 år deltar gratis
description: Bankvarvet is a fun run in Kisa, taking place on 7 May 2026. The event focuses on the joy of being active rather than achieving a personal best or running the fastest lap, and welcomes participants of all ages and abilities. Entertainment, activities and food experiences are also on offer throughout the day, making it a festival for the whole family and groups of friends. Bankvarvet encourages community spirit and setting your own goals, whether you walk, jog or run.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Kullaparken in Kisa
Focus on the joy of being active and setting your own goals
Family-friendly event with entertainment and activities
additional: The event runs from 16:00 to 20:00 and has over 2,000 participants. It includes entertainment, activities and food experiences. Participants are encouraged to sign up with friends or family for an even more enjoyable experience. Ultramarathon runner Frida Södermark shares training tips ahead of the race via the bank’s social media. The race starts at 18:30 in Kullaparken, Kisa; activities for the whole family; businesses can take part; entertainment and food throughout the day.

VR-Bank Abendlauf
