name: Putten Power Run
description: The Putten Power Run is the annual running event that makes the vibrant heart of Putten beat. On the Friday after Ascension Day, the town centre turns into a sporting arena, with an atmospheric course through the centre and Putterbos. Participants can choose from various distances, from kids’ runs to a challenging 10 km, and enjoy a fun-filled day with music, food stalls and activities for the whole family. The event celebrates sporting spirit and togetherness, and supports local charities.
course_highlights: An atmospheric course through the town centre and Putterbos
Start and finish on the lively square in the heart of Putten
Water stations along the course and at the finish
additional: Race numbers are available for collection from 15:00 at the race office on Kerkplein. The IPICO timing tag must be attached to your shoelace and returned after the finish; otherwise, a €7.50 charge will apply. Free parking is available at the car park on Brinkstraat. Changing rooms with toilets are available, but there are no showers. Medical support is available along the course and at the finish. Enjoy a lively atmosphere with a DJ, food stalls, a business plaza and children’s activities. The event offers water stations, medical support and parking. Showers are not available in the changing rooms. Registration is available on the day at Kerkplein.

name: Gotaleden Stafett & Ultra
description: Gotaleden Relay & Ultra is a brand-new running and relay event taking place on 9 May 2026. Four races are offered along the scenic Gotaleden trail between Gothenburg and Alingsås: individual distances (35 km and 75 km) and team relays (35/75 km), with stages ranging from approximately 4.5 to 12 km. The races feature varied terrain and beautiful scenery, and the finish at Nolhaga Park will be celebrated with an awards ceremony, food trucks, showers and an After Run. The event is aimed at everyone from recreational runners to experienced ultrarunners.
course_highlights: The course follows the Gotaleden trail between Gothenburg and Alingsås, with beautiful scenery and historic industrial environments
Varied terrain: trails, gravel and asphalt
The ultramarathon has substantial total elevation gain (approx. 1,403 m) and reaches a high point of ~185 m above sea level
additional: Age limits: Relay (35/75) from age 14; Ultra 75 and Sprint 35 from age 17. Relay 75 consists of 9 stages (2–9 people per team), with stages of 4.5–12 km; Relay 35 has 4 stages (2–4 people). Ultra 75: 75 km, asphalt/gravel/trail terrain, 16 aid stations and a food station in Floda; Sprint 35: 35 km, 7 aid stations. Stage start points are located near public transport, and the organizer offers the option to book a bus to the start when registering. The finish at Nolhaga Park offers an awards ceremony, food, showers and an After Run. The races start in Gothenburg (Valhalla IP) and, for the sprint, in Floda (Garveriet), with different start points along the Gotaleden. After the finish, runners can enjoy a finish-line celebration and After Run, as well as a training weekend at Öijared Resort in March 2026 ahead of race weekend.

name: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun
location: Karlsrofältet, Linnéplatsen, Botaniska Trädgården, Göteborg, Sweden
description: Änggårdsbergen Trailrun is a 12.5 km trail race in the Änggårdsbergen nature reserve in Gothenburg, organised by Språng Träning & Äventyr. The one-lap course features technical trails, hills and several viewpoints—a true trail race in the heart of the city. The race suits both those looking to push themselves and those who want to enjoy nature. The start and finish are at Karlsrofältet, near Linnéplatsen/Botanical Garden. The organisers welcome participants seeking adventure and close-to-nature experiences.
course_highlights: Technical trails, hills and fast downhill sections
Varied terrain: soft, pine-needle-covered and mossy trails, as well as short gravel sections
Several viewpoints overlooking the sea and central Gothenburg, in a nature reserve in the heart of the city
additional: Start and finish at Karlsrofältet (approx. 300 m from Linnéplatsen/Botanical Garden). Friends can start together in three start groups: 11:00, 11:03 and 11:06. Race bibs can be collected from 09:30 on race day; race numbers will also be sent by SMS on Friday. Trail shoes with a substantial tread are recommended; spiked shoes are prohibited. There is one aid station approximately halfway around the course and another after the finish. Energy partner Moonvalley provides sports drinks and bars. Wooden medals inspired by Vitsippsdalen. Start places can be transferred via Eq-Timing for 100 kr (name changes/transfers must be made by 27/4). Practice runs are offered (21 March: hill-running technique; 12 April: full-course practice run). Medical staff will be in the finish area. Public transport: take the tram to Linnéplatsen/Botanical Garden or a bus to Linnéplatsen. Parking is available around Slottsskogen; avoid parking in the Änggården residential area. Children aged 8 and over can run with a guardian, who is responsible for the child.

name: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Ordinarie anmälningsavgift: 195 kronor fram tills onsdag 29 april.

description: Östgötatidningen Mjölby Stadslopp is a family-friendly recreational running event starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby. The main race is six kilometres through the town. There is also the KyrkRundan, approximately three kilometres long, and a free children’s race. The event features music and activities along the route and is a local celebration that welcomes walkers, joggers and runners alike. You are warmly welcome to a day of movement, togetherness and fun on Saturday, 9 May 2026.
course_highlights: Six kilometres, starting and finishing in Stadsparken in Mjölby
Approximately half of the route runs close to the Svartån River
99 percent asphalt; a few challenging uphill sections and the final kilometre through central Mjölby towards Gästisparken
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Intersport on Friday, 8 May, 12:00–18:00 (a 25% discount coupon is provided when collecting your number). Uncollected race numbers will be distributed in Stadsparken no later than one hour before the start. The tab at the top of the race number is the timing chip—without it, no time will be recorded. Late registration is available 30 April–7 May via the website, and can also be completed at race-number collection on 8 May or in Stadsparken on 9 May (Swish only). Fitness4You will lead the warm-up. Refreshments are provided by, among others, ICA Supermarket Mjölby, with water and sports drinks from Finspångs Brunnsborrning. Participant numbers have been high in previous years, with 1,074 runners mentioned in coverage of the event. Registration for 2026 opens, and results and records are published by the event’s organising media.

name: Strandmilen
description: Strandmilen is a local running event in Hultsfred, following a pleasant, flat course along Lake Hulingen. There is a 10 km course and two children’s races, and the organizers welcome both club runners and recreational runners. Children can also enter the longer course if they wish. For more information, the organizers refer participants to the race-day information on the event page.
course_highlights: Flat course along Lake Hulingen
10 km for adults and two different children’s races
A pleasant, family-oriented event setting at Herrstorpet
additional: The children’s races start at 10:00 and the 10 km race starts at 11:00. You do not need to belong to a club to participate. The organizers refer participants to the race-day information for more details. The children’s races start at 10:00 according to the schedule; Strandmilen is part of Herrstorpet New Building Day, with rail-bike rides, guided tours and a concert during the morning.

name: Koster Trail
location: Kosterhavets Ekobod, Västra Bryggan, Nordkoster, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kostnad för deltagande: 1 250kr inkl. moms. I deltagaravgiften ingår startplats, mat och en god öl/glas vin/alkoholfritt.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Vi har också ett antal platser utan mat och dryck, de kostar 950kr inkl. moms.

description: Koster Trail is a challenging trail race in Kosterhavet National Park, taking place this year on Saturday, May 9, 2026, and celebrating its 5th anniversary. The race is held on Nordkoster and offers Bohuslän’s rocky shores, sandy beaches, trails, and several magical viewpoints along a course of approximately 15 km. After crossing the finish line, participants can recover with a saltwater swim and food at Kosterhavets Ekobod. The race is organized by Kosterhavets Ekobod in collaboration with local partners and has a limited number of entries (200).
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km along the coast on Nordkoster, with trails, sandy beaches, and rocky shores
Technically challenging course with sections of rocks and cliffs and many viewpoints
Start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod near Västra Bryggan; two aid stations along the course
additional: Start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod by Västra Bryggan on Nordkoster. The course has been approved by Kosterhavet National Park, and the race has only 200 entries. Two aid stations serve water and U Sport sports drink from Umara. Bibs can be collected on Friday, May 8, from 18:00 to 20:00, or on race day from 10:00. After the finish, pizza from Artisan Bread Karlstad and beer from Qvänum Brewery will be served. There are no shower facilities at the finish; bag storage is available at the start/finish. Participants need accident and liability insurance. Travel and accommodation tips are linked on the race website. Maximum 200 entries; minimum age 18; start and finish at Kosterhavets Ekobod near Västra Bryggan on Nordkoster; pizza and craft beer served after the race; aid stations along the course; registration opens January 10, 2026, at 10:00 via RaceID; results via RaceID.

name: Kolmårdstrailen
location: Kolmården, Norrköping Municipality, Östergötland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: Halvmarathon, 10 km, 10 km, 7.5 km, 5 km, 5 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.price: 21 km 400 kr; 11 km 300 kr; 6 km 200 kr; Ungdom 50 kr; Kidz 50 kr
tiers.description: Till och med 3 Maj: 21 km 400 kr, 11 km 300 kr, 6 km 200 kr, Ungdom 50 kr, Kidz 50 kr.

late_fee.price: 21 km 500 kr; 11 km 400 kr; 6 km 300 kr; Ungdom 50 kr; Kidz 50 kr

description: Kolmårdstrailen is a hilly, experience-focused trail race in the scenic Kolmården area, with technical trails, rocky slabs and plenty of elevation gain. You can choose from courses of approximately 21 km, 11 km and 6 km (as well as a 500 m children’s course). The course is described as challenging but close to nature. It passes, among other places, through Rödgölens Nature Reserve and offers beautiful views from Kolmården’s highest point. The organizer emphasizes the experience and provides services including a water station and downloadable GPX data for your watch.
course_highlights: Hilly, technical trail terrain with plenty of elevation gain and sections of rocky slabs
Passes Rödgölens Nature Reserve and Lake Ågelsjön; views from Kolmården’s highest point (171 m above sea level)
Small trails and singletrack, a wooden bridge over marshy sections, a rope in “koklämman” and a tough, partly off-trail final kilometre
additional: Regular registration is open through 3 May; late registration is available online until 6 May and then on site on race day from 09:00 to 11:00, with payment by cash or Swish. GPX data for the courses is available to download. There is a water station after approximately 7.5 km at Scoutstugan. A children’s race of approximately 500 m is available for children up to age 10. For Kolmården Night Trail, bring a headlamp; the course is marked with reflectors, there are no shower facilities, and chanterelle soup is served at the finish. The organizer offers cancellation and accident insurance as optional extras. The Kolmården events in the series include Kolmården Vertical (5 km, 300 metres of elevation gain), Swimrun Kolmården, Kolmården Night Trail (9 km) and Luciatåget (7.5 km). A results page is available, and multiple distances are emphasized during the event.

name: SHE Silverlöpet
organizer: Sala-Heby Energi AB (i samarbete med IFK Sala)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgift fram tom den 1/5: 2 km 40:- för barn

description: SHE Silverlöpet is a relaunch of the classic Silverlöpet, organised in collaboration with SHE. The race runs through central Sala and its beautiful surroundings, with the start and finish in Stadsparken. Choose 10 km (course measured), 5 km or a 2 km children’s race. The race is open to everyone and is presented as a community festival, with a medal for all participants.
course_highlights: Through central Sala and around Sala’s beautiful surroundings
Start and finish in Stadsparken, Sala
The 10 km course has been officially measured
additional: Registration is via Mitt Lopp (opens 2026-03-01). Online registration is open until the beginning of May; late registration takes place on site on 9/5 (5–10 km: 08:00–09:00, children’s 2 km: 08:00–09:15). Prizes and awards: a medal for all participants; prizes for 1st–3rd place in the women’s and men’s 10 km races; prize draws for the 5 km. Silverlöpet is being relaunched in Sala; the most recent race was held in 1999. The distances are 5 km and 10 km. The event is advertised by Sala-Heby Energi AB in collaboration with IFK Sala.

name: Vellinge Beer Run
description: Welcome to Vellinge Beer Run 2026—a friendly and inclusive recreational race that combines running with local beer culture. The race is 5 kilometres long and starts and finishes at Vellinge Brewery in central Vellinge. The race starts at 12:00 on 9 May 2026, and the course takes you through beautiful surroundings in the Vellinge area. After the finish, beer tasting is offered at the brewery. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners looking for a social and fun challenge.
course_highlights: 5-kilometre recreational race
Start and finish at Vellinge Brewery (Kompanigatan 18)
The course passes through beautiful surroundings in the Vellinge area
additional: Date and time: 9 May 2026, start at 12:00. Start/finish: Vellinge Brewery, Kompanigatan 18, 235 32 Vellinge. After the finish, beer tasting is offered at Vellinge Brewery. The race is described as suitable for all levels—both experienced runners and beginners. Date: 9 May 2026. The event emphasises socialising and local beer culture as core elements of the experience.

name: Älmhult Fights Cancer
description: Älmhult Fights Cancer is a charity race in Älmhult that raises money for the fight against cancer. The event is organised by Aktivitetshuset/the IKEA network and welcomes the general public, IKEA employees and their families. Registration is through RaceID, where participants choose both their distance and start time. Online registration is open until 9 May at 20:00, and on-site registration is available from 08:30, subject to availability. The race weekend also includes inspirational talks and an after-run at Grillen after the finish.
additional: Register through RaceID (choose a distance and start time). Online registration is open until 9 May at 20:00; on-site registration is available from 08:30, subject to availability. As this is a charity event, fees are non-refundable if you cancel. Group registration is supported (add additional participants during payment), and the confirmation email from RaceSupport includes your chosen distance and start time. Inspirational talks are held at Aktivitetshuset before the race (including Aron Anderson on 10 April, 17:00–19:00, and a talk by researchers on 24 April, 17:30–19:00). The after-run at Grillen starts at 14:00 after the race. A course map is available as a PDF on the event page, and IKEA Hotell is recommended for overnight stays.

tiers.description: 1 maj - 9 maj 130 SEK. Efteranmälan. Begränsat antal platser.

description: Sommarro Snabbare is a unique, fast-paced running race in the Sommarro cultural reserve in Örebro. The race follows a 2.6 km loop through a wooded park setting, with each lap having to be completed in progressively less time (the first lap in 25 minutes, the next in 24 minutes, the third in 23 minutes, and so on), making the race faster with every lap. Everyone starts on equal terms, and the winner is the one who lasts the longest—making it suitable both for fast runners and for those looking to challenge their endurance. There is also Lilla Sommarro Snabbare for children born in 2013 or later (one lap, no timing).
course_highlights: 2.6 km loop in a beautiful wooded park setting (Sommarro cultural reserve)
Hilly course, mostly gravel and fitness trails, with some off-road sections
Start/finish on a lawn; the race uses progressively faster lap times
additional: Mandatory race briefing at 10:45; warm-up with Nordic Wellness before the start. Timing is done with a transponder worn around the ankle (number of laps is the main factor in placing; if tied, the time on the final lap decides). A lost transponder incurs a charge of 800 SEK. Water/sports drink (Umara) and an energy station are available, along with light refreshments. Changing facilities/showers are not available; there are two public toilets nearby. Parking at Sommarro Värdshus and Lugnets IP; city bus 7 stops at Halltorpsvägen.

name: Ölands Kyrkstafett
description: Ölands Kyrkstafett is a classic long-distance relay, being held for the 47th time, and offers a fantastic running experience on Öland as spring gets underway. The start and finish are in Färjestaden, and the race comes in two formats: a longer course with eleven legs, totalling 67.5 km, and a shorter course with six legs, totalling 23.5 km. The race welcomes both dedicated runners and beginners, with legs for all levels. Event staff and a race announcer follow the race to provide the best possible service and atmosphere throughout the event.
course_highlights: Long course: 11 legs, 2.7 km to 8.5 km, 67.5 km total
Short course: 6 legs, 2.7 km to 5.4 km, 23.5 km total
Start and finish at Hamnplanen in Färjestaden
additional: Race bibs can be collected on 8 May from 15:00 to 17:00 and on race day, 9 May, from 08:00 to 09:30 at Hamngrillen in Färjestaden. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall, 200 m north of Ölands Köpstad. Wellness Studio will lead a group warm-up before the start. Individual leg times, split times and teams’ finish times will be provided. The race announcer will follow the leaders from start to finish. Accommodation and food are available at Ekerum Resort and Best Western Plus Kalmarsund Hotell. Registration is open until 30 April 2026, with late registration available through 6 May. Participants can look forward to a well-organised event with event staff, a group warm-up and a prize-giving ceremony for the top teams.

name: Humlestafetten
description: Humlestafetten is a relay race held in Bruksparken in Bromölla, with the start and finish in the same place. The race consists of six legs and is suitable for all runners, from recreational runners to more experienced athletes. The course is flat and easy to run, with a mix of gravel and asphalt, making the event a day filled with running enjoyment and camaraderie. The anniversary year is celebrated with a mini race for children and a draw for a hot-air balloon ride for participating teams. The mass start is at 11:00, and race bibs can be collected from 09:00.
course_highlights: Flat, easy-to-run course with gravel and asphalt
Six relay legs with timing via data chip
Water station at approximately 3.5 km on leg 1
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 09:00 in Bruksparken. Showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and many prizes are drawn among participants. Timing is done using a data chip, and both overall time and each runner’s leg time are recorded. The race has a mass start, and slower runners are asked to keep to the right to let faster runners pass. The event includes a mini race for children, medals for all participants, and prizes for the top three in each category. Race-bib collection starts at 09:00, and showers and changing facilities are available at Sparbankshallen. Registration is open through 8 May 2026.

location: Centrala Idrottsplatsen, Lund, Skåne County, Sweden

description: Lundaloppet is a recreational race held in central Lund, offering several distances for all ages and abilities, including 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and the children’s Little Lundaloppet. The race is known for its great atmosphere and scenic routes through parks and urban surroundings. It is a community celebration where both beginners and experienced runners come together to enjoy the joy of running in springtime Lund. The finish is inside Centrala Idrottsplatsen, the race’s vibrant heart since 1997.
course_highlights: 10 km of running joy through springtime Lund
Route through parks and the city centre
Child-friendly race of approximately 500 metres around Centrala Idrottsplatsen
additional: Race bibs can be collected at IFK-hallen at Centrala Idrottsplatsen on 8 May from 13:00 to 19:00 and on 9 May from 9:00. The warm-up for the main race takes place at the start on Svanevägen, with raised podiums along the way. Race confirmations are sent by email in week 18 and must be shown when collecting race bibs. Timing is recorded using a chip on the race bib, and the finish is filmed. Trail and city running; registration online; race numbers and T-shirts can be purchased in advance or on site.

name: Hörster Waldlauf im Naturpark Teutoburger Wald
Blue Power Run
organizer: Fundacja Pełnoprawni MY i Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom z Autyzmem SENSE
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organised for people on the autism spectrum, their families and friends. The event aims to support social inclusion through a shared sporting event that brings participants together and raises awareness of autism. The race takes place on a paved path by Arkonka Swimming Area in Szczecin. Above all, taking part is about the satisfaction of completing the challenge and overcoming yourself, regardless of finishing place. The event also includes group activities led by therapists and volunteers, further encouraging inclusion.
course_highlights: The route follows a paved path by Arkonka Swimming Area
An inclusive race for people on the autism spectrum and their families
Group activities led by therapists and volunteers
additional: The entry limit is 300 participants. Race packs can be collected at the Race Office on Friday, 16 May, from 10:00 to 12:00 and from 14:00 to 16:00, as well as on event day from 12:00 to 13:00. Starts are divided into age categories, with distances ranging from 200 to 600 metres. The Race Office and start are located by the Szyszka restaurant. The event is inclusive, with routes for children and adults, and takes place on a paved course in Arkonka. Online registration is available until 10 May 2025. The start is scheduled for 13:00.

name: Czerwona Trasa Nordic Walking Do Najdłuż...
description: The Red Nordic Walking Route in Wilkowo Nowowiejskie is a scenic and challenging 8.2 km route, serving as the first stage of the 14th edition of the Nordic Walking Grand Prix. The event will take place on 9 May 2026 and offers an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and to discover local attractions such as the largest wooden clog and a communal feast table. Participants can prepare by using the certified Nordic Walking routes available in the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality.
course_highlights: Red route, 8.2 km long
Scenic but challenging terrain
Local attractions: a communal feast table, the largest wooden clog and a snuffbox
additional: The event starts at 11:00. Registration is open from 18 March 2026 to 7 May 2026. The route passes through the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality, encouraging participants to use the certified Nordic Walking routes available in the region. The event offers sporting challenges, beautiful views and local attractions to enrich participants’ Nordic Walking experience.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: The 4th Płużnica Five is a 5-kilometer race held in the scenic village of Płużnica. The course has a varied surface, making it appealing to both recreational and more experienced runners. Participants start in the village center, and the event also includes children’s races and an awards ceremony. The race has a friendly, family atmosphere, as confirmed by positive reviews from participants in previous editions.
course_highlights: A 5 km route through the center of Płużnica
Surface: 71% asphalt, 23% dirt road, 6% paving stones
Scenic views and varied terrain
additional: Schedule: 10:40 official opening, 10:50 warm-up, 10:55 lining up at the start, 11:00 race start, 11:50 children’s races, 12:15 awards ceremony, 12:45 official closing. The course starts in the village center. Prizes and a welcoming atmosphere with refreshments are planned after the race. The participant limit is 200. The race is part of the Grand Prix of the Chełmno Land. Online registration, timekeeping, and live results are available.

name: KaaienLoop
location: Stadspark en centrum van Oosterhout, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Kaaienloop is a lively running event in Oosterhout, starting and finishing at the Heuvel. The 24th edition takes place on Saturday, 8 May 2027, and offers a range of distances for the whole family, from the 550-metre Bambino Run to the challenging 10 kilometres through the city park and town centre. The varied routes are accompanied by live music from bands along the course, creating a festive atmosphere. The Kaaienloop is open to all ages and ability levels, with chip timing and a strong focus on sociability and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: Course through the city park and the atmospheric centre of Oosterhout
Live music from various bands along the course
A range of distances, including a dedicated course for the Bambino Run in the city park
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day from 15:30 until 15 minutes before the start at the stand in front of Heuvel 7. The Bambino Run is 550 metres through the city park and can be run with a parent accompanying the child. The 5 km consists of 2 laps of 2.5 km, and the 10 km consists of 4 laps of 2.5 km. Timing is recorded via a chip in the race number and start and finish mats. Results will be published on uitslagen.nl. Participants can register for various distances, and the event also includes youth and company races. Photos and results from previous editions are available online.

name: Run van Gieten
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2.05 km, 1 km, 0.5 km, 0.3 km

price_tiers.distance: Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe wedstrijdloop 10 kilometer
Magnesium halve marathon Run van Gieten

description: The Run van Gieten is a running and walking event held on the Hondsrug in Drenthe. The 19th edition takes place on Saturday, 8 May 2027, and offers a wide range of distances, from 250 metres for the youngest participants to a half marathon. The event includes various races, such as the Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe 10-kilometre race, the Magnesium half marathon and the Magnesium 5.3-kilometre race. There are also youth and wheelchair runs, walking tours and special races for children. Everyone is warmly welcome to join this sporty day full of challenge and fun.
course_highlights: Running and walking event on the Hondsrug in Drenthe
Distances ranging from 250 metres to a half marathon
Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe 10-kilometre race with chip timing
additional: Participants in the 10-kilometre race can use the changing and shower facilities at De Goorns sports hall. Valuables can be handed in at the Impuls office on Brink. There are plenty of parking spaces nearby. All participants run with a Loopcircuit de Kop van Drenthe chip. Cash prizes are awarded to the fastest men and women in various age categories, with an additional bonus for breaking the course record. Registration is via QR code and includes the youth and school championships, walks and special runs.

name: SilvercityRUN
description: SilvercityRUN is an annual running event in Schoonhoven, known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting challenge. The race passes through the historic streets of the Silver City and attracts both recreational runners and dedicated athletes. With 5- and 10-kilometer distances and a special Kidsrun, there is a suitable race for everyone. The event is marked by a festive atmosphere, with music and enthusiastic supporters along the course.
course_highlights: Historic streets of Schoonhoven
5- and 10-kilometer distances
Friendly, festive atmosphere with music
additional: SilvercityRUN 2026 sold out, with 1000 participants. A special training group and a running shirt are available. Each year, an amount is raised for the charity 'Het Huis van Noord'. The annual race celebrated its anniversary edition in 2026 and featured various distances, including 5 km, 10 km and a kids’ run, with many volunteers and a lively atmosphere.

name: Springtime 2025
description: Springtime Helsingborg is an annual running event in Helsingborg organised under the Springtime brand. This year’s edition takes place on 10 May 2026 and offers several race categories, including Company/Team, MiniSpringtime, Everyone Can Run and the Open IFK Championships. The event is open to runners of different levels and offers both competitive and family-friendly activities. Registration is available via the website, and results from previous years are available online.
course_highlights: Several race categories for different audiences: Company/Team, MiniSpringtime, Everyone Can Run and the Open IFK Championships
Family-friendly format with broad participation
Results from previous years and registration via the official website
additional: Register via “Sign up here!” on the website; results are available for several years (2011–2025). name: Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race held simultaneously around the world. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the runners and gradually increases its speed until it catches the last participant. In Gdańsk Południe, the race will take place on May 10, 2026, starting at 13:00 near the Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie finish area. The course is an approximately 3 km loop on a paved surface, with a minimal uphill section on the connector. All entry fees support spinal cord research.
course_highlights: An approximately 3 km walking and running loop
Paved surface, uneven in places near the large reservoir
A minimal uphill section on the connector toward the smaller reservoir
additional: The race is open to runners and participants using wheelchairs. The Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the runners at a speed of 14 km/h and gradually speeds up. 100% of entry fees go toward spinal cord research. Participants use the Wings for Life World Run app to follow the race and results. The race starts at 13:00, and participants use the app to register and track their progress. The event is open to runners and wheelchair users.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: The Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race in which all participants start at the same time around the world, running from the Catcher Car. All entry fees go towards research into treatments for spinal cord injuries, making this not only a sporting challenge but also a charity event. You can take part locally or via the app, which lets you run from anywhere in the world.
course_highlights: Simultaneous start around the world
No traditional finish line—the Catcher Car pursues participants
A race for runners, wheelchair users and first-timers
additional: Participants can join the race locally or via the Wings for Life World Run app, which tracks time and distance. 100% of entry fees support spinal cord research. Marketing tools and promotional materials are available for organisers of local app runs. Taking part supports research into treatments for severed spinal cords; the event also includes merchandise sales and the option to join remotely, with all proceeds going to scientific research.

The run is a spin-off of Sportpark De Dikke Tien, an initiative by local residents to make exercise fun, sociable and healthy. There are three routes: 10 kilometres, 5 kilometres and a special 1-kilometre kids’ run. name: Leiden Marathon
description: The Leiden Marathon is an atmospheric running event held in the historic city centre of Leiden and the surrounding area. The course passes the beautiful canals, cheering crowds, and the green polders and villages around the city. The start is on Koninginnelaan, and the finish is beneath the iconic finish arch at Vismarkt. Marathon weekend offers several distances, including 42 km, 21 km, 10 km, and a 5 km Nightrun, and is an experience for both runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Start on Koninginnelaan
Finish beneath the finish arch at Vismarkt
Course through the historic city centre, along the canals, and across green polders
additional: The 10 km, 21 km, and 42 km walking distances start on Saturday. The 5 km Nightrun takes place on Saturday evening. The 10 km, 21 km, and 42 km running distances start on Sunday. Race numbers can be collected on Saturday and Sunday at Johnson & Johnson Park (Garenmarktplein). There is a supervised bag drop and a tent village with a help desk. The finish is a festive place, with large crowds along the course. Registration opens on 1 October 2023; the event includes several distances and activities, with the start and finish at Garenmarktplein and Johnson & Johnson Park.

name: Rondehoeploop
location: Ouderkerk aan de Amstel, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Rondehoeploop is a friendly and popular running race in Ouderkerk aan de Amstel, celebrating its 40th anniversary edition in 2027. The race offers challenging courses of 17.2 km and 5 km, plus a 2 km children’s race, with a welcoming start and finish at De Bindelwijk sports hall. The event attracts many participants and spectators each year, thanks in part to the enthusiastic volunteers and the crowds along the course. Every participant receives a medal, and various prizes are awarded across different age categories.

2 km children’s race, with a dedicated training schedule available

The fastest Ouderkerkers receive a dinner/lunch voucher, and a perpetual trophy after three consecutive wins. Anniversary edition; advance registration required; includes route directions and refreshment stations along the course.

The City Run is inclusive and accessible to athletes using handbikes or blades. Participants can collect their race numbers in advance at Sport2000 Sportshop Bouwes or on race day at Hotel Marktstad.

In Växjö, participants can choose between 2.5 km and 5 km, starting and finishing at Strandbjörket, around Lake Växjö. You can register individually or as part of a team. A medal, a finish-line bag and the Vårruset music quiz with prizes are included, while timing is optional. Age recommendations apply, and registration is online. As an extra new feature, free HPV vaccination is available on-site during Vårruset for women born in 1994–1999, according to Region Kronoberg.

You can register online up until race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start; you can opt out of timing when registering.

The start and finish are at Museiparken, and the course runs through central Uddevalla, passing, among other places, Östra station and sections of the old Lelångebanan railway. The event is held to raise awareness of blood donation, with both individual and team registration, followed by a group picnic after the finish.

description: Vårruset Göteborg is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and takes place in Slottsskogen on Tuesday, 12 May 2026 at 18:00. Individual entries include a medal, a finish-line goody bag, a race bib and the opportunity to take part in Vårruset’s music quiz; team entries (5 people) also receive a picnic after the finish. A digital option is available from 4 May to 4 June, with the medal mailed afterwards. Team entries (5 people) receive a picnic after the finish. Corporate packages are available for groups of more than 25 people via the company page.

description: Chalmersloppet is a campus celebration at Johanneberg campus that celebrates wellbeing and community. The race welcomes students, employees, alumni, and companies to run, network, and have fun together in the spirit of Chalmers. Distances range from 3.14 km (including a walking option) up to 9.82 km, and students can take part in all distances for free. The event is organised by Chalmers Student Union’s Teknologbolag and includes both a race and activities in a Runner Zone.

The finish passes near Mossen/Chabo, and the course goes past Kemigården and along Rännvägen.

Participants start in groups (waves), and options are available for wheelchair users and other participants using wheeled mobility aids. Students participate for free; company places are offered in connection with sponsorship and recruitment opportunities. The event focuses on health and wellbeing for the whole campus community (students, employees, alumni, and companies) and includes activities such as the Runner Zone and a warm-up.

The event offers a timed 5 km race for participants aged 13 and over, a 1.6 km Fun Run for all ages, and the Lilla and Mini races for children. Registration is free through the #RUN4ZERO initiative, and everyone who completes the race receives a specially designed medal. The race takes place in Skärholmen, Stockholm, and is free to enter through RUN4ZERO, with a medal for everyone who completes it.

name: Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka
description: Welcome to Kilsbergen Ut & Tillbaka in Ånnaboda, a friendly trail race where you choose how far you want to run. The race consists of three out-and-back routes that can be combined to make 10, 26 or 54 km. They offer hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with both technical sections and easy-to-run trails. Everyone starts at the same time from the same race centre, creating a social atmosphere where runners meet several times throughout the day. The event is organised by the Trail and Run association and offers an aid station, a drop-bag option and a simple hot meal after the finish.
course_highlights: Three out-and-back routes from Ånnaboda, with options of 10 km, 26 km or 54 km
Hilly trail running through forests and mountains, with technical sections and scenic trails

additional: Maximum 70 participants. Race numbers can be collected at the race centre from 08:00. The entry fee is paid via Swish to 123 118 33 18 — include your name as the payment message. Runners must carry all the equipment and energy they need on the course; there is no support along the route, only at the race centre. The race centre has an aid station with water, Umara sports drink, bananas, sweets and more; you can leave your own drop bag there. A simple hot meal is served after the finish (vegetarian option available). Toilets are available in the area; changing facilities and showers are at SM-stugan (lower car park). Parking is recommended at the lower car park. Three out-and-back routes (10/26/54 km) from Ånnaboda; maximum 70 participants; registration deadline 15 May; start at 09:00 on 16 May 2026; aid station, drop bag and meal after the finish.

description: 3 Mile Dwunastki is an extreme trail run organized by the “Dzik” Running Club Association in Szczecin, at the Krzekowo Shooting Range. The 3-mile course (4 km and 828 metres) runs over dirt roads, sand, uphill and downhill sections, concrete and sandy stretches, and forest roads, offering challenging running conditions. The race is free in 2026 and open to participants over 16, with a limited number of places. The start and finish are at the Krzekowo Shooting Range. The event is intended to bring people together and promote outdoor physical activity.
course_highlights: A 3-mile course (4 km and 828 metres)
Dirt roads, sand, uphill and downhill sections, concrete and sandy stretches
Packed trails and forest roads
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 15:00 on race day. The participant limit is 100, including 50 places reserved for soldiers of the 12th Mechanized Brigade. Participants aged 16 to 17 must have a declaration from a legal guardian. Race packs are distributed from 9:00 to 10:30. Technical briefing at 10:40 at the start. Start and finish at the Krzekowo Shooting Range, ul. Szeroka 70. Online registration; participant limit: 100. Terrain: dirt roads, sand, uphill and downhill sections, concrete and sandy stretches, packed trails, forest roads.

name: 8 Okonińska Pętla
description: The 8th Okonińska Pętla is an annual running event held in the picturesque village of Okoniny Nadjeziorne. The race will take place on May 16, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. It attracts outdoor enthusiasts with an appealing course surrounded by the Tuchola Forests and lakes. The organizers promise a friendly atmosphere and invite both runners and spectators to take part.
course_highlights: The course runs through the picturesque Tuchola Forests
The race takes place near lakes and forests
Start and finish in Okoniny Nadjeziorne
additional: The event is organized by the Śliwice Municipal Office. The organizer can be reached by phone at 509813660. Sign-language interpreter assistance is available upon prior request. The event takes place amid the well-developed tourist infrastructure of Śliwice municipality, including walking and cycling paths and parking areas. Nordic Walking competitions over a distance of 5 km are also planned as part of the event. The race is local in character and promotes physical activity among residents and visitors.

name: Bieg Krokodyla
location: Jezioro Rusałka, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

price_tiers.distance: Bieg 10 km, 5 km i Nordic Walking 5 km

description: The Bieg Krokodyla is an annual running event held by Lake Rusałka in Poznań. The event is scheduled for May 16, 2026, and includes 10 km and 5 km runs, a 5 km Nordic walking event, and children’s and youth races over shorter distances. The main runs and walk are scheduled to start at 12:00, while the children’s races begin at 9:00. Participants can choose a basic or extended package with a technical T-shirt. The course runs through scenic lakeside surroundings, offering attractive views and a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course by Lake Rusałka in Poznań
10 km and 5 km distances for adults, plus a 5 km Nordic walking event
Children’s and youth races over a range of shorter distances
additional: The extended package with a full-print technical T-shirt is available until 17.04.2026 for an additional 100 zł. The main runs and walk start at 12:00; the children’s races start from 9:00. The start location is by Lake Rusałka (GPS: 52.423071, 16.884526). Participants aged 16–18 may choose the 5 km or 10 km distance with a guardian’s consent. Lakeside location, online registration, different race packages, children’s and youth races.

description: Mariuszowa 5-tka is a race taking place on May 16, 2026, in Leszno, in the Nowy Świat forest district. The course follows unpaved roads and forest tracks, with distances of 5.3 km (one lap) and 10.3 km (two laps). In addition to the main races, the event includes a 4 km Nordic walking march and youth and children’s races over shorter distances. The race office is in the administrative building of the Provincial Multi-Specialist Hospital in Leszno, while the start and finish are on Jana Kiepury Street. The event is small-scale, with participant limits for each competition.
course_highlights: Course along unpaved roads and forest tracks in the Nowy Świat forest district
Race distances: 5.3 km (1 lap) and 10.3 km (2 laps)
A 4 km Nordic walking march, plus youth and children’s races over shorter distances
additional: The race office is in the administrative building of the Provincial Multi-Specialist Hospital in Leszno, by the main car park, with the entrance from Szpitalna Street. The start and finish are on Jana Kiepury Street, on the access road to the hospital beyond the ambulance entrance. Participant limits: 250 for the 5 km and 10 km races, 100 for the Nordic walking march, and 100 for the children’s races. The course follows unpaved roads and forest tracks; online registration; participant limits: 250 for the main races and 100 each for the march and children’s races.

name: V Szczeciniecka 5-tka
description: The 5th Szczecinek 5K is a running event held in Szczecinek, in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event is part of a duathlon and is scheduled for May 16, 2026, at 11:30. Participants can expect professional organization and timekeeping. The event is open to runners of different levels and offers a great opportunity for sporting competition and an active day out.
course_highlights: A 5 km distance on a scenic route in Szczecinek
Competition open to recreational and advanced runners
Professional organization and electronic timekeeping
additional: Telephone contact for participants: +48536034089; for event organizers: +48693943216. Bib numbers and organizational details are available on the website. No information is available about start waves, participant limits, or additional equipment. The race takes place on a paved road surface; online registration. This is a duathlon event, and taking part in the race is a great opportunity to spend an active day in the West Pomeranian region.

name: XVII Bieg Piastowski - półmaraton z Kruszwicy

description: The 17th Piast Half Marathon is a traditional half marathon held in Inowrocław, attracting runners from across the region. The course passes through scenic parts of the city, offering participants both a sporting challenge and the chance to admire local attractions. The event is part of the Piast Running Festival, which also includes other distances, fostering a running tradition and a sense of community.
course_highlights: The half-marathon course passes through charming parts of Inowrocław
Varied surfaces: asphalt and city paths
Views of distinctive places in the city and surrounding area
additional: The race office, regulations and detailed course are available on the website. The half-marathon course is marked and secured, and participants receive race packs. The event takes place as part of the Piast Running Festival, which also includes 5 km and 10 km races. Registration options are available for the half marathon, 5 km and 10 km, along with information about the course and event partners.

name: Rundje um ut Hundje
description: Rundje um ut Hundje is an annual running event in Horst aan de Maas, celebrating its 11th edition in 2027. The event offers a wide range of distances for all ages, from the Parent/Child Run to the 10 km race. The routes pass through the centre of Horst, creating a sporty and sociable atmosphere, made possible in part by the local community and sponsors. The organisers aim to provide a well-organised and accessible event for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes ranging from 350 metres to 10 kilometres through the centre of Horst
Start and finish at Lambertusplein, near the statue of ’t Hundje van Hôrs
Various youth and adult races with age-specific distances
additional: Free parking around Lambertusplein. Public transport: the 'Horst Centrum' bus stop is a 2-minute walk away. Prize ceremonies take place at Wilhelminaplein after the youth and adult races. Shirts can be ordered optionally for an additional fee. Multiple race categories, including kids, urban, 5 km and 10 km; location at Lambertusplein; anniversary year with special festivities

name: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Przelewice – Spring Edition is a recurring race held in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden, an ideal place for nature lovers and those seeking active recreation. The event aims to promote running and physical activity, and there is no age restriction for taking part. Participants can look forward to a unique atmosphere and commemorative medals, awarded after completing the main race and the children’s races. The event is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and held under the honorary patronage of the Marshal of the Voivodeship.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the Przelewice Dendrological Garden
The course runs through the garden’s unique natural surroundings
There is no age restriction for participants; children’s races are also available
additional: Medals are awarded to all participants who finish the main-distance race and the children’s races. Admission to the Dendrological Garden is paid, and the garden grounds are open during operating hours. The website provides no information about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees. The event promotes running and outdoor activity, with medals for participants and online registration. The race takes place in beautiful dendrological gardens, making it a unique experience for nature and sports enthusiasts.

name: Ekiden Pragmatiq
location: Jezioro Malta, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Ekiden PragmatIQ is a team marathon relay held in Poznań by Lake Malta. Teams of six cover the marathon distance (42.195 km), with each runner completing a designated leg. The course is paved and follows a 5.4 km loop, except for the first leg. The event combines sporting competition with teamwork and support for local charitable organizations. Ekiden Junior for the youngest runners is also held as part of the event.
course_highlights: Paved course around the Malta regatta course
Distance split into 6 legs: 9.795 km, 10.8 km, 4 × 5.4 km
Start by the HP Park Poznań Hotel; finish by the grandstands and relay zone
additional: The team time limit is 4 hours and 30 minutes. A dedicated relay zone is provided. The event includes a charity program, with PLN 42.91 from each entry fee donated to a local public benefit organization selected by the participant. Ekiden Junior for children covers 120 meters and is open to runners born from 2015 to 2024. The event ambassador is Dominika Stelmach, who also leads a special women’s team with athletic requirements. The event features team competition, the EKIDEN Junior race for children, charitable support, attractions, and an exciting atmosphere of sporting competition.

name: III Półmaraton Brzegiem Bałtyku
organizer: Kołobrzeskie Stowarzyszenie Biegów Ulicznych Nadmorscy Biegacze
description: The 3rd Kołobrzeg Half Marathon by the Baltic Sea is a flat road race held in the picturesque seaside setting of Kołobrzeg. The course follows a granite-paved promenade, a cycle path and asphalt roads, with five refreshment stations along the way. The start and finish are located by the Seaside Park Hotel. The race is part of the Kołobrzeska Odyssey series, promoting a healthy lifestyle and bringing the running community together. The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours, and timing is electronic, using disposable chips.
course_highlights: Flat course following a promenade, cycle path and asphalt roads
Course marked every kilometre with vertical signs
Five refreshment stations along the course
additional: The race office is open on 16.05.2026 from 18:00 to 20:00 and on 17.05.2026 from 8:00 to 10:50 near the start and finish. Electronic timing with disposable chips. Runners must wear their race number with the chip clearly visible. Pedestrians and cyclists may be present on the course; runners must obey traffic regulations. Open categories for women and men, as well as a classification for residents of Kołobrzeg County. The course runs along the promenade, where pedestrians and cyclists may be present. Time limit: 3 hours. Children’s races are planned. Other distances may also be available (5 km, 10 km, marathon).

name: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Biegowy
description: Moderska Dwusetka Cross Run is the second edition of an off-road race taking place on 17 May 2026 in Modrze, Poland. Participants can choose from a 5 km run, a 10 km run, or a 5 km Nordic Walking event. The course runs through fields and forests between the villages of Modrze and Drożdżyce, offering a chance to connect with nature and enjoy outdoor activity. The event aims to promote a healthy lifestyle and bring the local community together.
course_highlights: The running and walking route passes through fields and forests between Modrze and Drożdżyce
Distances available: 5 km run, 10 km run, and 5 km Nordic Walking
The route and event format remain the same as in 2025
additional: No information about entry fees is available. The event is promotional and community-oriented, takes place on open land, and has no stated participant limit or start waves. The event uses natural off-road routes, and participants can expect friendly competition in a welcoming atmosphere. Starts are scheduled between 8:30 and 9:45, and registration is available through the official event website.

name: Run Toruń Plaza
description: The May edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy – Run Toruń Plaza, taking place on May 17, 2026, offers two race distances: 5 km and 10 km. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness in the spring edition of the series and experience the unique atmosphere of running in Toruń. The organizers provide a professionally run event with a nationwide reach while ensuring a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere. The event is part of a running series promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity.
course_highlights: Compete over 5 km or 10 km
The atmosphere of running in Toruń
The spring edition of the Toruń Legends Trilogy series
additional: The race is organized by the “Run To Run” Association, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and sport. The event has a nationwide reach while retaining a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a unique medal and the opportunity to take part in a post-race satisfaction survey. 5 km and 10 km race, spring edition, Toruń Legends Trilogy series

name: Sierakowicka Piętnastka
description: Sierakowicka Piętnastka is an annual race held in Sierakowice as part of the Northern Poland Running Festival. The event takes place at the sports stadium at 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street and attracts runners of all ages, offering a 15 km main race as well as numerous races for children and young people. The event features electronic timekeeping, a lively atmosphere and prizes for the top competitors. Participants can expect professional organization, including medical and police support, as well as facilities such as bag storage, showers and a café.
course_highlights: 15 km main race course
Start and finish at the sports stadium in Sierakowice
Electronic timekeeping and rankings in 14 categories
additional: Race office opens at 10:00 at the Orlik sports field by the Primary School; bib numbers and chips will be distributed there. Free showers, bag storage, a café and toilets are available. Children’s and youth races start at 11:30; the 100 m preschoolers’ race starts at 12:40 (free). A recreational run-walk of 1,200 m starts at 13:05 for people not taking part in the main races. Prizes will be raffled among participants in the children’s and main races. Official parking is at 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street. Medical and police support will be provided. The event also includes preparatory training sessions, and online registration opens in December 2025. The race takes place at the sports stadium in Sierakowice, 7 Kubusia Puchatka Street.

name: Sezon Ogórkowy/Monte Cassino
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Nobel Run
description: The Nobel Run is a friendly, accessible running event held in the beautiful Almere Hout. The various routes pass through the area’s green, sustainable natural surroundings, giving the event a unique feel. The event aims to make a sustainable and sporting contribution to Almere Hout and is intended as a festive occasion for participants, spectators, and residents of Nobelhorst. The Nobel Run promotes social cohesion and gives the city of Almere a sporting boost.
course_highlights: Routes through the beautiful natural surroundings of Almere Hout
The course has a green and sustainable character
Distances range from a Kids Run to a 15 km run
additional: Race number with a built-in MyLaps timing chip. First name printed on the race number for registrations made before 1 May 2027. Race numbers and shirts can be collected on Saturday 15 May 2027 between 10:00 and 14:00 at the Nobelhorst community hall. Participants may hand in one bag with a numbered label. Entertainment, post-run massage, refreshment stations along the route and at the finish, official results, and personal photos are included. The official Nobel Run shirt, limited-edition socks, and BibBits magnets can be ordered optionally during registration. The event offers merchandise and registration options and emphasizes an environmentally conscious, community-focused approach.

name: Blodomloppet Munkedal
organizer: Föreningen Blodomloppet (i samarbete med Hälle IF)
description: Blodomloppet in Munkedal returns after its 2024 debut as part of the municipality’s public health initiative, encouraging more people to get active while raising awareness of the importance of blood donation. The event attracted hundreds of participants in its first year and includes Lilla Blodomloppet for children. In 2025, Hälle IF will take part as an organiser, with activities and information about blood donation on site. Registration is open, and everyone is encouraged to take part, regardless of age or fitness level.
course_highlights: Several distances, including 5 km and 10 km
Lilla Blodomloppet for children
Start and finish at Örekilsparken
additional: In previous years, Lilla Blodomloppet has been offered free of charge to schoolchildren thanks to support from the municipality. Activities and information about blood donation will be available at the event. All registered teams receive a picnic bag in the finish area (a general detail about Blodomloppet). Hälle IF is listed as a co-organiser of the event in Munkedal. Registration is open according to official information. Distances include 5 km, 10 km, Lilla Blodomloppet, Specialomloppet and a virtual race; participants can take part individually or as a team. Hälle IF is the new co-organiser for 2025.

name: Berga Brostafett
location: Berga, Laholm Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
description: Berga Brostafett is a revival of a five-leg relay in Berga along the Lagan, organised by Lagans AIK. The event is scheduled for 18 May 2026 at 18:00 and is expected to bring together approximately 30 - 40 teams of five runners each. The total distance is approximately 10 km over five legs, with each leg ranging from approximately 1 km to 3.2 km. Information and registration are shared via Lagans AIK’s page and the event on Facebook.
course_highlights: Relay race over bridges in Berga along the Lagan
Approximately 10 km in total over five legs (each approximately 1 km to 3.2 km)
Expected participation of 30 - 40 teams, supporting Lagans AIK
additional: The page contains information about registration for Berga Brostafett but does not show a clear price or registration link. Contact details shown on the page include lagansaik@gmail.com and support@laget.se. An event calendar is available and can be subscribed to via webcal://cal.laget.se/LagansAIK-Bergabrostafett.ics. Each team has five runners; one runner may complete two legs if needed. Registration information is available via Lagans AIK, and updates are shared on Facebook.

name: Gerstewitzer Mühlentaglauf
description: The Gerstewitz Mill Day Run is a long-standing running event offering distances from 400 m for children to 10 km for adults. After a break due to the coronavirus pandemic, the event has become very popular and combines sporting ambition with regional Pentecost traditions. Organized by SFG Nellschütz e.V., it offers runners of all ages an attractive racing opportunity in the Lützen region.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 m to 10 km
Combines competitive running with Pentecost traditions
Event in the Lützen region, with scenic running routes
additional: Distances up to 10 km, Pentecost festival, supporting program with a barbecue, children's entertainment, and ice cream sales

name: Dortmunder Friedenslauf
location: Kochschule, Dortmund-Kirchlinde, Dortmund, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Dortmund Peace Run is a traditional race held on Whit Monday, May 25, 2026, in Dortmund-Kirchlinde. The event offers various race distances through the scenic Rahmer Forest and is known for its family-friendly, sporty atmosphere. Musical entertainment and motivational drummers along the course accompany the event. The Peace Run is part of a race series organized by the Arbeitsgemeinschaft Straßenlauf and attracts runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Race routes through the scenic Rahmer Forest
Live musical support along the course
Family-friendly, sporty atmosphere
additional: Registration for running and walking events is available online until 60 minutes before each start. Bambini race registrations are accepted in person on the event day only, until 11:00 a.m. Age categories are determined according to the German Athletics Regulations (DLO). The Peace Run is part of a race series that starts in Hoeschpark and finishes in Westfalenpark. Races over 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon; online registration until 60 minutes before the start; event included in a series ranking; start and finish at the Kochschule in Dortmund-Kirchlinde; routes through the Rahmer Forest, with some challenging climbs.

name: Blodomloppet Kristianstad
price_range: 5/10 km – 350 kr till 28 april; Efteranmälan 400 kr; Lag: 1 750 kr till 28 april, därefter 2 000 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet – 100 kr till 18 maj; Efteranmälan Lilla Blodomloppet: 130 kr fr.o.m. 19 maj
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet Kristianstad in Tivoliparken on 19 May 2026. The event offers 5 km and 10 km races for men and women, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for children aged 0–12. It is suitable for runners and walking groups, participating individually or in teams. The scenic course heads into Vattenriket and has varied surfaces (grass, gravel and asphalt). The event traditionally ends with a picnic. It also has a clear community and blood-donation purpose and is run by local associations together with the blood centre.
course_highlights: Scenic course heading into Vattenriket
Surfaces vary between grass, gravel and asphalt
Lilla Blodomloppet takes place entirely within Tivoliparken; the 5 km and 10 km courses cross the Helge River
additional: Lilla Blodomloppet is for children up to 12 years old; the start and finish area is in Tivoliparken; bag storage is available (for bags only); the deadline for team registration is 12 May, and the final registration deadline for all races is 19 May; an Excel template for team registration is available on the registration page

name: Cytadela by Night # 115 - Wartostrada
location: Cytadela, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Cytadela by Night is a series of free, timed races held in Poznań over distances of 5 km and 10 km. The races take place in the scenic surroundings of the Citadel, offering participants a unique night-racing atmosphere. The event attracts runners of different age groups and ability levels, promoting physical activity and bringing the local community together.
course_highlights: The course runs through the Citadel in Poznań
Timed 5 km and 10 km distances
A nighttime racing atmosphere
additional: The races are free, held regularly, and timed. The event is supported by Kiprun Poznań Runners. It takes place at night and attracts participants of different age groups and ability levels, promoting physical activity and community integration.

name: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten
description: Sandbäckens Norrköpingsstafetten takes place on Wednesday, 20 May 2026, in Folkparken in Norrköping. Teams of four take turns walking, jogging or running a lively 4 km leg each. There are timed and untimed categories, and the race is promoted as an accessible, festive relay for recreational runners and teams. Thanks to HSB, children and young people can take part for free, and there is specific information for schools.
course_highlights: Four legs of 4 km each (4 × 4 km in total)
Start, relay exchanges and finish in the beautiful Folkparken
Suitable for walking, jogging or running; timed and untimed categories
additional: Children and young people take part for free thanks to HSB; schools are encouraged to register (school contact: mikael.grip@lopparrangoren.se). The organiser offers tents and event furnishings for hire through Rent a Tent (booking deadline to guarantee availability: 5 May; contact norrkoping@rentatent.se). The start, relay exchanges and finish are all in the park, creating a lively atmosphere for spectators and the event. Teams consist of four participants; event communications mention a picnic bag from ICA Kvantum Mirum Galleria and a medal at the finish. More than 700 participants and around 180 teams took part in previous years; young people and students participate free of charge thanks to sponsorship from HSB and Fiskeby. More information and registration are available at norrkopingsstafetten.se. ICA Kvantum Mirum provides a picnic for all participants; various sponsors offer tents or gathering areas.

name: Vårruset (Falun)
description: Vårruset is Sweden’s largest recreational running tour for women—a fun and welcoming spring evening where participants can run, jog or walk 2.5 or 5 km. The event tours 19 cities between 4 May and 4 June 2026, and Falun is one of the locations. All participants receive, among other things, a medal and race bib, and teams of five are rewarded with a picnic after crossing the finish line. The race has been held since 1989 and is aimed at recreational runners of different ages, according to the recommendations for each distance.
course_highlights: Two distances: 2.5 km and 5 km
The 5 km course is officially measured at all locations
Teams of five receive a picnic after crossing the finish line
additional: Individual registration includes a medal, a finish-line bag, timing (for those who have selected it) and a race bib. Team registration includes a picnic after crossing the finish line, a medal, a finish-line bag, timing (for those who have selected it) and a race bib. A team consists of five people, and the picnic voucher is issued only when the entire team (five paying participants) is registered. There is also a digital option (Vårruset Digital), where you can run between 4 May and 4 June and have a medal mailed to you; digital registrations cannot be combined with in-person participation in the tour. Payment is accepted via Swish and Klarna; the wellness benefit platforms Epassi, Benefits and Benifex are supported. Instructions on how to register and information about adding team members are available in the FAQ and registration guide on the website. Free training sessions ahead of Vårruset are offered by Falu IK Friidrott in collaboration with Vårruset and Intersport; two training sessions before the race are listed.

name: Stafettvarvet
location: Slottsskogsvallen, Slottsskogen, Göteborg, Västra Götaland, Sweden
description: Stafettvarvet is a spectator- and team-friendly relay taking place on 20 May 2026, starting and finishing inside the historic Slottsskogsvallen. Each team consists of four participants, all of whom run the same fast 3.2 km course around beautiful Slottsskogen, with the baton handover at the arena. After finishing, the team’s entry includes a picnic bag. Companies can also book a tent site in the entrance park for a team gathering and after-run. Registration is via the Göteborgsvarvet website, and the price per team changes according to the published pricing periods.
course_highlights: Fast 3.2 km loop around beautiful Slottsskogen
Start, baton handover and finish inside Slottsskogsvallen
All four team members run the same course; a picnic bag is included
additional: Registration is per team, not per team member. A team consists of 4 participants and can enter the women’s, men’s or mixed category. Relay batons, bibs and picnic bags are collected outside Slottsskogsvallen in the entrance park. Companies can register one or more teams, choose to pay by invoice and book a tent site in the corporate villages. Registration is open until 17:00 on race day, but the event may sell out earlier. The team consists of 4 participants; each runner runs 3.2 km; the start, baton handover and finish are inside Slottsskogsvallen; race confirmations/bibs are collected from 15:30 to 17:30; registration is via the Göteborgsvarvet website; corporate teams and invoice payment are available; a picnic bag is included with team registration.

name: Blodomloppet (Karlskrona)
price_range: Individuell: 300-350 kr; Lag (5 personer): 1500-1750 kr; Lilla Blodomloppet: 100 kr; blodgivar-rabatt 40 kr per person
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Karlskrona on 20 May 2026—a recreational event that highlights the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, take part in Lilla Blodomloppet (800 m), or walk 5 km. The courses have been measured by an official from the Swedish Athletics Federation, and walkers have a separate route so participants can finish with a picnic together. The event is organised by KA 2 IF and offers individual and team entries, as well as discounts for blood donors and ICA members.
course_highlights: Four routes: 5 km run, 10 km run, 800 m children’s race and 5 km walk
Walkers have their own route and can set off first, then enjoy a picnic with the others
The courses have been measured by an official from the Swedish Athletics Federation and meet the requirements for competition courses
additional: Organiser: KA 2 IF (Blodomloppet contact: karlskrona@blodomloppet.se, tel. 0793-299924). A team can have up to 5 participants, and team members can take part in different distances. For larger entries, an Excel template is available in the registration system for importing details, as well as the option of a customer page for companies/organisations to manage entries and discount codes in one place. Blood donors and ICA members receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. A picnic after the event is part of the programme. Courses: 5 km, 10 km, 800 m and 5 km walk; Excel template for larger groups; start times and warm-up details will be shared later via the information channel.

name: Västerviksfemman 2026
description: Västerviksfemman is an evening 5 km race starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Västervik. The race is run on a 2.5 km loop, completed twice, with a pleasant atmosphere and great spirit along the course. You can take part individually or enter a team (at least five people), with the five fastest times combined. Welcome to the running festival in Stadsparken on Wednesday, 20 May 2026 at 19:00.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km loop run twice, with a lap split halfway
Start and finish in Stadsparken; the course runs through central Västervik
The course may be adjusted due to construction work on Storgatan
additional: Race bibs are available for collection well before the start and must be collected before 17:30 on race day. Collection: Monday 18 May – Intersport 11–14; Tuesday 19 May – Intersport 11–14; Wednesday 20 May – at the stage in Stadsparken from 12:00. Registration is via RaceID (link provided on the event page). Team competition: at least 5 people per team; the team result is the combined time of the 5 fastest participants; if more than 9 participants are from the same organization, multiple teams can be entered. 5 km course; start and finish in Stadsparken; race bibs must be collected before 17:30 on race day or according to the schedule; start at 19:00; VO-Joggen times included in the programme; 20% team discount with code LAG20.

name: Potmarge Run
description: The Potmarge Run is an evening race over 5 and 10 kilometres that has been part of the series of runs organised by Lionitas in Leeuwarden since 2012. The routes are measured precisely and offer a unique running experience along the Van Harinxmakanaal and the River Potmarge, where you can enjoy nature in the city. The start is at the MICA/Mediahuis building at Sixmastraat 15. Participation is at your own risk and responsibility, and you can optionally order a medal.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the Van Harinxmakanaal
Run along the River Potmarge
Precisely measured 5 and 10 km routes
additional: Online registration is available until shortly before the start; no on-the-day registration. A medal can be ordered optionally for € 3,50. The start location is MICA/Mediahuis (Leeuwarder Courant building), Sixmastraat 15, Leeuwarden. Routes measured; online registration until shortly before the start; no on-the-day registration; free parking after 18:00.

name: Verkerkloop

tiers.label: tier_1

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Verkerkloop is an annual race through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet. The event includes a fast street course with 5 km and 10 km distances for individual runners, a school race for children in various age categories, and a business race for teams. The route passes through the Molenvliet industrial estate and surrounding streets, with a turnaround point halfway through. The Verkerkloop is a sporting event that contributes to a healthy, close-knit community and attracts thousands of participants each year.
course_highlights: Fast street course through Zwijndrecht, starting and finishing at Verkerk on Molenvliet
The 5 km distance consists of one lap; the 10 km distance consists of two laps
The route passes, among other places, along Molenvliet, Munnikensteeg, Klarinetsingel, Beethovenlaan and Develsingel
additional: Start and finish at Verkerk, Molenvliet 1, in the Molenvliet industrial estate in Zwijndrecht. The school race is for children aged 6 and up, with distances from 600 to 1,200 metres. Business race teams consist of 4 or 5 runners; the finish times of the first 4 runners are added together. Every participant receives a commemorative medal. Race numbers can be transferred through a resale platform. A maximum of 3,500 participants are allowed. Registration opens on 1 February 2027. The event is held at Verkerk on Molenvliet and also includes youth and business activities.

name: Vårruset (Västerås)
description: Vårruset in Västerås is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and takes place on Thursday, 21 May 2026, starting at 19:00 at Lögastrand. The event offers distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured) and is suitable both for experienced runners and for those who want to jog or walk. Everyone who registers individually receives a medal, a finisher’s bag and a race bib; teams of five are treated to a picnic after finishing. Timing is available for the 5 km, but you can opt out when registering if you do not want your result published.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lögastrand
The course runs through central Västerås
The 5 km distance is officially measured (2.5 km is also available)
additional: Registration is online and remains open through race day, closing no later than one hour before the first start. Recommended ages: 5 km: 13 years (11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km: 11 years (7 when accompanied by an adult). Teams of five receive a picnic after finishing. Participant benefits include a medal, a finisher’s bag, the Vårruset music quiz and prizes, and a race bib. Timing is available for the 5 km but can be opted out of. Local organiser: Västerås FK (www.vasterasfriidrott.se); information about a local training meetup will be published with separate registration via Västerås FK’s registration page. The distances are 2.5 km or 5 km; a team consists of five people, and registration is available as a team or individually. Timing can be opted out of during registration. Registration is online, and a picnic is served after finishing.

name: Blodomloppet Linköping
description: Take part in celebrating the life-saving act of blood donation at Blodomloppet Linköping! The event offers 5 km and 10 km routes that you can walk, jog or run, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for younger participants. The event is team- and business-friendly: many people take part in teams of five, and the race traditionally ends with a large picnic. You can register individually or as part of a team, and the organiser offers special discounts for blood donors and youth teams.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km (walk, jog or run)
Suitable for individual participants and teams (3–5 people; often teams of five)
The event ends with a large communal picnic
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (3–5 people); teams always pay for five, and you can add members to make a full team free of charge by 30 April (contact linkoping@blodomloppet.se). Youth teams (all members born in 2009 or later) pay half the entry fee until 30 April. Blood donors receive a discount of SEK 40 per person. The deadline for team registration is 14 May; online registration is open until the start. Everyone who registers by 14 May and provides a mobile number will receive an SMS ticket link for free travel within Östergötland for 6 hours on race day. Race bib collection: 19 May, 11:00–19:00 (GeBlod, Storgatan 32); 20 May, 12:00–18:00 (GeBlod); and 21 May, 16:00–19:00 (Saab Arena). From 1 May, some changes may require an in-person visit. Businesses can get a customer page in the registration system. Discounts for blood donors and information about training before the event are available. The team registration deadline may be in mid-May, and payment methods include Swish, card and e-invoice. The ticket provides free travel within Östergötland for up to 6 hours on race day.

name: Stigtomtaloppet 2026
location: Stigtomta, Nyköping Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
