description: Stigtomtaloppet is a scenic running festival in Stigtomta, organised by OK Hällen since 2012. The event is suitable for all ages and running abilities, with distances of 3.8 km and 7.6 km, shorter children’s races, and a new dog class in 2026. The courses combine grass, trails and roads through woodland and a residential area. The event is popular with both individual runners and teams/work groups who want to compete together. Teams receive a picnic basket, which can be collected from the catering tent after finishing.
course_highlights: Course on asphalt, trails and grass through woodland and a residential area
Start and finish on the green space next to ICA Nära in Stigtomta
The hill sprint: timing on the steepest hill and prizes along the course
additional: Start times: Little Kids 17:40, Primary/Middle School Class 18:00, Dog 18:15–18:20 (fast dogs first), Adults (including team competition) 18:45. The participant bag and race bib with timing chip must be collected no later than 30 minutes before the relevant start. Teams receive a picnic basket (collected from the catering tent; drinks not included). The catering tent accepts card payments. Parking is available as directed along road 52; cycling is recommended. The dog class is limited to 30 participants, and dog owners must clean up after their dogs. A dog-friendly option will be introduced in 2026, with a separate start for runners with dogs; participants can run, have the dog pull them, or walk in Stigtomta.

name: XIII Bieg 5 Mil
organizer: Gdyński Dywizjon Okrętów Bojowych, Gdyńskie Centrum Sportu, Stowarzyszenie Oficerów Marynarki Wojennej
description: The XIII 5-Mile Race is a 5-nautical-mile (9260 m) race organized in Gdynia by the Gdynia Combat Ship Squadron and the Naval Officers’ Association in cooperation with the Gdynia Sports Centre. The course consists of two 4630 m loops and runs along the waterfront. The start and finish are in front of the ORP Gen. K. Pułaski. The race is open to active-duty professional soldiers, civilian military employees, and civilian runners following prior verification. The event takes place in a friendly atmosphere, promoting physical activity and sportsmanship.
course_highlights: Distance: 5 nautical miles (9260 m)—two 4630 m loops
Start and finish in front of the ORP Gen. K. Pułaski
Coastal course in Gdynia, not certified by the PZLA
additional: Payments are processed through Przelewy24. Participants must be verified; foreign nationals may take part after prior agreement with the organizer. The participant limit is 500. Online registration, a post-race meal, and no PZLA certification.

name: Uka Pain (SM Trail)
description: Sweden Runners IF warmly welcomes you to Uka Pain on 22–23 May 2026 in beautiful Älvdalen. The event offers several distances, from 12 km up to 100 miles, and includes the Trail Swedish Championships/Masters Championships (28 km) and Junior Swedish Championships (12 km). The race centre and finish are at Hotell Älvdalen, and the courses run through Älvdalen’s magnificent terrain, with both runnable trails and more technical sections. The event offers a real challenge and views from several mountain peaks.
course_highlights: The 52 km course has approximately 1,500 metres of elevation gain
The course climbs to the summits of Hykjeberg, Skärklitt and Väsaberget
Mostly trails, with sections ranging from easy-running to very technical terrain; orange course markings
additional: Entry includes a race bib, timing, energy and aid stations, a finisher’s medal and a participant T-shirt (register by 30/4 to receive a T-shirt). Race-bib collection is at The Running Company (Dalgatan 81F) from Friday 22/5. Bus transport is available between Hotell Älvdalen and Boggberget for 100 Miles participants (departure at 15:10). No on-site registration. Name and category changes are possible until 14 May. Mandatory equipment is required for 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles. Cut-off times and checkpoint cut-off times are listed in the race information (e.g. 9 h for 28 km, 10 h for 50 km, 20 h for 100 km and 34 h for 100 miles). Start times: Friday 16:00–Saturday 02:00; drop bags are permitted for 100 km and 100 miles; GPS trackers are provided for 100 km and 100 miles; mandatory equipment is required for 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles; race centre at Hotell Älvdalen.

name: VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf
description: The VfL Ahaus Stadtfestlauf takes place on May 29, 2026, and offers runners a well-reviewed and attractive route through the town of Ahaus. The race is organized by VfL Ahaus 1892 e.V., one of the leading recreational sports clubs in the Münsterland region. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a friendly atmosphere with a focus on health and community. The route has been carefully explored and approved by the VfL Ahaus running group, so participants can look forward to a great running experience.
course_highlights: Route reviewed and approved by the VfL Ahaus running group
Attractive town route in Ahaus
Event focused on health and community
additional: Registration opens on March 15, 2026. Places are still available. The race takes place as part of the town festival. In cooperation with AOK, VfL Ahaus also offers functional training classes. The routes are not officially measured; registration opens on March 15, 2026; places are still available; the event is part of the town festival, which features a varied accompanying program.

description: The Volksbank Run “Around Offlumer Lake” is a long-standing running event in Neuenkirchen, Lower Saxony, taking place on May 29, 2026. The course runs around Offlumer Lake, with the start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg. A range of races is offered for all age groups, from the Bambini run and student races to the 10 km main race. The event is organized by the SuS 09 Neuenkirchen running group and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with on-the-day registration available.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on Haarweg
Course around Offlumer Lake, measured by the DLV for the 10 km main race
Distances range from a 300 m Bambini run to a 10 km main race
additional: On-the-day registration is available until 30 minutes before each start. Race bibs can be picked up from 3:00 p.m. at the registration tent. Timing is provided by Teamsoft-Sportzeit. Races start at staggered times, from 4:00 p.m. (Bambini run) to 7:00 p.m. (main race). Course: around Offlumer Lake. On-the-day registration available. Parking at the outdoor swimming pool and Offlumer Lake.

name: Göteborgsvarvet
description: Göteborgsvarvet is a well-known 21.0975 km celebration of running in Gothenburg, bringing together tens of thousands of runners and hundreds of thousands of spectators along the course. The race passes through the festival atmosphere of Slottsskogen, continues along Hisingen’s quays and by the buzz of Avenyn. The course has been certified by a World Athletics-licensed course measurer, and the event is complemented by Göteborgsvarvet Expo and numerous spectator and music stations along the route. Information about start groups and other details is sent in the race confirmation approximately two weeks before the race.
course_highlights: Start and festival area around Slottsskogen / Göteborgsvarvet Arena
The course passes Hisingen’s quays and Avenyn
More than 200,000 spectators and numerous music stations along the route
additional: The distance is a half marathon (21,097.5 m), and the course has been certified by a World Athletics-licensed course measurer. There are water stations along the course, and an interactive course map/GPX is published closer to race day. Start groups are assigned according to seeding rules; detailed start times and the location of your start group are sent in the race confirmation approximately two weeks before the race. Göteborgsvarvet Expo and Runners Zone are located at Göteborgsvarvet Arena/Slottskogsvallen. Registration is closed for 2026; seeding rules and start groups are available; the 21 km course passes Slottsskogen, runs along Hisingen’s quays and goes by Avenyn; the race is part of Varvet Week.

name: Ludvika stadslopp
description: Ludvika Stadslopp is organised by Ludvika FFI and is a family-friendly city race with several distances for both children and adults. The start and finish are at Charlie Normans torg, and the event includes a toddler race, Lilla Stadsloppet, and 5 km and 10 km races (with the option of running with or without timing). The event takes place on Saturday, 23 May 2026, and welcomes runners of all ages and abilities. There is a bonus associated with the 10 km course record.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Charlie Normans torg
Toddler race (ages 0–6), Lilla Stadsloppet (up to age 12), and 5 km and 10 km races
10 km: bonus/prize for a course record
additional: Register via a Google Form (https://forms.gle/Q5BfNzbjmGGyDGy46). Race schedule: 11:00 Toddler race (ages 0–6), 11:30 Lilla Stadsloppet (up to age 12), 13:00 start for the 5 km and 10 km races (with or without timing). The start/finish is between the railway station and the marina at Charlie Normans torg. All races start and finish at Charlie Normans torg; the day's programme includes different races, from a short toddler race to longer running distances.

name: Cityvarvet
description: Cityvarvet is a shorter, 4.3 km version of Göteborgsvarvet. It starts at Götaplatsen and takes you along Avenyn to a spectacular finish at Slottsskogsvallen. The race is a festive event with large crowds, music and cheer stations along the course, and is suitable for beginners, fast runners and families. We recommend that children up to 13 years old run with an adult. As a runner, you have access to the Runner Zone at the finish for recovery, snacks and drinks.
course_highlights: Start at Götaplatsen and run down Avenyn towards Slottsskogen
A 4.3 km city course with large crowds, music and cheer stations
Finish inside Slottsskogsvallen and access to the Runner Zone for recovery
additional: Distance: 4.3 km. Maximum 1,500 registered runners. Registration is open until 12:00 on race day (2026-05-23). Bib and start-card collection: pick up Thursday–Saturday, 21–23 May, at the Göteborgsvarvet Expo at Friidrottens Hus (Thursday 11:00–20:30, Friday 10:00–21:00, Saturday from 09:00). Two water stations on the course. Children up to 13 years old are recommended to run with an adult. Maximum 1,500 participants; start time 13:00; bib collection at the Expo (Friidrottens Hus); bag storage at the start until 12:30; water stations along the course; electronic chip timing; maximum time approximately 50 minutes; transport and expo information is available on the start-card page; changing facilities are not provided.

name: Uka Pain
description: UKA PAIN is a trail and ultrarunning event in Älvdalen, Dalarna, held over the weekend of 22–23 May 2026. The event offers several distances—12 km, 28 km, 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles—with the 28 km race serving as the Trail-SM/VSM and the 12 km race as the JSM on 23 May. The start and finish are at Hotell Älvdalen, and the courses run through woodland in the area, marked in orange. GPS trackers and drop bags are available for longer distances, and information about accommodation and registration is available on the official pages. Some distances require specific equipment, and participants are asked to bring their own cup to the aid stations.
course_highlights: Several distances to choose from: 12 km, 28 km, 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles
Trail-SM/VSM categories over 28 km and JSM over 12 km on 23 May
Start and finish at Hotell Älvdalen, with orange course markings and logistical support such as drop bags and GPS trackers for the longer races
additional: Race headquarters at Hotell Älvdalen; bib collection at The Running Company near the hotel; drop bags permitted for 100 km and 100 miles; mandatory equipment applies only to the 50 km, 100 km and 100 miles; participants must bring their own cup to the aid stations; GPS trackers are available for 100 miles and 100 km; start times include 16:00 on 22 May for 100 miles and 09:00/10:30/23:00 on 23 May for the other distances; course markings are orange.

name: VirsboRUN
location: Skräddartorpet, Virsbo, Fagersta Municipality, Västmanland, Sweden
description: Welcome to VirsboRUN, a family-friendly trail race at Skräddartorpet on Saturday, 23 May 2026. You can choose to run 1–4 laps of the 5.3 km loop (up to 21.2 km), or let the children take part in the free kids’ race of approximately 800 metres. The course passes through unspoilt nature and Hälleskogsbrännan, with varied trails and beautiful views. After finishing, participants receive a medal and a freshly grilled hamburger.
course_highlights: 5.3 km loop (up to 4 laps) — choose how many laps you want to run
Challenging terrain with approximately 101 metres of elevation gain per lap, including rocky sections and forest trails in Hälleskogsbrännan
Kids’ race, approximately 800 m (free), and an additional water station about halfway around (~2.5 km)
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Stora Ladan from 10:00. The kids’ race is limited to 50 participants, and the women’s and men’s classes are limited to 150 starters. Late registration is available until approximately 1 hour before the start on race day. Everyone who finishes receives a medal and a bag of surprises; freshly grilled hamburgers are also served (including vegetarian options). Relays are permitted (2–4 people), the maximum race time is 3 hours, and participation is at your own risk (no refunds). Participants must wear their race number visibly on their stomach; dogs are not permitted. Virsbo Fire and Rescue Service will be on site. Trail race in the forest near Virsbo at Skräddartorpet; 5.3 km loops with 101 m of elevation gain per lap; free kids’ course (800 m); medals for everyone; freshly grilled hamburgers for all competitors; outdoor gym, parking, changing rooms, showers, sauna, toilets and refreshments on site.

name: Å-Varvet
description: Å-varvet in Eskilstuna is a city running race where runners can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances. The race starts and finishes in the city park in central Eskilstuna and offers a run through beautiful urban surroundings, according to official information sources. The date listed for the 2026 edition is 23 May, and the organiser is described as Eskilstuna Municipality. The official Facebook page also promotes a quarter marathon of approximately 10,549 metres, offering an additional distance option.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the city park in central Eskilstuna
Run through beautiful urban surroundings
Distance options: 5 km and 10 km (with consideration for different courses and experience levels)
additional: Official sources list the distances as 5 km and 10 km, with the start and finish in the city park. The 2026 edition is scheduled for 23 May. The Facebook page also promotes a quarter marathon of approximately 10,549 m.

name: Greifenstein Berglauf
organizer: Fussfit Petry GmbH, webconcept GbR, weitere lokale Sponsoren
description: The Greifenstein Mountain Run is a challenging 5.3 km road race from Ehringshausen-Katzenfurt to Greifenstein Castle, taking place for the 27th time on 30 May 2026. The route follows country roads and farm tracks, climbing a total of 260 metres to the finish at the castle, which offers a wonderful view of the region. The race is open to youth, men, women and seniors, with a combined ranking across all categories. Nordic walking is offered without age-category rankings, and a free children’s race for the youngest participants takes place separately in the afternoon. The event concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle.
course_highlights: 5.3 km road race with 260 metres of elevation gain
Start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle with panoramic views
Challenging section of the course above Edingen
additional: The entry fee includes a bus transfer to the start, transport of clothing to the finish, and drinks at the start and finish. Race numbers and finisher shirts will be distributed in the courtyard of Greifenstein Castle from 14:00 on event day. Late registration is possible on event day until 30 minutes before the start. Parking is available at the outskirts of Greifenstein in the direction of Beilstein. A free children’s race will be held at around 16:50, accompanied by members of LG Dill. The awards ceremony and refreshments—including coffee, cake, cold drinks and bratwurst—will take place in the castle courtyard. In clear weather, the courtyard offers impressive views across the Dill Valley as far as the Feldberg in the Taunus. Register online by 28.05.2026; start in Katzenfurt, finish at Greifenstein Castle; no relay or walking event; results available since 2008.

description: The International Biesfeld Village Run is a long-standing running event in the municipality of Kürten, taking place on 30 May 2026. The race is known for its hilly course, which challenges runners and carries the slogan “Flat is somewhere else.” Various distances, including races for toddlers and schoolchildren, offer suitable competitions for all age groups. The event is organized by Biesfeld Triathlon e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with the start and finish at the Biesfeld Community Primary School.
course_highlights: Hilly race in the municipality of Kürten, with challenging climbs
Distances from 0.6 km (toddler race) to 9.2 km (main race)
Start and finish in the schoolyard of Biesfeld Community Primary School
additional: Race packs will be handed out on race day in the schoolyard of Biesfeld Community Primary School. No separate timing chip is required, as the chip is integrated into the race bib (RaceResult). A late registration fee of €3.00 applies from 23.05.2026; late registrations are possible on site on race day. Distances: 0.6 km, 2.1 km, 9.2 km; online registration until 28.05.2026; race bib with chip; event in Kürten-Biesfeld

name: Wälster Lauf
description: The Wälster Lauf is a traditional fun run and road race in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde, organised annually by Fortuna Walstedde. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and offers runners and walkers of all ages an appealing opportunity to get active. The event traditionally opens the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract growing numbers of participants. Alongside competition, the focus is also on the enjoyment of exercise and community.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course in Drensteinfurt-Walstedde
Fun run and road race with various distances
Traditional opening event of the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde
additional: The Wälster Lauf offers running and walking on a DLV-measured course. The event includes various age groups and distances, including a Bambini run, children’s races, a fun run, 5 km and 10 km road races, and walking. Start times are staggered from 15:30 to 17:15. The event opens the sports week in the village of Lambertusdorf Walstedde and continues to attract growing numbers of participants. It is a well-established regional running tradition, with courses known for their accuracy and fairness. It is suitable for both recreational runners and competitive athletes.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Leśny Ogród Botaniczny Marszewo, Gdynia, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden in Gdynia. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has been promoting running and the beauty of natural routes in Poland since 2014. The race attracts running enthusiasts who value being close to nature and the beauty of their surroundings. It’s a great opportunity to spend time outdoors among greenery and enjoy a unique atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country route through the Marszewo Forest Botanical Garden
Picturesque natural surroundings and scenic beauty
Spring race as part of the Botaniczna Piątka series
additional: The race takes place between 10:00 and 14:00. The organizers are a group of running enthusiasts who focus on cross-country races and attractive locations. The event is part of a series of races held in different Polish cities during the spring season. It is open to runners of varying abilities, with the option to take part in a 5 km race. The event promotes outdoor activity and encourages local communities to take up running.

name: Bieg Lwa
location: Tarnów Podgórny, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Bieg Lwa is an annual half marathon held in Tarnowo Podgórne, attracting both elite runners and amateurs. The event is known for its excellent organization, attractive course, and enthusiastic crowd support. The festival also features children’s races and various accompanying events, such as cheering competitions and concerts. Bieg Lwa is a great opportunity for sporting competition and family fun in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course in Tarnowo Podgórne
Pogoń za Lwem 10 km race course
Numerous refreshment stations along the course
additional: Option to transfer the race pack until 10 May 2026. Cheering Competition with a prize of PLN 1,000. Accompanying events: ØRGANEK concert, FOODSTIVAL, Hobby Horse Cup, and challenges on the stadium track. Major children’s races during the festival. Registration until 10 May, race and recovery packs, cheering competition, previous editions’ race sold out

description: Bieg Poznaniaka dla Przedszkolaka is a family running event taking place on May 23, 2026, in the picturesque Wielkopolski National Park and on the grounds of the Museum of Agriculture in Szreniawa. The program includes main races over 11 km and 5.5 km, a Nordic Walking march, and children’s and youth races over various distances. The event is charitable, with all proceeds going to support children with autism. The organizers provide electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals, and a range of activities for participants and their families, including free museum admission and outdoor games for children.
course_highlights: The main races and Nordic Walking route follow a marked loop of approximately 5.5 km in Wielkopolski National Park
Participants in the 11 km race complete the loop twice

name: Phoenix RUN
location: Smolarnia, Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Klub Biegowy Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska i Opalenicki Klub Biegacza
description: Phoenix RUN is a unique sporting event held in a scenic forest near the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. This is the second edition of the race, organized by the Phoenix Contact Wielkopolska Running Club, bringing together running and Nordic walking enthusiasts. The event offers a range of distances for adults and children, encouraging families and friends to spend time actively together. Participants can look forward to generous race packs, commemorative medals, attractive prizes, socializing, and a chillout zone.
course_highlights: 10 km main race through the forest
5 km Nordic walking for adults
Children’s races from 100 to 800 m
additional: Start and finish at the Smolarnia forester’s lodge, close to Nowy Tomyśl. Children’s races start at 9:00; the main race and adult Nordic walking start at 11:00. Events include a 10 km race, 5 km Nordic walking, and children’s races from 100 to 800 m. Participants can enjoy activities and prizes, and the forest route offers scenic views and an active day out.

name: XXVIII Bieg Święców
location: Sławno, Sławno County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 28th Święcowie Run in Sławno is an annual running event taking place on May 23, 2026. The 10 km main race follows the city streets, including asphalt roads, basalt paving stones, and asphalt bike paths. The route is secured and marked, with water refreshment points along the way. The event also includes children’s and youth races at the athletics stadium over distances from 50 to 600 metres. The organizers promote community engagement and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: The 10 km main race route (3 x 3.33 km) through the streets of Sławno: asphalt, basalt paving stones, and asphalt bike paths
Refreshment points along the route at 1.5 km, 3 km, 4.5 km, 6 km, and 7.5 km, with water served in paper cups
Children’s and youth races at the athletics stadium on a tartan track, over distances from 50 to 600 m

The children’s and youth races start at 11:00 at the athletics stadium, with distances adapted to participants’ ages. The awards ceremony will take place at the amphitheatre at 17:30. Registration is available online; the event also includes organized activities and support for runners.

The event takes place on Saturday, May 22, 2027, and offers a sporty, friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. Start times are spread throughout the afternoon and evening, allowing participants and spectators to enjoy a varied program.

Location in the center of Aalten
Memorial run in honor of Gerard Tebroke

The event is held every two years and has strong local and sporting significance.

description: The Pi Run 2026 in Neunkirchen-Seelscheid offers a diverse range of races for all age groups and ability levels. The event includes distances ranging from Bambini and children’s races to a 13.4-kilometer main race, as well as walking. The course is scenic, with refreshment stations and good on-site facilities. Every finisher receives a medal, and the top runners are honored. The Lions Club will provide cakes and drinks.
course_highlights: 13.431 km main race with two refreshment stations at km 6.5 and 11.5
Short Bambini and children’s races (approx. 600 m and 1,100 m)
Refreshment station on the recreational race course at approx. 3 km
additional: Race number pickup is available from 08:00 on race day in the start/finish area or in the nearby school building. Late registration is possible until 60 minutes before each start, with a €2 late registration fee. Changing facilities and toilets are available in school buildings and nearby halls. There is ample parking nearby. Every finisher receives a medal, and Bambini runners can get a scoop of ice cream from the sponsor. Registration is through the Race Result platform; participants receive running shirts and a multifunctional scarf. The event takes place in typical temperatures of around 20°C.

name: Ra(h)ser-Run
description: The Ra(h)ser-Run is a flat race through the Rahser district of Viersen, with distances from 1 km to 10 km. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists, and run mostly along paved paths beside the Niers floodplains. The event offers races for different age groups, including a Bambini run for the youngest participants and a schools’ city championship. Timing is electronic, using transponders in the race bibs. Registration is online only; late registration is available until 60 minutes before the start.
course_highlights: Flat, paved loops through Rahser and along the Niers floodplains
The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for ranking lists
Kilometre markers and course marshals along the route
additional: Late registration is available until 60 minutes before each start for an additional fee of €5. Race bibs contain an integrated transponder for electronic timing, with both gun and net times. Sittarder Straße will be closed to through traffic between Kränkelsweg and Oberrahserstraße for the duration of the event. Participants can purchase an event T-shirt as part of online registration until 07.05. School and children’s races, free training sessions at Hoher Busch Stadium, race distances for different grade levels.

name: Spatzenberg-Lauf
description: The Spatzenberg Run is a traditional fun run in Löhne, following a hilly circular course around and over the Spatzenberg in the nature reserve. The route runs mostly on paved paths and roads and offers an attractive running opportunity for all age groups. In addition to the 9 km main race, there are shorter 6 km and 3 km races for schoolchildren. The event is organised by Turn- und Rasensportverein Löhne 1910 e.V., running group, and takes place at the Obernfeld sports field.
course_highlights: Hilly circular course around and over the Spatzenberg (nature reserve)
Route on paved paths and roads
Distances: 9 km, 6 km and 3 km schoolchildren’s race
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the back of the race bib. Race materials can be collected from 9:00 on the event day at the Obernfeld sports field. Late entries are possible on the event day until 10:15, while race bibs are available. Payment by SEPA direct debit for online registration or in cash when collecting race materials. Hilly course around the Spatzenberg, registration online or on the event day, timing with a disposable chip, water at the finish station

name: Sponsorenlauf Brustkrebshilfe Dorsten
location: Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, Dorsten, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Khadijeh Mohri, Andreas Schilasky, Ali Abdali
description: The Breast Cancer Aid Dorsten charity run is a charitable event in Dorsten focused on supporting breast cancer care and raising awareness. It takes place in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof and offers a range of running and walking routes accessible to all ages and fitness levels. Alongside the sporting aspect, supporting breast cancer aid is the main focus. A minimum participation fee applies, and participants can supplement it with additional donations. Participants can run or walk, or support the cause with a donation without taking part in the route.
course_highlights: Event in Bürgerpark Maria Lindenhof, with wide paths and plenty of green space
Distances: 800 m for children, 2.5 km and 5 km for running or walking
Accessible changing rooms and shower facilities on site
additional: Race number distribution on site; parking nearby. You can also take part without running or walking by making a “Run with your heart” donation. The run takes place on May 31, 2026, with a focus on donations for breast cancer centers and community involvement. More than 2,000 participants are expected, with a fundraising target of over 50,000 euros.

name: MAXiLauf 2026
organizer: Stadt Hamm, Amt für Konzernsteuerung und Sport
description: The MAXiLAUF in Hamm is an annual running event featuring flat, record-eligible courses that appeal to runners of all ability levels. Events include a half marathon, a 10 km run, a 5 km run, and children’s and toddlers’ races. The courses run through the city of Hamm and offer an attractive, approved circuit route passing many landmarks. All participants receive an exclusive medal, and trophies are awarded to the leading runners. The event is family-friendly and part of the Landesturnfest LTF26.
course_highlights: Flat, DLV-measured circuit courses through the city of Hamm
Courses eligible for inclusion in best lists
Attractive routes passing many landmarks
additional: Bib-number distribution from approx. 8:30 a.m. at the Stadtsportbund tent. Timing uses a race|result® chip attached to the bib. On-site registration is available. Cut-off times: half marathon 150 min, 10 km 90 min, 5 km 50 min. Personalised medal engraving can be booked for an additional fee. Certificates are available on-site and online. Official merchandise is available in the shop. The race features a DLV-measured circuit, medals for all finishers, online and on-site registration, and a festive atmosphere for runners and spectators.

description: The 12th Elegant na 5 Run is an annual running event held in Mosina, scheduled for May 24, 2026. The event offers various distances for children, young people and people with disabilities, as well as a 5 km main race along the streets of the Mosina municipality. The start and finish are at Plac 20 Października, and the main race starts at 11:15. Participants can choose a basic package or an extended package with a T-shirt, making the event appealing to a wide range of runners.
course_highlights: The 5,000-metre main race runs along the streets of the Mosina municipality
Various distances for children and young people, from 200 m to 950 m
A special 200 m race for people with disabilities
additional: The start and finish are at Plac 20 Października in Mosina. Children’s and youth distances are divided into age categories, with race lengths ranging from 200 m to 950 m. The main race runs along the streets of the Mosina municipality. Extended packages include a T-shirt; basic packages do not. The race for people with disabilities is free and does not include a T-shirt. Distances range from 200 m to 5,000 m, with various age categories and a category for people with disabilities; the event starts in Mosina, and entry fees apply through May 2026.

name: BoryRun
location: Osiecznica, Bolesławiec County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: BoryRun 2026 is the largest running festival in the Lower Silesian Forests, taking place on 24 May 2026 in Osiecznica. The event brings together sport, health and mindful offline time, promoting intergenerational connections and the joy of movement without the pressure of competition. The routes pass through the picturesque Lower Silesian Forests and the historic setting of Kliczków Castle, offering a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. Children can take part in the special Boryrun Active race, with activities designed to develop fitness and self-confidence.
course_highlights: Routes through the picturesque Lower Silesian Forests
The historic setting of Kliczków Castle
A range of distances: marathon, half marathon, 10 km race and 5 km Nordic Walking
additional: Children can take part in the Boryrun Active race, with activities and a commemorative medal. GPX route files are available to download for training. The event promotes health, integration and mindful offline time. It features a range of distances and activities for children, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and the local community. Registration is available on site on 23–24 May 2026.

name: Gontyniec Ultra Trail
location: Wzgórze Gontyniec, Chodzież, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Gontyniec Ultra Trail is a mountain trail race held on the scenic Gontyniec Hill in Chodzież, the highest elevation in the Greater Poland Lakeland. The routes run mainly along forest paths on the red and yellow trails, offering runners a range of distances and elevation gains. Organised by the Gontyniec Ultra Trail Foundation, the event attracts trail and ultra-running enthusiasts from across Poland, with challenges ranging from 12 to 52 km. This iconic event combines sporting competition with the beauty of nature and the history of the region.
course_highlights: Routes follow the red and yellow trails to Gontyniec, the highest peak in northern Greater Poland
The race runs mostly on forest paths over natural terrain
A range of distances with elevation gains of approximately 300 to 1,300 metres

Routes are available to download in GPX format. The race takes place on Sunday, 24 May 2026, in Chodzież. The organiser is the Gontyniec Ultra Trail Foundation, which also organises other trail and ultra races. mountain routes, forest paths, trail running, various distances, event in Greater Poland

It is an athletics event and an excellent opportunity to spend time outdoors in a friendly atmosphere. The organizers provide professional timing and technical support.

The race takes place on a flat asphalt surface, conducive to fast times

description: The 12th Run with a Book, ON THE TRAIL TO THE FINISH, is an open running event organized by the Nicolaus Copernicus University (UMK) Alumni Program and the UMK Marathon Club. It is dedicated to the UMK community in Toruń and to enthusiasts of running and reading. The event takes place on the university campus in Bielany, Toruń, and the course follows forest paths and lanes through the academic woodland. Participants must complete the course while holding a book weighing at least 100 grams, highlighting the event’s distinctive combination of sport and the promotion of reading. The run is patronized by Robert Małecki, a crime-fiction author and UMK graduate, who takes part in the event and meets participants after the race.
course_highlights: The course follows forest paths and lanes through the academic woodland in Bielany and the surrounding areas.
The main race distance is 27,000 wolfhound tracks, a reference to Robert Małecki’s 27 crime novels.
Runners must carry a book weighing at least 100 grams, a distinctive feature of the event.
additional: The race office opens at 9:30. Online registration is open until 20 May 2026, with in-person registration available on race day. Entry fees are paid cashlessly on site (by card or BLIK). After the race, meet patron Robert Małecki at the Picnic with a Pump, celebrating the 25th anniversary of the UMK Alumni Program. An additional “With Małecki” category is available for runners carrying a book by the patron; results are calculated using an algorithm that takes both finishing time and book specifications into account. Woodland setting, online and in-person registration, distance of approximately 3.51 km, promotion of reading and physical activity, participation of Robert Małecki.

description: The Freedom Run Wageningen is a running event that celebrates freedom and connection in the city of liberation. Organised by Lions Club Wageningen, participants run in support of Stichting Kind en Kans, which supports children from families with limited means. The run offers four distances and takes participants through beautiful natural areas and the city, mainly along paved cycle paths. Everyone is welcome to take part and contribute to a future in which no child is left on the sidelines.

Finish with a scenic descent towards the finish at Visum Mundi

T-shirts can be ordered when registering. The organisers encourage sustainable transport and use sustainable materials, such as medals made from potato starch or waste wood and rPET cups at drink stations. Setting: city run; timing via bib tag; start/finish at Visum Mundi; parking near the start/finish; registration by advance entry only.

description: The Liemerse Landloop is an annual running event held on the fourth Sunday in May in Oud-Zevenaar and Ooy. The course passes through picturesque villages and along the Liemerse dikes, with official certification for the 5 km and 10 km distances. Distances include 3 km, 5 km and 10 km, plus a free Kids’ Run for children up to 12 years old. The atmosphere is warm and festive, with strong volunteer involvement and a lovely keepsake for every participant.

Registration is available online and on site; the event is run with the help of volunteers and offers various running categories.

It is aimed at marathon and ultramarathon runners and promises a varied and challenging course in a natural setting. The organizer is 100 Marathon Club Deutschland, a club for experienced marathon runners.

Premiere event with DUV ranking
Natural and varied course

name: Vårruset Jönköping
description: Vårruset in Jönköping is an evening race held by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken, with distances of 2.5 km and 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured). The race is open to participants of different ages, and registered participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib. Timing is optional, and teams of five receive a picnic after finishing. The event is organized locally by IKHP Huskvarna and welcomes both recreational and experienced runners for an enjoyable spring evening.
course_highlights: The course runs by Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken

Timing is optional and can be declined so that results are not published

A free training session is held before the season (for example, 19 March at 18:30 at Rocksjöstadion). Registration is online and can be completed up to race day, no later than 1 hour before the first start. Local organizer: IKHP Huskvarna. Distances: 2.5 km or 5 km. Age recommendations: 5 km: age 13 (11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km: age 11 (7 when accompanied by an adult). Teams consist of 5 people; the team leader enters their details, and members enter their details before the team registration is submitted. Picnic after finishing. Event area: Lake Rocksjön in Knektaparken.

name: Vårruset Karlstad
description: Vårruset in Karlstad is an accessible fun run for women, held as part of the Vårruset national tour. Participants can run 2.5 km or 5 km (the 5 km course is officially measured). The event suits both competitive runners and those who want to enjoy an evening walk on a spring evening. Teams of five receive a picnic after the finish, while individual entrants receive a medal, a finisher’s bag and a race bib. The event is organised in collaboration with the local club IF Göta Karlstad, with the event area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet.
course_highlights: 2.5 km or officially measured 5 km course
Event area between Sundstagymnasiet and Sundstabadet
Option to opt out of official timing at no extra cost
additional: What’s included: a medal, a finisher’s bag, the Vårruset music quiz and prizes, timing on the 5 km course for those who choose it, and a race bib (team entries include a picnic after the finish). Recommended ages: 5 km from age 13 (age 11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km from age 11 (age 7 when accompanied by an adult). Registration is online and remains open until race day, up to one hour before the first start. It is possible to take part in Vårruset digitally during the tour (4 May–4 June). Digital participants will have a medal sent to their home but cannot attend the local event. Includes pre-race meetups at Skutberget (15 April and 6 May at 18:00). Recommended ages by distance: 5 km—up to age 13 (age 11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km—up to age 11 (age 7 when accompanied by an adult). The event also collaborates with Barncancerfonden.

All participants receive a medal at the finish, and the event is known for enthusiastic crowd support, music and award ceremonies. Those looking for a shorter challenge can take part in AktivRundan, which is 3.8 kilometres, while children can run the 1.7-kilometre XL Bygg Lilla Slottsrundan. The event celebrates its 10th anniversary in 2026, with a lively celebration of running, music, prizes and community. After the race, an official After Run offers a chance to relax and mingle.

name: Sternchenlauf
description: The Sternchenlauf in Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock is a traditional fun run held annually on the Wednesday before Corpus Christi. The event offers various races for all age groups, from races for toddlers and children to 5 km and 10 km races, as well as walking. The course follows a varied 2.5 km loop with forest trails, gravel and asphalt, lined with enthusiastic spectators. In addition to individual categories, there are team and relay categories, making the race especially appealing to groups.

Flat course with clear signage
Out-and-back courses for the toddler, children’s and schoolchildren’s races on Falkenstraße

name: B2Run Hannover
description: The B2Run Hannover on May 27, 2026, is a company run covering a roughly 6.5 km, mostly flat route along the Maschsee, with a spectacular finish in the Heinz von Heiden Arena.
