The event features a professional supporting program with a host and music, and is ideal for beginners, walkers and experienced runners. The focus is on fun, togetherness and team building, not personal bests.
course_highlights: A varied loop of roughly 6.5 km along the Maschsee
Mostly flat route, suitable for beginners, walkers and experienced runners
Spectacular finish in the Heinz von Heiden Arena
additional: The event is part of the nationwide B2Run company running series and features a professional supporting program with a host and music. Teams can cross the finish line together and enjoy the event atmosphere. The event is ideal for team building, workplace health promotion and active breaks from the working day. 6.5 km route, team event, company run, finish in the Heinz-von-Heiden-Arena, custom team running shirts, focus on team building and corporate fitness

name: Steglitzer Volkslauf
price_range: 5,00 € Nachmeldegebühr, sonst keine expliziten Preise genannt
description: The Steglitzer Volkslauf is a traditional running event taking place on 27 May 2026 at Stadion Lichterfelde in Berlin-Lichterfelde. Organised by TuS Lichterfelde von 1887 e.V., the race offers a sporting opportunity for runners of all age groups. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organised proceedings. The races start and finish at Stadion Lichterfelde, providing an attractive setting for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stadion Lichterfelde
Routes through the area around Berlin-Lichterfelde
Traditional event with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Late registration is possible online from 25.05. (00:01) until 30 minutes before the respective start, for a fee of €5.00. Certificates for places 1–3 are presented during the awards ceremony. All placed participants may request a certificate showing their place and time at the venue after the last runner finishes. Multiple race distances, online registration, start times from 18:00, certificates and age-group rankings, event held as part of the Steglitzer Festwochen.

name: S:t Hans Extreme

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Fram till och med 18:e maj gäller ordinarie pris (280:- för vuxna och 180:- för ungdomar/juniorer t o m 20 år och studenter).

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Fram till och med 18:e maj gäller ordinarie pris (280:- för vuxna och 180:- för ungdomar/juniorer t o m 20 år och studenter).

description: S:t Hans Extreme is a welcoming but challenging trail race at S:t Hans Backar in Lund, taking place on Thursday, 28 May 2026. The race offers several categories for different levels and ambitions: Ultra (6 hours), 10 km, 5 km and a shorter 2.5 km lap, as well as team events. The course is technical, with significant elevation gain on each lap, and suits both competitive runners and those looking for a tough training challenge. The organisers welcome everyone and provide practical information about registration, payment and start times on their information page.
course_highlights: The course runs on S:t Hans Backar: technical trail with clear climbs and descents
One lap is 2.55 km with 140 m of elevation gain (10 km = ~10.2 km, 560 m of elevation gain; 5 km = ~5.1 km, 280 m of elevation gain)
The ultra lap is 4.38 km (with an out-and-back section so runners can cheer each other on); ultra runners complete as many laps as possible within 6 hours
additional: Register via Mittlopp.se (link from the organiser’s registration page). The regular online price applies until 18/5; late online registration is available 18–25/5 at a higher price. You can also register late at Löplabbet in Lund on 26/5 from 16–18 (in-store discount), and at the event venue on 28/5 (ultra categories 13:20–13:50, other categories 16:45–18:20). Payment is preferably by Swish (Lunds OK’s Swish number: 123 303 6787); cash in exact change is accepted in exceptional cases. Runners from Lunds Orienteringsklubb pay a reduced fee (50:-). Team events: the fastest team is determined over 40 km, and there is also a team competition for the greatest total distance. Course information: lap-based course at S:t Hans Backar, 2.55 km per lap with approximately 140 metres of elevation gain; the ultra categories take place within 6 hours. Start and finish at S:t Hans Backar. Registration and payment via Mittlopp.se; Swish payment; a live results link is available on the race page. Ongoing roadworks on Svenshögsvägen between Norra Ringen and Magistratsvägen may affect access; cycling or public transport is recommended.

name: Blodomloppet
organizer: Stora Tuna OK och Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott
description: Blodomloppet in Borlänge is an inclusive recreational event where you can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, or take part in Lilla Blodomloppet (approximately 800 m). The event is organised locally by Stora Tuna OK and Kvarnsvedens GOIF Friidrott and has a strong social focus, with team registration and a picnic to round off the event. It aims to raise awareness of blood donation and welcomes both individual participants and teams. Information and practical details (race bibs, storage, start areas) are published on the event page.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km running routes head north across Sportfältet and split at Storsvängen
The walking route heads down towards central Borlänge and finishes by the fruit and medal tables
Lilla Blodomloppet is approximately 800 m and takes place in the area around the event venue
additional: You can register individually or as a team (3–5 people; a picnic bag is included). Teams cannot register late after 21 May; individual participants can register late through the system until 28 May at 12:00. Late registration on race day is available at the event venue from 15:00 to 17:00 and payment is by Swish only (400 kr). Race bibs can be collected at Friskis&Svettis (Skomakargatan 9) on 24 May from 13:00 to 16:00. Blood donors receive a 40 kr discount per person. The kiosk at the event venue accepts Swish only. Team registration for 3–5 participants includes a picnic bag. Individual registration is also available; blood donors receive a 40 kr discount per person. The start is at 17:00, with a warm-up at 16:45 (according to the information provided). The routes include 5 km, 10 km and Lilla Blodomloppet, which is approximately 800 m; registration is via the website or in person at Sportfältet from around 15:00. The race package includes a technical T-shirt, race bib and medal.

name: Vårruset
description: Vårruset in Örebro is part of Sweden’s largest fitness tour for women and takes place on Thursday, 28 May 2026, at Gustavsviksbadet. Runners can choose between 2.5 km and a certified 5 km course. Both individual entries and team entries (teams of 5) are welcome. Participants receive a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib, with optional timing. Teams that register are treated to a picnic after finishing. The event is organised locally by KFUM Örebro Friidrott in collaboration with Marathongruppen and other local clubs.
course_highlights: Choose between 2.5 km and a certified 5 km course
Evening race at Gustavsviksbadet, starting at 18:30
Picnic after the finish for teams of five
additional: Registration is online and open until race day, up to 1 hour before the first start. Individual entries include a medal, a finish-line bag and a race bib, plus timing for those who choose it. Timing can be declined so that results are not published. Recommended ages: 5 km from age 13 (age 11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km from age 11 (age 7 when accompanied by an adult). There is also a digital option (Vårruset Digitalt), where the medal is sent after the tour ends and team registration is not available. Distances: 2.5 km or 5 km; team registration includes a picnic; age recommendations: 5 km, age 13 (age 11 when accompanied by an adult); 2.5 km, age 11 (age 7 when accompanied by an adult). Event area at Gustavsviksbadet; online registration and binding entry.

name: Int. Volkslauf, 38. Int. Halbmarathon, 22. Walkinglauf
description: TV Schwafheim is hosting the 52nd International Fun Run, the 38th International Half Marathon, and the 22nd Walking Event in Moers-Schwafheim. Races for children, adults, and walkers range in distance from 500 m to the half marathon. The course is closed to traffic, with several aid stations and timing by the Race Result system. The event is family-friendly and welcomes local club runners as well as half-marathon runners looking for a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Roads closed to traffic, with traffic rules to be observed
Several aid stations along the course
Timing with the Race Result system and two chips attached to the shoelaces
additional: Race number pickup in the morning at the clubhouse; late entries accepted until shortly before each start; showers at the clubhouse and in the Waldschule gym; certificates can be printed directly at the finish. Course maps, 2025 results, water stations, showers, registration from 08:00, late entries up to 30 minutes before the start, family-friendly

name: Klingenlauf
price_range: Erwachsene: 16,00 € bis 18,00 €, Jugendliche/Kinder: 8,00 €, Firmenstaffeln: 65,00 €, Staffeln: 10,00 €, Schul- und Gruppenstaffeln: 30,00 € bis 60,00 €
description: The Klingenlauf is a traditional running event in Solingen, taking place on June 4, 2026, in Südpark. With various races from 1 km to 10 km, relay races, and a company run, the Klingenlauf offers suitable running opportunities for all age groups and ability levels. The course runs through Solingen’s Südpark and along the Korkenziehertrasse. More than 1,500 runners take part each year, making the Klingenlauf a sporting highlight in the region.
course_highlights: Course through Solingen’s Südpark
Section along the Korkenziehertrasse
Various distances from 1 km to 10 km, as well as relay races
additional: Late registration is possible on the event day until 30 minutes before the respective start, provided the participant limit has not been reached. The late registration fee is €2.00. Race numbers can be collected on the event day and also on June 2, 2026, from 17:00 to 20:00 at the ice rink. The 5 km race is divided into two runs: Speed Run (max. 30 min.) at 18:15 and Fun Run (over 30 min.) at 18:45. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available on site. Various race categories, online registration, changing rooms, toilets and showers at the ice rink, limited baggage storage, certificates and honorary prizes, award ceremonies at the event venue

name: Leihgesterner Volkslauf
description: The Leihgestern Volkslauf takes place annually on Corpus Christi in the beautiful woodland landscape of Linden. Participants can choose from a 5 km walk, a 5 km run, or a 10 km run. The courses run mostly along comfortable forest paths with moderate elevation changes and are suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. Timing is chip-based, and race bibs require a deposit that is refunded when the bib is returned.
course_highlights: 5 km loop with 95% forest paths and approximately 50 m of elevation gain
10 km loop with 95% forest paths and approximately 110 m of elevation gain
A nature-filled route through the woodland landscape of Linden
additional: Race bib deposit: EUR 2, refunded when the bib is returned. Online registration is available until 03.06.2026 at 18:00 (group registration) or 04.06.2026 at 08:30 (individual registration). On-site late registration is not possible. Gross and net times are recorded using a chip. The start venue is the TSG Leihgestern sports clubhouse, Waldstraße 32, 35440 Linden. Run through nature, starting at the sports clubhouse; online registration available until 04.06.2026

name: Leśna Piątka Pikuś
location: Parking przy ścieżce edukacyjnej Nadleśnictwa Karnieszewice, Koszalin, Poland
description: Leśna Piątka Pikuś is a cross-country race held in the picturesque forest of the Karnieszewice Forest District in Koszalin. The 10 km course runs through charming woodland, with numerous climbs and descents and a section alongside a deep ravine, making the race challenging and full of memorable moments. Every participant who completes the distance will receive a commemorative medal. The start and finish are in the car park by the educational trail, providing easy access and convenient race logistics.
course_highlights: A 10 km course covering one full lap
Runs through the picturesque woodland of the Karnieszewice Forest District
A section alongside a deep ravine that calls for care and offers a unique experience
additional: The start and finish are in the car park by the Karnieszewice Forest District educational trail on Słupska Street in Koszalin. The course includes a variety of climbs and descents, as well as wet and dry sections, offering a varied running experience. Every participant will receive a commemorative medal after crossing the finish line. Participants receive medals, and registration and results are available online. The race is popular locally and brings the running community in Koszalin together.

name: Eksjö Stadslopp
description: Welcome to Eksjö Stadslopp on Friday 29 May 2026—a Friday evening race in the beautiful wooden town of Eksjö. The race programme includes the classic 10 km, a 5 km fun run, and children’s and youth races (1000 m and 600 m). The finish is at Stora Torget, and proceeds from the event go to Eksjö Södra IK’s children’s and youth activities. The 10 km and 5 km courses are officially measured, and the event welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: The race runs through Eksjö’s historic wooden town
Finish in the middle of Stora Torget in Eksjö
The 10 km and 5 km courses are officially measured
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Snäckan (next to the swimming pool). Collection times: Thursday 28 May, 17:00–20:00, and Friday 29 May from 14:00. Changing facilities are available at Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day. Late registration opens on 24 May for an increased fee and is available until one hour before the start of each race category via the same registration page. All finishers in the 600 m and 1000 m races receive a medal; finishers in the 5 km and 10 km receive a plaque. There is a sprint prize on the 10 km course after approximately 1.2 km (for the first man and woman, who must finish the race). Categories are determined by year of birth. Group registration by invoice: tavling.esik@gmail.com. Course maps can be collected at Snäckan on Thursday and Friday. Late registration opens on 24 May for an increased fee; race bibs can be collected at Snäckan by the swimming pool; parking is available at Storegårdsgatan 3A, Eksjö; changing facilities are available at Prästängshallen until 21:30 on race day.

name: Lindahls Helsingborg Night Run
description: Lindahls Helsingborg Night Run is an evening race set against the city’s night lights, with music, lighting and a festive atmosphere at its heart. Choose between 5 km and 10 km on a fast, almost flat course starting and finishing at Gröningen, just a short walk from Helsingborg C. The race is suited both to runners chasing a personal best and to those looking to enjoy a great running party with friends. The event is certified as a World Athletics Road Race 2026 and takes place on 29 May 2026, starting at 22:00.
course_highlights: Fast, almost flat course along Strandpromenaden (5 km; 10 km = 2 laps, with the lap turnaround at Gröningen)
Surface: approx. 90% asphalt, 8% hard-packed gravel, 2% grass
Start and finish at Gröningen, with a lively crowd, music and lighting
additional: Start and finish at Gröningen (approx. 10 minutes’ walk from Helsingborg C). Race bibs can be collected at Löplabbet in Helsingborg Wed–Fri 10:00–18:00 and at the venue from 20:00. Bag storage opens at 20:00 and uses numbered stickers. Löplabbet pacers are available for several finish times for both 5 km and 10 km. After Run and refreshments/products from partners (including Lindahls quark, SP Chark sausages, Erdinger non-alcoholic beer, Ramlösa, Dole and KitKat). Maximum number of entries: 1500. Distances: 5 km or 10 km; evening race in central Helsingborg with music and lights; date: 29 May 2026; registration offers timed or untimed options; entry fee: 500:-; company invoicing via a downloadable Excel form.

name: Abendlauf Wilstedt bei Nacht
description: The Wilstedt Night Run takes place on 29 May 2026, transforming the village of Wilstedt into an atmospheric race course. The event is family-friendly and open to everyone, from beginners to experienced runners. The new course offers lovely views of the village at night. Cheering spectators and an evening fireworks display add to the atmosphere.
course_highlights: New course through Wilstedt with lovely views of the village
Atmospheric setting with cheering spectators along the course
Floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt after the run until 22:30
additional: The start and finish are at the Wilstedt sports grounds. The event begins with the mini run at 20:15, followed by the jogging and walking starts. Late entries are available on the event day from 18:30 to 20:00 and cost 9 euros. T-shirts or functional shirts are only available to participants who register in advance and will be handed out on the event day. After the run, floodlit swimming at Heidebad Wilstedt is free until 22:30. Fireworks bring the event to a close at around 22:45. Nordic walking poles are not allowed on the course. Child and running strollers are permitted only for the hiking/walking event. Shower and changing facilities are available on a limited basis. New course through Wilstedt, family-friendly, evening event, registration until 17 May, including a mini run, fireworks and musical entertainment.

name: Raesfelder Mai-Lauf
description: The Raesfeld May Run takes place annually on the last Friday in May and offers a varied running programme for all age groups. From the 400 m Bambini races for kindergarten children to the 5 km and 10 km races for adults, there is something for everyone. There is also a 5 km team run, encouraging the fun of running together. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and are therefore eligible for inclusion in rankings.
course_highlights: 400 m child-friendly course for Bambinis
1,000 m and 2.3 km courses for children and teenagers
5 km and 10 km courses for adults, measured by the DLV
additional: Start times: 16:00 Bambini races (400 m), 17:00 1,000 m schoolchildren’s race, 17:30 2.3 km schoolchildren’s race, 18:00 10 km Volksbank Run, 18:05 5 km walking race, 19:30 5 km company, family and team run. The 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km loop. Part of the Lippe-Issel Cup, registration required, family-friendly, various categories.

name: Lauf Rund um Burg
description: The 37th Lauf Rund um Burg is part of the Cross and Forest Run Series and takes place around Burg bei Dithmarschen. The event offers runners the opportunity to run scenic 4.8 km and 10 km courses. The race is distinguished by its natural surroundings and varied course. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere and a well-organized event.
course_highlights: 4.8 km and 10 km running courses
Part of the Cross and Forest Run Series
Natural course around Burg
additional: Typical May weather conditions: approx. 20 °C, mostly cloudy, average precipitation of 55 mm. The race is part of MTV Burg’s varied sports program, with registration via Yolawo. Children’s and youth sports activities are also planned in good weather.

name: Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf
description: The Mühlhäuser Röblinglauf is a charity run with the unique concept “Sport meets Music,” benefiting the Kinderhospiz Mitteldeutschland. The event offers various races for children, young people, companies and individual entrants, as well as races for walkers. Alongside the sporting event, there is musical entertainment and a KinderGartenKonzert, making the run a special experience for participants and spectators. Race packs can be collected the day before, and an AfterRöblinglaufParty takes place after the run.
course_highlights: A variety of races for children, young people, companies and individual entrants
Charity run benefiting the Kinderhospiz Mitteldeutschland
Musical entertainment and a KinderGartenKonzert
additional: Race packs can be collected on 28.05.2026 from 15:30 to 18:00 at Schwanenteich in Mühlhausen. Team scoring is available for children’s and company races. The AfterRöblinglaufParty and KinderGartenKonzert are part of the supporting programme. Several children’s, youth and company races; online registration opens on 11.01.2026; donations benefit the Kinderhospiz Mitteldeutschland. The event includes music events and an after-run party.

name: Nacht von Hasbergen
description: Die Nacht von Hasbergen is a traditional road race taking place on Friday, May 29, 2026, in Hasbergen. The event offers exciting races for all age groups, from the Bambini run and relay to the 10 km main race. The races follow a new route, adjusted due to construction work. The event begins with an opening and a show act for the Bambini runners and ends with award ceremonies for the various races.
course_highlights: New route due to construction work on Tecklenburger Straße
Races ranging from the 0.5 km Bambini run to the 10 km main race
Road closures and parking restrictions along the race route from 16:00
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 15:30 for an additional fee of €2. Bib pickup begins on the day of the event at 15:30 in the Bürgersaal at the town hall, Hüggelplatz 1, 49205 Hasbergen. The event comprises five races: Bambini run 0.5 km, relay 5 x 0.5 km, half-distance 5 km (eligible for ranking lists), elite race 5 km, and main race 10 km (eligible for ranking lists). All proceeds from the Bambini run will be donated to youth work in Hasbergen. Various race distances, relay bibs, late entries on the day of the event, information about exchange points, online registration, route details with construction detour

name: Markaryds Sparbankloppet
location: Markaryd, Markaryds Municipality, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: Markaryd Savings Bank Run is a long-distance race held in Markaryd alongside the bank’s anniversary celebrations and the spring market. The race is mentioned as part of the anniversary programme and is being planned together with other activities during the anniversary year. According to sources, participation is funded through a registration fee that benefits local associations, making the race an initiative that strengthens the community. The event is presented as a welcoming opportunity to take part in a local setting and contribute to community life.
course_highlights: Held in May in Markaryd, alongside the spring market
Part of Markaryd Savings Bank’s 150th anniversary programme, which includes several activities
The registration fee supports local associations
additional: Register by filling in the form on the registration page. The race date is 2026-05-30, and the deadline for advance registration is 2026-05-27. Start lists will be published closer to race day (an archived 2025 start list is available). The Savings Bank Run is mentioned as an activity with a registration fee that benefits participating associations; planned anniversary activities include lectures, a treasure hunt and a family day.

name: Öland Lighthouse Challenge
price_range: 1490 kr/100 miles, 990 kr/50 miles, 590 kr/50 km
description: Öland Lighthouse Challenge is an ultramarathon on Öland, starting at Långe Erik Lighthouse. The race is offered over three distances—50 km, 50 miles and 100 miles—and follows coastal routes, meadows and woodland, with views of the Alvar and the Baltic Sea. The event is well organised, with water and aid stations along the course; all finishers receive a medal and a T-shirt. The organiser is Högby IF, and the event is suitable for both experienced ultrarunners and distance-trained recreational runners.
course_highlights: Start at Långe Erik Lighthouse, followed by coastal running along the Kalmar Strait to Sandvik (finish for the 50 km)
Route through meadows and woodland to Lindby (finish for the 50 miles), continuing to Långe Jan for the 100 miles
Views of the Alvar and the Baltic Sea; water and aid stations approximately every 20 km
additional: Bib collection on Friday from 13:30; race information, course maps and a GPX file (updated) are available on the race website; drop-bag labels are provided; all finishers receive a medal and T-shirt; 15% accommodation discount at Böda Sand (mention Lighthouse Challenge when booking); payment for late registration/bib collection: cash, card or Swish. Information about training and runs is available; aid stations approximately every 20 km; 15% accommodation discount at Böda Sand for the weekend (mention Lighthouse Challenge when booking); start at Långe Erik and finish at Långe Jan; medal and T-shirt included in the entry fee; late registration possible until 27 May, according to the race information.

name: Skatås ryggar
location: Skatås, Gothenburg, Västra Götaland County, Sweden
description: Skatås Ryggar is a major trail race in Gothenburg, following winding trails through the Delsjö area and Knipeflågsbergen Nature Reserve. The race offers courses crossing five, four or two ridges, with distances suited to both experienced trail runners and young people (10–16 years). The event is just a few kilometres from central Gothenburg and includes amenities such as water stations and refreshments. Welcome to a technical, nature-close trail experience near the city.
course_highlights: Winding trails through the Delsjö area and Knipeflågsbergen Nature Reserve
Courses crossing five, four or two ridges
The race is just a few kilometres from central Gothenburg
additional: Information about water stations, refreshments and start times is available on the race website. Course preview runs and training sessions are organised before the race (announced on the website). Youth categories for ages 10–16 are offered, and there is a group registration page. Results are published and updated on race day. The distances correspond to two, four or five ridges; youth categories are for ages 10–16; water stations and refreshments are provided during the race; preview runs and trail training take place at Skatås Motionscentral before the race.

name: Highland Charity Backyard Ultra
organizer: Highland Trail Club and Höglandskyrkan i Sävsjö
description: Welcome to Highland Charity Backyard Ultra in Sävsjö—a charitable and challenging backyard ultra organized in collaboration between Höglandskyrkan in Sävsjö and Highland Trail Club. The race is run in timed laps, with a mass start at 09:00 and a new start every hour on the hour. Anyone who cannot complete a lap within 60 minutes is out. Participants can choose between an easy 3.7 km loop around the lake and the tougher 6.7 km Bäckaskogsrundan. Proceeds from the race go to charitable causes.
course_highlights: 3.7 km around the lake (gravel road, trail, asphalt)—an easy course with good footing
6.7 km Bäckaskogsrundan (gravel road, forest trail)—technical, hilly forest running
Lap format: a new start every hour on the hour; 15 laps correspond to approximately 55 km or 100 km, respectively
additional: Parking at the Slottsruinen car park (toilets available); race bib, water bottle, food, and coffee and a bun are included in the entry fee. Food is served to participants at 11:30, 15:30, and 19:30. Race bibs can be collected from 07:30 to 08:30 on race morning. Late registration is open May 24–May 30 at 08:30 (late registration fee: 350 kr). The winner is the last person remaining to complete a lap, or the first to finish lap 15 if several participants remain. Participants choose their distance before each hourly start; prizes are awarded only to those running the longer course. Backyard Ultra format with two distances; maximum 15 laps; start at 09:00 and finish no later than 00:00; advance registration and late registration available until race day; start and finish area at the Slottsruinen car park in Sävsjö.

name: Säffle Stadslopp 2026
location: Medborgarhuset i Säffle, Säffle Municipality, Sweden
description: Säffle City Run is a spectator- and family-friendly festival in central Säffle, organised by Säffle SK. The event offers several classes for all levels: a tough but manageable 10 km race, 5 km for running or walking, shorter races for children, and Boxen Race, an obstacle-filled 5 km race. Expect plenty of support from spectators along the course and a welcoming atmosphere in the town centre. Everyone is welcome, whether competing or taking part for fitness.
course_highlights: Race in central Säffle with plenty of spectators
Scenic, spectator-friendly course through the town
Boxen Race: 5 km with challenging obstacles
additional: Start times listed on the pages: ST-Loppet 10:30 (mass start); 10K Team Sportia Loppet 11:00 (mass start); 5K Running 11:00 (mass start); Sibyllapromenaden 5K 11:00. Competition classes include children’s races and Boxen Race (5 km with obstacles). Partner/contact information: Team Sportia Säffle is listed as a point of contact, and RaceID handles questions about changing or transferring a race entry via support@raceid.com. Contacts listed on the page: Magnus (general questions), Stefan Guttman (organiser role) and Mattias (Boxen Race). Registration is online via RaceID, and the price increases on 10 May. Start/finish at Medborgarhuset in Säffle. Race numbers can be collected at Team Sportia Säffle or at race-day registration. Courses: 10K/5K along the waters of the Byälven and through central Säffle; ST-Loppet approximately 1.5K; Paprica-Loppet 300 m; Boxen Race approximately 2.5 km per lap, two laps.

name: HIT-felder Volkslauf
description: The HIT-felder Volkslauf is a long-standing race in Seevetal, organised by TSV Eintracht Hittfeld. It offers courses for the whole family, from short runs at the Peperdieksberg sports grounds to longer routes along country and forest paths. The event takes place on 30 May 2026 from 13:30 and is known for its friendly atmosphere and extensive supporting programme. All participants receive a finisher’s medal. Team rankings and cash prizes are also awarded to the largest groups of runners who register in advance.
course_highlights: Routes along country and forest paths, as well as partly paved side roads
Races over 600 m, 1000 m, 2.5 km, 4.5 km and 10.6 km, with small and large loops
Electronic timing; spikes are not permitted
additional: Start and finish at Hittfeld School Centre, Peperdieksberg sports grounds. Changing rooms and showers are available at the school centre. Late registration is possible on the day of the event, up to 30 minutes before the start, with cash payment (except for the Roland-Witt family run). Supporting programme with coffee, cake, grilled sausages and drinks. Certificates are available online at www.stgk.de. Team rankings apply to certain races. The group with the most advance registrations receives a challenge trophy and cash prizes. The event takes place in May, with typical temperatures of around 20°C for the low and 10°C for the high, and offers children’s races, walking and Nordic walking alongside the running courses.

name: Johannes-Lauf Lette
location: Ernsting's family Sportpark, Lette, Coesfeld, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Johanneslauf in Lette is a long-standing running event that has been held annually at the Ernsting's family Sportpark since 1998. The race attracts participants from across the region and is a regular fixture on the regional sporting calendar. It is organised by DJK Vorwärts Lette e.V., a club with a long tradition and a strong commitment to grassroots sport. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly and inclusive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Ernsting's family Sportpark
5-kilometre race
A tradition since 1998 with regional significance
additional: The race is part of the Streiflicher running series. Previous events have attracted around 400 participants and included a 5-kilometre walking route.

name: Leegebrucher Straßenlauf am 30.05.2026
price_range: Kinder frei; Jugendliche 3 Euro; Erwachsene 4 Euro
description: The Leegebruch Road Race takes place on May 30, 2026, and is a traditional running event in Leegebruch that welcomes runners of almost all ages. Participants run laps on the sports field and through the streets of Leegebruch. The event promises a lively atmosphere and is open to athletes of all ability levels. Registration is online via an external platform.
course_highlights: Laps on the sports field and through the streets of Leegebruch
Traditional running event with a family-friendly atmosphere
Suitable for runners of almost all ages
additional: Registration is online only; on-site registration is not possible. There are no age categories and no awards ceremony. Changing rooms and showers are not available. Cold and hot drinks and snacks are available at the kiosk. Parking is available at the fairground on Lindenstraße. Run on roads and at the stadium, online registration, no changing rooms or showers, parking on Lindenstraße

name: 08. Dünenfeld Marathon
description: The Dünenfeld Marathon in Augustdorf is a special race held according to the rules of the 100 Marathonclub Deutschland. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and has some trail-like sections. The start is at the level of the viewing platform, where runners can enjoy a beautiful view of the large dune fields. This is a private race with self-sufficiency and manual timekeeping; a photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof.
course_highlights: 7 laps of 6.1 km each, with trail-like sections
Start at the level of the viewing platform, with views of the dune fields
The course runs parallel to the dune field and the Ölbach
additional: The race takes place with at least 3 participants. There is no entry fee, but a voluntary donation of 5 € is requested. Timekeeping is done with a manual stopwatch, and a photo of the clock must be emailed on the same day. Showers and changing facilities are not available. Participants must be at least 18 years old. The course is marked with tape. Participants must be self-sufficient, as the start area is passed after every lap. Trail-like sections, self-sufficiency, no showers/changing facilities, participation at your own risk, limited number of participants, registration by 18:00 on the day before.

name: 34. Emder Matjeslauf
description: The 34th Emder Matjeslauf takes place on Saturday, 30 May 2026, in Emden city centre. This traditional city race has been organised by Emder Laufgemeinschaft e.V. since 1991 and is known well beyond the region. In addition to the 10 km main race, there are school class and team classifications, making the event suitable for all age groups. The course has been adjusted because of construction work on Neutorstraße, but still offers an attractive circuit through the city. Emder Laufgemeinschaft looks forward to welcoming many participants and wishes everyone the best of luck.
course_highlights: Circuit through Emden city centre
New course route due to construction work on Neutorstraße
Traditional city race held since 1991
additional: The 600 m Wattje Loop is limited to 400 participants. School class classifications are offered over 1,300 m and 2,500 m, as well as a team classification over 5 km. Race bibs and technical shirts will be distributed. Wattje participants can order cotton or technical shirts while stocks last. Multiple race distances; participant limit of 400 for the Wattje Loop; different race times; fixed date: 30 May 2026.

name: HafenCity Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld von 34€ trägt jeder selbst.

description: The HafenCity Run 2026 is a community run at a relaxed pace over a 4 km route through Hamburg’s HafenCity. There are no prerequisites or timekeeping; the focus is on fun and sharing the experience. The run brings together recreational sport, team spirit and charity, with part of the entry fee donated. Participants receive a DAV shirt and can take part from the age of 6.
course_highlights: 4 km route through Hamburg’s HafenCity
Run without performance pressure or timekeeping
Charity event with a donation from each entry and team
additional: The start window is from 13:00 to 14:00. There is no time limit or performance pressure. €6 per entry and a further €10 per team go into the donation fund. Participants receive a DAV shirt; the shirt size must be provided after registration. The run is open to everyone aged 6 and over. The entry fee is €34, including a DAV shirt. There are no pre-event meetings, and the run takes place on 30 May 2026 between 13:00 and 14:00. The route is approximately 4 km long and runs through HafenCity, with the focus on fun and community.

name: Aegidius-Lauf
location: Aegidiushaus, Auf der Bul, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Aegidius Run is a charity run in Hanover that has been established for over 20 years and takes place on 30 May 2026. The event offers several distances, including children’s races, a wheelchair race, 5 km and 10 km runs, and walking options. The start and finish are at Aegidiushaus AUF DER BULT, and all participation fees go exclusively to a good cause. The course is attractive, and times are recorded using a clock without chip timing. All participants receive a certificate, and the top runners are awarded prizes in kind.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Aegidiushaus AUF DER BULT in Hanover
Attractive course with several distances (1 km children’s race, 5 km, 10 km)
Clock timing without chip timing; certificates for all participants
additional: There is no chip timing, but times are recorded using a clock. All participants receive a certificate, and the first three women and men receive prizes in kind. Race shirts will be handed out at the information stands from 14:00 before the race. The fee of 15 euros for adult races goes exclusively to a good cause. Children’s races and the wheelchair race are free. The event begins with children’s races from 14:00, followed by the 5 km runs and walking at 15:15 and the 10 km run at 16:15. Several race distances, online registration, certificates for all, prizes in kind for the first three men and women, no chip timing; the race takes place behind Aegidiushaus in Hanover.

name: Allbaulauf 2026
description: The AllbauLauf 2026 takes place on May 30 around Niederfeldsee and Krupp Park in Altendorf, Essen. The event offers a varied mix of races for schoolchildren, young people, company runners, recreational runners, and competitive athletes. The short races for bambinis and schoolchildren are also especially popular; they run right along the lakeside promenade and across a bridge. The event is a sporting highlight, with a wide range of running options for all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Around Niederfeldsee and Krupp Park in Altendorf
300-meter bambini course along the lakeside promenade and across a bridge
A wide range of races, from schoolchildren to competitive athletes
additional: The bambinis start at 12:00 on a 300-meter course. The University Championships of the University of Duisburg-Essen take place as part of the AllbauLauf; registration is through the university’s sports department. The event includes distances of 300 m for bambinis, 1 km for schoolchildren, and 5 km and 10 km for adults. Registration is also available through the University of Duisburg-Essen’s sports department. Special offers are also available for company runs and group activities.

name: Bartenwetzer Volkslauf
location: Waldstadion Melsungen, Melsungen, Schwalm-Eder-Kreis, Hessen, Germany
price_range: Erwachsene 8,00 €, Jugendliche und Kinder 4,00 €, Bambini kostenlos
description: The Bartenwetzer Volkslauf is the oldest popular race in North Hesse and takes place on May 30, 2026, at Waldstadion Melsungen. The event includes children’s and schoolchildren’s races over 400 m and 1,000 m, as well as main races over 5 km, 10 km, and 19 km, on firm paths through Melsungen City Forest. As the 10th scoring race in the Nordhessencup, it offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, award ceremonies, and a buffet. The start and finish areas are picturesquely located on the edge of the forest, making the race especially appealing.
course_highlights: Races on firm paths through beautiful Melsungen City Forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Melsungen on the edge of the forest
A range of distances from 400 m to 19 km
additional: Race packet pickup from 14:30 at the MT clubhouse at Waldstadion. Changing rooms are available at the MT clubhouse. Refreshments include water on the longer routes, hot tea at the finish, and a buffet with coffee, cake, and bratwurst from 15:30. Medical services provided by the German Red Cross. Race-day registration is not possible. Certificates can be printed on site or downloaded online from RaceResult. Routes through Melsungen City Forest; online registration only; race number pickup at the clubhouse; no on-site late registration; refreshments in the finish area; medical services provided by the German Red Cross.

name: Lauf zwischen den Meeren
description: The Run Between the Seas is a unique relay race that takes teams of participants from Husum on the North Sea to Damp on the Baltic Sea. The 92.2-kilometre course is divided into ten stages and takes runners through the varied landscapes of Schleswig-Holstein. Alongside individual performance, the teams’ collective effort is central to the event. The race connects not only the coasts but also the people of the region, offering a special running experience for recreational and elite athletes alike.
course_highlights: A 92.2-kilometre course in 10 stages from Husum to Damp
Crossing the flat region of North Frisia, the Viking cultural monument Waldemars Wall, and Gottorf Castle
The final section passes through Schwansen’s rolling terminal moraine landscape, finishing on the Baltic Sea beach
additional: The race starts at the harbour in Husum (Schiffbrücke). The fastest teams take around 5 hours and 10 minutes and reach the finish at around 14:15. Race packs can be mailed or collected in person on certain days. A baggage transfer and bus shuttle are available. The event includes a pasta party and a runners’ party. The course has ten changeover points, with distances ranging from 6.9 to 11.5 kilometres. Course: 92.2 km, team relay race, registration opens on 13 June 2025, various stages and changeover points, catering and overnight accommodation available

name: Limbacher Marktlauf
description: The Limbach Market Run will take place for the 30th time on May 30, 2026, at Waldstadion Limbach-Oberfrohna. The event offers a great running atmosphere with new courses, new competitions, and a finisher medal. Alongside the sporting competition, participants can look forward to an extensive program of activities. The run is organized by LV Limbach 2000 e.V. and is a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Start at Waldstadion Limbach-Oberfrohna
New courses and competitions for the anniversary year
Finisher medal for all participants
additional: The run offers a finisher medal and an extensive program of activities. Registration is via Triathlonservice.de. Organizer: LV Limbach 2000 e.V. Running event with various distances, registration until May 27, 2026, start at the stadium, finisher medals, program of activities

name: Nienburger Spargellauf
description: The Nienburg Asparagus Run is a long-standing race taking place on May 30, 2026, in Nienburg. It offers various distances for children, teenagers, and adults. The officially measured courses follow flat, partly shaded loops, with the start and finish at the Wesavi parking lot. In addition to individual and children’s races, there is a 10 km relay, as well as company and club rankings. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and attractive prizes for the top runners.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured loops of 2.5 km per lap
Start and finish at the Wesavi parking lot in Nienburg
Partly shaded course
additional: The start and finish are at the Wesavi parking lot in Nienburg. The school races start from 13:00, the 10 km relay at 15:00, the 5 km Asparagus Run at 16:45, and the 10 km Asparagus Run at 18:00. Timing is electronic, with gun and chip times. Late entries are possible until 30 minutes before the respective start; late-entry fees vary. The course is flat and partly shaded. Prizes are awarded for the top placings. The event also includes children’s races and relay races, with prizes for placings. Registration is available online, and the event is very popular with participants.

name: Turm zu Turm Lauf
price_range: Nachmeldegebühr 2,00 € (bei Nachmeldung vor Ort), sonst keine expliziten Preise genannt
description: The 21st Turm zu Turm Run on 30 May 2026 in Georgsmarienhütte offers runners a varied and scenic experience. The main 24-kilometre route links the prominent viewpoints Hermannsturm and Varusturm and passes through woodland, with around 520 metres of elevation gain. There are also races for children, a fun run, a 10-kilometre scenic run and a walking route. The event is a sporting highlight of the Osnabrück and Westphalia region, with suitable routes for all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: 24 km route with approx. 520 metres of elevation gain between Hermannsturm and Varusturm
10 km scenic run with approx. 252 metres of elevation gain through woodland and parkland
3.4 km fun run with approx. 66 metres of elevation gain through Kasinopark
additional: The Bambini run (400 m) starts at 14:30, the children’s run (1,000 m) at 14:45, the fun run (3.4 km) at 15:10, the scenic run (10 km) at 15:00, and the walking route (6.4 km) starts at approx. 15:12. Certificates for the Bambini and school races are available on site; certificates for longer distances are also available online. The races are part of the ACTIVE-Dreierpack series and the Sparkassen-Cup. Routes: 400 m Bambini, 1,000 m children, 3.3 km fun run, 10 km scenic run, 24 km Turm zu Turm, 6.4 km walking route; registration until 28.05.2026; sustainable event using folding cups; refreshments include water, tea, cola, bananas, coffee, cake and sausages; dogs and baby joggers are not allowed.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – edycja wiosenna 2026
location: Ogrod Botaniczny Uniwersytetu Zielonogórskiego, Zielona Góra, Lubuskie, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Zielona Góra – Spring Edition 2026 is a cross-country race held in the picturesque Botanical Garden of the University of Zielona Góra. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka race series, which has promoted running and the beauty of natural trails in Wielkopolska and other regions since 2014. The course in Zielona Góra consists of two loops, allowing participants to enjoy the natural surroundings and a challenging yet appealing terrain profile. The organizers are running enthusiasts who emphasize the aesthetics and character of cross-country courses.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the Botanical Garden of the University of Zielona Góra
Two laps with a total course distance of 5 km
Picturesque natural surroundings
additional: The course consists of two loops. The race takes place in the Botanical Garden of the University of Zielona Góra. The organizers are a group of running enthusiasts who have organized cross-country races since 2014, with an emphasis on the aesthetic appeal of the courses. The event takes place amid beautiful natural surroundings, and details and registration are available on the event’s Facebook page.

name: 8 Borowiacka Dycha
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race held in the picturesque surroundings of the Tuchola Forests. The event attracts runners who enjoy being close to nature and taking part in a sporting competition on a moderately challenging course. The organizers, Stowarzyszenie Biegające Śliwice, ensure professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere for participants. The race is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich, underscoring its importance in the local running calendar.
course_highlights: The course passes through the picturesque Tuchola Forests
A 10 km distance with a moderate level of difficulty
Part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich
additional: The race is organized by Stowarzyszenie Biegające Śliwice, which promotes an active lifestyle and running. The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich series. A contact form and race updates are available on the website. The event also includes races for children, who receive medals and sweets. Registration is open, and participants can look forward to sporting competition and a good time.

name: Bieg Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema
description: Bieg Tropem Kaszubskiego Stolema is a 10 km road race taking place on 30 May 2026 in Żelkowo, in Kashubia. It is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for the race with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers encourage participants to use the training plans and expert support to prepare optimally for the race. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl race calendar, a platform supporting runners across Poland.
course_highlights: A 10 km road course
Scenic Kashubia as the race setting
Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to VDOT level
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, with instructions and expert support. Organizers can manage the race listing and explore marketing collaboration. The platform also offers a runner’s zone with tools for tracking progress and following training plans. Registration for the race opened on 10 April 2026, and the event is part of local initiatives promoting physical activity and Kashubian culture.

name: XI Bieg Memoriałowy
description: The 11th Adam Lewandowski Memorial Run in Orchowo is an annual running event organized by the Orchowo Municipality. The race commemorates Adam Lewandowski and attracts runners from various age categories. The event takes place in Orchowo and is an opportunity for sporting competition and for bringing the local community together. The organizers warmly invite all running enthusiasts to take part.
course_highlights: A 10 km race through the scenic surroundings of Orchowo
Online registration makes it easy to take part
Organized by the Orchowo Municipality, promoting sport and community integration
additional: The event is part of local sports initiatives, encourages physical activity, and commemorates runners who have made a significant contribution.

name: XI Bieg Pamięci Grupy Kampinos Żołnierzy...
description: The 11th Kampinos Group Home Army Soldiers Memorial Run is a race commemorating the soldiers of the Kampinos Group of the Home Army. The event takes place in Leszno, with the start and finish of the main race and the children’s races on the track at the Sports and Recreation Complex. The main race is 11 km long and is held in a historic commemorative atmosphere.
course_highlights: 11 km course
Start and finish on the track at the Sports and Recreation Complex in Leszno
Race commemorating the soldiers of the Kampinos Group of the Home Army
additional: The event is a memorial, with the option to take part in accompanying races; training plans are available.

name: XV Kwidzyński Bieg Papiernika
organizer: MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. oraz Fundacja Opiekuńcza MM Kwidzyn
description: The 15th Kwidzyn Paper Run is an annual running event founded in 2010 out of a passion for running and promoting physical activity for health and enjoyment. The 10 km race runs through the centre of Kwidzyn and brings together the local community and runners from across Poland. The event accompanies Paper Maker’s Day, a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees, and participation in the race and other attractions is free of charge. The organisers are MM Kwidzyn sp. z o.o. and the MM Kwidzyn Care Foundation.
course_highlights: A 10 km route through the centre of Kwidzyn
Two checkpoints and two water stations along the route
Safety and comfort provided throughout the route
additional: The event accompanies Paper Maker’s Day—a celebration for MM Kwidzyn employees—with a range of all-day attractions. The schedule includes the opening of the race office, a group warm-up, the main race, the awards ceremony and a children’s race. Participation in all attractions is free of charge. Photos and video footage will be taken during the race for promotional purposes. The event takes place on 30 May 2026, with online registration available. It runs all day and offers attractions for participants and their families.

name: Elsterlauf
organizer: SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda e.V. und Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Elsterlauf in Bad Liebenwerda is a traditional running and walking event, taking place for the 46th time on May 31, 2026. The event offers a variety of distances, including a marathon, half marathon, several walking and hiking routes, and children’s races. The course runs through the spa town of Bad Liebenwerda, with a family-friendly atmosphere and classifications for individual participants, teams, and companies. All participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate, and awards are presented by age group. The event is organised by SG Medizin Bad Liebenwerda and Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
course_highlights: A variety of distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km, 5.7 km, 2 km, walking, and hiking
Start and finish at Roßmarkt in Bad Liebenwerda, near the primary school centre with changing rooms and showers
Guided 11 km hike and family-friendly races such as the Bambini and taster runs
additional: Late registration is available on May 30, 2026, from 12:00 to 15:00, and on May 31, 2026, from 07:00 to 09:30. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Bad Liebenwerda primary school centre; baggage storage is available from 7:00 to 14:00. The finish closes for all distances at 13:15. There is a company and club classification, with teams of three participants. Cyclists and hikers start without timing or classification. All participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate. Results will be published online. Running event with online registration and various categories for runners, walkers, and families, including award ceremonies and finisher’s medals.

name: Urwaldlauf
description: The Urwaldlauf is a six-hour race in which participants can run as many laps as they like on a 1.85 km course through the forest near Saarbrücken within six hours. The start time is flexible from 10 a.m., and participants can enter individually or as part of a team. The course combines wide forest paths with idyllic singletrack trails and offers a challenging 46 metres of elevation gain per lap. The event places great emphasis on flexibility and fun, with an electronic lap counter and refreshments at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus.
course_highlights: 1.85 km lap through the forest near Saarbrücken
46 metres of elevation gain per lap; more than 1,000 metres over marathon distance
A mix of wide forest paths and idyllic singletrack trails
additional: Bib pickup is available on site from 9 a.m. Flexible start time from 10 a.m.; the finish closes at 4 p.m. Electronic lap counter and refreshment station at the Urwaldscheune Neuhaus. The field is limited to 350 participants. Late registration is possible online or on site; the late-registration fee is payable on site. Team classification available; make sure the team name is spelled consistently. Six-hour race, 1.85 km lap, approximately 46 metres of elevation gain per lap, forest paths and singletrack trails, flexible start time from 10 a.m., finish at 4 p.m., online registration until the Friday before the event, participant limit of 350.

name: ADAC-Tine-Flugplatzlauf
description: The ADAC Tine Airfield Run in Husum is a unique running event held on an actual airfield. The event is for the whole family and offers a special atmosphere for runners of all ages. Experience sporting ambition and a sense of community in the beautiful surroundings of Husum on the North Sea.
course_highlights: Run on an actual airfield
Family-friendly event
Beautiful North Sea surroundings in Husum
additional: Run on the Husum airfield, distances from 500 m to 10 km, family and children’s races, charitable support

name: 10K Hamburg - Elbe
description: The 10K Hamburg - Elbe is an exciting 10-kilometer race held at attractive spots in Hamburg, the city on the Elbe. The course follows fully closed and secured out-and-back routes on paved and asphalt paths. The race is open to runners of all ability levels and is officially measured in accordance with international competition regulations. The event is part of a cup competition comprising several 10K Hamburg races, with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Fully closed and secured out-and-back routes
Paved and asphalt paths
Attractive running spots along the Elbe
additional: A bag drop for personal belongings is available on race day. Due to limited parking, travel by public transport is strongly recommended. Official results and personalized certificates are available to download online immediately after the event. Multiple start locations (Elbe, Volkspark, Rotherbaum), online registration only, start at 9:00 a.m., medals for finishers

name: 16. Campuslauf Technische Universität Braunschweig
location: Campus of Technische Universität Braunschweig, Braunschweig, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 16th Campus Run of Technische Universität Braunschweig takes place on 31 May 2026 on the university campus. The run gives students and staff the opportunity to get active and spend time together on the university grounds. The event is part of the university sports program and promotes a sense of community and participants’ health.
course_highlights: Run across the grounds of the TU Braunschweig campus
Event as part of TU Braunschweig’s university sports program
Opportunity for students and staff to get active
additional: The event is part of TU Braunschweig’s university sports program. Some sports facilities are closed during the Pentecost holidays. A tax change taking effect in the 2026 summer semester introduces VAT on certain services. Run on 31.05.2026; registration online and on site; live results during the run

name: 32. Tangerlauf
description: The 32nd Tanger Run in Tangerhütte is a traditional race through the Tangerniederung, organised by SV Germania Tangerhütte. The course follows the River Tanger through the scenic Altmark countryside, which is especially beautiful in spring. The race has a long history dating back to the GDR era and was revived after German reunification. The organisers wish all participants good weather and an enjoyable race.
course_highlights: Course along the River Tanger
Race through the Altmark countryside
Traditional race with a history dating back to the GDR era
additional: The race takes place in spring, and the course runs through the Altmark countryside. The event has a long history dating back to the GDR era.

name: 4. Eilenriedelauf
location: VfR 06 Döhren, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 4th Eilenriedelauf takes place on May 31, 2026, in Hanover and is organized by Hannover Runners e.V. This community race runs through the southern Eilenriede and welcomes runners of all ability levels. The event is part of the Laufpass series and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments at the finish area. Volunteers are very welcome and are invited to a sociable post-race get-together.
course_highlights: Community race through the southern Eilenriede
Run in Hanover’s green lung
Family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments at the finish
additional: After the race, all volunteers are invited to a sociable get-together in the rugby club’s beer garden. Cake donations for the finish-area refreshments are requested and should be dropped off by 10 a.m. on race day. Registration by May 28. Start at the entrance to VfR 06 Döhren. Events include a 5 km run, 5 km walk, and 10 km run, with chip timing.

name: 40. Göttinger Frühjahrs-Volkslauf
location: Jahnstadion Göttingen, Göttingen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 40th Göttingen Sparkassen Volkslauf takes place on May 31, 2026, at Jahnstadion Göttingen and offers a varied programme of races for runners of all abilities. The event combines tradition and community, inviting both experienced runners and recreational joggers to enjoy an active day of fun and exercise. The distances are 2 km, 5.4 km and 10.8 km; unfortunately, the half marathon will not take place this year. The event focuses on health, wellbeing and community in the region.
course_highlights: Distances: 2 km, 5.4 km and 10.8 km
Start and finish at Göttingen’s Jahnstadion
The courses are not officially measured; details are available on the website
additional: No registration is required for the Bambini Run; race numbers can be collected free of charge on the day of the event. Registration on the day is not possible. The entry fee includes the organisation fee and a mineral drink. There are individual rankings and a special award for the most active school, as well as rankings in the S-Running-Cup, SüdNiedersachsen-Cup and Gö-Challenge. Race distances: 2 km, 5.4 km and 10.8 km; event at Jahnstadion; online registration; the half marathon is cancelled due to road closures; medical support and parking are available.

name: 5. Urwaldsteig-Ultratrail
location: Parkplatz Schloss Waldeck, Waldeck, Hessen, Germany
description: The Urwaldsteig Ultratrail is a challenging ultratrail run of approximately 66 km with about 2,000 metres of elevation gain around Lake Edersee. Starting in Waldeck, the route runs counterclockwise through varied natural landscapes, including dense forests, narrow trails, the Kahle Haardt nature reserve and Kellerwald-Edersee National Park. Runners can expect impressive views of the lake, historic sites such as Hünselburg and varied trail sections offering a rich nature experience. The start and finish are at the Schloss Waldeck car park. The race starts at 8 a.m.
course_highlights: Circular route of approximately 66 km with about 2,000 metres of elevation gain
Trail running on narrow paths through Kellerwald-Edersee National Park
Impressive views of Lake Edersee and historic sites such as Hünselburg
additional: Refreshment point at approximately km 32.2, after the bridge near Herzhausen. Day parking fee at the Schloss Waldeck start location: at least €5; please have the exact amount or pay digitally. The run follows the original Urwaldsteig route as marked; the GPX track is for general guidance only. Approximately 66 km, approximately 2,000 metres of elevation gain, trail terrain, refreshments at km 32.2, no showers or toilets, GPS recommended, participant limit of 30, start at 8 a.m. at the Schloss Waldeck car park.

name: 9. Hellmich Parkhauslauf
location: Parkhaus Lehrte, Lehrte, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The HELLMICH Parking Garage Run in Lehrte is a unique running event held in the Lehrte parking garage. Participants run a loop of approximately 1 km through the garage, with the inclines and views of the city making for a special running experience. There are three different races with varying numbers of laps, suitable for both children and adults. To ensure safety, each race is limited to 50 participants, and every finisher receives a medal as a keepsake.
course_highlights: Laps through the parking garage, approximately 1 km per lap
Start on the lowest level of the parking garage; finish opposite the start
Inclines and views from the top parking deck
additional: A maximum of 50 participants per race for safety reasons. Race packets can be collected on race day from 09:15 to 12:00 at the stand near the start. The awards ceremony takes place at 12:30 on the stage in front of the parking garage. The winners receive Lehrte Thalers as prizes. Maximum 50 participants per race; start and finish in the Lehrte parking garage; races begin at 10:15; awards ceremony at 12:30.

name: Eilenriedelauf Hannover
description: The Eilenriedelauf is a fun run through the southern Eilenriede in Hanover, organized by Hannover Runners. The event takes place on 31 May 2026 and offers runners of all abilities the opportunity to run amid Hanover’s beautiful natural surroundings. It is part of the Laufpass series and focuses on community and the enjoyment of sport. After the run, participants can enjoy a sociable atmosphere with refreshments and cake in the finish area.
course_highlights: Fun run through the southern Eilenriede
Run in Hanover’s green oasis
Part of the Laufpass series
additional: After the run, volunteers gather in the rugby club’s beer garden for a sociable get-together with food and drinks. Donations of cake for the finish-line refreshments are welcome and should be dropped off by 10 a.m. on the day of the event. Volunteers can sign up using a form or get in touch by email. Participation is part of the Hannover Region Laufpass program, which includes collecting stamps and earning rewards. Online registration is available. Refreshments are provided at km 3, 5, 7, 10 and at the finish.

description: The Erfurtshausen Run is a traditional running event in Amöneburg-Erfurtshausen that welcomes runners of all ages. It offers various races, including Bambini, children’s, fun run and main races, as well as walking/Nordic walking. The course is marked, every kilometre is indicated, and refreshment stations are set up along the route. At the finish, the organiser provides food and drink for participants. Times are recorded electronically, with stopwatches as a backup, and certificates can be issued on request.
course_highlights: Marked course with kilometre markers
Refreshment stations along the route
Changing rooms and showers available on site and at the sports clubhouse
additional: The Bambini run starts at 11:30 a.m. and the children’s run at 11:45 a.m. Registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start. Participants are insured through the Sports Federation of Hesse. Photos will be taken during the event and published on the website; participants may object. Changing rooms and showers are available on site and at the sports clubhouse. The course is marked, refreshments are available along the route, changing rooms and showers are available on site, and registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start.

name: Göttinger Frühjahrs-Volkslauf
location: Göttinger Jahnstadion, Göttingen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 40th Göttingen Sparkassen Volkslauf takes place on 31 May 2026 at Göttingen’s Jahnstadion and offers a varied program of races for runners of all abilities. Combining tradition and community, the event welcomes both experienced runners and recreational joggers to an active day of fun and exercise. The courses are almost flat, paved and partly asphalted, and follow a circuit through the region. Alongside the main races, there are also children’s and Bambini races, as well as walking routes suitable for all age groups.
course_highlights: Almost flat, paved and partly asphalted circuit courses
Distances: 2 km, 5.4 km and 10.8 km (2 laps)
A variety of race categories for all age groups and ability levels
additional: No registration is required for the Bambini race; race numbers can be collected free of charge on the day of the event. Late entries on the day are not possible. The entry fee includes an organizational contribution and a mineral drink. There are individual rankings in the respective races, with no age-group awards. The event is part of the SüdNiedersachsen-Cup and the Gö-Challenge. Race distances: 2 km, 5.4 km, 10.8 km; event at Göttingen’s Jahnstadion; the half marathon is not being held in 2026; participation is open to runners with or without club membership; entry fee includes a mineral drink; medical support is available; held in all weather conditions.

description: The TSV Bollensen Hiking Marathon warmly invites all fans of recreational sport to enjoy a pleasant hike through the beautiful Solling Vogler forest area. The routes are loop courses starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports clubhouse and run exclusively along forest trails. The region was awarded the “Wanderbares Deutschland” Quality Region designation in 2022. Refreshment stations along the routes, plus food and drinks at the finish, will keep you fueled. The event offers a friendly, family atmosphere and a relaxed get-together after the hike.
course_highlights: Forest trails through the Solling Vogler forest area
Loop courses starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports clubhouse
“Wanderbares Deutschland” Quality Region since 2022

name: 13. Bieg 10km Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10K is one of the most important 10 km running events in Wielkopolska, held since 2012. It attracts leading Polish athletes as well as runners from abroad, creating a unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and energy. The course is interesting and varied, with forest sections and a route through the streets of Swarzędz. The event also includes a Family Run and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, adding further excitement to the running festival.
course_highlights: A dynamic course profile with forest sections
An appealing route through the streets of Swarzędz
A new version of the course, highly praised by participants
additional: The event will include the 6th Family Run, open to participants of all ages, and a start for athletes using active wheelchairs. A unique commemorative T-shirt will be available for purchase. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns for its fifth edition at the festival. The event features various age categories, the option to purchase a commemorative T-shirt, and a wide range of activities and support for participants.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon is a special running event taking place on 31 May 2026 in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops with a total distance of 21.097 km, taking runners on a scenic route around Lake Swarzędzkie. The race combines sporting excitement with professional organisation, a unique atmosphere and enthusiastic support from spectators, creating an unforgettable celebration of running. The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival also features a 10 km race and a Family Run, making the event appealing to different age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: A scenic, dynamic route around Lake Swarzędzkie
Two loops with a total distance of 21.097 km
Some sections of the course are shaded, providing comfort during the race
additional: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival features three races: the Half Marathon, the 10 km race and the Family Run. Participants can purchase a special commemorative T-shirt. The event combines sporting, educational and charitable elements. The organiser provides professional organisation, safety, and special medals and prizes. The race atmosphere is boosted by enthusiastic spectator support and extensive media coverage. A route around Lake Swarzędzkie; educational and charitable elements; the option to purchase a commemorative T-shirt; an event held as part of the Swarzędz Running Festival.

name: Marceliński Bieg Wiosenny 2026
description: Marceliński Spring Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic appeal of the locations. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Wielkopolska, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
The aesthetic appeal of the selected locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: Authorization form template for collecting a race pack. The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The event will take place on May 31, 2026, at 10:00. Registration details are not provided, and the route covers the Marceliński Forest area.

The race offers a fast 5-kilometre distance, ideal for runners looking for a dynamic challenge. The event is organised for running enthusiasts who want to test their speed on a scenic course.
course_highlights: 5 km distance – a fast road race
Scenic course around Kupienin
First edition of the event
additional: 5 km races, first edition, locally organised

organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dopiewie
description: The Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki is the event’s anniversary 15th edition, traditionally held on the last Sunday of May. The main 10 km race follows forest tracks surrounded by greenery, offering pleasant conditions for running on soft surfaces. Nordic walking enthusiasts can take on a 7.5 km route, while the youngest participants can compete over shorter distances of 200 to 1,000 metres. The start and finish are located at the edge of the Palędzie–Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. The event is family-friendly and inclusive, promoting physical activity among residents of Dopiewo Municipality.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race on forest tracks surrounded by greenery
7.5 km Nordic walking route
Children’s races over distances of 200 to 1,000 metres
additional: Children’s races start at 10:15, the main race at 12:00, and the Nordic walking event at 12:02. The race office and race-pack collection are available in the days before the event at the GOSiR Dopiewo sports hall, and on race day on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. Individual and team classifications include categories for people with disabilities and residents of Dopiewo Municipality and LINEA Developer housing estates. Teams must be mixed (women/men). Distances: 10 km, 7.5 km, children’s races; start location: at the edge of the Palędzie–Zakrzewo forest, on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka; date: 31 May 2026; registration is now open.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Szpot
description: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival is a special running event taking place on May 31, 2026. The festival features three races: the 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon, the 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10K, and the 6th Szpot Swarzędz Family Run. The half-marathon course follows two loops around picturesque Lake Swarzędzkie, while the 10K offers a dynamic profile with forest sections and streets. The event brings together sport, education, and charity. Participants can enjoy a food zone, partner expo, post-race meal, massages, and a charity auction. The festival is open to everyone, including athletes using active wheelchairs and seniors over 70, who can take part free of charge.
course_highlights: Half-marathon course: two loops around Lake Swarzędzkie
10K course: a dynamic profile with forest sections and streets in Swarzędz
The event features three races, as well as a food zone and expo
additional: Participants aged 70 and over receive a free race package for the 10K and half marathon. Limited-edition commemorative shirts for runners and families are available to purchase. Athletes using active wheelchairs will make their debut in the 10K. After the race, there will be a post-race meal, stretching and massages at the finish, and a charity auction. The event area includes the surroundings of Lake Swarzędzkie. Discounts are available for families and veterans, and new accessibility amenities are provided.

The event offers a 10 km and a 5 km run, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking event, with open, age-group and local-resident classifications. The start and finish are on Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street, by Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn. The organizer plans a prize draw for participants, and the race office is open for several hours before the start.

Open, age-group and Kostrzyn municipality resident classifications

Mini Kurdeszowa Za(Dyszka) features children’s races from 100 m to 800 m, depending on age category, with commemorative medals for all participants. The event also includes training sessions and prize draws, and is part of the local sporting attractions.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
location: Stadion 'Arena Mistrzów', Gniewino, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
