description: The ZVO Energie-Straßen-Lauf Rund um Ratekau takes place for the 36th time on June 7, 2026, offering runners distances of 2 km, 5 km, 10 km and 15 km, as well as a 400 m Bambini run. The courses are officially measured and suitable for record attempts, with the start and finish at the TSV Ratekau sports field. There are races for all ability levels, including a schoolchildren’s cup that runs throughout the calendar year. The event places great emphasis on safety, with road closures, and provides refreshments along the course and in the finish area.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses suitable for record attempts over 2, 5, 10 and 15 km
Start and finish at the TSV Ratekau sports field
Separate classifications according to DLO age-group categories, with awards presented on stage
additional: Late entries are possible online and on site from June 1 for a fee of €3. Race bibs can be collected on June 6 from 17:00–19:00 and on June 7 from 8:00–10:00. Timing is provided by an integrated transponder attached to the race bib. There are two water stations along the course and refreshments at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available. Roads along the course are closed to traffic to ensure safety. Course through Ratekau, safety measures including road closures, schoolchildren’s cup throughout 2026, measured courses, family-friendly

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
location: Kazimierz Biskupi, Gniezno County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Run Under the Millennial Oaks is a unique sporting event held in picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of Bieniszew Forest. The race brings together sport, history, and the beauty of the local landscape, taking participants along an avenue of millennial oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, beginners, and families alike, with races over various distances and a Nordic walking event. It is organized by the Aktywny Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Municipality of Kazimierz Biskupi, and the race tradition dates back to the beginning of the 21st century.
course_highlights: The course follows a picturesque avenue of millennial oaks in the Pustelnik Nature Reserve
The race takes place in the heart of Bieniszew Forest, offering a chance to connect with nature
Running courses of 10 km and 5 km are available, along with a 5 km Nordic walking event
additional: Race-day check-in and race bib distribution take place the day before the race (June 6, 2026) from 17:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 8:30 to 12:15. The 10 km main race starts at 13:00; the 5 km accompanying race and 5 km Nordic walking event start at 13:10. The time limit for completing the race is 14:40. The winners’ awards ceremony and event closing take place after the race at 14:45. Participant limits: 250 for the main race, 150 for the accompanying race, and 100 for Nordic walking. The event was revived for the first time in 2007, with online registration available. Participants can look forward to attractive prizes and certificates.

name: X Festiwal Biegów Polski Północnej i Akt...
location: Wdzydze Kiszewskie, Gmina Kartuzy, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 10th Festival of Running and Physical Activity of Northern Poland in Wdzydze is a milestone edition of an event promoting running and physical activity in the scenic Kashubian region. It takes place from 5–7 June 2026, with its base at the sports field on Leśna Street in Wdzydze Kiszewskie. The festival brings together the running community of Northern Poland, promotes a healthy lifestyle, and showcases local culture and nature. The programme includes races over various distances, Nordic walking events, and cycling rallies.
course_highlights: Running routes of 1.6 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and 21 km
Scenic Kashubian landscapes and the forests of the Kościerzyna Forest District
Promotion of the “Kashubian Sea” and nearby natural attractions
additional: The race office is open during the festival. The event base is at the sports field on Leśna Street in Wdzydze Kiszewskie. The programme also includes Nordic walking events and cycling rallies. This milestone edition brings together the running community of Northern Poland. The event features various forms of physical activity, including running, walking, and cycling, promoting a healthy lifestyle in the Kashubian region.

name: XIII Maraton i Półmaraton Fundacji DASZR...
description: The 13th DASZRADE Foundation Marathon and Half Marathon, named after Barbara Karaczyńska, is a small-scale running event held in Opalenie and organized by the Daszrade Foundation in cooperation with the “Zapowiednik” Addiction Treatment Centre. The marathon course is entirely paved and runs through the scenic fields and forests of Kociewie. It is certified by the Polish Athletics Association and features numerous fairly steep climbs, with a total elevation gain of 646 m. The race takes place on a June morning and offers unforgettable views and a unique atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy a recovery meal, and everyone who finishes receives a commemorative medal, diploma and T-shirt.
course_highlights: Paved route through the fields and forests of Kociewie
646 m of total elevation gain, with numerous steep climbs
Course marked every 1 km, with aid stations every 5 km and on-course refreshment points
additional: Aid stations every 5 km, plus on-course refreshment points. A recovery meal is served after the race. Participants receive a commemorative medal, diploma and T-shirt. The 10 km “Olka” route partially overlaps with the half-marathon, is on a firm surface and runs through the forest. Paved route, 646 m of elevation gain, aid stations every 5 km, commemorative medals and T-shirts, 10 km “OLKA” route.

name: Eiberrun
description: The Eiberrun is a friendly and sporty running event in Eibergen, taking place on Sunday 6 June 2027. Participants can choose from several distances, including 5 km, 10 km, a corporate run, kids’ runs and a spectacular Urban Fun Run for young people. The event starts and finishes at the welcoming De Brink sports square, which is transformed into a lively venue especially for the occasion. The routes pass through the village and the Mallum countryside, with challenging and enjoyable courses for all ages and abilities.
course_highlights: The 10 km distance covers the 5 km loop through the village and Mallum countryside twice
Start and finish at the welcoming De Brink sports square
Urban Fun Run route through shops and over obstacles in the village
additional: Race numbers with timing chips will be ready for collection at the registration desk on De Brink. They can be collected on Saturday 5 June (time to be confirmed) and on Sunday 6 June from 09:00 until half an hour before the start. For registrations received before 12:00 on 31 May, the participant’s name will appear on the race number. Late registration is available on race day from 09:00 at a higher price. Prize ceremonies will take place at around 12:00 and 13:00. ASV Eibergen also offers clinics and training sessions to help participants prepare. Registration for the event on 6 June 2027 is open, with clinics and volunteer opportunities also available. The event starts and finishes at De Brink sports square, where participants can also enjoy the friendly atmosphere.

name: 37. Campuslauf Technische Universität Clausthal
location: Technische Universität Clausthal, Clausthal-Zellerfeld, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 37th Campus Run at Clausthal University of Technology takes place on June 9, 2026, and offers runners a sporting challenge on the campus grounds. The event includes various race distances, including one lap and three laps, as well as a children’s run. The race is a popular university sports event that welcomes students, staff, and guests. Alongside the sporting competition, there is also a Campus Open Air, creating a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Race routes on the campus grounds of Clausthal University of Technology
Course map for races of 1 lap and 3 laps
Separate course map for the children’s run
additional: Registration is through Clausthal University of Technology’s university sports system and requires an RZ account or one-time registration. The event also invites volunteers to get involved. A Campus Open Air takes place alongside the race and offers additional leisure activities. Course map, children’s run, team start, childcare during the event, registration by June 4, 2026

name: Gallaberget Trailrun
location: Gallabergsskogen, Vretstorp, Kumla Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Vretstorps IF Löpning organizes Gallaberget Trailrun in Gallabergsskogen, with running around Gallabergssjön. The event is an evening race suited to recreational runners and local runners, and is part of the club’s summer calendar. Information and registration are presented on the club’s page on laget.se, and the organizers warmly welcome participants to forest trails and running close to nature.
course_highlights: Forest trails around Gallabergssjön
Evening race (start 18:00)
Natural trail and forest terrain in Gallabergsskogen
additional: Organizer: Vretstorps IF Löpning. Location listed in the calendar: Gallabergssjön / Gallabergsskogen. The calendar event appears on laget.se, and the page offers instructions for subscribing via iCal, Google Calendar and Outlook. News posts on the page include prompts such as “Click to register,” but no direct registration link was found on the pages crawled.

name: Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The 19th MittSommerNachtsLauf on June 10, 2026, is an event for everyone, with a steady pace of approx. 6 min/km for runners or 6 km/h for walkers. The start is at 7 p.m. in the village center of Marklohe, and the finish is at the heated outdoor pool in Wietzen, where the swimming pool will remain open until 10 p.m. and the support association will provide refreshments. The running route is up to 18 km, with additional entry points at 13, 10 and 5 km; walking routes are up to 10 km or 5 km. The event promises a sporting evening in beautiful surroundings and is open to everyone who enjoys running or walking.
course_highlights: Start in the village center of Marklohe
Finish at the heated outdoor pool in Wietzen, with the swimming pool open until 10 p.m.
Running routes up to 18 km, with entry points at 13, 10 and 5 km
additional: The run follows a steady pace of approx. 6 min/km. After the event, the swimming pool at the outdoor pool in Wietzen will remain open until 10 p.m. The support association will provide refreshments. Walking routes are available up to 10 km or 5 km. Registration is open until June 3, 2026, by email or telephone through Gerlinde Vogel. Registration is open until June 3, 2026; participation is open to runners and walkers, with the start in Marklohe and the surrounding area.

name: 42. Bugasee-Marathon
description: The 42nd Bugasee Marathon takes place on June 11, 2026, in Kassel and is organized by Laufwerk Kassel under the direction of Sylke Kuhn. The course is 42.3 km long and follows flat, paved park paths around Bugasee in the Fuldaaue. The marathon consists of an opening section of 1.7 km followed by 10 laps of 4.06 km each. The event is designed as a birthday marathon and offers a personal atmosphere with no organizational fee, as this is covered by the birthday celebrant.
course_highlights: Flat course on paved park paths
Loop course with 10 laps of 4.06 km each around Bugasee
Start and finish in front of the information sign between Restaurant Strandbar and parking lot P1
additional: Participants time themselves; bring your own refreshments. Showers and changing rooms are not available. Certificates are sent by email as PDFs. Medals are available for registrations by 28.05. Minimum age: 18. Results are scored according to DLO. Participant limit applies. The race takes place with at least three participants. The marathon is part of a series of running events in Kassel; specific details about registration and the course route have not been published.

name: 41. AZ-Abendvolkslauf

price_tiers.distance: 5,0 km, 10,0 km, Walking, NordicWalking (Schüler und Jugendliche unter 18)

description: The 41st AZ Evening Fun Run takes place on June 12, 2026, in Uelzen and offers a varied programme for runners of all ages. There is something for everyone, from short taster runs for children to the main 5 km and 10 km races, as well as walking, Nordic walking and recreational hiking. The route passes through Uelzen’s historic city centre and along the Ilmenau meadows, among other places. The event is well established and supported by dedicated volunteers and numerous regional sponsors.
course_highlights: The route passes through Uelzen’s historic city centre
The 10 km circuit is run twice
Sections along the Ilmenau meadows and across the Katzenbuckel Bridge
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until approximately one hour before each event; the late entry fee is €3.00 (except for the taster run and hiking). All children’s and schoolchildren’s races up to 2.0 km award medals at the finish. Certificates can be printed online after the event. All events start on Albertstraße in front of the turning circle. Race routes, registration, sponsors, volunteers, virtual runs, parking, start on Albertstraße, registration deadline: June 9, 2026

name: Citylauf Grevenbroich
description: The Citylauf Grevenbroich is a family-friendly running event featuring nine different races for sports enthusiasts of all ages. The event offers ideal courses, great entertainment and top-notch organization, supported by the entire city. Alongside the sporting competition, there is an attractive entertainment program and coveted prizes for the top finishers. The races range from short Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to open and city championship races over 5 km and 10 km.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 700 m to 10 km
City championship race in the Sparkassen-Lauf over 10 km
Family-friendly event with nine races and a great entertainment program
additional: Nine races with start times from 17:30 to 20:40, including Bambini, schoolchildren’s and relay races. Certificates for all participants, plus medals and prizes for the top finishers. Timing provided by TAF-Timing. The event is a major city event with plenty of support and an entertainment program. Multiple race distances, online registration, chip timing, results since 2015, anniversary event in 2026

name: Holstenköstenlauf
organizer: SVT Neumünster in Kooperation mit BMS Die Laufgesellschaft mbH
price_range: 10 km Lauf: 23,00 Euro bis 26,00 Euro, 5 km Lauf: 13,00 Euro bis 16,00 Euro, Holstenkösten-Becher: 12,00 Euro
description: The Holstenköstenlauf in Neumünster is a traditional city race held as part of Schleswig-Holstein’s largest city festival, the Holstenköste. The event offers races for all ages, from Bambini to adults, and runs through various parts of Neumünster. The 10 km course is officially measured in accordance with DLV rules and promises an attractive route through the city centre, Tungendorf and Brachenfeld. All finishers receive a coveted festival medal as a memento of the event.
course_highlights: Attractive course through the city centre, Tungendorf and Brachenfeld
10 km course officially measured in accordance with DLV rules
Start and finish at Kleinflecken, with the same start and finish line
additional: Race-pack collection on 10 and 11 June 2026; timing by transponder (timing fee €3.00, waived if you have your own BMS chip); race number is non-transferable and must be worn on the front of your sportswear; Holstenkösten cup can be pre-ordered (€12.00) and collected at race-pack collection. Participation is available for various age groups; registration online or on site; race-number collection in the foyer of the Stadthalle; refreshments on the course and at the finish; award ceremonies in the evening.

name: Oesterweger Feuerwehrlauf
description: The Oesterweg Fun Run and Firefighters’ Race in Versmold offers a varied running program for all ages and ability levels on June 12, 2026. From short, free Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to an officially measured 10 km road race and a 6 km team and firefighters’ race, there is something for everyone. The flat, paved courses run through the town center, with spectators providing plenty of encouragement. Walkers can also enjoy a scenic 6 km route through the countryside at the same time.
course_highlights: Flat, paved courses through the center of Oesterweg
10 km loop with four identical laps plus an introductory lap
6 km laps for the team and firefighters’ race and walking
additional: The Bambini race (450 m) and schoolchildren’s race (1.2 km) have no entry fee. The schoolchildren’s race is for participants up to age 11 in the standings; the fun run is for those up to age 15. The team and firefighters’ race consists of teams of four participants each. Walkers start at the same time as the firefighters’ race from the back to avoid disrupting the runners. Various race distances, online registration, race brochures available to download, special categories for firefighters and teams, results on TimeTeamJung

name: Schwerter Ruhrstadtlauf
description: The Schwerter Ruhrstadtlauf takes place on June 12, 2026, at the GWG-Schwerte-Arena and welcomes numerous runners in its tried-and-tested format. The afternoon is dedicated to younger participants, with shorter distances, while the longer races are the main attraction in the evening. Particularly popular are the relay races for Bambini and youth, as well as the Nordic walking event along the scenic Ruhr Valley Cycle Route. The 10 km course is measured according to DLV criteria and follows a loop over paved and surfaced paths through a wooded area, finishing in the stadium.
course_highlights: 10 km course measured according to DLV criteria
Loop over the paved Ruhr Valley Cycle Route and surfaced forest paths
Finish in the stadium at the GWG Schwerte Arena
additional: Race pack collection and late registration on June 11, 2026, from 6 to 7 p.m. at the race office. Late registration is possible up to 60 minutes before the start of the respective category for a fee of €3 (free for Bambini). The entry fee includes timing via a disposable transponder, a personalized certificate, shower facilities at the VfB Westhofen clubhouse, baggage storage without liability, water stations for the 5 km and 10 km races, and drinks in the finish area. The event takes place in all weather conditions. The event offers a variety of running opportunities for all age groups and supports community sport. Registration is via the official website, and the event takes place on a Friday in June.

name: Voxtruper Volkslauf
description: The 13th Voxtruper Volkslauf on June 12, 2026, in Osnabrück offers a varied range of races for all ages and ability levels. The event includes distances from 0.4 km for Bambinis up to the 9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain. The races follow a very scenic route, with several refreshment stations to look after participants. Late entries are possible on the day of the event, and the event prioritises a safe, smooth experience; dogs and baby joggers are not allowed.
course_highlights: Very scenic race with a range of distances
9.8 km main race with 182 metres of elevation gain
Several refreshment stations depending on the distance (up to four for 9.8 km)
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event until 45 minutes before the respective race. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. Certificates can be printed online, and results are available at www.laufen-os.de. Refreshment stations: 1 at 3.9 km, 2 at 5.5 km, 4 at 9.8 km. Participants can register on site; dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. The routes are designed to be scenic.

description: The 14th Garbsen City Run on June 12, 2026, is Garbsen’s largest sporting event and offers races for all ages and ability levels. There are six different races, from a 500-meter parent-and-child race to the 10,000-meter Agon Tax Run. The courses pass through Rathausplatz and the IGS grounds, as well as along Meyenfelder Straße and by Lake Berenbostel. The event is family-friendly and emphasizes fun and community, supported by a dedicated organizing team and numerous volunteers.
course_highlights: Course around Rathausplatz and through the IGS grounds
Races along Meyenfelder Straße and by Lake Berenbostel
Distances ranging from 500 m to 10,000 m for all age groups
additional: Race-bib pickup is on 11.06.2026 from 17:00 to 20:00 at Garbsener Sport-Club 67 e.V. and on race day from 14:30 in the town hall. Changing rooms and showers are located at the IGS. There will be an awards ceremony for timed races, with medals for all participants. Certificates can be printed on site for a fee or free of charge afterward. Late registration on race day is possible for an additional fee of €3. Several race categories held throughout the evening offer a wide range of opportunities for recreational runners and families.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2026 Lauf 1: 36. Donoper Volkslauf
description: The Lippe Summer Series 2026 is a three-part running event taking place from 12 to 26 June 2026 in the Schieder-Schwalenberg region. The first race, the 36th Donoper Volkslauf, is organised by SC Donop 1948 e.V. and features a varied 7,777-metre course around the Donop sports field in Blomberg-Donop. The series combines sporting challenge with nature and community, and is open to runners, walkers and hikers.
course_highlights: A varied 7,777-metre course
Start and finish at the Donop sports field in Blomberg-Donop
Part of a three-race series through the region’s most beautiful landscapes
additional: The Lippe Summer Series comprises three races on three consecutive Fridays. Walking and hiking are also possible alongside the popular race. The event is supported by KOLIBRI Förderverein für offene Kinder- und Jugendarbeit Schwalenberg e.V. It takes place on roads and off-road, with temperatures around 23°C in June. It is a sociable run for the whole family.

name: Derentaler Löwenlauf
description: The Derentaler Löwenlauf is a traditional race in the Weser Uplands, designed as a sporting family festival for all age groups. The event offers various distances that lead through the beautiful Derentaler countryside and the Steinbach Valley. A particular focus is placed on embracing diversity, tolerance and working together, supported by a donation to the “augen auf!” foundation for each participant. The race is organised with great care by the Weserbergland Runners Derental and promises an unforgettable day for children, young people, adults and seniors.
course_highlights: 3 km students’ race for ages 8 and up
6 km loop through the Derentaler countryside
12.7 km course including the Steinbach Valley
additional: One euro per participant is donated to the “augen auf!” foundation. The race is designed as a family festival, with various distances for all age groups. Multiple distances (300 m, 10 km), no official timing, special route due to construction work, fundraising campaign for the “Augen auf!” foundation.

name: Kleinbahn-Lauf
description: The Kleinbahn Run in Rhauderfehn is a fun run with no timing, welcoming runners and walkers on 5- and 10-kilometre routes. There are also children’s races for kindergarten and primary school children, enthusiastically supported by parents and grandparents. The 10 km loop starts at the market square and follows the Hauptfehn Canal, through the villages of Holtermoor and Rhaude, and along the Ostfriesland Hiking Trail back to the finish. The 5 km route also starts at the market square and follows the Ostfriesland Hiking Trail back to the finish. The run is a great opportunity to experience the region on varied routes.
course_highlights: 10 km loop along the Hauptfehn Canal and Ostfriesland Hiking Trail
5 km loop with a section through Rhaudermoor and along the Ostfriesland Hiking Trail
Children’s races for kindergarten and primary school children
additional: The event is a fun run with no timing. Training plans are available for different performance goals. The event is open to runners and walkers alike. The run takes place in June, with typical temperatures around 23°C. Bus transport is available from Rhauderfehn to Ihrhove, and showers and changing rooms are provided on site. Competitions are also offered for children and young people.

name: Loop door Houten
description: Loop door Houten is an atmospheric running event held annually in the centre of Houten. It offers a range of distances, from the Kidsrun and Jeugdloop for primary school children to the 5 and 10 kilometres, the SAMSAMLOOP for pairs, and a team race for teams of four runners. The course passes through Oude Dorp and Castellum, with the finish at Het Plein, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and enthusiastic participants. Volunteers play an important role in the event’s success, which is also a celebration of running and having fun together.
course_highlights: Kidsrun and Jeugdloop through Oude Dorp, with several passes over Het Plein
5 and 10 km course with water stations in Castellum and a pass over Het Plein
Team race in which four runners finish together after relay handovers at various points
additional: Race numbers can be collected on the day of the event from 16:00 to 19:15 in the hall of Roskam in Oude Dorp. Digital late registration is available until 18:00 on the day of the event, as long as the maximum number of participants has not been reached. Pre-registration opens on 15 March. The schedule includes a warm-up for the Kidsrun/Jeugdloop and a walking event at 17:45, with the walks starting at 18:00, the Kidsrun at 18:10, the Jeugdloop at 18:25, the SAMSAMLOOP at 19:10, and the 5 km, 10 km and Team Race at 19:40. Awards are presented in various categories after the event. Training opportunities and course familiarisation sessions are offered beforehand. The organisers ask participants to prepare properly, including by following advice on running in high temperatures. Distances range from the Kidsrun (1 km) to 10 km, including the Jeugdloop and SAMSAMLOOP. Registration is open and volunteers are wanted. The event takes place in Houten.

name: Alpaca Race
location: Hisingsparken, Göteborg, Västra Götalands län, Sweden
description: The Alpaca Race is a challenging trail race in Hisingparken, Gothenburg, run over laps on a technical course. The race offers four distance options (1, 3, 5 or 10 laps), with substantial elevation gain, and is intended as preparation for tough mountain races such as UTMB. The race takes place on 13–14 June 2026, with night running for the longest distances and a medal for everyone who finishes. The event is organized by IF Kville, with the gathering point and aid station at Tuve ice rink/IF Kville’s clubhouse.
course_highlights: Technical trail course in the Hisingparken/Tuve area
Lap format: choose 1, 3, 5 or 10 laps (10 laps = 106 km, +6000 metres of elevation gain)
Course designed to match UTMB’s elevation gain per kilometre (a tough elevation profile)
additional: Start and time schedule: 10 laps start Saturday at 19:00 (24 hours, 20 places); 5 laps start Sunday at 07:00 (12 hours, 50 places); 3 laps start at 10:00 (8 hours, 50 places); and 1 lap has starts around 11:00/15:00 (1–3 hours, 100 places). Check-in and place assignment take place before the start. The aid station/start is at IF Kville’s clubhouse by Tuve ice rink, with toilets and the option to change and shower. Food: barbecue and the option to bring your own food; energy drinks and evening staffing are available. A course preview run is announced separately, with its own timing for those who wish to take part. Preview run before the race (date may vary); night-running period 19:00–07:00; 24 hours/20 places; barbecue/bring your own food at base camp.

name: Öland Ultra Trail
location: Böda Sand, Böda, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Öland Ultra Trail is a nature-focused trail race in northern Öland, with 50 km and 25 km distances for both men and women. The course runs through classic Öland woodland and coastal landscapes, passing places including Byrums raukar, Neptuni åkrar and Trollskogen. The 50 km race starts at Böda Sand and the 25 km race starts in Byxelkrok, with both distances finishing at Böda Sand. Participants who register by 6 June receive a T-shirt.
course_highlights: Byrums raukar (coastal area of rauks, or limestone sea stacks)
Neptuni åkrar (coastal meadow landscape with views)
Trollskogen (distinctive pine forest in northern Öland)
additional: Location: Sport Camp, Böda Sand (northern Öland). Date: 13 June 2026; 50 km starts at 09:00 at Böda Sand, and 25 km starts at 10:00 in Byxelkrok; both distances finish at Böda Sand. All finishers receive a medal. To receive a T-shirt, register by 6 June and provide your shirt size (men’s/women’s). Bib collection: Friday 12 June, 19:00–20:00, and on race day, 13 June, 07:30–09:00 (the last opportunity for on-site registration). On-site registration payment: cash, card or Swish. Contact/organiser: Högby IF. Both distances finish at Böda Sand; start times are 09:00 for 50 km and 10:00 for 25 km. Registration by 6 June 2026 for advance entries and until 11 June for late entries; advance registration includes a T-shirt.

name: Tjejmilen Sälen by EQPE
description: Tjejmilen Sälen is a summer race in a mountain setting, with 5 km and 10 km distances. In 2026, it will take place in Lindvallen, Sälen, on 13 June. The course offers varied terrain, including mountain trails, technical sections and open views—an experience for both first-time 10 km runners and experienced runners. The race is aimed at women and combines the natural surroundings with a sense of community. Timing is available and can be opted out of when registering.
course_highlights: Mountain trails and technical sections in a spectacular mountain setting
Moorland and views of Mellanfjället and Hemfjället
A narrow mountain trail climbing Hemfjället, with several mountain tarns
additional: Distances: 5 km and 10 km. Timing is available (optional). Age limits: 10 km from age 15 (or 13 when accompanied by an adult); 5 km from age 13 (or 11 when accompanied by an adult). Late registration is possible, subject to availability, until 2 hours before the first start and must be completed online via the regular registration page. Bus travel from Stockholm to Sälen can be booked. Payment options: online banking, Visa/Mastercard, Swish or invoice via Klarna. Water stations are located along the course. The distances are 5 km and 10 km; start groups; late registration until 2 hours before the first start; bus travel Stockholm–Sälen; payment options include bank transfer, card, Swish and Klarna; refunds only according to the insurance terms.

name: Flosjön-Edstjärn
description: Flosjön–Edstjärn is a half marathon organised by Edstjärns IK in the Flosjön/Edstjärn area. The race is part of the club’s annual events and is aimed at recreational runners and local club members. The course route and results from previous years, including split times, are published on the club’s website. The organiser directs enquiries and contact requests to the club’s email address.
course_highlights: Approximately 21 km of trail running between Flosjön and Edstjärn in Dalarna (Gagnef).
The course is approximately 80% off-road, with around 350 metres of elevation gain.
Organised by Edstjärns IK under the names Walk of Pain and Halvmaran, with an archive of results available.
additional: The course route for Flosjön–Edstjärn is published on the page “Course route for Flosjön–Edstjärn”. Results from previous races, including split times, are published on the website. The organiser is Edstjärns IK, a non-profit sports club open to everyone; contact: hej@eik.one. The Walk of Pain title is mentioned; results pages are available for Flosjön–Edstjärn; the 2020 edition was cancelled; results are available for the 2024 edition.

name: Ljungskileslingan
location: Ljungskile centrum, Ljungskile, Västra Götalands län, Sweden
description: LjungskileSlingan is a family-friendly running event with distances ranging from 300 metres for the youngest runners up to 10 km. The start and finish are in central Ljungskile, and the course passes through central Ljungskile and Lyckorna, partly along Ljungskile Bay and the seafront promenade. The scenic courses are only gently undulating, and the event offers a large prize pool. It is organised by Ljungskile Friluftsklubb in collaboration with Hälle IF and is held alongside LjungskileDagen and the Lions flea market.
course_highlights: Start and finish in central Ljungskile
The course follows Ljungskile Bay and the seafront promenade towards Lyckorna; scenic and gently undulating
Distances: children’s race 300 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km and 10 km; large prize pool
additional: The event is a community celebration held alongside LjungskileDagen and the Lions flea market, with a funfair, music and activities. There is a large prize pool: the top three in each category receive prizes, and other prizes are drawn among those who finish. The race has been held since 1994, and since 2015 Ljungskile Friluftsklubb and Hälle IF have shared the organising duties. The invitation page states that registration is open (see the invitation for more information). A children’s race for the youngest runners has been included since 2018. LjungskileSlingan is also connected to LjungskileDagen and has a history of varying distances and organisers before Hälle IF took over in 2024. In 2026, the 10 km returns with a new route.

name: Öllsjö Löpfest 2026
description: A warm welcome to Öllsjö Löpfest on 13 June 2026! After two previous editions, we’re back with a family-friendly running festival featuring several different races for all ages and levels. The event offers chip timing, a team competition and an activity area with music and family activities. Participant numbers are limited to maintain a cosy, family atmosphere.
course_highlights: Children’s races: 450 m and 1,700 m
Distance race: 5 km
7.5 km trail mix (with trail sections on the course)
additional: Automatic chip timing and a team competition are offered. A service fee of 12.50 kr is mentioned for registrations. The event area is open 10:00–14:00. Late registration from 8–12 June costs 225:-, and registration on the day, 13 June, costs 250:-. Music and activities for the whole family; participant numbers are limited. The fun run is promoted as inclusive for everyone, but the text does not specify registration details or distances. Webscorer mentions a manual wave start that may affect the start schedule.

name: 55. Bartenwetzer Volkslauf
description: The Bartenwetzer Volkslauf is the oldest people’s race in North Hesse and takes place on 30 May 2026 at Waldstadion Melsungen. The event includes children’s and schoolchildren’s races over 400 m and 1,000 m, as well as races over 5 km, 10 km and 19 km on firm paths through Melsungen city forest. As the 10th scoring race in the Nordhessencup, it offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, award ceremonies and a buffet. The start and finish areas are centrally located at Waldstadion, which also has changing facilities.
course_highlights: Races on firm paths through the beautiful Melsungen city forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Melsungen, on the edge of the city forest
Distances: 5 km, 10 km and 19 km, as well as children’s races on the track
additional: Race-pack collection from 14:30 at the MT clubhouse in Waldstadion. Same-day entries are not possible. Changing rooms are available at the MT clubhouse. Refreshments include water on the longer courses, hot tea at the finish, and a buffet with coffee, cake and bratwurst from 15:30. Medical services provided by the German Red Cross. Certificates and medals for the Bambini and 1,000 m races; certificates can be printed on site or accessed online. The event is subject to the applicable regulations for road races and running events held away from a stadium. Register online via RaceResult. The event at Waldstadion Melsungen includes award ceremonies, refreshments and medical support.

name: SV Greven Deichlauf
description: The SV Greven Deichlauf on May 30, 2026, offers an unforgettable running experience along the idyllic Ems dike and through the town forest. The route, surrounded by nature, is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes, and is accompanied by numerous spectators. Around 1,000 runners take part, seeking both a sporting challenge and an experience in nature.
course_highlights: Loop course from Emsaue Stadium along the Ems dike
Route passes through the town forest
Nature-filled running route with many spectators
additional: Running event, loop course, experience in nature, approx. 1,000 participants, official timing, medals for children and age groups

name: Hohenlimburger Lennelauf
description: The 3rd Hohenlimburg Lenne Run takes place on June 13, 2026, around Lennepark in Hohenlimburg. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ages and offers a suitable distance for every age group. It is organized by Elseyer Turnverein 1881 e.V., known for its wide range of sports activities for the whole family. The event promises a sporting, community-oriented atmosphere in a beautiful park setting.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lennepark in Hohenlimburg
Suitable for runners and walkers of all ages
Family-friendly event
additional: The event offers various running and walking distances to suit all age groups. Registration is through Elseyer Turnverein. Telephone inquiries are possible at certain times on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Fridays. The course is on asphalt; spikes are not allowed. Limited start places. Refreshments are available on site. Transponders are used for timekeeping.

name: Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf
location: Kurpark Bad Nenndorf, Bad Nenndorf, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf is a long-standing, DLV-approved public race and part of the Schaumburg Running Series. It takes place in the beautiful Kurpark in Bad Nenndorf and offers distances for different age and ability groups, including 1,000 m, 2,500 m, 5 km, 10 km, and 5 km walking and Nordic walking. The event is family-friendly and attracts many participants, who run on paved paths through the park. In addition to the sporting competition, there is an attractive supporting program and good facilities, including changing rooms and showers.
course_highlights: The course follows paved paths through the Kurpark
Start and finish on Kurpromenade by the Wandelhalle
A range of distances from 1,000 m to 10 km, plus walking options
additional: Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports center, which can be reached by bus shuttle. Insurance coverage is provided through an LSB contract. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Medical support is provided. A maximum of 300 participants in the 1,000 m and 2.5 km races. The 5 km Nordic walking and walking events are timed, with no placings. First race for the Samtgemeinde Cup. Scoring race in the Schaumburg Running Series. The race takes place as part of the State Garden Show, with various distances and a family-friendly atmosphere. Early registration is possible, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: Mut-Lauf
description: The MUT-LAUF Kiel is an annual running event that promotes greater openness and courage in addressing mental illness. Its aim is to take a stand against stigma and raise awareness of mental health. The event celebrates moving together without pressure to perform and is open to everyone, regardless of age, fitness level or physical limitations. Alongside the run, there is a varied program featuring music, interviews, food and drink, and a marketplace with information on mental health and prevention.
course_highlights: A run for everyone, with no pressure to perform, including wheelchair users
Event held at Moorteichwiesen in Kiel
Program featuring music, interviews and a marketplace
additional: Registration is available online via the Davengo portal or in person at KIELER FENSTER, Ambulantes Zentrum. The event takes place every year on the Saturday before Kiel Week begins. The program includes activities for the whole family and a marketplace featuring self-help groups and social services. The MUT-LAUF 2026 takes place on June 13, 2026, with registration via the Davengo portal. Entry fees are €10 for adults and €5 for children. Information about self-help groups and a sociable accompanying program will be provided.

name: Oelder Citylauf
description: The Oelde City Run is a traditional running classic in the heart of Oelde that has delighted runners of all ages for over 45 years. The event offers a varied programme featuring Bambini, schoolchildren’s and inclusive races, as well as 5 km and 10 km road races. The races take place before a large crowd in a festival-like atmosphere and are part of the Volksbank Cup race series. The course is measured to international standards and runs through Oelde city centre, with the start and finish at the Market Square.
course_highlights: An internationally measured 2.5 km lap, repeated as required for each distance
The course runs through Oelde city centre, with the start and finish at the Market Square
A variety of races for all ages, including Bambini and inclusive races
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, subject to a late-entry fee of EUR 3.00. Race packets can be collected at the event centre on the Market Square. Certificates for the schoolchildren’s and Bambini races are available on site; certificates for the other races are available online. Showers are available at the Oelde Comprehensive School sports hall, approximately 300 m from the finish. Registration is via Raceresult; the event is known for its diverse categories and friendly atmosphere.

name: Steinfurter Altstadt - Abendlauf
description: The Steinfurter Altstadt Evening Run is a traditional running event, holding its 38th edition on June 13, 2026. Organised by Turnerbund Burgsteinfurt, the event offers various age groups and race distances through the historic old town of Steinfurt. It is particularly family-friendly and is known for its lively atmosphere and large fields. Young runners receive medals and trophies, making the race a popular event for all ages.
course_highlights: Races through the historic old town of Steinfurt
Age groups from Bambini to masters athletes
A medal and water bottle for every young runner at the finish
additional: Race packs can be collected on the event day from 1 p.m. at the old town hall on the market square. Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Every young runner receives a medal and a water bottle; the first three in each category are awarded trophies. Races for different age groups, on-site registration, medals, trophies, reusable race numbers, entry fee paid by SEPA direct debit, no refunds possible

name: Söltjerlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 3,- € Kinder und Jugendliche bis einschl. Jg. 2007

description: The Söltjerlauf in Bad Münder is a charity run in the beautiful Süntel, where every lap counts. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, from children to marathon runners, and features a shaded forest loop of approx. 3.8 km with a refreshment point. Participants have four hours to run as many laps as possible, with the proceeds going to a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health, and invites participants to stay after the run for catering and the awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Shaded forest loop of approx. 3.8 km
Refreshment point on the course
Atmosphere at the Bergschmiede restaurant, with catering
additional: A shuttle service will be available from 09:30 to get participants to the 11:00 start on time. Online late registration is possible until 12.06.2026, with a late-registration fee of 3 euros. Every participant receives a certificate stating the distance they ran. Prizes will be awarded to the top individual runners and the top 10 teams. Parking is limited, so using the alternative parking areas and bus shuttle is recommended. Dogs are allowed only on a short leash and may not participate as members of a team. Competition open to all age groups; sponsors donate for local projects for every lap completed. Venue at Bergschmiede, supported by local sponsors including Sparkasse Hameln-Weserbergland and Ardagh Group.

name: Volksbank Haren Citylauf
description: The 27th Volksbank Haren City Run takes place on June 13, 2026, and offers an attractive, fast course through the center of Haren. The 5 km and 10 km races are measured by the DLV and eligible for official rankings, making them ideal for competitive athletes and recreational runners. Children and young people can take part in dedicated 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km races. There is also a team competition in the 5 km race, with teams from companies, clubs or other groups eligible to compete.
course_highlights: Attractive, fast course through the center of Haren
The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for official rankings
Dedicated races for children and young people over 400 m, 750 m and 1.5 km
additional: All participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive a finisher shirt. Entry fees are paid by direct debit. The 5 km race has a team competition for teams of at least 3 people. Children attending Haren's daycare centers and schools can take part for free if their institution participates. Large trophies and certificates are awarded in the school competitions. Free entry for children on school and daycare teams, registration until June 7, 2026, prizes for winners and teams, parking nearby

name: Werner Volksbank Stadtlauf 20. Team- / Firmenlauf
description: The 24th Werner Volksbank City Run 20th Team/Company Run takes place on 13 June 2026 in Werne. This running event offers the opportunity to get active with colleagues or friends and strengthen team spirit. The event includes two distances, 1 km and 10 km, and is aimed especially at teams and companies that want to run together.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km and 10 km
Start location in Werne
Typical June weather, with an average of 23 °C and mostly sunny days
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event promotes physical activity and team spirit, with registration via Raceresult. The weather in June is expected to be warm and sunny, at around 23°C.

name: Enni Donkenlauf
description: The ENNI Donkenlauf on 13 June 2026 in Neukirchen-Vluyn offers a varied range of running events for all age groups and ability levels. The courses are mostly flat and run along paved, low-traffic farm tracks and side roads, making them ideal for fast times. In addition to races, there are also non-competitive runs and walking events open to everyone. The event is family-friendly and includes special rankings for schools and youth groups.
course_highlights: Flat, mostly paved, low-traffic farm tracks and side roads
Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses
Minis-Run and Donki@school on the sports centre’s synthetic track
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 11:30 a.m. in Building “G”. The Minis-Run and Donki@school take place on the sports centre’s synthetic track. Dogs, baby joggers and cycling escorts are not permitted for safety reasons. Parking is limited, so travelling by bicycle or public transport is recommended. Smoking is prohibited throughout the school grounds, and dogs are not allowed on the sports grounds. Various distances (500 m to 10 km); registration is possible on site or online; some events do not have age-group rankings.

name: Gellershäuser Abendlauf
location: Sportplatz in Gellershausen, Edertal, Hesse, Germany
organizer: Turn und Sportverein Hessen 1848 Frankenberg Eder e.V.
description: The Gellershausen Evening Run takes place at the sports ground in Gellershausen, Edertal, and offers races for children and school students, as well as a 10-kilometer race and a half marathon. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup and attracts runners of various age groups. The course runs through scenic surroundings and offers a pleasant running atmosphere in June. Information about registration, the course, results, and photos is available.
course_highlights: Half-marathon and 10-kilometer courses starting at Gellershausen Sports Ground
Children’s and school students’ races included
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup
additional: Typical June weather: around 23 °C during the day and 13 °C at night, mostly sunny, with an average of 65 mm of precipitation. Children’s and youth races with distances of around 400 m and 1,000 m; the event promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.

name: 12. Heilwald Marathon
location: Heilwald, Bad Lippspringe, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 12th Heilwald Marathon takes place on June 13, 2026, in Bad Lippspringe. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and runs through the unique Heilwald forest, whose calming low-mountain climate and species-rich woodland offer a special running experience. The event is a privately organized race with self-supported aid. Timing is done by hand, and a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participation is at your own risk, and a voluntary donation toward tree planting is requested.
course_highlights: Six laps of 7.05 km through Bad Lippspringe’s Heilwald forest
Species-rich woodland with a calming low-mountain climate
The course was measured using a measuring wheel and GPS watch
additional: Runners provide their own refreshments, as they pass their cars after each lap. Timing is done with a hand stopwatch; a photo of the clock must be emailed on race day as proof. No showers or changing facilities are available. Participant limit: 18. Minimum age: 18. The organizer accepts no liability. Participation is at your own risk. By registering, participants consent to the creation and use of photos, result lists, and videos. Course: 6 laps of 7.05 km in the Heilwald forest; self-supported; no showers; participation at your own risk; participant limit: 18; registration until 6 p.m. on the day before the race.

name: 13. Himmelswegelauf
description: The 13th Himmelswegelauf on June 13, 2026, takes participants through a unique cultural landscape around Nebra (Unstrut). The race routes connect important archaeological sites such as the Pömmelte Ring Sanctuary, the Goseck solar observatory and the discovery site of the Nebra Sky Disc. The start and finish are at the Arche Nebra visitor center, near the Sky Disc, which is considered the oldest concrete depiction of the cosmos. In addition to the marathon, half marathon and 10 km Sky Disc Run, there are also walking events, cycling tours and hikes to the discovery site. The event is under the patronage of the Minister-President of Saxony-Anhalt and offers an appealing cultural and sporting experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Arche Nebra, near the Nebra Sky Disc
Routes pass the 4,000-year-old Pömmelte Ring Sanctuary
The marathon starts at the 7,000-year-old Goseck solar observatory
additional: Race pack collection and late registration are available on event day, with different times for the marathon, half marathon, Sky Disc Run, walking events and cycling tour. In addition to the running events, the event also offers walking, cycling tours and hikes. The award ceremonies are hosted by Radio SAW presenter Holger Tapper. The event is open to runners, cyclists, walkers and hikers; registration is required. The event is scheduled for June 13, 2026.

name: 14. Glück-Lauf
description: The Glück-Lauf in Salzgitter-Gebhardshagen is a varied running event that appeals to families and experienced runners alike. With distances ranging from 1.2 km for children to a challenging 21.2 km trail half marathon with almost 400 metres of elevation gain, the event has something for everyone. Around 400 participants, including recreational runners, competitive athletes and local club runners, share race day. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organised aid stations along the course.
course_highlights: Trail half marathon of approximately 21.2 km with almost 400 m of elevation gain
1.2 km children’s race, with U8 children taking part
Aid stations and advice to prepare for sunny weather
additional: The event includes a 10.8 km course with a remarkable story of a 64-year-old runner who overtook younger competitors. Participants are encouraged to prepare for the sun with caps, scarves and hydration packs. The event attracts both children and experienced runners and is a local highlight in Gebhardshagen. Distances from 1.2 km to 21.2 km, trail half marathon, family and competitive event, weather in June usually warm and sunny, registration possible online and on site.

name: 15. Fullestrand-Ultramarathon
description: The Fullestrand Ultramarathon takes place on June 13, 2026, in Kassel and offers a challenging 46.5 km course along the Fulda with about 350 metres of elevation gain. The route heads upstream from Kassel, follows the Fuldahöhenweg and returns along the Fuldaradweg, passing through varied landscapes and natural areas. Organized by Laufwerk Kassel under the direction of Sylke Kuhn, the event combines a sporting challenge with the beauty of northern Hesse’s nature and culture.
course_highlights: 46.5 km course along the Fulda with approx. 350 metres of elevation gain
Sections on the Fuldahöhenweg (marked X17) with some elevation gain
Return route on the Fuldaradweg R1 through the Fulda floodplains, Bugaseen and Kassel districts
additional: Meet at 7:58 a.m. at the start. Start and finish are at Auedamm 17 in Kassel, opposite the Pfannkuchenhaus next to the Auebad. Parts of the route follow cycle paths; traffic lights must be used at the Hafenbrücke. The event is organized by Sylke Kuhn, who also oversees other marathon and ultramarathon races in the region. The course includes flat paths and muddy singletrack, is unmarked, has water stations, and has an 8-hour time limit.

description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen is a traditional community race with a variety of events for all age groups. The event takes place at the Sophie-Scholl-Gesamtschule sports grounds and offers varied circuits for everyone from kindergarten children to experienced runners. The longer races follow a slightly modified 2.5 km loop, with the start and finish close to the event area, creating a special atmosphere. Alongside competition, the event emphasizes community spirit, supported by a prize drawing and a dedicated team of volunteers.
course_highlights: Varied circuits on the school grounds for children
Slightly modified 2.5 km loop for longer races, with the start and finish near the event area
Atmospheric course through residential streets, dirt paths and an athletics track
additional: On-site late registration is possible until one hour before the respective start, for an additional fee (€5, including a €2 deposit for a rented race bib). Kindergarten children and primary school pupils run an exciting circuit on the school grounds. The longer races use a 2.5 km loop, completed twice (5 km) or four times (10 km). Entry in the charity run includes automatic entry in the prize drawing. Proceeds from the charity run go to the Bastlergemeinschaft der Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is organized by SG Bredenbeck-Holtensen e.V. It takes place on the grounds of the Sophie-Scholl-Gesamtschule, with various race categories and a focus on community and health. Taking part supports the local community and promotes young athletes.

name: 23. Sudenburg-Lauf - Der Lauf mit dem Lächeln
description: The Sudenburg Run is held under the motto “For runners, by runners” and takes place on June 13, 2026, at Heinrich-Germer-Stadion in Magdeburg. The event is driven by enthusiasm for running and for the Sudenburg district. There are various race distances for children, young people and adults, which run through the city and the stadium. The focus is on encouraging as many people as possible to run and to do so with a smile on their faces.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Heinrich-Germer-Stadion, with a final lap of the stadium
A 2.2-kilometer loop, run twice or five times depending on the distance
The course passes through Salzmannstraße, Walmbergsweg, Braunlager Straße, Halberstädter Straße and Lemsdorfer Weg
additional: Race bibs can be collected on 12.06.2026 from 14:30 to 18:00 at the sport39 sports store (Halberstädter Str. 21), or at Heinrich-Germer-Stadion on race day until 9:00. Late entries are possible from June 8, 2026, through race day, but incur a late-entry fee. The award ceremony for the children’s races is at 10:15, and for the longer races at 11:45. The terms of participation include a liability waiver, fair conduct and an obligation to dispose of waste properly. The races count toward the SRL MD and EOC-Cup. Online registration only; participation in June 2026; part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP Series; the aim is to share the joy of running in the city.

name: DUD Ultra
description: The DUD Ultra 70km is a road ultramarathon in Duderstadt, Germany, held on a short loop around Duderstadt’s town walls. The loop is under 5 km long, with 36 m of elevation gain per lap, so runners complete the same course repeatedly throughout the day. The race has a 12-hour time limit, a participant cap, and an entry fee of 100 euros. The compact course lets spectators see the runners multiple times, while a single aid station serves the entire loop. The DUDultra organizer also offers other distances, including 50 km, 100 km, and a 100 km relay.
course_highlights: Loop under 5 km with 36 m of elevation gain per lap
Compact course with one aid station
Spectators can see runners multiple times along the course
additional: The race has a 12-hour time limit and a participant cap. Other event distances include 50 km, 100 km, and a 100 km relay for four runners. June weather is typically around 23 °C, with a minimum of 13 °C, and is mostly sunny. Run on a loop around Duderstadt’s town walls; limited number of participants; multiple ultramarathon distances at the event.
