description: The Ottermeerlauf in Wiesmoor is a traditional race taking place on June 13, 2026. The event offers a varied course and a motivating atmosphere, and is open to individual runners and relay teams. A particular highlight is the 6-hour ultramarathon, which is part of the Nordcup and is open to runners aged 18 and over. Every finisher receives a custom medal shaped like the outline of the Ottermeer, featuring the mascot Otti.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the “Lüttje Haven” cafeteria in Wiesmoor
Varied course with encouraging cheers from spectators
Custom medal shaped like the outline of the Ottermeer, featuring the mascot Otti
additional: Late entries are possible on the day of the event from 09:00 until one hour before the start. The minimum age is 18 for individual ultramarathon runners and 8 for relay teams. Michis Physiotherapie will offer massages on site in exchange for a donation. Race numbers must be worn visibly on the chest and returned after the race. The number of participants is limited to 400. Participation from age 18, medal with an Ottermeer design, on-site physiotherapy support, supporting program, team and family event.

name: 24h Lauf Halberstadt
price_range: 25 € für den 24h Lauf, andere Laufzeiten variieren
description: The 24-hour run at Friedensstadion Halberstadt takes place on June 12, 2026, at 18:00 and is organized by VfB Germania Halberstadt in cooperation with Freizeit- und Sportzentrum Halberstadt. The aim is to keep runners on the tartan track continuously for the full 24 hours. The event is part of VfB Germania’s club festival, where various sports departments introduce themselves and invite visitors to take part. Alongside the run, traditional activities include pulling a coach on the running track. The event offers a sporting challenge and a social program for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Run continuously for 24 hours on the tartan track at Friedensstadion
Part of VfB Germania’s club festival, featuring a range of sports activities
Traditional coach-pulling on the running track as a special highlight
additional: The run takes place on the tartan track at Friedensstadion. The aim is to keep the track continuously occupied by runners for the full 24 hours. In addition to the run, the club festival offers the opportunity to try various sports, including archery, table tennis, judo, athletics and gymnastics. Various running distances, club festival, Harzer-Lauf-Cup running series, registration by June 4, 2026, results live on site and online

name: Fischland-Darss-Zingst-Ultramarathon (FDZU)
description: The Fischland-Darss-Zingst Ultramarathon (FDZU) is the longest nature-experience run in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and will take place for the 10th time on June 13, 2026. The course runs through the unique Baltic Sea coastal landscape from Rostock to Stralsund and offers runners a special nature experience along the region’s peninsulas and islands. The event is steeped in tradition and has a distinctive atmosphere created by the combination of nature, challenge and community. Registration opens on July 1, 2025, and closes on May 31, 2026.
course_highlights: Scenic diversity along the Baltic Sea coast from Rostock to Stralsund
A nature experience on the Fischland, Darß and Zingst peninsulas
Course sections around the Saaler Bodden and on the islands of Poel and Usedom
additional: The race starts early in the morning at 04:06 amid the glow of blazing fire bowls. The course has been updated and includes location details for all aid stations. Registration is exclusively through the Tollense Timing GmbH portal. Non-cash prizes are awarded to the fastest runners on the king’s distance. Nature-experience run, course distance over 117 km, relay and beach section, sand passages, elevation profile up to 23 m, registration required

name: Harsefelder Lauf- und Musikfestival
organizer: Lauftreff Harsefeld, LSC Harsefeld, Stadtmarketing Harsefeld
description: The 20th Running and Music Festival in Harsefeld takes place on 13 June 2026 and combines sporting challenges with musical entertainment. Runners of all ages can take part in various distances, from children’s and toddler races to short-distance, long-distance and relay races. In the evening, Marktstraße turns into a lively party zone with an open-air disco and live music. The festival is a regular fixture in Harsefeld’s events calendar and, alongside the sporting events, offers a varied children’s programme and food stalls.
course_highlights: Children’s race: approx. 2,000 metres
Short distance: approx. 5,100 metres; long distance: approx. 10,200 metres
Relay: 4 × approx. 2,550 metres
additional: Registration opens on 1 April 2026. Official festival running shirts featuring the logo are available to order. All runners receive an anniversary gift when they collect their race numbers. Schools and kindergartens can earn cheques, which will be honoured on stage. Open-air disco until 11 p.m. with the 2006 Revival Party. Various race distances, children’s programme, music and party, registration opens on 1 April 2026, festival shirts, sponsors: Friedrich- und Margret Tobaben-Stiftung

name: Himmelgeister Brückenlauf
location: Steinkaul, Himmelgeist, Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Himmelgeister Bridge Run is a traditional half marathon that has been held annually in Düsseldorf-Himmelgeist since 2004. The route follows the Rhine almost to the heart of Düsseldorf and offers a scenic running course. The race starts early in the morning, around 8 a.m., at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist and is known for its family atmosphere and the after-run party in the beer garden at Haus Krevet. The race will be held for the last time in 2026, as the organizing team is stepping down after the anniversary.
course_highlights: Run along the Rhine with views of Düsseldorf
Start at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist
8 refreshment points along the 21.1 km course
additional: Bib pickup on June 12 from 1 p.m. to 7 p.m. and on June 13 from 6:15 a.m. to 7:45 a.m. at the start venue. Timing is by a chest transponder worn behind the bib. Clothes may be left in the beer garden at Haus Krevet at your own risk. After-run party with raffle and awards ceremony from around 10:30 a.m. Separate awards ceremonies for the top women, men, and teams; no age-group awards. Recommended transport: bus route 835 or carpooling. Parking in the Aldi car park is prohibited. Anniversary race, start at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist, final edition in 2026, participation in accordance with DLV regulations, no shower facilities, online results and photos

name: Kalimandscharolauf 2026
description: The 13th Kalimandscharolauf 2026 takes place on 13 June 2026 in Zielitz and is organized by SV Kali Wolmirstedt e.V., Athletics Department. The event is hosted by K+S Minerals and Agriculture GmbH, Zielitz plant. It is a non-stadium event and offers runners an attractive course in the Magdeburg/Börde region. Registration is open until 6 June 2026.
course_highlights: Run over the landscaped Friedrichshall spoil heap with scenic views
Hilly, challenging course for various disciplines
Varied supporting programme, including walking and Nordic walking
additional: The event includes categories such as Magdeburg, Börde and mountain running, with a registration deadline of 6 June 2026. It is part of a sustainable concept that makes use of former industrial sites.

name: Lauf um den Senftenberger See
description: The 49th Run around Lake Senftenberg takes place on June 13, 2026, and offers runners a choice of distances around scenic Lake Senftenberg. The event is open to all ages and ability levels, from the Bambini run to the challenging 17.7 km lake loop. Races start from 09:00 in front of the Seesporthalle Großkoschen, with a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and changing and washing facilities. Registration is online via myRacePartner, with late registration available until race day for a small fee.
course_highlights: 17.7 km loop around Lake Senftenberg
Other distances: 10.0 km, 5.4 km, 3.2 km, and a 200 m Bambini run
Start and finish at the Seesporthalle Großkoschen, with good facilities
additional: Late registration is available online from 12.06.2026 18:00 Uhr until 13.06.2026 09:00 Uhr for a late registration fee of €2.00. Parking guidance and refreshments are free until 13:00 on race day. Changing and washing facilities are available in the start and finish area. Participants take part at their own risk; the organizer accepts no liability. Registration is via myRacePartner; free parking until 13:00; changing and washing facilities available; children’s and family races included.

name: Luckenwalder Turmfestlauf
description: The Luckenwalder Turmfest takes place from 12 to 14 June 2026 around the market tower in Luckenwalde. This traditional city festival is open and accessible to all visitors, regardless of their budget. It offers a varied cultural programme and welcomes guests from near and far to celebrate together. The city is committed to an open festival by the people of Luckenwalde for the people of Luckenwalde and welcomes voluntary donations to support the event.
course_highlights: Various race distances, including the 10 km main race and an 800 m sprint
Part of the large Turmfest, with cultural and family-friendly activities
Children’s and youth races, as well as relay races for all age groups
additional: The Turmfest begins at 12:00 each day. The festival closes at 01:00 on Fridays and Saturdays and at 22:00 on Sundays. There is no standard cultural contribution; instead, voluntary donations are welcome and can be made at the tourist information office. The tourist information office is open during its usual opening hours. The event takes place as part of the Luckenwalder Turmfest, celebrated in Luckenwalde from 12 to 14 June 2026, with music, food, rides and family activities.

name: OSTSEE Run
description: The OSTSEE Run by ROTEC is a sporting highlight of the OSTSEE Sports Games in Cottbus. The run offers an attractive course for runners and walkers and is part of a varied sports and leisure program featuring numerous other competitions and activities. The event is aimed at sports enthusiasts of all ages and, alongside the sporting competition, offers a colorful program of activities and a large OSTSEE Party with free admission. This combination of sport and celebration makes the OSTSEE Run a special experience in the region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at APEX Ostsee-Sportpark Cottbus Willmersdorf
Running and walking course as part of the SPARKASSEN Half Marathon
Varied program of sports and leisure activities
additional: OSTSEE Party with free admission in the evening from 20:00 in the festival tent. Free OSTSEE shuttle service from the main railway station to the sports park. Varied program of activities including children's races, beach tennis, volleyball, archery, and other sports. Start times from 8:45; registration available. Participation in a taster run requires registration by 12.06.26

name: OSTSEE Sparkassen Halbmarathon
description: The SPARKASSEN Half Marathon takes place on June 13, 2026, in Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee. The 21-kilometer course starts at 10:00 from the Möbel Höffner grounds. Race materials can be collected from 7:00 at the start and finish area. The race is open to participants aged 18 and over and offers an attractive route along the Baltic Sea coast. There is no on-site registration; participants must register in advance.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer course along the Baltic Sea coast
Start and finish at the Möbel Höffner grounds
Route through Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee
additional: Race materials available from 7:00 at the start and finish area. No on-site registration. Race materials available from 7:00, no on-site registration, participants must be 18 or over, course distance: 21 km.

name: Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg
description: The Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg is a challenging running event taking place on June 13, 2026, in Altenburg. Participants can choose from a range of distances, including the marathon, two-person marathon relay, half marathon, 13.3 km run, fitness run, student and children’s races, and walking events. The course winds through the historic city of Altenburg, with varied sections including climbs in the city forest and a stretch along the Großer Teich. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event programme offers a wide range of entertainment, including music, a children’s festival, and a talk by running legend Uta Pippig.
course_highlights: Start on Altenburg’s Market Square, with a view of the Rote Spitzen
A 700 m climb through the city forest to the Bismarck Tower, the highest point on the course
Refreshment stations at 5 km and 7.5 km, with cheering and parties at the stations
additional: Race-number collection and late registration on June 12 from 17:00 to 21:00, and on event day from 7:00 until 30 minutes before each start, at the “Goldener Pflug”. Changing rooms, showers, and bag storage are available on site. Extensive event programme featuring a sports expo, talks, live music, a children’s festival, and a large party on event day. The marathon time limit is 6 hours and 30 minutes; Wendegasse closes after 2 hours and 45 minutes for the second lap. Runner refreshments, medical support, cultural programme, professional timing, collectible race numbers, drinks, hot food, showers, event T-shirts (pre-order by 31.03.26), secure luggage storage.

name: Tollenseseelauf
description: The Neubrandenburg Tollensesee Run is a scenic race around Lake Tollensesee that attracts more than 2,000 runners each year. With a variety of distances for all ages, it offers a diverse running festival in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is challenging, with some elevation gain, which is why the race is also nicknamed “The Toughest in the North.” More than 300 volunteers help make the event an unforgettable experience, with certificates, technical T-shirts, and trophies for the top finishers.
course_highlights: Routes around picturesque Lake Tollensesee
Challenging elevation gain on all courses
Family-friendly running festival with a variety of distances
additional: All participants receive a certificate and a technical T-shirt. Trophies are awarded to the top three overall male and female finishers; age-group winners receive prizes and certificates. A bus transfer for relay teams is available and can be requested during registration. Multiple distances, including a marathon relay and children’s races; registration at tollenseseelauf.de; a well-known event in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania

name: Waaker Bystopen-Attacke

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Familienlauf 2,5 km Kinder ab 6 Jahre 15,00 EUR

description: The Waaker Bystopen-Attacke is an obstacle race in Lower Saxony around the Waaker Büsteppe in the Göttingen Forest. The event offers distances of 2.5 km (family run), 5 km and 10 km, with more than 30 natural and artificial obstacles. Participants can enter individually or as part of a team; team scoring requires at least 4 runners. In addition to the main race, there is also a Bambini-Attacke for the youngest participants, with no registration required. The event focuses on fun, team spirit and exercise in nature.
course_highlights: More than 30 natural and artificial obstacles
Route around the 387.2-metre-high Waaker Büsteppe
Water and fruit at refreshment stations along the course
additional: Race packs can be collected from 08:00 at the Waake sports ground. Race numbers are attached to the wrist and also written on the upper arms and lower legs; no more race numbers on the abdomen. There are two refreshment stations along the course and one in the start-finish area. Showers and sanitary facilities are available at Waake primary school after the race. Drinks, grilled food, fries, cake and more are available before, during and after the race. Bags can be left free of charge in a supervised truck. The Bambini-Attacke takes place at the same time on the sports ground and requires no registration. Warm-up before every start. Obstacle race, family run, team and club scoring, online registration, optional T-shirt for a fee

name: Bürgerlauf Visbek
location: Pastors Wisk Visbek Park, Visbek, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 1st Visbek Citizens’ Run takes place on June 13, 2026, in Park Visbek (Pastors Wisk) and offers a varied program for runners of different age groups and ability levels. The event includes Bambini and school races, as well as middle-distance and main races over 5 km and 10 km, complemented by a walking or hiking route. Bib numbers can be collected on the day of the event from 3:00 p.m., and all races are professionally measured. Proceeds will benefit the Visbek Citizens’ Foundation, making this a sporting event with a social commitment.
course_highlights: Races in Park Visbek on a scenic, nature-filled course
Professional timing for all races
Part of the Volksbanken Running Cup in Vechta
additional: Bib numbers can be collected on the day of the event from 3:00 p.m. Late registration and on-site payment may be possible in individual cases. Parking is available near the Catholic parish hall, St. Raphael Kindergarten, the sports and swimming hall, Gerbertschule, and Blumen Ostmann. Refreshments are available on site, including a drinks van, fries, and bratwurst. The event is registered with and insured by the German Athletics Association. Terrain: urban/flat, online registration until 11.06.2026, bib numbers from 3:00 p.m., professional timing, parking nearby, refreshments on site

name: Drebber-Marathon
location: Schulstraße 1, Jacobidrebber, Drebber, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Drebber Run on June 13, 2026, offers a diverse selection of races for all ages and ability levels. The course follows an officially measured 2.34 km loop through the district of Jacobidrebber, with the start and finish at the sports field. In addition to individual and relay races ranging from a children’s run to a marathon, there is an appealing program of activities for spectators and participants. Emergency services personnel are especially invited to take part in the Blue Light Cup as a relay team and showcase their performance.
course_highlights: Officially measured 2.34 km loop through Jacobidrebber
Start and finish at the sports field, with a decorated course
A range of distances from a 500 m children’s run to a marathon
additional: The course will be closed from 13:00. Spectators and participants are asked not to ride bicycles on the course from 14:30. Parking is available at the sports field, and the route there is signposted. Children have their own race program starting at 14:30, with race number distribution at the clubhouse. The event features refreshments and activities for children in the schoolyard. Certificates with photos will be sent out after the race. Winners are honored in various age groups and team categories. Emergency services personnel can enter relay teams in the Blue Light Cup and receive a code for a free entry fee when they register. The start and finish are in front of the school at Schulstraße 1, Drebber. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and involvement of the local community.

name: 4 Skolwińska Mila
description: The 4th Skolwińska Mile is an annual street race held in Szczecin, attracting both adults and children. The event takes place on June 13, 2026, and continues the tradition of previous editions, offering participants the chance to compete over a short distance. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and bring the local community together. The organizers provide an easy way to get in touch via the entry form, as well as administrative support.
course_highlights: A 1-mile (1,609-meter) course in a scenic recreational area
Online registration and timing by Sport-Time
Prizes for the top finishers and medals for everyone who finishes
additional: The event also includes children's races over a distance of approximately 200 meters. Participants can use the entry form available on the website to contact the organizer and system administrator quickly. Participants can use training plans lasting from 8 to 20 weeks. The event is supported by a local building-supply store, and the participant limit is 60.

name: Coconaut Pomerania Summer Trail
description: Pomerania Summer Trail is a running challenge on the hilly trails of Pomerania, offering three distances: 45 km, 25 km, and 10 km. The event takes place in the picturesque area of Czymanowo, right by Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko observation tower, creating a unique trail-running atmosphere. The organizer, the Pomerania Sports Association, together with local sports centers, invites both first-time participants and experienced ultrarunners to take part in this unforgettable event. It’s a great opportunity to take on challenging courses and enjoy the beauty of Kashubian nature.
course_highlights: Hilly Kashubian trails
Courses of 45 km, 25 km, and 10 km
Start and finish by Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko observation tower
additional: Online registration usually closes 7 days before the event, but registration on race day may be possible if places are still available. The organizer provides a great race village at the concert square in Czymanowo, by Lake Żarnowieckie and the Kaszubskie Oko observation tower. The event offers different distances, GPX files to download, and requires specific equipment. The race takes place in a beautiful area with access to tourist attractions in Kashubia and Pomerania.

name: 23 Wilcza Dycha
location: Osieczna, Powiat choszczeński, województwo zachodniopomorskie, Poland
description: Borowiacka Dycha is an annual 10 km race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association. The event promotes an active lifestyle and attracts runners from the region, offering a scenic route through the Tuchola Forests. The race takes place in Osieczna and is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich. Participants can expect professional organization and a welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km route
Scenic terrain in the Tuchola Forests
The race takes place in Osieczna
additional: The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich series, with the chance to win a unique collection as part of the series. Participants can expect competitive racing and attractive prizes.

name: 7 Szamotulska Nocna Piątka
description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual, officially certified 5 km race held in Szamotuły. The course runs through the town’s streets, giving participants the opportunity to compete at a professional level with officially recognized results. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races over shorter distances. The main race starts in the evening, giving the event its distinctive nighttime atmosphere. The organizers look after participants’ comfort by providing refreshments after the race and awards ceremonies for the winners.
course_highlights: Course certified by the Polish Athletics Association
Night race starting at 21:55
Urban course through the streets of Szamotuły
additional: Temporary traffic arrangements will be in place on race day, with parking disruptions and designated detours. Race packs can be collected from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments for participants and awards ceremonies for the winners are planned after the race. There are 26 free race packs available for people with disabilities in the family race, accompanied by a caregiver, upon request by email. The event includes road closures and detours, and offers various distances, including 5 km, 255 m, and 555 m. Participants can find news and information on the website and Facebook.

name: Nocna Piątka

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Pakiet Smyki na Piątkę 35 zł ( numer startowy, chip, medal)

description: Szamotulska Nocna Piątka is an annual road race in Szamotuły, certified by the Polish Athletic Association. The 5 km course runs through the town streets, offering official results and a unique night-race atmosphere. The event is open to everyone, including children and families, who can take part in accompanying races. It attracts considerable interest, and participants can look forward to refreshments and an awards ceremony after the race.
course_highlights: A 5 km course certified by the Polish Athletic Association
A night race starting at 21:55
Route through the streets of Sportowa, Lipowa, Szczęsnego, Kolarska, Wioślarska, Łąkowa, 3 Maja and Staszica
additional: Temporary traffic changes apply on race day, with parking restrictions and designated detours. Race packs are distributed from 17:00 to 21:30. Refreshments and an awards ceremony for the winners are planned after the race. Free race packs are available for people with disabilities taking part in the family race with a guardian. The 5 km race starts at 21:00; the course is marked every 1 km and has a limit of 800 participants. Various categories are available, including family and children’s races, with race packs containing T-shirts and medals. An event schedule and traffic restrictions for the duration of the race are planned.

name: VIII Kwidzyńska zaDyszka
description: The 8th Kwidzyńska zaDyszka is a 10 km road race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Kwidzyn. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is aimed at runners with varying levels of experience who want to stay active and compete on a course of moderate difficulty. The organizers provide expert support and access to a platform for managing race information.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
Scenic surroundings in Kwidzyn
Course of moderate difficulty
additional: Training plans of 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. Expert support and a platform for managing the race profile and marketing collaboration are provided. Registration runs from April 17 to June 8, 2025; participant limit: 200.

name: 200 setny maraton - święto biegania z Ze...
XVI Grand Prix Stargardu Cztery Pory Roku
location: Morzyczyn, Stargard County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Blue Mountain TrailRun
location: First Camp Ånnaboda, Ånnaboda, Örebro County, Sweden
description: Blue Mountain Trail Run is a nature- and technical-trail-focused race held at First Camp Ånnaboda, with four distances (21 km, 15 km, 10 km and 6 km). The courses follow the Bergslagsleden and sections of mountain-bike trails, with lakeside stretches, forest trails and viewpoints such as Sånnabodahöjden. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere and offers services including bib collection, food sales, and nearby showers and changing facilities. The 21 km race has an extra competitive incentive: anyone who breaks the course record will be rewarded with 5,000 SEK.
course_highlights: Hilly, technical forest trails along the Bergslagsleden and mountain-bike trails
Expansive views from Sånnabodahöjden (266 m above sea level) and several forest lakes along the course
Clear course markings, aid stations at key junctions, and approximately 527 m of elevation gain on the 21 km course
additional: Bib numbers must be collected at least 45 minutes before the start; collection opens at 09:00, and on-site late registration is from 09:00 to 09:15. Changing facilities, showers and toilets are available at the red SM cabin, approximately 300 m below First Camp; swimming is possible at Södra Ånnabosjön. Electronic timing uses a timing chip worn on the finger; there are aid stations on the course, and food and refreshments are sold on site. Name and category changes can be made up to and including 9 June 2026 (fee: 150 SEK); a refund protection option is available (17% of the entry fee). First Camp Ånnaboda offers a 15% discount on cabin stays when booked via annaboda@firstcamp.se using the code "TrailRun". A service fee of approximately 10 SEK applies. Registration and bib collection take place 45 minutes before the start; food and drinks are available; changing rooms, showers and toilets are near the red SM cabin by the main parking area; medical kits are available at the start/finish and at water stations. First Camp Ånnaboda offers a 15% discount on cabin rentals with the code TrailRun.

name: Run Malmö
description: RUN MALMÖ is a new city race on 14 June 2026, with two distances: half marathon (21K) and 10K. Both share a start and finish area in Dockan/Varvsstaden. The courses are flat and fast, taking you through four distinct zones—from city vibes and parks to the waterfront and sea breeze in Västra hamnen, with views of Turning Torso. The race is suited both to those chasing a personal best and to those who want to experience Malmö together with the crowds and the joy of running. The organiser is Malmö Allmänna Idrottsförening (MAI).
course_highlights: A flat, fast course through four zones: city, parks, waterfront neighbourhoods and seaside
Passes Turning Torso and a long straight stretch along Ribban and Limhamnsvägen
Surface: mostly asphalt, with sections of paved gravel paths in parks and cobblestones in central areas
additional: Registration opens on 25 November 2025. Runners can also register via Epassi (wellness benefit). Start times: 10K first wave at 10:00 (last at 10:12); 21K first wave at 10:40 (last at 10:56). Time limits: 90 minutes for 10K and 3 hours for 21K. There is a 3.5 km cut-off on the 10K, which runners must pass within 32 minutes of the last wave starting. Services: water stations with water and Umara sports drink, medical assistance, a medal/fruit/drink at the finish, and toilets along the course. Distance changes are possible for an administration fee of 95 kr (and upgrading from 10K to 21K also requires payment of the price difference). Corporate packages are available with a gathering tent and group training. Tent price examples: 25 people 15,000 kr, 50 people 25,000 kr, 75 people 35,000 kr. Distances: 21K and 10K; Epassi wellness benefits are accepted as a payment option.

name: EVL-HalbMarathon Leverkusen
description: The EVL Half Marathon in Leverkusen is a traditional and challenging half marathon, taking place for the 24th time on June 14, 2026. The 21.1-kilometre course runs through the sports city of Leverkusen and features a special highlight: a passage through the BayArena, home ground of Bayer 04 Leverkusen. The hill-climb competition on Sauerberg presents another challenge. The race is open to runners of all ability levels, from beginners to professional runners, and offers a unique running experience with plenty of atmosphere and a sense of community.
course_highlights: The course runs right through the BayArena
Hill-climb competition on Sauerberg
A varied 21.1-kilometre route through Leverkusen
additional: Start and finish on Bismarckstraße, between the Ostermann-Arena and the BayArena. Runners born in 2010 or earlier are eligible for the half marathon, those born in 2016 or earlier for the 10 km race, and those born in 2018 or earlier for the 5 km race. Race bibs are non-transferable and must be worn clearly visible. There are still places available in the Bambini races. The 2026 event shirt is available. The organiser recommends a good training plan, including recovery and nutrition tips from running coach Andrea von Horn. The event takes place in all weather conditions. The course runs through Leverkusen, including the BayArena; registration for the Bambini races; event shirt and merchandise; podcast with tips and stories.

name: Sauerland-Höhenflug-Trailrun
description: The Sauerland-Höhenflug-Trailrun is a popular running event in the Sauerland, taking place on June 14, 2026. The event offers various distances from 0.4 km to a half marathon, running through the varied landscape of the Sauerland-Höhenflug. The trail run is open to runners of all ages and ability levels and is organized by Skiclub Hagen-Wildewiese e.V. in cooperation with Sauerland Tourismus and Naturpark Sauerland-Rothaargebirge. The event is part of the Volksbank-Sauerland-Laufcup and features a special sprint classification over the final 200 meters of the longer distances.
course_highlights: Distances from 0.4 km to a half marathon through the Sauerland
Sprint classification over the final 200 meters for the 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Various age groups and classifications, including races for schoolchildren
additional: The trail run includes several age groups and distances, including a Bambini run, races for schoolchildren, and main races. Timing is provided by Time and Voice using RaceResult. The half-marathon cutoff time is 3:15 hours. The event is part of the 2025 Volksbank-Sauerland-Laufcup. On-site late registration is available for an additional fee of €3. Distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; online registration; nature experience in the Sauerland; annual event in June

name: Barmstedter Stadtlauf
description: The 22nd Barmstedter City Run takes place on 14 June 2026 in Barmstedt. The event features measured, course-record-eligible 5 km and 10 km circuits. In addition to the main races, there are Nordic walking, walking, children’s races and Bambini races. The start and finish are at the Market Square in Barmstedt, and the course runs through the town centre and around Lake Rantzau, over a variety of surfaces including cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths.
course_highlights: Measured, course-record-eligible 5 km and 10 km circuits
Course through Barmstedt town centre and around Lake Rantzau
Varied surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt and firm sandy paths
additional: Timing uses a rental chip worn around the ankle (except in the children’s races); the chip is collected at the finish. Unreturned chips will be charged at 40 euros. Baby joggers and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. Different age categories and minimum ages apply to the races. The course may vary slightly due to construction work; information will then be posted on the website. Courses are measured; online registration is available; no late entries; refreshments and medals included.

name: Donatus-Lauf
location: Sportgelände SC Fortuna Liblar, Hamburg-Rissen, Hamburg, Germany
description: The Donatuslauf takes place on June 14, 2026, around Lake Donatus at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds in Hamburg-Rissen. The event offers various race distances, from a 400 m Bambini run and 1,200 m children’s races to a half marathon and a 10 km main race. The races are designed for different age groups and offer a family-friendly atmosphere, with additional walking and family races. The course is varied and well marked, with the start and finish area close to Erftstadt railway station. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races, and certificates can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400 m to the half marathon
Start and finish area near Erftstadt railway station, with easy access
Family run and Nordic walking as additional options
additional: Late entries are accepted only until the participant limit is reached and incur a €3 late-entry fee. Award ceremonies take place at the sports grounds immediately after each race. Parking is available only at Erftstadt railway station, just 100 m from the start and finish area. Certificates can be downloaded online as PDFs and printed. Courses around Lake Donatus; online registration; parking at Erftstadt railway station; start and finish area at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds.

name: Kirschlauf
description: The Kirschlauf in Kleinfahner, organised by USV Erfurt, is a long-standing race with a history spanning more than 20 years. The 24th edition takes place on 14 June 2026, taking runners along scenic routes with challenging highland trails. The event offers several distances, including a 14-kilometre main race, a 4.5-kilometre fun run, and races for schoolchildren and younger children. The awards ceremony is traditionally conducted by the Thuringian Cherry Queen, and the race is part of the TLV Running Cup.
course_highlights: 14-kilometre main race featuring a scenic highland trail and views across the northern Thuringian Basin
4.5 km fun run with challenging terrain in the Imtal valley
Finish through a cherry orchard above Kleinfahner, with a magnificent view
additional: Race-pack collection from 8:00 a.m. at the event tent by the mill. Late registration is available online from 2:00 a.m. on 13 June and on race day until 30 minutes before the race, with a €5 late-entry fee. Awards ceremonies take place from approximately 9:45 a.m. for the schoolchildren’s races and from approximately 11:30 a.m. for the other races. Registration until 9 June 2026; late registration is available. The route includes a highland trail and finishes in Kleinfahner. Children’s races and Nordic walking are also offered.

name: Handewitter Sommerlauf
description: The Handewitter Summer Run on June 14, 2026, offers a varied running event for the whole region, with courses for every ability level. From the Bambini race to 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, Nordic walking, relay, half marathon and wheelchair race, there is something for everyone. The event takes place around the Wikinghalle in Handewitt and stands out for its excellent organisation, lively atmosphere and unforgettable finish-line experience. The courses, measured by the DLV, are flat with few metres of elevation, making them ideal for beginners and experienced runners alike.
course_highlights: Flat courses with few metres of elevation
Start and finish at the Wikinghalle in Handewitt
A variety of distances, from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon
additional: Participants who register before the deadline receive a personalised race bib, event T-shirt and medal. Groups can register together using an Excel list. The event relies on volunteer helpers, who assist with directions, organisation and refreshments. The participant list is updated automatically and can be viewed online. Measured courses, online registration, support from on-site helpers, a variety of running events, family-friendly, community atmosphere.

name: Volkslauf Isernhagen
price_range: Adults 12,00 EUR, Kinder und Jugendliche 8,00 EUR, optional T-Shirt 15 EUR
description: The 25th Volkslauf Isernhagen takes place on 14 June 2026 and offers runners of all ages and ability levels a welcoming, traditional running event. Choose from four distances: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km and the classic 10 km race, which is measured by the NLV and counts toward the Laufpass. Timing is provided professionally using the runtiming system. All participants can look forward to a clearly marked course, a great atmosphere and a varied supporting programme. The entry fee includes a T-shirt and medal for children and young people; adults can purchase a T-shirt as an optional extra.
course_highlights: Four distances: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km and 10 km
The 10 km course is measured by the NLV and counts toward the Laufpass
Professional timing using the runtiming system
additional: Late entries on the event day are not possible. Registration is online via the RUNTIMING portal. All participants receive a refreshment at the finish. The entry fee includes a T-shirt and medal for children and young people; adults can purchase a T-shirt optionally for €15.00. The event takes place whatever the weather. Participation is at your own risk. Trophies and prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each distance and category, and cash prizes go to the fastest team. Multiple race distances, team competition, online registration via RUNTIMING, no late entries on the event day, medals and T-shirts for participants

name: Drei-Länder-Lauf
description: The Three-Country Run takes place on June 14, 2026, in Arenshausen and connects the regions of Thuringia, Lower Saxony, and Hesse. The event offers several race distances, including 1.2 km, 2 km, 5 km, and 13 km, with a mix of loop courses and out-and-back routes. In addition to the main races, there is a fun run for preschool children with no timing, as well as Nordic walking as a non-competitive event. The run has a long tradition as a symbol of the region growing together after German reunification.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Arenshausen sports field
Loop courses for the 1.2 km, 2 km, and 13 km races
5 km race is an out-and-back route with a lap of the stadium
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the starts, with a late-entry surcharge of 2.00 EUR, except for the children's races. Changing and shower facilities are available in the sports building. Parking is available directly at the Arenshausen sports field. Nordic walking (approx. 8 km) starts at approx. 14:00 with no rankings and no entry fee. The 400 m fun run is for preschool children, with no timing or placings. There is no entry fee for the main race. Online registration is open from 01.05. to 11.06.2026. Parking and changing and shower facilities in the sports building are available.

name: Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf
location: Sportplatz Schackensleben, Schackensleben, Börde, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The Schackensleben Hopfenlauf is a long-standing running event in Schackensleben, about 25 km west of Magdeburg in the Börde district. All races start and finish at the sports field. Distances include 400 m for children, 1.4 km for young people, and 6.0 km and 10.8 km for adults. The longer routes pass through the village and the surrounding countryside, with the gently rolling profile typical of the Börde region, along roads and paved farm tracks. Refreshments include drinks, coffee, cake, and grilled food. After the finish, there is a raffle with attractive prizes. The Hopfenlauf is part of the Novo Nordisk Landescup and the Elbe-Ohre-Cup.
course_highlights: Routes through the village and nearby area, with the gently rolling profile typical of the Börde region
Roads and paved farm tracks, with several drink stations
Start and finish at the sports field, with good changing and shower facilities
additional: The 0.4 km and 1.4 km races take place on the running track and in the immediate vicinity. After finishing, participants receive drinks and fruit for refreshment. The clubhouse at the sports field offers a generous selection of coffee, cake, lard sandwiches, drinks, and grilled food. A raffle with attractive prizes traditionally takes place alongside the awards ceremony. Multiple distances, online registration, changing rooms, showers, refreshments, and a raffle. Supports the German athletics system through official timekeeping.

name: REWE Women´s Run Hamburg
description: The REWE Women’s Run Hamburg is a road race for beginners and ambitious runners in the Elbe metropolis of Hamburg. The event offers a measured 10 km loop course, starting and finishing at Ballindamm. Alongside the main race, there is also the REWE Girl’s Run, a 1-kilometre race for girls aged 5 to 10. Participants receive a finisher’s medal and can use the showers and changing facilities after the race.
course_highlights: Measured 10 km loop course according to IWB and AIMS
Start and finish at Ballindamm in Hamburg
1 km Girl’s Run for girls aged 5 to 10
additional: Showers and changing facilities are available after the race at Gerhart-Hauptmann-Platz. A bag drop is available for personal belongings. The race number includes a disposable timing chip and must be attached visibly to the running shirt. Photos can be purchased from a photography partner after the race. The event also includes a 1 km Girls’ Run for girls aged 5 to 10, starting at 11:30. Changing facilities, showers and refreshments are available on site.

name: NEW-Citylauf
description: The 25th NEW-City Run in Erkelenz on June 14, 2026, is a popular running event that takes runners of all ability levels through the city centre. The event offers a sporting, community-focused atmosphere that appeals to both beginners and ambitious athletes. With a varied course and an electrifying atmosphere, the NEW-City Run is a highlight of the regional events calendar. Taking part is an invitation to enjoy the joy of running together with family and friends.
course_highlights: Course through Erkelenz city centre
Varied running course
Sporting atmosphere and shared experience
additional: The event takes place on Sunday, June 14, 2026. Registration and further information are available at www.new.de/laufserie. The organiser is the City of Erkelenz; contact is available through City Marketing. Run in the city centre, anniversary event, for all ability levels

name: Sparkassenlauf
location: Hessisch Lichtenau, Landkreis Kassel, Hessen, Germany
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a long-standing running event with DLV-certified courses over 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon. The races run through Wittringer Forest and offer a flat, fast loop course on paved walking paths, asphalt and a tartan track. All participants receive a personalized race bib with their name and a finisher’s medal. The event also hosts the district road-running championships and offers net times and live timing.
course_highlights: Flat, fast loop course through Wittringer Forest on paved walking paths and asphalt
Start and finish at the stadium on Bohmertstraße, with the finish on the tartan track
Two refreshment stations along the course, with additional stations if needed
additional: Personalized race bibs with first names for all participants. Net times and live timing are provided. The course is DLV-certified and eligible for rankings through 2027. Official bike escorts and marshals help ensure the runners move safely through the course. The Fun Walk cutoff time is 10:15. The race is part of the district championships and offers medals, shirts and a festive atmosphere, including live results and personal support.

name: Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund
description: Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund is a traditional running event held annually in Kappeln in the Schleswig-Flensburg district. The event gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to run on a varied course through the town and its surroundings. The race is organized by TSV Kappeln and is a popular event for sports enthusiasts from the region. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with a well-organized program and helpful support.
course_highlights: The course runs through the town of Kappeln and the surrounding countryside
Varied terrain with urban and natural sections
Well-marked course with support along the way
additional: The event is organized by TSV Kappeln, which also offers other sports activities and training times for various sports. A participant list, results, and a live list for following the race are available. Further details about the schedule, course, timing, and awards are available on the website. The event includes running and Nordic walking competitions; results are usually available shortly after the finish, and activities are offered for children and young people.

name: Alfelder Bernd Meyer Staffelmarathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Freizeit-, Vereins- und Schulteams beträgt 70 € (10 € pro Starter)

description: The Alfeld Bernd Meyer Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay marathon taking place on June 14, 2026, in Alfeld (Leine). The event is open to runners from across the region and is jointly organized by several local running clubs and the City of Alfeld. The course is an approximately 3 km loop, run twice, with the start and finish on the market square. Each team consists of 7 runners, who must be registered by name. Timing is electronic, using single-use transponders. There is also a children’s run of approximately 700 m.
course_highlights: Approximately 3 km loop, to be completed twice
Start and finish on the market square in front of the citizens’ office
Route through the town center and parks, with a varied course
additional: Each relay team consists of 7 people, who must be registered by name and run in the order specified on the day of the event. Bib numbers are personalized and equipped with single-use transponders for electronic timing. Participants may keep their bib numbers as souvenirs. A maximum of 80 teams may take part. The children’s run starts at 10:30 a.m. for girls and 10:45 a.m. for boys, over approximately 700 m. The marathon is known for its community atmosphere, including preparation and training sessions, and is a major event in the regional running calendar.

name: Barsbütteler Volkslauf
description: The Barsbüttel Volkslauf is a traditional running event held every June at the sports ground in the Barsbüttel Sports Centre. It offers various distances from 400 m to 10 km, mostly on flat, paved or firm sandy farm tracks. Most of the routes pass through the traffic-free Barsbütteler Feldmark and offer beautiful views, particularly the longer 5 km and 10 km routes. Times are recorded electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterwards. Food and refreshments are also available for runners and spectators.
course_highlights: The routes are mostly flat and follow paved or firm sandy farm tracks
Routes pass through the traffic-free Barsbütteler Feldmark and offer beautiful views
The 10 km route runs along a small avenue and past the Stapelfelder Moor
additional: Times are recorded electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterwards. The shortest distance (400 m) takes place entirely on the stadium’s tartan track. The 1 km and 2 km routes partly leave the stadium; the longer routes (5 km and 10 km) offer beautiful views and follow firm sandy tracks and paved farm roads. Food and refreshments are available for runners and spectators. Event on roads, registration online via TrainerDay, refreshments for participants and spectators.

name: BORNE TO RUN (48-Stunden-Lauf)
description: BORNE TO RUN is a 48-hour charity run in Unna that presents an extreme challenge for endurance and willpower. Participants are pushed to their limits over long, demanding hours. This race is for runners ready to take on a genuine test while supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: 48-hour run with distances of 43.2 km and 172.8 km
Venue in Unna, with typical June weather around 23 °C and mostly sunny skies
Charity event focused on endurance and willpower
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The run takes place from 12 to 14 June 2026; registration is open until 11 June 2026. Donations go to the German Children’s Hospice Service and NABU.

name: Famberglauf
description: The Famberglauf is a running event held in June in Fambach, organized by SV Schwarz-Weiß Fambach 09 e.V. The program offers four different distances: a 21.1 km half marathon, the 10.9 km Famberglauf, the 5 km Famberg Sprint, and a 1000 m children’s race. The event is open to runners of all ages and ability levels and has more of a friendly club-run feel than that of a large competition.
course_highlights: 21.1 km half marathon
Distances ranging from 1000 m to 21.1 km
Event in Fambach with a friendly club-run atmosphere
additional: The event comprises four races on the same day, including a children’s race. Participant numbers are low, suggesting a friendly club event. June weather is typically sunny, with temperatures around 23 °C. Several running distances are offered, including a half marathon, sprint, and children’s race; the event is part of the Landschaftscup 'Rhön - Thüringer Wald - Werratal'; participant numbers may be limited.

name: Ludwigsluster Schlossgartenlauf
description: The Ludwigslust Palace Gardens Run takes place on 14 June 2026 in Ludwigslust Palace Park and offers runners of all ages a varied choice of distances. The distances range from 2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, with walking routes of 5 and 10 km also available. New to the programme is a Bambini Run for the youngest children, with no registration or results, and an official medal waiting at the finish. This traditional event warmly welcomes beginners and experienced runners alike to enjoy the beautiful parkland.
course_highlights: Routes through the historic Ludwigslust Palace Park
A range of distances from 2 km to 15 km, plus walking routes
Bambini Run for children born in 2021 or later, with a medal
additional: The Bambini Run is free, requires no registration and has no results. It is approximately 500–600 metres long. Adult accompaniment is expressly welcome. Registration for the other races opens on 15 March. Run in Ludwigslust Palace Park; no registration required, no fees, no results, medals for everyone, parking available, drinks and refreshments, changing and shower facilities, 40th anniversary in 2026, route partly outside the park due to park restrictions, post-race party as part of the Linden Festival.

name: Nocny Maraton Kanału Bydgoskiego od 2007r.
description: The Bydgoszcz Canal Night Marathon is Poland’s oldest continuously held night marathon, taking place since 2007. The race is run in the unique nighttime setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty and along the Bydgoszcz Canal’s distinctive historic hydraulic structures: its 18th-century locks. The canal is the oldest inland waterway in Poland. The event attracts runners from across Poland and abroad, offering generous race packs, original medals and T-shirts, and professional timekeeping. It is growing in prestige and is known for its lively atmosphere, live music, and numerous accompanying attractions.
course_highlights: A night race in the setting of the Bydgoszcz Planty
A route along the historic 18th-century locks of the Bydgoszcz Canal
A unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
additional: There are 6 distances. Participants receive original medals, commemorative T-shirts, and generous race packs. Professional electronic timekeeping and race numbers are provided. Live music adds to the event’s appeal for runners and spectators. The event features 6 distances, electronic timekeeping, commemorative medals and T-shirts, and generous race packs. Participants can expect professional course markings and artistic entertainment during the race.

description: The 17th Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is an annual running event held in Elbląg, attracting runners to the 5 km and 10 km distances, as well as the Mini Piekarczyk Run for children. The event is known for its unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and community, and participants receive one-of-a-kind collectible medals. The organizers provide comfortable race-day facilities, including a race office for collecting race packets, a baggage deposit, and sanitary facilities. The race is a great opportunity to spend time actively and compete on the city’s scenic routes.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes along the streets of Elbląg
Mini Piekarczyk Run for children in various age categories
A unique collectible medal that can be combined with medals from other races in the city
additional: Race packets can be collected at Ogrody Shopping Centre (Saturday, 12:00–18:00) and at the Helena MOSiR Ice Rink Hall (Sunday, 7:30–9:30 for the 5 km and 10 km races; 7:30–13:30 for the Mini Run). Participants can use the baggage deposit, changing rooms, and showers at the ice rink hall. The Mini Piekarczyk Run includes several children’s age categories, with distances ranging from 50 m to 600 m. Races start from 12:35 on Sunday. 5 km and 10 km distances, team classification, entry-fee promotions, limited number of places, online registration

name: Grodziski Półmaraton Słowaka
location: Grodzisk Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Hunters Grodziski “Słowaka” Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Grodzisk Wielkopolski since 2007. The race commemorates Juliusz Słowacki, the patron of the local high school, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among residents. The half-marathon course is flat and runs through the town streets over two laps, with numerous refreshment and hydration stations. After the race, participants receive medals and can enjoy a hot meal and drinks. The event also provides an opportunity to promote the town and its local running community.
course_highlights: Flat course through the town streets, with two laps of approximately 10.5 km each
Course marked every 1 km with vertical and horizontal signs
Four nutrition stations and four hydration stations on each lap
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours. The race office is located at Grodziska Sports Hall, ul. Żwirki i Wigury 2A. Timing is provided by chips attached to race bibs. After the race, the organizer provides a hot meal and drinks. A team classification for sponsor teams is held in the 5 km race. The combined participant limit for the 5 km and 10 km races is 500. Registration and race-pack collection take place in Grodzisk Wielkopolski, ul. Żwirki i Wigury 2A, on 13 June 2026 from 12:00 to 20:00 and on 14 June 2026 from 6:00 to 8:00. Training sessions are held from registration until race day.

name: Omloop van Empel
description: The Omloop van Empel is a popular running race held annually in Empel. The anniversary edition attracts around 1,000 participants each year and is known for its sporty, friendly atmosphere. The organizers work hard to make it a wonderful day filled with socializing and sport. Participants and spectators are invited to enjoy this special running experience together.
course_highlights: Various distances for all levels
Friendly atmosphere with music and drinks
Includes children’s races and family activities
additional: Registration for the 10th edition is closed, and all race entries have been allocated. Around 1,000 participants are expected. The organizers encourage people to come cheer on the participants and experience the event’s atmosphere. Running and walking event; registration via inschrijven.nl; start location: Asmunt 3, Empel

name: Modine Söderköpings Stadslopp
organizer: Norrköpings Löparklubb i samarbete med Söderköpings OK

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Alla barn deltar som vanligt helt gratis i Ramunderstaden Lilla Brunnsparksloppet.

description: Modine Söderköping City Run is a fast, popular 5-kilometre race starting and finishing in Brunnsparken in Söderköping. The seventh edition takes place on Tuesday, 16 June 2026, on a flat, easy-to-run course suited to both fast runners and recreational participants. The course is lined with music stations and a large cheering crowd. After finishing, participants are treated to a summer platter from ICA Supermarket. The event also includes the free Ramunderstaden Little Brunnsparken Run for children, with several age groups.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 5 km course (officially measured by federation measurer Per Lindh)
Start and finish in Brunnsparken, Söderköping
Music stations and strong crowd support along the course
additional: Race bib collection: ICA Supermarket Söderköping, Monday 15 June, 12:00–18:00; remaining bibs can be collected in the start/finish area up to one hour before the start. The timing chip is attached as a tab at the top of the bib and must not be removed. Water is available at the start/finish and at 2.8 km. World Class leads the warm-up (15 minutes before each start; the children’s races warm up at 16:45). After finishing, ICA Supermarket serves a summer platter; massage is available after the race. Late registration: online and on site. Online registration is open through 14 June at 16:00, according to the information provided. The regular late-registration period (increased fee of 50 SEK, for a total of 375 SEK) runs from 8 June until one hour before the start; late registration is also available on site/at bib collection (the website’s news page lists the on-site fee as 345 SEK). The 5 km course runs through Söderköping; the start/finish area is in Brunnsparken; chip timing by Racetimer; warm-up before the start led by World Class; water at the start/finish and at 2.8 km; a medal for all participants; bag/outerwear drop-off at the start and finish; the Little Brunnsparken Run (1.1 km) for children; registration via the website; bibs collected at ICA Söderköping.

name: Blodomloppet (Visby)
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Visby—a community running event that raises awareness of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, or take part in Lilla Blodomloppet. The courses pass through Visby’s cultural heritage areas and are open to both recreational runners and teams. The event is organised locally by VIF Gute Friidrott together with the blood donation centre in Visby, and often ends with a picnic and activities for participants.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses run along Visby’s ring wall and through the town centre
The 10 km course includes the seafront promenade, Almedalen and Visby harbour
Scenic historic surroundings close to the town
additional: Team registration is available and costs 1,750 kr up to and including 26 May; groups can register many participants using an Excel template imported during registration; the event highlights blood donation and provides information about gifts for blood donors; local organisers: VIF Gute Friidrott (contact: Annie Gardell, Tel 0733 909722, email visby@blodomloppet.se) and the Blood Donation Centre in Visby (Tel 0498-26 84 53, email blodcentralen@gotland.se). There are three categories: 10 km, 5 km and Lilla Blodomloppet; registration via blodomloppet.se; start times in Visby are listed on the website; included: technical T-shirt, race bib and medal; team registration is available for companies and groups; the event is streamed live on blodomloppet.se.

name: 95. Terrainkurweg Marathon
description: The 95th Terrainkurweg Marathon in Salzgitter is a challenging run on a hilly course with around 150 metres of elevation gain and loss. The route passes through the Vöppstedter Forst, by the Forsthaus Liebenburg and along the Salzgitter golf course. The event is not an official DLV event and is aimed at well-trained runners. Refreshments are available in a covered room, including drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: 9.1 km loop through the Vöppstedter Forst
Loop course with around 150 metres of elevation gain and loss
Route along the Salzgitter golf course
additional: Refreshments are available in a covered room: hot tea, broth, cola, water, spritzer, pretzel sticks, nuts, bananas, cake and chocolate bars. No liability is accepted; participation is at your own risk. This is not an official DLV event. The marathon is part of an event in the Terrainkurwege series held in the Salzgitter region. No specific information about registration or entry fees is available.

name: Midsommarjoggen 2026
description: Midsommarjoggen is a running festival in Rynningeviken Nature Reserve in Örebro, taking place on 17 June 2026. The main race is 7.2 km, mostly on easy-to-run gravel paths along the water and through the forest. It suits both runners looking to run fast and those who prefer to jog or walk at a summer pace. The course passes Rävgången and Naturens Hus and finishes with an after-run gathering at Stora Hjortstorps gård, with food, drinks and good company. There is also a KidsRun (approximately 600 m) for children born in 2016 or later.
course_highlights: 7.2 km, mostly easy-to-run gravel paths along the water in Rynningeviken
Passes Rävgången and Naturens Hus, with evening sunshine and lake views
Two wooden bridges over Lillån and two longer hills by Venastugan
additional: Start at 18:30 (warm-up at 18:15; compulsory race briefing at 18:25). KidsRun starts at 17:45 (gather at 17:40). Bib numbers can be collected from the race office from 16:00; collect by 18:10 at the latest. Timing uses a loaned transponder (800 kr charged for a lost transponder); KidsRun is not timed. Water/energy stations at 3 and 5 km; toilets are available in the event area and at the water stations. No changing facilities or showers on site. After-run gathering at Stora Hjortstorps gård (BBQ 299 SEK, including water and coffee; half price for children under 12). Youth (born in 2008 or later) receive a 50% discount; group registration via info@epictrail.se. The course is described as 7.2 km in Rynningeviken Nature Reserve. Transponders are loaned at the start and must be returned (800 kr charged if lost). Food and drinks are provided along the course, followed by an after-run gathering at Stora Hjortstorps Gård (BBQ buffet 299 SEK, including water and coffee). No changing rooms or showers. Kids Run is not timed. The entry fee includes a place in the race, bib number, timing, medal, sports drink and energy.

name: Volksbank Stadtlauf Selm 2026
location: Campus Selm, Selm, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Volksbank Stadtlauf Selm is taking place for the fourth time as part of the popular town festival weekend. The officially measured course runs through the beautiful Auenpark and is popular with athletes from Selm and the surrounding region. The event offers races for various age groups, from Bambini races to fun runs over 5 and 10 kilometres. Mayor Thomas Orlowski will take part in the 10-kilometre race himself, highlighting the event’s friendly, sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Officially measured course through the Auenpark
Various races for children, teenagers and adults
Start and finish at Campus Selm
additional: The Stadtlauf begins with the Bambini race at 16:00 in the stadium (400 m). This is followed by school races over 1 km and 2.5 km, as well as fun runs over 5 km (18:00) and 10 km (19:00). Award ceremonies take place between the races. Volksbank Selm-Bork eG is the event’s main sponsor. Several race distances, start in the Auenpark, children’s and youth races, registration now open

name: Borejoggen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Lagjoggen följer samma priser som Borejoggen, alltså 300:-/person och ytterligare 50:- per person vid efteranmälan.

description: Borejoggen is a traditional Midsummer race in Torsby, welcoming elite runners, recreational runners and children. The main race is run on asphalt through central Torsby and is approximately 8.5 km. Minijoggen is a shorter class of approximately 1.5 km for children and young people. There is also Lagjoggen, a team race for teams of three, with the team’s combined time counting. The start is in the area around Östmarksvägen/Herrgårdsparken (Minijoggen at 09:30; Borejoggen and Lagjoggen at 11:00). Registration is via RaceID or at Prima Sport/Herrgårdsparken, according to the organiser’s information.
course_highlights: The main course is approximately 8.5 km on asphalt through central Torsby
Minijoggen is approximately 1.5 km for children and young people
Water stations at 2 km, 5.8 km and the finish
additional: The start is on Östmarksvägen/Herrgårdsparken. Race numbers and timing chips can be collected at Prima Sport during Midsummer week. Changing facilities and showers are available at Björnevi IP and Valbergsstugan; toilets are available at Herrgårdsparken and Björnevi IP. Prizes are offered, including sprint and hill prizes and prize money for the winners. Traffic marshals will be stationed on busy roads, and medical services will be available at the finish. The course is 8.5 km on asphalt through central Torsby. Start times are 9:30 for Minijoggen and 11:00 for Borejoggen/Lagjoggen. Registration is via RaceID or Prima Sport. Lagjoggen requires three participants per team. Water stations are provided as specified for the course.

name: Orsakajtn
description: Orsakajt'n and Orsabajk'n are an MTB and running race held every year on Midsummer Eve in Orsa. The event offers a unique combination of cycling and running in beautiful natural surroundings and attracts both young people and adults. Race numbers are sent digitally in advance, and bibs can be picked up at Karl Hedin in Orsa or at the start venue. A licence and membership in an association affiliated with the Swedish Cycling Federation are required for the MTB competition categories.
course_highlights: MTB and running race in scenic Orsa
Always held on Midsummer Eve
A licence and membership in a cycling federation are required for the MTB competition categories
additional: Registration opens on 29 April 2026. The entry fee increases by 50% from 16 June. No on-site entries; registration closes one hour before the start. Race numbers are sent digitally on 17 June. Bibs can be picked up on 18 June from 16:00 to 20:00 at Karl Hedin in Orsa or at the start venue on race day. No refunds for injury or illness. A licence is required for the MTB categories. Registration is online, and race numbers are available on mobile. Held in scenic Orsa.

name: 44. Heiligenröder Abendlauf
price_range: modest registration fees, free for Bambinis
description: The 44th Heiligenröder Evening Run is a traditional night road race in Niestetal, Germany, and part of the Nordhessencup running series. The event offers distances for all ages and ability levels, from 400 m for Bambinis to 20.35 km for experienced runners. It combines competitive racing with more relaxed running options: Bambinis, walkers and Nordic walkers are timed but not ranked. Participation is free for Bambinis, while children, teenagers and adults pay moderate entry fees.
course_highlights: Night road race in Niestetal-Heiligenrode
Distances from 400 m to 20.35 km
Part of the Nordhessencup running series
additional: Bambinis run for free; entry fees for children, teenagers and adults are moderate. Bambinis, walkers and Nordic walkers are timed but not ranked. The event is listed on laufen.de. Typical June weather: approx. 23 °C, mostly sunny. Night race, multiple distances, events for all ages, part of the Nordhessencup running series.

name: Gänseliesellauf
location: Krischerstraße, Monheim am Rhein, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Stadt Monheim am Rhein, Sportgemeinschaft Monheim 1894/1968 e.V.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: inklusive 100 Meter-Lauf für alle keine Anmeldegebühr

description: The 40th Gänseliesellauf takes place on June 12, 2026, in Monheim am Rhein and traditionally kicks off the town festival. Five different races are offered for various age groups, ranging from a 900-meter race for kindergarten children to a 10-kilometer race for adults. The event is organized by the City of Monheim am Rhein together with Sportgemeinschaft Monheim 1894/1968 e. V. Alongside the races, it offers a varied program of food and festival activities. The races start and finish on Krischerstraße, and all participants receive certificates that can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Krischerstraße at number 10
Five races for different age groups and distances
Event held as part of the Monheim town festival, with a festival program
additional: Late registration is possible up to one hour before each race. Certificates can be downloaded after the race via my.raceresult.com. Refreshments and food are available nearby during the races. The event is supported by MEGA Monheimer Elektrizitäts- und Gasversorgung GmbH. various race distances, registration by email, certificates available online, town festival program

name: Erftflitzer Lauf
description: The Erftflitzerlauf in Neuss-Holzheim is a family-friendly running event with a long tradition dating back to 1993. It offers various races for children, young people and adults, from short Bambini races to 5.5 km races for adults and young people. The event is known for its fun-focused spirit, with community and the joy of running at its heart. The course passes through the beautiful surroundings of Holzheim and offers suitable challenges for all age groups.
course_highlights: Various distances from approximately 400 m to 5.5 km
Relay races of 3 x approximately 400 m for different age groups
Family-friendly atmosphere with an emphasis on fun and community
additional: The Erftflitzerlauf includes several races, with start times from 17:30, beginning with Bambini and children’s races, followed by youth and adult races and relay races. The event is designed as a fun run without prizes for winners; instead, there is a raffle. Age categories are clearly defined, and races are available for children born in 2019 through to adults. The event takes place at the sports facility in Holzheim. Races for all age groups, family-friendly, central location, known as the Erftflitzerlauf since the 1990s.

name: Legdener Volkslauf / Mittsommernachtslauf
description: The Legden Midsummer Night Run is a popular fun run through the centre of Legden, taking place on 19 June 2026. The event is known for its relaxed atmosphere and lack of competitive pressure, as only the times of the first three women and first three men are recorded. Events include children’s races, a kids’ race for older children, 5 km and 10 km races for teenagers and adults, and a 5 km course for walkers and Nordic walkers. Wheelchair users are warmly invited to take part in the 5 km walk. Due to a road closure, the route has been slightly adjusted and now runs along Windmühlenweg, Osterwicker Straße and Melroseweg.
course_highlights: Run through the centre of Legden with cheering spectators
5 km and 10 km courses with a revised route via Osterwicker Straße and Melroseweg
Children’s races in two age groups (400 m for children born in 2022 or later, and for those born in 2020 and 2021)
additional: Race-number distribution on 19 June 2026 from 17:30 at Dahliendorfstadion. Late entries are possible on the event day up to 30 minutes before the respective start. Prizes in kind will be awarded by drawing race numbers. Group registration is available until 15 June 2026; no group registrations will be accepted after that date. Courses for children, teenagers, adults, walkers and wheelchair users; route changes due to a road closure.

name: 21. Laatzen Leinelauf
location: Laatzen, Region Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 21st Laatzen Leinelauf takes place on June 19, 2026, and offers runners 3.5 km, 6.5 km and 10 km routes through the idyllic Leine-Masch, with nature, water and wide meadows. The event also includes a 1.2 km Bambini run and a 6.5 km walking category. The 10 km route includes a team classification for mixed teams. The traditional Laatzener Winzerfest takes place alongside the race, rounding off the evening with culinary and musical highlights.
course_highlights: Run through the Leine-Masch, with nature, water and wide meadows
Refreshment station and musical support on the 6.5 km and 10 km routes
Team classification for mixed teams on the 10 km route
additional: Race-number distribution from 15:00 at the park of the Altes Rathaus. Timing by RUNTIMING GbR. Late entries can be made on site on race day from 15:00 until around 30 minutes before each race. Trophies for the 10 km winners; certificates and surprises for the top finishers and teams. Bambini run participants receive a small surprise. The event takes place alongside the Laatzener Winzerfest, with musical and culinary entertainment. Routes go through the Leine-Masch and finish at the wine festival; suitable for walkers, teams and children.

name: 40. Braunschweiger Nachtlauf
description: The 40th Braunschweiger Night Run on 19 June 2026 offers a varied programme of sporting events for all age groups, from Bambini races to recreational races. The races run through Braunschweig city centre, starting and finishing on Bohlweg; the Bambini races start at Burgplatz. The event is known for its special atmosphere and the support of the Braunschweigische Sparkassenstiftung, which makes the event possible and helps it develop. The race bib serves as a public transport ticket in Braunschweig on the day of the event. All finishers can download a certificate, and baggage drop-off is open until 23:30.
course_highlights: The route runs through Braunschweig city centre, starting and finishing on Bohlweg
The Bambini races start at Burgplatz
The race bib serves as a public transport ticket (Zone 40) on the day of the event
additional: Registration is via Davengo from 16 February 2026 to 14 June 2026. There are Bambini, children’s, youth, recreational and team races, with different start times from 18:00. The route will be closed to public traffic from 16:00. Baggage drop-off is located at Schlossplatz. For the Bambini races, accompanying runners can be registered at the same time; for the children’s races, accompanying runners must be registered separately. Teams can register collectively or individually; four or more runners count as a team. Registration is available via Davengo, with individual and team entry options. The event is open to all age groups and offers a festive atmosphere in the city centre.

name: SportScheck RUN Hamburg
description: The SportScheck RUN Hamburg is a traditional night run around the Outer Alster, held in an atmospheric evening setting. Depending on the distance, runners can complete the 7.5 km loop around the Alster once or twice. There are special 1 km and 1.8 km races for children. The start and finish area in Alsterpark offers a special atmosphere with a cheering zone, photo point and a large medal wall, bringing the Hanseatic spirit to life at dusk.

The route runs along the banks of the Alster, through Winterhude and Uhlenhorst, past the Hotel Atlantic and over the Kennedy Bridge
Night run with a special atmosphere as dusk falls
additional: There are two children’s races: the 1 km DAK Bambini RUN (up to age 7) and the 1.8 km DAK Kids RUN (ages 7 to 12). The start and finish area features a cheering zone, a photo point for finish-line photos and a large medal wall with finisher medals. Certificates and photos can be downloaded from the SportScheck website. This is a distance event, with results, certificates and photos available.

name: Brunsbüttler Citylauf
location: Stadion Bildungszentrum am Ziegelweg, Brunsbüttel, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany

The 5 km course is a loop, while the 10 km course is run twice. The youngest participants can take part in a children’s run of approximately 400 m in the stadium, making it easy for families to follow all the action.

10 km course consisting of two laps of the 5 km course
Children’s run of approximately 400 m in the stadium
additional: Timing is provided using transponders, which are handed out at collection. Changing facilities are available. All participants receive a medal. The children’s race takes place in the stadium, allowing families to follow everything from one location. A running event for athletes and families, with modern timing, changing facilities and medals for all participants.

name: Jemgumer Dörploop
description: The Jemgum Dörploop is a versatile running event in Jemgum, Lower Saxony, offering various distances for all age groups. From Bambini and schoolchildren’s races to challenging courses of 21.2 km and relay races with electronic timing, there is something for every runner. The event takes place at the sports centre in Jemgum and offers a friendly atmosphere, with refreshments in the finish area. The course consists of 5.3 km laps, which are run multiple times depending on the distance.

Relay race with 4 × 5.3 km laps
Water stations on the course and refreshments at the finish

The course runs around Hahnenberg and offers runners a varied challenge. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and promises a pleasant atmosphere in typical June weather, which is usually sunny.

Distances: 1 km and 8.3 km
Typical June weather, around 23 °C and mostly sunny
additional: The start location is Wöbbel, a district of Schieder-Schwalenberg. The event is part of the 2025 Lippe Summer Series.
