name: Challenge Gdańsk 2026
description: Challenge Gdańsk 2026 is a prestigious triathlon held on the Baltic Sea, amid the scenic surroundings of Gdańsk and Brzeźno. Athletes compete over the middle distance, comprising a 1.9 km swim in the Bay of Gdańsk, a fast 90 km bike course through the Vistula Żuławy, and a 21.1 km run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park, finishing on the Gdańsk pier. The event attracts both professionals and amateurs, offering a unique atmosphere and excellent conditions for sporting competition. It is an official qualifying race and takes place on June 19–21, 2026.
course_highlights: A 1.9 km swim in the Bay of Gdańsk
A fast 90 km bike loop through the Vistula Żuławy
A run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park, finishing on the pier in Brzeźno
additional: The option to purchase race-cancellation coverage with a full refund is available until June 1, 2026. Special discounts are available for teams of at least 10 athletes. Races take place over several days: the sprint on Saturday and the middle distance on Sunday. The race office and Expo are open on race days. Bike and wetsuit rental is available. Courses may be subject to minor changes due to agreements with road authorities. The middle-distance time limit is 16:45 on race day. Participants can purchase race-cancellation coverage with a full refund, and a portion of the fees is donated to Pomorskie Hospicjum dla Dzieci. The event is also known for its high attendance and recognition in the triathlon community, including the title Race of the Year 2021.

name: Nocny Bieg Świętojański

The main 10 km race takes place against the city’s picturesque backdrop, accompanied by races for children and young people. The event attracts runners of different age groups, offering sporting competition and a chance to connect in a nighttime atmosphere. The organizers provide professional event support, as well as photo and video coverage.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race
Picturesque route in central Gdynia
Nighttime event as part of the Gdynia Grand Prix

The event includes different age categories, including races for children and Nordic walking. Participants can look forward to an appealing nighttime sporting atmosphere, as well as extensive promotional materials and online results.

name: Grachtenloop
description: The Zorgspecialist Grachtenloop is an atmospheric evening run through Haarlem’s beautiful old town, with participants running along the canals and waterways. The course passes various cultural and tourist attractions and is supported by enthusiastic spectators, bands and DJs. The 10 km distance consists of two laps of the 5 km course. There is also a Hero KidsRun for children aged 4 and up, and a BusinessRun with extra facilities. The event offers a unique combination of sport and conviviality in a historic city setting.

Musical support from bands and DJs along the course

The BusinessRun includes a VIP location, food, drinks and massage. Group registration is also available, with separate invoicing and race bib delivery. The event provides race bibs, a course, refreshment stations, a medal, entertainment, timekeeping and medical support. Race bibs are delivered to the homes of participants in the Netherlands.

The course passes through woodland and open farmland and requires a good level of fitness. Children under 12 have a separate, flat out-and-back course, while the Bambini runners start on shorter loops around the sports field. The event is family-friendly and, in addition to the races, offers a raffle with attractive prizes as well as refreshments for spectators and participants.

name: Europalauf 2026

A range of routes is available, including accessible and panoramic options, as well as a challenging half marathon with elevation gain and bridge crossings.

Children aged 13 and under can take part in a shorter version of 25 laps and 50 km. The event takes place at the sports field in Brokstedt and offers a sporting challenge for teams who enjoy running together.
course_highlights: 50 laps of 2 km each for the 100 km relay
Teams run in pairs
Separate children’s relay with 25 laps (50 km)
additional: A maximum of 100 teams can take part. Local teams may register from 01.12.2025. To register, email staffellauf@tsvbrokstedt.de with the team leader’s details and the expected number of runners. Withdrawal of the entire team is not possible. The start and finish are at the A-Platz (Am Sportplatz 2b, 24161 Brokstedt). Race over 50 laps (pairs), children’s teams run 25 laps, shared finish, festival with activity area and food trucks, anniversary celebration from 20:00.

name: Never Give Up Hindernislauf
description: The Never Give Up obstacle run 2026 takes place on June 20 in Heinum near Gronau and offers a unique running experience for the whole family. Adults can take on a challenging main race of approx. 12 km with over 30 varied obstacles along idyllic forest and field paths on the edge of the Sieben Berge hills. There is also a 5 km run with more than 25 obstacles for children and adults, as well as a Kidsrun for ages 4 and up on an approx. 2 km course packed with exciting obstacles. Fun, team spirit and crossing the finish line together are the focus, alongside professional timing, medals for all finishers and refreshments in the finish area.
course_highlights: Main race: approx. 12 km with over 30 obstacles
Course follows forest and field paths on the edge of the Sieben Berge hills
5 km run with more than 25 obstacles for children and adults
additional: Professional timing for adults and children; medals and certificates for all finishers; refreshments in the finish area, including drinks, snacks, a cake buffet and street food; obstacles can be tackled solo or as a team; a large number of obstacles are on or around the sports field for a great spectator experience. Obstacle run through forest and fields, registration via RunTiming, family and children’s races, volunteers wanted

name: Referees Run
description: The Referees Run is a 10-kilometer race held annually in Borgholzhausen since 2005 as part of the “Nacht von Borgholzhausen” fun run. The Gelsenkirchen Referees’ Association traditionally fields one of the largest groups in the race. The event promotes camaraderie among referees through sport and offers an athletic challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The race takes place on June 20, 2026, and is coordinated by Stefan Tendyck.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer course
Part of the “Nacht von Borgholzhausen” fun run
Traditionally strong participation by the Gelsenkirchen Referees’ Association
additional: The race is part of the “Nacht von Borgholzhausen” event. Contact Stefan Tendyck for information. No prices or registration options are listed on the website. The Gelsenkirchen Referees’ Association is traditionally strongly represented. The Referees Run regularly attracts numerous referees from Westphalia and promotes camaraderie within the refereeing community.

name: Saucony Berlin 10K

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Anmeldung für den ersten Saucony BLN 10K kostet 35,00 Euro.

description: The Saucony BLN 10K is a spectacular new race taking place on June 20, 2026, at the historic Tempelhofer Feld in Berlin. The event combines fast urban running with a unique atmosphere at one of the city’s most historic locations. The start and finish are in the heritage-listed Hangar 6, alongside a Cool Down Zone with DJs, drinks and street food. The course consists of two fast 5-kilometre laps, passing historic aircraft and running through the hangar, offering an unforgettable running experience with urban lifestyle and music.
course_highlights: Two fast 5-kilometre laps across Tempelhofer Feld
Start and finish in the heritage-listed Hangar 6
Course passes historic aircraft and runs through the hangar
additional: The race package includes an event T-shirt, shoe-mounted transponder timing, refreshment stations, toilets along the course, post-finish refreshments, individual results, a finisher medal, insurance, an online certificate, a paid finish-line video, and access to the Sunset Party on the apron. Admission from 16:00; Sunset Party until 22:00; event ends at 23:00. Guests need a valid guest ticket, which runners can obtain free of charge until 31.05.2026. Bags up to a maximum of A4 size are permitted; no baggage storage is available on site. The course runs across Tempelhofer Feld, including the start and finish in Hangar 6, with a Cool Down Zone, music, street food, a neon-design medal, a limited-edition event T-shirt, and an urban festival atmosphere.

name: Sommerlauf Waren(Müritz) (LC/NLC)
description: The 4th Sommerlauf Waren (Müritz) is a running event hosted by the SV Waren 09 e.V. Laufteam. The race takes place at Müritzstadion in Waren (Müritz) and is open to children, young people, active runners, and Masters. The event offers runners of all ages a sporting opportunity in a beautiful setting. Registration is available through the tollense-timing.de platform.
course_highlights: Various race distances for all age groups
Event at Müritzstadion with a stadium-adjacent course
Part of Laufcup MV, ideal for competitive and recreational runners
additional: Stadium-based race, including children’s and youth competitions; registration via the organizer’s website; a popular summer event in the region

name: 15 Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej
price_range: 59 zł - 89 zł (darowizny), opłaty startowe nie są wymienione
description: The Górski Półmaraton Pętli Tatrzańskiej is a mountain half marathon held in Koszalin on a scenic route around Chełmska Hill. Runners can choose between a distance of 10.55 km and the full half marathon of 21.1 km, which consists of two loops. The start and finish are near the sanctuary and observation tower on Chełmska Hill, and the route runs through woodland with scenic views. The event is charitable, and donations support the work of the “SFX” Association.
course_highlights: Mountain route around Chełmska Hill, reaching an elevation of 136.2 m above sea level
Two distances to choose from: 10.55 km (one loop) and 21.1 km (two loops)
Start and finish near the sanctuary and observation tower on Chełmska Hill
additional: The race office is open from 9:00 to 10:30. The ceremonial start takes place in the square between the sanctuary and the observation tower. The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 14:30, with the possibility of a change. Donations to the statutory purposes of the “SFX” Association are non-refundable and non-transferable. The route follows woodland paths and is marked with the yellow “Pętla Tatrzańska” trail. Races over 10.55 km and 21.1 km; time limit: 4 hours; refreshment points, medals, trophies, chip timing, medical cover.

name: 54 Memoriał Żylewicza - Bieg Amatorów
description: The 54th Józef Żylewicz Memorial is a prestigious athletics meeting held annually since 1973 by the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club. The event commemorates Józef Żylewicz, an outstanding coach and sports activist, one of the founders of KS LECHIA Gdańsk and a co-creator of the Polish national athletics team’s successes. The Memorial takes place at the Athletics and Rugby Stadium in Gdańsk and combines sporting excellence with openness to the local community, attracting athletes from Poland and abroad. The programme also includes the amateur 3,000 m race “Szybka Strzała Północy” (“Fast Arrow of the North”), open to all running enthusiasts, with no age limits or athletic requirements.
course_highlights: A 3,000 m race on the professional track at the athletics stadium in Gdańsk
Course at the Athletics and Rugby Stadium, al. Grunwaldzka 244
The event brings professional athletes together with amateurs and the local community
additional: The amateur 3,000 m race “Szybka Strzała Północy” (“Fast Arrow of the North”) is open to everyone, with no age limits or athletic requirements. The event is symbolic in nature and promotes making athletics accessible to all. The Memorial also features the “Athletics for Everyone” festival, with activities for families, as well as Swedish relays for primary school students. The event includes various distances and age categories, with broad sponsorship and promotional support. Participants can expect medals, branded T-shirts and attractive cash prizes.

description: The Bieg Dwie Wieże is a race of approximately 15 km held in Kopalino. The course runs along unpaved roads, the beach and a pavement, offering varied surfaces and picturesque views. The time limit is 2.5 hours, and participation is limited to 250 people. The event is well organized, with water stations along the course and a recovery meal at the finish.
course_highlights: Approximately 15 km course
Runs along unpaved roads, the beach and a pavement
Water stations at 4, 8 and 12 km, and at the finish
additional: Participant limit: 250 people. Race office hours: 19.06, 13:00–19:00, and 20.06, 8:00–9:45 (verification closes at 9:45). Identity verification is required (ID card/student ID). A chip is mandatory; collect it at the race office and return it at the finish. Water and a recovery meal are available at the finish. Medical support is provided. Participants consent to the use of their image. Personal accident insurance is recommended. Online registration, limit of 250 participants, medical support, photography and filming, and rules of conduct on the course.

name: Challenge Poland
description: Challenge Gdańsk is a prestigious middle-distance triathlon held on the Baltic coast in the beautiful surroundings of Gdańsk. Athletes start from the city beach, completing a 1.9 km swim, a fast and flat 90 km bike course through the Vistula Fens, and a 21.1 km run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park. The finish is on a unique urban pier, making the finale unforgettable. The event is an official qualifier and is highly regarded by triathletes around the world.
course_highlights: 1.9 km swim in the Baltic Sea off Gdańsk’s city beach
90 km flat and fast bike course through the Vistula Fens
21.1 km run along the beach and Ronald Reagan Park, finishing on the urban pier
additional: Races are spread over three days: June 19 features races for children and the TREFL Aquathlon; June 20 features the sprint and Challenge Women by Brooks; and June 21 features the middle distance, with separate wave starts for PRO men, PRO women, and Age Group athletes. You can purchase an option to cancel your registration until June 1, 2026. Special discounts are available for teams of 10 or more. The bike course passes, among other places, Polsat Plus Arena Stadium. Race headquarters and the expo area are located by Brzeźno Beach in Gdańsk. The event also includes an expo, transition areas, technical briefings, and various race categories, and is an official qualifier for major international triathlons.

name: VI Maraton Leśny
location: Kwidzyn Forest, Kwidzyn, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 6th Kwidzyn Forest Marathon is a unique running event taking place on June 20, 2026. The marathon route passes through the picturesque woodland areas of the Kwidzyn Forest District, giving participants the chance to connect with nature and enjoy an active day surrounded by forests. The event combines sporting competition with environmental education, promoting environmental protection and local natural heritage. The organizers provide safety and support throughout the event.
course_highlights: The route passes through the woodland areas of the Kwidzyn Forest District
Contact with nature and picturesque scenery
Environmental education in a forest setting
additional: The event is organized by the Kwidzyn Forest District. It is linked to an environmental education program. No information is available about entry fees, start time, or online registration. The Kwidzyn Forest District’s telephone and email contact details are available. The event is connected with environmental education and forest activities, takes place in the Miłosna Forest Range, and offers the possibility of participating in various distances.

name: XIX Bieg O Błękitną Wstęgę
description: The 19th International Blue Ribbon Run is an annual running event organized by Stargard Athletics Club and held on the streets of Stargard. The main race starts at 21:00, creating a unique atmosphere for night running. The route starts at the Amphitheatre and circles the Jewel of Pomerania, offering views of Stargard’s most beautiful historic landmarks by moonlight. The event promotes health, fitness, and positive energy, encouraging an active lifestyle.
course_highlights: Start at the Amphitheatre in Stargard
Route around the Jewel of Pomerania
Views of Stargard’s most beautiful historic landmarks at night
additional: The race takes place at night, creating a unique atmosphere. The route is designed to let runners admire Stargard’s historic landmarks by moonlight. The organizer encourages runners to build endurance and prepare mentally for the race. night run, route around historic landmarks, registration coming soon

description: ZIELONKA CHALLENGE is an individual, long-distance running race and Nordic Walking event held in the scenic Zielonka Forest Landscape Park. The event offers distances ranging from approximately a quarter marathon to an ultramarathon, following forest roads, tracks and ravines among nature reserves and lakes. It is known for its excellent organisation, well-stocked refreshment stations, and a unique atmosphere of sporting competition and camaraderie. The event centre is in Owińska, near Poznań, and the finish is at the bathing area. The event will take place on 20 June 2026.
course_highlights: Routes follow forest roads, tracks, trails and ravines
Scenic nature reserves and lakes in the Zielonka Forest
Long-distance, point-to-point cross-country running and walking
additional: Starts are staggered: 7:00 — 100+ km ultramarathon and 21+ km Nordic Walking; 8:00 — 21+, 42+ and 75+ km runs; 10:00 — 10+ km run and Nordic Walking. The time limit is 12 hours (14 hours for the 100+ km ultramarathon). The event centre and race office are in Owińska at Traperska Osada; the finish is at the bathing area. The organiser provides refreshment stations and post-race recovery meals. Distances range from 10 km to 100 km. The event takes place in forest areas and features cross-country routes, Nordic Walking events, a 12–14-hour time limit, and registration online and on Facebook.

name: Heuvelrugloop
description: The Heuvelrugloop is a popular forest run in Maarn, known as the most beautiful forest run in the Netherlands. The race is part of the Heuvelrug Loop Challenge, in which participants can also take part in the Uilentoren Loop Leersum and the Koploop in Amerongen for a combined ranking and a discount. The event offers challenging courses through the wooded area of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and attracts around 1,000 runners each year. A running clinic is also available to help participants prepare for the 5 km and 10 km distances.
course_highlights: Wooded setting in the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Distances of 4.2 km, 10 km and half marathon
Participants experience a challenging and varied course
additional: The Heuvelrugloop is part of the Heuvelrug Loop Challenge, offering additional recognition and a discount for taking part in multiple events. A running clinic is available through RunXperience to help participants prepare for the 5 km and 10 km. The event attracts around 1,000 participants each year and offers a challenging course through a wooded area. Terrain: forest; registration: not specified; part of a challenge featuring multiple runs; preparation through RunXperience.nl

name: Gorch-Fock-Lauf Wilhelmshaven
distance_verbose: Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 1500 Meter, 0.6 km
description: The Gorch-Fock-Lauf in Wilhelmshaven takes place annually in June and offers distances for all age groups, including children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon and a marathon. The course runs mostly along the coastline and the inner harbor, starting on Jade-Allee and finishing in Pumpwerk Park. The course is measured by the DLV, ensuring fair competition. In addition to the sporting event, there is also a club and school race with attractive prize money to promote youth sports in the region.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course with a quality seal
Route along the coastline and the inner harbor
Start on Jade-Allee, finish in Pumpwerk Park
additional: The start area is on Jade-Allee, and the finish is in Pumpwerk Park. Timing uses a chip integrated into the bib number. A runners’ service will be held on June 13, 2026, at 6 p.m. in the Christus-Garnisonkirche. There are several refreshment stations along the course. The club and school race offers prize money to the five clubs/schools with the most participants. Changes of registration can be made online via a self-service link; no changes are possible on site. The event also includes a running service, club and school competitions, medals, shirts and prize money. Registration is online, with early-bird discounts available. The race starts on Jade-Allee and finishes in Pumpwerk Park.

name: Mendener Citylauf mit Halbmarathon und Schülerläufen

description: The 10th Menden City Run on June 14, 2026, offers an exciting sporting event with fast courses through Menden’s city centre. The event includes children’s races, a 5 km, a 10 km and a half marathon. Several event points along the course create a lively atmosphere, and participants are enthusiastically welcomed at the finish on Rathausplatz. Marathon-Club Menden e.V. warmly invites runners of all generations to take part in this traditional race.
course_highlights: Fast courses through Menden’s city centre
Several event points create a lively atmosphere along the course
Finish on Rathausplatz with an enthusiastic welcome
additional: Entry fees for participants from Menden kindergartens and schools are covered by Mendener Bank eG or Stadtsportverband Menden when registration is submitted centrally through the respective school(s). Teams with 6 or more starters receive a 25% discount on the 5 km race. Online pre-registration is available with direct debit or PayPal. Late registration is available on race day. Course in Menden, online registration, late registration on race day, parking at Neumarkt.

name: RVB Harlingerland Volkslauf
description: The RVB Harlingerland Volkslauf will be held for the 43rd time in 2026 and is organized by Lauftreff Schafhauser Wald e.V. in Dunum, Lower Saxony. The event is supported by Raiffeisen-Volksbank eG, Aurich, and offers runners and walkers of all ability levels a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. The routes pass through the beautiful Harlinger landscape, with the start and finish in Dunum. In addition to the Volkslauf, walking and Nordic walking options are available, along with an extensive photo and results archive from previous years.
course_highlights: Start on Vorackkerweg, finish at Dunum School
10 km Volkslauf with 2 laps
Half marathon and other routes with interactive course maps
additional: The event includes various distances: 10 km Volkslauf (2 laps), half marathon, 5 km Volkslauf, 7.5 km walking, and Bambini and schoolchildren's races. The start and finish are in Dunum, and the routes are available as interactive maps. The running group's training sessions are on Mondays at 19:00 and Wednesdays at 18:00, meeting at the NIGE sports ground or, from September, at the stadium on Peldmühle. Everyone is welcome, from beginners to professionals. The event takes place in June, with officially homologated courses for official performance records. It supports the German solidarity system in sport and is aimed at runners of all ages, including children and young people.

name: Globus-Theißen-Lauf
description: The Globus-Theißen Run is a community running event in Theißen, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place for the sixth time on June 21, 2026. The event offers distances for all age groups, from the Bambini race through 1.5 km, 3 km, and 7 km to 14 km. It is held at the Miners’ Stadium and is part of the Burgenland rankings for adults and the Wiesen-Grundcup for children and young people. Cake, coffee, and hearty food will be available, and there will be entertainment for children during the awards ceremony. The event is a joint project by Globus-Theissen, local clubs, and residents.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 m (Bambini) to 14 km
Start and finish at the Miners’ Stadium in Theißen
Course routes available as GPS tracks and PDFs
additional: Food and refreshments include homemade cake, coffee, and hearty dishes; proceeds support the clubs’ youth programs; entertainment for children during the awards ceremony; start and finish at the Miners’ Stadium; ample parking nearby; certificates for children at the finish; the event is part of the Burgenland rankings and the Wiesen-Grundcup. Courses for children, young people, women, men, and seniors; virtual routes are possible; a community event of regional significance

name: Reinhardswaldwalking
location: VfL Veckerhagen, Reinhardshagen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: VfL Veckerhagen 1897 e.V. warmly invites you to the 15th Reinhardswald Walking Day on 21 June 2026. Routes of 3 km, 6 km and 11 km are offered, leading through open countryside, along the edge of the forest and through the Reinhardswald. The start and finish are at the VfL Veckerhagen sports facility. Refreshment stations will be available along the way, and drinks, coffee, cake and bratwurst will be served at the finish. The three groups with the most participants will receive cash prizes.
course_highlights: Routes through open countryside, along the edge of the forest and through the Reinhardswald
Start and finish at the VfL Veckerhagen sports facility
Refreshment stations along the way
additional: The three groups with the most participants will receive cash prizes. For planning purposes, please provide a non-binding estimate of your group’s participant numbers by 13.06.2026. Participants are advised to bring a completed registration form to speed up registration on site. Participants can choose from 3 km, 6 km, 8 km and 11 km routes. The event promotes a sense of community and enjoyment of nature, with refreshments and prizes for the largest groups.

name: Sachsenlauf Coswig
price_range: 2 € erste Stunde, danach 1,50 € (Parkgebühren im Parkhaus an der Moritzburger Straße)
description: The Sachsenlauf Coswig is a long-standing sporting event held annually in June since 1980. The races follow forest roads, woodland trails and field paths through the Friedewald and into the Moritzburg Hills. A special highlight on the 21.1 km route is running through the Moritzburg State Stud to the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel. In addition to running distances, walking and hiking options cater to different fitness levels and ambitions. The event is part of the Meißner Sparkassencup and the Niederlausitzcup, and also features dedicated races for children and Bambinis, with surprises at the finish.
course_highlights: Running routes on forest roads, woodland trails and field paths in the Friedewald and Moritzburg Hills
Route through the Moritzburg State Stud, past the castle pond and Pferde-Hügel (21.1 km route)
Hiking routes on the Karras circular trails, passing natural features such as Moselwiese and Seerosenteich
additional: Start and finish are at the corner of Friedewaldstraße and Sachsenlaufweg. Awards ceremonies take place in the schoolyard. Changing rooms and restroom facilities are available in the neighboring Spitzgrund sports hall. The course closes for all distances at 14:00. Paid parking is available in the Moritzburger Straße car park. Travel by public transport (VVO bus routes 400, 401 and 405) is recommended. Children and Bambinis have their own out-and-back races (500 m and 800 m) with small surprises at the finish. Race bibs include a single-use timing transponder. Late registrations are possible on race day until 10:00; payment on site is cash only. Course adjustment due to the state championships, parking in the car park, travel by bus and train recommended, refreshments and awards ceremonies in the finish area, children’s and hiking routes

name: 10K Hamburg - Volkspark
description: The 10K Hamburg Volkspark is an exciting 10-kilometer race on fully closed and secured out-and-back routes in Hamburg. The course runs along paved and asphalt paths, offering an appealing running experience for runners of all abilities. The event is part of the 10K Hamburg series, which takes place at various attractive locations in the Elbe metropolis. Registration is online only, and the event is already sold out.
course_highlights: Fully closed and secured out-and-back routes
Runs along paved and asphalt paths
Attractive course in Hamburg’s Volkspark
additional: A bag drop for personal belongings and change of clothes is available on race day. Travel by public transport is recommended; for example, Stellingen S-Bahn station is about a 20-minute walk from the event site on Max-Schmeling-Straße. Registration is online only. The Cup ranking includes all 10K Hamburg events, with points awarded to the 30 fastest men and women. The race is open to the public, and using public transport is recommended. The event has a set distance of 10 kilometers and medals for all finishers.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 2
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Held annually, it attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. Participants can run all seven stages or choose individual stages, each approximately 10 kilometres long. The event places great importance on creating an enjoyable running experience and protecting the islands from overcrowding.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian Islands
Approximately 10 km of running per stage
Route along promenades, through dune landscapes and across the Wadden Sea UNESCO World Heritage Site
additional: Race numbers are distributed approximately 1 hour after the special ferry arrives and until 30 minutes before the start. Race numbers with an integrated timing chip are provided. Changing facilities, showers and toilets are available on the islands. Bag storage is available. Information events take place on 19.06. before the run. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:00 on Borkum. Stages on seven North Sea islands, approximately 10 km of running per stage. Registration is already full; there is no waiting list. Capacity is limited due to ferry and infrastructure constraints.

name: Barsinghäuser Fuchsbau Spendenlauf
description: The Barsinghausen Fuchsbau Charity Run is a running event in support of the “FUCHSBAU” Association – Bereavement Support for Children and Young People. Since 2010, the association has supported young people coping with the death of someone close to them. The charity run was launched in 2024 to fund Fuchsbau’s important work, as the association has relied entirely on donations since 2023. The event promotes community spirit and social engagement in Barsinghausen and will take place again in 2026.
course_highlights: Run for a good cause in Barsinghausen
A community event with a programme of activities and entertainment
Venue: REWE Sportpark Barsinghausen
additional: The charity run has prominent supporters and includes artistic performances and entertainment, such as a bouncy castle provided by Hoppeburg. Stadtwerke Barsinghausen supplies the drinking water. Jan Haller is the event’s patron for 2026. There is a dm running challenge and a programme of activities. The event takes place at REWE Sportpark. Run for 4 hours, with a variety of activities and refreshments on site; run on a sports facility; sponsors support runners per lap; family festival.

description: The Bestensee Lakes Run is a traditional race held annually in Bestensee since 2002. The race starts at the Landkostarena, surrounded by the region’s idyllic lakes and forests. The event is open to all age groups, and children and young people up to 13 years old can take part free of charge.
course_highlights: Three distances: 2 km, 7.5 km and 16 km

Route through the region’s scenic lakes and forests

name: Buchholzer Stadtlauf
location: Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Buchholz City Run is a traditional race with cult status in the Nordheide, taking place on 21 June 2026. The route runs right through the centre of Buchholz and is lined with numerous spectators, creating a special atmosphere and providing motivation. A range of distances offers suitable challenges for all ages and ability levels, from the children’s race to the popular team relay. Running training with certified coaches is also available, and all participants receive special medals and certificates.
course_highlights: Route through the centre of Buchholz
Numerous spectators along the route provide motivation
Two NLV-measured, record-eligible courses (10 km and half marathon)

Helmets are compulsory for inline skaters; full protective gear is recommended. Free finisher shirt for children and young people up to age 18; adults pay €5 per shirt. Drinks are provided every 5 km, with tea and water available more frequently. Various distances, running training, children’s races, measured courses, prizes for winners, medals, certificates, free finisher shirt for young people, drinks every 5 km, team competition.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Norderney (2. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. It takes place from 20 to 27 June 2026 and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad. The individual stages follow varied routes featuring maritime charm, dune landscapes and the Wadden Sea UNESCO World Heritage Site. The event offers a unique running experience, with each stage starting and finishing on an island, as well as comprehensive facilities including race-number collection, sports-bag storage and on-site awards ceremonies.
course_highlights: A stage race across seven East Frisian Islands, with approximately 10 km per stage
Routes through dune landscapes, beaches and the Wadden Sea UNESCO World Heritage Site
Each stage starts and finishes on an island, with maritime charm and fresh North Sea air
additional: Race numbers are collected on each island, for example at the tourist information office on Norderney from 10:00 to 12:00. Sports-bag storage is available on the islands, for example at the Conversationshaus on Norderney from 11:30 to 14:30. Showers, changing rooms and toilets are available on the islands. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:00 on the Kurplatz or at comparable locations. The race number includes an integrated timing chip and is valid for all stages. There is no waiting list or reserve list, and race entries cannot be transferred. The stage race covers seven islands. Participant numbers are limited due to infrastructure and ferry capacity. Registration is full; there is no waiting list.

name: Lamspringer Klosterlauf
description: The Lamspringe Monastery Run is an annual running and walking event starting and finishing at Lamspringe Forest Stadium. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including children's races, and is part of the Südniedersachsen Cup. Runners, walkers and hiking enthusiasts are warmly invited to enjoy the varied routes through the countryside around Lamspringe. The event combines sporting ambition with fun and a sense of community in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Lamspringe Forest Stadium
Several running and walking routes at various distances
Children's races and routes from 400 m to 23 km
additional: On-site late registration is available until 1 hour before the start. Distances: 400 m, 1 km, 2 km, 5 km, 15 km, 23 km. The event is part of the Südniedersachsen Cup. Start and finish at Lamspringe Forest Stadium; various distances (1 km, 5 km, 8 km, 13 km, 22.9 km); changing rooms and showers; refreshments available on site; part of the Südniedersachsen Cup.

description: The 16th Sababurg Zoo Run takes place on June 21, 2026, in the picturesque Sababurg Zoo and the adjacent Reinhardswald Forest. Runners will be cheered on by enthusiastic spectators and enjoy a unique natural setting on carefully selected courses. The run is a charity event in support of the planned Amphibian World, a new nature learning center that is to be created at the zoo. The Zoo Run is also part of the Reinhardswald Running and Walking Cup and offers courses for various age groups and ability levels.
course_highlights: Running courses in Sababurg Zoo and the adjacent Reinhardswald Forest
Beautiful views of the zoo, its animals, and Sababurg Castle
Courses on paved park paths, suitable for beginners and experienced runners
additional: Race bibs with transponders will be issued on race day and must be worn clearly visible at the front. Timing is by transponder. Aid stations with mineral water and bananas are available approximately every 3–4 km. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Bambinis may be accompanied by an adult but may not be carried. Dogs and baby joggers are not permitted on the running courses. Part of the Reinhardswald Running and Walking Cup series. Registration is open from May 1 to June 19, 2026; no registration on race day.

name: Schlossinsellauf Lübben
description: The Schlossinsellauf Lübben is a traditional running event on the idyllic Schlossinsel in the town of Lübben in the Spreewald. It offers courses for children, young people and adults, including Bambini runs, children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon and a Run & Bike half marathon. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and varied route, which runs both on the Schlossinsel and through the surrounding Spreewald area. The race is part of the Spreewald Cup and attracts numerous runners every year.
course_highlights: Courses on the idyllic Schlossinsel in Lübben
A range of distances, from the 550 m Bambini run to the half marathon and Run & Bike
Part of the Spreewald Cup, with a varied route
additional: Overall participant limit of 1,000 starters. Registration is binding and cannot be cancelled. Entry fees are collected by direct debit. Group and club registration is available. Age categories are defined for the children’s and youth races. The event is part of the Spreewald Cup. Changing rooms, cloakrooms, showers, medical care, refreshments and entertainment are available on site. Various race distances (Bambini, children’s races, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, Run & Bike). Registration opens on 01.02.2026. Participant limit: 1,000.

name: Töpfermarktlauf Bürgel
description: The Töpfermarktlauf in Bürgel is a long-standing race that has been established as a sporting highlight in the Saale-Holzland district since the 1990s. The event offers a range of distances, including the challenging 12 km main race and the 6 km beginners’ race, which pass through the varied landscape around Bürgel. All participants receive a handmade, pottery-crafted medal as a keepsake. The event is family-friendly, with children’s and schoolchildren’s races, and takes place on Sunday morning to make it possible for as many running enthusiasts as possible to take part.
course_highlights: 12 km main race with a challenging elevation profile for experienced runners
6 km beginners’ race on a varied route around Bürgel
Water stations along the course and refreshments at the finish
additional: Every participant receives a unique, handmade, pottery-crafted medal. Medals go to the first 250 registrants in the 12 km main race and the 6 km beginners’ race, as well as the first 200 children and schoolchildren. The awards ceremony takes place at approximately 11:00 a.m. at the sports field. Overall winners receive pottery-crafted trophies and certificates. There is no parking directly at the sports field, but designated parking areas are nearby. Timing is electronic and provided by GO-timing. The course is clearly marked, and the fire brigade ensures safety at road crossings. A bicycle escort accompanies all courses. Courses for children, beginners, recreational and elite runners; anniversary event; family and community atmosphere

The route runs through the city streets, offering participants a great atmosphere, sporting excitement, and positive energy. The event is family-friendly, with children’s races over distances from 100 to 600 metres, tailored to different age groups. Every child taking part in the races will receive a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish. It is one of the largest running events in the region, combining sporting competition with fun for the whole family.

Children’s races over distances from 100 to 600 metres, tailored to different age groups
An atmosphere full of sporting excitement and positive energy
additional: The McDonald’s Gryfice children’s races start at 10:00. Every child will receive a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish. Online registration is available for the children’s races. The entry fee on race day, payable at the race office, is 50 zł. The event takes place in the city of Gryfice, with a road route and electronic timing. Online registration is available; medals and prizes are planned for the best finishers. The participant limit for the main race is 150.

description: Bieg Świecie Biega Brzegiem Deczna is an annual running event held in the picturesque area of Deczno near Świecie. The main 10 km race takes participants through the Recreation and Leisure Centre grounds, offering an appealing course and sporting competition. The event also includes free races for children, making it a family-friendly and inclusive event. The organizers provide professional timing and race packs with T-shirts for early registrants. The main race is limited to 300 participants, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km course around the Deczno Recreation and Leisure Centre
Picturesque areas along the banks of the Deczna River
Children’s races as an integral part of the event
additional: The main race is limited to 300 participants, and the children’s races to 100 participants. The children’s races are free. The race pack includes a T-shirt for registrations received by May 31. The children’s races start at 10:00, and the main race starts at 11:00. Organizer contact: Bartosz Gładyszew, tel. 669-056-101. The event also includes competitions for children and attractive prizes for the top runners.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 2
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon that divides the classic distance of 42.195 km into seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each. The route follows loops through the beautiful countryside around Osterode in the Harz foothills. The event is open to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers, and also offers a Kids’ stage for younger participants. The event is organised by regional clubs and will take place for the 18th time in 2026.
course_highlights: Seven stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each, following loop courses
Countryside in the Harz foothills around Osterode
Additional 750-metre Kids’ stage in Schützenpark
additional: The stages start at 18:45 each day, except for the first stage on 21 June at 10:45 and the final stage on 27 June at 16:00. The awards ceremony takes place on 27 June at 18:00. Runners, walkers and Nordic walkers may participate. Minors need written consent from a parent or guardian. Club membership is not required. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshment stations and social activities at the finish. Registration is mainly by email, and the routes are tailored to the stages scheduled for each day.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 3
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of around 10 km each, travelling from island to island. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad and offers a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere, dune landscapes and the UNESCO World Heritage Wadden Sea. Due to limited ferry capacity and infrastructure, the number of participants is limited, ensuring an exclusive and well-organised event.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian Islands
Around 10 km per stage
Dunes, beaches and the UNESCO World Heritage Wadden Sea
additional: Race bibs are distributed from approximately 1 hour after the special ferry arrives until 30 minutes before the start. The race bib, with an integrated timing chip, is used for all stages. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available on the islands. Bag storage is provided. Information events are held on 19.06. before the race. The awards ceremony takes place at 15:00 on Borkum. Stage race across seven islands; no waiting list; limited number of participants; race entries cannot be transferred.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Baltrum (3. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run on Baltrum is the third stage of a popular running series on the East Frisian Islands. The car-free island of Baltrum offers a peaceful, natural setting with wide sandy beaches and the Wadden Sea, ideal for runners seeking nature and relaxation. The start and finish are on the village square in front of the town hall, and the event is well suited to families, walkers, and anyone looking to escape the stresses of everyday life. The awards ceremony takes place on the village square on the same day.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the village square in front of the town hall
Run through the car-free, natural island of Baltrum, with its wide sandy beaches
Charming island-village atmosphere and Wadden Sea setting
additional: Race bib collection from 09:00 to 11:00 at Haus des Gastes. Bag storage from 10:30 to 13:30 at Haus des Gastes and Sanitärhaus Ost. Changing facilities at Haus des Gastes and the town hall. Showers at SindBad, Mehrzweckhalle, and Sanitärhaus Ost. Toilets at several locations near the harbor, town hall, Haus des Gastes, SindBad, Mehrzweckhalle, and Sanitärhaus Ost. Awards ceremony at 14:00 on the village square in front of the town hall. The start and finish are on the village square in front of the town hall, with extensive facilities including changing rooms, showers, and bag storage. The awards ceremony takes place at 14:00. The event is part of the larger North Sea Run, which takes place from 20 to 27 June 2026 on several islands.

name: Sparkassen-Minimarathon
description: The Sparkassen Mini Marathon in Karlsruhe is a special running festival for children and young people, taking place on September 19, 2026, at the Carl-Kaufmann Stadium. Three distances are offered: the Mini Marathon, approximately 4.2 km; the Mini Half Marathon, approximately 2.1 km; and the Bambini Run, approximately 333 m. All races start and finish in the stadium, with the longer distances passing through the beautiful Günther-Klotz-Anlage. The event is inclusive and offers every child a medal and a personalized online certificate. Timing is done using a chip in the race number.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Carl-Kaufmann Stadium in Karlsruhe-Beiertheim
The Mini Marathon and Mini Half Marathon pass through the Günther-Klotz-Anlage
Inclusive event; children with disabilities may be accompanied by a support person
additional: Race number collection on event day from 11:00 until 30 minutes before each start. Changes to registration details can be made online free of charge. The timing chip is included in the race number. Prizes for the three fastest girls and boys in the Mini Marathon and Mini Half Marathon. Results and personalized certificates are available online. Distances: approximately 4.2 km, 2.1 km, and 333 m; registration on event day; inclusion for children with disabilities; start at the Carl-Kaufmann Stadium.

name: Böda Beach Run
location: Böda Sand-stranden, Löttorp, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Böda Beach Run is a race that stands out at Böda Sand. It is a challenging competition on sand and in water, suited both to those looking to compete and to families looking to have fun, with courses ranging from 500 metres to 10 km. Everyone who finishes receives a medal. The event is held at Böda Sand Beach Resort on 24 June.
course_highlights: Courses from 500 m to 10 km
A challenging competition on sand and in water
A medal for everyone who finishes
additional: Date: 24 June. The event takes place at Böda Sand Beach Resort (Bödasandsallén 11, 387 73 Löttorp). Contact/phone for Böda Sand: (+46)485-22200. The event is promoted as family-friendly and recurring in the resort’s events calendar. Special accommodation offers are available at Böda Sand; late registration and race-number pickup take place at Nordpoolen at 12:00 on race day.

name: Karlstad Stadslopp
description: Karlstad Stadslopp is a popular 10 km race in Karlstad, with something for every runner—from those chasing a personal best to those who want to enjoy the community atmosphere along the Klarälven. The event offers the classic 10 km, a shorter 5 km, and the Karlstad Minilopp and Miniminilopp for younger participants. The race starts at Tingvallabron and finishes in Museiparken; the 2026 edition opens SM‑veckan and will be broadcast on SVT. The organiser, IF Göta Karlstad, welcomes participants of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Start at Tingvallabron
Finish in Museiparken
Route along the Klarälven
additional: When registering, provide an estimated finish time for seeding; young people born in 2008 or later and students receive a 100 kr discount during certain periods; a 10 km team competition is available (at least six participants per team)—contact tavling@ifgota.se to register a team; payment via PlusGiro (47 37 91-2), with instructions for the race category and name; gift vouchers can be purchased via PG and notified to info@ifgota.se; participant information (PM) is sent by email and published on the website; After Run and a concert in Museiparken are part of the opening of SM‑veckan; the race is part of SM‑veckan 2026 and will be broadcast on SVT. The race offers 10 km and 5 km, as well as the Karlstad Minilopp (ages 7–12) and Miniminilopp (ages 0–6). Minimum age: 12; dogs are not allowed; walkers with a stroller or rollator may start in the last start group; participation is at your own risk; entry fees are non-refundable; publication of photos on the website and social media is permitted.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 4

description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon held in seven enjoyable after-work stages of 5 to 7 kilometres each around Osterode am Harz. The fourth stage runs through the beautiful Beber nature reserve in Schwiegershausen, with varied paths of gravel, concrete and grass. The start and finish are at Schwiegershausen Sports Hall, and the route offers a great view of the Harz as well as a mix of gentle and steep sections. The race is open to anyone physically able to run about 7 kilometres without stopping, and promotes a sense of community among regional clubs.
course_highlights: Beber nature reserve with varied paths
Great view of the Harz after a steep climb
A mix of gravel, concrete and grass paths
additional: The awards ceremony takes place on Saturday, 27 June 2026 at 18:00, with a raffle of prizes. The 750 m Kids’ Stage is offered on 27 June 2026. The event is jointly organised by seven regional clubs. You can take part without being a club member. Minors need written consent from their parents. Multi-stage marathon event, scenic route through Beber, start and finish in Schwiegershausen

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 4
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Over eight days, participants run, walk or Nordic walk stages of around 10 km on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from across Germany and abroad, offering a unique running experience with a maritime atmosphere and a chance to enjoy nature. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and sells out quickly.

Approx. 10 km per stage
Scenery featuring dunes, beaches and the UNESCO World Heritage Wadden Sea

Stage race across seven islands, approx. 10 km per stage, no waiting list, limited capacity due to ferry and infrastructure constraints, fully booked.

There is also a 25 x 400-meter team race and a Bambini run for children. The event features a varied course on the university campus and is open to all age groups and ability levels.

25 x 400-meter team race on a 400-meter loop
Bambini run for children aged 2 to 6 over a 400-meter lap

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Juist (4. Etappe)
location: Kurplatz, Juist, Nordsee, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the Lower Saxony North Sea coast. Stage 4 takes place on June 24, 2026, on the island of Juist, the longest of the islands at 17 kilometers, known for its dunes and Juist Water Tower. The start and finish are at Kurplatz, and the event offers runners and walkers a unique experience surrounded by nature and the sea. The race bib is valid for all stages and is issued with an integrated timing chip.

Dune landscape with dunes up to 22 m high and Juist Water Tower
Start and finish at Kurplatz, Juist

There is also a 750-metre kids’ stage on 27 June in Schützenpark.

name: Bremer Firmenlauf zur Spätschicht
description: The Bremen Corporate Run for the Late Shift is a community running event covering approximately 5 km around the Weser weir in Bremen, with team spirit and togetherness at its heart. It is aimed at companies, groups of friends and running communities who want to run or walk together without the pressure to perform. New for 2026, official timekeeping will be available for the first time for anyone who wants to measure their athletic performance. After the run, a lively after-run party with music, food and drinks provides a relaxed end to the evening.

Start and finish area behind Paulaner’s im Wehrschloss
At least one refreshment point along the course and refreshments at the finish

Race numbers must be worn clearly visible on the chest; race number belts are not allowed. Showers and changing rooms are available on site. The course is a loop, completed once. The route passes through Pauliner Marsch, Werdersee and the marina. Registration is online; participation is open to groups of 5 or more, and includes refreshments along the course and music at the party. The event is open to everyone, regardless of ability level.

name: DAK FIRMENLAUF Nordhessen 2026
description: The DAK Nord Hesse Company Run has been organised by FTSV Heckershausen 1890 e.V. since 2011 and is held under the motto “Running together—for your health. For life.” The event promotes health and the enjoyment of exercise and is open to teams and individual runners. The course is approximately 5.3 km long and runs mainly on unpaved paths, with a short asphalt section. The event takes place on 25 June 2026 at 18:30 and offers refreshing drinks and changing facilities on site.
course_highlights: Course approximately 5.3 km long
Mainly unpaved paths, with approximately 1 km of asphalt
Refreshment stations approximately every 2 km and in the finish area

Road traffic regulations must be observed. Event date: 25.06.2026. Course and registration details are available on the website; results will be published online.

name: Firmenlauf Bremerhaven
description: The 9th Bremerhaven Company Run takes place on Thursday, June 25, 2026, and is open to employees and apprentices from companies, government agencies, and other organizations. Participants run a 6 km loop from the Nordsee-Stadion through Speckenbüttler Park. With a limit of 500 participants, the event offers teams a great opportunity to compete athletically and have fun together. Groups receive a free-entry discount when at least 10 participants are registered by the end of May. The event is well established and very popular in the region.
course_highlights: 6 km loop from the Nordsee-Stadion through Speckenbüttler Park
Run for employees and apprentices from companies and government agencies
Limited parking available; alternative transport is recommended

name: De Ronde van Nieuwveen
location: W.P. Speelmanweg, Nieuwveen, South Holland, Netherlands

description: The Ronde van Nieuwveen is a running race held in and around the village of Nieuwveen, and is part of the Gemeente Nieuwkoop Circuit. The race takes place on the longest evening of the year and offers various distances for both children and adults. Children up to age 13 can take part in free kids’ runs of 400 m, 800 m and 1.7 km, while adults can choose from 5 km, 10 km and 15 km routes. The race features a varied course through the neighbourhood and village, with special attention paid to ensuring runners are well spread out along the course.

5 km, 10 km and 15 km routes running through and around Nieuwveen

Children can participate for free, but advance registration is requested to keep things running smoothly. Course through and around Nieuwveen, various distances for children and adults, free participation for children and the G-run, changing facilities and supervised bag drop.

name: Trosa Stadslopp
description: Trosa Stadslopp is a long-running community celebration, always held on the first Friday after Midsummer. In 2026, the race takes place on Friday, 26 June. The course runs through picturesque summer-time Trosa, with large crowds and close to the water, creating a summery atmosphere for both competition and recreation. The event offers categories for elite runners, recreational runners, young people and children, as well as the 8,900 m main race and shorter recreational options.

Start and finish at Trosa square, with large crowds and stage activities

Folksam recreational race insurance is available (e.g. SEK 155 for basic cover, Startklar Plus SEK 275). Bib collection opens at 10:00 at Team Sportia on race day. The 8,900 m main race has start groups based on target times (start group 1 at 21:00, followed by additional groups); there is also a children's race (700 m) and award ceremonies on stage. The organiser gives 50 cl of Vitamin Well to runners in the 8,900 m and 4 km races. The programme also includes 700 m and 900 m distances, Jogging/Walking with poles over 4 km, and information about night buses to Stockholm after the race.
