description: The BikeNavy! Run is a unique running event that takes place on the grounds of Nordholz Sports Airfield, which is otherwise not open to the public. The course runs within the restricted zone of the Nordholz Naval Air Base and offers participants a special atmosphere, with views of historic and modern aviation. After the race, visitors can explore the AERONAUTICUM Naval Aviation and Airship Museum. The event is ideal for runners looking for an unusual and unforgettable running experience.
course_highlights: Course across the grounds of Nordholz Sports Airfield
Route within the restricted zone of the Nordholz Naval Air Base
Close to the AERONAUTICUM Naval Aviation and Airship Museum
additional: On event day, food and drinks are available from 9:00 a.m. There is a charity raffle, and entry to the “Last Man Standing” show race is free from 10:30 a.m. Various races are offered for children and adults. Ample parking is available at Nordholz Sports Airfield. The venue can also be reached by public transport and bicycle. The event features various categories, including children’s races, duathlons and cycling races, as well as entertainment, registration and charity activities. After the race, visitors can explore the nearby AERONAUTICUM Naval Aviation and Airship Museum.

name: Halderner Volkslauf
description: The Haldern Volkslauf is a long-standing race that brings young and old together and fosters a sense of community among friends and families. The event will take place again on June 28, 2026, with the half marathon remaining permanently on the program following positive feedback. The event offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all abilities and welcomes participants.
course_highlights: Running together, young and old
Half marathon as a permanent part of the program
Event in Rees-Haldern with a family-friendly character
additional: The event includes a half marathon, online registration is open until June 22, and results from previous years are published.

name: Ohndorfer Volkslauf
description: The Ohndorf Fun Run is a family-friendly running event held annually in Ohndorf and is part of the Schaumburg Running Series. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners of all ages and ability levels. Online registration is available until the day of the event, with on-site late registration open until 30 minutes before the start. The run is attracting growing numbers of participants and offers a great opportunity to exercise together and experience a sense of community.
course_highlights: Various running distances for all ages and ability levels
Family- and team-oriented event with competitions
Traditional, family-friendly running event in Ohndorf
additional: Online registration is open until 3 p.m. on the day of the event. Late registration is available on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the start time. The Kurparklauf is canceled in 2026, so there will be no Samtgemeinde Cup scoring. Multiple running distances, team competition, family-friendly atmosphere; June weather is usually sunny.

name: Seester Sternenlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Handicaplauf für Menschen mit Behinderungen (auch Rollstuhlfahrer/innen): 8 EUR (Begleitperson frei)

description: The Seester Star Run will take place for the tenth time on 28 June 2026. It is a charity run in support of the Kinder-Hospiz Sternenbrücke in Hamburg. The event offers various distances for runners, walkers, Nordic walkers and Bambinis, including a special 10 km loop through the historic Lindenallee at Gut Seestermühe. Grill sausages, coffee and cake will be available, and the route will be lined with decorated streets and a great atmosphere. The organising team looks forward to welcoming many participants and spectators to this joyful and successful event.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the historic Lindenallee at Gut Seestermühe
Distances of 1 km (Bambini), 3 km, 5 km and 10 km
Start and finish at Seester Primary School
additional: Start and finish at Seester Primary School, Dorfstr. 43, 25370 Seester. Parking is available exclusively on Schulsteig, a dead-end street. Late registrations are not possible; changing the race distance is free of charge up to one day before the start. Participation is at your own risk. Star Run performance shirts, tank tops and sports/gym bags can be ordered for an additional fee. The run is a charity event focused on community and giving, with various distances for runners and walkers, as well as a children's race. Participation is open to everyone and supports the important work of the children's hospice.

name: Weiner Family Run 2026
description: The Weiner Family Run 2026 is a family-friendly running event organized by the FC Schwarz-Weiß Weiner running group on June 28, 2026. It is open to runners, walkers, children, and toddlers, with various distances ranging from approximately 500 meters to 10 kilometers. The focus is on enjoying physical activity and sharing the experience in a relaxed atmosphere. The start and finish area is at Sparkassenpark Weiner, and the routes run through the Weiner countryside. Participants can also enjoy a family-friendly program with an emcee and refreshments.
course_highlights: Start and finish area at Sparkassenpark Weiner
Routes through the Weiner countryside
Distances from the toddler run (approx. 500 m) to 10 km
additional: Online registration opens on February 7, 2026, via my race|result. A family-friendly program with an emcee and refreshments is available for participants. Races for all age groups include toddlers, children and teenagers, 5 km, and 10 km. Multiple race distances, family-friendly event, online registration opens February 7, 2026, start and finish at the SW Weiner Sparkassenpark.

name: Łabiszyński Bieg Świętojański
organizer: Łabiszyński Dom Kultury, Urząd Miejski w Łabiszynie, F.W. Martex, Uczniowski Klub Sportowy Łabiszynianka
price_range: najtańsze pakiety startowe dla pierwszych zarejestrowanych
description: The Łabiszyn St. John’s Run is an annual running event taking place on June 28, 2026, at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn. The main 5 km race starts at 10:00, followed by children’s and youth races in four age categories. Participants in the main race will receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger runners will receive a medal and a surprise. The top runners will be presented with awards after the event. The event is part of a running series and offers race packages to the first people to register.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Łabiszyn
5 km main race course
Children’s and youth races in 4 age categories
additional: Race packages with the lowest entry fees are available to the first people to register. Children’s and youth races with medals and surprises will follow the main race. Awards will be presented to the top runners after all races. Urban setting, medals, surprises, awards ceremony, 1-hour time limit, event promoting a healthy lifestyle.

name: Montagslauf Rund um Mackenzell
description: The Montagslauf Rund um Mackenzell is a traditional fun run held in the idyllic surroundings of Hünfeld-Mackenzell. The event offers several distances, including a children’s race, 5.3 km, 10 km, and a 14.3 km route with an additional loop. The courses pass through varied landscapes, with refreshment stations along the way. The event has a family-friendly atmosphere, with medical support provided by the Red Cross. Showers are available after the race, and untimed Nordic walking is also offered.
course_highlights: 5.3 km course through varied landscapes
10 km course with an additional 4.3 km loop for a total distance of 14.3 km
Refreshment stations and medical support provided by the Red Cross
additional: Children’s race: 2 km, start at 18:30; 5.3 km: start at 19:00; 10 km and 14.3 km: start at approx. 19:10. Untimed Nordic walking available over 5 km or 10 km. Register on site or using a form; payment in cash on site. Showers available after the race. Children’s race registration is mainly handled through schools. Courses, on-site or form-based registration, refreshments, showers, award ceremonies, and a Weißbier evening with brass-band music held in parallel.

name: 36. Göttinger Altstadtlauf
description: The Göttingen Old Town Run is a long-standing running event in downtown Göttingen, taking place for the 36th time in 2026. The event combines running with the special atmosphere of the old town and attracts runners of all ages. In addition to the main race, there are several school races and a popular company race with team scoring. The course runs through the historic city center and offers a lively atmosphere full of excitement and activity.
course_highlights: Course through historic Göttingen city center
Several shortened old-town loops for schoolchildren and young people
Team scoring in the company cup, with a coveted challenge trophy
additional: Race bibs can be collected on several days before the race at FIZ - Fitness and Health Center of the University of Göttingen. Company cup with special and team scoring. Cut-off times for the main race are 18:50 and 19:35. No race-day entries are possible. Contact via form and telephone hotline before the event. Online registration until June 14, 2026; no race-day entries; includes the school race and company race. Race through the city center with historic charm.

name: 32. Lippesee Marathon
description: The 32nd Lippesee Marathon in Paderborn-Sande is a private marathon held according to the rules of 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, covering a total of 42.7 km around Lake Lippesee, a popular recreational area and water sports centre. Participants must provide their own refreshments, as there are no aid stations, and record their time manually. A photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof. The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, is limited to 18 participants, and will take place only if at least five participants register.
course_highlights: 7 large laps of 6.1 km each, 42.7 km in total
Course around Lake Lippesee, a popular recreational and water sports area
Depending on the weather, the course is marked with arrows or barrier tape
additional: Time is recorded manually using a stopwatch; proof must be emailed on race day as a photo of the clock. Showers and changing rooms are not available. Participants must provide their own refreshments, as none are provided, but they pass their cars after every lap. Minimum age: 18. Participant limit: 18. Register by email no later than 6 p.m. on the day before the race, providing personal details. A liability waiver and consent to the use of photos and videos are part of the registration. Course: 7 laps of 6.1 km around Lake Lippesee; no showers or changing rooms on site; participation at your own risk; limited field (18); registration by email.

name: Böda Sandsloppet
location: Böda Sand SportCamp, Böda Sand, Öland, Sweden
description: Böda Sandsloppet is a family-friendly fun run held at Böda Sand on Öland by Högby IF Athletics. The race offers several distances for adults and young people: 6.5 km and 4 km for adults, and 1.8 km and 1 km for young people, with the start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp. Everyone who finishes receives a medal, and a highlight of the main race is a sausage after the finish. Register at olandrunning.se or on site. The registration deadline is June 26, 2026, with late registration available until July 1.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in the Böda Sand area on Öland
Distance options: 6.5 km and 4 km for adults; 1.8 km and 1 km for young people
All finishers receive a medal, and sausages are served after the finish
additional: Start and finish at Böda Sand SportCamp. Registration deadline: June 26, 2026; late registration available until July 1. Register at olandrunning.se or on site. Payment by cash, card or Swish.

name: Byrundan
location: Unos Park, Gamleby, Västervik Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Byrundan is a city race held in Gamleby, starting and finishing in Unos Park. The event offers races for all ages and is well suited to both recreational runners and families. Welcome on 3 July 2026 — registration opens shortly.
course_highlights: Takes place in Gamleby’s urban setting
Starts and finishes in Unos Park
Races for all ages
additional: Registration opens shortly; start and finish in Unos Park; races are offered for all ages; organiser’s postal address: C/o Lena Persson, Lapserums Gård, 594 92 Gamleby. The race is held indoors in Unos Park; registration opens shortly for 2026-07-03.

name: Büsumer Volkslauf
description: The Büsum Volkslauf is an annual running event suitable for beginners and experienced runners alike. Various distances are offered, from 400 metres for children to 10 kilometres for experienced runners. The new route follows the waterfront promenade, loops around the Familienlagune and returns, with the start and finish at Büsumer Hauptrand. The event promises a sporty day on the North Sea coast with a beautiful running backdrop.
course_highlights: New route along the waterfront promenade
Loop around the Familienlagune
Start and finish at Büsumer Hauptrand
additional: Three race distances: 400 m Bambini Run at 18:15, 5.5 km health run at 19:00, and 10 km race at 19:00. Registration is also possible by phone at 0176 96204634. Running event on the North Sea coast in Büsum, with routes for Bambini runners, health runners and competitive runners; finish at the swimming pool; registration online and by phone; start and finish at Büsumer Hauptrand; route along the promenade and around the Familienlagune.

name: Drevenacker Volksbank Abendlauf
description: The Drevenacker Volksbank Evening Run is a traditional running event in Hünxe-Drevenack, organized by the TUS Drevenack TL-Abteilung e.V. Various races take place on the event day, a Friday in July, including an officially measured 10 km road race, a 5 km jogging race with a youth category, a 5 km non-competitive walk, and children’s and toddlers’ races. The course runs through the scenic surrounding area, with the start and finish at the sports field on Buschweg. The event offers suitable competitions for all age groups and professional timing by the TAF Timing Team.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km course with age groups in five-year increments
5 km jogging race with a separate youth category and an officially measured course
Children’s and toddlers’ races for children and young people, with age-appropriate distances
additional: The start and finish are at the sports field on Buschweg. Women start at the tennis clubhouse, and men start in the gym on Buschweg. A €2.00 deposit is charged for the timing chip for each race number and refunded when it is returned. Late registrations are possible on the event day from 16:30 until 45 minutes before the respective start, subject to capacity. Every participant receives a certificate; prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in each age group. Online registration is available; the event is part of the Lippe-Issel-Cup; results are available online.

name: Marburger Nachtmarathon
description: The Marburg Night Marathon will take place for the 27th time on 3 July 2026 and is the largest running event in the Central Hesse region. The event offers a classic marathon, a half marathon, and a relay marathon with up to four participants. The course passes through Marburg’s picturesque old town and along the Lahn, following a flat, record-eligible loop with views of Landgrave Castle and St. Elizabeth’s Church. The race starts in a special atmosphere at 7 p.m. in the historic market square, and the finish is at the University Stadium. All participants receive a high-quality medal featuring a notable Marburg landmark each year.
course_highlights: Flat, record-eligible loop course
Route passes through the old town and along the Lahn
Views of Landgrave Castle and St. Elizabeth’s Church
additional: The relay marathon consists of four runners, each completing a leg of around ten kilometres. The first relay runner starts in the market square, and the exchange zone is on Frankfurter Straße. Each team receives one race number attached to an elastic race-number belt. Safety pins are provided at registration. The number of participants is limited to ensure safety and an enjoyable running experience. The start and finish are at the University Stadium, about 1 km from the starting point. Course in Marburg’s city area, start at Georg-Gaßman-Stadion, relay exchange on Frankfurter Straße, registration opens on 1 March 2026

name: Rotenburger Strandfestlauf - Rotenburg rennt
location: Rotenburg an der Fulda, Hesse, Germany
price_range: 1 Euro Startgeld für Bambini, vergünstigte Preise für Schüler- und Jugendläufe
description: The Rotenburg Strandfest Run takes place every year on the first Friday in July as part of the traditional Heimat- und Strandfest in Rotenburg an der Fulda. The flat, fast course runs through the town centre and offers various events for young runners, main-race participants, elite runners and teams, as well as walking. New features include precisely measured school and elite races, plus the Beer Mile, where having fun is the main focus. The event combines sporting ambition with a friendly, social atmosphere and is a highlight of the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Rotenburg town centre
School race: exactly 1,248 metres—a tribute to the year Rotenburg was founded
Elite race over 1.609 km (land mile), with entry requirements
additional: No on-site registration is possible; advance registration is available only through specialist portals. The 5 km and 10 km courses are no longer offered; instead, the main race covers a 1.5 km course five times. The Beer Mile has no timing and includes four alcohol-free beer breaks at 400 m intervals. Elite race entry requirements: men, 03:10 min/km; women, 03:30 min/km. Events for young runners, main-race participants, elite runners and teams, plus walking. Preparation through a running group; supported by Sparkasse.

name: Bad Essener Abendlauf
location: Kirchplatz, Bad Essen, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 3,00 EUR Schüler und Jugendliche bis 18 Jahre

description: The 29th International Bad Essen Evening Run takes place on July 3, 2026, at Kirchplatz in Bad Essen. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with races for all ages and ability levels, including a Bambini run, a schoolchildren’s race, a relay, an open race, and a 10 km main race. A particular highlight is the new relay, with a shortened 6 x 400 m course that makes it easier for more children, young people, and adults to take part. Food and drinks will be available at Kirchplatz. Participants from the partner town of Bolbec, France, traditionally take part, underscoring the event’s international character.
course_highlights: Relay race with a 6 x 400 m course and just two changeover points
Three-lap 10 km main race starting and finishing at Kirchplatz in Bad Essen
Drinks available on the course in hot weather
additional: The Bambini run has no registration or entry fee. Late registration is available on the event day until 30 minutes before the race for a €2 fee. Race numbers can be collected at the venue on race day until approximately 30 minutes before the start. A drinks and sausage stand will be available at Kirchplatz. Multiple race distances, registration on-site and online, family-friendly event, international participants, food and drinks available on-site.

name: Bocksten Trailrun
location: Öströö Fårfarm, Åkulla Bokskogar, Varberg Municipality, Halland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: Marathon, 24 km, Halvmarathon, 12 km, 6.7 km, 5 km
description: Bocksten TrailRun is a nature-focused trail race with its event centre at Öströö sheep farm and courses in the Åkulla beech forests. The event offers four distances (5 km, 12 km, 22 km and Ultra 44 km) through beech and spruce forests, with lake views and varied trails. The races are spectator-friendly, have limited start places, and offer participants a special medal. Welcome to experience the joy of running and a sense of community in a magical forest setting.
course_highlights: Running in the Åkulla beech forests and enchanting spruce forests
Varied terrain: technical trails, off-trail sections and gravel roads with lake views
Plenty of elevation and scenic views; also a 6.7 km loop course for the Vineyard Backyard Ultra
additional: Distances: 5 km (start 10:15, 200 places), 12 km (start 10:00, 400 places), 22 km (start 10:30, 300 places) and Ultra 44 km (start 08:00, 100 places). The total number of start places is limited (only 1000 places). GPS coordinates for the event centre: 57.06881078975495, 12.506526026672418. Only tap water is served during the event (no plastic bottles); Tailwind and squash are available as alternatives. For the Vineyard Backyard Ultra, bringing your own cup is mandatory; a headlamp and personal medication are mandatory, and the headlamp must be worn between 20:00 and 07:00. Bib collection and registration take place in the start area (see the invitation for the specified times); if you need assistance, contact race management on 076-8159678. It is possible to take out Startklar cancellation and accident insurance (see the invitation for prices). The summer edition takes place on 27 June 2026, with distances of 5/12/22/Ultra 44 km; the winter edition is at Öströö Gård, with 5/12/24 km and 500 places. Accommodation can be booked through Åkulla Resort with a discount (code bockstentrailrun). The Backyard Ultra race at Ästad Vingård has a 6.7 km course and starts every full hour.

name: Strömstadmilen
description: Strömstadmilen is organized by Strömstad Running Club and takes place on Saturday, 4 July 2026. The race offers runner-friendly distances through central Strömstad at the most beautiful time of year in Bohuslän, with the course lined by enthusiastic crowds. The main course is an accurately measured 5 km loop that can be run once or twice (5 km or 10 km); the start and finish are inside Strömsvallen. Everyone is welcome—there are also children’s races and a walking class for those who want to enjoy the event without timekeeping.
course_highlights: Runner-friendly 5 km loop through central Strömstad (run 1 or 2 laps for 5/10 km)
The course is lined with spectators and clearly marked with numerous directional signs
Start and finish at Strömsvallen; lap changes take place in the outer lanes as instructed
additional: Bib pickup and late registration: Friday 3 July, 15:00–18:00 at Strömstad Shoppingcenter, and from 09:30 on race day at Strömsvallen. T-shirts can be pre-ordered when registering by 7 June (199 kr) and collected with the race bib; sizes are available for children and adults. Timekeeping ends at 16:45. Parking at Strömsvallen is limited; alternative parking is available at Strömstad Gymnasium (~500 m away). Everyone who finishes receives a specially designed medal; photographers will be along the course, and a selection of photos will be posted on Facebook/Instagram after the race. New walking class, approximately 3 km along Strömstadvattnet; start and finish at Friluftsmuseet/Fiskartorpet; start time 11:00; distances include 10 km as two laps of 5 km, 5 km, a 4 km walk, 1 mil for youths and 1 km for the youngest children; bib pickup and late registration via Strömstad Shoppingcenter or Strömsvallen; T-shirt, medal, awards ceremony, parking and other logistics.

description: Kolmården Ultra Trail is a welcoming but demanding trail race for both elite runners and recreational runners. Choose between the longer challenges (45 km or 60 km), with routes taking you through Kolmården Forest, up onto Kvarseboklint’s mountain ridge and down to the shore of Bråviken, onward past the natural surroundings of Nävsjön, and finally through the technical Bråviksbranten before the finish. The race combines technical trails, boardwalks across bogs and spectacular views, with well-equipped aid stations along the way. The organizer emphasizes safety and mandatory equipment, as well as a medal and light refreshments at the finish.
course_highlights: Kvarseboklint’s impressive mountain ridge with views
Descent to the shore of Bråviken and passage by Nävsjön, with boardwalks across vast bogs
Technical and demanding running through the Bråviksbranten Nature Reserve
additional: Mandatory equipment: mobile phone, running vest/backpack with fluids (at least 0.5 L), pressure bandage/blood-stopping dressing, and a map with the emergency number (provided at bib collection). Aid stations: 45K = 4; 60K = 5 (detailed stations with different energy products are listed for the 48 km variant). Bib collection from 05:30; bibs must be collected at least 30 minutes before the start. The course is marked with large orange arrows and flagging tape. Light refreshments and a custom-designed medal are included at the finish; massage is available at cost. Energy and fluids provided in partnership with Umara. Mandatory equipment; start times: 45K 08:00; cutoff time 13:30 at 44 km; aid stations: 45K = 4, 60K = 5; finish: a meal is included in the entry fee.

name: Läckövarvet
organizer: Kroppslabbet; Språng träning & äventyr; Stiftelsen Läckö Slott
description: Welcome to Läckövarvet, a running race starting and finishing at the magnificent Läckö Castle on Kållandsö. The race is offered over 21 km and 10 km, as well as a 2 km children’s race, and features varied terrain with forest trails, gravel roads and short sections of asphalt, along with views of Lake Vänern. The course passes well-known places such as Spiken Fishing Harbour and Roparudden, and finishes with a lap through the moat around the castle. The race is aimed at both competitive runners and families looking to enjoy a nature-rich, cultural and historic running experience.
course_highlights: Varied terrain: forest trails, gravel roads and short sections of asphalt
The course passes Spiken Fishing Harbour and the technical, scenic trails at Roparudden (cliffs and winding paths)
Start and finish at Läckö Castle, with a final lap through the moat and the finish line in front of the castle gate
additional: Courses start outside Läckö Castle; refreshments/energy supplies along the course; medical care and showers on site; lunch package for 165 kr after the finish; parking 50 kr; taking the bus to the race is recommended; included in the Västsvenska Löparcupen.

name: Mörksuggejakten TrailRun
description: Mörksuggejakten is a classic race in the long-distance cycling cup in Rättvik, enjoyed by elite cyclists and recreational riders alike. The main course is available as a 72 km route or a shortened 44 km version, featuring varied terrain with gravel roads, trails and some challenging climbs, as well as fine views over Siljan. The route passes places such as Vidablick, the Hedsåsen summer farm, the Enån valley with its narrow suspension bridges, and Dalhalla and Springkällan. The event also includes Lilla Mörksuggejakten for young riders at the Jarl area and is organised by IK Jarl.
course_highlights: Main course: 72 km (or a shorter 44 km option)
Views over Siljan from Vidablick and the Hedsåsen summer farm
Sections along the Enån valley with narrow suspension bridges; passes Dalhalla and Springkällan
additional: Registration for race categories is via RaceWeb; late registration is handled on RaceWeb between 08:30 and 12:00 (Lilla Mörksuggan). Bib collection for Lilla Mörksuggan: Jarlstugan, Saturday 5 July, 09:00–11:30. Bibs with chips are used in race categories and recreational/family categories (children's, recreational/family categories are not timed). A technical zone/feeding station is located in the arena between the start and finish zones; medical staff will be on site (contact person: Josefin Linell, tel. 076-796 39 69). Changing rooms and showers are available at Jarlstugan. Mörksuggejakten TrailRun was first held in 2017. The race is part of the Mörksuggejakten events in Rättvik and is coordinated with Lilla Mörksuggejakten; late registration and bib collection are planned in connection with 4 July 2026.

name: Semesterhalvmaran
location: Fjugesta, Laxå Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden
description: The Vacation Half Marathon is a summer race organized by running club LK Gränslöst, giving runners the opportunity to experience the beautiful open landscapes of the Närke Plain. The course often follows gravel roads among rolling grain fields, offering a nature-close, summery running experience. LK Gränslöst is an inclusive club that welcomes runners of all levels.
course_highlights: Gravel roads across the Närke Plain
Rolling grain fields and open views
A summer vacation-time race with a relaxed, nature-close feel
additional: LK Gränslöst organizes several summer races: the Vacation Half Marathon, the Summer Ten-Kilometer, and the children’s race Solruset. The club announced that the races would be paused in 2025 because key people in the organizing group were unavailable. The club also holds open Wednesday training sessions at 18:00 in Örebro (location varies), led by Carina Gustavsson and Thomas Stenius.

name: Gotland Run 511k (2026)
description: Gotland Run 511k is more of a running adventure than a traditional race: a self-supported journey around Gotland of approximately 511 km, starting and finishing in Visby. Participants follow a clockwise loop that also includes a circuit of Fårö, with support from four so-called Angel Stations along the way. The organizer provides some basic services, but runners are responsible for most food and logistics arrangements. The entire route must be completed on foot within 10 days, with regular position reports throughout the day.
course_highlights: Circular route around Gotland (starting and finishing in Visby), including a circuit of Fårö
Most of the route follows Gotlandsleden: long stretches of asphalt, gravel roads, and shorter sections of trail
Four Angel Stations along the course offering water, support, and sometimes the opportunity for a short rest or a bed
additional: Self-supported format: the organizer provides only the most basic services; participants are responsible for food and most accommodation. A pre-race dinner and race briefing in Visby on the evening before the start are mandatory. One night’s accommodation at Visby Fängelse Hostel and breakfast on race morning are included, as are a race bib, luggage storage during the race, and a souvenir for finishers. Transport back to Visby is available for participants who withdraw. Participants must report their position twice daily (10:00 and 22:00) using an online check-in tool and a Google Maps link. The overall time limit is 10 days (an average of ~51 km per day). The information page has sections on mandatory equipment and basic rules. History: the first edition in 2023 had 5 starters and 3 finishers. Distance approximately 511 km (318 miles); four Angel Stations along the way; no pacing; mandatory equipment; pre-race dinner and briefing; one night’s accommodation in Visby included; luggage storage; race bib; transport back to Visby if withdrawing; finishers receive a souvenir.

name: Oberlichtenauer Sommerlauf
description: The 44th Oberlichtenau Summer Run takes place on 27 June 2026 and invites runners of all ages to a sporting event that has brought together the Saxon running community and guests from near and far for over four decades. The day begins with children’s races over 800 metres and 2.2 kilometres for the U12 and U14 age groups. These are followed by the recreational run of approx. 5 kilometres and the challenging 13-kilometre main race, which tests stamina and skill with steep climbs and fast descents over the Keulenberg. The running group of Sportgemeinschaft Oberlichtenau looks forward to welcoming all participants.
course_highlights: Children’s race: 2 laps around the sports field (800 metres)
U12 and U14 children’s race: 2.2 km along Keulenberstraße
Main race: 13 km with challenging climbs and descents over the Keulenberg
additional: Race day starts with the children’s race at 09:45, followed by a new children’s race for U12 and U14 at 09:55. The awards ceremony takes place immediately after the children’s races. The recreational run starts at 10:25 and the main race at 10:30. The running group is led by Patrick Thomschke (department head) and Jens Schäfer (manager). The event usually takes place in summer temperatures of around 23°C. Registration and further details are available on the official website. The race is a great opportunity for runners to achieve personal bests and experience the beautiful Saxon landscape.

name: 10. Hochkippenlauf
description: The 10th Hochkippenlauf takes place on 4 July 2026 at Stadion Profen and is organized by SV Eintracht Profen. Various races are offered for different age groups, from a children’s race to distances for young people and 10 km races for adults. The event is part of a sports festival running from 3 to 5 July 2026. The race is a great opportunity for sports enthusiasts of all ages to compete in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 400 m children’s race (one lap of the stadium)
Distances of 2.1 km, 4.2 km and 5 km for young people
10 km race for U18, U20 and adults
additional: The race is part of a sports festival running from 3 to 5 July 2026. The children’s races take place over one lap of the stadium. The race is held at Stadion Profen, with warm, sunny weather in July. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to win prizes in various categories.

name: 46. Küstenkanallauf
description: The 46th Küstenkanallauf takes place on 04.07.2026 in Friesoythe. The event offers races over 22 km, 11 km and 5.5 km, as well as walking and hiking routes. The scenic course runs along the Küstenkanal and is suitable for runners of all ability levels. This traditional event is organised by KC Ikenbrügge von 1971 e. V.
course_highlights: Scenic course along the Küstenkanal
Distances of 5.5 km, 11 km and 22 km
Walking and hiking routes available
additional: Start times: Runners in the 5.5 km, 11 km and 22 km races start at 17:00; walking and hiking start at 16:15. Registration is via an online form on the website or through the contact option, providing your name, year of birth, club and town. This is a local event with a friendly atmosphere that attracts numerous runners from the region each year. Registration, results and further details are available on the official website and in the race information.

name: 9. Bremer Brückenlauf
price_range: ab 8,00 € bis 45,00 € je nach Kategorie und Frühbucherstatus
description: The Bremer Brückenlauf on July 4, 2026, invites runners to experience Bremen from a unique perspective. The course crosses bridges spanning the Weser, the Kleine Weser and the Werdersee, offering a maritime atmosphere in the heart of the city. Several distances are available, including a half marathon, 10 km run, 5 km run, a special 5 km underwear run and children’s races. The event promises good spirits, a summery atmosphere and breathtaking views of Bremen and the Weser.
course_highlights: Run across several bridges in Bremen
Course over the Weser, Kleine Weser and Werdersee
Officially measured, record-eligible courses
additional: Optional medal engraving (€10 for adults, €7.50 for children). Start times vary by distance, from 16:30 (underwear run) to 18:15 (5 km and 10 km walking). All main races are measured by the DLV and are record-eligible. Children’s races are measured privately. Walkers and Nordic walkers are listed in alphabetical order in the finish results. Participation rules and age categories are clearly defined. Loop course with official measurement, age categories and competition categories; medal engraving available; Nordic walking included.

name: Benkhauser Schlosslauf
location: Schloss Benkhausen, Espelkamp, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

description: The Benkhausen Castle Run is a sporting event taking place for the second time in 2026, set in the unique surroundings of Benkhausen Castle. The event offers varied running routes along paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Benkhausen. The start and finish are at Benkhausen Castle Square, where race bibs are also distributed. The event is open to running enthusiasts of all ages and includes various distances, including children’s and schoolchildren’s races.
course_highlights: Running routes along paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Benkhausen
Start and finish at historic Benkhausen Castle Square
Kilometre markers along the route for guidance
additional: Late registration is possible on race day from 12:30 p.m. until 60 minutes before the start, provided the participant limit has not been reached; a late-registration fee of €2 applies. The number of participants is limited to 200 runners per main race (6.5 km, 10.8 km, 20.8 km), with a maximum of 600 registrations in total. Race packs will be available from 30.06.2026 at Drogerie Emmerling and on race day at the castle square. Timing uses disposable-chip technology. Showers and changing facilities are available at Benkhausen Primary School. All participants in the children’s and schoolchildren’s races receive medals; there is no timing or awards ceremony. The well-known announcer Heino Krüger will accompany the races. Registration opens on 01.02.2026; late registration is available on site; the participant limit for the main races is 200 per distance, with a maximum of 600 registrations in total; chip timing; event held as part of a sports festival

name: 01. Okertalsperren Ultra-Marathon
location: Altenau im Harz, Goslar, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 1st Okertalsperren Ultra Marathon takes place on July 4, 2026, in Altenau in the Harz Mountains. The course covers 47.4 km and consists of three laps of a 15.8 km, mostly flat route around the main arm of the Okertalsperre reservoir. The route follows the forebay, crosses the dam and the main dam, and offers a scenic run with only gentle climbs. The event is suitable for experienced runners. Participants are advised to bring their own refreshments, and they are responsible for timing themselves. After the race, participants receive certificates by email, and the results are published on the website.
course_highlights: Three 15.8 km laps around the Okertalsperre reservoir
Crossing the forebay dam and the main dam
Mostly flat course with gentle climbs
additional: Participants are advised to bring their own refreshments, for example from the trunk of their car. Runners time themselves using a running watch or phone and submit proof by photo or screenshot via email to the organizer. Certificates are sent as PDFs by email. Results are published on the website. The race takes place on July 4, 2026. It is a self-supported event with no explicit entry fee, and participants must provide proof of their results. The course consists of three 15.8 km laps around the reservoir.

name: 23. Schneekopflauf
location: Schmiedefeld am Rennsteig, Thüringer Wald, Germany
description: The Schneekopflauf is one of the most beautiful and challenging mountain races in Germany, held in the Thuringian Forest. The route runs from Schmiedefeld via Großer Finsterberg to Schneekopf and covers 12.7 and 22.2 kilometres, with plenty of climbs and elevation gain. This race is particularly suitable for experienced runners who want to test their limits. Since 2025, there has also been a Schneekopf hike for Nordic walkers and hikers, who are also rewarded with a medal at the summit.
course_highlights: 12.7 km and 22.2 km routes with challenging climbs
Elevation gain from the start to the summit at 978 m
Run through the Thuringian Forest with breathtaking views
additional: Late registration is possible from 26.06.2026 until 30.06.2026, 23:59. Cancellation is possible until 30.04.2026 with a 50% refund, minus a EUR 5 processing fee. Switching from 12.7 km to 22.2 km is possible by paying the difference; no refund is available for switching in the other direction. Entries are non-transferable. Steep, challenging, elevation gain, mountain race, Nordic walking, hike

description: The Schwerin Five Lakes Run is a traditional race in northern Germany, taking place for the 40th time on 4 July 2026. The event offers a range of distances around Schwerin’s five lakes, including a half marathon, 15 km, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as a children’s sea mile. Runners enjoy a scenic course starting and finishing at Bertha-Klingberg-Platz. The event is known for its good organisation, friendly atmosphere and varied competitions, including corporate and school rankings.

Children under 10 may participate in the 5 km and 10 km races only when accompanied by an adult. Distances include the half marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km and a children’s sea mile. Registration is available online or by post. Entry fees can be paid by SEPA direct debit, credit card or bank transfer.

Organised by SV Viktoria Goch, Athletics/Running Club, the event is expected to welcome over 800 runners of various age groups to Goch town centre. The programme ranges from a Bambini run and a 2,000 m hobby group and company run to races for everyone around the Steintor. The event offers suitable distances for both competitive and recreational runners in an open, healthy outdoor atmosphere.

Part of the Gocher Fußball Sommer, with over 800 participants

Running event with various distances; registration via TAF-Timing; registration deadline: 17 June 2026.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, combining sport with charity. The 10th-anniversary edition takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to fulfill the dream of Marlena, a beneficiary of the foundation, to travel to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and every kilometer brings them closer to making this dream come true. It is not only a sporting challenge but also an opportunity to join forces in support of children in need.
course_highlights: The run lasts 25 hours, making it a unique endurance challenge

The event is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Janikowo, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, which offers high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and welcoming to everyone who enjoys physical activity.

Organized by the local Sports and Recreation Center

The race offers a 10 km distance through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia, combining sporting competition with the beauty of the region. Kaszuby Biegają is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from elements earned at individual stages.

A 10 km distance in northern Poland
Part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, featuring a unique assembled medal

Registration opens in December 2025. The event commemorates Jacek Bandurski.

name: Kadeloop
description: The Moore DRV-Kadeloop in Schipluiden is a traditional running event held annually on the first Saturday of July since 1978. The main distance is 12 km through the green Midden-Delfland area and along the Vlaardingsekade back to Schipluiden. There is also a 5 km run and a 1 km and 2 km junior race. The event is known for its beautiful scenery and friendly atmosphere and is part of the Zomer Runcircuit.

Run along the Vlaardingsekade back to Schipluiden
Junior races of 1 km and 2 km, specially for children

The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which has been hosting this relay marathon since 2013 and has built a dedicated running community. The relay marathon offers runners an attractive and varied route through beautiful parkland, with no disruptive road crossings.

No disruptive road crossings on the course

The event is organised by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which also runs other races. Photos and videos of previous relays are available on the website. Registration is via my.raceresult.com; the race is held as a relay marathon, and results are available on the day of the event.

name: Dorflauf TSV Wiera

Officially registered with the German Athletics Association
Results are included in the official rankings

The run traditionally takes place at the weekend and continues to attract growing numbers of participants.

Exciting 5 km and 10 km main races

Several races are offered, including children’s and youth races as well as main races for adults; the event takes place in Ellerbek; the 2026 edition is sold out, with 350 participants.

The organizers provide professional timing and technical support, while participants can expect efficient organization and a friendly atmosphere. It’s a great opportunity to get active and bring the local community together.

Professional electronic timing

The race has been held since 2011 and traditionally takes place on the Monday of week 28, starting at 20:00. It is well established in Västervik and attracts runners of different ages.

The children’s race starts level with the Stegeholm Castle ruins, by the sun deck and Myntbryggan, and follows the cycle path along Gamlebyviken to the finish at Grönsakstorget. Participants receive a medal after finishing. Bib collection is at ICA Maxi or the race office; advance registration closes on 3 July at 16:00; registration on race day is open from 13:00 to 19:00.

The course consists of seven large loops of 6.10 km each, approximately 42.7 km in total, and offers a quiet, self-supported running environment, with refreshments available at your own car after each loop. The event is limited to 22 participants and is open to runners aged 18 and over. Marathon times are recorded with a hand stopwatch, and participants are asked to make a voluntary donation to environmental or social projects.
course_highlights: Seven large loops of 6.10 km each; total distance approximately 42.7 km

Course marked with arrows and barrier tape, depending on weather conditions

The event offers runners a short, fast course and is a popular competition in the region. Results and photos from previous races are available on the website.

name: Roruper Abendlauf

The course is flat and paved, with a ten-kilometre loop that is completed once or twice depending on the distance. The finish is in the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium, where runners complete a lap of the stadium before crossing the finish line. In addition to certificates and trophies, cash prizes are awarded to the top runners in the half marathon and 10 km race.

Ten-kilometre loop, with a longer first lap for the half marathon
Stadium lap before the finish at the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium
additional: All races start at the Rorup sports ground. Certificates are awarded to all finishers, trophies to the winners, and special prizes to the top three runners in each age group. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three male and female finishers in the half marathon and 10 km race. Courses are officially measured; online registration is available until 30 minutes before the start; parking is available; refreshments are provided on the course; finish in the SV Brukteria Rorup stadium.

name: Musköloppet
location: Muskö Hembygdsgård, Muskö, Haninge kommun, Stockholms län, Sverige
description: Musköloppet is a long-standing running race in a spectacular archipelago setting, starting and finishing at Muskö Local Heritage Centre/Muskö IF’s clubhouse. The race usually attracts around 300 runners (about 400 including the youngest children) and has a friendly, homecoming atmosphere, with many taking the opportunity to meet relatives and neighbours. The event offers children’s and youth classes as well as recreational classes (5 km and 10 km) on varied surfaces, and takes place on Saturday, 11 July 2026.
course_highlights: Start/finish at Muskö Local Heritage Centre, near the clubhouse, outdoor gym and hockey rink
Course surfaces: approximately 50% asphalt, 30–40% gravel and 10% trail
The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured (course measurer Mikael Hill, 240523); this year, the 10 km is run as a single loop
additional: Late registration is available at the start/finish area up to one hour before the race starts. Food and drinks are available at the start/finish. Directions by car and public transport, as well as parking information, are available on the “Find us” page. Around 300 runners usually take part (about 400 including the youngest children). Start/finish area at Muskö Local Heritage Centre/Muskö IF’s clubhouse; 5 km and 10 km courses with varied surfaces (approximately 50% asphalt, 40% gravel and 10% trail on one course; approximately 60% asphalt, 30% gravel and 10% trail on the other); merchandise, kiosk snacks, coffee, soft drinks and food from Micke’s Grill; late registration at the finish area up to one hour before the race starts.

name: Klåveröd Backyard 2026
description: Klåveröd Backyard 2026 is an event published on Facebook in Svalöv, taking place on Saturday, 11 July 2026, and created by Linda Bengtsson. The event is associated with Klåveröds Ski Club and is presented on an official Facebook event page. It is located in Klåveröd near Söderåsen, offering trail and forest running in a natural setting. For details and contact information, see the event page on Facebook.
course_highlights: Running in Klåveröd/Svalöv near Söderåsen
Trail and forest terrain (event organized through Klåveröds Ski Club)
Close to the natural areas and national park area of Söderåsen
additional: Organizer/creator: Linda Bengtsson; event associated with Klåveröds Ski Club; the main information page and invitation are on the Facebook event page: https://www.facebook.com/events/1496584765165217/; Klåveröd's Facebook group and page are used for local information. At the previous Klåveröd Backyard in 2024, Jonas Elmer won with 14 laps, approximately 90 km in total.

name: Sommerlauf des LSV Porz
location: Gut Leidenhausen, Köln-Porz, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: Nachmeldung 2 € am Veranstaltungstag, sonst keine expliziten Angaben
description: The LSV Porz Summer Run is a popular race in the Gut Leidenhausen recreation area in Cologne-Porz. Held as the Ingeborg Urbach Memorial Run, it offers distances from 1 km to 5 km for competitive runners and recreational joggers. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for official best lists, with the 5 km loop considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne. The entry fee also supports Brusthilfe Deutschland e.V. and the Leidenhausen Forest School.
course_highlights: Race in the Gut Leidenhausen recreation area
5 km and 10 km courses measured by the DLV and eligible for official best lists
The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne
additional: The registration deadline is 23.06.2026. Late registration is possible on the event day for a fee of €2; school students are exempt from the late registration fee. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Race numbers must be worn on the chest. €1 per participant is donated to Brusthilfe Deutschland e.V. and the Leidenhausen Forest School. Terrain in the Leidenhausen recreation area, registration by SEPA direct debit, race number worn on the chest, medals for all pre-registered participants, awards ceremonies for the top runners, certificates available online

name: Wybelsumer Polderlauf
description: The Wybelsumer Polder Run is a running event for children and adults held at the Wybelsum sports ground in Emden. Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V., the event offers a sporting opportunity for the whole family in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. It is part of Emden’s diverse events calendar and promotes the local community and sport.
course_highlights: Running event for children and adults
Venue: Wybelsum sports ground, Emden
Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V.
additional: The event includes various running distances for all age groups and is a popular regional event in the Krummhörn region.

name: Bergheide-Cross 2026
description: SCB Langendamm invites you to the 4th Bergheide Cross 2026. The course starts on the access road to the clubhouse of the local small-bore rifle club and runs through the “Osterberg” local recreation and nature conservation area. The event offers three distances for different scoring and age categories, as well as walking on the shorter course. There is also a 1,000-metre race for children and young people. The event is sanctioned by the DLV and takes place on 11 July 2026 from 16:00.
course_highlights: Course through the “Osterberg” nature conservation area
Start on the access road to the clubhouse of the local small-bore rifle club
Three distances: 10.4 km, 5.2 km and a 1,000 m race for schoolchildren
additional: The 1,000-metre race is for children and young people aged 6 to 14, and registration is free and available only on site. The 5.2 km race is open to participants aged 14 and over, and the 10.4 km course to participants aged 16 and over. The main race starts at 17:00; the race for schoolchildren starts at 16:00. Walking is offered on the shorter course. Free on-site registration for the race for schoolchildren, a run in the Osterberg nature area, a family-friendly event.

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race held in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to take on a course of moderate difficulty. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, making event logistics convenient. All running enthusiasts are invited to take part in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.
course_highlights: A 10 km course in Bukowiec
Race office in the sports hall in Bukowiec
A commemorative medal for every participant who finishes the race
additional: The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec. Every runner who crosses the finish line receives a medal. A registration form is available, allowing you to contact the organizer and system administrator quickly. Registration takes place online, the event is local in nature, and results are available electronically.

name: Dodenauer Volkslauf
organizer: Leichtathletik Gemeinschaft Eder (LG Eder) / TSV Dodenau

description: The Dodenau Volkslauf is a recreational running event open to everyone, starting and finishing at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall in Battenberg-Dodenau. The event offers a range of distances from Bambini races to a half marathon, as well as Nordic walking. To be included in the rankings, participants must belong to an athletics club or an LG. Online registration is available until about one week before the race; late registration is possible at the start.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Dodenau multi-purpose hall
Distances for Bambini, short, middle and long races, as well as a half marathon
Nordic walking over 5 km and 10 km
additional: Late registration at the start is possible from 07:45 until 45 minutes before the respective start. To be included in the rankings, participants must provide their club or LG on the registration form. Terrain: Dodenau multi-purpose hall, online registration, various running distances, Nordic walking

description: The 41st Pönitz Volkslauf takes place on 12 July 2026 in Pönitz and invites runners, walkers and Nordic walkers to a sporting and social event. The course runs through the scenic Holstein Switzerland, with romantic hedgerows, summer fields and peaceful meadows. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, show performances and an awards ceremony at the Pönitz Sports Park. All participants receive a commemorative medal, and attractive prizes are awarded to the winners.
course_highlights: Scenery of Holstein Switzerland, with hedgerows, fields and meadows
Start and finish at Pönitz Sports Park, with a summer atmosphere
Refreshments and show performances at the venue
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal. The awards ceremony begins at 11:15, with medals for the overall winners (places 1–3) and trophies and certificates for age-group winners and finishers. Members of SVG Pönitz pay half the entry fee. The event offers refreshments, show performances and a friendly atmosphere for athletes, companions and spectators. Runners can choose between the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and Nordic walking. Starts are from 8:30. A shared experience of community and nature.

name: 27. Gläserner Mönch Lauf
description: The Gläserner Mönch Run is a traditional trail race in the Harz foothills, returning after a seven-year break. The course is known for its undulating profile, with more than 100 metres of elevation gain per lap, and the legendary climb up 222 steps to the “Gläserner Mönch.” Participants can choose from various distances, from the Bambini Run to the 18 km Extreme Run, and experience unspoilt nature among rocks and forest. The event combines a sporting challenge with a love of the local area and takes place around the Landhotel Schäferhof in Halberstadt.
course_highlights: 222 steps to the “Gläserner Mönch”
Undulating profile with more than 100 metres of elevation gain per lap
Unspoilt nature among rocks, forest and cobblestones
additional: Start and finish at the Landhotel Schäferhof in Halberstadt OT Langenstein. Electronic timing with a transponder (€5 deposit). Late registrants do not receive the full race pack. Awards ceremony from approximately 12:15 p.m.; children’s races immediately afterwards. Minimum age and participation requirements apply. Limited places available; various race distances; nature trail with elevation gain.

name: 8. Barigauer Turmlauf
description: The Barigauer Turmlauf is a traditional race in Oberhain near Königsee, taking place on 12 July 2026. The event offers runners an attractive course with scenic sections around the Barigauer Tower. The race is aimed at ambitious runners and running enthusiasts looking for a sporting challenge in a natural setting. It is organized by Laufverein Königsee, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and smooth event.
course_highlights: Scenic course around the Barigauer Tower
Natural running trails in Oberhain (Königsee)
Traditional race with a friendly atmosphere

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race taking place on 12 July 2026 in Starogard Gdański. It’s a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course and prepare for race day with dedicated training plans tailored to different ability levels. The organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making the event appealing to both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a moderately challenging event on a paved surface, ideal for improving your fitness and competing in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on a paved surface
Moderately challenging course
Scenic surroundings of Starogard Gdański
additional: Training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks are available and tailored to the runner’s VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. Organizers can use a platform to manage the race listing and collaborate on marketing. The event is planned for summer 2026 and is aimed at runners of different age groups and ability levels, with the option to take part in the 10 km race.

name: Victorialoppet
price_range: 175-550 kr beroende på kategori och registreringsdatum
description: Victorialoppet is an annual running festival in Borgholm, celebrating its 45th year in 2026. The event offers several distances for all ages and abilities, including the 9 km main race, the 4 km Victoriajoggen, the 2 km Lilla Victorialoppet, and Mini for the youngest participants. The course is fast and easy to run, with beautiful coastal views and an enthusiastic crowd. The event is a festive celebration, with music along the course and a welcoming atmosphere for participants and spectators alike.
course_highlights: Fast, easy-to-run 9 km course with coastal views
Music at several points along the course
Courses for all ages, including para-sport categories
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 to 18:00 on race day at Borgholm Sports Hall. Changing rooms and showers are available for men and boys at the sports hall, and for women and girls at Viktoriaskolan’s gymnasium. Water is provided along the 9 km course, and participants receive refreshments after the finish. Timing uses disposable chips for most races; timing is optional for Victoriajoggen and the para-sport categories. Children in Lilla Victorialoppet receive a medal, ice cream, and a drink after the finish. The event runs from early afternoon into the evening, with several start times and races. Distances include 9 km, 4 km, 2 km, and 1.5 km, with participants from different age groups and disability categories. The event takes place in Borgholm’s sports area and includes both competitive and recreational races, as well as fundraising for charitable causes.

name: SUNSET Hamburg 2026
description: Altra Sunset Hamburg takes place on Wednesday, July 15, 2026, at Wilhelmsburger Inselpark. The race features a scenic loop of approximately 5 km on asphalt and paths, which can be run 1 to 3 times, allowing distances of approximately 5 km, 10 km, or 15 km. Participants can choose their preferred number of laps flexibly on race day, with a checkpoint counting the laps. There is also a relay, in which the course is run four times, with teams of 2 to 4 runners. The event is open to anyone who is fit and has no medical concerns; club membership is not required.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km loop in Wilhelmsburger Inselpark
Asphalt and paths underfoot
Checkpoint on the course to count laps
additional: Race packet distribution starts at 17:30. The finish closes at 21:30; sunset is at 21:41. The race distance can be chosen flexibly on race day. Relay teams consist of 2 to 4 runners; team members do not need to be named in advance. Eligibility by year of birth: 5 km from 2016, 10 km from 2012, 15 km from 2010. The race takes place at Wilhelmsburger Inselpark. Online registration is available. Depending on the number of laps, the course distance is 5 km, 10 km, or 15 km, with a checkpoint to count laps.

name: Lauf um und am Gartower See
location: Nordufer des Gartower Sees, Gartow, Lüchow-Dannenberg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The run around and along Gartow Lake is a traditional running event held on the lake’s north shore in Gartow. The course offers a natural setting with views of the lake and the surrounding Gartower Tannen, making it ideal for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the SV Gartow sports club, which has supported sporting activities and community in the region since 1946. The start and finish are centrally located in town, creating a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Scenic course along Gartow Lake
Start and finish in the heart of Gartow
Run through the Gartower Tannen and the idyllic Elbe River valley
additional: SV Gartow is a long-established club with more than 600 members, offering a wide range of sports and regularly hosting events that attract participants from beyond the region. The running event is part of a vibrant sports community supported by volunteers. There are no fixed triathlon training times, but participants arrange individual meetups and take part in competitions. The event takes place in a scenic setting that also offers opportunities to relax and enjoy nature. It includes races for children, young people, adults, and seniors, with start times from 19:00. It is a great opportunity to experience nature and take part in sport.

name: Kraftprovet
organizer: Trollhättans IF Friidrott och Trollhättans SOK
description: Kraftprovet is a classic city race in the heart of Trollhättan, celebrating its 40th anniversary on 17 July 2026. The course follows the canal through leafy surroundings and varied, hilly terrain, with beautiful views of the Göta älv, the locks and the historic power stations. The race brings together elite runners and recreational runners and creates a festive atmosphere with spectators, music and activities for the whole family. It is organised by Trollhättans IF Friidrott and Trollhättans SOK.
course_highlights: The course follows the canal area and the locks and waterfalls area in Trollhättan
Varied, hilly terrain with marked kilometre points
Views of the Göta älv, the locks and historic power stations
additional: Start and finish at Hansenplatsen in Trollhättan. Race bibs and T-shirts can be collected at the start/finish area from 10:00; collection closes 30 minutes before each start. Names will be printed on race bibs for entries submitted by 30 June. Functional T-shirts can be ordered when registering by 15 May (included for Kraftprovet 11.6 km and Specialprovet; costs 130 kr for the other races). Specialprovet welcomes assistants/guides at no extra cost. Kraftprovet has pacers for 50, 55 and 60 minutes; Fun Run is untimed. Silver medals are awarded for times under 50:00 (men) and 55:00 (women). The costume contest gathers at 15:45, with a prize pool for the best costume. The 40th anniversary features new race elements; Knatteprovet, Miniprovet and the 800 m race are also on offer. This year's T-shirt can be purchased when registering.

name: Kölner Zoolauf
description: The Cologne Zoo Run is a unique running event at Cologne Zoo, taking place for the 13th time on July 17, 2026. It offers four different races for all age groups, from Bambini and children’s races to challenging 10 km races. The course runs through the zoo and past numerous animal enclosures, making the run a special experience. Official timing and certificates are included for most races, and the event places great emphasis on safety and family-friendliness.
course_highlights: A 1.62 km loop through Cologne Zoo, with views of numerous animal enclosures
Choose to run between 1 and 6 laps (1.6 km to 10.05 km)
Start and finish in front of the main entrance to Cologne Zoo
additional: Start times: BambiniLauf 18:15, KidsLauf 18:30, TopLauf 19:00, FunLauf 20:15. A requested bib number is available for an additional €3. On-site late registration is possible up to and including event day, with a €5 late-registration fee. Participation with dogs, strollers, walking poles, or music devices is not permitted. Official timing is provided for all races except the BambiniLauf. Certificates can be printed online. Safety and supervision of children in the start and finish areas are organized. Four race types (Bambini, Kids, Top, Fun); online registration; no refunds for non-participation; participation requires a bib number and timing chip; participation with dogs or headphones is not permitted.

name: Freiberger Bürgerfestlauf
description: The Freiberger Bürgerfestlauf is one of Germany’s largest Bürgerfest running events and takes place on July 17, 2026, in Freiberg. More than 1,600 runners take part across four different distances, from 600 meters to 10 kilometers. The event has a high finisher rate of over 95% and is followed by a Bürgerfest with live music in the market square. The start and finish are in the center of Freiberg, creating a lively, community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Four distances: 600m Bambini Run, 1km Student Run, 5km Health Run, 10km OptiMove Run
Start and finish at Marktplatz Freiberg a.N.
Timing with a single-use transponder and a cutoff time of 1:20 hours for the 10km distance
additional: Race packet pickup and on-site registration at PRISMA on the market square on July 16 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on July 17 from 15:00. Awards ceremony from approximately 20:00 on the Seebühne. Changing facilities and showers at the Stadthalle and indoor swimming pool. Parking at the Wasen Sports Center (5–10 minutes on foot). Drinks provided during the race and from 18:00 as part of the Bürgerfest by local clubs. Online registration available; open to all age groups, with a festive program featuring music.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a 5-kilometre night race held on the Baltic Sea coast as part of the IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, as city lights reflect off the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set off on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. The event has become an important and eagerly anticipated part of the city’s sporting calendar, combining competition with the unique atmosphere of a night run.
course_highlights: A 5 km route along the Baltic Sea coast
A night race with striking city lights reflected on the asphalt and water
An event held as part of the IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends
additional: The race is held as part of the IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends in Gdynia, Warsaw and Poznań. It attracts hundreds of runners and is a regular feature of these sporting events. Seaside route, limit of 1,500 participants, entry fees in tiers of 60 zł, 75 zł, 90 zł and 100 zł.

name: Hornsjön Runt
location: Pensionat Hornsjön, Löttorp, Borgholm Municipality, Kalmar County, Sweden
description: Hornsjön Runt is a family-friendly running event around Öland’s only inland lake, through beautiful and varied scenery. Organised by Högby IF, it offers distances for children and young people, 5.5 km, 11 km, and a non-timed walking class. The start and finish are at Pensionat Hornsjön, and everyone who completes the event receives a medal. The event combines a long tradition with scenic routes over gravel, sand dunes, forest, and open pastures.
course_highlights: Around Öland’s only inland lake (Hornsjön)
Varied terrain: gravel with Öland limestone, grass, and sand dunes
Passes cow pastures and deciduous and coniferous forest; three water stations along the course
additional: Register by 11 July 2026. Late registration is available through 16 July, followed by the option to register when race bibs are distributed from 12:00 on race day. The non-timed walking class starts between 13:00 and 16:00. There are three water stations along the course, plus refreshments at the start/finish. Showers and changing facilities are available at Högby sports ground. Prizes are awarded to the top three in all classes, with additional prizes drawn at random. Start times: youth classes 15:30; 5.5 km 17:00; 11 km 17:05. The walking class is available over 5.5 or 11 km, with starts between 13:00 and 16:00. Showers and changing facilities are available at Högby sports ground.

name: OYLER Berglauf
description: The 27th Oyler Berglauf takes place on July 18, 2026, as part of Sports Promotion Week in Marklohe. Organized by Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle, the race offers a sporting challenge on Oyler Berg. The event is part of a varied sports program and is aimed at runners looking to experience a hilly course in a friendly club atmosphere. The exact route and further details can be found on the organizer’s website.
course_highlights: Race on Oyler Berg
Venue: Sportplatz Oyle
Part of Sports Promotion Week 2026
additional: The Oyler Berglauf is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026, which takes place from 18.07.2026 to 26.07.2026 at Sportplatz Oyle. The organizer is Jugendgemeinschaft Oyle von 1953 e.V. No pricing or registration details, start times, or wave information have been published on the website. The event is part of Sports Promotion Week 2026 and takes place at Sportplatz Oyle; no specific registration information is available.

name: 1. Stoppelfeld Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr beträgt 50 Euro pro Teilnehmer.

description: The Stoppelfeld Ultra 2026 is a classic Backyard Ultra race taking place on July 18 and 19, 2026, in Kerpen-Blatzheim. This unique endurance format is not about speed, but about completing a 6.706-kilometre lap within 60 minutes every hour and starting again promptly on the hour. The course runs mainly along field and farm tracks around Blatzheim, starting and finishing at the Blatzheim sports field. The event is limited to 50 participants and promises a family-friendly atmosphere as well as a major mental and physical challenge.
course_highlights: An exact 6.706-kilometre loop
Course along field and farm tracks around Blatzheim
Start and finish area at the Blatzheim sports field
additional: Each new lap starts promptly on the hour. Anyone who does not finish a lap in time or fails to show up for the next start on time is eliminated. Any time remaining in the hour after finishing may be used freely for recovery, refreshments or short breaks. The maximum number of participants is limited to 50 to ensure a family-friendly atmosphere. Registration is online only and is binding only after payment. Participation is at your own risk; good health is required. The course runs along field and farm tracks, with the start and finish area at the sports field. A maximum of 50 participants; the event continues until the 30th lap is reached or a participant is unable to continue.

name: 22. Wiesenlauf
description: The 22nd Wiesenlauf on July 18, 2026, in Klein Meckelsen offers runners the opportunity to compete on officially measured and DLV-approved 5 km and 10 km courses. The event includes district championships over both distances and a regional championship over 5 km, with classifications starting from age group M/W 14. The start and finish are at the Klein Meckelsen sports field, and the event is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 10 km circuit and 5 km course with a turnaround point
Officially measured and DLV-approved running courses
Classifications for the district championships (Rotenburg/W.) and regional championships (Lüneburg)
additional: Late registration is possible until 18:00 on the day of the event, with a €3 late-entry fee in addition to the entry fee. Race numbers can be collected from 18:00 at the announcer’s stand at the sports field. Changing and shower facilities are available at the sports hall on Schulstraße. Parking is available at the sports grounds and at the gymnasium. Awards will be presented to the top three finishers in each race and gender; all participants will receive a medal. Certificates are available online. The event starts at 19:00 and offers a summery running atmosphere. It is a great opportunity for runners of all ages to compete and take part in championships.

name: 4. Fachberg 100
description: The Fachberg 100 is a 100 km road race in Northeim, Germany, starting on July 18, 2026, at 6:00 a.m. The course consists of 15 laps and a short out-and-back section, alternating between asphalt and field paths. Each lap involves about 75 meters of elevation gain, for a total of 1,125 meters. This is a small ultrarunning event with limited participation and no entry fee; runners must bring their own provisions.
course_highlights: 15 laps alternating between asphalt and field paths
About 1,125 m of total elevation gain
6:00 a.m. start
additional: No entry fee; participants must bring their own provisions. A small field, with 21 finishers to date. Typical July weather: around 25 °C during the day and 15 °C at night, usually sunny. The event is a small, close-knit ultramarathon community, with about 21 finishers in previous editions.

name: Spendenlauf Recke
description: The Spendenlauf Recke on July 18, 2026, is a charity event in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster. Organized by Andreas Egelkamp Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär GmbH & Co. KG and the company Lewe from Recke, the event offers two distances: 5 kilometers for beginners and those who prefer a relaxed run, and 10 kilometers for experienced runners looking for a greater challenge. The focus is on coming together for a good cause, with the entire entry fee donated. The event combines sporting commitment with social responsibility and invites everyone to take part and show their support.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route, ideal for beginners and relaxed runners
10-kilometer route for experienced runners seeking a greater challenge
Charity run in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster
additional: The entire entry fee will be donated. The organizers are Andreas Egelkamp Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär GmbH & Co. KG and the company Lewe from Recke. The event supports Kinderkrebshilfe Münster, which gives hope and improves quality of life for affected children and families. Routes: 5 km and 10 km; online registration only; run in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster
