description: The 12th Szczecin Night Port Marathon and the 7th Szczecin Night Port Half Marathon are night road races held in Szczecin, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The marathon course consists of two identical loops, each 42.195 km long, while the half marathon is one 21.097 km loop; both courses are certified by the Polish Athletics Association (PZLA). The race starts at 23:00. Participants can expect original T-shirts and a special classification for people connected with the maritime industry. The event is organized by Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia, Zachodniopomorska Federacja Sportu, and RAZ Event, with the support of the City of Szczecin and port partners.
course_highlights: The marathon course consists of two identical loops through the streets of Szczecin and is certified by the PZLA
Start and finish at Florian Krygier Municipal Stadium
Course markers every 1 km and refreshment stations along the course and at the finish of each loop
additional: The marathon time limit is 6 hours. A new classification category, “People of the Sea,” is for participants connected with the maritime industry. Start and finish at Florian Krygier Municipal Stadium. The course may be modified slightly due to renovation work near Trasa Zamkowa. Registration opens at 12:00. The course may be subject to minor changes due to construction work. The event includes a “People of the Sea” category for participants connected with the maritime industry.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail race taking place on 18 July 2026 in the scenic Elbląg Upland, by the Vistula Lagoon. The course runs along wild trails, with varied elevation and peaceful natural scenery, offering runners a chance to connect with the region’s nature and history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain-running series that promotes physical activity in harmony with nature and welcomes both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support and a comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: The wild natural landscapes and scenic hills of the Elbląg Upland
Routes through Elbląg Upland Landscape Park and four forest reserves
Views of the Vistula Lagoon and historic sites, including Old Prussian hillforts and the Imperial Stone
additional: The race pack includes a waterproof race bib with a chip, medical support, course markings, aid stations, drinks and snacks at the finish, a commemorative medal, and a GPS tracker for the 81 km distance. Starts take place in waves from 5:00 (81 km) to 10:30 (14 km), with separate Garmin Junior races for children. The online technical briefing on Facebook will take place on 15.07.2026 at 20:00. The system applies discounts when registering for more than one event in the series. The event also includes junior categories and challenge options, and the routes pass through reserves and hiking trails, offering unique experiences for runners and nature lovers.

name: 2 Chojnicka Piątka
description: 1. Chojnicka Piątka is a road race held in Chojnice on 26 July 2026. The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich and attracts runners from various places, offering sporting competition and a great atmosphere. The route runs through the city streets, giving participants attractive views and the chance to test their fitness over 5 km.
course_highlights: Road race in the centre of Chojnice
5 km route
Held as part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich
additional: The event is planned for 18 July 2026, and the route runs through the streets of Chojnice, mainly along Rybacka Street. Registration details have not been provided.

XIII Półmaraton i Ćwierćmaraton
location: Chrzypsko Wielkie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn
distance_verbose: Marathon, 28 km, Halve marathon, 14 km, 7.5 km
description: The Midzomer Marathon Apeldoorn is a unique running event held on a summer evening through the shady forests of the Veluwe around Apeldoorn. The race offers five distances, ranging from 7.5 km to the full marathon of 42.195 km, with the start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos. The routes mostly follow wide Veluwe paths and forest trails across varied terrain with around 300 metres of elevation gain, making for a challenging and atmospheric experience. Start times are scheduled so that you run into the evening and finish well before sunset, giving the race a special summer ambience.
course_highlights: Run through the shady forests of the Veluwe
Varied terrain with around 300 metres of elevation gain and one-quarter unpaved
Start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos, with the finish in daylight
additional: All five distances start later in the day so you can run into the summer evening. The marathon has a time limit of 5 hours, and participants may bring their own cycling companion to provide support along the course. Parking is free and within walking distance of the start location. Registration includes a finisher’s medal and a Midzomer shirt. On the day, you can switch your entry to a shorter distance free of charge at the event office. The event also relies on volunteers to help with various tasks. Five distances: 7.5 km, 14 km, half marathon, 28 km and marathon; cycling companions are allowed for the half and full marathons; facilities include water and fruit stations, free parking and public transport connections.

name: Flughafenlauf Barth
description: The Barther Airport Run takes place on July 19, 2026, at Stralsund-Barth Baltic Sea Airport and offers a varied program of seven races for runners and walkers of all ages. From short distances for young runners to the half-marathon distance, there is something for everyone. The event promises a morning full of movement, fun, and exciting races in a unique setting right at the airport. Walkers are also very welcome, and food and refreshments will be available on site.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stralsund-Barth Baltic Sea Airport
Distances from 500 m to the half marathon (21 km)
Water station on the half-marathon course
additional: On-site late registration is possible, with a €2.00 late registration fee for events of 4 km and longer. Bib pickup begins at 7:30 a.m. on race day in the terminal building. Awards are given to places 1–3 in the age-group and overall categories. The “Airpott” café and restaurant offers light snacks and drinks. Participants are asked to return their bib after finishing. Various running and walking distances, family-friendly, at Stralsund-Barth Baltic Sea Airport

name: Kaszubski Festiwal Biegowy VII Kaszubski Maraton o Wschodzie Słońca
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
price_range: od 49.50 PLN do 250.00 PLN w zależności od dystansu i terminu
description: The Kashubian Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on July 19, 2026, on a scenic route through the towns of Rozewie, Swarzewo, Jastrzębia Góra, and back to Rozewie. The festival offers a range of distances: a marathon, half marathon, and 15 km, 10 km, and 5 km races, so runners of all abilities can find a suitable route. The marathon starts at 04:35, giving participants the chance to experience the remarkable sunrise over Kashubia. After the races, the organizers provide refreshments and hold a prize draw, creating a festive, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic Kashubian towns and coastal areas
The marathon starts at dawn, offering a unique experience and energy along the route
Beautiful views of the coastal area and the distinctive character of Northern Pomerania
additional: The route is available to download in .GPX, .KML, and .TCX (Garmin) formats. After the races, refreshments are served and a prize draw is held for participants. The event has a festive atmosphere and brings together runners of all abilities. Route available to download; registration open until the end of June 2026; a memorial event for Franciszek Sojka

name: Amsterdam Pride Run
description: The Amsterdam Pride Run is a colorful and inclusive running event held during the Pride Amsterdam festivities. Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports, it offers a sporting celebration of diversity and equality. The run takes place in the city of Amsterdam and attracts a broad range of runners and supporters who come together to support the LGBTQ+ community. The atmosphere is festive and unifying, with an emphasis on sportsmanship and inclusion.
course_highlights: Running route through central Amsterdam
Inclusive and festive atmosphere during Pride Amsterdam
Organized by Rainbow Athletics Amsterdam and Pride and Sports
additional: The Amsterdam Pride Run takes place in the afternoon during Pride Amsterdam, with an entry fee ranging from €8 to €18. The event is part of a broader program of queer sports activities organized by Pride and Sports. It has a festive and safe atmosphere, with an emphasis on inclusion and sportsmanship. Route through Flevopark and along the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal; several race options, including a walk and a business run; a colorful and inclusive event during World Pride

description: The Turfveld Summer Cross in Den Burg, Texel, is an atmospheric running race held on Sunday mornings in July and August. The route passes through Texel’s varied landscape, with a sheltered course in the forest, a challenging climb and beautiful trails. There are several distances for different age groups, including a separate loop for children. The race starts at 10:30 a.m., with registration from 9:45 a.m. at Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld.
course_highlights: Varied forest landscape with sheltered trails
Challenging climb along the course
Beautiful natural trails
additional: Registration is available from 9:45 a.m. at Bospaviljoen 't Turfveld, Nattevlakweg 2, 1791 PB Den Burg. Separate distances are offered for children up to 12 years old (1 km), ages 13 to 15 (2 km), and ages 15 and over (4 and 8 km). The race is held every Sunday in July and August. Running race with several distances, located in a wooded area, registration from 9:45 a.m., start at 10:30 a.m.

name: Löttorpsvarvet
location: First Camp Löttorp, Löttorp, Öland, Sweden
description: Löttorpsvarvet is a family-friendly cross-country race held at First Camp Löttorp on Öland. The main distance is 6.2 km, and the course runs through woodland and meadows, with beautiful views of the Baltic Sea. Youth races of 1.4 km and 800 m are available for younger runners, and all finishers receive a medal. The event is organised by Högby IF and welcomes both recreational runners and young athletes.
course_highlights: 6.2 km of scenic cross-country running around First Camp Löttorp
Run through woodland and meadows with views of the Baltic Sea
Youth courses: 1.4 km and 800 m
additional: Register by 15 July 2026. Late registration is open until 20 July; after that, you can register when collecting your race bib on race day (from 15:00). Late registration fee: SEK 300 for Men/Women and SEK 200 for Children/Youth. Payment accepted by cash, card or Swish. Children’s/youth classes: P/F7 (800 m), P/F9, P/F11 and P/F13 (1.4 km), with separate start times; classes for ages 11 and under have no timing or prize-giving. All finishers receive a medal. Information: Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02. Register by 15 July 2026; late registration until 20 July; after that, at race-bib collection on race day from 15:00. Late registration fee: SEK 300 (Men/Women), SEK 200 (Children/Youth). Classes P/F11 and younger have no timing or prize-giving. Cross-country race at First Camp Löttorp, with start times for different age groups: P/F7 (800 m), P/F9 (1.4 km), P/F11 (1.4 km) and P/F13 (1.4 km).

name: 34. Lippesee Marathon
description: The 34th Lippesee Marathon in Paderborn-Sande is a private marathon run held according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, around Lake Lippesee, a popular leisure area and water sports center. Participants must bring their own refreshments, as there are no aid stations, and record their time manually; a photo of the clock must be submitted by email as proof. The event is intended for experienced runners aged 18 and over, has a limit of 18 participants, and takes place only if at least five people register.
course_highlights: Seven laps of 6.1 km around Lake Lippesee, 42.7 km in total
The course is marked with arrows and tape; a GPS track and map are available in advance
The course can be very busy in good weather; participants can access their own supplies at their car after each lap
additional: Timekeeping is done with a manual stopwatch; a photo of the clock taken on race day must be emailed as proof. Showers and changing rooms are not available. Participation is at your own risk, and a liability waiver applies. Register by email no later than 6 p.m. on the day before the event, providing personal details. The organizer requests a voluntary donation of €5 for a tree. Minimum age: 18. Participant limit: 18. Course: 7 laps of 6.1 km each. Participants bring their own supplies; no showers or changing rooms. Participation is at your own risk; the organizer accepts no liability.

name: Bokeler Windmühlenlauf
description: The 20th Bokeler Windmühlenlauf takes place on 24 July 2026 in Bokel. This long-standing anniversary race is organised by ALG-VfL Bokel. The number of participants is limited to 300, and registration is via the RaceResult platform. The race offers runners a special atmosphere in the region and is a popular event for enthusiasts of endurance sports and athletics.
course_highlights: Various race distances (5 km, 10 km, children's race)
Local club atmosphere
Limited to 300 runners
additional: The number of places is limited to 300. The organisational fee covers provision costs and is non-refundable, including in cases of force majeure. Registration is via RaceResult; places are limited to 300. Date: 24.07.2026

name: Fun-Lauf "Durch den Wewerschen Wald"
description: The 33rd Fun Run “Through the Wewer Forest” in Paderborn is a community run with no timing and no entry fee, taking place on 24 July 2026. The event supports children in need through many thousands of steps and asks participants to donate instead. The races take place on flat loop courses with little elevation gain and are suitable for everyone. There are also races for children and young people.
course_highlights: Flat loop course (one lap)
Little elevation gain (30 to 40 metres uphill)
Distance options: 5 km and 7 km
additional: Run with no timing and no entry fee; donations are requested instead. There are races for children and young people. The finish location is not publicly displayed (RUNME Premium required). Runs on flat loop courses, various distances, no timing, no entry fee, donations for charitable causes.

name: 13. Heilwald Marathon
description: The Heilwald Marathon in Bad Lippspringe is a special race held in the midst of the 200-hectare Heilwald, a recreational and therapeutic forest unique in Europe, with a soothing low-mountain climate. The course consists of six large loops of 7.05 km each, for a total of 42.3 km, and has been carefully measured using a measuring wheel and GPS. This is a private, self-supported running event with manual timekeeping; a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participants take part at their own risk. There is no entry fee; instead, voluntary donations for tree planting are requested.
course_highlights: 6 loops of 7.05 km through the Heilwald in Bad Lippspringe
A species-rich therapeutic forest unique in Europe, with a low-mountain climate
Self-supported event, with refreshments available at your own car after each loop
additional: Time is recorded using a manual stopwatch; proof must be submitted by email on race day as a photo of the clock. Showers and changing facilities are not available. Participant limit: 18. Minimum age: 18. Participation is at your own risk, with a liability waiver. The organizer reserves the right to reject registrations without giving a reason. Course: 6 loops of 7.05 km; self-supported; no showers or changing facilities on site; participation at your own risk; limited field of 18.

name: 38. Heiligenhafen Mitternachtslauf

description: The 38th Heiligenhafen Midnight Run takes place on July 24, 2026, offering runners a special experience with late-evening start times. The main course covers 10 km through the town of Heiligenhafen, along the waterfront promenade and around the inland lake, with plenty of support along the route. Additional races include the Binnensee Run (approx. 5.5 km), the Midnight Run Double Mile (approx. 3.2 km) for young people, and the Mini Midnight Run (approx. 1 km) for children. The event is organized by TSV Heiligenhafen and is a popular tradition, featuring electronic timing and a lively program on race day.
course_highlights: 10 km loop through Heiligenhafen, including the waterfront promenade and inland lake
Gentle ascents and descents; start and finish at the Lütjenburger Weg sports field
Additional distances: 5.5 km Binnensee Run, 3.2 km Double Mile, 1 km Mini Midnight Run
additional: Electronic timing with transponder technology at no rental charge; late entries are possible on race day up to 1 hour before the start for an additional fee; participant limit of 1,250 runners; relay race available; extensive supporting program with children’s races, the Double Mile, the Binnensee Run, and Zumba events. The race is officially measured, with certificates, trophies, and cash prizes for the top finishers. Individual and relay races are available; participation is open from age 16.

name: Falkenbergs Stadslopp

tiers.label: tier_1

description: Falkenbergs Stadslopp is a popular 10 km road race through Falkenberg’s central streets and green spaces. The race takes place on Saturday, 25 July 2026, with a mass start at 12:00, and is suitable for both experienced runners and recreational participants. In 2026, the course has been rerouted because of municipal work at Doktorspromenaden. The event has a festive atmosphere, with spectators cheering along the course. It has been held for more than 40 years and is part of Tour de Falkenberg.
course_highlights: 10 km through the city centre and green spaces
New course route in 2026 because of work at Doktorspromenaden
Start at Falkenbergs Idrottsplats (new start location) and finish in the city centre at Nygatan / Stortorget
additional: One distance: 10 km, with separate women’s and men’s categories; the course is officially measured by the Swedish Athletics Association. The prize ceremony is at approximately 13:00, and every finisher receives a medal. Self-seeded mass start, with start corrals marked by pace flags (e.g. 4:30/km). Water is available at the start and at two aid stations along the course. Race bibs can be collected at Team Sportia (Lokstallarna, Sandgatan 40) on Thursday and Friday of race week from 12:00 to 18:00, and at the start area on Saturday from 9:00. Bag drop is available at the start area from 10:00; bags must be collected by 15:00. Entry fees are non-refundable, but the organisers can help with name changes. The race is part of Tour de Falkenberg and is the 2026 district championship. The 10 km course runs through central Falkenberg; the start is on Läroverksgatan and the finish is at Nygatan/Stortorget. The course has been changed for 2026 because of Doktorspromenaden.

name: Bjäre Trail
description: Bjäre Trail is a trail race on the beautiful Bjäre Peninsula, featuring a very hilly course along the northern side of Hallandsåsen. You run through Sinarpsdalen, dense beech forests with rushing waterfalls, and past grazing pastures, a disused ski slope and an old railway—the course offers many magical views. The website lists several distances (12 km, 17 km, 34 km and 51 km) and a children’s race. You are welcome to register and enjoy a challenging trail experience close to nature.
course_highlights: A very hilly course along the northern side of Hallandsåsen
Passes through Sinarpsdalen and dense beech forests with rushing waterfalls
Features grazing pastures, a disused ski slope and an old railway, with magical views
additional: Start and finish at Båstad Företagsby, Ängelholmsvägen 269, 42 Båstad. The children’s/junior race is approximately 2,000 m. Register on site (cash or Swish) for 60 kr. The website offers race information, a start list, previous results and a GPS file (.gpx) of the course. Maximum 300 participants; register via the website; the regular registration deadline is one week before the start; late registration is available on race day for an additional fee. Race numbers can be collected at the start/finish no later than one hour before the start, or at Bjäre bär’s farm shop. Toilets are available in the business park; there are no changing rooms or showers. Travel by Skånetrafiken is recommended.

name: 10. NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf
price_range: 25 EUR für Erwachsene, 20 EUR für Kids
description: The NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf is a maritime race held annually on the North Sea island of Norderney since 2016. The event offers a unique running experience amid the island’s natural surroundings and special atmosphere. The routes pass through the historic Kurplatz and by landmarks such as Napoleonschanze, Schwanenteich and the island windmill. The race is suitable for all age groups and includes distances from the Bambini Run to the half marathon.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Kurplatz, beside the Conversationshaus and Badehaus
Past Napoleonschanze, the oldest monument on Norderney
Through the lively shopping streets, with spectators cheering runners on
additional: The official technical T-shirt can be ordered during registration and is distributed with the race pack. It costs EUR 25 for adults and EUR 20 for children. Late entries are possible online until 22.07.2026 for a fee, and in person on 24 and 25.07.2026. Timing is by ChampionChip; chip rental costs between EUR 3 and EUR 5, depending on the race. A preferred race number is available for an additional EUR 3. Cut-off times: 1:15h for 10 km and 2:30h for the half marathon. Island and maritime theme, sustainable technical T-shirt, in-person registration, online results, ferry connections for participants, test run on the day before the race, certificates and medals for children

name: 6. GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon
description: The GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon is a 50 km trail race starting in Kaltenweide, Langenhagen, Germany. The course has a modest elevation gain of around 350 metres and must be completed within 8 hours. It runs through woodland and trails, past Brelinger Berg and its geological nature trail, then back along Bissendorfer Moor. The event is registered with the German Ultramarathon Association and offers online results, certificates and finisher medals.
course_highlights: 50 km trail with approximately 350 m of elevation gain
Loop course over Brelinger Berg and its geological nature trail
Section along Bissendorfer Moor
additional: Participants have 8 hours to complete the course. The event offers finisher medals, online results and certificates. Typical July weather is around 25 °C, with mostly sunny days. The route includes 16 km from Kaltenweide to Brelingen, 18 km around Brelinger Berg and the Geological Natural Monument, and the final 16 km back to Kaltenweide along Bissendorfer Moor. The event offers certificates and finisher medals.

name: FriesenCross
description: The Friesencross in Schillig is one of Germany’s most extraordinary cross-country running events and takes place on July 25, 2026. The course runs right along the beach and offers a unique natural experience along the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea. Runners cross soft sandy beaches, green meadows and even the muddy seabed, perfectly combining a sporting challenge with a North Sea atmosphere. The event is hosted by running and sports presenter Heino Krüger, who guides the day with extensive experience. The Fries festival takes place alongside the race, bringing atmosphere, music and culinary highlights.
course_highlights: Course right along Schillig beach
Route along the UNESCO World Heritage Site of the Wadden Sea
Course across sandy beaches, green meadows and muddy seabed
additional: The event is hosted by running and sports presenter Heino Krüger. The Fries festival takes place alongside the Friesencross on Schillig beach, bringing music, atmosphere and culinary highlights. Races on sand, meadows and tidal flats; various distances (400 m to 10 km); supporting program with the Fries festival; registration includes a T-shirt; race commentary by Heino Krüger.

name: Mulsumer Speckenlauf
location: Sportplatz Mulsum, Wurster Nordseeküste, Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: kostenfrei für Mitglieder, sonst nicht explizit
description: The Mulsumer Speckenlauf is a traditional running event held annually by TSV Mulsum. The event takes place at the Mulsum sports ground in Wurster Nordseeküste and attracts numerous runners. The course offers a sporting challenge, accompanied by a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main race, there is also a children’s sports festival featuring classic events, highlighting the family-friendly character of the event.
course_highlights: 5.3 km course offering a sporting challenge
Start and finish at the Mulsum sports ground
Family-friendly children’s sports festival featuring classic events after the race
additional: On-site late registration is possible up to 45 minutes before the start. A cash prize is offered for improving a course record. Course distances: 5.3 km and 10 km; start and finish: Mulsum sports ground; registration until 23 July via wattzeit; participation at your own risk.

description: We invite you to the 26th edition of the Run Around Moryń and Lake Morzycko, a unique event combining sporting competition with the beauty of Western Pomerania. It’s a great opportunity for runners and fans of an active lifestyle to meet in Moryń and enjoy being outdoors. Whatever your experience level, there’s something here for everyone.
course_highlights: Scenic route around Lake Morzycko
Beautiful views of Western Pomerania
A sporting community atmosphere and active lifestyle

The finish is at Pokoju Square in front of the stage. Participants must be at least 16 years old and obey traffic regulations.

The course runs through the streets of Lębork
Ceremonial start at Pokoju Square, race start on Armii Krajowej Street, finish at Pokoju Square

Certified course, start and finish at Pokoju Square, secured by event staff, participants must obey traffic regulations, race packs can be collected on race day.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the location. The organizers’ goal is to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. It’s a great opportunity to spend time actively in the beautiful surroundings of Gdynia.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on Gdynia’s scenic routes
Routes that highlight the beauty of the location
Organized with passion since 2014
additional: The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages.

name: XIII Pętla Tuszkowska Matka
description: The 13th Tuszkowska Matka Loop is a 10 km race held in Lipusz as part of the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series. The course winds through the scenic landscapes of Kashubia, offering participants exceptional views and sporting challenges. Part of the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series
Runs through the charming landscapes of Kashubia

There is also a 5 km race, the 5 van DAEL, and a youth run for children up to 12 years old. After the finish, participants receive an original running shirt and excellent refreshments at the atmospheric finish field.

description: The Volkswandertag in Bollensen is an annual event held on the last Sunday in July, open to hiking enthusiasts of all ages. A range of family-friendly routes is offered, following forest trails through the beautiful Solling region. The marathon and half-marathon hikes are loop courses starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports clubhouse. All routes are marked and have refreshment stations. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with food and drinks in the finish area and a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Forest trails through the Solling region
Loop courses starting and finishing at the TSV Bollensen sports clubhouse
Refreshment stations along the route and at the finish
additional: Participant limit: 400. Refreshments along the routes (3 stations on the marathon and 2 on the half-marathon), plus coffee and cold drinks at the start, one complimentary drink and a food voucher at the finish. On-site late registration is available up to one hour before the start, with a €5 late registration fee. Hiking routes of 3, 7, 12 and 42 km; registration by 29.05.2026; participant limit of 400; refreshments and drinks included; special stamp on 27 July 2025 for €3.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
description: The Nadmorski Spa Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque town of Dąbki in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the attractions of the Dąbki Health Resort and the Municipality of Darłowo. The program includes races for children and young people, a 10 km race, and special accompanying races such as the Spa Sea Mile. Organizers provide a varied program and attractive prizes, and the race route runs through the charming spa area.
course_highlights: 10 km race route through the Dąbki Health Resort area
Spa Sea Mile over a distance of 1,852 m
Children’s and youth races over distances from 150 m to 1,100 m
additional: The event program spans two days: on 25 July, the Spa Sea Mile, with separate races for women and men; and on 26 July, races for children and young people, the ZaRadnych i OdWażnych 1,100 m race, and the main 10 km race. The race office is open from 16:00 to 18:00 on 25 July and from 8:30 on 26 July. The time limit for completing the Sea Mile is 20 minutes. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and the Dąbki Health Resort, with registration opening on 1 April 2026.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
organizer: Zachodniopomorskie Centrum Kultury Obszarów Wiejskich i Edukacji Ekologicznej
description: The summer edition of Botaniczna Piątka is a 5 km race held in the picturesque Przelewice Dendrological Garden. It is a great opportunity to combine physical activity with relaxation amid greenery and nature. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series and is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants receive a commemorative water lily-shaped medal, and the main race is scheduled to start at 10:00.
course_highlights: A 5 km course in the Przelewice Dendrological Garden
Picturesque scenery surrounded by greenery and nature
A relaxing atmosphere for a summer race
additional: The race takes place as a special summer edition of the Botaniczna Piątka series. Participants receive a commemorative water lily-shaped medal. The event is co-financed from the budget of the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and held under the honorary patronage of the Marshal of the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Przelewice Gardens also offer a range of attractions and services, including garden tours, a restaurant, conference rooms and guest rooms. Finisher medals; an event connected with culture and education; the opportunity to take part in a summer edition in beautiful gardens.

name: V Bursztynowy Półmaraton Jantar
location: Jantar, Gmina Stegna, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: ATEA Kalmarmilen
description: ATEA Kalmarmilen is an established 10K race in Kalmar, held on 29 July 2026, and welcomes both recreational and elite runners. The race starts at Teatervallen and finishes at Larmtorget. The course passes Kalmar Castle, Stensö, the Old Town, the harbor, Fredrikskans, Lindö and Ängö before returning to the city centre for the final stretch. The race also has District Championship/Veteran District Championship status for Östsvenska and is organised by Högby IF. It is part of the I Run Kalmar race series. The children’s race, Lilla Atea Kalmarmilen, is held on the same day for different age groups, making it a family event with several running options.
course_highlights: Starts at Teatervallen and finishes at Larmtorget in Kalmar
The course passes landmarks including Kalmar Castle, the Old Town and the harbor
Illuminated running tracks and exercise trails in Kalmar; Lilla Atea Kalmarmilen for children is held at the same time
additional: Högby IF’s athletics page lists several upcoming races, including Kalmar Backyard Ultra, Skälbyloppet and Ölands Tjurrus, with dates and start times. The pages mention GPX files and a course map, as well as a walking category (Skälbyloppet: 4 km without timing) and separate start times for youth and senior categories. Race bib collection is at Kalmar Teater on 28 July from 15:00 to 17:00 and 29 July from 15:00 to 19:00. ICA MAXI provides drinks, fruit and chocolate after the race. Lilla Atea Kalmarmilen is held at the same time for children aged 2–13; the main race has a 10 km distance, as well as mini categories and distances for younger age groups.

name: 43. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a private marathon run held in accordance with the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.10 km each, for a total of 42.7 km, and is marked with arrows or barrier tape depending on the weather. The event emphasizes self-sufficiency, as runners pass their cars after each lap. Marathon times are recorded using a hand stopwatch, and a certificate is sent by email. Participants must be at least 18 years old. There is no entry fee, but a voluntary donation of €5 is requested.
course_highlights: 7 large laps of 6.10 km each, 42.7 km in total
Course marked with arrows or barrier tape depending on the weather
Self-sufficiency is possible, as runners pass their cars after each lap
additional: Start and finish at the parking lot by the Stadthalle, Hauptstraße 120, 33378 Rheda-Wiedenbrück. No showers or changing rooms are available on site, but there are toilets with warm water 150 m away and two additional toilets near the course. Participant limit: 22. Register by email no later than 6 p.m. on the day before the event, providing first name, last name, year of birth, and club. Participation is at your own risk; a liability waiver applies. Marathon times are recorded using a hand stopwatch; the ultramarathon has external timekeeping, with a photo as proof. Participants who stop the clock for drink breaks will be disqualified. Course: 7 laps of 6.10 km; ultra: 8 laps of 6.25 km; no showers; toilet 150 m away; participants must be at least 18; registration by 6 p.m. on the day before the event.

name: 4 PolandRockowy Bieg Policz się z cukrzy...
location: Broczyno, Czaplinek, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: 39e Kooyman Polderloop
description: The Kooyman Polderloop is an annual running race in De Kwakel, organized by Atletiek Vereniging Aalsmeer. This popular race takes place during a beautiful summer of sport and attracts many participants, including many AVA members. The event offers an enjoyable, sporty evening with a challenging course through the polder landscape. It is a fixture in the region and is known for its friendly, accessible atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the distinctive polder landscape
Evening race with a sporty, welcoming atmosphere
Organized by the local athletics club, AVA Aalsmeer
additional: The start is usually at AVA, Sportlaan 43, Aalsmeer. There is a sociable post-race gathering with coffee or tea in the clubhouse. The club also organizes walking groups and running courses, strengthening the sporting community. Registration is via Inschrijven.nl; the event is part of the Polderfeest, which features activities such as food festivals, performances, and family activities over several days.

name: 07. Stadtholz Marathon
description: The Stadtholz Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a run at Heideteich, featuring a 6.14 km trail loop. The event is not competition-focused; it is aimed at runners who enjoy running in nature. The marathon is being held to mark Evi Köppe-Neeb’s linen wedding anniversary and offers a special atmosphere at Heideteich. The course features natural trails and a peaceful setting.
course_highlights: Trail course at Heideteich
6.14 km loop
Natural running course in Rheda-Wiedenbrück
additional: The run is explicitly not competition-focused. The organizer is Evi Köppe-Neeb. The course consists of trail loops at Heideteich, each 6.14 km long. The marathon is part of a regional event series; specific details about registration and terrain have not been published.

name: Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf
description: The Springe-Deister Summer Run on July 31, 2026, features a measured 5 km loop at the foot of the Kleiner Deister. The course is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), meaning results can be included in rankings. Kilometer markers are clearly signposted, and the course is gently hilly, with an elevation difference of about 20 meters. The race starts at 5:45 p.m. at Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe and is aimed at runners looking for an attractive, officially recognized race in the region.
course_highlights: 5 km loop measured by the DLV
Kilometer markers color-coded and signposted
Gently hilly course with an elevation difference of approx. 20 m
additional: Start and finish at Schulzentrum Süd (OHG) in Springe. Registration opens on March 22, 2026. Other events include the 15 km Stadtwerke Springe Run and 5 km walking/Nordic walking. The course is officially measured and recognized for rankings. Starts from 5:45 p.m.; part of the Laufpass series; course profile with 35 m of elevation gain.

name: Bruksleden Terrängmaraton
description: Welcome to Bruksleden Terrängmaraton, a friendly trail race along the beautiful Bruksleden on Saturday, 1 August 2026. The race offers two distances: 42 km (Helan) and 21 km (Halvan), and is suitable for both experienced trail runners and curious recreational runners. The courses pass through forests, along winding trails and by lakes, with varied and sometimes technically demanding terrain. The number of starting places is limited to preserve the welcoming atmosphere, and there are staffed checkpoints along the course. After finishing, showers and a light meal are available.
course_highlights: Running on Bruksleden’s winding forest trails
Sections passing lakes and beautiful forest scenery
Varied, sometimes technical terrain with steep climbs and descents
additional: Two distances: 42 km (Helan) and 21 km (Halvan). Limited number of starting places: 200. The deadline for standard registration is 17 July 2026; late registration is available through 30 July 2026 for a 50% surcharge. There are staffed checkpoints along the course for refills. Course profiles and routes (21 km and 42 km), as well as maps, are published on the organiser’s pages. The organiser reserves the right to make changes to the course. Gathering/start information is listed as 10:00; after finishing, showers and a light meal are available. The number of starting places for Helan and Halvan is limited, to approximately 200 participants. The finish area at Fageråsen includes showers and catering.

name: PRB (Växjö)
description: PRB is a Backyard Ultra event in Växjö, held as a Silver Ticket event in 2026. Participants run a 6,706-metre loop, with a start every hour on the hour. The first start is at 10:00, and the race follows last-person-standing rules based on the general principles of Backyard Ultra. The course is varied and easy to run, combining asphalt and gravel/trails to help runners keep going for as long as possible. The loop turnaround and finish are on the southern shore of Trummen, with services in the turnaround area for runners and their companions.
course_highlights: 6,706-metre loop — 24 loops equal 100 miles (160.93 km)
Approximately 35 metres of elevation gain per loop
Around 3 km of asphalt per loop, with the rest on gravel and trails; the turnaround is on the southern shore of Trummen, close to a playground, skate park and swimming area
additional: The organiser provides an aid table in the turnaround area with sports drink (Umara), water, Coca-Cola, coffee, sweets, crisps and fruit. A cooked meal is served every six hours, with the first serving after four hours. Anyone who completes at least one loop receives a medal from Yoga Wood and a Finisher Beer from Tomorrow Brewing. Participants may set up small tents and chairs in the turnaround area. The nearest bus stop is Trummenvägen (route 3), and the recommended parking is at Ica Kvantum Teleborg (fee: ~10 SEK/day). Participants who choose to withdraw must notify the race management to receive a result. You may not cross the start line and turn back, as the course is one-way, but you may cross the line to change clothes, eat, use the toilet, etc. The race information indicates that public transport and parking are nearby.

name: ÖTILLÖ Gothenburg
description: ÖTILLÖ Swimrun Gothenburg is a well-established swimrun race in the southern Gothenburg archipelago, rooted in a strong local tradition. The event offers three distances—Experience, Sprint and World Series—with varied running and many short open-water swims between granite islands. The start and finish area at Styrsö Bratten is easy to reach by frequent ferry services, and the organiser highlights spectator-friendly views and a summer-friendly race format. The schedule and practical information (ferries, race bib collection and more) are published on the race website ahead of the races.
course_highlights: Frequent transitions between land and water, with many short, intense swim sections (island hopping)
Varied terrain on granite islands: fast trails, rocks and hilly sections
Spectator-friendly and easy to reach, with several daily ferry departures to Styrsö Bratten
additional: Schedule and practical information: race bib collection at the gym at Styrsöskolan (Friday 16:00–17:00 for Experience/Sprint/World Series; Saturday morning according to the timetable); fixed ferry times are recommended (departures from Stenpiren/Saltholmen to Styrsö Bratten). The World Series entry fee includes timing, live tracking if needed, a safety plan with safety boats at swim sections, aid stations along the course, and free post-race food and drink at the finish. Distance-specific details: World Series ~39,200 m (29 running, 28 swimming), Sprint ~22,400 m (18 running, 17 swimming), Experience ~8,800 m (8 running, 7 swimming). Start and finish at Styrsö Brattenbadet; ferry services from Saltholmen or Stenpiren provide access to the race area; limited parking at Saltholmen; use of public transport and the Västtrafik To Go app for ferry tickets and schedules is recommended. Plan your journey in advance and arrive at the start area in good time.

name: HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf, 46. Int. Volkslauf mit HM
description: The HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf in Duisburg is a traditional road race with a flat course along the Rhine. On 25 July 2026, events will be held over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km and the half marathon (21.1 km). The flat course makes the race appealing to runners of all abilities. All events share the same finish line, and the event offers a pleasant atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Rhine
Events over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km and the half marathon
All events finish at the same location
additional: Start times: 7.5 km walking at 15:00, 5 km run at 16:50, 10 km run at 17:40, half marathon at 17:30. All events take place on a flat course. Results will be published on the RUNME results page. The event takes place on 25 July 2026 and offers start times for various events. Results will be available shortly after the races finish. The event is particularly appealing in good weather.

name: Sechs-Std.-Lauf am Förderturm Bönen
location: Ehemaliges Zechengelände, Bönen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Six-Hour Run at the Bönen Headframe is a unique ultrarunning event held on an officially measured loop course at a former colliery site. The course is traffic-free, gently undulating, and consists of asphalt and compact gravel. The event offers comprehensive refreshments, including vegan options, and professional lap counting via race result. With a minimum age of 20, the run is aimed at experienced ultrarunners who want to test their endurance in a friendly, well-organized atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop course at a former colliery site, traffic-free
Lap length: 1,340 m; surface: asphalt and compact gravel
Officially measured course with gentle undulations
additional: Race bib pickup on event day from 07:00 to 08:30. Showers and changing facilities are available at the nearby Goethe Sports Hall and in the Förderturm Shaft Hall (not supervised; no liability is accepted). A variety of food and drinks, including vegan options, will be provided before and during the run. Laps are counted electronically via race result, with measurement of the remaining distance. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross local branch in Bönen (DRK-Ortsverein Bönen e.V.). Awards ceremony at approximately 16:00. Minimum age: 20. Maximum 200 participants; on-site registration is possible for a €10 fee. Loop course at a former colliery site, vegan refreshments, race bib pickup 07:00–08:30, minimum age 20.

name: Markttagelauf
description: The Markttage Run in Bredstedt is an international charity run, with entry fees donated to a good cause. There are different distances for children, beginners and experienced runners, taking them through Bredstedt’s town centre. The event fosters community spirit and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups. Registration is online, and the entry fees are moderate to make it accessible to as many people as possible.
course_highlights: Different routes for children, beginners and experienced runners
Run through Bredstedt’s town centre
International charity run
additional: Registration is online only, until 30.07., at www.my.raceresult.com. Entry fees are donated. Note: The event information PDF is currently not accessible. Several distances for different ability levels; event in August 2026; children participate for free, adults pay up to 5 euros.

name: 18. Ottonenlauf
description: The Ottonenlauf is a scenic race in the Harz Mountains, bringing runners from three different villages to a shared finish in the UNESCO World Heritage City of Quedlinburg. The 21.1 km, 42.2 km and 69 km distances start in Stiege, Alexisbad and Meisdorf, respectively. The route runs mainly along forest and woodland paths through the Selke Valley, with shaded forests, rural sections and moderate climbs that call for a good pace. Walking and Nordic walking options are also available, making the event accessible to a wide range of participants. Electronic timing and finisher medals round out the event.
course_highlights: Scenic trail race along the Selketal-Stieg
Forest and woodland paths with shaded sections
Moderate climbs, with 809 m of ascent and more than 1,000 m of descent on the long course
additional: Three starting points for different distances, all finishing in Quedlinburg. Electronic timing and medals for all finishers. Typical August weather: approx. 25 °C and mostly sunny. Trail-style race with multiple distances, including walking options; course not officially measured; medals for all finishers; online registration; route through quiet Harz forest paths.

name: 24. Hella Marathon Nacht
description: The hella marathon nacht rostock is an atmospheric sunset run set against the picturesque backdrop of the Haedgehalbinsel in Rostock’s city harbour. The event offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 km and a schoolchildren’s race. All start at dusk and finish beneath bright lights. The route passes through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, and is closed to traffic. The event combines a sporting challenge with northern German hospitality and a holiday atmosphere.
course_highlights: The marathon route runs along the Warnow and through the Warnow Tunnel
The half marathon passes through IGA Park and runs along the Warnow to the city harbour
The Rostocker 7 km is a loop around the city harbour
additional: Start times: schoolchildren’s race 17:00, marathon 18:00, Rostocker 7 km 19:07. Finish closes at 23:30. Start and finish at the Haedgehalbinsel, Rostock city harbour. A technical shirt can be pre-ordered (€28, until 21.07.2026 only; collection only during event weekend). Race-pack collection on 31.07.2026 and 01.08.2026 on site. The event takes place in Rostock, with the start and finish on the Haedgehalbinsel at Rostock city harbour. It is known for its festive atmosphere, medals and professional timing. The routes run along the Warnow and through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park.

name: adidas Runners City Night
description: The adidas Runners City Night Berlin is a unique summer event that combines running and inline skating with a big party on the famous Kurfürstendamm. The event offers 5 km and 10 km courses for runners, as well as a 10 km inline skating course through the vibrant City West. Live bands, cheering zones and enthusiastic fans create an exhilarating atmosphere that makes the race an unforgettable experience. The finish at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church, with its illuminated finish arch, is the perfect finale to this sporting night.
course_highlights: Course through City West and along Kurfürstendamm
Live bands and cheering points, especially at the adidas Cheering Zone at Adenauerplatz
Start and finish at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church
additional: Start times: 5 km run at 19:00, 10 km run at 20:00. Timing is recorded using a transponder on the back of the race bib. The 5 km run has a turnaround point; the 10 km run follows a star-shaped route with several passes by the adidas Cheering Zone. Eligibility: born in 2016 or earlier (5 km) or 2014 or earlier (10 km). Personalized medal engraving can be booked. Extras such as an event shirt and bag storage can be added during registration. The course runs along Kurfürstendamm and through Old West Berlin; the start is at sunset. Includes a medal with a lighting effect; medal engraving is optional. Online registration is available.

name: hella marathon nacht rostock
description: The hella marathon nacht rostock is an atmospheric sunset run along the Warnow, with maritime flair and Hanseatic hospitality. The event takes place in Rostock in August and offers races over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7 and a children’s race. The start and finish are at Rostock’s city harbor, where runners set off at dusk and finish beneath bright lights. The course runs through the Warnow Tunnel and IGA Park, among other places, making for a unique running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rostock’s city harbor, with maritime flair
The course passes through the nearly 800 m-long Warnow Tunnel
Run through IGA Park with a picturesque sunset
additional: Start times: children’s race 17:00, marathon 18:00, Rostocker 7 approx. 19:07. Finish closes at 23:30. Marathon participants must pass the Warnow crossing checkpoint by 20:40. Pre-ordered technical shirts are available only during event weekend; no shipping by post. Race packet pickup at the event center on Haedge Peninsula, Rostock city harbor, on 31.07.2026 from 16:00–19:00 and on 01.08.2026 from 12:00–18:30. Event in August, dusk start, various race distances, finisher medals, certificates available immediately, optional event shirt, chip timing.

name: Hemfurth-Edersee-Abendlauf
description: The Hemfurth-Edersee Evening Run is a traditional late-summer event that brings runners of all ages together in the beautiful surroundings of Edertal-Hemfurth. In pleasant temperatures and as the sun sets, the focus is on the joy of running and a sense of community. Participants can look forward to refreshments, good music and a relaxed get-together at the finish. The run is organized on a voluntary basis by TSV 08 Hemfurth-Edersee e.V. and is a popular event for competitive runners, recreational joggers and families.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque countryside around Lake Edersee
Evening start in pleasant temperatures
A shared running experience for all ages
additional: The Evening Run takes place annually in late summer, usually in early August. The event is organized on a voluntary basis. There are refreshments, music and a social get-together at the finish. Timing is done using special software that is used only once a year. The available pages do not provide explicit information about start times, price tiers or registration procedures. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberg Running Cup. All finishers receive certificates, Bambini participants receive medals, and prizes are awarded to the top runners in the main categories. On-site registration is possible until 30 minutes before the start.

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: The St. Dominic’s International Run is a prestigious running event held annually in Gdańsk since 1994 and an integral part of St. Dominic’s Fair. The race attracts over 1,200 participants and tens of thousands of spectators, offering a unique atmosphere in the city’s historic centre. The course runs through the picturesque streets of Gdańsk’s Old Town, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration. The running festival features several races, including the 5 km Women’s Run, the 5 km Men’s Run and the Polish 10 km Championships.
course_highlights: A 1,412 m loop through central Gdańsk, starting and finishing by Neptune’s Fountain
The route passes along Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników, Podwale Przedmiejskie and other streets
Cheering from more than 25,000 spectators along the course
additional: The course is a 1,412 m loop in central Gdańsk, allowing spectators to follow the competition closely. The event is accompanied by the varied programme of St. Dominic’s Fair, with concerts, shows and partner stands. The run promotes social integration, a healthy lifestyle and sport for people with disabilities as part of the “Chase St. Dominic” prologue. The event includes various race categories for women, men, elite runners and VIPs, with a wide range of age groups. Participants can support charitable causes through their entry fees, which go towards various social initiatives.

name: Arm Race Kamień
location: Cekow-Kolonia, Kamień County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: ARM Race Kamień is an extreme OCR obstacle race that welcomes both professionals and amateurs looking for an adrenaline rush. It is a challenge for whole families, including children, offering unusual entertainment and a chance to overcome personal weaknesses. The race is among Poland’s elite events of this kind and continues to grow, giving participants unforgettable experiences.
course_highlights: Extreme OCR obstacle race
Courses for different experience levels: PRO 10K, PRO 5K, OPEN 10K, OPEN 5K, FUN 5K, Pomarańczowy Wojownik
An event for families with children, amateurs, and professionals
additional: Distances: 5K and 10K; various formats; natural terrain; online registration

name: TGS - Trail Genom Skåne
description: TGS – Trail Through Skåne is a trail race featuring beautiful trails in Göinge and Hovdala Nature Reserve, starting and finishing at Trädhuset (Hovdala, Hässleholm). The race offers four distances (TGS 60, 35, 25 and 10), with TGS 60 run over two loops (35+25). The new 2026 route is more technical and has a reduced amount of asphalt (under 3 km), bringing runners closer to nature. The race is suitable for runners of different levels who want to enjoy forest terrain and well-marked courses.
course_highlights: Run on beautiful trails in Göinge and Hovdala Nature Reserve
TGS 60 consists of two loops (35+25); the course is more technical, with under 3 km of asphalt
Aid stations at km 13.2 and 24.6; start/finish at Trädhuset (Hovdala)
additional: Start and finish at Trädhuset (Hovdala, Hässleholm). TGS 60: 61.7 km with 1,060 m D+ / D- (maximum time 9h15min, cut-off at the loop point at 13:30). TGS 35: 35.1 km, 600 m+/-, starts at 09:30, finish closes at 17:00. TGS 25: 26.6 km, 460 m+/-, starts at 10:45, finish closes at 17:00. TGS 10: 10.2 km, 200 m+/-, starts at 13:45. Aid stations (VK) offer food, water, cola and sports drink (listed at km 13.2 and 24.6 depending on the distance). Registration is binding after payment; the organizer recommends that runners take out recreational race insurance. Start: The Treehouse/Trädhuset at Hovdala; various distances (50, 25/27, 10 km); restrictions include no trekking poles and carrying a mobile phone, water and energy; maximum times/cut-off times as stated on the website; free parking near the start/finish; aid stations as needed on hot days; results and food after the race.

name: Nordkirchener Halbmarathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 15 EUR bei Anmeldungen bis zum 15. Juni

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 17 EUR bei Anmeldung vom 16. Juni bis 27. Juli

description: The Nordkirchen Half Marathon takes place on August 2, 2026, and offers a scenic course through Nordkirchen Castle Park and the Obsen farming community. Runners start at the stadium in Castle Park, complete two laps of the stadium, and then run a nearly 10-kilometer loop through picturesque parkland and villages. Several aid stations along the route provide refreshments for participants. The finish is back at the stadium, where spectators can cheer on the runners and enjoy a lovely time together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the stadium in Nordkirchen Castle Park
Run through the expansive castle park with views of the castle
Loop through the Obsen farming community, where enthusiastic neighbors cheer runners on
additional: Personal refreshments can be dropped off before the start (8:00–8:45 a.m.). Water stations are located at km 4.5, 7, 9, 10.5, 14, 16.5, and 18.5. On-site late registration is available until 8:00 a.m. for an additional fee of EUR 3. Bibs with timing chips for electronic timekeeping will be issued and collected after the race, but participants may keep them as souvenirs. The course goes through Castle Park and Obsen, with the start and finish at the stadium in Castle Park. Registration is available online and on race day. Live results are available. Parking is available at the stadium, Nordkirchen Comprehensive School, and the Sundern car park.

name: 10. Charity-Lauf Koldingen
location: Koldingen, Pattensen, Region Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Koldingen Charity Run is part of the Sparkassen Running Pass of the Hanover Region, one of Germany’s largest running series, with 43 events in 2026. Runners can explore the Hanover Region on foot and collect stamps for their running pass at each event. The run offers a varied course in the beautiful surroundings of Pattensen and promotes recreational sport in the region. The event is open to everyone who wants to stay active while doing good.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic Hanover Region
Part of a major running series with 43 events in 2026
Opportunity to collect stamps for the Sparkassen Running Pass
additional: Participation in the Sparkassen Running Pass includes a digital app for collecting stamps and a digital running diary. A classic fold-out running pass is also available. The series features a variety of running events across the Hanover Region, with attractive rewards for taking part. The event offers laps for children and young people, with start times between 16:00 and 17:30, and usually takes place in August in warm weather.

name: 55. Volkslauf Rund um Wellen
description: The 55th Volkslauf Rund um Wellen takes place on August 2, 2026, in Beverstedt-Wellen and is one of Germany’s oldest marathon races, with a family-friendly atmosphere. The event offers challenging courses over four distances: marathon, half marathon, 11 km, and 5 km. Some courses are officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The routes pass through varied landscapes, including forest trails and different surfaces. The event is organized by TSV Wellen and relies on support from many local volunteers.
course_highlights: Marathon and half-marathon courses officially measured by the DLV
11 km course with varied surfaces and forest trails
Aid stations every five kilometers on the half-marathon and marathon courses
additional: Late entries are accepted until 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €3 late-entry fee (except for children’s races). Handwritten commemorative certificates are available for an additional €3. Changing rooms and showers are available at the start and finish area. Participants travelling from farther away can stay overnight in the sports hall by prior arrangement. First-aid services are provided by the German Red Cross. Course marshals are provided by the Wellen Volunteer Fire Brigade and TSV Wellen volunteers. Walkers are welcome in the 5 km, 11 km, and half-marathon events, but are not ranked separately. Multiple race distances, family-friendly, community event in a small village community, supported by the local volunteer fire brigade.

name: Halland Ultra Beach Trailrun
organizer: Benen på Ryggen Adventures; Svalhögens IF
description: Halland Ultra-Beach (HUB) is a coastal ultrarunning event in the West Coast landscape that celebrates free trail running. The race consists of six stages between Gothenburg and Båstad, offering distances from individual stages (40–72 km) to the full race at 100 km, 100 miles and 200 miles. The routes often follow the shoreline and vary between sand, trails, pastures and more rugged terrain; runners navigate using digital maps/GPX and are largely self-sufficient between checkpoints. The organisers provide stations with warmth, food and energy from Umara, as well as some baggage transport and drop-bag services for the longer distances.
course_highlights: Six stages along the West Coast between Gothenburg and Båstad, mostly close to the shoreline
Varied terrain: beaches, trails, pastures and sections without clear tracks (some water crossings occur)
Largely off-trail and unmarked—navigate using a digital map/GPX (keep the sea on your right)
additional: Early-bird discount applies until 2025-09-30; registration is open until 2026-07-26, with very limited opportunities to register late. Maximum entries: 60 places for 200M and 100M; 30 places per individual stage. For 100k, 100M and 200M, some food and drop-bag service are provided at the end of each stage. The race pack includes a digital map, roadbook and GPX file; baggage transfer to the finish and hot food/drinks at checkpoints and the finish are provided. The race is largely self-sufficient between checkpoints and partly unmarked. Umara energy products are available at the stations; the race pack includes maps, a digital route description and GPX files. Hub Femdagars offers five daily stages (75/64/51/51/87 km), with accommodation options and pacing and guidance services; registration for Femdagars is via Race-ID.

name: Esenser Volksbanklauf - 31. Stadtlauf
description: The 31st Esens City Run, held as the 6th Esenser Volksbank Run, takes place on Friday, July 31, 2026, in Esens. The traditional “Around St. Magnus” run offers exciting races in the city center for runners of all ages. The event begins with the 670-meter Bambini run, followed by student races over 1,340 meters. Adults can compete over five and ten kilometers, with both races starting at the same time. The awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races.
course_highlights: “Around St. Magnus” run in Esens city center
670-meter Bambini run
Adult races over 5 and 10 kilometers
additional: Start times: Bambini run at 18:10, student race at 18:30, and adult 5 km and 10 km races at 19:30. Awards ceremonies take place immediately after the races. Online registration is available. Start and finish at Esens Market Square; online registration available; July weather: approx. 25°C, sunny

name: Heimat- und Schützenfestlauf
description: The Zerbst Local Heritage and Marksmen’s Festival Run takes place in the palace gardens of Zerbst/Anhalt and offers flat, varied routes on a 1.5 km loop combining paths and roads, with the start and finish in front of the town hall. The event is open to children, teenagers and adults, with distances ranging from 1.5 km to 9 km. Its friendly, family atmosphere and the opportunity to compete in different age groups and teams make it a popular event as part of the Local Heritage and Marksmen’s Festival.
course_highlights: Flat 1.5 km loop in the Zerbst palace gardens
Start and finish in front of the town hall
Sections on paths and roads
additional: Parking at Gartenstraße 21 (for navigation systems, enter Gartenstraße 26). Changing and shower facilities are available at the gym of the “An der Stadtmauer” primary school (approx. 500 m from the town hall). Certificates for the top three finishers in each age group. Trophy for the running group with the most participants (club, company or school; excluding the event organizers). No refunds for non-participation. Participants must be fit to compete. By registering, participants consent to the storage and publication of competition-related data and images in accordance with the EU GDPR. Race distances: 1.5 km, 3 km, 4.5 km and 9 km; online registration; run in the palace gardens; start times and further details on the official website.

name: Berglauf
description: TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. warmly invites you to the mountain run in Höxter, featuring a challenging course with varied terrain. The event includes a children’s mountain run of approx. 1 km and a main race of approx. 3.2 km with a steady climb and an elevation gain of about 170 metres. The course starts on the sports field and runs over grass, paved paths, meadow trails, and narrow gravel and forest paths to the finish in the forest. This long-standing running event welcomes runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Children’s mountain run of approx. 1 km with 50 m of elevation gain on a narrow gravel/forest path
Main race of approx. 3.2 km with a steady 170 m climb over paved paths and meadow trails
Start and finish on the sports field, with varied surfaces
additional: After the main race, runners return to the sports field by jogging gently or by car. The children’s mountain run starts on the sports field, with approx. 150 m of flat grass followed by paved and forest paths. The event is organised by TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. It takes place in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25°C and occasional rain. Registration is via the official website; details are available in a PDF file.

name: Gifhorner Friedhofslauf
location: Ev.-luth. Friedhof St. Nicolai, Gifhorn, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Gifhorn Cemetery Run is a special event held at the St. Nicolai Protestant Lutheran Cemetery in Gifhorn. Runners can choose between 4- and 8-kilometre courses. After the run, participants can enjoy a relaxed get-together with a barbecue and drinks beneath the apple trees. Traditionally held in the evening, the event combines physical activity with a laid-back atmosphere in a historic setting.
course_highlights: 4- and 8-kilometre routes around the cemetery grounds
A relaxed get-together with a barbecue and drinks beneath the apple trees
Direct connection to the Gifhorn Old Town Festival
additional: The run supports the Friedhofsmobil, a free transport service for seniors. After the run, participants can go straight to the Gifhorn Old Town Festival. Courses, registration, cemetery tours, refreshments, 2026 dates: 7 and 8 August.

name: Stora Stöten Run
description: Stora Stöten Run is a trail race in the heart of the Falun Mine World Heritage Site, offering a historic and varied running experience. The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses, following old routes known as Vattnets Väg till Gruvan (The Water’s Way to the Mine). The race has three distances (21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km) and welcomes both competitive runners and recreational participants, with the option to run timed or untimed. The event is organised by the orienteering club OK Kåre, which welcomes participants to the start and finish at Falun Mine.
course_highlights: Three courses: 21.6 km, 13.6 km and 5.6 km, starting and finishing at Falun Mine
The course passes medieval smelting sites, mining farmsteads, dams and dam houses along Vattnets Väg
Varied terrain: gravel, grass, trail tracks, nature paths and short paved sections; an initial climb and clearly marked downhill sections
additional: Start and finish at Falun Mine; warm-up begins at 12:10 on Falu Rödfärg’s paved area (approximately 7 minutes), led by Friskis & Svettis; all courses start at the same time, and runners are divided into two optional groups based on target pace (group 1: women ≤6 min/km, men ≤5 min/km). Runners can choose to run with or without timing; prizes go to the first three finishers on each course, with raffle prizes for other participants; teams can be registered (teams of 3), and registrations can be transferred free of charge through the registration system. The race information mentions aid stations/water stops, parking, race office, showers/changing facilities and course markings. All three courses start and finish at Falun Mine; results from previous years are available.

name: Ölands Marathon
description: Öland Marathon is an open marathon starting and finishing in the square in Löttorp. The course is very flat and easy to run, entirely paved, and offers views of Blå Jungfrun. The race consists of an inner loop of 2.1 km and an outer loop of 11.2 km, repeated three times until the distance of 42.195 km is reached. The race is organised by Högby IF and is aimed at recreational runners and masters categories in the stated divisions.
course_highlights: Very flat, easy-to-run marathon course
100% paved, officially measured by federation course measurer Carl‑Gustaf Nilsson
Start and finish in the square in Löttorp; a 2.1 km inner loop plus an 11.2 km outer loop repeated 3 times, with views of Blå Jungfrun
additional: Race bibs can be collected from 12:00. There are three aid stations per lap (approx. 13.3 km), serving sports drink (Umara), Coca-Cola and water; personal energy supplies must be handed in no later than one hour before the start. All finishers receive a medal/fossil made of Öland limestone; ÖM medals go to the top two in each category. The women’s and men’s winners receive dinner for two at Kalk in Löttorp. Accommodation is available in four-bed cabins at Högby IP. Aid stations: three per lap. The course consists of a 2.1 km section in Löttorp followed by an 11.2 km section: Löttorp - Alvedsjö - Kalmarsund - Gudesjö - Löttorp, repeated three times for a total of 42.195 km. Start and finish in the square in Löttorp; accommodation information is available via links on the organiser’s website.

name: Svartåloppet
description: Svartåloppet is a recurring running event held on the second Saturday in August, bringing together runners over several distances. The event offers 14 km and 5.5 km on hilly forest roads and trails, as well as a flat 2.5 km route on roads. The start and finish are at Svartå Folketshus, and timing is provided by Racetimer, delivering modern and reliable results. The event welcomes both recreational and competitive runners and highlights the local landscape and trail network.
course_highlights: 14 km and 5.5 km: hilly forest course on forest roads and trails
2.5 km: flatter route on roads
Start and finish at Svartå Folketshus
additional: Timing for Svartåloppet is provided by Racetimer, and results from previous years are published via Racetimer. The event is held annually on the second Saturday in August. The website contact is listed as Svartå Utvecklingsgrupp, telephone number 076 3073096. Three distances; children's race includes a medal and bag of sweets; on-site registration is available at the stated times (09:00–10:30), according to the event information.

name: Bunketorp Backyard Ultra Trail
description: Bunketorp Backyard Ultra Trail is a “last-man-standing” race in Backyard Ultra format, where participants run a 6,706-metre lap every hour on the hour until only one runner remains. The course in Bunketorp, Lindome (south of Gothenburg), runs entirely through woodland on well-trodden trails, with no asphalt or gravel, and features varied, hilly terrain. The race is organised by IK Uven and has a personal, family-friendly setup with good facilities for both runners and accompanying guests. The 2026 race starts on Saturday, 8 August 2026 at 10:00.
course_highlights: Lap distance: 6,706 metres (Backyard Ultra rules)
Soft forest trails without asphalt or gravel, and no long straight sections
Approximately 140 m of elevation gain per lap, with three distinct major climbs
additional: The organiser provides changing rooms with showers and a sauna, at least seven toilets (including portable toilets), 3–5 participant tents, and space for personal tents. The race office handles bibs, valuables storage and results; a staffed aid station is available throughout the race, and simple refreshments are sold to spectators. First aid supplies and a defibrillator are available at the venue (there is no trained medical staff). There is no age limit; participation is at the participant’s own risk. Race rules: laps are one-way, participants must be in the starting corral at every hourly start and must inform the race office if they withdraw. Prizes are awarded to the top three women, the top three men and the best team (3 runners). Participants start every hour and must complete a lap within the hour; 6,706 m per lap; 120 starting places; Silver Ticket for 2026; results reported to DUV; aid station, drinks, hot food at certain times, changing facilities, toilets, showers and sauna.

name: Ångaloppet Trail
description: Ångaloppet is a welcoming swimrun event at Ånga gård, with the aim of making “swimrun for everyone.” The 2026 races take place on 8 August and include several distances and events for different levels, including 22 km, 11 km, Trail, 5 km and Family. The courses feature varied landscapes with forest trails, gravel roads and hilly, technical terrain; the swimrun races also include several swim sections in both lake and sea. The organisers emphasise a welcoming atmosphere for participants of all ages and experience levels.
course_highlights: Varied forest, trails and gravel roads
Hilly, technical terrain suited to trail running
Located between Lake Ången and the Baltic Sea—combining running and swimming (for the swimrun distances)
additional: In 2026, the event comprises five races on the same day (8 August): 22 km, 11 km, Trail, 5 km and Family. The 22 km race is a loop course (11 km per lap), with approximately 20 swim sections in total (the longest about 190 m and the shortest about 30 m), six aid stations along the course and a cutoff of 2.5 hours at the lap point. Team changes are possible for a fee of 400 SEK—email info@angaloppet.se. The courses are marked, and start group 1 (the earliest start) is listed at 10:00. Ångaloppet Trail is a new distance in the 2026 programme. Team changes are possible for a fee of 400 SEK. More information about equipment, safety, accommodation and parking is available on the event pages.

name: Kräftivalloppet
description: Kräftivalloppet is a running event in Tidaholm that is part of Kraftivalen and takes place near Gamla torget. Registration for the adult race is required via motionsloppet.se, while the children’s and senior races do not require advance registration. Warm-ups before the races are held in collaboration with Hälsocenter, and the event is open to the whole family. The children’s race for ages 7 and up is approximately 600 metres per lap (up to three laps); the rollator and senior races are approximately 600 metres; and the race for children from age 2 is approximately 400 metres.
course_highlights: Part of Kraftivalen in Tidaholm, with the start and event area around Gamla torget
Advance registration via motionsloppet.se is required for the adult race; the children’s and senior races do not require advance registration
Short children’s and senior races, with distances of approximately 400–600 metres per lap
additional: Warm-up before the races with Hälsocenter

name: Istrun - Skaras snabba halvmara
description: Istrun – Skara’s Fast Half Marathon is a half marathon organised by Istrums SK - Friidrott in Skara. The race name highlights that the course is fast and is aimed at runners who want to run a fast half marathon. The race is currently full, but the organiser offers a waiting list for interested runners. For questions or to join the waiting list, runners are asked to email istrun@istrumssk.se.
course_highlights: Half marathon in Skara (promoted as “Skara’s Fast Half Marathon”)
additional: The race is currently full; interested runners can join the waiting list by emailing istrun@istrumssk.se. All information about the race refers to Istrums SK - Friidrott. Entries are handled through RaceID, and runners who are not members of a club are advised to register in M Motion or K Motion, according to the page. PB note: a participant mentions a PB of 1:47.29 in a Facebook post.

name: Häv och Gräv Vikbovändan 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: vuxen 470 kr (fram till den 30/6, sedan kostar loppet 520 kr)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: duoklass: 940 kr per par (fram till den 30/6, sedan kostar duolopp 1040 kr)

description: Häv & Gräv Vikbovändan is a summer event on Vikbolandet in Östergötland where participants can choose to run or cycle. The main course is approximately 45 km long and runs mostly on paved roads and gravel (about 50/50), with several aid stations and samples from local farms along the way. There are categories for runners, cyclists, duos and children, and the event has a clear focus on local producers and an authentic farm setting. Pre-registered participants receive a collapsible cup (folding cup), which they must bring during the event to avoid disposable cups.
course_highlights: Main course approximately 45 km, about 50/50 gravel and asphalt
Aid stations at several local farms, with delicacies and opportunities to visit the farms
Opportunities to meet and sample products at farms with animals (ostriches, alpacas and yaks)
additional: The number of participants in the main event is limited (300). Online registration is open until 4 August; late registration is available from 09:00 in the start area until 30 minutes before each start (if places are available). Pre-registered participants receive a collapsible cup, which must be used during the event. The children's race (approximately 700 m or 1,400 m) requires no advance registration and is free for participants thanks to sponsorship from ICA (children receive a medal and ice cream). Toilets and showers are available at APPTEK's premises (open approximately 09:30–18:30).
