The running category is timed, with prizes for the top three women and men; the cycling and duo categories have special rules (helmets are compulsory, e-bikes are not allowed, and duo partners may swap as often as they like but must stay within 100 m of each other). There is a group warm-up before the start. Aid stations offer water and sports drinks; pre-registered participants receive a collapsible cup; everyone receives a medal; the event is not sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; helmets are compulsory for cycling; the start and finish are in a floodlit trail setting; medical staff are on site; image rights rules apply. Register at vikbovandan.se/472-2/ or via the registration page on the main website.

name: Storå 6 timmars och 3 timmars
location: Guldsmedshyttan, Lindesberg Municipality, Örebro County, Sweden

name: 16. Piesauer Glasmacherlauf
description: The 16th Piesauer Glasmacherlauf takes place on 1 August 2026 in Piesau, Thuringia. The event offers 2 km races for children and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a 10 km Nordic walking competition on forest paths. It is part of the Sparkassen-Cup and the TLV Running and Nordic Walking Cup, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with changing and shower facilities and refreshments on site. Trophies and awards are presented to the fastest runners and by age group.
course_highlights: 2 km children's race
10 km main race exclusively on forest paths
10 km Nordic walking with poles; running is prohibited
additional: Changing, washing and shower facilities are available. Food, drinks and cake are available for purchase on site. Trophies go to the fastest runners on each course (places 1–3 in each gender category), with awards for the top three in each age group. Team classification for the 10 km race, based on the 2 fastest women or 3 fastest men from a club. Forest paths, team classification, trophies for the fastest on each course, awards, registration until 29.07.2026

name: Frontrun - Janus Queer Games 2026
organizer: Janus Queer Games / SC Janus e.V.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 17 Euro pro Person bei online Anmeldung

description: The Frontrun is an inclusive running event held as part of the Janus Queer Games 2026 in Cologne, welcoming runners of all genders. Events include a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and a 5 km partner run. The start and finish are on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow. The course is clearly marked and supported by encouraging course marshals. The event values community, diversity, and the joy of sport in an open and supportive environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Jahnwiesen beneath a large rainbow
5 km loop for the shorter runs; 2 loops for the 10 km run
Alphabetically marked course with friendly course marshals
additional: Race bibs can be collected until 11:30 a.m.; group warm-up at 11:45 a.m. Manual timekeeping with +/- 3 seconds’ precision. Free water stations during the run; after the run, fruit and a cake buffet are available for donations benefiting Anyway e.V. There are no age-group rankings; rankings are in the female, male, and all-genders categories. The 5 km partner run is ranked in the All Gender category. Race-day registration is possible if places are available. The course is flat and runs on the Jahnwiesen. Registration is available online and on the event day, with refreshments and rankings in several categories.

name: CJ Schmidt Hafentagelauf
description: The CJ Schmidt Harbour Day Run takes place in Husum, a city on the North Sea in Schleswig-Holstein, as part of the Husum Harbour Days festival. The event offers flat road races over various distances, including children’s and youth races, a 5 km race, a 10 km race, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay. There is also the Husum Corporate Cup, in which company teams of four compete. The course runs through the city centre and along the harbour, combining urban streets with waterfront paths, accompanied by the fresh North Sea breeze.
course_highlights: Flat road races through Husum’s city centre and harbour
Course along the North Sea coast with a fresh sea breeze
A range of distances for children, young people and relay teams
additional: The organiser is Husumer Sportverein seit 1875 e.V. Timing is provided by Race Result, and registration is managed by LAV Husum. Typical August weather in Husum is around 25 °C, with mostly sunny days and average precipitation of 60 mm. The event also includes team and corporate races as well as family races, with a festive atmosphere in the harbour area. August weather is usually sunny, at around 25°C.

name: 1. Hannover Backyard Ultra
description: The 1st Hannover Backyard Ultra takes place on August 8, 2026, in the Georgengarten in Hanover. In this unique race format, runners complete a 6.706 km lap every hour until only one person remains. The event offers a special challenge for endurance runners and promotes community and sporting ambition in the Hanover region.
course_highlights: A 6.706 km lap every hour
Start and finish in the Georgengarten, Hanover-Herrenhausen
Run until only one person remains
additional: The race takes place in the Georgengarten in Hanover. Registration is via an external platform, and participation is limited to 70 runners. The event emphasizes community and experience in ultrarunning.

name: Volkslauf um den Mittelpunkt Deutschlands
location: Krebecker Sportplatz, Krebeck, Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: Erwachsene €8,00, Schüler bis 16 Jahre €3,00, Kinder bis 6 Jahre kostenlos
description: The Volkslauf around the Geographic Center of Germany is a sporting running event on August 8, 2026, in Krebeck, suitable for all ages and for both competitive and recreational runners. The event offers various running and walking distances with changing elevation profiles, some of which are challenging, on paved or asphalt paths. The races start and finish at the Krebeck sports field, and all participants receive fruit and drinks during and after the competition. Medals and prizes are awarded to the top finishers, and there are age-group rankings as well as medical support on site.
course_highlights: Changing elevation profiles, some of which are challenging
Paved or asphalt running and walking routes
Aid stations on the 5.7 km and 10.4 km routes
additional: Late entries and changes to registrations are possible until approximately 30 minutes before the respective start, for a €2.00 processing fee. Showers, toilets, and changing rooms are available in the sports hall. Participation is at your own risk. Photos and video footage will be taken on event day and may be published. Routes on paved or asphalt paths, fruit and drinks provided, showers, toilets, medical support, online registration available, start and finish at the Krebeck sports field

name: Volkslauf um den Auesee
description: The 5th race in the Mühlenkreis Series takes place on 08.08.2026 at ATSV Espelkamp by Lake Aue. The course follows paved and partly asphalted paths around Lake Aue and is almost flat, with no significant elevation changes. The race is part of a popular regional series with a total of nine events. It is organized by ATSV Espelkamp, which provides a well-organized event and a pleasant race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop around Lake Aue
Paved and partly asphalted paths
No significant elevation changes
additional: The race is part of the Mühlenkreis Series, which comprises nine races in the region. The series awards ceremony takes place in Espelkamp on 14.11.2026. The race offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and medical services on site. Registration is by email, and the course follows asphalt and forest paths. The event is also part of a regional running series.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
description: Śliwicka Dyszka is an annual race organized by the Biegające Śliwice association, promoting an active lifestyle and running. The event takes place in the picturesque area around Śliwice, offering participants an attractive 10 km route. The race attracts both recreational and experienced runners, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition and community spirit.
course_highlights: 10 km route
Picturesque surroundings of Śliwice
Organized by the local Biegające Śliwice association
additional: The event is part of the local running calendar. Details about registration and the route are not readily available on the website, but it is a popular sporting event in the region.

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny is a unique one-hour race held in Koszalin on a challenging, approximately 1-kilometre loop through forest terrain, with significant elevation changes and varied surfaces, including sandy sections. Participants compete to complete as many laps as possible within one hour, and must start their final lap before the hour is up. The race promotes sport, recreation, volunteering and active tourism. At the finish, runners receive an exceptionally heavy medal and a drink. The event is organised by the “SFX” Association and Rozbiegany Koszalin.
course_highlights: An approximately 1 km loop through challenging, hilly forest terrain
Varied surfaces, including sandy sections
Significant elevation changes and demanding terrain
additional: Electronic chip timing; medical support provided by the PCK Koszalin Rescue Group; each participant receives a race bib with safety pins; a drink at the finish; the race begins with a mass start; participants must complete their final lap if they started it before the one-hour limit; open to people aged 18 and over with a current medical certificate or a signed declaration. Registration opens on 6 June 2025. The event takes place on sandy terrain in Koszalin. Participant limit. Participants can cover 1 km within the hour.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny UAM, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań – Summer Edition is a cross-country race held in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a series of races that have promoted running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland since 2014. It attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate the aesthetics and character of cross-country routes. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, just 500 metres from the Botanical Garden, offering additional scenic appeal.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań
Picturesque natural surroundings
Alternative location by Lake Rusałka, 500 m from the start
additional: Race packets can be collected by an authorised person. The organiser places particular emphasis on the aesthetic qualities of the routes and the character of cross-country races. Trzymsie.pl is a partner of the autumn series. The alternative race location is Lake Rusałka, 500 metres from the UAM Botanical Garden. The 5 km route runs through parkland; online registration; participant limit: 500; start and finish in the UAM Botanical Garden. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and outdoor activity.

name: Kullamilen
location: Höganäs friidrottsarena, Höganäs kommun, Skåne län, Sweden
description: KullaMilen is a welcoming running event in Höganäs, with distances for children, recreational runners and veterans. The event offers 2.5 km for children/youth, 5 km for walkers or runners, and 10 km (competitive and recreational classes), starting and finishing at Höganäs athletics arena. The event is organised by Höganäs Friidrott together with local clubs and is part of the Skånska veterancupen for veteran classes choosing to compete. The event emphasises community and the joy of being active, from beginners to experienced runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Höganäs athletics arena; a fast course with plenty of running along the Öresund coast
The 10 km course is officially measured and sanctioned by the Skånes Friidrottsförbund; the 5 km shares the 10 km course but turns back earlier
The 2.5 km children’s course runs partly through Lerbergsskogen; asphalt and gravel surfaces, marked by course marshals
additional: Race numbers can be collected at the Race Office at the athletics arena from 09:30 and no later than 30 minutes before each start; race numbers must be worn on the chest. Water stations are located at approximately 3.5 km and 6.5 km, as well as at the finish. All participants receive a medal; prizes are awarded to the best in each class, and there is a prize draw. The prize-giving takes place in the start/finish area. Changing rooms and showers are approximately 75 metres from the finish; light refreshments are sold at the arena. Results are published at www.hoganasfriidrott.se and www.kullamilen.se. Red Cross medical staff will be on site. Part of the Skånska veterancupen; registration is open at a reduced price until 1 April.

name: Brunnenlauf
location: Iburg-Stadion, Bad Driburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bad Driburg Brunnenlauf is an annual running event organized by TV "Jahn" Bad Driburg e.V., welcoming runners of all ages. The challenging course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa gardens and the town, and finishes at Iburg Stadium. The event emphasizes fairness and sportsmanship and uses timing with a reusable chip. Registration is online only; late entries are not possible.
course_highlights: Challenging out-and-back course with hills
The course runs along the Sachsenring, through the spa gardens and the town
Finish at Iburg Stadium, Bad Driburg
additional: Timing is provided exclusively with the reusable race result chip, worn on the foot using a chip strap. The chip deposit is 10€ and is refunded when the chip is returned. Late entries are not possible. Participants may be disqualified for violations of fairness and good conduct. Online registration only; no late entries. Participation from age 18; children and school students participate free of charge.

name: Diekseelauf
description: The Sparkassen Diekseelauf is a traditional fun run around Lake Dieksee in Bad Malente-Gremsmühlen. The event takes place on August 9, 2026, and offers runners an attractive course with modern transponder-based timing. Participants can conveniently view and download their results and certificates online. The race is organized by TSV Malente and is open to runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Dieksee
Timing with transponder and race number
Start and finish at the Dieksee promenade
additional: Timing is provided using a race number with an integrated transponder. The race number must be worn clearly visible at the front. Results and certificates are available online and can be downloaded after the race. Terrain along Lake Dieksee, on-site registration available, start and finish area at the Dieksee promenade, refreshments in the finish area

name: v-office-Europalauf
location: Neustadt in Holstein, Ostholstein, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The 39th vOffice Europalauf on 09 August 2026 is an international race connecting the Baltic Sea resorts of Neustadt, Pelzerhaken and Rettin along the half-marathon route. The course offers magnificent views across Neustädter Bucht and returns to Neustadt along the beach promenade, parallel to the beach. In addition to the half marathon, there are races over 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km, as well as a Bambini race. The event is a popular sporting event in the region and is organised by TSV Neustadt.
course_highlights: The half-marathon route connects Neustadt, Pelzerhaken and Rettin
Magnificent views across Neustädter Bucht
The route returns to Neustadt along the beach promenade, parallel to the beach
additional: The start and finish for all races are at Seebrückenvorplatz, Neustadt-Pelzerhaken. Race pack collection begins at 7:00 at Kurzentrum Soziales Genesungswerk (SGW), Dünenweg 1-3, opposite the Tourist Information office. The schedule includes several start times for different distances and disciplines (half marathon, 10 km Windberglauf, 5 km Promenadenlauf, 5 km Nordic walking, 2.5 km Leuchtturmlauf, 900 m Bambini race). Award ceremonies begin at 10:30. The event ends at 13:00. The event features various race distances, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km and children’s races. The race takes place on 9 August 2026 and offers a beautiful setting and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Blodomloppet (Jönköping)
description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Jönköping—a recreational event highlighting the need for blood donation, where you can walk, jog or run. In Jönköping, timed 5 km and 10 km races are offered, as well as an untimed 5 km walk. Children can take part in Lilla Blodomloppet (approx. 700 m), which has a mass start and a medal. Participants enter in teams, and the event traditionally ends with a picnic.
course_highlights: Distances: timed 5 km and 10 km races, plus an untimed 5 km walk
Lilla Blodomloppet: approximately 700 m for children up to 12 years old, with a mass start and medal; starts from Knektaparken
Event area at Knektaparken, with a traditional group picnic after the finish
additional: Team entries consist of 3–5 participants; registered blood donors receive a 40 kr discount if they indicate this when registering. Changes (e.g. from 10 km to 5 km) cost 50 kr; show your order ID when collecting your race pack. For registration on race day (11 August), payment is accepted only by Swish or cash. Other payment terms are 30 days, with several payment options (Swish, card via Swedbank Pay, postal giro, invoice). Team and individual entries have different prices; discounts are available for blood donors, and an invoice fee applies. Race numbers can be collected at Hovslätts IK’s clubhouse or at the start. The awards ceremony takes place at 19:30.

name: Vetlanda Citylopp

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Dam-, herr- och motionsklassen (10 km och 5 km) 180 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kids F8/P8 - F12/P12 (1 km till 1,7 km) 100 kr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Föreningar (max 15st per anmälan) 900 kr (Föreningar kan anmäla i F/P8-F/P12 samt Junior 5km)

description: Vetlanda Citylopp is an open, spectator-friendly city race taking place on 14 August 2026, with the start and finish on Storgatan in Vetlanda. Runners can choose between 5 km and 10 km on a fast, looped course. There are also several children’s and youth classes, as well as a Funkis class. Bib collection and late registration are available at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day, and the event includes activities and simple food service in the square. Photos and videos will be taken during the race and may be used in future marketing.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Storgatan in central Vetlanda
Fast, spectator-friendly looped course (5 km or 10 km)
Children’s and youth distances from 400 m to 1.7 km, plus Funkis 1 km
additional: Bib collection and late registration are available at Stortorget from 12:00 on race day. Late registration is available until 30 minutes before each start time. Payment on site can be made via Swish (a surcharge applies for late registration). Timing is provided by Racetimer using a chip in the bib, and results are published live on Racetimer’s website and on the OK Njudung website. The event includes activities and simple food service in the square; the organizer will take photos and videos during the race. Participants can walk, jog or run at their own pace. On-site late registration is available for a fee. Photos and videos taken during the race may be used for marketing.

name: Trail- & Ultravasan (Vasaloppet)
description: Vasaloppet organises a summer week of running and mountain biking, including races such as Ultravasan and Trailvasan. The events take place in mid-August and attract tens of thousands of registered participants each year. Registration and practical information are available at vasaloppet.se. The event is organised by Vasaloppet, a non-profit organisation owned by IFK Mora and Sälens IF.
course_highlights: Part of Vasaloppet’s summer week of running and mountain biking
Includes the Ultravasan 90 and Trailvasan (10/30) distances in mid-August
Organised by Vasaloppet (owned by IFK Mora and Sälens IF)
additional: Registration is through Vasaloppet’s registration pages at vasaloppet.se; registering early means a lower price. For company registrations and group bookings, contact foretag@vasaloppet.se. Vasaloppet customer service can be reached by phone at 0250-392 00, and general enquiries at info@vasaloppet.se. Ultravasan 90 is part of Vasaloppstrippeln 90; bib and chip collection is in Mora/Sälen; baggage transport to Mora and Evertsberg; medals and an award ceremony are promised. Trailvasan 10 has a maximum of 1,000 participants, an age limit of 11+, and a start opportunity until 18:15; there are two water/aid stations along the course.

name: Trail- & Ultravasan
location: Sälen and Mora, Dalarna County, Sweden
description: Ultravasan 90 is a challenging ultramarathon that follows the classic Vasaloppet Trail from Sälen to Mora. The race starts early in the morning in Berga by and offers a scenic, historic running experience through pine forests, winding waterways and summer pasture farms. Participants can enjoy a well-organised race with several aid stations and the option to transport change-of-clothes bags to different checkpoints. Ultravasan 90 is part of Vasaloppstrippeln and attracts runners from around the world who want to test their endurance on a spectacular course.
course_highlights: Start in Berga by, Sälen, with sunrise over the marshes at Smågan
7 official checkpoints with drinks and energy, including Evertsberg, where drop bags can be collected
Scenic pine forests, winding waterways and summer pasture farms along the entire course
additional: Race numbers and timing chips can be collected in Sälen or Mora the day before, or at the start area. The start corrals open at 04:30. Change-of-clothes bags can be dropped off in Sälen for transport to Mora or Evertsberg. Toilets and medical care are available at all checkpoints and in the start and finish areas. Massage is offered in Evertsberg and Hökberg. Official checkpoints with drinks and energy are located at Smågan, Mångsbodarna, Risberg, Evertsberg, Oxberg, Hökberg and Eldris. The event is part of Vasaloppstrippeln. Trail ultramarathon, checkpoints, gear transport, medals, start in Sälen, finish in Mora, Swedish Championship status 2026, maximum 2500 participants

name: 8. Wisent-RUN
location: Wisentgehege Springe, Springe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wisent-RUN is a popular race at Wisentgehege Springe, taking place for the eighth time on August 7, 2026. The event offers various race distances, including children’s races and timed competitions, set in a natural environment. With a family-friendly atmosphere and free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00, the race is a sporting highlight for all ages. The event is organised by VfV Concordia Alvesrode e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Köhlerhütte in Wisentgehege Springe
Race routes through the natural surroundings of Wisentgehege
Children’s races with timing and an awards ceremony
additional: Free admission to Wisentgehege from 15:00. The 500 m children’s race “Frischlingsrennen” is untimed and open to children born in 2021 or later. The 1 km children’s race is timed and includes an awards ceremony for children born from 2016 to 2021. Ample parking is available. The event is open to everyone, with free admission for visitors. It offers an opportunity to explore the wildlife at Wisentgehege while getting active.

name: 24. Dammer Stadtlauf
description: The 24th Damme City Run is an evening road race through the center of Damme, organized by OSC Damme in cooperation with the City of Damme. The program includes three starts: a schoolchildren’s race, a general race for all participants, and the main evening race. After a two-year pandemic-related break, the race returns with an expected field of over 500 runners. The event is characterized by an open, local atmosphere, with on-site registration available, as runners fill the streets of the town center.
course_highlights: Evening road race through Damme city center
Three starts: schoolchildren’s race, general race, and main race
The course stays in the city center, with a lively atmosphere
additional: On-site registration is available, encouraging open, local participation. August weather is typically sunny, with temperatures between 14 and 25 °C. The event includes several categories, including children’s races and the main race, on a route through the city, with a relaxed, welcoming atmosphere.

name: 24. Knesebecker Einhornlauf
description: The Knesebecker Unicorn Run is a traditional running event in the Isenhagen region, held annually in August. The event gives runners of various ability levels the opportunity to test themselves on varied courses. Online registration is conveniently available via the RaceResult platform, where all results and certificates can also be accessed. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Wittingen and attracts numerous running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km course
Nordic walking option
Event held on the school grounds in Knesebeck
additional: Registration is online via RaceResult. Results and certificates are also available via RaceResult. The race takes place on Friday evening. Participant numbers are limited to 100; registration and results are available online; the event is held on the school grounds in Knesebeck.

name: 17. VSB Dresdner Nachtlauf
price_range: early bird price (specific amount not provided)
description: The VSB Dresden Night Run offers a beautifully illuminated course with views of the Dresden skyline. Torches and glow sticks create a special atmosphere. The 11.5 km course follows the Elbe to the Blue Wonder and returns along the Neustadt side of the river, while the 6.2 km course also runs along the Elbe and finishes via the Albert Bridge. Alongside the sporting experience, there are children’s races and a special team ranking for clubs and organizations. The event takes place at Heinz-Steyer-Stadion and is a highlight of the region’s running calendar.
course_highlights: 11.5 km course with views of the romantically illuminated Elbe Castles and the Blue Wonder
6.2 km course along the Elbe, returning via the Albert Bridge
Course illuminated by torches and glow sticks, with views of Dresden’s nighttime skyline
additional: Start times: 18:30 Bambini Run (400 m), 19:00 Children’s Run (1.8 km), 20:00 11.5 km Run, 22:15 6.2 km Run. Pacemakers for target times of 50, 60 and 70 minutes on the 11.5 km course. Team ranking with prize money for the clubs/organizations with the most participants. Cutoff times: 21:40 (11.5 km) and 23:15 (6.2 km). Night run, registration for 2026 open, event in Dresden, various race distances available

name: 35. Speller Sparkassen-Sommernachtslauf
description: The 35th Spelle Sparkassen Summer Night Run is a traditional race in Spelle, organised by SC Spelle-Venhaus. The event offers runners an appealing course in the beautiful surroundings of Wählehof. The race is suitable for all ages and ability levels and takes place in a relaxed atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a well-organised event with a family-friendly feel.
course_highlights: Course through the scenic surroundings of Wählehof
Well-marked routes over various distances
Varied paths combining paved and natural-surface sections
additional: The event takes place in the evening, making it a special summer night run. Results are available online, along with detailed directions. Course maps are available as PDFs, including routes for 5 km, 10 km and walking. The event is part of the EL CUP series, offers numerous categories for all age groups, and is known for its flat course and friendly atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy the summer evening with music and refreshments.

name: Vasastafetten
description: Vasastafetten is a festive mass-participation relay race along the classic route from Sälen to Mora. Up to ten runners share a total distance of approximately 92 km, with legs ranging from 4.5 to 15 km. The race welcomes elite runners and recreational participants, as well as teams from clubs, companies and groups of friends. The start is in Berga by in Sälen, and the event is one of the oldest competitions of the summer week. The 2026 start time is 08:00 on August 15.
course_highlights: Trail race along the classic Sälen–Mora route
Ten legs of approximately 4.5–15 km (approximately 92 km in total)
Starts in Berga (Sälen) and finishes in Mora
additional: Race packs containing bib numbers and an information letter are sent to the team leader approximately two weeks before the race. The timing chip is collected on race day at the Vasaloppet start in Sälen, or at the race office in Mora in the days before the event. The entry fee includes bus transport for participants on legs 1 and 2. A bus ticket to the start for leg 1 must be booked; runners on leg 2 must take the organizer's bus to Smågan. Starting corrals open at 07:30, and participants should arrive by 07:55 at the latest. The timing chip is worn as a wristband, and the relay pass must be placed visibly in the windscreen. The maximum number of participating teams is 600; the minimum age is 8. Start in Sälen/Berga; finish in Mora; relay points along the course; bib number and chip required; relay checkpoints and services along the course; start documents and chip handled by the organizer.

name: Schierker Sommerlauf
description: The Schierker Sommerlauf is a traditional race in the Harz Mountains, taking place for the 24th time on 8 August 2026. The event offers varied distances from 1 km to 16 km, running through the impressive landscape around Schierke. Runners can enjoy breathtaking views, a unique atmosphere and great support in the finish area at the Schierker Feuersteinarena. The race is part of the new Harzer Laufcup 2026 and is open to runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Run on paved forest roads, with two laps for the 8 km main race
Breathtaking views of the Brocken and the Harz landscape
Start and finish at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, with a great atmosphere
additional: The start and finish are at the Schierker Feuersteinarena, which has changing rooms and showers. The course runs along paved forest roads. There is a refreshment point at the newly built toboggan run. Registration is online, with personalised race numbers for those who register in advance. Use of the showers is included in the entry fee. The event is part of the Harzer Laufcup 2026. Courses on paved forest roads, online registration, personalised race numbers, refreshments included, electronic timing, certificates and trophies for the winners.

name: Dülmener Wasserlauf mit 5 km Walking
location: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Dülmen Water Run with 5 km walking takes place on August 15, 2026, in Dülmen. The event gives runners and walkers the opportunity to participate in 5 km and 10 km races. It takes place at Sportzentrum Nord and promises pleasant conditions in typical August weather, with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny skies. Please note that the exact event details should be verified with the organizer before registering.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km and 10 km
Venue: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen
Typical August weather, around 25 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. The event offers a team competition in which four runners start together, and places special emphasis on water and environmental protection. It is family-friendly and open to runners of all abilities.

name: Hambacher Volkslauf
description: The Hambach People’s Run takes place on 15 August 2026 in Niederzier-Hambach and offers races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. There are also 10 km walking and Nordic walking routes. The courses are measured by the DLV, and the event is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and looks forward to a large turnout.
course_highlights: Measured courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon
10 km walking and Nordic walking routes
Part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup
additional: Registration is now open via the website. Course maps and the race information are available as PDFs. The event is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. Courses measured, online registration, part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup

name: 100MeilenBerlin - Der Mauerweglauf
description: The 100MeilenBerlin – Der Mauerweglauf is a historically significant ultramarathon that follows the route of the former Berlin Wall around West Berlin. The approximately 161-kilometre course runs mostly on paved paths, but also includes trail-like and sometimes uneven sections. The start and finish are at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahnsportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. The race commemorates the victims of Germany’s division and is held annually, with the direction changing from year to year.
course_highlights: The course follows the former East German border strip around West Berlin
The direction changes annually; in 2026, the race runs counterclockwise
26 aid stations spaced 5 to 9 kilometres apart, including 3 changeover points with drop bag facilities
additional: Start and finish at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahnsportpark; there is no parking on site, so using public transport is recommended. The race bib serves as a public transport ticket. Time limit: 30 hours for individual runners and 27 hours for 2-person relay teams. Shuttle buses to the start run on the morning of race day. Three changeover points offer drop bag facilities. There are 26 aid stations, with mostly vegan refreshments. Timing uses transponders from race result germany. Soup is served at the finish, and all finishers are invited to the awards ceremony. The race starts at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahnsportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg at 6:00 a.m. and finishes the following day at 12:00 p.m. The race is known for its historical significance, varied course and support from numerous aid stations. It is a demanding ultramarathon that challenges participants’ physical and mental strength.

name: 2. Backyard Ultra-Marathon Tharandter Wald
description: The 2nd Backyard Ultra Marathon in the Tharandter Wald is organised by SC Freital e.V. and takes place in one of Saxony’s most beautiful forest regions. The course consists of a 6.7 km loop, which runs mainly on forest trails and is run in both clockwise and counterclockwise directions. The start and finish area is at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg. A total of 100 starting places are available, and registration is via RaceResult.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop, mainly on forest trails
The direction changes: counterclockwise at first, clockwise at night, then counterclockwise again during the day
Start and finish area at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg
additional: The first 8 laps are run counterclockwise; from 18:00 (night course), clockwise; and from 6:00 (day course), counterclockwise again. There are 100 starting places in total. Registration is via RaceResult. Maximum 100 participants; registration via RaceResult; accommodation at the Jugendfreizeithof Grillenburg; race format: hourly laps until only one runner remains.

name: Altenlotheimer Dorflauf
description: The Altenlotheim Village Run is a great opportunity to get active together. With courses for children and longer distances, there is something for the whole family. The event takes place on 15 August 2026 in Altenlotheim and invites runners of all ages to experience the local running community.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 1 km to 21 km
Family-friendly running event with courses for children
Starts in Altenlotheim amid beautiful surroundings
additional: The weather in August is usually sunny, with an average temperature of 25 °C and 60 mm of precipitation. The event welcomes all age groups and offers a range of distances. In addition to the main races, there are children’s and Bambini races, relay races, and Nordic walking. The event is well organized and offers a great opportunity for community and exercise.

name: Josef Kaderhandt-Waldlauf Plus
price_range: Waldlauf (20 km und 20 km Plus): 20€, 7,8 km Lauf: 5€
description: The 42nd Josef Kaderhandt Forest Run in Menden is a long-established running event organized by Marathon-Club Menden e.V. The route follows paved forest paths through the scenic Sauerland and offers a sporting challenge with demanding sections. In addition to the classic 20 km forest run, runners can take part in the 20 km Plus Marathon and extend their distance to an ultramarathon of up to 50 km by completing additional laps. The start is in Waldemei near the Kolping Memorial Stone, and the finish is at Bürgerbad Leitmecke. There is also a 7.8 km fun run for runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Paved forest paths in the Sauerland
A challenging and scenic route
Variable ultramarathon distance of up to 50 km over multiple laps
additional: The time limit for all events is 6 hours. The start is in Waldemei, Menden, and the finish is at Bürgerbad Leitmecke (new). Parking areas are clearly marked; please do not park in residential areas or on Gisbert-Kranz Straße. The course consists of 3 laps for 20 km, 4 or more laps (up to a maximum of 8) for the 20 km Plus and ultramarathon, and a 7.8 km fun run. Participants can register online; late registration is available in cash on the event day. The route follows paved forest paths, starting in Waldemei and finishing at Bürgerbad Leitmecke. This is the 42nd edition of the event.

name: WoKiMen
location: Parc de Tarbes, Altenkirchen, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: WoKiMen is a family-friendly day of running in Parc de Tarbes in Altenkirchen, offering a range of running and activity options for children, adults, teams, walkers, Nordic walkers, and even dog owners. Children can run 0.5 km or 2 km, while adults can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. The TeamChallenge is a relay with three 1 km legs. Alongside the races, there is a varied program featuring yoga, Zumbathlon, and an adventure course. The day ends with a relaxed Chill & Grill event featuring Nepalese specialties, Italian wood-fired pizza, popcorn, coffee, and cake.
course_highlights: Family-friendly event with races for children and adults
A range of race distances from 0.5 km to a half marathon (21 km)
Additional program featuring yoga, Zumbathlon, and an adventure course in the park
additional: The 5 km course is especially open to walkers, Nordic walkers, and runners with dogs. The TeamChallenge consists of three 1 km relay legs. The event takes place in Parc de Tarbes and offers a family atmosphere, ending with a Chill & Grill. It is open to everyone, with activities for children and adults, team relays, dog runs, and a varied supporting program. It is aimed at families, recreational runners, and community groups.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – Summer Edition is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that showcase the aesthetic qualities of the locations. The organizers aim to promote running and provide participants with a unique sporting and scenic experience. Join this friendly, dynamic running event.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes
The aesthetic qualities of the locations
Organized with a passion for running since 2014
additional: Registration for the summer editions is available via the entry form. The organizers place particular emphasis on cross-country running and the aesthetics of the routes. Trzymsie.pl is the partner of the autumn Botaniczna Piątka series. Cross-country race; registration for the summer edition via the entry form

name: XII Rozłaziński Bieg po radość z życia
Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See
location: Kurpark am Kanal, Bad Bederkesa, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See is a running event for participants of all ages and abilities, held on the third Sunday in August in Bad Bederkesa. The course passes through a natural setting and offers a motivating challenge for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. The event promotes community and the joy of being active, making it a special experience for both race participants and recreational runners. The start and finish are in Kurpark am Kanal, and timing is by transponder.
course_highlights: Scenic course around Beerster See
Start and finish in Kurpark am Kanal
Free drinks on the opposite side of the lake and at the finish
additional: Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune opposite the castle. Showers are available at the Moortherme upon presentation of your race number. Timing is by transponder, which must be returned after the race. The cut-off time for the main races is 1 hour 45 minutes. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Course distances: 7.6 km; hiking, walking and Nordic walking: 1.1 km, 0.5 km and 14.6 km. Race packs are distributed in the Amtsscheune. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Timing is by transponder.

name: Breitunger Pleßlauf
location: Sporthalle am Riegelsweg, Breitungen/Werra, Thuringia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Start- incl. Chip­ - Gebühren 6 Km Lauf: 9€

description: The Breitunger Pleßlauf takes place on 23 August 2026 in Breitungen/Werra and offers running distances from 1 km to 30 km, as well as 10.7 km Nordic walking. The event is organised by SV Lauftreff Breitungen e.V. and starts and finishes at the sports hall on Riegelsweg. The varied courses are suitable for both children and experienced runners. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event offers timing with a single-use chip, trophies and non-cash prizes for the fastest participants, and finisher medals for the main distances.
course_highlights: Running distances from 1 km to 30 km
10.7 km Nordic walking
Start and finish at the sports hall on Riegelsweg in Breitungen
additional: Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start, with a late-entry fee of €5 for the main distances and Nordic walking. Timing is provided using a single-use chip from GO timing. Race packs can be collected at the sports hall on 22.08.2026 from 12:00 to 15:30 and on race day from 07:00. Changing rooms, showers and toilets are available at the sports hall. Trophies are awarded to the three fastest finishers in the main distances, along with non-cash and cash prizes for the winners. All finishers in the main distances receive a laser-engraved medal. Course profiles, mountain run, online registration, results, photos, videos, dates in 2024–2026

name: Run´n Roll for Help
description: Run’n Roll for Help is a long-standing city race in Giessen that has delighted runners for more than 28 years. Every year, the city-centre streets become a sporting highlight where, alongside the competition, supporting a good cause is also a priority. With more than 1,200 participants in 2025 and over €19,000 raised for Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe, the event is an important charity running festival in the region. The event offers a great atmosphere and warmly invites everyone who loves running to join in August 2026.
course_highlights: Course through Giessen city centre
Traditional city race with a large number of participants
Charity race in support of Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe
additional: Registration for the race opens soon. More than 1,200 runners took part in 2025. The event raises donations for Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe. Photos and videos from the event are available in the photo gallery on the website. Official hashtags for social media are #MiteinanderMehrBewegen and #RunandRollforHelp. Charity race, registration opening soon, donations for social causes, support for HIV prevention and youth work

name: Wohldenberger Waldlauf
description: The 21st Wohldenberger Forest Run on August 16, 2026, offers runners of all ability levels varied routes through the Wohldenberger Forest. For more than two decades, this event has been one of the most popular in the Hildesheim region, attracting 200 to 300 participants each year. The course follows natural forest trails with changing surfaces and hilly sections, making it a true cross-country running experience. There are suitable distances for beginners, families, walkers, and ambitious runners, from short children’s races to the challenging half marathon.
course_highlights: Natural forest trails with changing surfaces
Hilly sections in the Wohldenberger Forest
A range of routes for all ability levels, from 0 km to 21.1 km
additional: Six starts for everyone: Shorty Run (free, 11:30), Schoolchildren’s Run (1.5 km, 11:15), 4 km walking (09:10), 4 km run (09:00), 10 km run (09:10), half marathon (08:50). Registration is available for individuals or groups. The event takes place at the Waldsportanlage of SV Rot-Weiss Wohldenberg in Holle. Four routes; on-site registration available; forest cross-country run on trails with changing surfaces.

name: Wolfsburg Staffellauf powered by VfL Wob e.V.
price_range: Startgebühren der Kinderstaffeln werden vom Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V. übernommen, sonst keine Angaben
description: The Wolfsburg Relay, organized by VfL Wolfsburg e.V., is a special team experience that brings together runners of all ages and backgrounds. On August 16, 2026, the second edition of this relay marathon will take place, where teams from schools, clubs, and businesses can experience sporting team spirit together. The route passes through the green Stadtforst, with the start and finish at the VW-Bad, where music will also create a lively atmosphere. Children’s relay teams are supported by Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V., making participation especially appealing.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the VW-Bad
Route through Wolfsburg’s green Stadtforst
Music by DJ Tomoritzland in the start/finish area
additional: Children’s relay teams consist of 5 participants, including at least one female and one male participant. The entry fees for children’s relay teams are covered by Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V. Race bibs will be collected after the race and reused for future events. Race packets can be collected on 14.08.2026 from 16:00 to 18:00 at the VfL office, or on event day from 8:00. Dogs are not allowed at the VW-Bad. Medical services will be on site. Participants may use the swimming pools at the VW-Bad free of charge. Relay race, teams from different groups, course maps, impressions, registration via my.race|result

name: Marceliński Bieg Letni 2026
description: Marceliński Summer Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the beauty of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on promoting cross-country running in Wielkopolska, offering participants a unique running experience amid beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: A cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
The scenic appeal of the proposed locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: Authorization form for collecting a race pack. The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The event focuses on trail running. Registration details are not provided on the website, but can be found on the event’s Facebook page.

name: XXI Bieg Lesoków
description: The 21st Lesoków Run is an annual race held in Szemud and part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event offers two courses, 5 km and 10 km, through the picturesque Kashubian countryside, encouraging people to spend time actively outdoors. It attracts runners of various age groups and ability levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.
course_highlights: The courses run through the charming Kashubian countryside
Two distances are available: 5 km and 10 km
The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of Szemud
additional: The event will take place on 16 August 2026, with online registration available from December 2025. The race is part of the regional Kaszuby Biegają series, which promotes physical activity in Kashubia.

name: Hagbloms Nattloppet
description: Hagbloms Nattloppet in Kalmar is a 5.0 km night race offering an atmospheric running experience along Kalmar’s streets, with music, lighting and surprises along the course. The start and finish are at Stortorget, and the event is open to walkers, joggers and competitive runners. Everyone who finishes receives the Nattloppet medal, and those who register by 16 August also receive the race’s unique T-shirt. The event is organised by Högby IF (athletics).
course_highlights: Start, lap point and finish at Stortorget in Kalmar
5.0 km through the city along Kalmar’s streets, with music, lighting and surprises
A 5 km walking category without timing is available
additional: Race bibs and on-site registration are available at the Högby tent at Stortorget on Thursday 20 August from 15:00 to 17:00 and Friday 21 August from 18:00; on-site registration closes 1 hour before the start. All participants receive a medal, a drink, fruit and a piece of chocolate from ICA MAXI. Payment can be made by card, cash or Swish. Contact: Högby IF / friidrott@hogbyif.se, Jonne Svensson 070-693 87 44, Calle Nilsson 070-444 31 02. 5 km walking category without timing; race bibs and on-site registration at the Högby tent at Stortorget on 20 August from 15:00 to 17:00 and 21 August from 18:00; unique Nattloppet T-shirt for those who register by 16 August; drinks, fruit and chocolate for all participants.

name: Bürener Volkslauf - Hochstift-Cup
description: The Bürener Volkslauf is a traditional running event in Büren, taking place on 21 August 2026. The races cover various distances, including Bambini, children’s, schoolchildren’s and corporate races, on paved routes with minimal elevation changes through the scenic Aftetal valley. All participants receive certificates, and the top runners are awarded trophies. The event is part of the Hochstift-Cup and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: 5 km out-and-back course through the scenic Aftetal valley
Fully paved course with minimal elevation changes
800 m schoolchildren’s and children’s races on the 400 m track
additional: Certificates for all participants. Trophies for places 1–3 (men/women/diverse) in the overall standings. The City of Büren’s challenge trophy for first place in the team standings. Special prize for the largest team (corporate runners only). Certificates can be printed via the “race result” software after the event. Race numbers and transponders will be provided. Changing and shower facilities are available. Parking and travel information will be provided. The courses are challenging, with minimal elevation changes. The registration deadline is the day of the event. Registration is via MY RACERESULT.

name: Schleswiger Treppenlauf
description: The Schleswig Stair Run takes place for the 13th time in 2026 and features a new, attractive course starting and finishing at the Polierteich. Participants complete 10 laps with a total of approximately 940 steps, mostly on firm sand. The event offers both individual and duo competitions, with ample parking available at Stadtfeld. It is a sporting challenge in Schleswig, organised by the Spiridon Schleswig running club.
course_highlights: 10 laps with approximately 940 steps
Mostly firm sand underfoot
Start and finish at the Polierteich
additional: Start and finish at the Polierteich; ample parking at Stadtfeld; event runs from 18:30 to 21:00; individual and duo competitions available; mostly firm sand underfoot. Registration is open; parking at Stadtfeld; running time from 18:30 to 21:00.

name: 11. Lichterlauf Tangermünde
location: Kaiserstadt Tangermünde, Elbufer, Bleichenberg, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The Tangermünde Lichterlauf is an atmospheric race right on the Elbe in the historic imperial town of Tangermünde. On August 21, 2026, runners of all ages and ability levels can take part in several race distances, including a children’s run, a 5 km fun run, a 10 km main race and a team relay. The course runs along the picturesque Elbe promenade and offers a special atmosphere, followed by an after-run party in Tangermünde. The race is a community sporting event that puts fun, exercise and team spirit front and center.
course_highlights: Run along Tangermünde’s Elbe promenade below the castle
Loop course of approximately 1 km, with 5 or 10 laps for the main races
Children’s run of approximately 500 m; parents may accompany children
additional: Timing is provided using a chip that must be returned after the race. Medical support is available along the course. All participants receive a certificate, which is available online. The team relay is awarded a trophy. Race numbers must be worn clearly visible on the chest. Refreshments are provided before, during and after the race. The event takes place at Bleichenberg on the banks of the Elbe and includes various distances, children’s and youth races, and an after-run party. It is part of the regional race calendar and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: 19. Barßeler Hafenfestlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Fristgerechte Anmeldung bis zwei Tage vor dem Lauf (Mittwoch)

description: The 19th Barßel Harbour Festival Run takes place on 21 August 2026 near Barßel Harbour. The event offers races for different age groups, including Bambini runs, children’s races, a 5-kilometre run, Nordic walking and a 10-kilometre main race. The course runs on paved roads and is suitable for all age groups. The event is organised by Sport- und Turnverein Barßel and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, supporting activities and refreshments.
course_highlights: Start and finish near Barßel Harbour and the swimming and sports centre
Bambini runs of approximately 400 metres on the main road, in two groups with different bib colours
10-kilometre race on a 5 km loop course on paved roads
additional: Race bibs can be collected on race day from 15:30 at the Schützenhaus Barßelermoor, and the evening before from 17:00 to 19:00. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start. Bag drop is in the sports hall; use your race bib for identification. A sweep bicycle accompanies the races, with cut-off times of 19:15 (5 km) and 21:00 (10 km). Parking is available at several locations in Barßel; diversions due to the harbour festival are signposted. Registration is open until 19 August 2026. Late entries are possible for a fee. Parking is available nearby. Race bibs can be collected at the Schützenhaus. The event is hosted by an announcer, and timing is provided by Laufmanager.

name: Buntekuhlauf
description: The Buntekuhlauf in Lübeck-Buntekuh is a traditional race taking place for the 18th time on August 21, 2026. The event offers various races for all ages and ability levels, from short runs on the sports grounds to longer distances on pedestrian paths. The races take place on pedestrian paths closed to traffic and on the sports grounds, creating a safe and pleasant atmosphere for all participants. The SC Buntekuh e.V. organizes the race with the aim of making exercise fun for everyone.
course_highlights: Routes on the sports grounds (750 m and 1.5 km)
Longer distances (5 km, 10 km, 15 km) on pedestrian paths; roads are not closed to traffic
The 5 km route is completed multiple times for the 10 km (2 laps) and 15 km (3 laps) races
additional: Race packets will be distributed on August 20, 2026, from 6 to 8 p.m. and on the event day from 3 p.m. Late registration is possible until August 16, 2026, at 8:00 p.m.; after that, it may be available on the event day but is not guaranteed. Bib numbers are not personalized, but certificates will include the usual details. Changes to registrations are free until a certain time; after that, a fee of 10 euros will be charged. Several race categories are available, including a fun run, walking, and longer distances; online registration is possible. The start and finish are on Koggenweg in Lübeck-Buntekuh.

name: Volkslauf Um die Taakener Ähren
description: The “Um die Taakener Ähren” fun run is a family-friendly and popular running event in Taaken, taking place on 21 August 2026. The event offers various races for all age groups, from the Bambini run through the schoolchildren’s and jogger runs to the competitive 10 km main race and a relay. The course runs through Taaken and its picturesque fields of grain, with fun and community at the heart of the event. All participants receive pastries at the finish, and the winners are awarded traditional winner’s loaves. The village provides refreshments and drink stands, creating a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through Taaken and its picturesque fields of grain
Start and finish on the green behind the sports hall
A 10 km relay with an original baton, for teams of 2 to 4 runners
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the start of the respective race for an additional €2. Changing rooms and showers are available in the Taaken sports hall. Parking is located behind the sports hall. Water, fruit and pastries are provided, and there are also snack and drink stands. All runners in the main, relay and jogger races can enter a raffle held after the main race awards ceremony. Various race categories, team relay, children’s and youth races, refreshments on site.

name: Mottenburger Meile
description: The Mottenburger Meile is a traditional cult race on the Elbe in Hamburg, held every year on the Friday after the Hamburg school holidays. The accurately measured out-and-back course is 7.5 km long, equivalent to one Prussian land mile. The race starts and finishes on the banks of the Elbe below Halbmondsweg/Elbchaussee and offers a romantic atmosphere with evening lighting. Alongside the sporting competition, the race supports the Hamburg Donations Parliament and commemorates Jewish victims of the Holocaust with a Stolperstein memorial stone.
course_highlights: Accurately measured 7.5 km out-and-back course (one Prussian land mile)
Start and finish on the banks of the Elbe below Halbmondsweg/Elbchaussee
Romantic lighting for an evening race
additional: Limited to 300 participants. Late registration fee: €1 organizational fee. Relaxed get-together afterwards, weather permitting. The organizer accepts no liability. By registering, participants grant permission for their personal data and photographs to be published. Course: 7.5 km; night race; participant limit: 300; registration probably online; start from 7 p.m.; donations support the Hamburg Donations Parliament.

name: Ultravasan
description: Ultravasan 90 is a trail race starting in Berga by, Sälen, offering runners the classic Vasaloppet route through scenic summer landscapes. The race starts at dawn at 05:00 and follows the historic checkpoints to the finish in Mora, with views of pine forests, waterways, trails and traditional mountain farm settings. The race is 92 km long, has Swedish Championship status in 2026 and is part of Vasaloppstrippeln; the maximum number of participants is 2,500, and the minimum age is 17.
course_highlights: Dawn start at 05:00 in Berga by—watch the sun rise over the marshes around Smågan
Seven Vasaloppet checkpoints along the course, with drinks, energy, toilets and medical care
Scenic stretches through open pine forests, winding waterways, well-trodden trails and picturesque traditional mountain farm settings
additional: Race bibs and chips can be collected in Mora or Sälen in the days before the race, or at the start venue. Start pens open at 04:30, and your time starts when you cross the start line. Baggage transport to Mora is available, and you can send a change-of-clothes bag to Evertsberg. There are refreshment stations approximately every five kilometres, as well as toilets and medical care at all checkpoints. Maximum 2,500 participants; training grants of SEK 60,000 are awarded to the winner in each of the women’s and men’s categories. Ultravasan consists of two longer ultramarathon distances: Ultravasan 90 (Sälen–Mora, approximately 92 km) and Ultravasan 45 (Oxberg–Mora, approximately 45 km). Both finish in Mora and are part of Vasaloppet’s Summer Week.

name: Detmolder Residenzlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt 11,00 Euro für Erwachsene und wird per Bankeinzug nach der Anmeldung gezahlt.

description: The Detmold Residenzlauf is a long-standing running event taking place on 15 August 2026 in Detmold. The event offers various races for children, young people and adults, including a Bambini run, school races, a 5 km fitness run and the 10 km main race. The start and finish are on the Market Square in Detmold, providing a central and lively setting. The event is supported by Stadtwerke Detmold and AÜG NETZWERK as title sponsors and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and a range of categories.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Market Square in Detmold
Various distances from 1.5 km to 10 km
Timing with the Raceresult timing system
additional: Race bib collection on the event day from 15:30 at the Rathaus am Markt in Detmold. Timing is provided by the Raceresult timing system; personal chips are not permitted. Free admission to the Aqualip leisure pool upon presentation of the race bib. Medals for all participating children and young people. Awards ceremony on the Market Square: school races from around 18:30, 10 km race from 20:00. Friedrich-Brakemeier Challenge Trophy for the school with the highest participation rate. Vouchers for schools, teams and groups with the most advance registrations. The race attracts numerous participants from the region and, alongside the main distances, also features children’s races and special competitions. Results and certificates are available online.

name: Exter FlexRun! 2026
location: Sparkassen Sportpark Exter, Vlotho, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Exter FlexRun on 22 August 2026 at Sparkassen Sportpark Exter offers a flexible running format for all ability levels. Participants can choose their distance and run up to four laps of 10.5 km each, covering up to the full marathon distance. There are also relay events, walking and Nordic walking courses, and a children’s run. The event takes place in a scenic setting and offers a great atmosphere, with refreshments and entertainment on site.
course_highlights: Loop courses on paved paths and mostly asphalt roads in and around Vlotho Exter
Refreshment stations at 4.0 km, 8.5 km, and in Sportpark Exter
Showers, changing rooms, and a wide range of refreshments at Sportpark Exter
additional: The start and finish for all events are at Sportpark Exter. Flexible distance choice, with up to 4 laps (10.5 km each). 4 x 10.5 km relay for teams. Walking/Nordic walking: 10.5 km and 21 km. Children’s run: 1.6 km, from age 6. Team and company rankings with awards. Courses are marked and staffed by marshals. Registration is via Race Result; the event offers showers, changing rooms, refreshments, and is family-friendly.

name: Heideköniginnenpokal
description: The Heideköniginnenpokal (HeiPo) in Amelinghausen is a traditional fun run, taking place for the 31st time in 2026 as part of the Heideblütenfest week. The challenging routes pass through scenic landscapes, including along Lopausee. The race attracts many participants and is a mainstay of regional running events.
course_highlights: Scenic stretches
Route along Lopausee
Part of the Heideblütenfest week in Amelinghausen
additional: The Amelinghausen running group meets regularly on Mondays and Wednesdays to run together. There is also a beginners’ course that gradually introduces participants to running. The event is part of a lively running-group community that takes part in many fun runs and marathons across Germany. The race takes place in August, with typical summer weather around 25°C and possible rain. There are also children’s races and other fun runs as part of the festival week.

name: Jahn-Gedenklauf
description: The Jahn Memorial Run in Lanz is a traditional running event organized by SV Jahn Lanz e.V. The event takes place at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn Stadium and offers various distances, which also count toward the Prignitz Cup. The start time is 10 a.m., and the run is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The event is supported by Kreissportbund Prignitz e.V. and is a fixture in the regional sports calendar.
course_highlights: Short course: 6.6 km
Long course: 12.5 km
Outside the Prignitz Cup: 3 km
additional: Courses are not suitable for spikes; on-site registration is possible; start at the stadium

name: Münsterland-Sternlauf - Benefizlauf
location: Universitätsklinikum Münster, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Münsterland Star Run is a charity run in aid of Kinderkrebshilfe Münster e.V. at Münster University Hospital. Five routes lead in a star shape from various towns in the Münsterland region to the shared finish at Leonardo Campus in Münster. The run is designed as a stage event, allowing participants to set their own pace and run one or more stages. 100% of the proceeds are donated to Verein zur Förderung krebskranker Kinder Münster e.V. to support the treatment and care of the children affected.
course_highlights: Five routes lead in a star shape from various towns in the Münsterland region to Münster
Mostly farm tracks, footpaths and cycle paths, as well as traffic-calmed streets
Accompanied by stage leaders and a German Red Cross broom wagon; refreshments at stage points
additional: This is not a race, and participants set their own pace. They can run one or more stages, and can start and finish at any stage point. Participants are responsible for their own return transport. For the first time, donations can be made cashlessly. Donation receipts are issued for donations of €200 or more. The run is accompanied by stage leaders and a German Red Cross broom wagon. Refreshments are offered at stage points in cooperation with Kolping families. The run takes place in Münster and promotes social cohesion through sporting commitment.

description: The Rammelsberger Steigerlauf is a challenging mountain run in the North Harz, held at the Rammelsberg UNESCO World Heritage Site in Goslar. The event offers various routes with gradients of up to 30%, passing through historic mining scenery and varied forest and mountain sections. Participants can look forward to professional timing and a unique running experience with an alpine character. Routes range from a short run for children to a marathon and trail run with up to 1,110 metres of elevation gain. The event is for runners, walkers and trail runners looking to challenge their fitness and sure-footedness.
course_highlights: Gradients of up to 30% on challenging sections
Start and finish at the Rammelsberg UNESCO World Heritage Site, amid historic mining scenery
Trail sections with an alpine character and up to 620 metres of elevation gain (BergmannTRAIL)
additional: Late registration is possible on 21.08. from 15:00 to 18:00 and on 22.08. from 08:00 on site, with a €3 late registration fee, up to 30 minutes before the start. All participants receive a yellow wristband for free access to the mining site (excluding guided tours). The BergmannTRAIL starts 200 m underground and includes a 250 m tunnel section where helmets are compulsory. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Dogs are not permitted on the site. Routes with up to 1,630 m of elevation gain, challenging sections with gradients of up to 30%, mining scenery, late registration available on site

name: Osnabrücker 6-Stunden-Lauf
organizer: Norbert Dulle, Heinz Hagen, Maik Mittmann, Holger Schulze, Florian Siebelmann, Frank Wilke
price_range: 49 Euro für Einzelstartende, 145 Euro für Staffeln
description: The Osnabrück 6-Hour Run takes place on 22 August 2026 at Rubbenbruchsee in Osnabrück and celebrates its 10th edition. The run is a charity event supporting HelpAge’s “Every Grandma Counts” campaign and is open to all runners who want to cover as many kilometres as possible within six hours. Whether you are an ambitious runner, training for a marathon, or simply interested in running, walking or hiking together in the beautiful landscape around the lake, everyone is welcome. The event offers individual and relay entries and focuses on community and a good cause.
course_highlights: Circuit around Rubbenbruchsee in Osnabrück
Run, walk or hike in beautiful natural surroundings
Six-hour event with a freely chosen distance
additional: Briefing at 09:45, with attendance required for all runners. Relay teams: minimum 3, maximum 6 participants. The legendary “Every Grandma Counts” running shirt can be ordered for 25 euros when registering (sizes S/M/L; other sizes available on request). No refunds for failure to attend. The event supports the charitable organisation HelpAge Deutschland e.V. The route is a 3,130 m paved circuit around Rubbenbruchsee; the run is inclusive; refreshments and race materials are available on site; charity run supporting HelpAge Deutschland.

name: Sieber Berg- und Panoramalauf
location: Sieber, Herzberg am Harz, Niedersachsen, Germany
price_range: 44,00 € für das Original, 34,00 € für die Panorama-Runde, 19,00 € für das Natur-Erlebnis, Kinder 6,00 €; Frühbucherpreise bis 31.03.2026 ab 38,00 €
