description: The 16th Baltic Sea Coast Marathon is an annual running event held in the picturesque towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. Participants can choose between the marathon and half-marathon distances, both running along the seashore and offering exceptional views and atmosphere. The event attracts runners from various age groups, including the K60+ and M65+ categories. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs along the shore of the Baltic Sea
Picturesque views of the sea and the coastal towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo
Available distances: marathon (42 km) and half marathon (21 km)
additional: The participant limit is 250. The K60+ and M65+ age categories have reduced entry fees. Registration is open from 16 March to 26 August 2026. The fee on event day is higher. The start and finish are in the coastal towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. The participant limit is 250; registration opens on 16 March 2026 and includes information about dates and fees.

name: XI Bieg Dożynkowy
location: Kobylarnia, Gmina Nowa Wieś Wielka, Poland

name: Burgwald Märchen Marathon
description: The Burgwald Märchen Marathon in Rauschenberg is a varied running event with distances for an ultramarathon, marathon, half marathon, 3/4 marathon, fun runs and a costume run. The event offers a well-organized course with refreshments, timing and medals for all finishers. Bib pickup takes place the day before, and the races start from 8:00 a.m. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy the race in a fairytale setting.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 5 km to an ultramarathon (52 km)
Start and finish close to the sports hall and outdoor swimming pool in Rauschenberg
Cutoff time for all races is 16:00
additional: A maximum of 1111 entries are available across all races. Bib pickup is on 29.08.2026 from 17:00 to 19:00 at the Rauschenberg sports hall. Late registration is available on 29.08. from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 30.08. until one hour before the respective start, subject to late entry fees (€3 for the ultra, marathon and half marathon; €2 for other races). All finishers who reach the finish by 16:00 receive a medal. Certificates can be printed online or collected in the finish area. The start and finish are close to the sports hall and outdoor swimming pool in Rauschenberg. The course runs mostly through the forest, partly on paved paths; refreshments are available every 5±2 km; dogs are allowed.

name: DO IT FAST
description: DO IT FAST in Dortmund gives runners the opportunity to run their personal best on a fully measured 2.5 km loop course. Depending on the distance, runners complete 2 or 4 laps. The course is eligible for ranking lists. In addition to the sporting competition, participants can look forward to a finisher medal, refreshments, and an awards ceremony for the top runners. A photo banner in the finish area invites participants to take photos, and results are available digitally via QR code.
course_highlights: DLV-measured 2.5 km loop course
10 km race: 4 laps; 5 km race: 2 laps
Photo banner in front of the blast furnace as a keepsake photo spot
additional: The race office opens at 07:30. Awards for men and women, places 1–3, take place on the event area after the finish. Finishers receive a medal and refreshments. Results and certificates can be accessed via the QR code on the race bib. A €5 late registration fee applies to registrations after the registration deadline. Races take place on a measured 2.5 km loop course. Registration is open until 16.08.2026. Shirt options, timing, an awards ceremony, and photos are included.

name: Kölner Halbmarathon- Die Generalprobe
location: Sportpark Müngersdorf, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 27th Cologne Half Marathon on August 30, 2026, offers runners a choice of four distances: 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 28 km. Everyone starts together at 10 a.m. at the NetCologne Stadium at Sportpark Müngersdorf. The route goes through Cologne and is designed as a dress rehearsal for other races. Water, bananas, energy bars, and non-alcoholic drinks will be available along the route and at the finish. The event is organized by Leichtathletik-Team Deutsche Sporthochschule Köln e.V. and is known for its friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the NetCologne Stadium at Sportpark Müngersdorf
Four distance options: 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 28 km
Refreshments along the route and at the finish, including water, bananas, and Maxi Nutrition bars
additional: Late registrations are possible in person at race-pack pickup until August 30, 2026, subject to availability. For safety reasons, baby joggers, dogs, walkers, and music devices are not permitted. Custom bib numbers can be selected for a €3 fee. Changes to registrations are only possible at race-pack pickup and cost €15. Route, start/finish in Cologne, late registration on site, refreshments, race-pack pickup, parking, showers, changing rooms

name: Lahnparklauf
price_range: 14,00 € für 21,1 km und 30 km, 9,00 € für 5 km und 10 km
description: The Lahnparklauf takes place on August 30, 2026, in the heart of Hesse. It is an established running event for runners of all ability levels. The proven course concept, known as the LOOP, will be retained this year. The organizing team at team-naunheim SPORT e.V. looks forward to welcoming many participants and also offers training in a range of sports.
course_highlights: Proven LOOP course route
Running event in the heart of Hesse
Suitable for runners of all ability levels
additional: Registration is expected to open in early June 2026. In addition to the race, training is also offered in running, trail running, triathlon, fitness, dance, Zumba, and yoga. Course map and elevation profile online; online registration; parking at the REWE car park; no bag storage provided by the organizer; medical services provided by Malteser Hilfsdienst e.V.

name: Rund um Ennepetal

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 7 € je Etappe bei Voranmeldung bis zum 23.08.2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 30 € für alle Strecken bei Voranmeldung bis zum 23.08.2026

description: Rund um Ennepetal is an annual mass-participation sporting event held on the last Sunday in August. It combines running, hiking and walking along the 60 km Ennepetal Circular Hiking Trail, divided into five stages. The route passes through varied countryside, with magnificent views of the Bergisches Land, reservoirs and historic places. The event is suitable for all ability levels and offers guided groups for runners and walkers, as well as independent hiking. The stages are scenic and feature cultural highlights and challenging sections. After the event, participants can access their results and certificates online.
course_highlights: 60 km over 5 stages, with varied ascents and descents through forests, floodplains and horse pastures
Magnificent views of the Bergisches Land, reservoirs and historic half-timbered villages such as Beyenburg
Guided groups for runners and walkers; independent hikers receive GPX data; refreshment points at the end of each stage
additional: Late registration is available on the event day for a fee, up to 30 minutes before the start. The start and finish are at the sports grounds of Rot-Weiß Rüggeberg e.V. Bus transfers to the start points of stages 2 to 5 and back are arranged. The course closes at 20:30. Runners and walkers are accompanied in groups by guides familiar with the area; hikers receive GPX data for independent tours. Results and certificates are available online. The event comprises several stages on a challenging route, including bus transfers between start points and refreshments at the changeover points. Participation is open to everyone, with various disciplines and a friendly, family atmosphere.

name: Mühlhäuser Altstadtlauf
organizer: Stadtverwaltung Mühlhausen, Kreissportbund Mühlhausen, SV 1899 Mühlhausen e. V.
price_range: Schülerläufe: 1,00 Euro; Hauptläufe 5 km / 10 km: 6,00 Euro (Jugend), 12,00 Euro (Erwachsene)
description: The Mühlhausen Old Town Run is a traditional race through the historic old town of Mühlhausen, held annually since 1997. With three distances of 1.7 km, 5 km, and 10 km, it offers a sporting alternative to the Mühlhausen Kirmes and brings runners from the region together. The traditional start and finish point is Untermarkt in Mühlhausen. The event is organized in cooperation with the athletics club SV 1899 Mühlhausen e.V. and attracts around 800 to 1,100 participants each year.
course_highlights: Three distances through the historic old town (1.7 km, 5 km, 10 km)
Start and finish at Untermarkt in Mühlhausen
A tradition since 1997, bringing together runners from the region
additional: The run traditionally takes place as part of the Mühlhausen Kirmes and is designed as a sporting alternative to the festival. It is organized in cooperation with the local athletics club SV 1899 Mühlhausen e.V. No prices or start times are published on the website. The start and finish are at Untermarkt in Mühlhausen. Three distances: children's races from 9:00 a.m., 1.7 km; main races of 5 km and 10 km; online registration until August 22, 2025; supporting program at Untermarkt.

name: 22. Eilenriederennen Hannover
location: Eilenriede Park, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Eilenriederennen Hannover is an established summer running event that takes runners through the green heart of the state capital of Lower Saxony. The race offers three different distances: 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course is officially measured, mostly paved and almost completely flat, making it possible to run fast times. The event has a pleasant atmosphere, with a musical programme in the beer garden, and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass series in the Hannover region.
course_highlights: 100% paved course, except for a short U-shaped detour on unpaved paths on the 5 km distance
Out-and-back course to the Waldstation and back to the Zoo and Lister Turm
The course is completely flat apart from crossing the Messeschnellweg and is officially measured
additional: Race bib collection is recommended the day before (29.08.2026) from 15:00-17:00 at the Lister Turm beer garden to avoid delays. Late registration is available online until 29.08.2026 at 14:30 and on site at no extra charge, provided the race is not sold out. Refreshment stations at km 3, 5, 7 and 10 offer water, isotonic drinks and energy gels; watermelon and drinks are available at the finish. Timing is by chip integrated into the race bib. The event venue is Stadtteilzentrum Lister Turm, Walderseestr. 100, Hannover. Travelling by bicycle or public transport is recommended (Stadtbahn lines 3, 7 and 9, Lortzingstraße stop). The course is officially measured, with refreshment stations at km 3, 5, 7, 10 and at the finish; registration is online or on site; race bib collection is at the Lister Turm beer garden; the event takes place in summer.

name: 23. Windmühlenberglauf
location: Bezirkssportanlage am Windmühlenberg, Fallersleben, Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 23rd Windmühlenberglauf takes place on August 30, 2026, in Fallersleben (Wolfsburg) at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg. The event is hosted by VfB Fallersleben and gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a traditional race. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Windmühlenberg and promises a varied running experience. Registration is open until August 25, 2026.
course_highlights: Race at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg
Scenic course in Fallersleben
Traditional race with different age and ability categories
additional: The registration deadline is August 25, 2026; the event offers various race distances and promotes community and sporting exchange.

name: 30. Lauf um den Arendsee
description: The 30th Run around Arendsee (LUDA) takes place on August 30, 2026, at Strandbad Arendsee. This anniversary edition offers runners from the region and beyond a scenic setting in nature. There will also be a small party on the eve of the race, bringing people together to celebrate sport and community. Organized by Kersten Friedrich Events, the event promises professional delivery with strong regional ties.
course_highlights: Event venue at Strandbad Arendsee
Run through the natural landscape of the Altmark region
Anniversary event with a party on the eve of the race
additional: Registration for the race opens on December 1, 2025. The event is part of a day featuring four events in Arendsee on August 30, 2026. A small party will be held at Strandbad on August 29, 2026. Event photos will be provided. The organizing team donates €1 per participant to Special Olympics Sachsen-Anhalt e.V. Registration has been open since December 1, 2025; the event includes several competitions and a party on the preceding day; it is also suitable for marathon training.

name: 45. Königseer Stadtwaldlauf
location: Oberhain bei Königsee, Landkreis Saalfeld-Rudolstadt, Thüringen, Germany
description: The Königseer Stadtwaldlauf is a traditional running event in Oberhain near Königsee, held annually. The event offers runners of various ability levels an attractive route through the municipal forest, with varied terrain. Its friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings make the run a special experience for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Run through Königsee’s picturesque municipal forest
Varied terrain featuring forest roads and nature trails
Family-friendly event with various distances
additional: Events for children, young people, adults and Masters; registration until 28 August 2026; typical August weather around 25°C. Please check details with the organizer before registering.

name: 6-Stunden-Sparkassenlauf
location: Sportzentrum Seevetal, Seevetal-Fleestedt, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 6-Hour Sparkasse Run in Fleestedt takes place on 30 August 2026 on a 1,200-metre loop at the Seevetal Sports Centre. The course runs mostly over paved surfaces and partly over grass. It is clearly visible from the start/finish area, adding to the excitement for spectators. Alongside the individual event, there are team and relay competitions, with the marathon (42.2 km) receiving its own classification. The run is open to runners born in 2008 or earlier, and for the first time the relay is also open to young people born in 2014 or earlier. Younger participants can take part in a 5,000-metre run and have the opportunity to earn a DLV running badge.
course_highlights: 1,200 m loop at the Seevetal Sports Centre
Course is mostly paved, with some grass
Course is clearly visible to spectators from the start/finish area
additional: The marathon distance requires 35 laps. The team classification adds up all kilometres; the relay includes handovers. Entry is open to those born in 2008 or earlier, and the relay to those born in 2014 or earlier. The 5,000 m youth run is for participants born from 2009 to 2014. Children born from 2015 to 2020 can earn a DLV running badge. The event starts at 10:00 in the morning and lasts six hours, during which participants complete as many laps as possible. Breaks are permitted. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, various running categories and activities for children.

name: Blankeneser Heldenlauf
description: The Blankeneser Heldenlauf on 30 August 2026 offers five varied courses with different distances and profiles, appealing to both beginners and experienced runners. The races pass through the picturesque Blankenese stair district, along the Elbe and through a mix of parks and residential areas. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and unique combination of urban and natural running. At the finish, participants can look forward to a finisher’s medal and a lively awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Courses run along the picturesque Elbe waterfront and through the Blankenese stair district
A variety of profiles, from flat to challenging, with climbs such as Polterberg
Finish at Blankenese weekly market square, with a finisher’s medal
additional: The start is at Strandweg/corner of Mühlenberg, approximately a 15-minute walk from the event site. Bag drop is available at the event site from 8 a.m. The official registration deadline is 19.08.2026; online late registration with an increased entry fee is possible until 29.08.2026. A medal is included in the entry fee for finishers. Results and certificates will be available online. Photos can be purchased after the event through a photo partner. Various course profiles and distances, including medal presentation and awards ceremony; registration, late registration and travel by public transport are possible.

name: Grafschaftslauf
location: Gut Rietberg, Rietberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Grafschaft Run connects the historic towns of Rietberg, Verl and Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock, offering runners a varied course rich in history and atmosphere. The race starts at Gut Rietberg, passing historic buildings and running through the town centre before continuing along the Ems to the garden show grounds. The route passes through atmospheric locations, with several relay handover points, and finishes in the Holter Forest at Jagdschloss zur Holte, which provides an impressive backdrop for the finish. The race is characterised by varied country trails, enthusiastic spectators and a special blend of sport and regional history.
course_highlights: Start at Gut Rietberg, with the historic ambience of the castle
Atmospheric spectator spots in Westerwiehe and Kaunitz, with relay handovers
Final stretch through the tranquil Holter Forest to Jagdschloss zur Holte
additional: The relay is organised as a three-person team over 28.5 km, with two handover points in Westerwiehe and Kaunitz. The route passes through historic town centres, runs along the Ems and through the garden show park, and finishes at the castle in Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock. A 10 km run and walking events are also available. The event places emphasis on an atmospheric experience, with several spectator points and musical accompaniment. Events: 28 km individual run, relay, 10 km run, walking; registration opens 01.01.2026; Motto: Experience history as you run

name: Altra Sunset Wattenmeer
price_range: 1.100,00 Euro bis 1.500,00 Euro für Teams, je nach Anmeldedatum
description: The Altra Sunset Wattenmeer is a unique team relay race taking place on August 29 and 30, 2026. The route covers approximately 250 kilometers through the impressive natural landscapes along the Elbe and the UNESCO World Heritage Site Wadden Sea National Park. The race starts in Hamburg on St. Pauli Hafenstraße and finishes in St. Peter-Ording, in the Bad district. Teams consist of 5 or 10 runners, each covering several stages, making the race a special shared experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 250 kilometers through the UNESCO World Heritage Site Wadden Sea National Park
Start in Hamburg, finish in St. Peter-Ording, Bad district
A nature experience along the Elbe amid breathtaking landscapes
additional: Teams’ start times are assigned after registration closes, based on their reported average pace. Digital map materials will be provided to teams a few weeks before the event. Teams must arrange their own vehicles (teams of 10 need 2 vans; teams of 5 need 1 van). Runners born in 2010 or earlier are eligible to participate; for Ultra teams, the cutoff is 2008 or earlier. Team categories include gender-based and mixed teams. Registration is handled by a team captain, who manages the team members. The race comprises 30 stages, with running during both day and night and navigation using map materials; it starts in Hamburg and finishes in St. Peter-Ording. Teams from several countries may participate. Conditions include changeable weather and a sporting challenge.

name: CrossFunRun
description: The CrossFunRun on 30 August 2026 in Ahrensburg offers varied courses for all age groups and ability levels. The races take place in Wulfsdorfer Park, with the start and finish at Heidkoppelhof. The event is family-friendly, with special Kids Cross-Run courses and relay competitions. All participants receive medals, certificates and prizes. The event is organised by WEcycle e.V., which ensures a great atmosphere and exciting cross-country running experiences.
course_highlights: Course distances from 500 m to 5 km, depending on age group
Start and finish at Heidkoppelhof, Wulfsdorfer Weg
Family-friendly Cross-Run courses and relay competitions
additional: Late registrations are possible on site from 10:00 for an additional fee of 5 euros. The event offers medals, certificates and prizes. There are Cross-Run relay competitions for teams of 3 or 4. Access is via Bornkampsweg and Wulfsdorfer Weg in 22926 Ahrensburg. On-site registration is possible. Various categories, family-friendly, activities for cyclists and runners, start and finish at Heidkoppelhof Ahrensburg.

name: Stundenlauf des TuS Fleestedt
location: Sportzentrum Seevetal, Seevetal, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 6-Stunden-SPARKASSENLAUF in Fleestedt takes place on August 30, 2026, on a 1,200-meter loop at the Sportzentrum Seevetal. The course is mostly paved, with some grass sections, and is largely visible from the start/finish area, adding to the excitement for spectators. Alongside the individual event, there are team and relay events, and the marathon distance (42.2 km) has its own classification. The race is open to participants born in 2008 or earlier, with special events for teenagers and children.
course_highlights: 1,200 m loop, mostly paved with grass sections
Most of the course is visible from the start/finish area
Marathon distance with 35 laps and its own classification
additional: Participation is open to people born in 2008 or earlier; for the first time, the relay event is also open to teenagers born in 2014 or earlier; 5,000 m race for teenagers born from 2009 to 2014; DLV running badge for children born from 2015 to 2020 during the event; the team classification combines all kilometers completed. Event held on a 1,200 m loop at the Sportzentrum Seevetal, with various events and registration available.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The 40th Volkswandertag of TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. is a traditional walking event in Tiftlingerode, taking place on August 30, 2026. The event is aimed at walking enthusiasts and offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy nature and the surrounding area. It is a sociable, sporting activity suitable for all age groups. The event is organized by TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. and is part of the German Athletics Association’s competition calendar.
course_highlights: Walk at the TSV Immingerode sports ground
Participation in the Volkswandertag in Duderstadt
Enjoy nature in the Eichsfeld region
additional: Walking event, location: TSV Immingerode sports ground, Duderstadt. Registration and contact via the club

name: Wandertag
location: Neuhaus im Solling, Holzminden, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Neuhäuser Hiking Day is an annual hiking event in the Solling-Vogler region around Neuhaus im Solling. Participants can choose from four routes of varying lengths, from 4.7 to 18 km, through varied landscapes of dense forests, green meadows and beautiful viewpoints. The start and finish are at the Haus des Gastes in Neuhaus, where hikers can set off between 8 and 10 a.m. Drinks and light snacks are available at checkpoints for a small fee. An awards ceremony takes place in the afternoon, recognizing, among others, the groups with the most participants and the oldest hikers.
course_highlights: Varied landscapes featuring densely forested areas and lush green meadows
Great viewpoints with beautiful panoramas of the Weser Uplands
Four marked routes ranging from 4.7 to 18 km
additional: The start and finish are at the Haus des Gastes in Neuhaus, Lindenstraße 6. Participants set off between 8 and 10 a.m. Drinks and light snacks are available at checkpoints for a small fee. An awards ceremony takes place in the afternoon, recognizing the groups with the most participants and the oldest hikers. Savory dishes and a selection of sweet cakes will be served. Musical entertainment and a varied range of information and sales stalls round off the event. Routes from 5 to 20 km, refreshments at checkpoints, musical accompaniment, sales stalls, afternoon awards ceremony.

name: 47. Półmaraton Szczecin Bieg na 10 km
location: Plac Jasne Błonia im. Jana Pawła II, Szczecin, Poland
description: The 47th PKO Szczecin Half Marathon is an annual running event taking place on 30 August 2026 in Szczecin. Participants can choose between the half-marathon distance (21.0975 km) and a 10 km race, both following a single-loop route through the city streets. The start and finish are at Jan Paweł II Jasne Błonia Square. The course is certified by PZLA and marked every kilometre, and timing is electronic, using chips in the race bibs. The organisers offer wave starts and high-quality Ventus technical shirts in the extended race packages.
course_highlights: Single-loop route through the streets of Szczecin
Distance-choice point at 9.6 km on the route
PZLA-certified course, marked every kilometre
additional: Participants can choose a basic or extended package, with a Ventus technical shirt included in the extended package. Start and finish at Jan Paweł II Jasne Błonia Square. Participant limit: 6,000. Electronic timing using chips in the race bibs. Wave starts available. Race packages can be shipped by InPost courier, with the option to redirect them to a parcel locker. Distances: half marathon and 10 km race; location: Jasne Błonia, Szczecin; date: 30 August 2026, 09:00–13:00

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
location: Jezioro Kierskie, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held by historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon in 1984. Athletes can expect calm, warm waters for the swim; a fast, flat bike course through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań; and a run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds, a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines sporting competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.
course_highlights: Swim in the calm, warm waters of Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland’s first triathlon
A flat, fast bike course through villages and the western part of Poznań
A run towards the city centre, finishing at the Poznań International Fairgrounds
additional: The race starts in a rolling-start format. The start and finish venues are Lake Kierskie and the Poznań International Fairgrounds. IRONKIDS will take place the day before, on August 29, 2026, with a start time of 11:00. Registration for the main race is sold out; notifications are available in case additional places open up. Participants can change their race date free of charge under the Flex90 offer. The event also includes activities such as the Night Run and IRONKIDS, and the participant limit is 1,500. Registration requires a credit card.

name: Blodomloppet (Borås)
location: Ymergården och Skidstadion, Borås, Västra Götaland, Sweden
price_range: 1750 kr för laganmälan, 350-450 kr för individuella deltagare
description: Blodomloppet in Borås is a recreational race offering 5 km and 10 km running distances, as well as a child-friendly course called Lilla Blodomloppet, approximately 800 metres long. The races follow hilly trails and roads in scenic areas around Ymergården and Skidstadion, offering a wonderful nature experience for both runners and walkers. Lilla Blodomloppet is specially designed for children up to 12 years old, and all participants receive T-shirts and medals. After the race, families can explore an activity trail called “Jätten Ymers Stig”. Blodomloppet is part of a larger national initiative to raise awareness of blood donation and promote health.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km on hilly trails and roads in a scenic area between Ymer and Kype
Lilla Blodomloppet, approx. 800 m, for children up to 12 years old; all receive T-shirts and medals
After the race, families can enjoy the “Jätten Ymers Stig” activity trail
additional: You can register individually or as a team (3–5 participants). Team registration includes a picnic bag. An extra picnic bag can be purchased for 250 kr. Late registration is available on site on the day of the event for an increased fee, up to one hour before the start. Names for race bibs must be submitted by 10 August. Lilla Blodomloppet provides T-shirts and medals for all children. After the race, families are invited to explore “Jätten Ymers Stig”, an activity trail. The event includes medals, picnic bags, activities for children and the opportunity for the whole family to take part. Participants often receive technical-fabric T-shirts and medals as souvenirs.

name: Blodomloppet

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmälningsavgift Blodomloppet (5 eller 10 km): 350 kr  t.o.m 12 augusti.

description: Join in celebrating the life-saving act of blood donation at Blodomloppet Växjö on 2 September 2026. The event offers 5 km and 10 km (10 km = two laps of a course-measured 5 km route), as well as Lilla Blodomloppet for the youngest participants. The start and finish are in Linnéparken, and the course is described as flat and fast, with plenty of crowd support along the way. The event welcomes both individual participants and teams, and traditionally wraps up with a picnic and activities in the event area.
course_highlights: Start and finish in beautiful Linnéparken, in front of the main stage
Flat, fast, course-measured 5 km route (10 km = two laps)
Separate walking route for the 5 km walk and a dedicated loop for Lilla Blodomloppet (~600 m)
additional: You can register individually or as part of a team (maximum 5 participants per team). Team members can take part in different distances. The deadline for team registration is 26 August 2026. An Excel template is available for bulk registrations, and the organiser can help set up a customer page or discount code for companies registering more than 20 participants. Changing a name or changing category/distance costs 50 SEK. Registration is open until the day of the event, and you can also register on site in Linnéparken (at the late-registration and race-number pickup tent). Lilla Blodomloppet takes place on its own loop in Linnéparken, with the same start and finish. Course details: the start and finish are in Linnéparken; the 5 km course is used for the 10 km race; on-site registration and team registration are available; a T-shirt, race number, medal and goodie bag are included; water stations and storage are mentioned.

name: Blodomloppet Halmstad
price_range: 350 kr t.o.m. 11 aug; 1 750 kr för lag om fem personer inklusive picknickkasse

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 1 750 kr för lag med fem deltagare inkl. picknickkasse t.o.m 11/8

description: Welcome to Blodomloppet in Halmstad, a recreational race that raises awareness of the vital importance of blood donation. You can walk, jog or run 5 km or 10 km, and there is also Lilla Blodomloppet for children and families. The event is organized by Halmstad Orienteering Club together with the blood centers in Halland, and many teams usually finish with a shared picnic.
course_highlights: Choose between 5 km or 10 km on a coastal route
Finish area with views of the sea at Tylösand
Separate Lilla Blodomloppet for children and families
additional: Registration is available only through the Blodomloppet website. Teams of five participants receive a picnic bag. Food, drinks and ice cream can be purchased at the existing kiosks near the start. Companies can rent tents in the finish area through Halmstad Partytält (info@halmstadpartytalt.se). Bag drop is available; start and finish information, a map and changing facilities are mentioned in the event information; tents can be rented in the finish area.

name: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie
description: Leśna Piątka Odwrotnie is a cross-country race held in Koszalin on September 3, 2026. The course follows the usual route in the opposite direction, allowing participants to experience it anew. The event is open to runners, Nordic Walking enthusiasts, and mixed pairs. All participants receive medals at the finish, with trophies for the top finishers in various categories. The race is the season finale of Leśne Piątki and part of the Touru Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, encouraging activity throughout the year.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in the forest of the Karnieszewice Forest District
Start and finish at the car park on Słupska Street in Koszalin
The route is run in the opposite direction, offering a chance to experience it anew
additional: Race numbers with chips can be collected at the race office on race day. Participants can compete in the running, Nordic Walking, and mixed-pair categories. The race is part of the Touru Biegów po Okolicy - TurBO, where the kilometres covered count, not pace. After the race, a photo gallery prepared by the A7 FILM team will be available. Participants can register online. The event also features photography attractions and is part of the Touru Biegów po Okolicy (TurBO).

name: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail
description: Icebug Xperience West Coast Trail is a three-day trail running stage race in the Ramsvik area of Bohuslän on Sweden’s west coast, covering roughly 75–77 km over coastal cliffs, forest trails and beaches. The event is presented as an inclusive outdoor experience with separate starting groups for Walk, Jog and Run, so both competitive runners and those wanting a scenic multi-day hike can participate. Race Village accommodation is organised in cooperation with Ramsvik Stugby & Camping, and family-friendly options such as a Kids Camp with supervised activities are offered. Expect varied, technical terrain and daily stages that showcase the archipelago and coastal villages.
course_highlights: Three stages across coastal cliffs, narrow forest trails and beaches
Daily stages include Ramsvik–Smögen (~25 km), Bohus-Malmön–Kungshamn (~31 km) and Hunnebo–Ramsvik (~22 km)
Technical rocky peaks, enchanted forests and seaside village passages
additional: Participants choose a starting group (Walk, Jog or Run); to aim for the overall top 50, you must start all stages in the Run group. Official accommodation partner: Ramsvik Stugby & Camping (location of Race Village). There is a Kids Camp offering supervised activities (sailing, fishing and visits to Nordens Ark) while adults run the stages. Stage maps are provided for each day (Ramsvik–Smögen, Bohus-Malmön–Kungshamn, Hunnebo–Ramsvik). Kids Camp and family activities; energy stations and mandatory equipment; accommodation and transport information related to Ramsvik.

name: 24. Duderstädter Sparkassenlauf
description: The 24th Duderstadt Sparkassenlauf takes place on 28 August 2026 in Duderstadt’s historic pedestrian zone. The event starts at 16:00 with the opening ceremony in front of the town hall, which is also the finish point for all races. Distances include a 600 m Bambini run, 1.25 km school races, and 5 km and 10 km races. Children and young people receive finisher medals; participants in the 5 km and 10 km races receive neckerchiefs, and winners are rewarded with cake. The event is supported by the City of Duderstadt, Sparkasse Duderstadt and other sponsors.
course_highlights: Races through Duderstadt’s historic old town and pedestrian zone
Finish in front of the beautiful town hall
A range of distances from 600 m to 10 km, including races for children and young people
additional: The event opens at 16:00 with remarks by patron and Mayor Thorsten Feike and the board of Sparkasse Duderstadt. The Bambini races have a participant limit of 250, while the school races have limits of 300 to 400 participants. Neckerchiefs are given as finisher gifts for the 5 km and 10 km races. On-the-day registration is not available. The awards ceremony starts at 18:00. Several race distances, registration via the website, medals for children, neckerchiefs for longer races, event in the historic city centre

name: Höinger Heidelauf
location: Ense-Höingen, Kreis Soest, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Höinger Heidelauf is a traditional running event held annually on the first Friday in September in Ense-Höingen. Known as the toughest 10 km race in the Soest district, the event offers distances for different types of runners, including 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon. The course runs along mostly paved paths and gravel trails through the Sauerland hills and features challenging terrain. Alongside the sporting challenge, the event puts community and atmosphere at the forefront, making it a special experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Toughest 10 km race in the Soest district
Course along paved paths and gravel trails
Run through the hilly Sauerland landscape
additional: Children’s races start at 16:45, the 5 km and half marathon at 17:30, and the 10 km race at 18:30. The start and finish are at Karl-Kleine-Stadion. The event offers great refreshments and a strong sense of community. Temporary road closures and safety measures should be taken into account. In the past, the event has set participation records despite adverse weather conditions. Running event with children’s races and main races, a challenging course with elevation gain, and online registration available.

name: IHK-Ausbildungslauf move-on
location: Rostrup bei Oldenburg, Ammerland, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The training run “Move On!” is organised by the Oldenburg Chamber of Industry and Commerce (IHK) and takes place on 4 September 2026 around the Zwischenahner Meer. The course is approximately 12 km long and runs from BBS Ammerland in Rostrup via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen, returning to Rostrup. The event is aimed at trainers, apprentices, examiners, teachers and other people involved in vocational education and training in the Oldenburg region. In addition to the run, the event offers a programme including race-number collection, team photos, a barbecue evening with music and an awards ceremony. The event takes place in all weather. Parking is available at BBS and Bau-ABC Rostrup.
course_highlights: Approximately 12 km circuit around the Zwischenahner Meer
Start and finish at BBS Ammerland in Rostrup
Route via Eyhausen, Zwischenahn, Aschhausen and Dreibergen
additional: Race numbers and T-shirts can be collected at BBS Rostrup on event day from 14:00 to 15:30. A walking group starts at 15:00. The run starts in four groups from 16:00, at four-minute intervals. After the run, a barbecue with a musical act will take place from 18:00 at Bau-ABC, near the finish. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 18:30. The IHK accepts no liability for accidents or theft. The event takes place in all weather. Valuables cannot be stored. Parking is available at BBS and Bau-ABC. Run on 4 September 2026; registration opens on 1 June 2026; takes place in all weather; parking available at BBS and Bau-ABC Rostrup.

name: Sparkassen Pütt-Tage-Lauf 2026
organizer: Sparkasse Münsterland Ost, SG Rote Erde Beckum, Ski-Club Beckum, TV Beckum, Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen
price_range: online registration, exact fee not specified
description: The Sparkassen Pütt-Tage Run is a road-running event held on Fridays in downtown Beckum as part of the city’s Pütt-Tage festivities. The program includes short children’s races, a youth race, a charity run, and the 10 km main race, which also serves as the FLVW 10 km Road Running Championships. The course covers several laps through the streets around Hühlstraße, where the start and finish are also located. The event is organized by several local clubs and the Lions Club Beckum-Ahlen. Timing uses a RaceResult transponder in the race bib.
course_highlights: City streets around Hühlstraße in Beckum
10 km main race over several laps
Charity run of approximately 4.2 km over about five laps
additional: The program begins with a 400 m Bambini Run, followed by 1 km children’s races (ages 6–9), a 2 km youth race (ages 10–15), and the 10 km main race (ages 16 and up). Timing uses a RaceResult transponder in the race bib, and results are published online. Multiple race types, including children’s, youth, charity, and main races; held as part of the Pütt-Tage festivities; city-street race; timing with a RaceResult transponder.

name: Straberger 1/3 Marathon
description: The Straberger 1/3 Marathon takes place on September 4, 2026, in Dormagen and offers races over 5 kilometers and 14.065 kilometers. The scenic route passes Kloster Knechtsteden and runs through the forest, making it ideal for beginners, experienced runners, and ambitious athletes. The event features samba and a festive atmosphere in the town center and is also suitable as a tune-up run for the Cologne Marathon. Children can take part in junior races and receive free running shirts and medals at the finish.
course_highlights: Scenic route past Kloster Knechtsteden
Run through the forest
Festive atmosphere and samba in Straberg town center
additional: Children up to U8 receive a free running shirt and a medal at the finish. Adults can order a breathable running shirt for 18 euros when registering and collect it with their race number on event day. The junior races take place at Linden-Kirch-Platz in the town center, with different lap lengths depending on age group. Parking is available nearby at Hubertus-Schützensaal and the sports ground. Scenic route, junior races, festive atmosphere, start and finish at Linden-Kirch-Platz, online registration, free for children up to U8, running shirt included

name: 23. Lehrter CityLauf
description: The 23rd Lehrte City Run takes place on September 4, 2026, and is a traditional running event in downtown Lehrte. The races cover distances of 2, 4, and 10 kilometers, including Bambini and school races, as well as a 2-kilometer inclusion run. The company competition over 4 and 10 kilometers will once again be sponsored by the KURTULUS GRUPPE. Music and a varied program of activities featuring LSV departments will create a great atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route runs through downtown Lehrte
Races over 2, 4, and 10 kilometers
Inclusion run as part of the 2-kilometer race
additional: There is a company competition over 4 and 10 kilometers, sponsored by the KURTULUS GRUPPE. Musical accompaniment by Walter Nebel. LSV departments can take part in the program of activities. Help with course support and organization is welcome. Booth spaces are available for companies. In addition to the races, the event offers a varied program of activities, including live music, food stalls, and company competitions. The event is open to everyone; registration is via Raceresult.

name: Dijkenloop
location: Beneden-Leeuwen, West Maas en Waal, Netherlands

name: Run to the beat powered by Bang & Olufsen 2027
Midnattsloppet Göteborg
description: Midnattsloppet Göteborg takes place on 5 September 2026 and offers a festive evening race of 5 km or 10 km, starting and finishing at Gustaf Adolfs torg. The races pass through the heart of the city and along Avenyn, with music, spectators and activities along the course creating a carnival atmosphere. The event welcomes individual runners, teams and companies, combining competition with a nighttime celebration. It is promoted as a memorable running experience, with late start times and a strong focus on atmosphere.
course_highlights: Two-lap course along Avenyn, starting and finishing at Gustaf Adolfs torg (the 10 km race covers two laps)
Late-evening start for a unique nighttime atmosphere — the 10 km starts at 21:00
Crowds of spectators, music and activities along the course create a festive atmosphere
additional: The start area and warm-up take place at Gustaf Adolfs torg. The 5 km entry fee includes, among other things, a Björn Borg T-shirt (this year's colour/design), chip timing, energy drink along the course, and a bar/fruit at the finish; a medal can be purchased when registering. Registration through wellness-benefit providers (Benifex, Epassi, Benefits) is available. Cut-off times: 10 km = 90 minutes (from the last start group), 5 km = 45 minutes; course closure/lap rules apply (for example, stopping at Tyska Bron for the lap and rules for the second lap). Company and team registration, as well as the purchase of gift codes, are available. Start times: 10 km at 21:00 and 5 km at 21:30. The race pack includes a T-shirt, chip and the option of a medal. Wellness subsidies are available through Benifex, Epassi and Benefits. Company and team participation is available, and a course map can be found on the website.

name: HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon
description: The HOKA Helsingborg Half Marathon is a well-organised half marathon featuring fast sections, varied terrain and a spectacular finish by the sea. The start and finish are at Dunkers Kulturhus, and the course runs through Helsingborg’s historic centre, past Kärnan, through Pålsjö Forest and Laröd. Much of the course is shared with the marathon route. It has around 170 metres of elevation gain, a hill up towards Kärnan at 2 km and a long downhill after 19 km. The race hosts the 2026 Swedish Half Marathon Championships and offers the option to donate any amount to Min Stora Dag.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Dunkers Kulturhus; around 3 km through the historic centre, including Stortorget and Kärnan
The finish line and final stretch run along the sea at Gröningen, with celebrations on the pier facing the Öresund
Around 170 metres of elevation gain in total; a hill up towards Kärnan after ~2 km and a long downhill after ~19 km; mostly asphalt, with sections through forest and city
additional: The 2026 Swedish Half Marathon Championships are held in conjunction with the race; championship participants must represent a club affiliated with the Swedish Athletics Federation; option to donate any amount to Min Stora Dag during registration; the race-bib T-shirt must be actively selected and is specially produced (cannot be exchanged or returned); group registration is available via a dedicated group form/link (on the registration page); the course map shows the start/finish, split times, refreshment stations, toilets, cafés, parking and the Stadsdelsfesten along the route. 2026 Swedish Half Marathon Championships; around 4,000 starting places; fundraising for Min Stora Dag; group registration with invoice; bib collection can be linked to T-shirt selection (the T-shirt is non-returnable), according to the registration page.

name: Lydinge Resort Stafett
description: Lydinge Resort Relay is a team event over two distances—42.2 km and 21.1 km—in which teams of 2–4 people divide up our beautiful and varied courses. The race starts at Sundstorget in Helsingborg, and the routes take in everything from the city centre and the land ridge to coastal stretches, with the finish along the seafront promenade. The relay has four exchange stations and varied legs through both natural and urban settings. It is offered in men’s, women’s, mixed and corporate categories. The event also partners with Min Stora Dag to raise funds for children.
course_highlights: Start at Sundstorget and finish along the Seafront Promenade
Exchange stations including Ättekulla, Fredriksdal and Pålsjö Forest
A varied route through the city, along the coast and through nature reserves
additional: Team size: 2–4 runners; distances: 21.1 km (legs approximately 3.6–6 km) and 42.2 km (legs approximately 9–12 km); categories: men’s, women’s, mixed and corporate. Enter your teammates’ email addresses when registering so they receive confirmation by email. Larger group registrations can be made using a separate group form. A race T-shirt is optional and made to order; it can be collected at Löplabbet after the race. Test runs are offered, for example on 18 April and 6 June 2026. You can donate to Min Stora Dag during registration. Lydinge Resort Relay offers group registration with invoicing. Participants receive a T-shirt designed for the year, which can be collected at Löplabbet in Helsingborg after the race; T-shirts cannot be exchanged or returned. The partnership with Min Stora Dag helps raise funds for children in need.

name: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun
description: Merrell Göteborg Trailrun is an exciting and challenging trail race in Gothenburg, with distances for everyone, from a shorter 8 km to longer 33 km and 45 km routes. The courses follow adventurous trails through leafy forests and over rocky outcrops, taking runners from the edge of the city into the wilderness. After the finish, AfterRun awaits, with food, a finisher item and a unique medal. The race emphasises the experience, community and sustainability, and starts and finishes in Kvibergs Park.
course_highlights: Adventurous trails, leafy forests and rocky outcrops with spectacular views
Courses passing Bergsjön, Paradiset and sections of the Bohusleden (the 33 km route follows the Bohusleden)
Technical terrain alternates with runnable sections and significant elevation gain
additional: Start and finish in Kvibergs Park (all races gather there); the 33 km race starts at Angereds kyrka, with a shared bus from Kviberg (the bus departs at 10:10); race bib collection: Friday at Löplabbet Östra Hamngatan, 11:00–18:00, and Saturday from 09:00 at the event area in Kviberg; AfterRun food is included for participants; live tracking and split times are available; registration is individual via partner Race.se and is binding (no refunds); free name changes until 2026-08-23, then 200 kr from 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-03; the organiser encourages use of public transport (trams 7 and 11, buses 56 and 510), and paid parking is available. Distances also include a 33 km start at Angereds kyrka, with a shared bus to the start; the course may change, and the start and finish are in Kvibergs Park; aid and energy stations, mandatory equipment and medical support are available on site; some cutoff and finish times are listed in the race information.

name: Västgötaloppet Trail 2026
location: Dammen i Tvärred, Ulricehamn Municipality, Västra Götaland County, Sweden
description: Västgötaloppet Trail is a family-friendly trail race held in beautiful woodland and rugged terrain around Dammen in Tvärred, south of Ulricehamn. Choose between 7, 17 or 27 km on routes featuring narrow trails, moss-covered rocky sections and plenty of elevation. The event focuses on the experience, community and joy of running, with volunteers, a race announcer and on-site services, as well as hot food and a medal for everyone who finishes.
course_highlights: Narrow forest trails and moss-covered rocky sections
A challenging, hilly course with magical views
Start and finish at Dammen in Tvärred (parking nearby)
additional: All distances start and finish at Dammen in Tvärred; parking is available nearby. There are aid stations along the course (in partnership with Umara Sports). Hot food is included for all participants after finishing, and everyone who completes the race receives a medal. A free mini-race for the youngest participants starts at 10:45, with on-site registration; a course test run takes place on 3 May with several pace groups. Västgötaloppet Trail is part of Västgötatrippeln (Classic/Skate, MTB and Trail). The event area is Dammen in Tvärred; the start and finish are centrally located, with parking nearby, and participants are offered drinks, snacks, a medal and hot food after the race. The 27 km and 17 km races have prize ceremonies; the 7 km race offers prizes by lottery. Part of Västgötaloppstrippeln.

name: Felsburglauf
description: The Felsburglauf is a traditional running event held annually since 2013 on the last Sunday in August at the stadium below Felsburg in Felsberg. The event offers races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m and attracts runners of all ages from the region. Its family-friendly atmosphere and beautiful setting make it a popular event in the Schwalm-Eder district. As a licensed race in the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup, participants can also earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: Races over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m and 10,000 m
Start and finish at the stadium below historic Felsburg
Family-friendly atmosphere in beautiful surroundings
additional: The race is part of the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup. The youngest participants are often born in 2020 or later, and the oldest runner was born in 1937. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht 1863 Felsberg and partner TSV Jahn Gensungen. Distances: 400 m, 1 km, 5 km, 10 km; terrain: stadium and the area around Felsburg; registration not explicitly mentioned

name: Herbstwaldlauf (Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup) inkl. Hobby-Mountainbike-Rennen
location: Finnentrop-Fretter, Finnentrop, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 62nd Herbstwaldlauf (Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup) in Finnentrop-Fretter is a short running event taking place on September 5, 2026. There is also a hobby mountain bike race alongside the run. The event offers runners and mountain bikers an attractive opportunity to experience the autumn scenery of the Sauerland and enjoy an active day.
course_highlights: Short 0.4 km running course
Includes a hobby mountain bike race
Autumn woodland scenery in the Sauerland
additional: The event offers a varied course route, including a trail run, hill run, and mountain biking, with mostly changeable weather in the Sauerland.

name: Volkslauf in St.Vit Laufen und Gutes tun
location: St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The charity run “Laufen und Gutes tun” takes place on September 5, 2026, in St. Vit, Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The races follow flat loop courses through St. Vit, starting and finishing at the Küsterhaus. The event supports various social causes, including pediatric outpatient palliative care, the Malteser Herzenswunsch ambulance, DKMS, and families in need. Alongside the runs, the event features an inline skating race for the first time, as well as a charity tattoo campaign to encourage participants’ social commitment.
course_highlights: Flat loop courses through St. Vit
Start and finish at the Küsterhaus
9.1 km inline skating race (5 laps), helmets required
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the running shoe. Race bibs and materials can be collected on event day from 13:30 in the registration tent next to the Küsterhaus. Water is available along the course, with tea and fruit at the finish area. Changing facilities are available at the local youth center. Helmets are required for the inline skating race. A charity tattoo campaign and DKMS registration will be available on site. Participation through membership is possible; donations support children’s hospices, DKMS, and families in need. Races are offered over various distances, including a Bambini run and inline skating.

name: Werler Kurpark Crosslauf - Hindernislauf für Groß und Klein
location: Werl Kurpark, Werl, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Werler Kurpark Crosslauf is an obstacle race for all ages, held in the picturesque Kurpark in Werl. The event offers races for different age groups and ability levels, from short courses for children to a challenging 6.4 km course for endurance runners. New in 2026 is the relay cross, which encourages team spirit and fun. The varied course features numerous exciting obstacles that make the race a special experience.
course_highlights: A variety of obstacles, including Climb the Wall, Waterlagoon and Mountainclimber
Distances from 480 metres to 6.4 kilometres
New for 2026: Project S as an additional obstacle
additional: On-site late registration is available up to 60 minutes before the respective start (except for the relay). Race numbers use electronic timing via Racersult. An exclusive Kurparkcross shirt can be pre-ordered only until 30.06.2026. Spikes, barefoot running and costumes are not permitted for safety reasons. Accompaniment on the course is permitted only for the U6 Bambini race. Obstacles, courses for children and adults, family-friendly, team spirit, fun

name: Wiehler AggerEnergie- und Sparkasse Gummersbach Sommerlauf
location: Wiehltalstadion, Wiehl, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Wiehl AggerEnergie and Sparkasse Gummersbach Summer Run is a varied running event for all age groups and ability levels. Starting at Wiehltal Stadium, the routes pass through the redesigned parks in the center of Wiehl and offer a scenic setting. Whether you run individually or as part of a team, the Summer Run invites you to get active, enjoy a sense of community, and have fun. The motto “We in Wiehl are sporty!” underscores Wiehl’s vibrant sporting culture.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wiehltal Stadium
Route through redesigned parks in the city center
Scenic and varied course
additional: The run takes place on Saturday, 05 September 2026. The event is open to individual runners and teams. Contact: Nicole Woberschal (Tel. 02262 99-206). Routes start at Wiehltal Stadium and offer a scenic setting. Registration available.

name: Wildman Harz
description: WILDMAN Harz is a challenging trail-running event around the mountain town of Wildemann in the Harz Mountains. The course features tough climbs, technical downhills, spruce forests and alpine meadows, offering an authentic trail-running experience in the Upper Harz. With distances from 1.5 km to 55 km, there is a suitable challenge for every trail runner. The event also features a varied program, including a pasta party and a barbecue party, making the weekend a special experience.
course_highlights: Tough climbs and technical downhills
Spruce forests and alpine meadows
Singletrack trails over rugged terrain around Wildemann
additional: Late registration is possible online up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late-registration fee of EUR 10. Age limits are defined for each course. The program includes a pasta party on Friday and a barbecue party on Saturday. There are race categories, mandatory equipment and aid stations. Registration is through the partner myRacePartner.com. Courses have up to 2,100 metres of elevation gain. Aid stations, timing, environmental and fair-play rules, a program including pasta and barbecue parties, and registration are required.

name: Borkumer Meilenlauf und Nordic Walking
location: Borkum, Nordseeinsel Borkum, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Anmeldungen bis 01.08.2026 mit vollem Leistungspaket inklusive T-Shirt

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Anmeldungen bis 20.08.2026 mit vollem Leistungspaket inklusive T-Shirt

description: The 20th Borkum Mile Run with Nordic Walking takes place on 5 September 2026 on the North Sea island of Borkum. The varied courses wind through the island’s scenic beaches and dunes, offering a suitable challenge for every aspiring runner, from the junior Pirate Run to the quarter marathon. The offshore climate and fresh sea air make the event a special experience, rounded off by an extensive programme for participants and their companions.
course_highlights: Courses through Borkum’s beaches and dunes
Offshore climate and fresh sea air
A variety of distances, from the Pirate Run to the quarter marathon
additional: Late entries are possible on site on event day up to 45 minutes before the start of the competition, for a late-entry fee of EUR 5.00, but without entitlement to the full package of services or a T-shirt. Refreshments on the course and at the finish, changing rooms, bag storage, showers, and 90 minutes of free access to the Erlebnisdeck at Gezeitenland are included. Discounted ferry fares are also available on the event weekend. Courses along the promenade and beach; no age categories for Nordic Walking; refreshment stations on longer courses.

name: Ederauenlauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.4 km
description: The Ederauenlauf in Bergheim is a popular running event offering a variety of distances suitable for runners of all ages and ability levels. The course runs through the picturesque Ederauen and provides ideal conditions on a measured course eligible for record lists. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, numerous volunteers, and great spirit. Alongside the sporting competition, the focus is also on sharing the experience and supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Measured course eligible for record lists through the Ederauen
Distances from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km)
Start and finish at the central sports complex of TV08 Bergheim
additional: The event offers various distances, from the 400 m Bambini race to the half marathon (21.1 km). The course is dry and sheltered from the wind, with ideal running weather. There is a family-friendly atmosphere with many volunteers and spectators. The event supports social projects such as the Marburg Children's Cancer Aid. The central sports complex of TV08 Bergheim serves as the start and finish venue. Courses are measured and well marked, including for Nordic walking; donations support children's cancer aid; event in September 2026.

name: Fehmarn Marathon
description: The Fehmarn Marathon takes place annually on the island of Fehmarn and offers runners a varied course through the eastern part of the island. The main races follow roads, dike paths and uneven dirt tracks, providing a diverse running experience. The event starts on 5 September 2026 at 9:30 a.m. at the sports field at Inselschule in Fehmarn. In addition to the marathon, there are other races with award ceremonies, and all participants receive an official marathon shirt. Timing is done with a foot chip attached to the running shoe, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Loops along roads, dike paths and uneven dirt tracks
Course through the eastern part of Fehmarn
Start and finish at the sports field at Inselschule
additional: Bib pickup is available the day before the event from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. and on the day of the event from 8:00 a.m. Award ceremonies take place at staggered times after the races. Timing is done with a foot chip, which must be returned after the race; a €15 fee applies if it is lost. The event ends at approximately 3:15 p.m. with the arrival of the bicycle escort marking the end of the course. Parking is recommended, with the start area within walking distance. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective race. Shirts tend to run small, so larger sizes are recommended. The event takes place in all weather conditions; online registration is available, including running shirts and various categories.

name: Intern. Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
location: Neustadt am Rübenberge, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run, hosted by TSV Poggenhagen von 1946 e.V., takes place on September 5, 2026. This traditional public race is scored according to the rules of the German Athletics Association (DLO) and is recognized for all DLV public race badges. Certificates are available for all finishers and can be downloaded online. An awards ceremony is held for the top three finishers in each category. A special prize is also awarded to the largest registered group. Acceptance of the terms of participation and liability limitations is required to take part.
course_highlights: Scored according to DLO rules
Recognized for all DLV public race badges
Awards ceremony on race day, with a special prize for the largest group
additional: Online registrations are acknowledged with a confirmation. The organizational fee is non-refundable if you do not start. Certificates for all finishers are available to download online. The event is part of the TSV Poggenhagen program and, alongside the races, offers the opportunity to earn DLV public race badges. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and the scenic course in the Meer region.

name: Volkslauf Eisbergen 2026
location: Sportplatz Eisbergen, Waterbusch 40, Porta Westfalica, Germany
organizer: TuS Eisbergen TURN- UND SPIELVEREIN 1919 EISBERGEN e. V.
description: The Volkslauf Eisbergen is a long-established running event in Porta Westfalica, offering several distances for children and adults. The course runs around the Eisbergen sports ground and offers varied running options, with a 5.7 km fun run and a 17.7 km long-distance race. Food and refreshments are available for participants, and the event is part of the Mühlenkreisserie. The course can also be viewed on Komoot, allowing runners to prepare in advance.
course_highlights: Loop around the Eisbergen sports ground, with the start and finish at the sports ground
Fun run course: approx. 5.7 km; long-distance course: approx. 17.7 km (two laps with minimal changes)
Children’s races: 400 m Bambini run, 800 m schoolchildren’s run
additional: Bambini run (400 m) for children up to age 6, with no registration or entry fee. Schoolchildren’s run (800 m) for children up to age 12. Online registration is available only until 04.09; after that, late registration is possible on site for an additional fee. Start times have changed: Bambini run 14:00, schoolchildren’s run 14:15, fun run and walking 15:00. Food and refreshments are available. Distances: 5.7 km fun run and walking, approx. 17.7 km long-distance race; start location: Eisbergen sports ground, Waterbusch 40; September weather: around 19°C, cloudy

name: Volksbank Mitte Kurstadtlauf
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Kurstadtlauf in Heilbad Heiligenstadt is a long-running race taking place for the 27th time on September 5, 2026. The 19-kilometer course crosses the Dün and starts and finishes in the Vitalpark. A tree is planted to reforest local woodlands for every participant, making the race environmentally special too. The event offers a welcoming atmosphere and invites runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: 19 km race across the Dün
Start and finish in the Vitalpark (Leineaue 1)
Scenic course with sections through the forest
additional: Race bib distribution from 8:30 a.m. in front of the Vitalpark. Late registration is possible for an additional fee of €3. Start and finish in the Vitalpark, race across the Dün, tree-planting campaign for participants

name: 55. Brockenlauf
description: The Brockenlauf is Germany’s oldest mountain race and has been held annually in Ilsenburg in the Harz Mountains since 1927. The main 26.2 km course climbs 890 metres to the Brocken, the highest mountain in northern Germany, and offers a demanding challenge with changeable high-mountain weather at the summit. The course passes through picturesque countryside and historic places, with impressive views along the way. In addition to the main race, there are shorter routes that also offer an experience of nature. The event is open to all runners, whether or not they belong to a club.
course_highlights: 26.2 km with 890 metres of elevation gain to the Brocken
Changeable high-mountain weather at the summit, with temperatures from -15 °C to 15 °C
Start in the medieval town of Ilsenburg; run along the Ilse and through the Harz Forest
additional: Split times are recorded at several points along the 26.2 km course using SPORTident Timing. The course is demanding, with steep sections of up to a 12.5% gradient and concrete slabs at the summit. The event is open to runners and walkers. The organizer reserves the right to change the course if conditions on the Brocken are unreasonable. Registration is already open. Various distances are available, including ultra and running events, as well as a book flea market and exclusive running shirts.

description: The Brokser Volkslauf takes place on September 5, 2026, in Bruchhausen-Vilsen and offers running and walking events for all age groups. The event includes distances from 400 m to 20 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. Held in all weather, it offers participants a varied supporting program with a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The races start at the school and sports center, and children’s and youth races are rewarded with medals.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 m (Bambini Run) to 20 km (Volkslauf)
Start and finish at the school and sports center in Bruchhausen-Vilsen
The 20 km route consists of two laps of the 10 km route
additional: The start and finish are at the school and sports center in Bruchhausen-Vilsen. Race bib distribution begins at 13:00. Late registration is available on the day of the event. Award ceremonies take place at staggered times after the individual races. Medals are awarded for the children’s and youth races. The supporting program includes a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. Running, walking, held annually, in all weather.

name: 46. Internationaler Steinhuder-Meer-Lauf
description: The 46th International Steinhuder Meer Run invites running enthusiasts to Poggenhagen on September 5, 2026. The event offers 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon races, all starting together. The scenic course runs around Poggenhagen, past the air base and as far as the bathing island in Steinhude. Children can also take part in races over 450 and 850 metres. All races finish at the TSV Poggenhagen sports park.
course_highlights: The course runs north of Poggenhagen
The 10 km race passes the air base and Großenheidorn
The half-marathon goes as far as the bathing island in Steinhude and back
additional: The children's races over 450 and 850 metres start at 9:30 a.m. All main races start together at 11 a.m. on Dewitz-von-Woyna-Straße in Poggenhagen. The finish is at the TSV Poggenhagen sports park. Races over 5 km, 10 km and half-marathon; children's races; start at 11 a.m. in Poggenhagen; online registration available

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
location: Portowy region Gdańska, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 60th Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event held in the port region of Gdańsk on 5 September 2026. It brings together athletes of various ages and ability levels, with race-walking events over 10 km (women and men, including Open, U20 and U18 categories), 5 km and 3 km for younger participants, as well as the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also includes the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the “Walk with the Postman” Prologue and the Polish Post Office Defenders’ Run – Energa Cup. The organiser, LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, promotes physical activity among people with disabilities, too, with wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.
course_highlights: Race walking over 10 km, 5 km and 3 km, with distances suited to different age categories
Polish Masters Championships over 5 km and Polish U23 Championships over 10 km
Accompanying events, including the “Walk with the Postman” Prologue and the Polish Post Office Defenders’ Run
additional: The festival promotes physical activity among people with disabilities through wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions. It is organised by LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club and supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism. Events cover several distances, including 10 km, 5 km and 3 km, and online registration is available. The event promotes sporting activity among people of different ages and people with disabilities, with support from the Ministry of Sport and Tourism.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The XLVI International Usedom Marathon is a unique running event that crosses two countries along Europe’s longest seaside promenade. The 42 km course connects Świnoujście in Poland with Wolgast in Germany, passing through historic seaside resorts and scenic woodland. Runners can enjoy varied surfaces and beautiful views of the Baltic Sea, as well as the unique atmosphere of Usedom Island.
course_highlights: The route follows Europe’s longest seaside promenade
Passes through the historic seaside resorts of Ahlbeck, Heringsdorf and Bansin
Varied surfaces: asphalt, cobblestones and forest trails
additional: Transport to the marathon start is provided by the organizer’s buses, with a stop near the race office at 7:15. Boarding is available at various points on Usedom Island. Baggage transport to the stadium in Wolgast is provided. Time limit: runners must pass Kölpinsee (km 21.8) within 2:30 h and Zinnowitz (km 30) within 3:30 h; otherwise, they will be withdrawn from the course. After these time limits, the course will not be supported and no refreshment stations will be available. Start in Świnoujście, finish in Wolgast, bus transfer available, registration until 30 August 2026. The routes include urban, forest and coastal sections.

Veluwse Trailrun

LöpRallarn
location: Bottnaryds IP, Bottnaryd, Ljungby Municipality, Kronoberg County, Sweden
description: LöpRallarn is part of Rallarloppen and is organized by Bottnaryds IF. The race offers shorter distances (listed as 7.5 km and 15 km) and attracts both young people and recreational runners—for example, the 2025 race drew around 102 participants. The start is at Bottnaryds IP, and the event takes place as a late-summer activity in the area around Bottnaryd. The organizer publishes results and contact details via the race’s designated email address.
course_highlights: A gently undulating loop near Bottnaryds IP (described as an 8 km loop in the Rallarloppet information)
A route that follows parts of the old, disused railway embankment
Passes natural areas near Dumme Mosse
additional: Previous editions (2025) featured both 7.5 km and 15 km, with many young people on the start list; the organizer publishes results via the same website and designated email address. LöpRallarn is part of the Rallarloppen series, alongside RallarLoppet (cross-country skiing) and CykelRallarn. The Rallarloppen course runs through the surrounding countryside, with the start and finish at Bottnaryds IP. LöpRallarn offers several distances (1 km, 2 km, 7.5 km and 15 km) for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: 16. Wardenburger Sommerlauf
description: The Wardenburg Summer Run is a long-standing race in Wardenburg that welcomes runners of all ages. Various distances are offered, from 5 km to the 10-mile race; some start together and split at the Tillysee. The event focuses on fair, well-organized race management with chip timing and offers runners a varied route through the region. Children can take part in special untimed races, and Nordic walking is also on the program. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of a dedicated organizing team.
course_highlights: The 10 km and 10-mile races start together and split at the Tillysee
Varied routes from 5 kilometers through the Wardenburg region
Timing with a chip integrated into the race bib
additional: No on-the-day entries are possible. Race bibs have an integrated chip; race bibs must be returned in the finish area. Running with dogs is not permitted. Baby joggers are allowed; participants with baby joggers should line up at the back. The Bambini run is without a race bib or timing. Toilets and changing rooms are available. Runners who exceed the 16:00 time limit will not be timed. Several distances; some races are not timed; participation is only permitted with a race bib; no on-the-day entries; organized via Laufmanager.

name: 31. Fulda-Marathon

price_tiers.distance: Halbmarathon (Einzel und Team), 5 km, 11 km, Mini-Marathon

description: The Fulda Marathon is a special running experience in the heart of Fulda, Hesse. The route passes the cathedral, runs through the Baroque Old Town and the Fulda floodplains, and finishes in the stadium. The event is organised by volunteers from Leichtathletik-Gemeinschaft Fulda e. V. and offers a well-planned course and professional organisation. In addition to the half marathon, there are other events, including 5 km and 11 km races and a mini marathon for different age groups.
course_highlights: The route passes the cathedral and runs through the Baroque Old Town
A run through the natural landscapes of the Fulda floodplains
Finish in Fulda’s city stadium
additional: Start times for the other races: 10 km at approx. 09:40, 5 km at approx. 10:00, mini marathon at 14:00 (primary school) and 15:00 (lower secondary school). The routes for all events are clearly mapped and can be downloaded. The event is organised by volunteers, with comprehensive support along the course, medical care and refreshments. Fulda Marathon T-shirts and a health check are available. Various events include the half marathon, 11 km, 5 km, team and mini marathon; registration opens on 01.02.2026; check the terms and conditions and cancellation fees; numerous refreshment and support points, an accompanying programme and medical care.

name: 8. Flensburg liebt dich Marathon
description: The Flensburg liebt dich Marathon offers a varied running experience, with routes through Flensburg’s modern and historic city centre, along the Sonwik Marina and by the harbour. The marathon consists of four laps of 10.55 km, with a maritime atmosphere, and finishes at Südermarkt. There is also a half marathon over two laps of the same course, as well as other races, including a marathon relay, 10 km and 5 km runs. The event sends a positive message about community and quality of life in the region and warmly welcomes runners of all abilities.
course_highlights: Four laps of 10.55 km through the city centre, Sonwik Marina and harbour
Flat roads along the Förde with a maritime atmosphere
Finish at Südermarkt in Flensburg
additional: For registrations from 24.08.2026 onwards, race bibs will not be personalised, and medal engraving and shirts will not be offered. Race materials can be collected upon presentation of the digital registration confirmation or an identity document. Participation is limited to 1,000 runners for the marathon and 2,000 for the half marathon. The awards ceremony takes place at Flensburg Galerie. For safety reasons, participation with electronic audio devices, walking poles, jogging strollers, prams and animals is not permitted. Online registration only; race materials can be collected at Flensburg Galerie. Various race distances are available, including a marathon relay, children’s races and practice sessions.

name: DresdenHALF
location: Dresden city center, Dresden, Saxony, Germany
