description: The DresdenHALF is an exciting half marathon that will pass through the heart of Dresden for the first time on September 6, 2026. The 21.1-kilometer course runs along the Elbe and past the city’s most beautiful landmarks, with each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s partner cities. The event offers runners a unique experience against a historic backdrop and with an international atmosphere. In addition to the half marathon, there are also other races for children and recreational runners, making the weekend a special running experience.
course_highlights: 21.1 km through the heart of Dresden, along the Elbe
Each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden’s 13 partner cities
Start at the World Trade Center Dresden, finish at the Saxon State Parliament
additional: The DresdenHALF starts at the World Trade Center Dresden and finishes at the Saxon State Parliament. The course is officially measured and eligible for record lists. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and the time limit is 3 hours. Race packets will be distributed on September 4 and 5, 2026, at the World Trade Center Dresden. Every participant receives exclusive arm warmers and a finisher’s medal. The EWG Dresden5K includes an exclusive bobble hat. It is possible to transfer a race entry for a fee. All KidsRUN participants receive a finisher’s medal and certificate. The course is officially measured; participation is open to runners aged 16 and over; the time limit is 3 hours; merchandise and race-entry transfers are available; children’s races and events on the day before the race on September 5 are included.

name: Kasseler Frauenlauf 2026
description: The Kassel Women’s Run is a charity run for women in Kassel-Wehlheiden, traditionally held on the first weekend in September at the Buchenau athletics track. The event focuses on exercise without performance pressure: there is no timing, no ranking and no pressure to set personal bests. Participants can run, jog, walk or stroll, with short children’s races as well as 5 km and 10 km run-walk routes on flat courses. The day supports women in need and fosters a relaxed community atmosphere, with a warm-up program, music, food, a raffle, childcare, applause and participant certificates.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km and 10 km routes
Children’s races of 400 m and 800 m
Finish at the Hessenkampfbahn on Auedamm
additional: There is no timing or ranking. Participants can run, jog, walk or stroll. The event offers a community atmosphere with a warm-up, music, food, a raffle, childcare and participant certificates. It takes place at the Buchenau athletics track in Kassel-Wehlheiden and emphasizes relaxed, inclusive participation for women and children of all ages.

name: Lembecker Galgenberglauf
description: The Lembecker Galgenberglauf is a traditional race with a history spanning more than 40 years, held in Hohe Mark Nature Park. The routes pass through gently hilly woodland and offer runners a special experience in nature. Various distances are offered, from a 400 m Bambini run to the 10 km main race, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is family-friendly and offers suitable races for all age groups.
course_highlights: Routes pass through gently hilly woodland in Hohe Mark Nature Park
Running routes are entirely on forest paths, some of which are gravel
Gentle climbs along the route
additional: Start times are staggered by distance and age group from 09:30 to 10:40. Tea and water are available in the start and finish area, and breakfast is offered. No showers or changing rooms are available. The late entry fee for in-person registration on the day of the event is €3.00. Race on forest paths with gentle climbs; registration online or on the day of the event; no showers or changing rooms; tea, water and breakfast available.

name: New Balance KÖ MEILE 2026
price_range: kostenlos bis 28 Euro, je nach Kategorie und Meldedatum
description: The New Balance Kö Meile is a unique running event on Düsseldorf’s Königsallee, taking place on September 6, 2026. It offers runners of all abilities a running party with plenty of atmosphere, music, confetti, and a special setting in the heart of the city. The event includes various races over 5 km, the mile (1,609 m), and children’s and youth races. The course is officially measured, paved, and certified by World Athletics, making it eligible for rankings. Whether you’re aiming for a personal best or taking part in your first race, the shared running experience is what matters most.
course_highlights: Officially measured, paved circuit on Königsallee
Official World Ranking Competition with World Athletics certification
Atmosphere with a DJ truck, cheering zone, medal, and donuts
additional: The 5 km races are divided by target finish times to prevent lapping. A limited edition of event performance shirts is available to order only when registering. The Elite Mile for women and men, as well as the REHACARE Inclusion ½ Mile, are invitation-only races. Late registration is available until race day for an additional fee, subject to the participant limit. Officially measured, certified circuit; various race categories; personalized race bibs for registrations through August 30, 2026; event shirts available for purchase; race packs can be collected on September 4 and 5, 2026; shipping options available during registration.

name: Schapener Volkslauf
description: The Schapen Fun Run offers runners and walkers a choice of distances in a natural setting around the village of Schapen and the Riddagshausen ponds. The routes pass through idyllic woodland and pond areas, as well as historic places such as Schapen railway station. The 1.2 km route is especially family-friendly and is intended mainly for children and young people, accompanied by their families. The event features a group warm-up, childcare and massages in exchange for a donation, and warmly welcomes everyone who enjoys running.
course_highlights: The 10.5 km route loops around the Riddagshausen ponds and passes through Buchhorst
The 6.1 km route passes Schäfer’s Ruh and historic Schapen railway station
The 1.2 km route is for children and young people and can be completed once or twice
additional: Start times vary by distance, from 9:15 a.m. to 10:20 a.m. There is a group warm-up, childcare and massages in exchange for a donation. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 1921 Schapen e.V. The event takes place in September 2026 and includes various running and walking distances, as well as activities such as a warm-up, childcare and massages.

name: Sparkassen-Stadtlauf
description: The 20th Sparkassen City Run in Wachtendonk takes place on September 6, 2026, transforming the municipality into a lively running arena. The event welcomes all ages and ability levels, from ambitious runners and recreational joggers to families. The races start at 2:00 p.m. at Friedensplatz, accompanied by an exhilarating atmosphere, a varied supporting program, and dedicated volunteers. The run offers outstanding athletic performances and personal achievements in a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: A variety of races for all ages and ability levels
Start and finish at Friedensplatz in Wachtendonk
An exhilarating atmosphere along the course and a varied supporting program
additional: Registration is easy via the registration button on the website. The event is being held under the leadership and organization of the Municipality of Wachtendonk for the first time. A varied supporting program and dedicated volunteers help create a special atmosphere. Races for all ages and ability levels, online registration, supporting program, at Friedensplatz

name: Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 6,00 € für Kinder & Jugendliche bis einschl. Jahrgang 2008

description: The Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg is a long-standing running event taking place on September 6, 2026, in Pinneberg. The event offers various distances for children, young people, and adults, including a 1 km fun run for kindergarten children, a 2.5 km beginners’ and team race, and 5 km and 10 km courses for older participants. The races follow green loop courses through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark, with the start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark. The event is family-friendly, and spectators can watch and cheer on the children throughout the fun run.
course_highlights: Green loop course through Pinneberger Fahlt and around Drosteipark
Children’s fun run with 2 laps around Drosteipark
Start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark
additional: Race packs (bib numbers including transponders) will be distributed at the VfL-Sportzentrum Fahltskamp on 04.09.2026 from 09:00-19:00 and on 05.09.2026 from 09:00-16:00. Late entries are possible online until one hour before the start for an additional fee of €5.00. The team classification is based on 3 runners, whose individual times are added together; mixed teams are allowed. Online registration is available; bib number pickup is on September 4 and 5 at the VfL-Sportzentrum; late entries are subject to a fee; the start and finish area is at Drosteiwiese.

name: Geithainer Herbstlauf
description: The Geithain Autumn Run is a family-friendly autumn race held at the Geithain Stadium in Geithain, Germany. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a 300 m Bambini Run, a 2.5 km Chestnut Run for children, a 7 km Fun Run, a 7 km walking route, and a 17 km scenic run for older participants and walkers. The start and finish are at the stadium, and the courses are GPS-measured and approved by the German Athletics Association. In addition to the races, there is a children’s programme, a bouncy castle, certificates, medals and small prizes. Every fifth finisher in races of 7 km or longer is rewarded with a bottle of sparkling wine.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Geithain Stadium
GPS-measured courses ranging from 0.3 km to 17 km
Family-friendly programme with children’s races and walking routes
additional: Every fifth finisher in the 7 km races or longer receives a bottle of sparkling wine. The event is organised by Impact Geithain e. V., with support from FSV Alemannia Geithain e. V. The children’s programme and bouncy castle are part of the event. The event includes children’s races, childcare, certificates, finisher medals, small prizes for children and a special bonus: every fifth finisher in the longer races receives a bottle of sparkling wine.

name: Brunsberglauf

name: 10. Parchener Fiener-Cross
description: The Parchener Fiener-Cross is a traditional cross-country race in the Jerichower Land district and part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP running series in northern Saxony-Anhalt. The event attracts numerous runners of all ages each year and offers additional competitions, including the Heidel Team Cup and a family category. The race takes place at the Klapperhalle on Parkstraße in Parchen and is known for its varied cross-country course. The event promotes running in the region and combines sporting competition with a sense of community.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in the Jerichower Land district
Start and finish at the Klapperhalle in Parchen
Part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP, with the Heidel Team Cup and a family category
additional: The event takes place near the Klapperhalle in Parchen, with refreshment stations and a family-friendly atmosphere. Registration is online, and results are published after the race.

name: 15. Brunsberglauf
location: Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für die 5 km-, 11,7 km- und 21,1 km-Strecke

description: The 15th Brunsberglauf on September 6, 2026, in Buchholz/Holm-Seppensen offers runners a varied program with main races over 11.7 km, a half marathon, and a 5 km family run. The routes pass through woodland and blooming heathland, with highlights including Höllenschlucht, Brunsberg, Mühlenteich, and Zwergentunnel. There are also four children’s races for different age groups. The whole family can enjoy an attractive program in the finish area. The Brunsberglauf is held under the motto “Run and do good” and supports charitable organizations in the region.
course_highlights: Routes through woodland and blooming heathland
Highlights: Höllenschlucht, Brunsberg, Mühlenteich, Zwergentunnel
Hill competition on Brunsberg and team competitions
additional: The timing transponder is loaned free of charge and must be worn around the ankle (a €40 fee applies if it is lost). There are water stations on the longer routes, and free drinks and refreshments at the finish. Team competitions are offered for the 5 km and 11.7 km races, with at least four runners per team. Award ceremonies take place immediately after the races. Dogs are not permitted on the routes. Changing rooms, showers, and sports-bag storage are available in the sports hall. Routes through woodland and heathland, children’s races, a program at the finish, donations to charitable causes

name: 23. Schoninger Volkslauf
description: The Schoninger Volkslauf is a long-established running event in the Solling, held annually by SC Schoningen 04. It offers runners of various ages and ability levels the opportunity to run on varied routes through the beautiful landscape around Schoningen. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and strong sense of community, promoting sport and togetherness. Every year, numerous runners take part to compete and enjoy a great running event together.
course_highlights: Running routes through the varied landscape of the Solling
Distances from 6 km to 11 km (historically documented)
Friendly atmosphere and strong community spirit at SC Schoningen 04
additional: The race traditionally takes place in September. It is organized by SC Schoningen 04, which also offers a broad sports program. There is no current online registration or pricing information on the website. The event usually starts at 10:00 a.m. In addition to the main races, the event offers children’s and family runs and is a regular fixture on the regional running calendar. Registration and detailed route information are available on the official website.

name: 37. CURREX Alsterlauf
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf is a traditional road race in Hamburg, held on a flat, traffic-free loop around the Inner and Outer Alster lakes. The event offers a unique start and finish atmosphere in central Hamburg and is one of Europe’s largest 10-kilometer road races. In addition to the 10 km main race, there are also 5 km races, a schoolchildren’s race, and the R5K Tour for young runners. The courses are officially measured and ideal for fast times.
course_highlights: Flat, traffic-free loop around the Inner and Outer Alster lakes
Start and finish on Ballindamm in central Hamburg
Courses officially measured in accordance with World Athletics/AIMS guidelines
additional: The start and finish of all races are on Ballindamm. The courses are flat, paved, and traffic-free. Every kilometer is marked with signs. A high-quality technical shirt is available to order online until 25 August 2026 and will be distributed on event weekend. The Hamburg 10 km Road Championships are held as part of the Alsterlauf. The event takes place in Hamburg and attracts around 5,400 participants each year, with support from new title partner CURREX, including charity and hotel partnerships, results, photos, and health checks.

name: 38. Volkslauf des TSV Breuna
location: Lauf- und Wanderpark Breuna, Breuna, Waldeck-Frankenberg, Hesse, Germany
description: The 38th Breuna Malsburg Run takes place on September 6, 2026, and is a traditional running event in the Breuna Running and Hiking Park. The run offers an attractive course through the beautiful natural surroundings of Breuna and is open to runners of all ages. The event is organized by TSV Breuna e.V. and is part of the Nordhessencup. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.
course_highlights: The Breuna Running and Hiking Park provides a scenic setting
A variety of courses for different age and ability groups
A traditional event with a friendly atmosphere
additional: TSV Breuna athletics training times: Tuesday at 6:30 p.m., Thursday at 7:00 p.m., and children's training on Tuesday at 5:00 p.m. The meeting point is always at the sports field. All event details are available in the linked PDF race information. Race details are available in PDF race information; registration is via raceresult.com

name: 6. Tuchmacher Stadtlauf
description: The Tuchmacher City Run in Bramsche is a popular event with several distances that attracts numerous participants each year. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and varied route through the town centre. The 10 km main race is especially popular with competitive athletes, while the well-attended schoolchildren’s race creates a lively atmosphere. The Bramscher Rumläufer organise the race with great dedication, supported by local schools and sponsors.
course_highlights: Run through Bramsche town centre, with the streets closed to traffic
Temporary bridge over the Talbachgraben for a springy running experience
Three distances: 2.1 km schoolchildren’s race, 5 km and 10 km main races
additional: The schoolchildren’s race regularly attracts large numbers of participants, supported by the commitment of Bramsche’s schools. The event is backed by a large team of volunteers and sponsors. The Bramscher Rumläufer offer regular training runs and a motivating running community in the region. Part of the Sparkassen Cup; includes a schoolchildren’s race; community atmosphere; no late registration possible.

name: Bahndammlauf
description: The Buchholz Bahndammlauf is a varied running event that combines nature and good food. The route starts at the stadium and follows the railway embankment through the districts of Wahl and Wallau to the Franziskuskreuz, with a challenging climb to Mückensee, the highest point on the course. From there, the route continues mostly downhill or on level ground to Asbach-Walgenbach, with several drink stations along the way. The event takes place at the SV Buchholz 05 sports ground and, alongside the race, offers an extensive cake buffet and savoury food from the Grillhexen. Participation supports the Förderkreis für krebskranke Kinder und Jugendliche Bonn e.V.
course_highlights: Route with a gentle climb through Wahl and Wallau
800 m climb to the highest point at Mückensee
Several drink stations along the route
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until 45 minutes before the start for an additional fee of €5. Race materials can be collected from 07:30 in the start and finish area. The event supports the Förderkreis für krebskranke Kinder und Jugendliche Bonn e.V. An awards ceremony takes place directly after each race, with trophies and certificates for the three top finishers. Free parking is available at the nearby REWE car park. Terms and conditions, course profiles, childcare, registration via RaceResult, results and certificates are available online; donations go to children with cancer.

name: Breunaer Volkslauf mit 21,1km Malsburglauf
description: The 38th Breunaer Malsburglauf takes place on September 6, 2026, and is an established running event in Breuna. The race runs through the Breuna Running and Hiking Park and offers an attractive course for runners. The event is organized by TSV Breuna e.V. and welcomes runners of various ages and ability levels. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.
course_highlights: Race through the Breuna Running and Hiking Park
Attractive course in scenic surroundings
Traditional event with a long history
additional: TSV Breuna Athletics training sessions are on Tuesdays at 6:30 p.m. and Thursdays at 7:00 p.m.; children’s training is on Tuesdays at 5:00 p.m. The meeting point is always at the sports field. Full details about the race are available in the linked PDF race information documents. The event offers water stations, refreshments on site, showers, and changing facilities. Certificates, trophies, and prizes are awarded for the various competitions, including team classifications in the half marathon. Children receive certificates of participation, and local refreshments including coffee, cake, and grilled food are available after the race.

name: Gölitztallauf
description: The Gölitztallauf is an annual running event in Marktgölitz, celebrating its 44th edition on September 6, 2026. The event offers four different distances, including a 1 km children’s race. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and awards in various age groups. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races to keep participants’ waiting time to a minimum.
course_highlights: Four different distances, including a 1 km children’s race
Start and finish at the Marktgölitz outdoor swimming pool
A scenic route through the Gölitztal
additional: Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races to minimize waiting times. Durable race bibs are used. The organization has been adjusted to make race-bib distribution and payment more efficient. The event is part of the Sparkassen-Cup and the TLV-Cup. It is also part of the TLV running cup, with detailed route information and online registration available. The event takes place in warm weather, with refreshments and award ceremonies on site.

name: R5K - 5K Alsterlauf Hamburg 2026
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf Hamburg is a long-established running event with officially measured, flat, paved circuit courses along the Outer Alster and on Ballindamm. The event offers various distances, including 10 km, 5 km and schoolchildren’s races, and is open to runners of different age groups. The races are held on traffic-free courses and are safely supervised by police and marshals. The Hamburg 10 km Road Championships are also held as part of the Alsterlauf.
course_highlights: Flat, paved circuit courses along the Outer Alster and on Ballindamm
Courses officially measured in accordance with World Athletics/AIMS guidelines
Traffic-free course with kilometre markers and safety supervision
additional: The start and finish of all races are on Ballindamm. The 5 km course closes at 12:15. Eligibility is based on year of birth, with a minimum performance of 22:00 minutes for R5K. A technical T-shirt can be ordered online until 25 August 2026; collection is only available during event weekend, with no postal delivery. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, with fixed start times and official timing. It offers a great opportunity to experience Hamburg through sport and enjoy close-up views of the Alster.

name: Stadtallendorfer Stadtlauf
description: The Stadtallendorf City Run takes place as part of the Heimat- und Soldatenfest in Stadtallendorf and is organized by TSV Stadtallendorf in cooperation with the German Armed Forces. The course is a loop through Heinz-Lang-Park and the adjacent stadium. Races are offered for different ability levels, including a 5-kilometer fun run and a 10-kilometer main race. Youth and children’s events follow. The run attracts numerous athletes and offers a sporting challenge in a friendly, festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop through Heinz-Lang-Park
Course runs through the neighboring stadium
Races for all ability levels, from children to seniors
additional: The run is part of Stadtallendorf’s Heimat- und Soldatenfest. Separate races are held for the fun run (5 km), main race (10 km), youth, and children. The event is held in cooperation with the German Armed Forces. Participants start in new race shirts donated by KHS. Distances: 5 km and 10 km; start location: Stadtallendorf; average September weather: 19°C, cloudy

name: Stadtwerke Halbmarathon Bochum
price_range: 25 Euro für Finisher-Shirt, weitere Gebühren variieren

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Stadtwerke Halbmarathon Bochum bei Meldung bis 30.06.2026 - 45 €

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Stadtwerke Halbmarathon Bochum bei Meldung bis 26.08.2026 - 55 €

description: The Stadtwerke Bochum Half Marathon 2026 is a traditional race that takes runners through Bochum city centre. The course consists of an opening loop and three large loops, with around 150 metres of elevation gain, making it varied and challenging. In addition to the half marathon, there are relay races, a 10 km race, a 5 km race, a schoolchildren’s race and a Bambini race. The event also offers an extensive supporting programme and a training group starting in May 2026.
course_highlights: Half marathon course with approx. 150 metres of elevation gain
10 km race with approx. 50 metres of elevation gain over 2 loops
Courses measured to DLV standards
additional: Online registration opens on 01.02.2026. Late registration is available on 05.09.2026 (16:00–19:00) and on race day until 60 minutes before the start, for a fee and subject to availability. A finisher shirt can be pre-ordered for 25 euros and collected on race day. Cancellations and refunds are not possible, but transfers are permitted for a fee. The training group starts on 12 May 2026. Registration opens on 1 February 2026 and closes on 26 August 2026; options are available for a shirt, transfer and changes; no refunds; event in Bochum-Mitte.

name: Wardenburger Sommerlauf
location: IGS am Everkamp, Wardenburg, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wardenburg Summer Run is a long-standing race by runners, for runners, held at the IGS am Everkamp in Wardenburg. A range of distances starting at 5 kilometres is offered, including a 5 km fun run, a 10 km public run and a 10-mile run. The races feature varied courses, with the split between the 10 km and 10-mile routes at Tillysee serving as an important landmark. The event emphasizes fair and well-organized race management, with chip timing, and also offers special races for children.
course_highlights: The 10 km and 10-mile runners start together and continue together until the split at Tillysee
Varied routes from 5 km, with Komoot links for detailed course maps
At Tillyhügel, 10 km runners turn right and 10-mile runners turn left
additional: No changes to entries or race-day registrations are possible on the day of the event. Bibs have an integrated timing chip and must be worn visibly. Runners with baby joggers are asked to line up at the back of the start. Running with dogs is not permitted. The Bambini run has no bibs or timing. Bibs must be returned in the finish area; a €5 fee will be charged if they are not returned. The time limit for runners is 16:00. Toilets are available on site. The event takes place on 5 September 2026 at the IGS am Everkamp in Wardenburg. There are various race categories, chip timing via race bibs, no race-day registration, and facilities including toilets, changing rooms and showers.

name: Dörverden läuft 2026
description: The run in Dörverden is a versatile running event suitable for all ages and ability levels. The measured courses range from 1.8 km for walking, running and Nordic walking to the 10 km main race, which consists of two 5 km laps. The event offers a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere and promotes community sport in the region of Lower Saxony. Races start in staggered waves from 10:00, so every participant can find a suitable event.
course_highlights: Measured courses from 1.8 km to 10 km
10 km main race consisting of two 5 km laps
Separate events for walking, running and Nordic walking
additional: Four events with start times between 10:00 and 11:25. All courses are measured. The event welcomes everyone, from walkers and Nordic walkers to experienced runners. It is organised by TSV Dörverden von 1908 e.V. The event starts in the morning from 10:00; the courses are measured, and registration is online via the organiser’s website. It attracts around 300 to 500 participants and offers a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Glomb City Marathon Bremerhaven
description: The GLOMB City Marathon Bremerhaven is an annual marathon in Bremerhaven that has been held since 2005. In addition to the marathon, the event includes a half marathon and a 10 km race. The course is a flat loop starting and finishing in front of the Bürgermeister-Smidt Memorial Church, and runs through the city centre and Havenwelten. Runners enjoy an attractive route with many sights and a unique waterfront and harbour backdrop. The event is organised by the event agency Execute Sports Events, which ensures professional organisation.
course_highlights: Flat loop through Bremerhaven city centre and Havenwelten
Start and finish in front of the Bürgermeister-Smidt Memorial Church
The course runs along the waterfront and harbour basin, past Klimahaus and the U-boat Wilhelm Bauer
additional: Timing is fully electronic, using a transponder integrated into the race bib that can be disposed of after the race. Group registrations are available with a 10% team discount for groups of 10 or more (register via info@execute-sports.de). Event shirts can be ordered with a binding commitment and are handed out when race packs are collected. The course is known as the Haven-City Run and offers spectators short distances and good views of the runners. The event also includes a sports and business fair, as well as corporate and public-sector races. September weather is generally mild, around 19°C, and mostly cloudy. The course is known for being flat and is ideal for fast times.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is Poland’s oldest continuously held 10-kilometre road race, taking place in Gdańsk. The race starts at the historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The course is certified and marked at every kilometre, and the finish is at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, providing an added attraction for participants. The event draws up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Defenders of the Coast in 1939.
course_highlights: Certified course marked every 1 km
An opportunity to run through the Tunnel under the Dead Vistula, which is normally closed to pedestrian traffic
Finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, a modern football stadium
additional: Race bib collection at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk on 6–7 September 2026. Water station on the course at approximately 6 km. Participant limit: 5,000. Free buses will take runners to the start on race day. Bag drop available with a race bib sticker. No showers. The awards ceremony will take place at the finish at approximately 11:45. Cash prizes and trophies for the winners in the OPEN and age-group categories. Registration runs from 2026-03-02 to 2026-08-20, with a limit of 4,900 participants. Official T-shirts can be purchased at the Expo. The event includes race-pack collection, the Expo, transport, the start, and the awards ceremony at Westerplatte.

name: VII Bieg o Puchar Wójta Gminy Zblewo
location: Twardy Dół, Zblewo, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: X Bieg Neptuna
location: Trzebież, Police County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: Rondje Oude IJsselstreek

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De kosten per team bedragen € 60,00. Inschrijven kan t/m vrijdag 3 september 2027.

description: The Rondje Oude IJsselstreek is an annual relay race organized by athletics club Atletico’73, in which teams of seven runners cover distances between 4 and 7 kilometers. The start and finish are at the Atletico'73 athletics track in Gendringen. The route passes through a beautiful green setting and several villages in the municipality of Oude IJsselstreek. Participants enjoy the event as a fun, sporty activity to share with their teammates.
course_highlights: 7 stages of between 4 and 7 kilometers through a green setting
Routes through the villages of Ulft, Silvolde, Westendorp, Sinderen and Voorst
A mix of paved and unpaved roads and paths, sometimes with loose sand
additional: Teams consist of 7 people, with at least 1 woman and 1 man. There are two start waves, with the slower wave starting first. Bonus and penalty minutes are awarded based on the team’s gender mix and speed. Prizes are awarded to the fastest team, the last team, and teams that finish in specific places. Cycling routes are available to reach the relay points without crossing the running routes. Untrained runners and participants under 14 are advised not to take part. 7 distances between 4 and 7 km, course on paved and unpaved roads, start and finish at the Atletico’73 Gendringen athletics track

name: Blodomloppet Eskilstuna
description: Blodomloppet in Eskilstuna takes place on 7 September 2026 and is organised by Eskilstuna Friidrott. The event offers women’s and men’s 5 km and 10 km races, as well as Lilla Blodomloppet and Specialomloppet. The courses are described as fast and flat. The event is held in Stadsparken and combines recreational running with the aim of raising awareness of blood donation, including through a donor gift and a picnic tradition. Information and event details are published on the event page, and participants can register individually or as a team.
course_highlights: A fast, flat course with very little elevation change
The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured
The start and event area are in Stadsparken
additional: Participants can register individually or as a team (maximum 5 people per team); members of the same team can take part in different distances. For larger registrations, an Excel template can be downloaded from the registration page, and the organiser can help set up a customer page or discount code for companies with more than 20 participants. Blood donor gifts are distributed at the Unilabs blood donor centre tent in the event area. Bag storage/drop-off is available (drop-off and collection are listed as 17:00–20:00). Course distances: 5 km and 10 km. Lilla Blodomloppet is 800 m. The event area includes bag drop and a picnic bag; participants can register individually or as a team (maximum 5 people per team).

name: Skärblackaloppet 2026
location: Folkets Hus i Skärblacka, Skärblacka, Östergötland, Sweden

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Early Bird, 250 kr, fram till och med 30 april 23:59.

description: Skärblackaloppet is an annual fun run in Skärblacka, offering a festival atmosphere for runners and spectators. The main race is 6 km through the town, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus. There is also a 4 km walking class and a 900 m Little Children’s Race. The race is open to all levels and features generous prizes, lotteries and goodie bags for participants. Organisers Frida Södermark and Stefan Fransson warmly welcome everyone to the starting line on 9 September 2026.
course_highlights: 6 km through Skärblacka, starting and finishing at Folkets Hus
The course includes asphalt, cycle paths, gravel and some trails
4 km walking class (shortened course) and 900 m Little Children’s Race near Parkskolan
additional: Start and finish at Folkets Hus in Skärblacka. Race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka on Tuesday 8 September, 11:00–18:00; any remaining race numbers will be handed out at Folkets Hus no later than one hour before the start. Late entries are available when collecting race numbers. All participants receive a goodie bag; prizes, a sprint prize and lotteries are offered (including a tyre prize and course-record bonus). The walking class was introduced in 2024; race numbers can be collected at ICA Supermarket in Skärblacka; registration is via raceid; late registration is available on race day from 15:30; payment is accepted only by Swish or cash; a chip in the race number records the time; medical care, food and drink are available on site.

name: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run
location: Gripholms Slott, Mariefred, Strängnäs Municipality, Södermanland County, Sweden
distance_verbose: 100 miles, 100 km, 50 km, Halvmarathon, 8 km, 2 km
description: Sörmlands 100 Trail Run is a multi-day event (11–13 September 2026) through the scenic and biologically rich landscapes of Sörmland, with distances ranging from approximately 8 km to 100 miles. The routes follow technical singletrack, coastal trails and faster sections, and suit both experienced ultrarunners and recreational runners, depending on the distance chosen. The event focuses on the trail-running experience, with local food, talks and a friendly, inclusive atmosphere. The organisers offer GPS tracking, GPX files and aid-station support for a memorable weekend in Sörmland.
course_highlights: A route featuring forest trails and coastal cliffs along the Sörmlandsleden
Approximately 300 metres of elevation gain (22 km) and technical singletrack
Terrain: approximately 85% trail, 10% gravel and 5% asphalt
additional: GPX files are available to download; live GPS tracking and intermediate and final results are provided. The event is cupless—bring your own cup. Longer distances include a buff, live tracking, GPX, a window decal and a handmade wooden finisher’s medal or belt buckle, depending on the distance. Detailed mandatory kit lists apply to the 100 km and 100-mile distances (including 1 litre of fluids, a mobile phone, navigation tools, a first-aid kit, a map, a GPS tracker, an emergency blanket, a rain jacket and a headlamp). Early cut-offs and aid-station locations have been published; the organiser plans shuttle buses from Nävekvarn Camping to Nyköping (approximately 100 SEK, payable via Swish on site). A Night Trail and a 2 km children’s race are included; start and finish locations include Gripholms Slott in Mariefred and Nävekvarns Folkets Park. Bus transfers and GPX routes are included in the information for various distances.

name: Bergisch Gladbacher Stadtlauf
organizer: SV Blau-Weiß Hand e.V., Stadt Bergisch Gladbach
price_range: Hauptlauf: 11-23 Euro, Erlebnislauf: 9-13 Euro, Gruppenrabatte verfügbar
description: The Bergisch Gladbach City Run is a long-standing running event that has taken place annually since 1996. On September 11, 2026, around 1,000 running enthusiasts will start at 6:30 p.m. on Konrad-Adenauer-Platz in the car-free city center. The event includes an untimed fun run and a main race with rankings in various age groups. The event is accompanied by a colorful program of music, food, and drinks, adding to the atmosphere of the city and culture festival.
course_highlights: Run through the car-free city center of Bergisch Gladbach
Start and finish on Konrad-Adenauer-Platz in the city center
Traditional opening event of the city and culture festival
additional: Late registration for both races is available on September 12, 2025, from 4 p.m. The fun run is untimed and has no age-group categories. The main race includes rankings for all age groups, from birth year 2014 onward, in accordance with the 2025 German Athletics Regulations. Certificates for all participants are available online. The awards ceremony is at around 9 p.m. Special awards go to the largest registered group and the youngest and oldest participants. Distances: 3 km and 9 km; online registration; timing with a MikaTag transponder; program includes music and food.

name: Bergneustädter AggerEnergie- und Sparkassen Nachtlauf
location: Bergneustadt, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bergneustädter AggerEnergie- und Sparkassen Nachtlauf is an evening running event in Bergneustadt, Germany, held on a Friday after nightfall. The program offers several running and walking options, including a flat 3.7 km course, a 5.4 km relay, a 5.4 km run, and a 10 km run. All races start and finish at the same locations, making the event family-friendly and easy to follow. Children’s and youth competitions round out the program, making the evening appealing to local clubs, young runners, walkers, relay teams, and adults looking for a short but intensive evening run.
course_highlights: Flat 3.7 km course as a gentler option
Hilly 5.4 km and 10 km courses
Shared start and finish area for all races
additional: The event takes place on Friday evening after nightfall. It is designed to be compact, making it easy for families and supporters to follow. Typical September weather is around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night, usually cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Family-friendly; children’s and youth competitions; September event with typical weather of around 19 °C high, 10 °C low, and 45 mm of precipitation.

name: Int. ENNI Citylauf Xanten
price_range: 40 Euro (5 km und 10 km), 25 Euro (Jahrgang 2010-2013 5 km), plus Pfand
description: The 31st Int. ENNI Citylauf Xanten takes place on September 11, 2026, in Xanten and offers races over 1.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km. The event is an established running event in the city of Xanten and is open to runners of all ability levels. The race takes place in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. The course runs through the city and offers varied scenery.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Course through the city of Xanten
Typical September weather with mild temperatures and cloudy skies
additional: Please check the event details with the organizer before registering. Races in Moers, Sonsbeck, Neukirchen-Vluyn, and Xanten; registration until March 2026; T-shirt included; rankings based on gun times

name: SportScheck RUN Köln
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The SportScheck Run Cologne is an atmospheric night run that gives runners the opportunity to experience Cologne after dark. Participants traditionally start on the Rhine Boulevard and run either 5 km or 10 km through the city center, passing historic landmarks such as the City Hall and enjoying an impressive view of Cologne Cathedral illuminated at night. The event is part of Germany’s largest and longest-running city race series and offers an unforgettable atmosphere, with refreshments at the finish and a finisher’s medal.
course_highlights: 5 km loop along the Rhine Boulevard between Hohenzollern Bridge and Deutz Bridge
Run past the historic City Hall, dating from 1330
Breathtaking view of Cologne Cathedral illuminated at night
additional: Children can take part in the 1 km DAK Kids Run. The 5 km course can be run once or twice (for 10 km). Finish-line refreshments and a finisher’s medal are included. Training plans are available to help participants prepare. The course runs between Hohenzollern Bridge and Deutz Bridge, with the start on the Rhine Boulevard. Night run; children’s and family runs included.

name: Emder Sparkassen Delftlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bei der Onlinemeldung bis zum 10. September 2026 pro Teilnehmer*In 8,00 Euro

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bei der Onlinemeldung bis zum 10. September 2026 pro Teilnehmer*In 8,00 Euro

description: The Emder Sparkassen Delftlauf takes place on September 11, 2026, at Hafentor in Emden and is organized by Emder Laufgemeinschaft e.V. The event offers 6-kilometer and 10-kilometer runs, as well as 6-kilometer walking/Nordic walking. The course runs through the city of Emden and is held in accordance with the International Competition Rules. Timing is done with a chip provided by the organizer, and certificates are awarded to the three fastest women and men. The race is open to everyone, including unaffiliated participants.
course_highlights: 6-kilometer run (3 laps) and 10-kilometer run (5 laps)
6-kilometer walking/Nordic walking
Course at Hafentor in Emden with an urban character
additional: Race materials can be collected from 16:00. Timing is done with a chip provided by the organizer, with results based on gun time. The organizer would appreciate the return of race numbers after the event. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Event held in all weather conditions, open to everyone, chip timing, age groups, award ceremonies, start and finish at Hafentor

name: Lauf der Bildung Aschersleben
description: The Lauf der Bildung in Aschersleben is a family-friendly city run on Friday evening, starting and finishing at Augustapromenade. The route passes through the historic town-wall area and offers distances of 2.3 km, 4.6 km and 9.2 km for children, recreational runners and ambitious runners completing multiple laps. The event is part of the Solvay Cup and attracts both club runners and local families. The atmosphere is small-scale and family-oriented, and the event is well organised by Kreisvolkshochschule Aschersleben.
course_highlights: 2.3 km loop through Aschersleben’s historic town-wall area
Varied surfaces add variety, even on the shortest distance
The longer distances consist of multiple laps of the 2.3 km course
additional: Start and finish at Augustapromenade, next to Kreisvolkshochschule and Kreismusikschule. The event takes place on Friday evening and is family-friendly. Around 260 participants, including club runners competing for Solvay Cup points. A sprint finish decided the women’s 9.2 km race. The event offers several running distances, is part of the Solvay Cup, and attracts club runners, families and running enthusiasts. The route runs along the historic town wall and is known for its varied surfaces.

name: Halvmaraton Den Genfundne Bro Special 2027 RUN
MOSSARUN
description: Mossarun is a small, welcoming charity race in southern Sweden, focused on technical singletrack and community rather than prize money. The main format is a 17 km loop used for the 24-hour ultra; there are also 51 km and a children’s race. The course is technical and hilly, with many short, steep climbs and mostly singletrack. The organizers emphasize simplicity and sustainability, and a large portion of the entry fee goes to charity.
course_highlights: 17 km loop — used for the 24-hour ultra (51 km = 3 laps)
Approximately 500 m of elevation gain per lap (according to barometric watches)
90% singletrack, 10% gravel; technical terrain with many short hills
additional: Accommodation: you can sleep in the barn (20–30 places) or camp on site; social activities before and after the race include a campfire and BBQ/pizza. Wood-fired pizza is sold (100–120 kr, 13:00–15:00). 24-hour runners pass the base camp every lap; there are special features for the 24-hour race ("chainsaw segment") — see the race rules. The cut-off for the 24-hour ultra is stated as Sunday 6.09.2026. The event provides separate toilets/changing rooms and access to menstrual products; support is available to help find a night-running buddy for dark laps. Swish donations to WAR Child: 900 55 47 (write "mossarun"); alternatively, donate via the respective NGO’s website. Registration requires proof of a donation to War Child or another NGO; the event offers several distances and a child-friendly course.

name: Bysjöloppet
description: Bysjöloppet is a popular race by Lake Bysjön in Åtvidaberg, organised by Åtvidabergs IF since 1983. The courses combine asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails, with the start and finish at Edbergavallen. There are distances for both children and adults. The race is traditionally held on the second Saturday in September and welcomes recreational runners, competitive runners and teams alike.
course_highlights: Mixed surfaces: asphalt, gravel roads and forest trails along Lake Bysjön
Start and finish at Edbergavallen
The 10 km course includes a hilly trail section (the illuminated trail in Humpa) and is more challenging
additional: Register via the link to the registration system; payment by Swish or bank giro (discount codes may be available online). Race bibs can be collected from 10:00 on race day at Edbergavallen; on-site late registration is available from 10:00 (payment by Swish or exact cash). Distance information: 700 m (children, untimed), 1.3 km (children, timed), 5 km (measured 5.0 km, mixed asphalt/gravel) and 10 km (measured 10.0 km, mixed asphalt/trail/gravel, hilly). All finishers receive a medal; a special commemorative medal is awarded for completing the race for the 10th or 20th time (adult categories). Team registration (4–6 participants) includes a picnic bag intended for 5 people; team registration may close on 7 September if the bags run out. There is a kiosk at the event site. The prize ceremonies are at approximately 12:00 for the 1.3 km and approximately 14:00 for the 5 km and 10 km. Distances: 1.3 km, 5 km and 10 km; all finishers receive a medal; adult categories can earn an extra commemorative medal for their 10th or 20th race; team registration is for 4–6 participants; race bib collection at Edbergavallen; an ICA picnic bag after the finish; kiosks at the event site; prize ceremonies according to the prize table. Preparatory activities include a running workshop and open group interval training before the race.

name: Norasjön Runt
description: Norasjön Runt is a scenic half marathon around Lake Nora in Nora, organised by IFK Nora since 1929. The race is held annually in early September and has historically been an important race in the Södra Svealand district, with DM/VDM status according to the district invitation. The route passes through varied scenery around the lake, including open fields, forests and streams, offering a course suited to both competitive runners and recreational runners. The race has a long tradition and is a popular part of the region’s running events.
course_highlights: Norasjön Runt — a half marathon around the lake
Varied scenery along the course, with open fields, forests and streams
DM/VDM status in the Södra Svealand district and part of Södra Svealands Löparie
additional: 71st edition (2025) and 96 years since the race began; the distance is a half marathon, and the event is associated with the DM/VDM district of Södra Svealand.

name: Hagenloppet
description: Hagenloppet is an established cross-country race organised by IF Hagen on scenic Billingen in Skövde. The race offers a spectator-friendly 4.4 km course, run once or twice, along with a separate youth category and a children’s race for the youngest participants. The event has a long tradition and recently celebrated its 50th edition, with a focus on forest trails and the joy of running. Welcoming to both runners and spectators.
course_highlights: Scenic Billingen in Skövde
Spectator-friendly 4.4 km course, run once or twice (8.8 km)
Youth categories over 2.5 km and a special children’s race for the youngest participants
additional: Registration is via Race-ID, according to the invitation; the race information sheet (preliminary) is published ahead of the race. Late registration is permitted on site, approximately 45 minutes before the start (according to a previous information sheet). Results are published under Documents/Results (listed as Raceresult for previous years). The text mentions the 50th edition of Hagenloppet; the race takes place at Billingen in Skövde.

name: Gränna StadsTrail
description: Gränna StadsTrail is a welcoming trail race offered over 5, 10 and 21 km, starting and finishing at Gränna Square. The courses combine fast-running asphalt with winding trails through beech and coniferous forests, offering magnificent views of Lake Vättern and Grännaberget. The race is designed to be as much about the experience as the performance, and is suitable for both recreational and more experienced runners. All participants receive timing and a unique medal at the finish.
course_highlights: 5 km: mostly asphalt, finishing with a descent down Grännaberget on a winding trail
10 km: a mix of asphalt and trail, with views along Lake Vättern and Grännaberget
21 km: winding trails through beech forest, gravel roads and challenging hills, with magnificent views
additional: A mass start from the square takes runners through Gränna to the harbour, where timing begins; timing on all distances; a unique medal for all participants; the event venue and finish area are in the centre of Gränna, close to cafés, restaurants and accommodation; the courses may be changed depending on conditions and permits. Timing on all distances. Start and finish at Gränna Square. Distances: 5, 10 and 21 km. The courses may change depending on conditions and permits.

name: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra
description: Bocksten Vineyard Backyard Ultra is a Backyard Ultra race held at Ästad Vineyard in Varberg. The race follows a 6.7 km loop that starts every full hour; the first start is at 09:00, and everyone who finishes in time starts the next loop until only one runner remains. The course consists of gravel and grass and offers views of vineyards and lakes. The organizer emphasizes that places are limited (200) and that participants take part at their own risk.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop (gravel and grass)
Views of vineyards and lakes along most of the loop
Starts every full hour (Backyard Ultra format), first start at 09:00
additional: Bib distribution/registration takes place in the start area in the morning (listed as 07:30–08:45 / 07:45–08:45 in the information). Mandatory equipment: headlamp and personal medication (the headlamp must be used between 20:00 and 07:00). Participants must bring their own cup (no disposable cups are provided). The start/finish and race area are at Ästad Vineyard’s staff car park near the high ropes course; places are limited to 200 participants and participation is at your own risk. Maximum 200 participants; registration 07:30–08:45; headlamp mandatory 20:00–07:00; own cup mandatory; Tailwind drinks; meals at scheduled times; signs and guidance on site; take care at crossings and follow instructions.

name: Nybro Backyard 12h
organizer: Nybro Skidklubb & Topp och Dröm HB
description: Topp & Dröm organizes Nybro Backyard 12h as part of its annual race program in Nybro. The race is a 12-hour Backyard format that welcomes runners seeking an ultra challenge at a social and inclusive event. The organizer emphasizes exercise, community, and enjoyment of nature, and also offers rentals and personal training in Nybro. Contact details for Topp & Dröm are available on its website.
course_highlights: 12-hour Backyard format
Organized in Nybro by Topp & Dröm
The organizer focuses on exercise, community, and enjoyment of nature
additional: Organizer: Topp och Dröm HB, Sommargatan 17, 382 38 Nybro. Organization number: 969796-6407. Contact email: info@toppochdrom.se. Swish payment number: 123 698 89 01. Topp & Dröm also offers ski rentals (roller-ski and cross-country ski packages) and personal training in Nybro. The race features a 6,706 m loop, starts every full hour, and has changing rooms and showers nearby; parking is available at the stadium, and camping and motorhome pitches are available through Nybro Camping. Registration is via Mittlopp, and race bibs can be collected from 06:30 to 07:45 on race day.

name: Södra änggårdsloppet
location: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Södra Änggården, Göteborg, Sweden
description: Södra Änggårdsloppet is an inviting trail race in Södra Änggården, held for the third year. The course is approximately 8 km long with around 310 metres of elevation gain and runs through Änggårdsbergen. Participants are divided into groups so that both competitive runners and recreational runners feel comfortable. The event has a festive atmosphere, with smoke fireworks, food trucks, a DJ, and a medal and drink for participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 8 km trail race
Around 310 metres of elevation gain through Änggårdsbergen
The course follows forest trails in Södra Änggården
additional: Participants are divided into groups/waves. The event has a festive atmosphere with smoke fireworks, food trucks, and a DJ. The participant package includes a nice medal, sparkling wine at check-in, and non-alcoholic beer at the finish. The event time is listed as Saturday 12:00–16:00. The organiser is listed as WAI AB (contact: Byhrviktor@gmail.com), and Trailrunning Sweden AB is listed as the contact/organiser portal (info@trailrunningsweden.se). 8 km trail race through Änggårdsbergen with around 310 metres of elevation gain; participants are divided into groups; festival atmosphere with smoke fireworks, food trucks, and a DJ; medal, sparkling wine at check-in, and non-alcoholic beer at the finish; register via the link below.

name: Innovationsstafetten
organizer: IFK Lund Friidrott; Ideon Science Park; Medicon Village
description: Innovationsstafetten is a team relay held in the Brunnshög and Ideon areas in north-eastern Lund. The start, finish and relay exchange area are in Nobelparken, and the course winds north towards ESS and through Kunskapsparken before returning to Nobelparken. Teams compete in women’s, men’s or mixed categories, and each runner covers approximately 5 km. The event is organised in collaboration with IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park and Medicon Village. It is well suited to companies, student teams and families, alongside Nobelloppet and Brunnshögskalaset.
course_highlights: The course passes through Nobelparken and Kunskapsparken and heads towards ESS/Max IV
A relatively flat course with approximately 10 metres of elevation change
A mix of gravel and asphalt, with views over north-western Lund from the hill
additional: Teams consist of 2–4 people (company pages state 2–4; some texts mention 4); each runner covers approximately 5 km. The first leg starts together at 14:00; subsequent exchange times depend on the team’s pace (there is no time limit). Changing facilities, storage for outerwear, and food and drink are available in Nobelparken; runners receive a medal or a sausage after finishing. Recommended transport: tram line 1 to Brunnshögstorget. Four-person teams; start, finish and relay exchange area in Nobelparken (Brunnshög); the course heads towards ESS and Kunskapsparken; late registration on 1 September; student pricing; a Mecenat card is mentioned for bib collection; organised in collaboration with IFK Lund Friidrott, Ideon Science Park and Medicon Village.

name: Volvo Tierparklauf
description: The Volvo Tierparklauf takes place on September 12 and 13, 2026, at Tierpark Berlin. It is especially family-friendly and suitable for beginner runners. The route leads through the zoo, past various animals such as monkeys and flamingos, creating a unique atmosphere. Participants and accompanying persons receive free admission. The event is part of the popular Berlin läuft! series and is known for its animal-themed atmosphere and comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: Route through Tierpark Berlin with views of monkeys, flamingos and other animals
Free admission to Tierpark Berlin for participants and accompanying persons
Running festival for the whole family at the event venue
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the shoe. Participants receive a comprehensive starter pack, with refreshment stations, toilets, an online certificate and free admission to the zoo. Groups of 15 or more receive a 10% discount and can collect their race materials together. Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start. Optional extras such as event shirts, medal engraving and HD finish-line videos can be booked. Free admission, run through Tierpark Berlin, family-friendly, route past animals

name: Freiberger Herbstlauf
location: Platz der Einheit, Freiberg, Saxony, Germany
description: The Freiberg Autumn Run is a traditional race through Freiberg’s municipal forest, starting at Platz der Einheit on September 12, 2026, from 10:00 a.m. The varied program offers races for the whole family, including Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, several running distances from 2 km to the half marathon, as well as a corporate relay and the Einfach?Mensch!Lauf. The varied routes pass through the surrounding forests and include some climbs, making the race especially appealing.
course_highlights: Route through Freiberg’s municipal forest
Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports facility
Varied routes with some climbs
additional: Events for the whole family, including Bambini and children’s races, Nordic walking, a corporate relay and a unicycle race. Various distances from 400 m to the half marathon. Start and finish at the Platz der Einheit sports facility. Multiple events, including the half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, children’s races, Nordic walking, a unicycle race and team competitions; the venue is the municipal forest and Platz der Einheit.

name: Nordhorner Meile
location: Nordhorn, Grafschaft Bentheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Nordhorner Meile is the largest running event in the County of Bentheim, with over 2,000 participants. The varied 5 km and 10 km courses run along the Verbindungskanal and through Nordhorn city centre, finishing at the Alte Kirche am Markt. Alongside competitive elite runners and recreational athletes, over 1,500 schoolchildren from the region also take part. The event is known for its lively atmosphere, with more than 3,000 spectators cheering on runners along the course.
course_highlights: Varied 5 km and 10 km courses
Route along the Verbindungskanal and through Nordhorn city centre
Finish at the Alte Kirche am Markt
additional: Online registration is available exclusively via the website. The event also includes school races and is part of the new Grafschafter running series. Over 3,000 spectators create a special atmosphere along the course. The event takes place on 12 September 2026 and offers a lively atmosphere in Nordhorn city centre. It is open to runners of all abilities, from recreational runners to competitive athletes.

name: 10-Teiche-Marathon
description: The 10-Ponds Marathon in Hahnenklee is a scenic marathon held in September as part of the HarzerWanderWochen. The route leads through the Upper Harz and gives runners the opportunity to experience the region’s natural scenery and numerous ponds. The event is part of a ten-day hiking programme featuring a variety of activities and live music. The marathon is a special challenge for runners who appreciate combining athletic achievement with enjoying nature.
course_highlights: Run through the Upper Harz with views of ten ponds
Part of the HarzerWanderWochen, featuring a varied hiking programme
Starts at 10:00 on 12 September 2026
additional: The marathon is part of a ten-day hiking programme featuring guided hikes, evening events with live music, and other activities. A limited-edition marathon T-shirt is available as a special souvenir. Trail and scenic run, various categories, athletically challenging, as part of the HarzerWanderWochen

name: 21. Citylauf
description: The GVG Citylauf Bedburg is a traditional running event taking place on 13 September 2026 in Bedburg’s traffic-free town centre. The event offers various distances for all age groups, from the Bambini run and children’s races to the 10 km main race. The races start and finish in the marketplace in front of the town hall, with routes through the town centre. The Citylauf is ideal for runners of all abilities and promotes physical activity in the community.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the marketplace in front of the town hall
Traffic-free routes through the town centre, featuring turnarounds and loops
10 km main race covering five complete laps through the town centre
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until one hour before the respective start, with a late-entry fee of €3.00 (the Bambini run is free to enter and has no late-entry fee). Headphones, MP3 players, jogging strollers and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. The routes are measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). A 12-week running course is available to help beginners prepare. The event takes place on 12 September 2026 and includes children’s races as well as the main races. Registration is online, and the event is very popular with the local community.

name: 3. Wunstorfer Citylauf
description: The Wunstorf City Run is a running event in the city center of Wunstorf, organized by TuS Wunstorf. The race starts and finishes in front of the town church, which serves as the event hub. There are various distances, from a 400-meter Bambini run and several children’s and youth races to the 10-kilometer main race. The course is a 1,400-meter loop through the city center, run a different number of times or in a modified format depending on age group and distance. The City Run therefore offers suitable races for runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: 1,400-meter loop through the city center
Start and finish in front of the town church
Various distances from 400 m to 10 km
additional: The race takes place on September 12, 2026, in Wunstorf. Typical September weather is around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event is suitable for all age groups, with dedicated races for children and young people. It includes various race distances: 400 m, 900 m, 1,600 m, 4,400 m, and 10,000 m. The course runs through the city center, starting and finishing in front of the town church. The race promotes health and community spirit in Wunstorf.

name: Dabendorfer Herbstlauf
description: The Dabendorf Autumn Run is a traditional running event organised by MSV Zossen 07 e.V. It takes place on 12 September 2026 in Dabendorf and offers courses for runners, walkers and Nordic walkers from 1.3 km to 15 km. The run is part of the Brandenburg Cup and the Energie-Cup Teltow-Fläming and welcomes both experienced runners and beginners. The event starts at 2 p.m. at the Sportforum Dabendorf; the race office opens at 12 p.m. All participants are welcome to choose the course that suits them.
course_highlights: Course distances from 1.3 km to 15 km
Scoring event in the Brandenburg Cup and Energie-Cup Teltow-Fläming
Start and finish at the Sportforum Dabendorf
additional: The race office opens at 12:00 p.m. Runners, walkers and Nordic walkers can participate. Only those wishing to score Cup points need to follow the course requirements. The event also includes walking categories, a new start location at the Sportforum Dabendorf and independent timekeeping. Registration is online via Raceresult.

name: Horpizlauf Wagrien-Fehmarn
description: The Hospizlauf Wagrien-Fehmarn is an 85 km trail run that starts in Oldenburg in Holstein and takes place in September. This small ultra event is limited to 100 runners and has a 13-hour time limit. The route runs mainly along cycle paths and field roads, with about 60% asphalt, 30% firm sand paths, and the remainder singletrack, as well as around 800 metres of sandy beach. Runners pass the Fehmarnsund Bridge and are supported at aid stations on piers. Each registration also supports the Förderverein Hospiz Wagrien-Fehmarn e.V., which is working to establish a hospice in Oldenburg.
course_highlights: 85 km trail with approximately 60% asphalt and 30% firm sand paths
Passage beneath the Fehmarnsund Bridge
Aid stations on piers near the coast
additional: The race is limited to 100 participants and has a 13-hour time limit. The route includes around 800 metres of sandy beach. Each registration supports the Förderverein Hospiz Wagrien-Fehmarn e.V. The race is limited to 100 runners and takes place in September. It offers a unique combination of experiencing nature and a sporting challenge.

name: KlosterLauf Wiedenbrück
location: Kloster Wiedenbrück, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The KlosterLauf in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a special running event taking place for the fourth time on September 12, 2026. The start and finish are at Wiedenbrück Monastery, and the races follow two scenic loop courses through the town. The event is aimed at both competitive runners and anyone who enjoys the camaraderie and fun of running. Community and the joy of running are at the heart of this sporting highlight.
course_highlights: Start and finish at historic Wiedenbrück Monastery
Two scenic loop courses through Wiedenbrück
Distances of 5 km and 10 km
additional: The entry fee includes awards, an awards ceremony, timekeeping, results, certificates, race materials, parking, refreshments, a bag drop, toilets, changing rooms, and medical services. After the race, an after-run party takes place in the monastery garden until 10 p.m. Scenic loop courses, on-site registration available, after-run party in the monastery garden, start and finish at Wiedenbrück Monastery

name: Lauf durch die Osterdörfer
description: The Lauf durch die Osterdörfer is a road race held at the Sportzentrum Arlewatt in Schleswig-Holstein. The event typically takes place in September and offers participants a choice of 1.5 km and 10 km distances. It is part of the Waterkant-Cup series and is organized by the local club SZ Arlewatt and its running and athletics department. The event is a recurring local race with online registration and published results.
course_highlights: Road race through the Osterdörfer
Start and finish at the Sportzentrum Arlewatt
Part of the Waterkant-Cup series
additional: Typical September weather: approx. 19 °C high, 10 °C low, mostly cloudy with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The race takes place in September; online registration is available, and results and photos from previous years are available.

name: Neubrandenburger Staffelmarathon (LC/NLC)
description: The Neubrandenburg Relay Marathon is a long-standing relay event taking place on September 12, 2026, in Neubrandenburg. The event is hosted by SV Turbine Neubrandenburg e.V. and gives runners the opportunity to tackle the marathon distance together as a team. The start is at 9:30 a.m., and the event runs until about 2:30 p.m. The club’s running group organizes the event and looks forward to welcoming many participants.
course_highlights: Relay marathon in Neubrandenburg
Hosted by SV Turbine Neubrandenburg
Various categories for all age groups
additional: The race starts at 9:30 a.m. on September 12, 2026; details about the terrain and registration are available on the website.

name: Rudelsburglauf
description: The Rudelsburglauf is a long-standing running event along the Rudelsburg near Bad Kösen, organised by LG Rudelsburg 1995 Bad Kösen e.V. The race takes place annually and gives runners of all ability levels the opportunity to enjoy the beautiful local region together. The event is a highlight in the club’s calendar, combining a sporting challenge with an experience in nature. Information about the race announcement and registration is published in good time before the event.
course_highlights: Various distances along the historic Rudelsburg
Scenic routes in the Bad Kösen region
A traditional community race with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Registration and the race announcement for the 2026 Rudelsburglauf will be published on the website from summer 2026. LG Rudelsburg also offers training groups and community runs that enrich club life. The event also offers camping facilities and is open to all age groups. Nordic walkers can also participate.

name: Schledehausener Berglauf
location: Sporthalle Schledehausen, Schledehausen, Bissendorf, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Schledehausener Berglauf is a 10-hour hill-running event in Schledehausen, part of Bissendorf, Germany. The race starts and finishes at the Schledehausen sports hall. The goal is to climb and descend a short hill as many times as possible, accumulating the most elevation gain within the time limit. The course is 700 metres long and has an elevation gain of 32 metres, with an average gradient of 10%. There are individual, relay and team categories. The event is organised by Omas on Tour as a charity event in support of HelpAge Deutschland e. V.
course_highlights: 700-metre out-and-back course
32 metres of elevation gain with a 10% gradient
Start and finish at the Schledehausen sports hall
additional: The race lasts 10 hours, during which participants can run up and down the hill as often as they like. There is an aid station where participants can take a break or stop running. The German Ultramarathon Association recognises performances of 45 km or more. Run on a 700-metre turnaround course, elevation gain 32 metres, gradient 10%, registration opens on 16.01.2026, participant limit 150, supporting “Every Grandma Counts”

name: Spiegelsbergelauf
price_range: 4 km: 5-10 €, 8 km: 10-15 €, 14 km: 15-19 €, Nachmeldungen am Veranstaltungstag gegen Gebühr
description: The Spiegelsbergelauf on 12 September 2026 in Halberstadt offers varied running routes for all ability levels. The 14 km route passes over the Gläserner Mönch and is a real challenge, with its elevation gain and terrain. The 8 km loop around the Jagdschlösschen combines speed and nature, while the 4 km route through the Spiegelsberge is an inviting introduction to racing. The youngest participants can take part in a 400 m taster run. The event is organised by SwimBikeRun Halberstadt e.V. and takes place at the Sportanlage Friedensstadion.
course_highlights: 14 km run with 277 metres of elevation gain, passing over the Gläserner Mönch
8 km run with 117 metres of elevation gain around the Jagdschlösschen
4 km run through the Spiegelsberge
additional: Late registrations are possible on the event day (12.09.2026) from 08:00 to 08:45 for a fee of €5. Race numbers can be collected on 11.09.2026 from 16:00 to 18:00 and on the event day from 7:30. The event takes place at Sportanlage Friedensstadion, Spiegelsbergenweg 79 / Gebrüder-Rehse-Str. 38820 Halberstadt. Secured course, race-number collection on the day before and on the event day, social runs before the event, detailed course descriptions and age groups

name: SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL
description: The SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL is a welcoming trail race in the beautiful surroundings of Suhl, celebrating its anniversary edition on September 12, 2026. The route follows partly winding trails away from the main artery of the Thuringian Forest, passing clear streams, dark valleys and glistening mountain ridges. The event offers an unforgettable experience in nature with spectacular views and is part of the SÜHLER BÜCHSEN CUP. All finishers of the longer distances receive ITRA/UTMB® qualifying points.
course_highlights: Partly winding trails away from the main artery of the Thuringian Forest
Passing clear streams, through dark valleys and over glistening mountain ridges
Spectacular views and an experience in nature in the Suhl area
additional: Pasta party on the eve of the race, starter bag, on-course and finish-line refreshments, tracking for position monitoring, emergency medical care by the mountain rescue service, finisher shirt, finisher medal, finisher surprise gift, finisher certificate (online printout), winner’s trophies for the first three women and men in each trail category, age-group rankings, ITRA/UTMB® qualifying points for the Riesentrail and Heldentrail, free parking and showers, maximum participant numbers per distance (Wichteltrail 344, Riesentrail 177, Heldentrail 199), no on-site registration, Wichteltrail start at 10:30 a.m. by patron André Knapp, Mayor of the City of Suhl, optional breakfast from 04:00 a.m. in the start/finish area, award ceremonies from 3:00 p.m. The event offers cultural and scenic highlights, including course profiles, GPX downloads and detailed information about the individual trails.

name: ULTRAMARATHON DM im 100km-Straßenlauf
description: The 38th German 100 km Ultramarathon Championships take place on September 12, 2026, at Stadion Wartenberg in Berlin-Wartenberg. This road race is a demanding long-distance event that requires endurance and mental strength. The event is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and offers an official championship atmosphere under the patronage of the German Athletics Association. Participants can look forward to professional organization and an athletic challenge.
course_highlights: 100 km road race on a flat, fast course
Start and finish at Stadion Wartenberg
Official German Ultramarathon Championships
additional: The race takes place on roads, with Stadion Wartenberg as the start and finish venue. Registration closes on September 5, 2026. Categories include youth, senior and masters. September temperatures are expected to be around 19°C, with approximately 45 mm of precipitation.

name: Unstrutlauf
description: The Unstrutlauf is a versatile running event in Dingelstädt, offering suitable distances for all ability levels, from 2 km to the half marathon (21.1 km). The varied routes run along the Unstrut and feature scenic highlights, paved cycle paths, and short climbs. Drinks, fruit, and bratwurst are provided. All proceeds are donated to charitable projects in the region, giving the event a special social character.
course_highlights: Varied scenery along the Unstrut
Half marathon with two turnaround points and little elevation gain
Relay with four legs, including sections along the Unstrut Cycle Path
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the respective race and cost €3.00. Timing is provided using the BIP chip system. Each participant receives a medal worth €5.00 and a certificate at the awards ceremony. Water, fruit, and bratwurst are included. Toilets, showers, and changing facilities are available in the start area. Relay participants must arrange their own transport to the changeover points. Various race distances from 2 km to 21 km; refreshments including drinks, fruit, and bratwurst; parking at the Schützenplatz and behind the outdoor swimming pool; electronic timing using the BIP chip system.

name: 21. Citylauf
description: The Nordhausen City Run (Old Town Run) takes place on September 12, 2026, in the historic old town of Nordhausen. The race offers various distances, including special races for children and school students, and is part of the North Thuringia Running Cup. The event features a varied route through the city and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km, 3.3 km, 6.6 km, and 9.9 km
Run through the historic old town of Nordhausen
Part of the North Thuringia Running Cup
additional: Typical September weather: approx. 19 °C, low of 10 °C, mostly cloudy with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The run takes place in Nordhausen’s old town, with support from local sponsors and organizations. The route has not yet been confirmed; the start location is likely to be the Marktpassage.

name: Niedermeiserer Dorflauf
price_range: 6,50 € für Erwachsene, 3,00 € für Schüler, kostenlos für Bambini
