description: The Niedermeiser Village Run is organized by TSV 1864 Niedermeiser e.V. and takes place on 12 September 2026 in Liebenau/Niedermeiser. The races run around Bodenberg, with distances ranging from 400 metres to 18.5 kilometres. Walking and Nordic walking events over various distances are also offered. The start and finish are at the Niedermeiser sports ground, where race materials are also distributed. The event is approved by the Hessian Athletics Association and is held in accordance with the applicable regulations.
course_highlights: Running distances from 400 m to 18.5 km around Bodenberg
Walking and Nordic walking routes of 5 km and 8.5 km
Start and finish at Niedermeiser sports ground, with changing rooms and showers
additional: Start and finish at Niedermeiser sports ground, Bruchweg 60. Race materials are available from 14:30 at the Niedermeiser sports ground/threshing hall. Changing rooms and showers are available at the TSV Niedermeiser clubhouse. The event is approved by the HLV and is held in accordance with the applicable regulations. The event may cause disruption for motorists; please follow signs and instructions from marshals. Results will be published online at www.tsv-niedermeiser.de, www.reinhardswaldcup.de and my.raceresult.com. Distances from 400 m to 18 km, parking at the sports ground, race materials available from 14:30, results online, race part of the Reinhardswald Cup

name: II Ćwiartka Drzymały
location: Miasteczko Krajeńskie, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland

name: Leszczyński Festiwal Sportu – Półmaraton Leszczyński C&C Partners
Mälarömilen
description: After more than ten years away, Mälarömilen is back on Ekerö—a welcoming race for runners of all levels. The event features four races in one day: Mälarö Knattelopp, Lilla Mälarömilen, Mälaröfemman and the classic main race, Mälarömilen (10 km). The start and finish are at Träkvista sports ground, and the event emphasizes community, the joy of exercise and fast courses for those who want to compete. Teams and companies can also register together through a convenient group registration.
course_highlights: Paved walking paths and park trails
Signs at every kilometre marker
Start and finish at Träkvista sports ground; the course passes along the walking path north of the sports ground
additional: Online registration closes 7 days before the race; late registration is available on race day for an increased fee. The number of places is limited, and registration is valid only once payment has been completed. Timing and race bibs are used in all categories (except Mälarö Knattelopp, which is untimed; Lilla Mälarömilen girls/boys aged 9–11 are timed but not ranked). The event area is at Träkvista sports ground, with medical services, a water station just after the start/lap point, and toilets, showers and changing rooms in KOM-huset. Recommended public transport options: buses 177 and 301–311 (Träkvista Idrottsplats stop). The total limit is 1,000 runners, and all proceeds go back to Mälarö SOK’s sports activities. The race offers company and team registration, as well as support for teams.

name: Rådalunken
description: Rådalunken is an annual running race in Lidköping organised by Lidköpings VSK. The 2026 race is planned for 13 September, with the start and finish at Rådåsgården and routes through the Rådaskogen fitness trails. Participants can choose from several distances: 2 km, 5.8 km, 11.4 km and 16.7 km, with different start times. Timing is provided by C-time, and Umara sports drink is served during the races; registration is via RaceID. The race is part of a long tradition dating back to the 1960s and also includes a papricalopp for younger children.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rådåsgården in Lidköping, with routes through the scenic fitness trails in Rådaskogen
Several distances for different levels: 2 km, 5.8 km, 11.4 km and 16.7 km
Timing provided by C-time, with Umara sports drink served during the races
additional: Rådalunken 2026 takes place at Rådåsgården, Lidköping, with several distances and timing and drink sponsors; a papricalopp for younger children is part of the event week. Registration is via RaceID, and race numbers are collected before the start.

name: Internationaler Altenaulauf
description: The International Altenau Run in Borchen is a traditional running event organised by SC Borchen 1926/32, Athletics Department. The race takes place annually and is part of the Hochstift Cup. Alongside the sporting competition, the event also demonstrates social commitment: coffee and cake are offered free of charge, and donations are collected for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V. The event offers runners of different age groups and ability levels an attractive platform.
course_highlights: Part of the Hochstift Cup
A variety of distances for different age groups
Traditional race with a social commitment
additional: Coffee and cake are offered free of charge at the cake stall. Donations are collected for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V. Runners can register for distances online; the event also includes social activities such as coffee and cake and fundraising for Aktion Lichtblicke e.V.

name: 6. DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused extreme experience in the wooded Deister hills near Springe. The event offers running and walking routes of 10 km, 21.1 km (half marathon) and 42.2 km (marathon), with challenging climbs, including the Deisterhölle, with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with aid stations, places to sit and filled rolls for walkers. The event is all about consideration for others and enjoying nature, with awards for the fastest runners and a finisher’s gift as a souvenir.
course_highlights: Deisterhölle with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch
Marathon walk with an additional climb to Bielstein and the Deister ridge
Aid stations with places to sit and filled rolls
additional: Race bib collection from 7:15 a.m. at IGS Springe. Chip timing with a rental chip; return the chip to receive a wheat beer glass as a finisher’s gift. Showers and changing rooms in the IGS Springe sports hall. Parking at IGS, netto and BZE. Travel by S5 to Springe station, then a 10-minute walk to the Nord school centre. Awards ceremonies: 10 km and half marathon at 12:00, marathon at 14:30. Sew-on patches for walkers. Trail event with challenging terrain, refreshments at aid stations, and options for runners and walkers.

name: Braker hkk Lauf
description: The 19th Braker hkk Run takes place on September 13, 2026, in Brake (Unterweser). It is a short running race with distances of 850 meters and 10 kilometers. The race offers a pleasant opportunity to run in typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. Please check the exact event details directly with the organizer.
course_highlights: Distances: 850 m and 10 km
Typical September weather with approx. 19°C and 45 mm of precipitation
Start location in Brake (Unterweser)
additional: The race offers two distances: 850 meters and 10 kilometers. September weather is typically mild and cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event usually takes place in pleasant temperatures of around 19°C. Participants should check the latest details with the organizer before registering.

name: Brückenlauf Halbmarathon Köln des ASV Köln
description: The ASV Köln Bridge Run Half Marathon is a long-standing 21.1-kilometre race that takes runners through the heart of Cologne, along the Rhine and across six of the city’s most beautiful bridges. The course offers spectacular views of the cathedral and the city, with an uplifting atmosphere and music along the route. Alongside the half marathon, shorter distances are available: the Kölsche Runde (11.11 km) and the Bambini Run (500 m), for beginners and children. The race combines a sporting challenge with Rhineland joie de vivre and is ideal for both ambitious and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 21.1 km along the Rhine with views of Cologne Cathedral
Cross six Cologne bridges, including the Hohenzollern Bridge and Rodenkirchen Bridge
Start and finish at the Chocolate Museum forecourt, with a lively atmosphere
additional: The Bridge Run is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is eligible for record lists. The LVN South-East regional championships take place as part of the half marathon. Registration is online, with on-site late registration available on the day of the event. The Kölsche Runde is ideal for beginners and recreational runners; the Bambini Run is for children aged 3–6. The start and finish are both at the Chocolate Museum forecourt. The event features music, commentary and a lively atmosphere along the route. The race starts in the Rheinauhafen and is part of the LVN South-East regional championships. Online registration is available, including a T-shirt for members. Entry fees vary by category.

name: Hattinger Hüttenlauf
description: The Hattinger Hüttenlauf is a traditional race in HenrichsPark in Hattingen, offering a range of running and walking distances for all age groups. The course follows paths surfaced with paving stones, water-bound gravel and asphalt, passing the park’s ponds. The start and finish are beneath Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Industrial Museum Henrichshütte. Alongside the sporting competition, there are categories for Bambini, youth, the fun run and the 10 km Sparkasse Run, as well as awards for the largest groups and the fastest Hattingen runners. The event is family-friendly, and all participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Course in HenrichsPark on paths surfaced with paving stones, water-bound gravel and asphalt
Start and finish beneath Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Industrial Museum Henrichshütte
Course runs alongside the park’s ponds
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the respective start. All Bambini race participants receive a medal. All participants can print their certificates online. Age-group categories are offered, with awards for the largest groups (schools and clubs) and the fastest Hattingen runners. Various running distances, online registration, supporters from the sports and business sectors.

name: Kiel Lauf
description: The Kiel.Lauf is a long-established running event in Kiel, with various competitions for all age groups. The main event is the half marathon, covering 21.1 kilometers through western Kiel and attracting both recreational runners and elite athletes. The 10.2-kilometer fun run is the event’s largest race by participation and offers a lap through Kiel city center with a great atmosphere. There are also shorter races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: The half marathon runs across western Kiel
The fun run goes through Kiel city center
A range of distances from approx. 0.7 km to 21.1 km
additional: The half marathon starts at 10:50 a.m. and the fun run at 09:45 a.m. Due to construction work, short-notice course changes may occur and will be announced in good time. The event is very popular, with more than 10,000 runners. There are various races for schoolchildren and Bambinis, making the event family-friendly. The event includes street closures and participant information, and offers technical running shirts for most categories.

name: Othaler Gutshof Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Othaler Gutshoflauf is a young but popular running event starting and finishing at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal. The event offers distances ranging from 0.5 km to the 21.1 km half marathon, which is known as the Intersport Liebig Half Marathon and passes through several villages. The race gives participants the chance to explore the eastern foothills of the Harz on varied routes. Around 350 runners take part each year, highlighting the event’s growing popularity.
course_highlights: Half marathon route through Sotterhausen, Holdenstedt, Klosterrode and Beyernaumburg
Start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm at Gutshof Othal
Distances ranging from 0.5 km to 21.1 km
additional: Start times: 09:00 half marathon, 09:45 10 km run/walk, 10:00 5 km run/walk, 10:05 0.5 km run, 10:15 1 km run, 10:30 2 km children’s race. Routes for children, recreational runners and competitive runners; start and finish area at the Youth and School Farm in Othal; supported by sponsors such as Intersport Liebig and Autohaus Liebe.

name: Rathaus Center Dessauer CityRUN
description: The 26th Dessauer Rathaus-Center CityRUN is a long-standing race in downtown Dessau that has attracted runners from the region and beyond for many years. The route follows a circuit through the city’s central streets, with the start and finish on Zerbster Straße near the Rathaus-Center. The race offers a sporting challenge in an urban setting and is part of a varied sports programme organised by Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising major sporting events in the region for decades.
course_highlights: Circuit through downtown Dessau
Start and finish on Zerbster Straße at the Rathaus-Center
Route along Steinstraße, Askanische Straße and Kavalierstraße
additional: Volksbank children’s race for children up to 9 years old over 1,000 metres, free for all children and schoolchildren from Dessau. The organiser is Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organising numerous major sporting events in the region for over 20 years. Various distances, including children’s races; company race; on-site registration available; finisher medals

name: Volksbank-Münster-Marathon
description: The Volksbank-Münster-Marathon is a major running event organized by runners for runners, largely by volunteers and with great dedication. With around 12,000 participants, more than 300 artists and bands, and over 100,000 spectators along the course, this autumn marathon offers a unique atmosphere. The course is almost entirely flat and runs through the running- and cycling-friendly city of Münster. A red carpet is rolled out in the finish area on Prinzipalmarkt, making the finish a special experience.
course_highlights: Almost entirely flat course
More than 300 artists and bands along the course
Finish on a red carpet at Prinzipalmarkt
additional: The marathon is part of a major event featuring several races, including the Atruvia Staffelmarathon, Wecker-28 (28 km), Stadtwerke-Kids Marathon, Westfalen AG Charity-Lauf (10 km), and H+B technics-Gesundheitslauf (6 km). There is a combined ranking with the Enschede Marathon. The marathon office is open on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 9:00 to 15:00. A marathon guide with general information and FAQs is available. The marathon attracts around 12,000 runners, offers qualification opportunities for other races, and is supported by numerous sponsors. There are also accompanying events such as talks and health seminars.

name: Waldlauf des TuS Calle-Wallen - Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup
description: The 46th TuS Calle-Wallen Forest Run is part of the Volksbank Sauerland Running Cup and takes place on September 13, 2026, in Meschede. The event offers 1 km and 10 km races and is open to runners of all age groups. The race runs through the wooded areas around Meschede and promises a varied course in a natural setting. September weather is typically mild and mostly cloudy, ideal for running events.
course_highlights: Run through the wooded areas around Meschede
1 km and 10 km distances
Natural setting and varied course
additional: Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with lows of about 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation; skies are mostly cloudy. The event takes place in Meschede, where typical weather is around 19 °C with cloudy skies. It is a great opportunity for the whole family to take part in a traditional race.

name: wep-Lauf
organizer: WEP Intersport Engels / Ralf Sester / TuS Jahn Hilfarth
description: The wepLAUF in Hückelhoven is a varied sporting event with a family-festival atmosphere, taking place on September 13, 2026. Distances range from a marathon to short races for children, including a Flexi Marathon where participants can decide after each lap whether to continue. The start and finish area is on Breteuilplatz, and alongside the race programme the event features a lively supporting programme with a bouncy castle, stage entertainment and stalls. The event particularly encourages children and young people to take part through a school competition. Surrounding streets are closed during the races, and free parking is available at Hückelhoven Center.
course_highlights: The marathon course is completed four times, and the half-marathon course twice
Flexi Marathon with an individually chosen distance and a certificate for the distance completed
Start and finish area on Breteuilplatz; streets are closed during the races
additional: The marathon traditionally starts as the first event of the day. Free parking is available at Hückelhoven Center. Registration is open until September 10, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. The varied supporting programme includes a bouncy castle, stage entertainment and sponsor stalls. The schools with the most participants receive awards. Registration is open until September 10. The start and finish area is on Breteuilplatz; free parking, changing rooms and showers are available. Support is provided for young runners and company relay teams.

name: 17. Parklauf Tangerhütte
description: The 17th Parklauf Tangerhütte takes place in the idyllic Tangerhütte City Park and is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP running series in northern Saxony-Anhalt. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including 1.1 km for young runners, 2.9 km for juniors, and 5.4 km and 10.3 km for adults. The routes loop around Spiegelsee and pass sights such as the New Palace and the mausoleum. In the finish area, SV Germania Tangerhütte provides refreshments, including grilled food, drinks, fruit, coffee, and cake.
course_highlights: Loop course in Tangerhütte City Park, with its idyllic Spiegelsee
The junior course passes the New Palace and the mausoleum
Adult courses cover 2 or 4 laps through the autumnal city park
additional: Start and finish are in front of the old sports hall at Jahn-Sportplatz. Grilled food, refreshing drinks, fruit, coffee, and cake are available in the finish area. Distances range from 300 m to 10.3 km; online registration; race part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP series.

name: 21. swb-Marathon Bremen
description: The 21st swb-Marathon Bremen takes place on 13 September 2026 and offers runners a varied running experience through Bremen. The start and finish are on Bremen’s Marktplatz. The course passes well-known landmarks such as Werdersee, Weserwehr, Rhododendron Park, the university, Bürgerpark, Überseestadt and Schlachte, and finishes with a run through Weserstadion. Alongside the marathon, there is also an AOK Half Marathon, a HIRSCH 10 km race and an AOK Children’s Run. The event is for beginners and experienced runners alike and promises an unforgettable day of sport, with a great atmosphere and support from spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Bremen’s Marktplatz
The course passes Werdersee, Weserwehr, Rhododendron Park and the university
Run through Weserstadion before the finish
additional: Start and finish area on Bremen’s Marktplatz. Optional extras can be booked, including a finisher’s shirt, an HD video of the finish and participation in the pasta party. Various distances are available for beginners and experienced runners. The run through Weserstadion is a special highlight. The event features strong spectator support and a lively atmosphere. Online registration is available; start times begin at 11:30. The course runs through Bremen and features highlights such as Werdersee and Weserstadion, with additional options including a pasta party and finisher’s shirts.

name: 43. Internationalen Airport Race
price_range: various, e.g., 28 Euro for shirts, 15 Euro for cotton shirts, 12-40 Euro for race entries
description: The 43rd International Airport Race in Hamburg takes place on September 13, 2026, offering a varied running experience around Hamburg Airport. The 10-mile race traditionally starts at 11:00 a.m. at the LSV sports grounds on Borsteler Chaussee. In addition to the 10-mile main race, there are also 5 km races and the Mini Airport Race. The unique airport setting provides ever-changing views and a special atmosphere.
course_highlights: A varied route around Hamburg Airport
Start and finish at the LSV sports grounds on Borsteler Chaussee
A unique airport setting with ever-changing views
additional: In addition to the 10-mile main race, there is also a 5 km race and a Mini Airport Race of approximately 1.4 km. The event is very popular, with almost 4,000 registered participants. The race is part of the Hamburg Running Cup. Registration is via the official registration page. Routes on roads, footpaths and hiking trails; online registration; race shirts and medals; refreshments and showers on race day

name: Brachter Depotlauf
location: Brachter Depot, 41379 Brüggen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Brachter Depot Run is a guided trail run through the beautiful Brachter Depot, with different pace groups ranging from 5:00 to 7:00 min/km. Various distances are offered, including a half marathon, 14 km, a 5 km beginners’ run, a children’s run (max. 2 km), and walking. The event places an emphasis on experiencing nature and social engagement: participation in the children’s run is free, and a starting donation is collected on the day of the event. Organized by TSF Bracht and Depotrunners Bracht, the runs offer a varied course in a natural setting.
course_highlights: Guided trail run through the Brachter Depot
Different pace groups ranging from 5:00 to 7:00 min/km
Various distances: half marathon, 14 km, 5 km, and children’s run
additional: Participation in the children’s run is free. A starting donation of €10.00 is requested for all other runs; it must be paid in cash at the registration desk on the day of the event. The event is organized by TSF Bracht and Depotrunners Bracht. Refreshments are provided for participants. Runs take place in different pace groups to accommodate all running speeds. Trail run, various distances, refreshments provided, online registration.

name: DeisterCrossing Springe
description: DeisterCrossing is a nature-focused endurance event combining running and walking in the outstanding natural surroundings of the forested Deister mountain range. The event offers 10 km, 21.1 km and 42.2 km courses for runners and walkers. The challenging routes include the Deisterhölle, with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch, and offer a unique nature and mountain experience near Hanover. The event has a relaxed atmosphere, with participants looking out for one another. Alongside the sporting challenge, it offers refreshment stations, finisher gifts and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The Deisterhölle, with 200 metres of elevation gain in one stretch after 5 km
Marathon walkers tackle an additional 50 metres of elevation gain to the Bielstein
Nature and mountain run in the forested Deister mountain range near Hanover
additional: Race number pickup from 7:15 a.m. at IGS Springe. A rental timing chip is provided and exchanged at the finish for a wheat beer glass with the DC logo. Showers and changing rooms are available in the IGS Springe sports hall. Parking is available at IGS, Netto and BZE. Travel by S5 to Springe station, then a 10-minute walk to the Nord school centre. Refreshment stations with seating and filled rolls; finish buffet. Awards for the first three women and men in the running events at 12:00 (10 km and half marathon) and 14:30 (marathon). Walkers receive patches to sew on. Courses in woodland, refreshment stations, patches for walkers, online certificates, awards ceremonies, parking, showers and changing rooms in the sports hall, travel by train.

name: Dübener Heidelauf
location: Obermühle, Bad Düben, Landkreis Nordsachsen, Sachsen, Germany
description: The Dübener Heidelauf is a traditional forest run held at the picturesque Obermühle in Bad Düben, a spa town in northern Saxony. The event is organised by SV Bad Düben and offers races for children, teenagers and adults. With distances ranging from 500 m to the half marathon (21.1 km), the run appeals to both young runners and experienced distance athletes. It is part of the regional athletics scene in northern Saxony and Leipzig and is known for its family-friendly, club-oriented character.
course_highlights: Forest run through the Dübener Heide
Distances from 500 m to 21.1 km (half marathon)
Venue: Obermühle in Bad Düben
additional: The run takes place in typical September weather, with an average temperature of 19 °C (low of 10 °C) and mostly cloudy skies. The event includes age groups from under 8s through to adults and is a regional club race rather than a major commercial event. Cross-country/forest terrain; races for various age groups; regional club event

name: Eicklinger Volks- und Familielauf
description: The 1st Eicklingen Fun Run and Family Run is aimed at active families who would like to enjoy a lovely day running together. The focus is on having fun and enjoying running, without the pressure of competition. The event offers a friendly atmosphere for all age groups and encourages people to be active together.
course_highlights: 3 km and 6 km running routes
Family-friendly event
Starting point in Eicklingen
additional: Typical September weather: approx. 19 °C, low of 10 °C, average precipitation of 45 mm, mostly cloudy. The event is ideal for families who want to run together and offers a relaxed, community atmosphere. September weather can affect the running experience, but is generally pleasant.

name: Garbenteicher Volkslauf
description: The Garbenteich Volkslauf, organized by Sportverein 1928 Garbenteich e.V., is a traditional race in Pohlheim known as a good preparatory course for the Frankfurt Marathon. The course has been optimized for safety, so it no longer crosses any federal highways or railway lines. There are seven refreshment stations offering water, cola and tea, and participants can look forward to excellent refreshments after the race. Race numbers can be collected on the event day from 08:00 or the day before at the Garbenteich Sports and Cultural Hall.
course_highlights: Safe course route with no crossings of federal highways or railway lines
Seven refreshment stations offering water, cola and tea
Courses of moderate difficulty with moderate elevation gain
additional: Race numbers and timing transponders can be collected on the event day from 08:00 or the day before between 16:00 and 17:00. Late entries are possible on the event day until the start of the race for an additional fee of EUR 5. Changes to another distance are free of charge up to two days before the race. The course is marked and checked several times before the start. The race takes place on 13 September 2026, starting behind the Garbenteich Sports and Cultural Hall. Club membership is not required, and the event is ideal for marathon preparation.

name: Kristall Lauf Weißwasser

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voranmeldung ist bis zum 05. September 2025 23:59 Uhr online über den Baer-Service möglich

description: The Kristall-Lauf Weißwasser is a varied fun run for runners and walkers of all ages. The course crosses mixed terrain, including asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, and forest trails with roots. The event counts toward several regional rankings, including the Dresden District Rankings, the Sachsenenergie Läufer-Cup, and the Niederlausitz-Cup. It also features an official walking ranking by the German Athletics Association. A special feature is the traditional team race, which promotes community and team spirit.
course_highlights: Mixed terrain: asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, and forest trails with roots
Part of regional rankings: Dresden District Rankings, Sachsenenergie Läufer-Cup, and Niederlausitz-Cup
Official walking ranking by the German Athletics Association
additional: Late entries are possible in person on race day, with a late-entry fee of €6 (2025) or €4 (2024). The event includes individual and team rankings. The courses are marked on site on race day, and those markings are binding. The event is open to all age groups, from children to seniors. Terrain: asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, and forest trails with roots; team race with at least three runners; start at Bruno-Bürgel-Oberschule; registration in person or online

name: runroll City
description: The runroll City event takes place on 13 September 2026 in Bielefeld and offers a fast-paced sporting experience on a flat, 7.2-kilometre course through the heart of the city. The course is ideal for fast times and is suited to both intensive run training and a quick race. Participants can enjoy being active in an urban setting and be part of a dynamic event.
course_highlights: 7.2-kilometre course
Flat course layout for fast times
Urban race through the heart of Bielefeld
additional: The event is known for its inclusive atmosphere and the option to run or skate. It is aimed at everyone who enjoys being active in the city and offers an attractive course in central Bielefeld.

name: Stiftungslauf Salzgitter
description: The Stiftungslauf at Salzgittersee is a traditional running event taking place on 13 September 2026. The event offers various races, including two main races, a relay race, a Shorty run and walking. The start is at 10:30 a.m. at the DLRG building at Salzgittersee in Lebenstedt. Bürgerstiftung Salzgitter warmly invites everyone who enjoys running to join in and have fun exercising together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the DLRG building at Salzgittersee
Various events: main races, relay race, Shorty run and walking
Route along Salzgittersee in Lebenstedt
additional: The event includes two main races, a relay race, a Shorty run and walking. For questions, the organizer can be reached by phone at 0172/5416779. Event at Salzgittersee featuring main races, a relay race, a Shorty run and walking.

name: Zeuthener Jedermannslauf
price_range: kostenlos bis ca. 14,- € je nach Wettbewerb und Anmeldedatum
description: The Zeuthen Jedermann Run is a popular community race held every September in Zeuthen. It offers various events for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances ranging from 400 m to 10 km. The event is family-friendly and promotes recreational sport in the region. The races start at Zeuthen S-Bahn station and follow a varied route along the Waldpromenade.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400 m to 10 km
Start and finish on Miersdorfer Chaussee at Zeuthen S-Bahn station
Family-friendly community race with classifications for all age groups
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for an additional fee. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the events. There are age-group classifications and overall placings, with awards. The event runs from 8:00 a.m. to approximately 4:00 p.m. The course includes cobblestones. Registration is open until 10.09.2026; bib number pickup is on 12.09.2026. Medals for all finishers. Facilities and offerings include showers, refreshments, and sales stands.

name: HochRhön-BergTrail
description: The HochRhön Mountain Trail is a challenging trail-running event in the picturesque uplands of the Hochrhön around Hilders. The event offers four trail distances from 7 km to 42 km, with varied routes through forests, singletrack, forest roads and meadows. The races feature some steep climbs and wonderful views, particularly from Auerbergsee and Buchschirm. Alongside the sporting challenge, supporting a good cause is also a focus: part of the entry fees is donated to the Malteser Children’s Hospice and Family Support Service in Fulda. The event is part of the regional Trailrunning Cup Rhön and also offers children’s races.
course_highlights: Varied surfaces: asphalt, forest paths, forest roads, singletrack, hiking trails, meadows, stairs and wooden bridges
Challenging climbs, including a singletrack ascent steeper than 20% on the 7K Trail
Fantastic viewpoints, including views of Scheppenbachtal, Milseburg and Wasserkuppe
additional: Start and finish are at the TSV Hilders sports grounds. Start times: 29K and 42K at 9:30 a.m., 7K and 15K at 10:45 a.m., KidsRun at approximately 9:40 a.m. Race bibs can be collected on race day at the Hilders fire station or beforehand at BECK Orthopädie. Race briefings are mandatory. The 15K course is an ITRA National League race and a UTMB Index Race. There will be an expo at the sports grounds. The event supports a fundraising campaign for the Malteser Children’s Hospice and Family Support Service in Fulda. Medical services are provided by the DRK Mountain Rescue Service and volunteer fire brigades. Distances: 7 km, 15 km, 29 km and 42 km; start and finish at the TSV Hilders sports grounds; online registration opens on 23.12.2025; limit of 550 trail participants; children’s races are free; donations support charitable causes; medical services provided by mountain rescue and volunteers; equipment available at BECK in Hilders.

name: II Złotowska Dziesiątka
description: The 2nd Złotów Ten is a road race taking place on September 13, 2026, in Złotów. Participants complete two laps of 5 km each, for a total distance of 10 km. The event is organized by the Złotów Social Activity Center and aims to promote an active lifestyle and bring the local running community together. All running enthusiasts are welcome to take part.
course_highlights: The course consists of two laps of 5 km each
A road race in the center of Złotów
Organized at the Municipal Stadium and on nearby streets
additional: The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Złotów and on nearby streets. The course consists of two 5 km laps. Registration is available through the Domtel-Sport platform. The organizer, the Złotów Social Activity Center, provides contact and support. A 10 km road race with online registration, support from local businesses, an appealing course, and prizes

name: Poznań Track Day 2026
location: Tor Poznań, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Tor Poznań Track Day is a series of exciting motorsport events held at the race track in Poznań. Participants have the opportunity to compete, train, and take part in qualifying rounds held throughout the 2026 season. The event is aimed at motorsport enthusiasts and also offers car rentals and one-to-one instruction with instructors. It is a great opportunity to experience the thrill of motorsport and improve your skills on a professional track.
course_highlights: Race track in Poznań with professional facilities
Opportunity to take part in various rounds and qualifying sessions during the 2026 season
Training sessions and one-to-one instruction with instructors

Participation payments must include the correct payment reference to confirm entry. Multiple rounds include training sessions, qualifying, and night races, with a focus on sporty driving and the excitement of the track.

location: Środa Wielkopolska, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 11th Run of Hope and the 7th Greater Poland Lawyers’ Championships are a charity run organized in Środa Wielkopolska to support the work of the Piotr Hospice. The event combines sporting competition with an important social cause, engaging the local community and the legal profession. It is an established tradition that promotes physical activity and solidarity.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Old Market Square in Środa Wielkopolska
Charity run supporting the hospice
Various distances and activities, including children’s races and Nordic walking
additional: The run is a charity event supporting the Piotr Hospice. Registration opens on March 1, 2026. The website has no details about the course, start times, or fees. The event is scheduled for September 13, 2026, and includes various running and activity options; participation supports the work of the Piotr Hospice.

name: Chyża 10
location: Nowy Tomyśl, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 12th Chyża Ten is a fast and popular 10 km race organized by the Nowotomyski Chyży Running Club. The event takes place in Nowy Tomyśl and counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix in running. The race starts at 9:00, and the race office is open from 7:00 to 8:30. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, offering a friendly atmosphere and a well-prepared course.

Race counts toward the Nowotomyski County Grand Prix
Start at 9:00; race office opens at 7:00

The event also includes 5 km races, and registration opens on June 1, 2025. The race is part of a series of sporting events organized by the club.

description: The Northern Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on 13 September 2026 on the Hel Peninsula, bringing together the tradition of the Northern Marathon and the Marathon Relays under one name. The course passes through the scenic locations of Hel, Jastarnia and Rozewie, along Puck Bay, with sea views and four lighthouses giving the race its unique character. The event offers a range of distances for runners of all ability levels, from the marathon and relays to the half marathon, 10 km and 5 km, as well as a children’s race, the Little Lighthouse Keeper Run. It’s not just a sporting event, but also a journey through the coast’s beautiful spots and a chance to connect with nature.
course_highlights: The course runs along Puck Bay with views of the sea
There are four lighthouses along the course: in Hel, Jastarnia and two in Rozewie
The course passes through some of the most beautiful spots on the Hel Peninsula and the coast
additional: The course is available to download in .GPX, .KML and .TCX formats. Registration is open from 1 January 2026 to 24 August 2026 at 15:00. Co-organisers and partners include local sports and cultural centres and a holiday resort. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Marshal of the Pomeranian Voivodeship. The Little Lighthouse Keeper Run is for children and young people up to 14 years old. The course is available to download in .GPX, .KML and .TCX formats; coastal and seaside terrain; the event includes various distances and competitions for adults and children.

name: Crow Mountain Survival
description: The Crow Mountain Survival obstacle race in Bremen is an exciting adventure returning for its ninth edition on September 6, 2026. Distances range from 1.2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, featuring challenging obstacles and spectacular water sections, including a swim across Lake Werdersee. The event offers challenges for beginners and experienced OCR veterans, as well as inclusive races for people with disabilities. The varied course runs through forests, meadows and over different terrain, testing endurance, strength and agility. Special untimed races for children and newcomers make it easier to get started.
course_highlights: Spectacular water crossing through Lake Werdersee
Varied course through forests, meadows and over different terrain
Challenging obstacles involving climbing, balancing, crawling and traversing
additional: Wave starts of 10 people every 60 seconds for the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km races; runners are assigned to waves based on their pace at registration; untimed youth and inclusive races; medals and certificates for all participants; start times vary by distance, e.g. the youth race at 09:30 and the introductory race at 12:00; children under 12 require prior approval to participate in certain distances. Distances range from 5 km to 15 km, with water sections, natural trails through forests and meadows, challenging obstacles, and inclusive youth, introductory and inclusive races.

name: B2Run Berlin
description: B2Run Berlin on September 16, 2026, is a corporate run featuring a course of approximately 5.7 km around Berlin’s Olympic Stadium. The race finishes with an emotional finish-line moment inside the historic Olympic Stadium and offers a unique team event for companies and individual participants from Berlin and the surrounding area. The focus is on team spirit, motivation and fun—not personal bests—making it ideal for beginners, walkers and experienced runners. The event combines physical activity with workplace health promotion and a professional supporting program featuring a host and music.
course_highlights: Approximately 5.7 km circular course around Berlin’s Olympic Stadium
Emotional finish inside the Olympic Stadium
Suitable for beginners, walkers and experienced runners
additional: The race is part of the nationwide B2Run corporate running series, which focuses on team building, health promotion and employee motivation. The course can also be completed on foot or in a wheelchair. The event features a professional supporting program with a host and music. Companies of all sizes and individual participants can take part. More than 10,000 participants are expected; there are various VIP and general areas; registration and ticket information are available on the official website; the stadium layout and terms of participation are described in detail.

name: Mjärdevistafetten
price_range: 700-1000 kr/lag (student/under 18 100 kr/lag; priser varierar efter anmälningsdatum)
description: Mjärdevistafetten is a lively public relay in Collegiumparken in Linköping Science Park. The competition is for teams of four, with each runner covering a leg of approximately 3 km. The race starts at 17:00, and there are activities, food sales, and an awards ceremony with a prize draw after the finish. The event welcomes everyone from elite teams to recreational runners and encourages colourful and creative touches along the course.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Collegiumparken, Linköping Science Park
Team competition: 4 people per team, each leg approximately 3 km
Awards ceremony at approximately 18:15 and a prize draw using race bib numbers
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Mjärdevi Center / DoSpace on Wednesday 11 September from 11:00 to 13:30 and Thursday 12 September from 11:00 to 13:30 (after that, in the start and finish area). Food is available on site, and an After Run package for the whole team is offered (price: 140 kr). The event encourages companies to create activities along the course (water stations, performances, etc.) and features attractive prize sponsors and prize draws. Teams collect their bibs at Mjärdevi Center/DoSpace before the event (usually from 11:00 to 13:30 on the days before), and After Run packages are available for teams (e.g. 140 kr according to the 2024 version). The event follows COVID-19 safety measures in line with recommendations from the authorities and encourages a focus on sustainability in themed activities.

name: Stadtfestlauf Lüdinghausen
description: The Stadtfestlauf Lüdinghausen is a long-standing running event organized by SC Union 08 Lüdinghausen e.V. It gives runners of different ages and ability levels the opportunity to compete on varied routes through the town and surrounding area. The race is part of the Westmünsterlandlaufserie and attracts numerous participants each year, who value both the sporting competition and the sense of community. The event is open to everyone who enjoys running and is organized by a dedicated club with many years of experience.
course_highlights: Varied routes through Lüdinghausen and the surrounding area
Part of the Westmünsterlandlaufserie
A range of running routes for different ages and ability levels
additional: Runners can register online; the event also includes a market, music, and family activities.

name: Wipperfürther Stadtlauf

description: The 20th Wipperfürth City Run takes place on September 18, 2026, and runs through Wipperfürth’s historic town center. The event offers races for all age groups, from the kindergarten run to the 10 km main race, which is officially measured by the DLV. The races are electronically timed, and all participants receive commemorative medals. The event is open to everyone; club membership is not required. Attractive awards are presented to the fastest runners and age-category winners.
course_highlights: Wipperfürth’s historic town center
10 km main race with 7 large laps, measured by the DLV
Various distances from 0.5 km to 10 km
additional: Late registration is available on September 18, 2026, from 4:00 p.m. at the KSK branch on Marktplatz (EUR 3 surcharge). Race packets will be available from 4:00 p.m. at Marktplatz. Changing facilities and showers are available at the fire station at Lüdenscheider Straße 14. Relay exchanges take place in the start area on Lüdenscheider Straße, with the sash or baton handed over there. All participants receive commemorative medals; the top finishers in the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races receive trophies, while prizes are awarded in the 4.4 km race and main race. The city champions are determined from the fastest participants from Wipperfürth. Various race events, medals for all finishers, registration until September 11, 2026, start/finish at the Ohler Wiesen large parking lot

name: SportScheck RUN Hannover
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The SportScheck Run Hannover is an evening night run that transforms Hanover’s city centre into a spectacular light show. Runners can choose between a 1 km course for children and 5 km and 10 km courses, which pass through the illuminated city centre and landmarks such as Opernplatz, the Lower Saxony State Parliament, Kröpcke and the New Town Hall. The nighttime atmosphere makes the run a memorable experience. The fastest runners can take part in a 10 km SpeedRUN, which is run in under 50 minutes. The event welcomes runners of all ability levels and also offers training plans to help them prepare.
course_highlights: 5 km loop through Hanover city centre
Past illuminated landmarks such as Opernplatz, the State Parliament, Kröpcke and the Town Hall
Evening start with a special nighttime atmosphere
additional: There is a 10 km SpeedRUN for runners aiming to finish in under 50 minutes, starting one hour before the regular 10 km run. Children aged 7 to 12 can take part in a 1 km race. Training plans for different performance goals are available. The event takes place in the evening, with a festive atmosphere and a route passing Hanover’s main landmarks. No specific prices are stated.

Participants can choose between 5 km and 7 km, and group registration is also available. The event promotes fitness, health and team spirit in training companies and takes place on September 18, 2026, at the VSV Hedendorf-Neukloster sports facility.

Venue: VSV sports facility, Buxtehude-Hedendorf
Promotes fitness, health and team spirit

There are three race distances: 2.1 km, 4.2 km, and 10.5 km, all starting in the market square. The event welcomes participants of all ages and supports a good cause while fostering a strong sense of community. The entry fee for schoolgirls is covered; adults pay 6 euros. Groups of four or more can enter the team competition and win trophies.
course_highlights: Three race distances: 2.1 km, 4.2 km, and 10.5 km
Start and finish in the market square in Dannenberg’s historic town center
Charity run supported by local sponsors, with refreshments

All proceeds go 100% to the Onkologisches Netzwerk Wendland. Run on 18.09.2026, individual and team competitions, online registration with PayPal, race-number collection at Apotheke Seepassage, part of the Wendland-Lauf-Cup

name: Iedema Building Run 2026
description: The Iedema Building Run 2026 in Harderwijk is a sporting event focused on exercise, social connection and entrepreneurship, with a special emphasis on supporting the Prinses Beatrix Spierfonds. Participants can walk or run and help raise money for research into muscle diseases. The event encourages individual and team fundraising efforts to make a positive impact on the lives of people with muscle diseases. It is an inclusive and meaningful run for anyone who wants to contribute to a future without muscle diseases.
course_highlights: Supporting research into muscle diseases
Community-focused charity run
Organised by Sportcentrum Iedema
additional: The event supports the Prinses Beatrix Spierfonds and encourages participants to start individual fundraising campaigns, contribute as a team and raise money for research into muscle diseases. Participants are encouraged to fundraise and take part in an event that promotes exercise and community spirit.

Kretsloppet i Borås
description: Kretsloppet in Borås is a street festival where runners of all ages are invited to run 5 km or 10 km through the city streets and parks. Younger participants can take part in children’s races (400 m and 2 km), and the event finishes in the heart of Borås, in the city centre/city park. The event welcomes both experienced runners and recreational runners, and encourages people to take part in groups with family, friends or colleagues. The organisers describe a joyful atmosphere with music, cheers from the crowd and activities around the race.

Finish in Borås city centre/city park (selfie booth at the finish)
Children’s races of 400 m and 2 km, specially suited to younger participants
additional: Registration is available on the website until race day (no later than 1 hour before each race). Accident insurance is included in the registration fee. Payment can be made by card or Swish; group registration for companies/organisations is available, with invoicing through a group account. Items can be pre-ordered during registration: the Kretsloppet functional T-shirt (150 kr, order by 19 August), wooden medal (50 kr, last day to pre-order 11 September) and ICA City recovery bag (70 kr, last day to order 11 September). After registering, a booking confirmation is sent by email; approximately one week before the race, a race pass with a QR code is sent, which is used to collect the race bib. Registration for the 10 km closes on 30 June; on-site registration is available until 1 hour before the start. Registration for the 5 km can be made via the website up to and including race day. Accident insurance is included in the registration fee. The race pass with QR code and race bib can be printed or shown at the venue. Group registration is available for companies/organisations. Add-on items can be pre-ordered: T-shirt 150 kr, medal 50 kr and ICA Recovery Bag 70 kr. A certificate is available via the results website.

name: Black River Run, 100 miles
location: Västerås SOKs klubbstuga Orientalen, Västerås, Sweden
description: Black River Run is an urban ultramarathon in Västerås, offered over several distances: 100 miles (161 km), 50 miles (80.5 km), Instegsultra (48 km), 20 miles (32.2 km) and 10 miles. The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. The course consists of a varied 10-mile (16.1 km) loop featuring technical trails, running tracks, gravel roads, hiking trails and some asphalt. The race is organised by Västerås Löparklubb. Finishers receive a medal, and runners who complete the 100 miles in under 24 hours receive a belt buckle.
course_highlights: One loop is 10 miles (16.1 km); the race consists of repeated loops
Varied surfaces: technical trails, running tracks, gravel roads, hiking trails and some asphalt
An urban course, with the start, lap point and finish at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen
additional: Distances: 100 miles, 50 miles, Instegsultra (48 km), 20 miles and 10 miles. The start, lap point and finish are at Västerås SOK’s clubhouse, Orientalen, which has changing rooms, showers and a sauna. 100-mile runners who complete the course in under 24 hours receive the BRR belt buckle; other finishers receive a medal. Participants may decline the medal, in which case the organiser donates SEK 20 to Médecins Sans Frontières. The course is permanently marked with red posts. The 100-mile distance has a 24-hour time limit.

name: Lergöksloppet
location: Råbocka camping, Kronoskogen, Ängelholm Municipality, Skåne County, Sweden
description: Lergöksloppet is a recreational race organised by FK Snapphanarna on winding trails and forest roads in the beautiful Kronoskogen in Ängelholm. The start and finish are at Råbocka Camping, and the race welcomes children, recreational runners and competitive runners. After finishing, participants receive a medal, and fruit/juice or coffee/tea and a sandwich are served, depending on the class. Shower and changing facilities are limited, and it is also possible to register on race day for an additional fee.
course_highlights: Winding trails and forest roads in Kronoskogen
Start and finish at Råbocka Camping
A forest setting near Ängelholm, suitable for children and recreational runners alike
additional: Race bibs are handed out at Råbocka Camping from 09:00 on race day. Late registration is available on race day from 09:00 for an additional fee, until 30 minutes before the start. Medals go to everyone who finishes; prizes are awarded to the top woman and man. Shower and changing facilities are available in limited numbers. Class 1 can be run together with children at no extra cost. The race starts and finishes at Råbocka Camping, with Kronoskogen as the venue; free parking is available, and shower and changing facilities are available in limited numbers. After the finish, participants can take a dip in the sea near the shore of Skälderviken.

name: Klarälvsloppet Run 21k
description: Klarälvsloppet Run 21K is a fast, scenic half marathon on a former railway embankment between Forshaga and Karlstad. The course is entirely traffic-free and has no steep climbs. The race is certified by the Swedish Athletics Association and has three hydration stations serving water and sports drink. The race starts at Forshaga Learning Centre and finishes in Karlstad, where participants are offered fruit and refreshments after the finish. It is a popular race that attracts many runners looking to set a personal best in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: The course follows a former railway embankment and is entirely traffic-free, with no steep climbs
Three official hydration stations serving water and sports drink
Certified half marathon with central sanctioning from the Swedish Athletics Association
additional: The start is at Forshaga Learning Centre, with race-bib collection from 09:00 to 10:00. A bus leaves from Karlstad City Library for the start at 09:00 and has room for equipment. The maximum time allowed for the race is 2:45 hours; a sweeper minibus is available. Bag transport to the finish is provided. Medical care is available at the start, finish and hydration stations. After the finish, bananas, buns and chocolate are offered. Sports drink is supplied by Umara, with a discount code for participants. The event also includes other distances, such as 7.5 km, as well as longer cycling and roller-ski races; corporate challenges and health initiatives are also available.

name: Insellauf Rund um Amrum
location: Norddorf auf Amrum, Nordfriesland, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Insellauf Rund um Amrum is a popular fun run for everyone, held annually in late summer in Norddorf on the North Sea island of Amrum. The event offers a sporting challenge amid the unique natural surroundings of the Wadden Sea National Park, a World Heritage Site. Participants can enjoy the varied landscape of dunes, Kniepsand and sea views. The race is an appealing way for both locals and holidaymakers to combine physical activity with experiencing nature.
course_highlights: Run through the varied landscape of Kniepsand and dunes
Course in the Wadden Sea National Park, a World Heritage Site
Start and finish in Norddorf on Amrum
additional: The Insellauf takes place annually in late summer. The event is part of Amrum’s extensive sports programme. The venue is the AOK-Nordseeklinik, Strunwai 23, in Norddorf on Amrum. The event takes place in the Wadden Sea National Park area and emphasises experiencing nature and beach activities. Registration is possible on site or by email, with refreshments and support provided by local partners.

name: Mühlenlauf in Laar
location: Laar, Grafschaft Bentheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: Verein zur Erhaltung der Windmühle Laar/Vechte e.V.
description: The Mühlenlauf in Laar has been organized by SV Grenzland Laarwald since 1986 and takes place annually on the third weekend in September. Runners of all ages can choose between 2 km, 5 km and 10 km courses. The start and finish are both by the historic windmill, which, together with the windmill association, creates a welcoming atmosphere. Drinks and refreshments are provided for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish by the historic windmill in Laar
Course distances: 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
Run through the scenic surroundings of Laar
additional: The Mühlenlauf is organized in cooperation with the sports club. The windmill and the local heritage house can be rented for celebrations. Drinks and refreshments are available on site for runners and spectators. The Mühlenlauf takes place in September, with drinks and refreshments provided. Advance registration is possible; late registration is available on site. The event takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Röderhof-Benefiz-Lauf
description: The Röderhof Charity Run takes place on September 19, 2026, in Diekholzen and offers various running and walking distances for all age groups and ability levels. This traditional charity event focuses on the enjoyment of running and coming together to support a good cause. Distances range from 500 meters to 10 kilometers, including special wheelchair races. Start times are staggered to ensure the event runs smoothly.
course_highlights: A variety of distances from 500 m to 10 km
Inclusive wheelchair races and walking routes
A run through the scenic surroundings of Diekholzen
additional: Online registration closes on 15.09. at 21:00. Late entries are possible on the event day up to 1 hour before the start, subject to a €2 late-entry fee. Payment by direct debit is possible. The event includes several start times for different distances and categories, including special wheelchair races and walking routes. Various running events, wheelchair races, walking, and the option to donate via PayPal

name: Welterbelauf Zollverein 2026
location: Zollverein, Essen-Stoppenberg, Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Welterbelauf Zollverein takes place on September 19, 2026, on the grounds of the Zollverein coking plant in Essen-Stoppenberg. The courses run along the Ring Promenade and past prominent industrial landmarks such as the Doppelbock winding tower, the SANAA building, and the Zollverein spoil tip. Various events are available for all ages and ability levels, including a 10 km run, relays, walking, and Special Olympics categories. The 10 km course is officially measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings. The race combines a sporting challenge with the unique atmosphere of this UNESCO World Heritage Site.
course_highlights: Course along the Ring Promenade and past the Doppelbock winding tower
Passes the SANAA building and the Zollverein spoil tip
10 km course officially measured by the DLV and eligible for rankings
additional: The event offers eight different competitions, including the 10 km Zollverein Run, 3 x 3.3 km Pütt Relay, 5.4 km Kumpel Run and Steiger Walk, 2.7 km Coking Plant Run, 1.2 km Schoolchildren's Race, 600 m Helen Keller Run, and 300 m Bambini Run. Parking on the grounds is free for participants and visitors. The venue is easily accessible by public transport and car. The DLV and IAAF International Competition Rules apply. Registration opens on May 15, 2026; the event includes team relays (Pütt Run) and offers certificates and results online.

name: 32. Stadtparklauf

The event offers various distances from 500 m to 10,000 m and is open to runners of all ages and ability levels. The course winds through the picturesque city park, offering a pleasant running atmosphere in a green setting. The run is organized by SV Glückauf Sondershausen e.V. and is very popular in the region.
course_highlights: Run through Sondershausen City Park
A variety of distances from 500 m to 10,000 m
Family-friendly and varied course

description: The Devil's Loop - Langenberg Backyard Ultramarathon is a challenging ultramarathon held in Enge-Sande, Schleswig-Holstein. The race is part of the Waterkant Cup and gives runners the opportunity to test their endurance on a demanding course. The organizer, Sportverein Enge-Sande von 1959 e.V., is a multi-sport club offering a range of sporting activities. The event is aimed at ambitious runners looking for a special challenge.

Event in the rural surroundings of Enge-Sande
Part of the Waterkant Cup, which includes several races

The event is designed to last for an extended period, with runners completing multiple loops until only one runner remains. It takes place in September 2026 and is very popular with ultramarathon enthusiasts. Participants must register in advance, and the event is known for its friendly atmosphere and challenging course.

name: Altstadt-Run 2026

The course loops around the distinctive water tower and offers a sporting challenge in a scenic setting.
course_highlights: A varied cross-country run around the water tower
Distances of 1 km, 2 km, 5 km and 10 km
Separate races for children and school pupils
additional: Nordic walkers are also welcome. Typical September weather: approx. 19 °C, mostly cloudy, with about 45 mm of precipitation. The run takes place on 19 September 2026 and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with various competitions and courses for all age groups.

name: Duinger Berglauf
description: The Duinger Berglauf takes place on September 19, 2026, in Duingen, Lower Saxony, and offers races for children and adults. The event starts and finishes at the OBS sports hall and includes short children’s races as well as more challenging 5 km and 10 km hill races with around 110 metres of elevation gain. Organised by Duinger Sport-Club e.V., the race has been an accessible local hill-running event for 19 years. After the race, all participants receive free access to the indoor swimming pool and sauna, with changing rooms, showers and refreshments available on site.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses with approximately 110 m of elevation gain
Routes mainly on paved farm and forest paths
Children’s races near the school grounds; adult races start at the sports hall
additional: Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start. Free access to the indoor swimming pool and sauna after the race. Changing rooms, showers, food and drinks are available on site. No club membership required. Various distances, including children’s and adult categories; registration is possible until shortly before the race; post-race amenities include the indoor swimming pool and sauna.

name: Edeka Ladage-Lauf Wennigsen

description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen offers a varied program for all age groups, with distances ranging from approximately 600 m for kindergarten children to 10 km for adults. The races take place on a varied loop course on the grounds of the Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School, passing through residential areas and along field paths, with a special atmosphere at the start and finish. Alongside the sporting competition, the social aspect is also important: proceeds from the main race are donated to the Bastlergemeinschaft der Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is a popular community race with a family-friendly atmosphere and a long tradition in the region.
course_highlights: Varied loop course on the grounds of the Sophie Scholl Comprehensive School
The route passes through residential areas, along field paths and along Argestorfer Straße
Start and finish close to the event area, with a special atmosphere
additional: Late entries are possible up to one hour before the respective start, subject to an additional fee. The kindergarten and primary school races start at 17:00, and awards ceremonies take place shortly after the races. The 5 km race consists of two laps of the 2.5 km course, while the 10 km race consists of four laps. Entry in the main race automatically includes entry into the prize draw. Proceeds from the main race are donated. Various race distances, children’s and adult categories, donations to local associations.

name: Freimarktslauf
description: The Freimarktslauf in Garrel is the region’s largest fun run and offers a varied running experience for young and old, beginners and professionals, on its flat circuits. The event includes distances from a 400 m Bambini run to 10 km main races, held on a flat 2.5 km circuit through Garrel. Alongside the sporting competition, community and fun take centre stage, supported by RunClub Garrel, which specifically encourages beginners. With more than 1,300 participants, the race is a popular event filled with unforgettable moments.
course_highlights: Flat 2.5 km circuit through Garrel
All main races use the same circuit, with 1, 2 or 4 laps
A range of distances from 400 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: The race offers combined scoring for the 5 km and 10 km races. There are special races for children and young people, including a Bambini run, a taster run and a schoolchildren’s run. RunClub Garrel supports beginners and returning runners with group training sessions. The event is a large community gathering with more than 1,300 participants, and numerous photos and results are available online. The race includes various distances and is open to runners of all age groups. Registration is online, and the event is part of the region’s festivities.

name: Klausdorfer Kranichlauf
description: The Klausdorf Crane Run invites runners of all ages to enjoy a choice of running routes in the beautiful surroundings of Klausdorf. Times are recorded using a chip issued with the race bib. Every participant receives a certificate and a medal, and the top three finishers in each race are honored separately. Refreshments are provided along the route and at the finish, and changing rooms and toilets are available at the Vorpommernhus. The event offers a friendly, family atmosphere and is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: Scenic running routes through Klausdorf, Hohendorf, Wendisch-Langendorf, Zarrenzin, Barhöft and Prohn
Start and finish at the Vorpommernhus, close to the beach
Refreshments along the route and at the finish
additional: Late registration is available at the Vorpommernhus on 18.09.2026 from 18:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 07:00 to 09:30. The awards ceremony for the Landknirpselauf takes place immediately after the finish. Ample parking is available around the Vorpommernhus. Registration is possible by email or online. Participation is at your own risk. All participants receive medals and certificates. Refreshments are available at the finish and along the route. Parking is available.

name: Wilstermarsch Lauf
description: The Wilstermarschlauf is a traditional running event in Wilster, taking place for the 34th time on September 19, 2026. The event offers various distances for children and adults, including 400 m, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km, through the scenic Wilstermarsch. Alongside the sporting competition, a varied program featuring games, bouncy cushions, a DJ, a barbecue stand, and refreshments provides entertainment and a welcoming atmosphere for participants and spectators. The race is part of the Steinburg Cup and attracts several hundred runners each year, supported by numerous volunteers.
course_highlights: Runs through the scenic Wilstermarsch
Stadium laps for children, with enthusiastic support from spectators
5 km loop through Nortorf and Wilster, featuring a varied course
additional: The Wilstermarschlauf includes several races for different age groups and distances, including children’s races from 400 m, a 2 km children’s race, 5 km and 10 km races, and 5 km walking. There is an extensive program featuring bouncy cushions, a DJ, a barbecue stand, refreshments, and a photo wall. Around 40 volunteers support the event, which is part of the Steinburg Cup. Prizes and vouchers are raffled among participants, and the 33rd women to finish receive anniversary gifts. Registration is planned for spring 2026. The event is part of the Steinburg Cup and offers a family-friendly day with entertainment for everyone involved.

name: Wutzseelauf
description: The Wutzseelauf in Lindow (Mark) is a family-friendly public race, taking place for the 21st time on September 19, 2026. The varied courses run around Lake Wutzsee through Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park and offer running opportunities for all age groups, from Bambinis to experienced runners. The event is known for its welcoming atmosphere, professional chip timing and varied supporting program. Participants can look forward to distances from 600 meters to 22 kilometers, including Nordic walking. Award ceremonies take place after the races, and every finisher receives a certificate to download or have printed on site.
course_highlights: Courses around Lake Wutzsee in Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park
Distances from 600 m to 22 km for all age groups
Varied routes with forest and lakeside sections
additional: Timing is provided by myRacePartner using transponders integrated into the race bibs. Late entries can be made online on race day up to 10 minutes before the respective start, except for the Bambini races, which have no late-entry fee. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races. Every finisher can download their certificate online or have it printed on site. Course profiles for children, youths and adults, online registration, race bibs with transponders, various distances, routes through the forest and around Lake Wutzsee

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
location: Gontyniec, Chodzież, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race, lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km through the picturesque Gontyniec Massif. Competitors cover the greatest distance they can, with well-stocked aid stations available after every loop. The course offers changing scenery at different times of day, with beautiful views of the Noteć Valley and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as beehives shaped like ancient gods. It is a unique experience for runners seeking a challenge and unforgettable impressions.
course_highlights: Non-stop race on loops of approximately 10 km
Aid station for competitors after every loop
Views of the Noteć Valley and unique figurative beehives along the course
additional: The race lasts 6 or 12 hours non-stop. The course consists of loops of approximately 10 km. An aid station is available after every loop. Competitors can choose the 6- or 12-hour option. The course runs through the Gontyniec Massif, with scenic views and natural attractions. Trail, mountain and forest paths; participant limit of 150 in each race; preparation period of 8 to 20 weeks.

description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race taking place on September 19, 2026, in Sopot. The start and finish are located in the parking lot by the Forest Opera, and the course runs through the picturesque surroundings. The race is part of a series of four events held on different dates and at different locations in Sopot, offering participants a unique atmosphere and the chance to compete over a short distance. The participant limit is 250, ensuring an intimate and well-organized event.
course_highlights: A 5 km course around the Forest Opera in Sopot
Start and finish in the parking lot by the Forest Opera
The race takes place in picturesque parkland and green spaces
additional: The participant limit is 250. Only runners wearing race bibs and people performing organizational duties may be on the course. Runners line up at the start in the designated area. The finish is at the same location as the start. The event includes several editions, with the main race taking place on September 19, 2026; discounts are available to Sopot residents with a Karta Sopocka card; the courses include beach and park areas; participants receive medals and drinks.

name: Damloop by night 2026
description: The Damloop by night is a unique evening run of 5 English miles (8 km), starting in Amsterdam and finishing in Zaandam. The run is known for its festive atmosphere, with great beats and light effects, making it a nonstop party for all participants. The event combines a sporting challenge with a lively atmosphere, ideal for runners looking for a special experience.
course_highlights: Evening run of 5 English miles (8 km)
Starts in Amsterdam, finishes in Zaandam
Festive atmosphere with music and light effects
additional: The Damloop by night is a nonstop party with beats and light shows. There is a special registration procedure for fast runners who finished in the top 3 of the previous edition. Extra products are also available to order, such as the official On Running shirt. The organizers focus on safety and preventing runners from overheating. The event includes various race distances, virtual options, and a festive finale. The 8 km race is known for its festive atmosphere and starts and finishes at the Olympic Stadium.

name: Werkhoven Loopt 2026
description: Werkhoven Loopt is a friendly and sporty running event in the Kromme Rijn region, held annually on the third Saturday of September. The 11th edition in 2026 offers running opportunities for all ages, with distances of 1 and 2 km for children and 5 and 10 km for adults. The event is open to both recreational and competitive runners and is known for its welcoming, accessible atmosphere. Enthusiastic volunteers help make it an unforgettable day.
course_highlights: Run through the beautiful Kromme Rijn region
Distances for children (1 and 2 km) and adults (5 and 10 km)
A friendly atmosphere with activities on the Brink
additional: Race numbers can be collected between 15:00 and 17:15. A warm-up is scheduled for 16:25. The event is suitable for all ages and abilities, with a festive atmosphere and various activities at the Brink hospitality square. Distances: 1 km (kids’ run), 2 km, 5 km, 10 km; advance registration is recommended; the event takes place at De Brink 5 in Werkhoven.

description: The 4 Mijl van Assen is an annual running event held in the Marsdijk district of Assen, starting and finishing at Anne Frank Plein. This ninth edition, on 19 September 2026, combines sport with a lively festival featuring music, attractions, a fair and a sports market. The run is suitable for all ages, with various categories including the main 4-mile distance, a College Run and a free Univé Kids Run for primary school pupils. The race also marks the start of Asser Sports Week and is an important event in the AssenRuns running circuit.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Anne Frank Plein in the Marsdijk district
Course through Assen’s northernmost district
Includes special events for frame runners (2 miles and 4 miles)
additional: The main 4-mile distance has a single start at 14:00, with the front starting pen reserved for the fastest runners. The Univé Kids Run starts at 11:55 with a group warm-up and is free, including a kids’ shirt and medal (while supplies last). Clinics are also offered for different groups to help them prepare for the 4 miles. On race day, a festival featuring music, attractions, a fair and a sports market takes place in Anne Frank Park. Registration is currently closed; the event includes running races, a festival, Kids Runs, a College Run, clinics and a sports market.

name: Nijmegen-Rotterdam
description: The Nijmegen-Rotterdam is the longest continuous walking event in the Netherlands, covering a distance of 160 km. The event starts on Saturday 19 September 2026 at 11.00 in Nijmegen and finishes on Sunday 20 September in Rotterdam. The route was renewed in 2022 and is improved every year, with six refreshments stops and various support stations along the way. The organisers provide a safe and well-supported walking experience, including first aid and foot care. Participants who complete the event successfully receive a certificate and a special keepsake.
course_highlights: 160 km continuous walking route from Nijmegen to Rotterdam
Six refreshments stops and several free support stations along the way
Route renewed in 2022 and improved every year
additional: The event starts in groups from Sporthal De Boog in Nijmegen. Registration is open from 9.30 to 10.30. Wearing a reflective vest is mandatory during the night; one can be rented or purchased at the start. An experienced first-aid and foot-care team will be on hand. A meal is served after approximately 60 km. If you withdraw, the entry fee is refunded minus a €5 administration fee. Discounts may be available for federation members and members of other associations. 160 km route, start in Nijmegen, finish in Rotterdam, including refreshments stops, support stations, a meal and first aid; reflective vests and flashlights are recommended.

name: Run & Roast Eindhoven
location: Museumpark VONK, Eindhoven, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Run & Roast Eindhoven takes place on Saturday, 19 September. Participants can choose between a 5 or 10 kilometre race, and there is also a 1-kilometre kids’ run for primary school children. The course is flat, fast and well paved, with the start and finish at Museumpark VONK in the renovated PreHistorische Dorp in Genneper Parken. After the run, participants can enjoy a delicious plant-based Beyond Meat burger, music and a convivial atmosphere with food trucks. There are great prizes for the fastest runners and special discounts for participants.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 5 or 10 kilometre course through Genneper Parken
Start and finish at Museumpark VONK, the renovated PreHistorische Dorp
Well-paved route with one or two laps
additional: Race numbers can be collected on race day from 15:00 at Brasserie Vonk. Registration includes a plant-based Beyond Meat burger. Participants receive discount vouchers for All4running and Virtuoos nutritional supplements. Prize winners receive, among other things, Karhu running shoes, Shokz headphones and supplement packs. There will be music and a convivial atmosphere with food trucks after the finish. Flat course, start and finish at Museumpark VONK, including a burger, music, food trucks and a kids’ run.
