description: The 11th edition of the Kwintelooyen Run takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, in the beautiful Utrechtse Heuvelrug nature area near Rhenen. This running event offers four distances: a 1 km kids’ run, and 5 km, 10 km and 15 km routes that run entirely on natural terrain. The run supports charities that help children and young people with disabilities. Participants receive an exclusive Puma running shirt and a medal at the finish, making the event both sporty and festive.
course_highlights: The course runs entirely on natural terrain: forest paths, sandy paths, single trails and semi-paved paths
Beautiful climbs and panoramic views of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Quiet, traffic-free routes with no asphalt, cobblestones or traffic lights
additional: The kids’ run starts at 11:00, the 5 km at 12:00, the 10 km at 13:30 and the 15 km at 14:00. Participants in the 5 km, 10 km and 15 km receive an exclusive Puma running shirt when they collect their race number. Every runner receives a medal at the finish. Registration at the reduced rate is open through September 13; late registration is possible until September 18, while race bibs remain available. The event supports two charities: Stichting Netwerk voor Jou and Stichting De Wijde Mantel Q-Dreams. Register by September 13, 2026, for a discount; late registration is available. Participants receive medals and running shirts. The event takes place in Rhenen, in the Utrechtse Heuvelrug.

description: The Woellust Run is a friendly, accessible running event in Groningen, with distances for both children and adults. The 2.5-kilometre course winds through the neighbourhood with no fewer than 30 turns and plenty of enthusiastic supporters along the route. Children can take part in the 500- and 1,000-metre races, while adults can choose between 5 and 10 kilometres. There are great prizes to be won, including prize money for the top three in the 5- and 10-kilometre races and a special prize for setting a new course record.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km course with 30 turns
Run through the neighbourhood with plenty of supporters
Children’s races of 500 m and 1,000 m; adults’ races of 5 and 10 km
additional: Registration on the day of the run incurs a surcharge of € 2,50 per entry. The minimum age for the children’s 500 m race is 4–9 years, for the 1,000 m race 4–11 years, and for the 5 and 10 km races 10 years. The children’s race awards ceremony is at 14:30; the 5 and 10 km awards ceremony is at 16:00. Prize money is awarded to the top three in the 5 and 10 km races, and there is a special Primera course-record prize for new records in the 5 and 10 km races. The course starts at the intersection of Duintjerlaan and Sterrenboschlaan. Registration is open, with prizes for the top three and course records.

description: The Mini Marathon Zeewolde is an accessible running event held annually, with distances of 1.1 km, 2.1 km and 4.2 km for participants of different ages. The event has a friendly atmosphere and supports the Conor Cares foundation, which works to fight childhood cancer. Start groups are divided by age, and prizes are awarded to the fastest runners in each category. Registration is free until 17 September; after that, the entry fee is 5.50 euros per participant.
course_highlights: Distances of 1.1 km, 2.1 km and 4.2 km
Start groups divided by age
Friendly atmosphere with activities at Kerkplein
additional: The prize ceremonies are around 14:45 for the 1.1 km and 15:15 for the 2.1 km and 4.2 km. There is a relay category, with prizes for the fastest team across three age categories. After the finish, there is plenty to see and do at Kerkplein. Distances of 1.1 km, 2.1 km and 4.2 km, including age-based start groups; a fundraiser for childhood cancer; registration is free until 17 September, then 5.50 euros.

Distances include the 1 km Kidsrun/FrameRunners, 2.8 km, 5 km, 10 km and half marathon. The routes head towards Camminghaburen and the Groene Ster. After the race, every participant receives a bag of products from FrieslandCampina, Dr. Oetker and Royal Koopmans. The Condensloop is excellent preparation for the Amsterdam or Eindhoven Marathon. Participation is at your own risk.

Routes towards Camminghaburen and the Groene Ster
Distances from 1 km to the half marathon

description: The Open Dutch National Stair Climbing Championship in Appelscha is an exciting stair-climbing race specially for young people aged 10 to 16. Participants race up the stairs of the Bosbergtoren as fast as possible, with speed and fitness at the heart of the event. The race takes place during the festive Bloeiweek and offers a unique chance to conquer the Bosberg and test your fitness. There is also a free fitness test in the parking lot of restaurant De Bosberg. Participation is free, but registration through Loopsportvereniging Invictus is required.
course_highlights: Climb the stairs of the Bosbergtoren
Start from the Boerestreek in the direction of the Bosbergtoren
Viewpoint at the top of the Bosberg
additional: Participants gather between 11:15 and 11:30 on the Boerestreek. A free fitness test is available in the parking lot of restaurant De Bosberg. Participation is at your own risk. Start time: 12:00. Registration is required for young participants. Event location: Bosbergtoren in Appelscha.

name: Run2day Bosloop Veenhuizen
description: The Run2day Bosloop in Veenhuizen is a friendly, small-scale running event held four times a year. The routes pass through the forests and heathland around Veenhuizen, with distances of 3, 5 and 10 kilometres, each on its own course. The start is at the sports hall on Kerklaan, which also has changing and shower facilities. The event is suitable for all ages and attracts an average of 40 to 100 participants per edition.
course_highlights: Routes through the forests and heathland around Veenhuizen
Distances of 3, 5 and 10 kilometres, each with its own route
Start and facilities at the sports hall on Kerklaan in Veenhuizen
additional: You can register on site from 9:00 to 10:15 or in advance using the registration form on the website, up to the Thursday before the event. Times are recorded, and results are available online within 2 days. A laptop displaying the recorded times is available in the sports hall canteen. The event takes place four times a year, with registration available in advance via the website or on site on the day. It is a small-scale event suitable for all ages.

name: Bolloop Lunetten
description: Bolloop Lunetten is a running event in the Lunetten neighbourhood of Utrecht, organised by Bewoners Overleg Lunetten together with Utrecht Atletiek. The event is part of Wijkdag and offers a 1 km Kids Run for children up to age 12, and 5 km and 10 km distances for older participants. The 10 km is open to participants aged 16 and over, while anyone aged 4 and over can take part in the other distances. It is a classic road race with no frills, ideal for families, recreational runners and anyone who wants to run close to home. The event has been a fixture in the Lunetten calendar for several years and is celebrating an anniversary this year.
course_highlights: Road race in the Lunetten neighbourhood of Utrecht
Distances: 1 km Kids Run, 5 km and 10 km
Open to participants aged 4 and over (10 km from age 16)
additional: Registration is via Inschrijven.nl. The event offers a safe and organised environment for participants. Typical September weather is mild, with temperatures around 19°C and little rainfall. Road race, distances: 5 km, 10 km, Kids Run, registration via Inschrijven.nl

name: ‘kLEEF Run
description: The ‘kLEEF Run & Walk 2026 is a running event organized by Atletiekvereniging Veluwe in Apeldoorn. The event offers a sporty and convivial atmosphere for both runners and walkers. The start and finish are at Sportpark Orderbos, a well-known venue with good facilities. The event is suitable for different levels and ages, and participants can enjoy a scenic route in the surrounding area.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sportpark Orderbos in Apeldoorn
Route through the natural surroundings of the Veluwe
Suitable for both runners and walkers
additional: The organizers provide changing rooms and shower facilities at CSV for AV Veluwe members on training and event days. The sports park is easily accessible by public transport and car. No specific information about start times, pricing or registration was found on the pages. Registration includes a race number, training courses and a reflective vest; location: Sportpark Orderbos, Apeldoorn

description: The Helderse Vallei Trailrun 2026 is an atmospheric trail run celebrating its sixth edition this year, in memory of Ineke Smit, one of the founders of this trail. The focus is on enjoying the natural surroundings and running on as many unpaved paths as possible, without timekeeping or performance pressure. The routes start at the open-air theatre at Helderse Vallei in Den Helder and offer various distances for adults and children. There are aid stations with water and fruit along the way, and the organisers are working with Stichting Vredesbeweging PAX Nederland on a peace collection.
course_highlights: Trail run on as many unpaved paths as possible
Aid stations with water and fruit along the way
Start and finish at the open-air theatre at Helderse Vallei
additional: You can register in advance via inschrijven.nl or on race day at the Helderse Vallei visitor centre from 09:30. There is no timekeeping or registration during the run. The organisers are working with Stichting Vredesbeweging PAX Nederland, and a collection box for donations to PAX will be available. Trail run on unpaved paths, beach and dunes; no timekeeping; routes start between 10:00 and 11:00, with aid stations offering water and fruit.

name: Run for Care
location: Krimpen aan de Lek, South Holland, Netherlands
description: On Saturday, September 19, 2026, the very first Run for Care will take place in the Krimpenerhout recreation area, near Krimpen aan de Lek. This is a 5- or 10-kilometer sponsored run for runners and walkers, where the goal is not the fastest time but the biggest heart. Participants can take part individually or as a team and raise sponsorship money to provide help and hope in Eastern Europe and Central Asia. Alongside the run, there will be a lively fair at the De Groene Weg charity shop, so family and friends can enjoy the day too.
course_highlights: A 5- or 10-kilometer sponsored run in the Krimpenerhout recreation area
Starts at 13:00; take part individually or as a team
A lively fair at the De Groene Weg charity shop on the same day
additional: Participants can register as individuals or as a team and create a personal fundraising page to raise sponsorship money. The event is being held to celebrate the 40th anniversary of OostEuropa Zending / Christian Care East West in Krimpen aan de Lek. Running and walking; participants aged 16 and over; registration open until September 16; includes a fair with activities for all ages.

name: Hökensås Trail
description: Hökensås Trail is a trail race taking place on 20 September 2026 in the area around First Camp Hökensås, outside Tidaholm. The race offers three distances: 19 km, 11.5 km and 5.5 km, with the start and finish at First Camp Hökensås between 10:00 and 14:00. Organizer CKU6 (Cykelklubben U6) offers the race as part of Motionsloppet, in collaboration with Grebbestad Multisport, according to the information provided. The terrain combines forest roads and trails with roots and rocks, offering nature-close challenges in the Hökensås area.
course_highlights: Distances: 19 km, 11.5 km and 5.5 km
Start and finish at First Camp Hökensås in Tidaholm
Start times between 10:00 and 14:00
additional: Distances: 19 km, 11.5 km and 5.5 km; starts from First Camp Hökensås; Start times 10:00–14:00; Sports drink supplier: Umara; Organizer: CKU6 as part of Motionsloppet; Contact: hokensastrail@motionsloppet.se

name: Billingehusloppet
description: Billingehusloppet is a traditional cross-country race organised by IFK Skövde (now run by IFK Skövde Skidor), with a history dating back to 1966. Since 1993, both men and women have competed in the main 10.5 km race, which has strong local and historical roots and listed course records. In recent years, the event has expanded to include categories for younger runners and a Nordic walking category. Welcome to a classic cross-country challenge in the beautiful surroundings of Billingen.
course_highlights: A traditional cross-country race on the slopes of Billingen
Main distance: 10.5 km (since 1993), on varied terrain
Categories for younger runners (Knatteloppet, Lilla Billingehusloppet) and Nordic walking
additional: Organised by IFK Skövde Skidor. Course records are listed on the website (e.g. Men’s 10.5 km: 31:51; Women’s 10.5 km: 37:44). There is an archive of results, separate shorter children’s races, and a Nordic walking category. Cross-country race distances range from 1.6 km to 10.5 km; Nordic walking is available on all courses; Knatteloppet and Lilla Billingehusloppet are for younger runners; results and registration are available via links on the Svenskalag page.

name: Coop Linköping Runt
price_range: Gratis för LGIF-medlemmar; övriga deltagare pris ej angivet
description: COOP Linköping Runt is a city race in Linköping, starting and finishing in Trädgårdsföreningen. The race is organised by Linköpings GIF (LGIF) in collaboration with COOP Linköping, and registration is through cooplinkopingrunt.se. For LGIF members, the race is free with the campaign code LGIF2024; the price for other participants is listed on the website. The event is also looking for volunteers and offers a clear city-run experience in central Linköping.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Trädgårdsföreningen, in central Linköping
A city run focused on central Linköping
The LGIF2024 campaign code makes the race free for LGIF members
additional: The website includes sections on Time & place, Registration fee, Registration, Timing, Prizes, Time limit, Race bibs, Race confirmation, Transfer of entry, Category change, Unable to attend/Insurance, Changing & showers, Bag drop, Toilets, Warm-up, Food & drink, Energy, Medical care, Results and Terms. Registration through cooplinkopingrunt.se; campaign code LGIF2024 makes the race free for LGIF members; volunteers are wanted.

name: Trollhättan City Trail
description: Trollhättan City Trail is a trail race in central Trollhättan, starting and finishing at Folkets Park. The courses follow technical trails and many staircases along the waterfall and canal lock area, offering varied, hilly terrain with sections of gravel and asphalt. The event offers several distances for both experienced trail runners and recreational runners—from the Mini Trail children’s race to the longer Half Marathon+. Runners with dogs are also welcome in designated start groups.
course_highlights: Technical, winding trails and challenging staircases in central Trollhättan
Passes sights including Kopparklinten, Gamle Dal, several canal locks, Olidan and Kungsgrottan
Varied, hilly terrain with sections of gravel and asphalt; the 22.5 km course includes an extra loop with more technical trails
additional: Bib pickup from 11:30 at the start (Folkets Park). Marked and signposted changing rooms are available at Arena Älvhögsborg (Storgatan 1). Toilets are available at the start and in the changing area. There are three aid stations with water and sports drink along the course, plus an aid station at the finish. Trollhättan Mini Trail (0.8 km) is a children’s race with no timing. The 8.5 km and 14 km distances are also open to dogs on a leash in separate start groups (in cooperation with MIMsafe). GPX files are available; start times according to the race information: Trollhättan Mini Trail at 13:00, other distances at 14:00 and 14:15; aid stations along the course and at the finish; bag storage at the start/finish; changing rooms at Arena Älvhögsborg.

name: Bedburger Citylauf 2026
description: The GVG Citylauf Bedburg takes place on September 13, 2026, in the town center of Bedburg. The races run through the traffic-free town center, with the start and finish on the market square in front of the town hall. Various distances are offered, from a 300-meter children’s race to the 10 km main race, as well as relay events. The race is suitable for all age groups and offers a great opportunity to experience Bedburg in motion.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the market square in front of the town hall
Routes run through Bedburg’s traffic-free town center
The 10 km main race consists of five laps through the town center
additional: Late registration is possible on race day up to one hour before the respective start, with a €3.00 late-registration fee (except for the Bambini race, which is free to enter). Headphones, MP3 players, jogging strollers, and dogs are not permitted for safety reasons. Multiple race distances; registration online and on site up to one hour before the start; no dogs or headphones on the course.

name: Aerzener twinfit-Volkslauf
price_range: € 5,– bis € 9,– je nach Lauf und Anmeldung

description: The Aerzener twinfit Volkslauf is a family-friendly running event offering various distances. It starts and finishes in Aerzen. Events include 5 km and 10 km fun runs, a 5 km company and team run, a 1.8 km schoolchildren’s run, and a free children’s run. The event takes place on September 20, 2026, and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments and an awards ceremony. The races are scored according to DLV rules, and participants can win prizes and enter a raffle.
course_highlights: Start and finish at twinfit, Königsförder Straße 19, 31855 Aerzen
5 km and 10 km fun runs, plus a 5 km company and team run
1.8 km schoolchildren’s run and free children’s run
additional: Late registration is available on September 20, 2026, from 9:00–9:45 a.m.; for the schoolchildren’s run, until 11:45 a.m. Changing facilities with showers are available at twinfit. The awards ceremony is scheduled for around 1:30 p.m., with certificates for places 1–3 and a raffle. Drinks are available along the course and snacks in the finish area. Parking is available at twinfit. Events for children and young people. Registration opens on August 1, 2026; late registration is available on the day of the event. Scoring according to DLV rules, prizes and certificates, company and team run, parking at the event venue.

name: Druffeler Volkslauf
description: The Druffeler Volkslauf takes place on 20 September 2026 in Rietberg-Druffel and offers timed races over 1 km and 10 km. The event supports a solidarity initiative in sport that promotes running and maintains a relief fund for the families of injured runners. laufen.de members can benefit from the “Book smart, pay less!” offer. The course is officially measured and suitable for record purposes.
course_highlights: Timed races over 1 km and 10 km
Start in Rietberg-Druffel
Typical September weather: around 19 °C, with mostly cloudy skies
additional: Registration supports a solidarity initiative in sport and a relief fund for injured runners. Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with a minimum of 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation; skies are usually cloudy. Discounted registration is available through laufen.de; the event supports charitable causes. Ask the organizer for details before registering.

name: Herbstlauf und 29. Wandertag Fleckenberg
location: Sportplatz auf der Latroper Straße, Fleckenberg, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 39th Autumn Run and Hiking Day in Fleckenberg takes place on September 20, 2026, at the sports field on Latroper Straße. The event is a scoring race in the Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup and features a scenic 15 km loop with varied terrain. The route follows forest paths, a paved climb, and some rocky sections, making well-cushioned running shoes ideal. Changing rooms and showers are available, as are food and drink sales. After the race, an awards ceremony will be held, with certificates and trophies.
course_highlights: 15 km loop starting at the sports field, elevation 360 m
Varied route with a paved climb, firm forest paths, and some rocky terrain
The return route follows the final kilometres of the Rothaarsteig Marathon
additional: Indoor changing rooms and showers are available. A wide selection of food and drinks will be on sale. The awards ceremony begins at approximately 12 noon, with awards for the children’s and youth races. Every participant receives a certificate; the fastest runner receives a trophy. Scoring race in the Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup; start and finish at the sports field on Latroper Straße; indoor changing rooms, showers, refreshments, and certificates for all finishers.

name: Lauf Rund um den Fühlinger See
location: Fühlinger See, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 15€ für 10 km und 5 km, 10€ für Jugend, Kinder kostenfrei, Nachmeldung 5€
description: The Rund um den Fühlinger See Run is a traditional road race in Cologne, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers a wide range of distances for runners of all ages: a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and a 1 km children’s run. The courses loop around the regatta course used for the 1998 World Rowing Championships and are measured by the DLV, allowing performances to qualify for rankings. The race is an ideal test ahead of the Generali Cologne Marathon and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, attractive medals, and non-cash prizes for age-group participants.
course_highlights: Course loops around the regatta course used for the 1998 World Rowing Championships
Courses measured by the DLV and accompanied by a course certificate
Road-race routes with little traffic in Cologne-Fühlingen
additional: Timing is provided by a disposable chip attached to the race number, included in the entry fee. Late entries are possible online up to 30 minutes before the start (adults: €5; children/youth: free). Race packets will be distributed on race day from 08:45 at the boathouse on Fühlinger See. Changing rooms and showers are available in the boathouse. Non-cash prizes are awarded to the first three in each age group, and attractive medals to the first three finishers in each race. Measured courses, DLV-measured courses, start times from 09:30, free parking, changing rooms and showers at the Fühlinger See boathouse, music and refreshments on site.

name: Möhnesee-Pokal-Lauf = Mehr als eine Herausforderung
description: The 38th Möhnesee-Pokal-Lauf, under the motto “More than a challenge,” takes place on September 20, 2026, in Möhnesee-Günne. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 30 km, and challenges participants with a demanding course. The race is known for its varied scenery and the special atmosphere at Möhnesee. Runners can look forward to a sporting challenge in beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km and 30 km race distances
Venue in Möhnesee-Günne, surrounded by scenic countryside
Typical September weather, with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies
additional: The race takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026. Average temperatures are around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night. Approximately 45 mm of precipitation is expected, with mostly cloudy skies. The race is held in September, with typical temperatures around 19 °C; checking with the organizer for further details before registering is recommended.

name: Seidenraupen Cross
location: Hülser Bruch, Krefeld, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Seidenraupen Cross in Krefeld is one of the most interesting cross-country races in North Rhine-Westphalia, organised in a friendly, family atmosphere. Runners can look forward to challenging 6.5 km and 16 km courses through Krefeld’s largest nature reserve, the Hülser Bruch, with tough climbs, fast descents and beautiful natural scenery. Alongside the main races, there are also children’s races at the Hülser district sports complex. The event offers a varied, nature-filled running experience for beginners and experienced runners alike.
course_highlights: Run through the Hülser Bruch nature reserve, with three hills
Tough climbs and fast descents
Children’s races on a variety of surfaces (grass, sand pits and cinder track)
additional: The start for hikers, walkers and Nordic walkers is at 10 a.m. Registration is open until one hour before the race. The course distances are approximately 6.5 km and 16 km, and can also be covered on foot. The children’s races take place at the sports complex on Hölschen Dyk. The event supports social projects every year. Trail and cross-country sections; routes on forest and hiking trails; start and finish at the Hölschen Dyk sports ground; registration until one hour before the race.

name: Kassel Marathon
description: The Kassel Marathon is the largest sporting event in North Hesse and takes place from September 18 to 20, 2026, at Auestadion Kassel. The event offers a range of races, including a marathon, half marathon, power walking, relay and corporate run, as well as children’s races. The marathon course includes 200 metres of elevation gain and runs through the city of Kassel. Participants receive a finisher medal and a free finisher shirt. Runners are supported by medical care from the German Red Cross and post-race massage services.
course_highlights: Marathon course with 200 metres of elevation gain
Start and finish at Auestadion Kassel
A range of races, from the marathon to the Bambini run
additional: Finishers receive a medal and a free finisher shirt (sizes XS–XXL). A free post-race massage is available at Auestadion. Medical care is provided by the German Red Cross and a medical team. The certificate can be downloaded and printed online; no printing is available on site. The main event takes place at Auestadion and includes a medal, certificate, finisher shirt, medical care, massage and refreshments; registration is available online; participants must have been born in 2008 or earlier.

description: The PSD Bank Half Marathon in Hamburg is a fast, flat running event through the Wandsbek district, taking runners as far north as Berne U-Bahn station. The route heads back via Rahlstedt and Tonndorf to the start and finish area on Wandsbeker Marktstraße. The race is known for its unique atmosphere, with support from spectators and live bands along the course, and takes place in late summer at dusk.
course_highlights: Fast, flat course through the Wandsbek district
Northernmost point at Berne U-Bahn station
Strong support from spectators and bands along the course
additional: Bag drop on race day from 08:30 to 13:30 at Wandsbeker Wochenmarkt. The start and finish are on Wandsbeker Marktstraße in front of Quarree shopping centre. Race pack collection takes place on 19 and 20 September 2026. Services include medical emergency care, a closed and secured race course, and a finisher’s medal. Results and personalised certificates are available online. The event also includes the Köhlbrandbrückenlauf and offers detailed information about the course, registration, and results.

name: 14. Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra
description: The Northeim Daylight Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon held in Northeim. The route passes through varied terrain and offers a special challenge for experienced ultrarunners. The event has a long tradition, with numerous finishers and records underscoring the race’s high quality and sporting demands. Participants can download the route’s GPX track to prepare optimally.
course_highlights: A long ultramarathon distance of over 100 km
Varied terrain with a daylight-running character
Course records of over 125 km (men) and 104 km (women)
additional: The route’s GPX track can be downloaded. The event has a long history, with finisher numbers and course records. The pages do not provide explicit prices or start times. The event takes place twice a year, in March and September, and has been held multiple times since 2018. The routes are available as GPX files, making preparation easier.

name: 28. Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The 28th Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf is a friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. The event offers courses of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied program including face painting for children. The event is open to all runners; club membership is not required.
course_highlights: Distances from 1.4 km to 21.3 km (half marathon)
Start and finish at the SVE Hiddestorf sports field
Friendly atmosphere with a runners’ breakfast and food and refreshments
additional: Race numbers and chips will be issued on event day from 7:00 a.m. Timing is by chip; chips must be returned after the race. A free Möhrrchenlauf (500 m) for children up to 6 years old is offered, with no registration or entry fee required. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports club/tennis club facilities close to the start and finish. Parking is limited, with parking areas no more than 500 m away on foot. Late entries are possible online only, until the registration deadline. The runners’ breakfast is free for all participants and includes cheese, salami, baguette and red wine (for those aged 18 and over). Distances: 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and 21.3 km; online registration; the event takes place at the sports field in Hiddestorf; parking is limited.

name: 8. Altstadtlauf Salzwedel
description: The Altstadtlauf Salzwedel is part of the Elbe-Ohre-Cup and will take place for the eighth time in 2026. The course runs through the historic old town of Salzwedel on a 5 km loop. The longer distances, 10 km and half marathon, are run over multiple laps accordingly. The event is organized by Sportclub Demker ´95 e.V. and offers runners in northern Saxony-Anhalt an attractive racing opportunity.
course_highlights: Loop through the historic old town of Salzwedel
5 km loop as the basis for all distances
Longer distances (10 km, half marathon) run over multiple laps
additional: The event recorded 223 finishers in 2023 and offers running opportunities for all age groups, including Bambini and youth races.

name: Uentroper Geithelauf
description: The 24th Uentroper Geithelauf takes place on September 20, 2026, and takes runners through the green heart of Uentrop. The event is organized by Turn- und Sportverein 46/68 Uentrop e.V. and offers a sporting community in a natural setting. The routes pass through fields and forest paths in the surrounding area and are suitable for a range of fitness levels. The event emphasizes fun, community, and a welcoming atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes through the green heart of Uentrop
Scenic paths through fields and forests
Suitable for a range of fitness levels
additional: The running groups are divided so that no one is overwhelmed and everyone can find their own pace. Experienced instructors support participants with technique and preparation. The event encourages flexibility and the enjoyment of running as a group. Run through the green heart of Uentrop. Date: September 20, 2026

name: CANOSSA Benefiz Berglauf
location: Burgberg, Bad Harzburg, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The CANOSSA Charity Mountain Run® in Bad Harzburg is a challenging charity run through the Harz National Park, taking place on September 20, 2026. Participants can complete the course running, walking or hiking; it ends at the CANOSSA Column on Burgberg. The event supports inclusive work with children and young people in the Goslar district and combines a sporting challenge with social commitment. After the run, participants can enjoy a festive post-race event with music, refreshments and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: The course passes through a protected area in the Harz National Park
Highest point at Luisenbank above the Eckertalsperre (12 km course)
Wonderful views of the Brocken and mixed forests from the level hillside path
additional: Race bibs are available from 8:30 a.m. upon submission of a signed liability waiver. Two courses: 12 km run (starts at 10:00 a.m.) for runners aged 16 and over, and 6 km run (starts at 10:30 a.m.) for runners, walkers and hikers aged 10 and over. There are no course signs due to nature conservation requirements; participants can navigate using course marshals and Harz Club information signs. After the run, there will be music and refreshments on Burgberg, followed by an awards ceremony at around 12:00 p.m., with a unique indulgence certificate for all participants. It is possible to take the gondola up in exchange for a donation of at least 30 euros. The cable car’s last descent is at 6:00 p.m. The event is open to runners, walkers and hikers aged 10 and over. There are no course signs, only markers, and the event promotes environmental protection by asking participants not to leave any waste in nature. The event concludes with a program including music and refreshments on Burgberg.

name: Citylauf Leer
description: The Citylauf Leer is a traditional running event taking place on September 20, 2026, in downtown Leer at Denkmalsplatz. The event offers races for various age groups and distances, including Bambino, Teeny, 5 km, and 10 km races. The course follows closed circuits through the town center, with refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area. All participants receive a T-shirt (while supplies last), and attractive prizes and certificates are awarded to the top runners. The event offers individual and team classifications and takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Closed 2.5 km circuit (green) through the town center for the 5 km and 10 km races
Closed 1.1 km circuit (yellow) for the Bambino and Teeny races
Refreshment stations along the course and in the finish area at Denkmalsplatz
additional: Race bibs can be collected at Denkmalsplatz on event day from 10:00. Late registrations are accepted on event day from 10:00 until 45 minutes before the respective start. Each participant receives a T-shirt in exchange for returning their race bib, while supplies last. The top three finishers in each race receive prizes/vouchers and a certificate/medal. There is a team classification for the 5 km race, with at least 3 runners per team. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Animals are not permitted to participate. Course on a closed circuit through the town center, refreshments along the course, online certificate printing, team classification, race bibs with deposit, no animals permitted.

name: Grebinlauf
description: The Grebinlauf takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, in Grebin and offers varied courses for runners, walkers, children, and relay teams. The event is known for its great atmosphere and a special finish on the Grebin sports field. One highlight is the turnaround point at Grebin Mill, which makes the course unique. Registration is through the Davengo platform.
course_highlights: Varied courses
Special turnaround point at Grebin Mill
Finish on the Grebin sports field
additional: Events: Schmarkrunde / Nordic Walking – 4.5 km; Krümellauf for children – 2.3 km. Registration through Davengo. Events: Schmarkrunde / Nordic Walking (4.5 km), Krümellauf for children (2.3 km). Registration through Davengo.

name: Heidelauf Halle am 20.09.2026
description: The 278th Heidelauf Halle takes place on 20 September 2026 in Halle (Saale) and is organised by SV Halle Triathlon. The event gives runners of different age groups and ability levels the opportunity to take part in a long-established race. The course runs around the Heidebad and offers varied running scenery. Registration is open until race day.
course_highlights: Race around the Heidebad in Halle (Saale)
Various categories for children, youth, adults and masters
Long-established event with over 270 years of history
additional: The registration deadline is race day, 20 September 2026. The organiser is SV Halle Triathlon. The event is classified as a non-stadium event (category 6.5.1). It takes place at Am Heidebad 10 in Halle (Saale). Registration is by email. Various categories are offered for different age groups.

name: Horster Löwenlauf
location: Schloss Horst, Gelsenkirchen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 2nd Horster Löwenlauf takes place on September 20, 2026, around Schloss Horst in Gelsenkirchen. This sporting event offers a lively, welcoming atmosphere for all age groups, with refreshments and entertainment in the castle park. Following the great success of the inaugural event, the race is once again being organized as a sporting highlight for the Horst district. The event takes place on World Children’s Day, which is considered especially fitting.
course_highlights: Race around Schloss Horst and the former racecourse
Event in the castle park with refreshments and entertainment
Community sporting event for all age groups
additional: Regular registration is open until September 11, 2026; late registration is available until September 18, 2026, for an additional fee. A race shirt can be added as an option (design to follow). The event is expected to run until approximately 2:00 p.m. It also includes children’s and Bambini races, with a particular focus on families and community. Online registration is available.

name: Lohelauf
description: The Lohelauf in Wentorf bei Hamburg is a traditional race taking place for the 21st time in 2026. The event offers a range of distances for different age groups and ability levels, including races from 1.5 km to 9 km and a 5 km walking route. The race takes place in the beautiful Wentorfer Lohe conservation area and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and team spirit. On event day, a tent village at the dog park serves as the start and finish area, where participants collect their race numbers and enjoy the event.
course_highlights: Routes through the Wentorfer Lohe conservation area
Various laps from 1.5 km to 9 km depending on age group
Start and finish at the dog park, with a tent village
additional: The Lohelauf takes place on 20.09.2026 from 10:00 to 13:00. On event day, a tent village at the dog park serves as the start and finish area. The event is open to all age groups, with age-appropriate routes. Results and certificates are available online after the race. The Lohelauf offers distances of 1.5 km, 3 km, 6 km, 9 km and 5 km walking. Registration is through RaceResult. On-site amenities include refreshments, bicycle parking, and medals and certificates for all participants. The event regularly attracts numerous runners from the region.

name: Mommelsteinlauf
description: The Mommelsteinlauf in Floh-Seligenthal, district of Hohleborn, is a family-friendly running event organized by SV 1962 Hohleborn. From the Bambini run and youth and beginner courses to the challenging 32 km trail, every runner and Nordic walker can find a suitable distance. The courses are marked and have aid stations from 8 km onward. The event offers timing with race-number transponders and medical support. Participants can enjoy refreshments and a coffee-and-cake buffet at the finish.
course_highlights: Distances from 500 m to 32 km south of the Rennsteig
Aid stations from 8 km onward (Holzplatz Brotterode, Weinberg intersection, Tennelberg hut)
Up to 1,100 m of elevation gain on the 32 km course
additional: Start times: 09:00 32 km Ausdauerpfad, 09:10 500 m Bambinilauf, 09:30 1 km Fuchstrail, 10:00 4 km youth and beginner run, 10:00 8 km Traditionslauf & Nordic Walking, 10:00 16 km Traditionslauf & Nordic Walking. The finish closes for all distances at 13:30. Services: toilets and showers (limited), changing rooms, medical support, certificate printing and online results, coffee-and-cake buffet, snack service. Registration opens on 1 June 2025; parking available on site, refreshments at aid stations, timing by GO-Timing, various distances for all age groups.

description: The Sparkassen Coastal Marathon in Otterndorf is a traditional race on the North Sea coast, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers various distances, from a Bambini run for kindergarten children to the classic marathon covering 42.195 km. The routes pass through the historic old town, along the Elbe dike and by the water, providing a varied and scenic running experience. In addition to the marathon, there are half-marathon, 10 km and 5 km races, as well as relay and walking events. The event emphasizes community, endurance and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Route through the historic old town and along the Elbe dike
Marathon over four laps, combining varied city and countryside scenery
Half-marathon and other distances by the water and on paved paths
additional: The Bambini run is limited to 300 children from daycare centers in the Samtgemeinde Land Hadeln and is non-competitive. There are various age groups and classifications for schoolchildren. The event offers free parking, bag storage, and one hour of free use of the Otterndorf saltwater thermal baths (excluding the sauna) upon presentation of a race bib. There is a Cuxland classification with cash prizes for runners from the district of Cuxhaven. Award ceremonies are held in stages by distance and classification at the Historic Town Hall. The event takes place on the Elbe dike and in Otterndorf’s historic old town, with special categories such as handbikers and walkers. It is a family-friendly event with a strong sense of community.

name: Uplengener RVB Herbstmarktlauf
location: Raiffeisen-Volksbank, Reetstr. 13, Uplengen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Uplengener RVB Autumn Market Run takes place on September 20, 2026, in Uplengen, Germany. This long-standing race was first held in 2002 and offers races for children and schoolchildren. The start is at the Raiffeisen-Volksbank car park, Reetstr. 13. The event is ideal for runners of all ages who want to enjoy an autumn running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km, 6.6 km, and 10 km
Start at the Raiffeisen-Volksbank car park, Reetstr. 13
Typical September weather: around 19 °C and mostly cloudy
additional: Please check the event details with the organiser before registering. Typical September weather: around 19 °C, cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation; ideal for an outdoor autumn run.

name: Weddelbrooker Dorflauf
description: The Weddelbrook Village Run is a traditional race through the village of Weddelbrook and the surrounding countryside. It offers various distances from 900 m to 10 km, so runners of all ages and ability levels can take part. The course passes through scenic areas, including around the lake, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with many volunteers on site. The race is known for its good organisation and the opportunity to compete with other runners or simply enjoy running.
course_highlights: Course through the village, around the lake and through the surrounding countryside
A variety of distances from 900 m to 10 km
Scenic and varied running routes
additional: The race includes several age and distance categories, including a Bambini run for children aged 3–4 and up. Photos from the race can be requested by email by providing your bib number. The event is supported by many volunteers and takes place annually. It offers various distances, including Bambini and junior races, with results by age group. Photos and further information are available on request.

name: Wilscher FUN-RUN
description: The Wilscher FunRun is a longstanding race that has been held annually since 2005 at the Wilsche sports ground in Gifhorn. It is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup and offers an appealing 10 km race. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and strong participation, and is a fixture in the regional running scene. The race starts promptly at 10 a.m., and the event is supported by local organisations such as the fire brigades and the German Red Cross (DRK).
course_highlights: 10 km race as part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup
Start and finish at the Wilsche sports ground
Fire brigade and DRK participation for safety
additional: The FunRun is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup, which has a total of 9 races. The event is supported by the Wilsche and Neubokel fire brigades and a DRK emergency response vehicle. A children’s race and the Wilscher Marathon have been offered as part of Gifhorn Running Day since 2015. The registration link for 2026 will be published later. Start at 10 a.m.; registration is via the organiser’s website, and participation is open to all running enthusiasts.

name: Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf is a family-friendly running event organized by the running group of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. It offers distances of 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km and the Hemmingen Half Marathon (21.3 km). Alongside the sporting competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners’ breakfast, cake, waffles, grilled food and drinks, as well as a varied supporting program including face painting for children. The event is particularly suitable for runners of all ages and emphasizes a friendly, welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances from 1.4 km to 21.3 km (half marathon)
Start on Ihmer Straße, with different start times for each distance
Family-friendly atmosphere with a runners’ breakfast and food on offer
additional: The 500 m Möhrchenlauf (start: 9:10 a.m.) and 1.4 km Schülerlauf (start: 9:15 a.m.) are free for children up to age 6 and ages 7–12, respectively. The runners’ breakfast after finishing is free for all participants. Food includes a cake buffet, waffle stand and grilled food at reasonable prices. Team scoring is available, and clubs and teams can register together. Various distances, children’s and youth races, walking; registration is required for some races.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th “King of the Park” Run is an annual running event organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. The competition takes place in the scenic surroundings of the town park, offering participants an appealing course and sporting competition. The race attracts both recreational and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and community engagement. The organizers provide professional event services and a comprehensive race pack.
course_highlights: The course runs through the town park in Mosina
Scenic surroundings with natural greenery
A well-marked and prepared running course
additional: The event is organized by the Mosina Sports and Recreation Centre. Telephone: +48 61 813 29 03. Detailed information and registration will be available soon. The event is part of the Mosina municipality’s calendar of sports and recreational events. It also includes races for children and young people, with medals and accompanying attractions for participants. The races are part of the Mosina Grand Prix series.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechitów Half Marathon is Poland’s oldest half marathon, held continuously since 1978. The 21.0975 km race route runs from the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish at Saint Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno, recalling the historic journey of Otto III. The race attracts thousands of runners every year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. The organizers provide professional race services, timing and course safety, while participants receive a race pack with a medal and a recovery meal.
course_highlights: Start at the Small Open-Air Museum in Ostrów Lednicki; finish at Saint Adalbert’s Square in Gniezno
A 21.0975 km PZLA-certified route, entirely on asphalt
5 refreshment stations along the route, including water and isotonic drink
additional: The time limit for completing the half marathon is 3 hours and 30 minutes. Timing is provided by chips attached to race bibs. The organizer provides coach transport to the start in Ostrów Lednicki. The race pack includes safety pins for attaching the bib, a medal at the finish and a recovery meal. Registration and race-pack collection take place at the sports hall of II LO in Gniezno on 19 September from 15:00 to 20:00 and on 20 September from 7:00 to 9:00. The participant limit is 2,000; minimum age is 18. Travel by coach or own transport.

name: II Bieg Farmera
description: The 2nd Farmer’s Run is a 10 km road race taking place in Police. The event is a great opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic course, and participants can use training plans tailored to different experience levels. The organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help runners prepare optimally for the race. This sporting event is aimed at runners who value good organization and the opportunity to improve.
course_highlights: 10 km road course
Scenic areas of Police in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship
Tailored training plans lasting 8 to 20 weeks
additional: Training plans are available to suit each runner’s level, along with expert support and the option to use a platform for managing the race’s profile and marketing cooperation. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as local community integration. Participants can count on support and attractions along the course.

name: VII Bieg Pocztyliona
location: Cewice, Gmina Cewice, Powiat lęborski, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 7th Pocztylion Run is a 10 km race taking place on September 20, 2026, in Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship. Runners can prepare for the race using dedicated training plans tailored to different experience levels. The event is a great opportunity for runners to test their fitness on a scenic course and enjoy friendly competition.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
Road course in Cewice
Scenic surroundings of Pomerania
additional: Training plans from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner’s VDOT level and including instructions and expert support. Date: 2026-09-20; Location: Cewice, Pomeranian Voivodeship; Distance: 10 km

name: 12 Bieg Ziemi Puckiej
location: Połczyno, Puck County, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

name: NN Dam tot Damloop 2026

price_tiers.distance: The Virtual 40th NN Dam tot Damloop

description: The NN Dam tot Damloop is the Netherlands’ biggest running festival, starting in Amsterdam and finishing in Zaandam. The 10 English Miles route takes you through the unique IJ Tunnel and past lively music and cheering crowds in Amsterdam-Noord. In 2026, the event celebrates its 40th edition with a festive programme and an unforgettable finish on Peperstraat in Zaandam. After the finish, you can enjoy the celebrations at the Dam tot Dam Park during the Finish Festival.
course_highlights: Start on Prins Hendrikkade in Amsterdam
Run through the IJ Tunnel between the city centre and Amsterdam-Noord
Finish on Peperstraat in Zaandam, with a street party on Zuiddijk
additional: Registration opens in stages: Le Champion members can register from 6 April through 17 April, after which general registration opens on 18 April. A Premium Business Package is available for teams. The Business Run is popular with companies, with more than 25,000 participants. A free BackStory race bib is available. After the finish, there is a Finish Festival at the Dam tot Dam Park. Participants can choose from several distances, virtual options and special anniversary activities. The event has a festive, supportive atmosphere, with music and merchandise available.

name: StoneCityRun
description: The DYKA StoneCityRun is an atmospheric running event in Steenwijk, taking place on 20 September 2026. Participants run along the historic ramparts, through Rams Woerthe park and the centre of Steenwijk, with plenty of spectators and entertainment along the course. There are various distances for all ages and abilities, including special events such as the G-Run for people with disabilities and a walking tour. The event celebrates inclusivity and a friendly atmosphere, with the start at Theater de Meenthe and the finish at the Markt.
course_highlights: Run along Steenwijk’s historic ramparts
Through Rams Woerthe park and the centre of Steenwijk
Finish at the atmospheric Markt in Steenwijk
additional: After registration closes, it is possible to collect a blank bib at the start location, De Meenthe, from 13:00 on 20 September, without timekeeping. Children under 6 must be accompanied, and those accompanying children or people with disabilities may participate for free. Changing rooms and showers are available at the start location, and parking is available. The rollator run is specifically for older people, and the G-Run is inclusive, with support and assistive aids permitted. Participants can choose from various distances, including 0.6 km, 1.5 km, 3 km, 5 km and 10 km. The event also offers walks and special runs for people with disabilities, as well as parking, changing rooms and showers. Registration closes on 1 September 2026.

name: LOS Dokkum
distance_verbose: 50 km, Marathon, Halve marathon, 13.4 km, 6.7 km
organizer: Stichting Promotie Dokkum en stichting Ik ben Wil
description: LOS Dokkum is a unique 12-hour running and walking event in Tolhuispark in Dokkum. Every hour, the starting signal sounds for a 6.7-kilometre running lap or a 3.9-kilometre walking lap. The challenge is to decide how long you can keep going and answer the question again each time: shall I do one more lap? The event combines sporting spirit with a convivial atmosphere in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: A 6.7-kilometre running lap each hour
A 3.9-kilometre walking route through Tolhuispark
Starting signal every hour for 12 hours
additional: The event takes place in Tolhuispark. Participants can choose between running and walking. The starting signal sounds again every hour, giving the event a unique dynamic. The event supports charitable causes and is backed by volunteers and local businesses. It is open to teams and children, and is part of an annual initiative.

name: Preston Palace Almelo Allee Run
description: The Preston Palace Almelo Allee Run is an atmospheric running event in the green surroundings of Gravenallee in Almelo. The event offers distances for both beginner and experienced runners, including a new 2-kilometre youth and beginners’ run. The start and finish are at the ice rink opposite the sports park, with a course along wide avenues in a much-loved, atmospheric setting. It promises to be a sporty and enjoyable day for athletes, supporters and visitors of all ages.
course_highlights: Course along wide avenues in the green Gravenallee
Start and finish at the ice rink opposite the sports park
Atmospheric setting, with support from Huize Almelo
additional: Distances for all ages and levels, including a new 2-kilometre youth and beginners’ run. Start and finish at IJsbaan Almelo, Sluiskade Zuidzijde 195, 7607XT Almelo. The event runs from 10:30 to 13:00. Routes through rural areas, the option to train with athletics club SISU, participation for all ages, and a focus on health and community.

name: Freedom Run - Libertyloop
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 16.09 km, 8 km, 3000 meter, 1.6 km
description: Freedom Run - Liberty Loop is a recreational running event held in Geldrop to celebrate 80 years of liberation. The race offers four running distances, named after well-known veterans, and a half marathon. There is also a free Kidsrun for primary school children, as well as several walking routes past war memorials and streets named after resistance fighters. The event emphasizes celebrating freedom together and offers a unique combination of sport and history.
course_highlights: Four running distances named after veterans: 4, 8 and 10 miles, and a half marathon
Walking routes past war memorials and streets named after resistance fighters in Geldrop
Free Kidsrun for primary school children, with 1/2-mile and 1-mile distances
additional: Start times vary by distance: walking starts between 9:00 and 10:00, the Kidsrun at 10:15, and running between 10:45 and 11:15. Walking and running routes are available as GPX files. Participation is at your own risk, and walking is free for children up to and including age 15. Registration opens on 5 May via the website. Participants can choose from several distances, including 3 km, 1.6 km, 8 km, 10 miles and a half marathon. The event takes place at the Weeffabriek in Geldrop and starts on 20 September 2026. Registration opens on 5 May 2026.

name: Rondjes van Pijn
description: Rondjes van Pijn is an endurance run organized by IJsvereniging Pijnacker, held on Sunday, September 20, 2026, at the Tinteltent in Pijnacker. The race consists of repeated 4.2-kilometer laps starting every half hour, with a maximum of ten laps. Participants can set their own pace: completing a lap faster means more rest before the next start. The event is aimed at both young people and adults and emphasizes endurance over speed.
course_highlights: Repeated 4.2 km laps starting every half hour
Up to ten laps possible
Course in and around the Tinteltent, Pijnacker
additional: Participation is at your own risk; participants are responsible for their own training and insurance. The course is shared with recreational users, and traffic marshals are present at some challenging spots. Dogs are welcome on parts of the course. Repeated 4.2 km laps, maximum distance of approximately 42 km, registration via the website, dogs welcome on parts of the course, and safety and personal responsibility are emphasized.

name: Maasheggenloop
description: The Maasheggenloop, organized by Atletiek Vereniging Sporting Boxmeer, takes place on September 20, 2026, in the beautiful Maasheggen area, the oldest cultural landscape in the Netherlands. The event offers a suitable distance for every age and ability, from the Bambinoloop for the youngest children to the Half Marathon for experienced runners. The routes pass through a unique, nature-rich setting, with a cash prize for breaking the course record in the Half Marathon and 10 km. The atmosphere is sporty and welcoming, with fun keepsakes for all youth participants and trophies for the podium finishers.
course_highlights: Run through the Maasheggen area, the oldest cultural landscape in the Netherlands
Distances range from 250 metres for the youngest participants to a half marathon
Cash prizes for breaking the course record in the 10 km and half marathon
additional: Start times vary by distance, from 09:45 for the Bambinoloop to 11:00 for the 5 km. Prize-giving takes place shortly after each distance. All youth participants receive a fun keepsake, and podium finishers receive trophies. There is a cash prize of 100 Euro for breaking the course record in the Half Marathon and 10 km. Distances for all ages, course records, registration via website, refreshments and first aid available

name: Molenbroekloop
price_range: gratis voor GAC-leden, anders niet vermeld

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Vanaf 1 augustus t/m 17 september via www.inschrijven.nl

description: On Sunday, 20 September 2026, GAC Gemert is holding the annual Bouwgroep van Schijndel Molenbroekloop. The race consists of several 2.5-kilometre laps through the Molenbroek neighbourhood. Participants can choose from distances of 1.1 km (youth), 2.5 km (juniors), 2.5 km, 5 km, 7.5 km and 10 km. The start and finish are on the GAC Gemert athletics track. Prizes are awarded to the top men and women in the 5 km and 10 km races, and to the top boys and girls in the youth races. The organisers support sustainability by using reusable race bibs, which must be returned after the race.
course_highlights: 2.5 km lap through the Molenbroek neighbourhood
Start and finish on the GAC Gemert athletics track
Distances range from 1.1 km (youth) to 10 km
additional: Participants receive reusable race bibs, which must be returned after the race. Entry is free for GAC members. Registration is also available on race day between 9:00 and 10:30 in the canteen by the athletics track. Distances from 2.5 km to 10 km, youth races, start and finish on the athletics track, sustainable race bibs

name: Rotterdam Half
description: The Rotterdam Half Marathon takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, and starts at 09:00 at the Maassilo in Rotterdam. The 21.1-kilometer route passes through authentic Rotterdam South, by iconic spots such as Katendrecht, the SS Rotterdam and the harbor area, and finishes spectacularly inside Rotterdam Ahoy. The course is fast, flat and officially certified, making it ideal for runners aiming for a fast time. After the finish, there is a festive afterparty with a DJ and various facilities for participants and supporters.
course_highlights: Start at the Maassilo and a loop around Katendrecht past the SS Rotterdam
Through the harbor area, with quays, cranes and views of the skyline
Finish inside Rotterdam Ahoy, with light shows and an afterparty
additional: Participants gather in waiting areas and start in 7 waves of 1,000 runners, with one wave every 5 minutes between 09:00 and 09:30. Race bibs can be collected at Run2Day on Saturday or at Ahoy on Sunday morning between 07:00 and 08:00. Luggage can be dropped off free of charge at a drop-off point in Ahoy using a luggage tag. There is a finish celebration with breakfast, free coffee between 09:00 and 10:00, flower sales and an afterparty with DJ All Hans On Deck. The minimum age is 18. No tracking app is available for this edition. The race has multiple waves starting from 09:00, with registration available through Run2Day Rotterdam. The course can be downloaded as a GPX file, and there is a festive finish with a food court and afterparty. Travel tips are provided for the metro and parking.

name: Misty Lakes Trail
description: The Misty Lakes Trail is a challenging trail run taking place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, in Gerwen (Nuenen). The routes pass through beautiful forests with many small lakes and heathland, with more than 90% of the course on unpaved paths. The trail features short climbs, winding single tracks, and an ascent of the “Roof of Brabant,” the Gulbergen. The various distances offer a rewarding challenge for every level, with a welcoming finish area where spectators can cheer on the runners.
course_highlights: More than 90% unpaved paths through forests and past small lakes
Winding single tracks and short climbs
Ascent of the over-60-metre-high Gulbergen, the “Roof of Brabant”
additional: The start and finish are at ’t Huysven, De Huikert 35, 5674 RG Nuenen. Partner NNormal will have a stand where trail runners can test trail shoes. There will also be a pop-up store selling trail gear on site. Bib transfers are possible via Inschrijven.nl and a resale platform. The Misty Lakes Trail running shirt will still be available in limited quantities at the race office on the day. Visitors can cheer on the runners at the finish between 11:30 and 15:30 while enjoying a drink and BBQ. The routes are marked with orange ribbons, GPX files are available, and facilities include changing rooms, showers, and first aid.

name: 1 v.d. 4 loop Zuiderpark
location: Zuiderpark, Den Haag, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The 1 van de 4 circuit is a running race organised by the Hague Road Runners in Zuiderpark in The Hague. The event is part of a circuit featuring several races and celebrates its 40th anniversary in 2026. It offers a friendly, sporting atmosphere for runners of different levels and ages. The course runs through the beautiful Zuiderpark and is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Course through the green Zuiderpark in The Hague
Suitable for different levels and ages
Part of a circuit featuring several running events
additional: The Sparta loop starts at 11:00. A beginners’ course takes place on the same day from 09:30 to 10:30. The event is part of a circuit featuring several races, with a 40th-anniversary celebration for the 1 van de 4 races. On-site registration is available. The event is organised by Haag Atletiek, Sparta, De Koplopers and HRR. Typical Dutch autumn weather is expected.

name: Rooise Crosslopen 1e
description: De Rooise Crosslopen 1e is a cross-country running race taking place on Sunday, 20 September 2026, in Sint-Oedenrode. The event offers various races for different age groups, including pupils, juniors and seniors, with distances of up to 7.9 km. Advance registration is open until and including 19 September 2026. The race is suitable for runners of various ages and abilities and takes place in a natural setting in Brabant.
course_highlights: Cross-country race with various distances up to 7.9 km
Races for pupils, juniors and seniors
Natural setting in Sint-Oedenrode, Brabant
additional: Advance registration is open until and including 19 September 2026. Participants can choose a race from the listed age categories and distances. Visit the organiser’s website for the latest information. Registration is open until 19 September 2026.

name: Vooruitgangloop
location: Oude Veerdam recreatiegebied, Zuidland, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Vooruitgangloop is a running event held in the beautiful Oude Veerdam recreational area near Zuidland. The first edition is organised by IJsclub Vooruitgang and offers an atmospheric run through a green, natural area. The start and finish are at the ice rink, which is easily accessible by bicycle and public transport. The event is suitable for all ages, with a kids’ run and a 10 km race, and includes a warm-up and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the green Oude Veerdam recreational area
Start and finish at the IJsclub Vooruitgang ice rink
Scenic route with views of the Bernisse and the surrounding natural landscape
additional: On-site registration is not possible. The venue opens at 10:00 for race-number collection. The warm-up, provided by GrapeFine sports, is at 10:50. The 1 km kids’ run starts at 11:00 from the whisper-boat grounds. The 10 km race starts at 11:45, with the starting signal given by Alderman Hamerslag. The course will be cleared by the sweep team at 13:15; all runners must have finished by then. The canteen and venue close at 14:30. There are no facilities for showering or changing. Free parking is available in a large car park 100 metres away at the Bernisse recreational area. Bicycles can be parked on the ice-club grounds. The ice rink is opposite the Stationsweg bus stop, served by line 106. Start at 11:00; location in Zuidland, near the Oude Veerdam recreational area; parking information and access via the bus stop and car parks; volunteers wanted to help organise the event.
