description: De Tien van 't Aogje is a running event in Princenhage, Breda, taking place on 20 September 2026. The event offers 5 km and 10 km races, with a fun family run as an additional event. Race numbers are sent in advance by email, and there is an awards ceremony immediately after each race at the Haagsemarkt. The event attracts many participants and has a maximum capacity for each distance.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km races through Princenhage
Awards ceremony immediately after the race at the Haagsemarkt
Fun family run as an additional event
additional: Race numbers are sent by email with additional information. There are two times to collect race numbers. The awards ceremony takes place immediately after each race at the Haagsemarkt. There is a maximum number of participants for each distance. Registration for 2025 is closed; advance registration for 2026 is available until 13 September 2026. The event takes place in Princenhage, Breda, and includes several race distances, with awards ceremonies after each race.

name: Nachtlauf über 7 Meilen und 30. Jedermannlauf über 3,1 Meilen (5 km)
description: The Zonser Night Run offers two exciting races: the 7-mile race and the 5 km fun run. The event takes place in Dormagen-Zons and is known for its unique nighttime atmosphere. The course runs through the historic old town, giving runners a special experience. The race is open to all ages and ability levels and is a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: 7 miles (approx. 11.3 km) through the historic old town of Zons
5 km fun run as a shorter option
Night run with a special atmosphere and lighting
additional: No late registration is possible. The event takes place in the historic old town of Zons. There is an accompanying program and an awards ceremony. Parking and travel information are available on the website. The race takes place at night and offers a special atmosphere. Late registration is not possible. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers a great opportunity to experience the historic surroundings.

name: Schülerlauf
location: Wymeer, Landkreis Cloppenburg, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Teilnahmegebühr von 3 € je Teilnehmer*in, mit der Anmeldung in der Schule abzugeben

description: The Rüppurr Schools’ Student Race is a traditional annual running competition that brings together students from several schools in Karlsruhe. The event has separate classifications for girls and boys, and all participants receive certificates and medals. Prizes are awarded to the first three finishers. Registration is through the schools, and late registration is available on the day of the event. The race takes place around the TUS Rüppurr club grounds and promotes youth sport in the region.
course_highlights: Each course is marked with a different colour
Separate classifications for girls and boys
Preparation runs before the main event
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event from 15:00 to 15:30 in the gymnastics room at the TUS clubhouse. Registration is through the schools. Students under 16 need the signatures of both legal guardians to register late. Courses are marked by colour; there are separate classifications for girls and boys; all participants receive certificates and medals; prizes go to the first three finishers; late registration is available on the day of the event.

name: Zombies are Coming 180km
description: Zombies are Coming is a unique 180-kilometre ultrarun from Amsterdam to Groningen. Participants must maintain a steady pace of 7.5 km/h to finish within 24 hours. They carry all their own supplies and run without a crew while being pursued by a “zombie horde” that eliminates anyone who falls behind the pace. It is not a race against other runners, but a personal challenge to reach the finish and stay ahead of the zombies.
course_highlights: 180 kilometres from Amsterdam to Groningen
A steady pace of 7.5 km/h is required
Rolling cutoff: runners caught by the zombie horde must stop
additional: Participants must carry everything themselves; crews are not allowed. The race has a rolling cutoff: anyone caught by the zombie horde, which moves at 7.5 km/h, must stop. Participants arrange their own return journey, but a zombie vehicle may help them reach a public transport stop. The route is in the Netherlands and takes place in both darkness and daylight. Public water taps are available, but there are no aid stations or on-site volunteers.

name: Martini Marathon
price_range: 4,22 euro voor sololopers, 21,10 euro voor estafetteteams
description: The Martini Marathon in Groningen is a unique marathon on the athletics track, organized by Groningen Atletiek. The race takes place on Friday evening, 25 September 2026, and offers both a solo marathon of 42,195 metres and a relay for teams of 3 to 5 runners. The relay consists of 2,195 metres followed by four 10,000-metre legs, ensuring a challenging and fast running experience. The atmosphere is friendly, with catering along the way and after the race, and all participants receive a medal. The winners receive the prestigious Martini Trophy.
course_highlights: Marathon on the Stadspark Groningen athletics track
Relay with legs of 2,195 m and 4×10,000 m
Maximum of 60 participants on the track at a time
additional: A maximum of 60 runners can be on the track at a time, with a reserve list for additional entries. The maximum time allowed to complete the marathon is 5 hours and 15 minutes. Catering is available along the way and after the race. The start and finish are at the Stadspark Groningen athletics track, where changing facilities and baggage storage are also available. The event is organized by Alex Jager on behalf of Groningen Atletiek. Track race with solo and relay options; registration opens on 01-01-2026; participant limits and time limits apply.

name: Nedmag Moonlightwalk

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: De deelnemers betalen € 12,50 inschrijfgeld. Van dit bedrag gaat €10,- naar het goede doel.

description: The Nedmag Moonlightwalk in Veendam is an atmospheric evening walk of approximately 6 kilometres that takes place by moonlight. It is not a race, but a relaxed walk where participants can enjoy various performances and special experiences along the route. The route is accessible to almost everyone, including wheelchair users, and offers a unique way to experience Veendam. The proceeds from the walk go to charity; this year, they will benefit the Margarethe Hardenberg Cultural Centre.
course_highlights: Walking route of approximately 6 km
Various performances and entertaining acts along the way
Accessible to wheelchair users
additional: The start location is Museumplein Veendam. Registration is open from 19:00 to 19:30, and participants can start between 19:30 and 20:30. It is also possible to register on the evening itself and pay in cash or by PIN. The walk also finishes at Museumplein. Dogs are allowed if kept on a leash and owners bring their own bags to clean up after them. There are no official toilet facilities along the route, but toilets at businesses or canteens may sometimes be available. The route is a surprising change from the norm; this is not a race, it is suitable for almost everyone, and it features entertainment and support for a good cause.

name: DGI Nordjysk Trail Cup 2026/2027 - Lundby Krat Trail
Tour de Fredensborgs efterårsløb i Nivå 2026
Tjurruset
price_range: early bird priser, exakt belopp inte specificerat
description: Tjurruset in Karlstad is one of the year’s most eagerly anticipated and muddiest running festivals. The race offers a challenging course with obstacles, mud and water, creating a unique and fun running experience for all participants. The atmosphere is defined by camaraderie, fighting spirit and joy, making Tjurruset a memorable event for both runners and spectators. Registration is open, and booking your place early is a good way to get the best price and motivation to train.
course_highlights: Challenging obstacle course with mud and water
One of the year’s muddiest and most fun running festivals
Strong camaraderie and spectator energy along the course
additional: Team registration is available for teams of 5–6 people, with the five fastest times counting. Register teams by email at tavling@ifgota.se, as the team registration form is currently not working. The race is approximately 10 km long, with team and children’s races also available. Medical staff will be on site, and participants must register in person with their race number and chip.

name: Neusser Integrationslauf
description: The Neuss Integration Run, organized by DJK RHEINKRAFT Neuss 1914 e.V., takes place on 19 September 2026 at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sportanlage in Neuss. The event celebrates integration in practice, bringing together people of all backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities, to run or walk together. The focus is on community and making a statement for integration, not competition. A colorful program featuring music, children’s activities and food makes the day a celebration for participants and visitors.
course_highlights: An open course for running and walking, with no time pressure
Participants of all ages and backgrounds
A colorful program featuring a bouncy castle, bull riding and music
additional: The run is open to people of all ages, backgrounds, skin colors and religions, including people with disabilities. There are no rankings; the focus is on fun and community. The program offers a range of activities for participants and visitors, including a bouncy castle, bull riding, children’s activities, music and culinary specialties. The event takes place at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sportanlage and is part of SportWoche für Alle 2026, which features inclusive sports activities and taster sessions.

name: Schottener Stauseelauf
description: The Schotten Reservoir Run is organized by TGV Schotten, the largest sports club in the Vogelsberg region. The event gives runners the opportunity to compete on varied courses around the reservoir. The run is part of the club’s extensive sports program, which also includes numerous major running events. Participants and visitors are warmly welcome to enjoy the sporting atmosphere and beautiful scenery.
course_highlights: Running routes around the Schotten Reservoir
Varied terrain in the Vogelsberg region
Organized by an experienced sports club with professional timing
additional: Registration, results and certificates are provided through the club’s own timing service, "TGV SportStar". TGV Schotten is a large sports club with more than 1,300 members and organizes other major events in running and other disciplines in addition to the Reservoir Run. The race is known for its fast, flat course and attracts runners from across the region. Registration is available on the official website, and the event is a popular opportunity for recreational and competitive runners to improve their personal bests.

name: Appelhülsener Landlauf
location: Appelhülsener Landlauf, Nottuln-Appelhülsen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Appelhülsener Landlauf on September 26, 2026, is a family-friendly running event in the beautiful Münsterland, offering distances for all age groups. The officially measured 5 km and 10 km races are eligible for rankings and combine Westphalian charm with rural scenery. Refreshment stations and a varied selection in the finish area ensure participants are well catered for. The event is part of the Westmünsterland Running Series and offers a welcoming atmosphere for runners and walkers.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses, eligible for rankings
Water stations every 2.5 km
Start and finish area with changing and shower facilities at the sports center
additional: Race packets can be collected at the sports center from 13:00 on race day. Timing is provided by Race-Result using a reusable chip attached to the race bib, which is collected at the finish. Changing and shower facilities are available directly in the start/finish area. The first three male and female finishers in the 5 km and 10 km races will receive awards. All participants in the Bambini and schoolchildren’s races will receive a medal. Nordic walking is untimed, with no awards ceremony. Certificates and results are available online; certificate printing is offered at race-bib collection. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, 48301 Nottuln. The courses are officially measured. Online registration is open until 24.09.2026; late registration is available on site for a fee. Race packets can be collected from 13:00 on race day. Parking is available at Marienplatz 15, Nottuln.

name: Bahnstreckenlauf
location: Zinhaine, Bad Marienberg, Westerwaldkreis, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Wäller Bahnstreckenlauf in Bad Marienberg is a new running event starting in 2025. From 2026, it will also count as a scoring race for the Wäller-Lauf-Cup. The course is an out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach bei Bad-Marienberg and Nistertal. The start and finish are on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company, with a nearby parking lot for participants. The event is organized by TuS Bad-Marienberg Leichtathletik and offers runners an attractive course in the region.
course_highlights: Out-and-back route along the cycle path between Langenbach and Nistertal
Start and finish on Zinhainer Weg, above the Rübsamen company
Parking available right by the start and finish
additional: The event is part of the Wäller-Lauf-Cup from 2026. Certificates and individual results are available online. The course is an out-and-back route on a cycle path, suggesting a flat, fast course. The event offers various age categories and distances.

name: Halveraner Herbstlauf
location: Innenstadt von Halver, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Halver Autumn Run takes place annually on the last weekend in September in Halver town centre. Organised by SSV Halver together with LGHS, the event offers races for toddlers and schoolchildren, as well as a relay for recreational runners. The main event is a 4 x 900-metre relay with two categories (U100 and Ü100). The event has been a fixture on the local running calendar for over 20 years and takes runners right through Halver city centre.
course_highlights: Relay race with 4 x 900-metre laps
The course runs through Halver town centre
Separate races for toddlers, schoolchildren and youth
additional: Late entries are possible online or at the race office up to 45 minutes before the respective race start. A fee of €1.50 (online) or €2 (race office) applies to entries on the day of the event. Toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at Lindenhof School. The roads will be closed for the race from 12:00. All participants receive a medal; the top three in each age group also receive medals and certificates. Relay race, 4 x 900 m, in Halver town centre, age categories U100 / Ü100

name: REHAmed Herkules-Berglauf
description: The REHAmed Herkules Mountain Race is a challenging mountain race through Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe in Kassel, running almost entirely on paved natural paths. The course passes numerous sights, including Löwenburg and Steinhöfer Waterfall, and finishes at the Hercules Monument. The race is open to runners and walkers and offers both individual and three-person relay categories, making it ideal for families, clubs and companies. Changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Reformschule gym, and a bag transport service to the finish is provided.
course_highlights: The course runs almost entirely on paved natural paths through Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe
Passes well-known sights such as Löwenburg, Steinhöfer Waterfall and the Hercules Monument
Relay race with three legs and handovers at notable points
additional: Bag transport to the finish is available from 10 a.m. in the start area. Participants make their own way back to the start on foot or by bus route 22. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Reformschule gym. Relay results are based on the combined times of the three individual legs; there are no age-group categories for relays. The course runs on paved natural paths and asphalt. Registration is online via RaceResult. The start and finish are in Bergpark Wilhelmshöhe in Kassel. Wooden medals are awarded; T-shirts can be ordered. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Reformschule gym.

name: Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte
description: The 19th Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte takes place on September 26, 2026, and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. The routes pass through the historic town center, along the Ems and through the surrounding countryside, vividly reflecting the motto “Town, Country and River.” In addition to the 10,000-meter main race, there are other events, including a 5,000-meter race, walking, children’s and Bambini races, and an untimed fun run. The event is suitable for competitive runners, recreational runners and families, and is organized by TV Friesen Telgte e.V.
course_highlights: 10,000-meter main race through the historic town center, the Ems floodplains and the countryside
5,000-meter race with a water station halfway along the course
Varied routes featuring asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a €2 late-entry fee (for the Bambini race, charged once per family or group). Changing facilities are available at the old double gymnasium at the school center, close to the start and finish. Medals, trophies and certificates are awarded in various events and age groups. The course is varied, with asphalt, a tartan track, paved paths and natural trails. Photos and video recordings will be taken and published. The start and finish are at the school center sports field; registration is online; changing facilities are at the Old Double Gymnasium; children’s races are not timed.

name: Weezer Staffellauf
description: The Weeze relay race has been held in Weeze in mid-September each year since 1985 and has become a popular relay event, with up to 250 teams taking part. The course follows a scenic 5 km loop along the Niers hiking trail. The event offers various relay categories, including Bambini, school, and regular relays, and attracts runners of all ages. The athletics department of TSV Weeze organizes the event with great dedication and looks forward to welcoming many participants in 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km loop along the Niers hiking trail
Relay event with Bambini, school, and regular relay categories
Held annually in mid-September since 1985
additional: The 40th Weeze relay race will take place on 26 September 2026. The race announcement and registration will follow at the end of July. The event has attracted up to 250 relay teams. The 38th Weeze relay race in 2024 had 32 Bambini teams, 36 school relay teams, and 55 regular relay teams cross the finish line. Participants can register online until the end of July 2026; the event also includes school and community competitions, as well as on-site refreshments.

name: Herbstcross des SSV-MG-Ahlsdorf / 2. Peter Zinke Gedenklauf
Kreuzhorst Ultra
description: The Kreuzhorst Ultra (KRHU) is a friendly Backyard Ultra in Magdeburg-Kreuzhorst, taking place for the third time on September 26, 2026. The 6.7 km course restarts on the hour, and participants run as many laps as they can or want to. The race is a private invitation-only event focused on community, passion, and the joy of running. The course is mostly on forest and farm tracks, with no significant climbs, and results are recorded for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop on forest and farm tracks
Starts on the hour; run for as long as you can or want to
Results recorded for distances of 53 km, 100 km, and 160 km
additional: The race is a private invitation-only event with no public registration and a maximum of 70 participants. Water, sports drink, cola, fruit, and cake are available in the start/finish area, and participants are asked to contribute items themselves. No mandatory equipment is required, but a headlamp and phone are recommended. Parking, toilets, and showers are available at the SV Pechau sports ground. The race includes several categories, including 50 km, 100 km, and 100 miles, with the fastest person in each category winning. It is not a public event, but a private invitation event with modified Backyard Ultra rules.

name: VR-Bank Mitte Herbstlauf in Dingelstädt
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Autumn Run in Dingelstädt is a versatile running event taking place on September 26, 2026. The event offers courses for all ability levels, from a children’s run for the youngest participants to a half marathon that passes through the impressive 1,530-meter-long Küllstedt Tunnel. The flat, fast courses are measured to DLV/IAAF standards and are ideal for personal bests. The Autumn Run is part of the Eichsfeld Cup and the TLV Running Cup, and also hosts the Thuringian State Road Running Championships.
course_highlights: Half marathon through the 1,530-meter-long Küllstedt Tunnel
Flat, low-turnaround courses with only 2 to 50 meters of elevation gain
Courses measured to DLV/IAAF standards
additional: Start and finish on the fully paved Kanonenbahn cycle path near Bahnhofsallee in Dingelstädt. Changing rooms, registration and the awards ceremony are in the primary school sports hall. Bib pickup from 8:00 a.m. Age-group awards according to DLV standards. The 1 km race is limited to 50 starters, with a referee-led start lineup. Net timing; placings determined by gun time. The courses are flat and fast, including tunnel sections; registration in the primary school sports hall; start and finish on the Kanonenbahn cycle path; refreshments along the course and at the finish; age-group awards; part of the Eichsfeld Cup and the Thuringian State Championships.

name: Bergzeitlauf Brockenheroes 2026
description: The BROCKENHEROES mountain time trial and mountain race is a challenging individual time trial in the Harz, taking place on September 26, 2026, in Schierke. Participants compete on various courses of up to 24 km with up to 900 meters of elevation gain, including road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing, and Nordic walking. The event offers a unique challenge against the clock, the mountain, and yourself, starting on the Brockenstraße and finishing on the Brocken plateau. The atmosphere is defined by sporting ambition and the impressive natural scenery of the Harz.
course_highlights: Main course: 11.2 km with 550 meters of elevation gain on the Brockenstraße
Longer course: 24 km with 900 meters of elevation gain to the Brocken plateau
A range of disciplines: road cycling, mountain biking, unicycling, running, roller skiing, and Nordic walking
additional: Race packs can be collected on Friday from 16:00 to 19:00 and on race day from 8:00. Electronic timing, medical support, drinks, and refreshments at the finish are included. The event offers views from the Brocken plateau across to several distant cities and landmarks. After the race, there is a recovery walk to cheer on the participants starting later. Participants under 15 require parental permission to take part, and parental supervision is required. Mountain individual time trial, running, roller skiing, Nordic walking, e-bikes permitted for road races, various course distances, age categories, online registration

name: Böckstiegellauf
price_range: 18,00 EUR bis 29,00 EUR (je nach Strecke und Anmeldezeitraum)
description: The Böckstiegellauf is a scenic race through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills, starting at Peter auf’m Berge in Bielefeld and finishing in Werther town centre. Routes of 18 km and 10 km are offered, along with a 2.5 km student race. Part of the course follows the Hermannslauf route and passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum. The event is very well organised, with a bus shuttle from the finish to the start and an awards ceremony in the centre of Werther.
course_highlights: A route through the Teutoburg Forest and the Ravensberg Hills
The course passes the Böckstiegelhaus and the Böckstiegel Museum
Starts at Peter auf’m Berge and finishes in the centre of Werther
additional: The start is at Peter auf’m Berge and the finish is at Venghauss-Platz in Werther. Buses to the start leave from Werther bus station from 12:00. Late entries are possible at Venghauss-Platz on the event day from 11:00 to 13:00, subject to remaining places. Most of the course is in good condition; the section at the 18/10 km route split at kilometre 3.7 is very gravelly. The routes pass through nature and the town. Registration is already open, with bus transport to the start. There is no parking at the start, and late entries are subject to availability.

name: Cloppenburger Citylauf
organizer: Stadt Cloppenburg, Lauftreff des SV Bethen
description: The Cloppenburg City Run is a popular running event held as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival, which takes place annually on the last weekend of September. The main race starts at the Red School on the Market Square and runs along Eschstraße to Rathausplatz. In addition to the main race, there is a relay competition in which teams of four each complete a course of approximately 1,000 metres four times. The event is organised by the running group of SV Bethen e. V. and supervised by the NLV Cloppenburg district association.
course_highlights: The main race starts at the Red School on the Market Square
The course runs along Eschstraße and finishes at Rathausplatz
The relay features laps of approximately 1,000 metres, completed four times
additional: Relay teams receive a 50% discount on the entry fee if all four runners also take part in the main race. All events except the main race start and finish at Rathausplatz. The event is supported by local sponsors and takes place as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival. Events for various age groups, start times, course distances, registration not yet open

name: Drei-Täler-Lauf
location: Mettingen, Tecklenburger Land, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 3-Täler-Lauf, organised by TV Mettingen 1930 e.V., takes place on 26 September 2026 and takes participants along varied routes through the three valleys of Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal in the Tecklenburger Land. The main 14.1 km race features challenging, undulating terrain and impressive views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg. There is also an 8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes alike. Children are warmly invited to take part in an 800 m junior race and a 400 m Bambini race, with fun taking priority for the youngest participants. The event is family-friendly and offers one-time-chip timing, as well as showers and changing rooms at Ludgeri-Schule.
course_highlights: Scenic route through Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental and Köllbachtal
14.1 km main race over undulating terrain, with views of Querenberg, Schafberg and Schniederberg
8.3 km 2-Täler-Lauf and a Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes
additional: Timing is provided by a Runtiming one-time chip, integrated into the race number and included in the entry fee. The finish closes at 16:30; participants finishing after that time will not be recorded. Showers and changing rooms are available in the sports hall at Ludgeri-Schule. The three fastest women and men in the main and 2-Täler-Lauf races, as well as the three fastest boys and girls in the junior race, receive awards. Personal race certificates showing finishing times can be downloaded free of charge from the Runtiming website. Results are linked online at www.tvmettingen.de. Award ceremonies take place after the respective races. The route passes through the valleys of the Tecklenburger Land and has challenging terrain. Children’s races and parking are available; online registration is possible.

name: Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf
description: The Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf is a long-standing running event held annually since 2002 on the Pohl-Boskamp grounds. With distances of 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km, the race offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is especially family-friendly, with special Bambini runs for children and a varied supporting programme featuring games, a food area and entertainment. It promotes community spirit and enjoyment of physical activity, and welcomes individual participants, school classes, teams and companies.
course_highlights: Three distances: 2.8 km, 5 km and 10 km
Bambini runs of approximately 500 m for preschool and first-grade children
Refreshments along the 10 km course and fruit in the finish area
additional: Registration is available directly at the event venue from 11:30 a.m. on race day. Late registration for children and teenagers costs €8.00 and is available until 45 minutes before the race starts. Awards ceremonies for places 1–3 overall and in the age categories take place at 2:15 p.m., 4:00 p.m. and 5:00 p.m. On the Friday before the race, the programme celebrating the potato begins with the coronation festivities for the Pellkartoffelkönigin and an after-show party with free admission. Various distances, Bambini runs, supporting programme, awards ceremonies, prize draws, after-show party, registration from 11:30 a.m. on race day

name: Hotfoot Run Warstein
price_range: Super Early Bird Preise (spezifische Preise nicht gelistet)
description: The Hotfoot Run Warstein is a spectacular obstacle race on September 26, 2026, with distances ranging from 5 km (Family Edition) to 20 km, making it suitable for all fitness levels and age groups. The course runs across the Montgolfiadengelände, the ski slope and through the quarry, with plenty of muddy obstacles, water slides and foam. The event features an exciting start show, a unique atmosphere and has promoted team spirit and fun since 2007. Whether you’re a fitness enthusiast, a fun-loving group or a family, everyone can enjoy an unforgettable adventure here in NRW.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Montgolfiadengelände
Course runs across the ski slope and through the quarry
Spectacular obstacles featuring mud, water slides and foam
additional: Participants start in several waves (Überflieger, Senkrechtstarter, Dauerbrenner, Spätzünder) for different ability levels. Discounted group rates are available for groups of 6 or more, with discounts of up to 20%. Optional extras include a finisher shirt, timing, a bandana and a photo package. Participants under 18 must provide consent from a parent or guardian. Terrain includes a ski slope, quarry, water and foam elements; registration with group discounts; various distances and a Family Edition; entertainment with bands and DJs.

name: Höhlerfestlauf
location: Stadtwald Gera, Hofwiesenpark, Gera, Thuringia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5,0 km Jedermannlauf ab Ak M/W U16 (ab 14 J., ab Jahrgang 2012): 10 €

description: The 11th Höhlerfest Run on September 26, 2026, in Gera offers a varied running event with routes for all age groups and ability levels. New this year is the 22 km cross-country run with obstacles and 420 m of elevation gain, which passes through the city forest and Hofwiesenpark. In addition to classic distances from 0.8 km to 12 km, there are walking and para-athlete routes, as well as the popular parent-child run for preschoolers. The event is known for its special atmosphere, with live music and a family-friendly feel, and is supported by the city of Gera.
course_highlights: 22 km cross-country run with obstacles and 420 m of elevation gain
Routes through Gera’s city forest and Hofwiesenpark
Refreshment stations at 6, 11 and 17 km, as well as at the finish
additional: Late registration is available on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the start, for an additional fee of EUR 5. The award ceremonies begin at 12:15, with trophies for the winners of the 22 km, 12 km and 5 km races. The parent-child run is a fun event, with medals and certificates for all children. Live music and a song composed especially for the Höhlerfest create a special atmosphere. Various running routes, including an obstacle run and a parent-child run; live music; an obstacle run for participants with disabilities; running routes through the city forest and Hofwiesenpark.

name: Lauf Rund um den Grengel
location: Engelskirchen, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Jugendliche (5 km und 10 km) zahlen nur 7,- €

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Jugendliche (5 km und 10 km) zahlen nur 7,- €

description: The Rund um den Grengel Run is a traditional fun run in Engelskirchen, organized annually by VfL Engelskirchen e.V., Athletics & Triathlon Department. The event offers various distances, including a Bambini run, junior races, a 5 km fun run and a 10 km main race, some of which are held as municipal championships. The course is flat and runs across a sports field, roads and forest paths. It has been measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The friendly atmosphere and the involvement of children and young people make this a special event for all age groups.
course_highlights: Flat course across a sports field, roads and forest paths
5 km and 10 km courses measured by the DLV
Municipal championships included over 5 km and 10 km
additional: Late entries are possible online up to 60 minutes before the respective start, subject to a €5 late-entry fee. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Medical services are provided by the Malteser organization in Engelskirchen. All Bambini runners receive a medal. Certificates can be viewed and printed online. Awards ceremonies are held for the three fastest overall finishers in the junior race, 5 km and 10 km. The courses are measured by the DLV; start times begin at 14:00; registration is online only; all age groups may participate; children receive medals and certificates are digital; medical services are available on site.

name: Oldersumer Appel-Loop
description: The Oldersum Appel-Loop is a popular race that takes runners through Oldersum’s scenic parks, along the Rorichumer Tief canal and through the “alte Seilerei” museum. The course finishes in the Apfelpark, where the Oldersum Apple Market is also held, with food and refreshments available. In addition to the main 5 km and 10 km races, there is a 5 km walking course and 800 m children’s races for different age groups. The race is part of the Ostfriesische 7 running series and offers a lovely atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Run through Oldersum’s parks
Route along the Rorichumer Tief canal
Pass through the “alte Seilerei” museum and finish in the Apfelpark
additional: Late registration is possible on the event day until 30 minutes before the start of the respective race. The Appel-Loop is part of the Ostfriesische 7 running series, where participants can receive a series T-shirt by taking part in at least 5 of the 7 races. 800 m children’s race, 5 km walking, 5 km and 10 km main races; through parks and the alte Seilerei museum; part of the Ostfriesische 7 running series

name: R5K Berlin
description: The R5K Tour Final 2026 is a youth race held as part of the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON, where ambitious runners aged 12 to 22 can measure their 5K times. The final in Berlin is part of a three-race series, with times added together to determine the overall winners in the U20 and U23 age groups. In addition to the sporting challenge, attractive prize money and training camp grants are available to the top participants. The event supports young athletes and offers an exciting platform for emerging running talent.
course_highlights: Flat 5K course in the heart of Berlin, starting at Potsdamer Platz and finishing at the Brandenburg Gate
Part of the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON, which features one of the flattest marathon courses in the Abbott World Marathon Majors
Aid stations and BRITA refill stations along the course to help runners stay hydrated
additional: Registration is online from 20.05.2026 to 25.09.2026 through an account belonging to an adult. Results are ranked in the U20 and U23 age groups, and participants must complete at least three 5K races in the cup series, including the final in Berlin. Minimum times apply for prize-money eligibility. Race bibs can only be collected in person at the MARATHON EXPO. A warming poncho is provided free of charge to all finishers in the finish area. The R5K is a series of five 5-kilometer races in Germany for young people aged 12 to 22, with an overall ranking, prizes for U20 and U23, and training opportunities.

name: Schelder Berglauf
description: The Schelder Berglauf is a challenging mountain race in Dillenburg, held annually by ASC Dillenburg. The course runs through varied terrain with steep climbs and offers runners a sporting challenge in a natural setting. The event attracts both competitive and recreational runners and is a fixture on the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain course with steep climbs
Natural course through woods and hills
Traditional event with regional significance
additional: Runner information, terrain details, registration and further guidance are available on the website.

name: Nocna Piątka 2026
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Nocna Piątka is a unique 5-kilometre race taking place on 26 September 2026 in Gdańsk, the day before the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The start and finish are on the illuminated track at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, where participants can expect a spectacular show featuring lasers, music and light effects. The route winds through the city and is enlivened by spectator points with music and fire shows, creating a unique nighttime atmosphere. This new version of the well-known race accompanying the half marathon has moved to Saturday evening to offer runners and spectators a special experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the illuminated track at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
City route with fire shows and spectator points featuring music and a DJ
Spectacular show featuring laser displays and energetic music
additional: The race takes place the day before the half marathon, with the start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. It features a nighttime atmosphere with music, laser and fire shows, and spectator points with a DJ. An evening race with laser and pyrotechnic displays, starting at 20:00, on an illuminated route. An event accompanying the Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon. The participant limit is not provided. Attractions and visual production are described as being of the highest standard.

name: Kołobrzeska Odyseja
description: Kołobrzeska Odyseja ’26 is a series of three exceptional races held in Kołobrzeg, bringing together passion, strength and a seaside atmosphere. The event offers races over 5 km, half-marathon, marathon and 10 km distances. The courses are certified by PZLA, and participants can look forward to generous race packs, a finisher area with a hot meal and drinks, and valuable prizes. It’s a perfect opportunity to feel the energy of the seaside and become part of a new running tradition in Kołobrzeg.
course_highlights: Courses certified by PZLA
A flat course along a pedestrian and cycle promenade with an asphalt and cobblestone surface
Seaside atmosphere and views
additional: Start and finish by the Seaside Hotel at ul. Wschodnia 20 in Kołobrzeg. Race office hours: 16.05.2026, 18:00–20:00, and 17.05.2026, 8:00–10:50. Facilities: baggage deposit, changing rooms, showers and toilets. Professional timekeeping and referees. Finisher area with a hot meal, snacks, isotonic drinks and water. Awards ceremony at the Atrium Seaside Park Hotel. Quiz with additional prizes for participants attending the ceremony. Courses certified by PZLA, finisher area, meals, prizes, awards ceremony, accommodation discounts, timekeeping, generous race packs

name: 42e Halve van Katwijk
location: Duinplein, Katwijk aan Zee, Katwijk, South Holland, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 meter, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The 42nd edition of the Halve van Katwijk takes place on September 26, 2026, and is a popular running and walking festival along the coast. The event is known for its sporty, welcoming atmosphere and beautiful course, which starts and finishes at Duinplein in front of the lighthouse on Katwijk Boulevard. The Halve van Katwijk offers several distances for runners, walkers and children, and attracts many participants each year who enjoy the unique surroundings and friendly atmosphere. The organizers are continually working to improve the event and give everyone an unforgettable day.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Duinplein, right in front of the lighthouse on Katwijk Boulevard
Refreshment stations at Vriezenwei, Panbos and Wassenaarse Slag
Various courses with GPX files available, including special Kidsrun routes
additional: Start and Finish Village at Duinplein with changing facilities, toilets, activities and massage. No on-the-day registration is available. Parking garage on the Boulevard and alternative parking garages nearby. No supervised bicycle parking is available. Business Run with its own start pen, group photo, souvenir and networking drinks afterwards. GPX files for all routes are available. The event also includes a Kidsrun and Business Run; registration is popular and often closes early due to high demand.

name: De 5 van Bavel

description: De 5 van Bavel is an annual running event in ’t Klooster, Bavel, celebrating its 10th anniversary edition in 2026. The event offers a fun and sporty day for all ages, with several distances, including a 5 km race, a 10 km fun run and a kids’ run. The start and finish are centrally located on Kloosterstraat, by Café-zaal ’t Karrewiel. De 5 van Bavel also supports a good cause: research into neuroendocrine tumors (NET).
course_highlights: 5 km race and 10 km fun run, with multiple laps through the village
Kids’ run of approximately 500 metres, starting and finishing on Kloosterstraat
Start and finish by Café-zaal ’t Karrewiel on Kloosterstraat
additional: Late registration and race-number collection are available from 13:00 on race day at ’t Klooster. The Berenboot kids’ run starts at 16:00, followed by the 5 km race at 16:15 and the 10 km fun run at 17:00. The awards ceremony for the top three finishers in each event takes place afterwards. Running event with several races, including volunteers and traffic marshals; part of the Bavelse kermis; registration via the website and on site.

name: Run for Hope
location: Dordrecht Biesbosch, Dordrecht, South Holland, Netherlands
description: Run for Hope is an inspiring running event taking place on 26 September 2026 in the Dordtse Biesbosch. Participants can choose from distances of 5, 10 or 21.1 kilometres and run to raise money for clients of De Hoop, who receive support in building a new life. The run is centred on hope and togetherness, with runners encouraged by supporters as they contribute to a social cause together. The event combines sport with a meaningful commitment to helping others.
course_highlights: Run through the nature-rich surroundings of the Dordtse Biesbosch
Choose from three distances: 5, 10 and 21.1 kilometres
A run with a social purpose and plenty of support along the course
additional: Proceeds from the run will be used to support De Hoop clients as they return to society. The goal is to raise 75,000 euros together. The organisers emphasise the importance of togetherness and experiencing a sense of fulfilment during the run. Distances of 5, 10, and 21.1 km; charity fundraising; scenic run through Dordrecht Biesbosch.

name: Spanderswoud Trailrun
location: s-Graveland, Gooise Meren, North Holland, Netherlands
description: The Spanderswoud Trail Run is a relaxed trail run through the beautiful Spanderswoud and surrounding nature reserves in the Gooi region. The 10, 20 and 30 km routes take you along winding forest paths, singletracks and open heathland, with no race element or time pressure. The start and finish are at the Natuurmonumenten visitor centre at Landgoed Boekesteyn in ’s-Graveland. There are aid stations along the way, and afterwards you can enjoy a snack and a drink at Café-Restaurant Brambergen.
course_highlights: Fully marked 10 and 20 km routes; the 30 km route is partly navigated via GPX
Varied terrain with singletracks, forest paths and heathland
Start and finish at the Natuurmonumenten visitor centre at Landgoed Boekesteyn
additional: Start times for the 10 and 20 km routes are between 09:00 and 11:30 in five time slots; participants choose their own start time. There are two aid stations (approximately at 5 km and at the finish; longer distances have an extra station). First aid is available at the start/finish. The 30 km route requires experience with GPX navigation. There is no timekeeping and no cups at the aid stations; participants are advised to bring their own cup or order an EpicTrails soft cup. Parking is available; carpooling is recommended. Part of the entry fee goes to nature organisations. Trail routes follow forest paths, sandy stretches and narrow trails; there is no race element; start times are selected during registration; GPX data is provided for the long distance; finisher medal; no cups, so bringing your own cup or a soft cup is recommended.

name: Crob Run
description: The Crob Run is a running event in Haaften taking place on September 26, 2026. It offers a scenic run along the dikes around Haaften and through the natural landscape along the Waal, suitable for all ages. There are several distances, including kids’ runs for children aged 5 to 12, and 5 km and 10 km races for adults. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, with music, food options and a bar. Part of the proceeds goes to charity.
course_highlights: Run along the dikes around Haaften
Scenic natural landscape along the Waal
Friendly atmosphere with a DJ, food options and a terrace
additional: Kids’ runs start between 14:00 and 14:30, while the 5 km and 10 km races start together at 15:30. There is a water station on the 5 km and 10 km routes, with fruit and extra water at the finish. Changing rooms are available for men and women. The event grounds are open until 18:00, with a DJ, food options, a bar and a terrace. First aid is available in the Burcht van Haeften building. There is no registration deadline, but places are limited. The 5 km and 10 km have a time limit of 1 hour and 30 minutes. Free parking is available around the Burcht van Haeften; cycling and carpooling are recommended. Participants can enjoy a festive atmosphere with music and food trucks, and receive a medal featuring the windmill and the grey heron of Haaften. The event supports charities such as ROPA run and is wheelchair accessible, with adapted sanitary facilities.

name: Hill Repeat Madness: 4-uurs trailrunchallenge
location: Landgoed Gulbergen, Nuenen, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: Hill Repeat Madness is a challenging 4-hour trail running challenge held at Landgoed Gulbergen in Nuenen. This trail run challenges runners to test their endurance and speed on a varied course in a natural setting. It is organised by Trailrunners Brabant, known for their passion for trail running and for creating a sporty, friendly atmosphere. The race is ideal for trail runners who enjoy an intense and dynamic running experience.
course_highlights: Trail run at Landgoed Gulbergen in a natural setting
4-hour challenge focused on endurance and speed
Varied course suited to trail running
additional: Participants can register via WeTicket. The event takes place at 't Dak van Brabant in Nuenen, with a route of approximately 2.5 km per lap, including elevation changes. There are no shower or changing facilities, and volunteers can sign up to help.

name: BEAT Running Festival
description: The BEAT Running Festival on 26 September 2026 in the Amsterdamse Bos is a unique knockout running event where participants run successive 1 km laps at an increasing pace. The race is about keeping up with an official pacer; anyone who falls behind is eliminated, until one man and one woman remain. Alongside the exciting race, there’s a festival with food, drinks, challenges and a community zone, making the event more than just a running race. The winners receive a sports trip worth €2,000.
course_highlights: 1 km laps with the pace increasing each lap
Pace set by an official pacer
Knockout format until one man and one woman remain
additional: The race starts at a pace of 6:30 min/km and speeds up by 15 seconds per km each lap, down to a minimum pace of 3:30 min/km. After each lap, there’s a short rest zone where runners wait until the pacer sets off again. Eliminated participants remain part of the festival as supporters. There’s a Challenge Zone and Community Zone with activities, merchandise and activations. Knockout race with 1 km laps, increasing pace, festival experience, food & drinks, challenge and community zones, location in Amsterdamse Bos

name: Mission Run
description: MissionRun 2026 takes place on Saturday, 26 September in Scherpenzeel and offers running and walking routes of 5, 10 and 20 km, including a half marathon for participants aged 18 and over. The course runs through the nature-rich countryside around Scherpenzeel, along forest trails and quiet country roads, and is suitable for experienced runners, recreational runners and walkers alike. All proceeds from the event go to International Justice Mission, supporting Anne & Dianne’s Muskathlon. The start and finish are at Oud Willaer 74, with MyLaps timing for the running distances.
course_highlights: Nature-rich countryside around Scherpenzeel, with forest trails and country roads
Varied course on the border of the Gelderse Vallei and the Veluwe
Routes of 5 km (1 lap), 10 km (2 laps) and a half marathon (4 laps)
additional: MyLaps timing for the running events. Race numbers can be collected from 09:30. Walkers can still register on the day. The 10 km route consists of 2 laps, and the half marathon consists of 4 laps of the same course. The half marathon is open only to participants aged 18 and over. Parking is available at De Breelaan 6, 3925 HX Scherpenzeel. Terrain: urban course; timing via MyLaps; registration for running is open until 24 September, and for walking on the day itself.

description: The Zevenheuvelentrail & Dutch National Trail Running Championships take place in the wooded, hilly area around Nijmegen. The trail features challenging routes with steep climbs, difficult descents and unpaved paths through natural areas such as the Nijmegen hills and Landgoed van Jurgens. The Dutch National Trail Running Championships comprise a 28-kilometre short trail and a 56-kilometre long trail, where athletes with an Atletiekunie licence compete for the Dutch title. The organisers provide a welcoming event with aid stations and a professional approach.
course_highlights: Hilly forests around Nijmegen, with steep climbs and difficult descents
Unpaved, narrow paths through natural areas such as the Nijmegen ridge and Landgoed van Jurgens
Routes ranging from 7 to 56 kilometres, with more than 1,000 metres of elevation gain on the longest distance
additional: The Dutch National Long Trail (56 km) starts at 09:00; the Dutch National Short Trail (28 km) starts at 12:30. Drinks are available on the course without restrictions, including water, Maurten sports drink and nutrition. Start waves are staggered; the start area opens 5 minutes before the start, and bibs show the wave. Bib transfers are possible until 25 September at 18:00. Aid stations offer a range of snacks and Maurten gels/bars on the longer distances. Registration is open until 12 September 2026; participation requires an Atletiekunie or hardlopen.nl licence or day licence.

name: BergermeerRun 2026
description: BergermeerRun 2026 is a sporty and friendly event in the Alkmaar neighborhood, suitable for all ages. Whether you want to run fast or simply take part, everyone is welcome to reach the finish together with friends and family. Supporters, music, and volunteers along the course create an energetic atmosphere. This year, the event supports Stichting Leergeld Alkmaar and offers a safe running experience with well-monitored routes and first-aid stations.
course_highlights: Safe course with clear route markers
Support from supporters, music, and volunteers along the course
Maximum of 500 participants for an intimate and friendly atmosphere
additional: Tickets are also available for purchase at the field before the event, with a €2.50 surcharge per ticket. There is space for a maximum of 500 participants. The event takes place on Neighbors’ Day and encourages neighborhood activities and community spirit. Race in Alkmaar with categories for kids and adults; registration closes on September 25, 2026, and on-site registration is available.

name: Roldertoren Run
description: The Roldertorenrun is a running event in and around Rolde, with three distances: half marathon, 10 km and 5 km. The half marathon takes you through the beautiful Drenthe countryside, with heathland, burial mounds, streams and old cart tracks, and finishes at the Jacobus Church. The 10 km is suitable for experienced runners and partly follows the Balloërveld and the Wandelspoor. The 5 km is a fast, fully paved route with views of the Balloërveld and a single track back to the finish at the tower. The start and finish are at the Roldertoren.
course_highlights: Route across the Balloërveld, with purple heathland and burial mounds
A mix of paved and unpaved terrain, with single tracks and old cart tracks
Views of the Roldertoren and a finish at the Jacobus Church
additional: Race number will be mailed to participants. Participation is at your own risk. Start and finish at the Roldertoren. Cancellation with a refund minus administration fees is possible up to 1 month before the event. No pets or buggies are allowed during the race. Registration for the race is closed; participants will receive their race number by post. The event emphasizes the experience and natural beauty of the area.

description: The Schokland Run is a unique running event organised by AV NOP in collaboration with Het Flevo-landschap and Museum Schokland. The run takes place on the beautiful World Heritage Site of Schokland and combines nature, culture and sport on a challenging course. The 10 km route goes across the entire island of Schokland, while the 5 km route goes around the Zuidereiland. The start and finish are at Middelbuurt 2, Schokland. Participants receive a souvenir, timekeeping and a refreshment at Restaurant Schokland.
course_highlights: 10 km route across the entire island of Schokland
5 km route around the Zuidereiland via the Het Flevo-landschap maintenance shed
Start and finish at Middelbuurt 2, Schokland
additional: The entry fee includes a souvenir, timekeeping and a refreshment at Restaurant Schokland. The 10 km route is a new, longer loop across the entire island. The start and finish are at Middelbuurt 2, Schokland. The 10 km route goes across the entire island of Schokland; the 5 km route goes via the Zuidereiland; the start and finish are at Middelbuurt 2.

name: Gelderse Poort Ultra
location: Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken, Ooij, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: The Gelderse Poort Ultra is a challenging 50-kilometre trail that brings the Dutch Ultra Series to a worthy close. The route takes you through the beautiful floodplains around Nijmegen, the forests towards Berg en Dal, and the distinctive countryside in between. With between 700 and 1,000 metres of elevation gain, technical trails, and varied scenery including “klompenpaden” (traditional clog paths), heathland and forests, this ultra offers a special experience in nature. The start is at Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken in Ooij, where participants can enjoy a delicious dinner after the race and, if they wish, stay overnight.
course_highlights: Route through the floodplains around Nijmegen and the forests towards Berg en Dal
Between 700 and 1,000 metres of elevation gain, with plenty of hills
Technical trails, “klompenpaden” (traditional clog paths), heathland and forest scenery
additional: The start location is Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken in Ooij, which has an à la carte restaurant and overnight accommodation after the race. Participants navigate using a GPX file on their own watch or phone. There are 3 to 4 aid stations along the route, but no cups are provided, so bring your own race cup or flasks. The time limit is 8 hours; runners must finish before 17:00. Race bibs can be collected from 08:30 at the race office. The start location is Hotel Restaurant Oortjeshekken in Ooij, with options for overnight stays and dinner. The route has 700–1,000 metres of elevation gain and technical trails, with an 8-hour time limit for the 50 km distance.

name: Groot Boeschoten Trail
distance_verbose: 35 km, 23 km, 13 km, 5 km, 1.2 km, 0.6 km
description: The Groot Boeschoten Trail takes place on Saturday 26 September 2026 in Voorthuizen, starting and finishing at Camping De Zanderij. The routes have been completely revamped and offer a varied course across the Veluwe, through forests, heathland, sandy tracks and historic estates. The course passes open heathland, fields and forests towards Speuld, Huinen and Garderen, with historic sheepfolds serving as landmarks and refreshment stations. The routes are approximately 99% off-road and clearly marked, with premium refreshment stations along the way. Children can take part in a special Kids Trail, which includes a medal and access to the swimming pool.
course_highlights: Completely revamped routes featuring a mix of forests, heathland, sandy tracks and estates
Course passes the historic sheepfolds of Groot and Klein Boeschoten
Approximately 99% off-road, with clear markings and premium refreshment stations
additional: Premium refreshment stations offer water, sports drinks, snacks and fresh fruit. Kids Trail participants receive a medal and a treat, and get access to the swimming pool at Camping De Zanderij. Prizes are awarded to the fastest men and women in the 13 km, 23 km and 35 km events; there are no prizes for the 6 km event or the walks. You can switch to a shorter distance until 1 July, transfer your bib free of charge until 30 June, and cancellations are not possible. The Kids Trail includes a medal and pool access. Distance changes are possible until 1 July; bib transfers are free until 30 June. Cancellations are not possible.

name: 14. Bahrs-Kartoffellauf
description: The 14th Bahrs Potato Run 2026 in Jembke offers runners a varied program with three distances: the 10 km Bahrs Run, the 5 km Potato Run, and an 800 m children’s run. The event takes place on September 27, 2026, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, culinary delights, and a colorful program featuring performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders. Race bibs must be returned after the run, and there is no on-site registration. The event is part of the running cup and offers not only sporting challenges but also a chance to socialize over a generous cake buffet and savory dishes.
course_highlights: 10 km course on Komoot
5 km course on Komoot
800 m children’s run
additional: Start times: 10 km Bahrs Run at 10:30, 5 km Potato Run at 12:00, and 800 m children’s run at 13:15. No on-site registration; advance registration only. Race bibs must be returned after the run. Food and drink include potato soup, veggie bowls, potato pancakes with applesauce, burgers, bratwurst, shashlik, and rosemary potatoes. Performances by the Jembke Cheerleaders at approximately 11:45 and 13:00. Award ceremonies take place after the respective races. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, diverse running options for all age groups, and the opportunity to combine the run with a social gathering.

name: Asse-Volkslauf und Nordic Walking
description: The Asse Run and Nordic Walking event organised by TSV "Vater Jahn" Wittmar is held annually and will take place for the 34th time on 27 September 2026. The event is very popular, with record participation last year. It offers various running and walking routes in the beautiful surroundings of Wittmar and is open to athletes of all ages. Registration opens at the end of June. Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run.
course_highlights: Route distances: 0.3 km and 10.6 km
Nordic walking included
Venue: Wittmar, Germany
additional: Late entries are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, except for the kindergarten run. Registration opens at the end of June; detailed information is available in the official race announcement. The event includes running and Nordic walking events.

name: Schusterlauf
description: The Schusterlauf Preetz is a long-standing running event with various distances, taking place on September 27, 2026, in Preetz. The challenging 16 km course leads through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker, and requires good to very good fitness. Alongside the main race, there are shorter distances, including the Bambini Run for children and the Kirchsee and Wehrberg runs. The event is part of the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, where participants can earn points toward the overall standings.
course_highlights: 16 km course through forests and meadows and along Lake Lanker
Good, firm-footed trails in the Wehrberg and along the shores of Lake Kirchsee
Challenging course with a changeover point at Gut Wahlstorf
additional: Race number collection is available the day before the event (19:00–20:00) and on race day from 08:00 at the Alte Wilhelminenhalle, Schulstraße 2, 24211 Preetz. Participation in the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, including points scoring, is automatic. Race number changes are not possible. New service: Bags can be dropped off in a truck on the Marktplatz near the finish. GPX files for the 5 km and 16 km courses are available to download. Courses are available as GPX files; online registration; start and finish in Preetz; bag drop-off service and results downloads.

name: Bergkloster-Lauf
description: The Bergklosterlauf, organized by TuS Velmede-Bestwig in cooperation with Bergkloster Bestwig, takes place on September 27, 2026, in the Sauerland. The 6, 10 and 21-kilometer races pass idyllic streams, run along ridges with magnificent views and through smaller settlements before finishing at Bergkloster Bestwig. In addition to the races, there are children’s and youth races, plus a supporting program featuring live music, childcare, free massages and extensive catering. The event is also part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup organized by LAC Veltins Hochsauerland. The start and finish are easy to reach and offer ample parking, as well as affordable accommodation at Bergkloster.
course_highlights: Routes pass idyllic streams
Ridges with magnificent viewpoints
Finish at Bergkloster Bestwig
additional: Free massages are offered after the finish. Childcare is available for “running parents.” The start and finish are just 600 meters apart and are easy to reach by bus, train or car. There are 500 parking spaces nearby, including spaces for motorhomes. Affordable accommodation is available at Bergkloster. The 10-kilometer race is also open to walkers. The children’s and youth races start at 12:00. The 10-kilometer race and the children’s and youth races are scoring events for the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup. Routes of 6, 10 and 21 km; children’s and youth races; registration via Race Result; parking and accommodation at Bergkloster; route maps on Outdooractive

name: Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf
description: The Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf is an atmospheric race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf, offering an extensive selection of different running events so there is a suitable distance for everyone. The event delights competitive runners as well as children and recreational runners. The start and finish are on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf. In addition to the sporting event, participants and visitors can enjoy a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music.
course_highlights: Race through the Cologne neighborhood of Bickendorf
Start and finish on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf
Varied program featuring food and drink and music
additional: The event grounds offer a varied program featuring food and drink stalls, exhibitors, and music. The race offers different events for all ages and ability levels. Various distances, including children’s and dog races; registration opens on February 14; a traditional neighborhood race in Cologne-Bickendorf

name: 23. Vinnhorster Volkslauf
description: The 23rd Vinnhorster Volkslauf in Hannover offers flat routes along the canal and through the forest, ideal for personal bests. The race is open to everyone, including walkers and people with mobility impairments. Families can enjoy a baby-jogger run and a varied program of activities, including a bouncy castle, face painting, and a photo booth. A special tradition is honoring the 19th and 56th finishers, commemorating the founding of TuS Vinnhorst in 1956. The Volkslauf is an event for all ages and running levels.
course_highlights: Flat route along the canal
Forest sections
Family-friendly activities, including a bouncy castle and face painting
additional: The race includes distances of 1.2 km, 5 km, and 10 km. Walkers and people with mobility impairments are welcome. There is a baby-jogger run for families. Typical September weather is around 19 °C, with lows of 10 °C; it is usually cloudy, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Flat course, family-friendly activities, special prizes for certain finishers

name: Volkslauf durch das schöne Alstertal
description: The Volkslauf through the beautiful Alstertal takes place on September 27, 2026, in Hamburg and offers runners an attractive route through nature along the hiking trails in the upper reaches of the Alster. The event includes various distances, from a half marathon to 10 km and 4 km, as well as introductory runs for children. The route is notable for its natural setting in the heart of Hamburg, with a few small climbs and stairs. The event is part of the 27th Hamburger Laufcup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments and medical support.
course_highlights: Natural route along the hiking trails in the upper reaches of the Alster
A few small climbs and stairs along the route
Out-and-back courses for the 10 km, 4 km and introductory runs, with the start and finish in the same place
additional: First-aid vehicle and German Red Cross (DRK) support service on the route. Showers and changing rooms in the sports hall on the school grounds. Supervised baggage drop in the gymnasium. Finish-line refreshments include drinks and fruit. Photos and certificates available online. Late entries possible until 27.09. for an additional fee. The event takes place at the grounds of Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium, Sportplatz Struckholt, Wellingsbütteler Landstr. 43 a, 22337 Hamburg. Run in the Alstertal, registration possible by email, results on DAVENGO, part of Laufcup Hamburg.
