description: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the world’s largest and most prestigious marathon events and part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors. The course is known for its flat terrain and takes runners past Berlin’s most beautiful landmarks. In addition to the classic marathon, the event offers a 5-kilometer race, inline skating races, and a variety of ways to participate through charity, tour operators, or running camps. The event is distinguished by its unique energy and international running community.
course_highlights: The flattest course in the Abbott World Marathon Majors, with minimal elevation gain
Route past Berlin’s most beautiful landmarks
15 aid stations with water and energy boosters
additional: On event day, all finishers receive a free, warm, reusable poncho. Alternatively, a bag drop with a transparent bag can be booked for a fee of 5 €. Race materials can only be collected in person at the Marathon Expo with a race card and ID. Public transport is free to use with the race card in fare zones ABC from September 24 to 27, 2026. Personal refreshments can be handed in at designated aid stations (no glass containers). Options include charity entries, travel packages, inline skating, training camps, and special race bibs for charity runners. The event is part of the World Marathon Majors series.

name: Northeimer Stadtlauf
description: The Northeim City Run is a traditional running event held in the town of Northeim. The races start and finish at Münsterplatz, a central location in the town. The event is organized by Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V. and offers a sporting event for runners of all ages. It takes place on September 27, 2026, and features various race distances through the town.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Münsterplatz in Northeim
Urban running routes through Northeim
Event organized by Kreis Sportbund Northeim-Einbeck e.V.
additional: The start and finish are at Münsterplatz, Northeim. The race office is located in the Bürgersaal at Münsterplatz. Online registration for 2026 is not yet available. Results from the previous year are available online. The event offers a mix of road and trail races in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. Registration is not yet available, but interested runners can look forward to September 27, 2026.

name: Auricher Spendenlauf
location: Energie Erlebnis Zentrum, Aurich, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Aurich Charity Run is a non-profit running event supporting various charitable organizations, including Leukin e.V. and the Sandhorst Volunteer Fire Department. The races take place around the Energy Experience Centre in Aurich and offer events for all age groups, from the Bambini run to the main 5 km and 10 km races. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the support of numerous volunteers and sponsors. Award ceremonies take place soon after the races, and certificates are available online.
course_highlights: The Bambini, disability and youth runs follow the walking trail around the Energy Experience Centre East Frisia
The 5 km and 10 km main races pass through an industrial and residential area, starting and finishing at the Energy Experience Centre
The 10 km race consists of two laps of the 5 km course
additional: Late entries are possible on site up to 30 minutes before each event begins. The award ceremonies for the Bambini and senior races take place at 12:30, and those for the main races at 15:30. Certificates for the first three places are presented soon after each race; other certificates are available online. Races for children, young people and people with disabilities; online registration; charitable purpose; courses around the Energy Experience Centre; race times and age groups in accordance with the DLV; course map available

name: Kienberglauf
description: The Kienberglauf is a long-standing running event organized by SV 08 Oehrenstock e.V., held annually on the last Sunday in September. It offers a range of events for different age groups and ability levels, including Nordic walking, children’s races, and distances from 2 to 16 kilometers. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Oehrenstock near Ilmenau and is a highlight of club life. Trophies are awarded to the fastest runners, and all participants receive a certificate.
course_highlights: Scenic routes around Oehrenstock
Various distances from 800 m to 16 km
Events for all age groups, including Nordic walking
additional: Late registrations are possible until 9:00 a.m. on the event day for a fee of €3.00. Trophies are awarded to the fastest runners by time, and all participants receive a certificate. The event has several start times for different races, e.g. Nordic walking at 9:30 a.m., the kindergarten mile at 9:35 a.m., and various running distances from 10:00 a.m. Start times are between 9:30 and 10:10 a.m. Registration is open until 9:00 a.m. with a late registration fee; certificates and trophies are awarded to participants.

name: Kleeblattultra (100-Meilen-Lauf)
description: The Kleeblattultra is a challenging 100-mile ultramarathon in Schwarme, Lower Saxony, passing through three districts. The event was conceived with the idea of establishing the first 100-mile race in northern Germany. Organized by TSV Schwarme and a dedicated four-person team, the race offers experienced ultrarunners a unique opportunity to take on a special challenge. The course consists of four 25-mile cloverleaf loops, run consecutively. The event prioritizes professional organization, with timing, live tracking, and aid stations.
course_highlights: 100 miles through three districts
Four separate 25-mile course sections (cloverleaf loops)
Start and finish area in Schwarme, with the sports hall serving as the event center
additional: Check-in on 25.09.2026 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 26.09.2026 from 07:00 to 08:30. Race briefing on 26.09.2026 at 08:30. Course closes on 27.09.2026 at 15:00. Participants must be at least 18 years old. Participant limit: 30 solo runners and 5 two-person relay teams. Includes timing, live tracking, a pasta party, and a substantial breakfast. Relay teams may start provided they follow the order of the cloverleaf loops (South, West, North, East). The course cannot be shortened. Course length: 162 km. Registration required. Cutoff times. Sponsors welcome. Volunteers wanted. GPX data available.

name: Marner Kohltagelauf
description: The Marne Cabbage Day Run is a traditional race in Dithmarschen and an official part of the Dithmarschen Cup and the Dithmarschen Corporate Cup. The event offers various distances, from 400 metres for children to 10 kilometres for adults. The routes are closed to traffic, well signposted, and marked at every kilometre. Refreshments are available along the route and at the finish, and times are professionally recorded using a chip attached to the race bib. The event takes place in almost any weather and offers changing and shower facilities at the Marne swimming pool.
course_highlights: Routes closed to traffic and well signposted, with kilometre markers
Water stations every 5 km and refreshments at the finish (mineral water, isotonic drinks, fruit)
Chip timing using the race bib, with no rental fee
additional: Late registration is possible online up to 30 minutes before the start, with a €5 late entry fee. Data changes and transfers are possible for an administrative fee of €5. The event takes place in almost any weather. Changing rooms are available, and showers can be used at the Marne swimming pool. Various race distances, registration until August 2026, well-signposted routes, refreshments and changing facilities on site

name: Nordahl Grieg Gedenklauf
organizer: Förderverein der Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule mit gymnasialer Oberstufe Kleinmachnow

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Organisationsbeitrag: Kinder und Jugendliche (bis 19 Jahre) 3,- € pro Person

description: The Nordahl Grieg Memorial Run is a traditional running event in Kleinmachnow, taking place on 27 September 2026 at Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule. The event offers various races for toddlers, schoolchildren, teenagers and adults on circuits around the school and Kleinmachnow Lake. All participants receive drinks and refreshments in the finish area, as well as medals after finishing. The event is organised by the Friends’ Association of Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule and is under the patronage of the Norwegian Ambassador and the Mayor of Kleinmachnow.
course_highlights: Circuit around Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule in Kleinmachnow (800 m toddlers’ race)
Circuit around Kleinmachnow Lake, Karl-Marx-Straße, A.-Grimme-Ring and Schopfheimer Allee
Distances of 3.2 km, 6.4 km and 9.7 km
additional: Late entries are possible on race day until 09:30, with a late-entry fee of €2. Age-group categories are determined according to the DLV competition rules. The use of music devices during the run is prohibited. Trophies are awarded to the overall winners of the main race (9.7 km), and certificates to the top three in all age groups. A perpetual trophy is awarded to the loudest school in the TKS region. A run for children, teenagers and adults, with various distances and refreshments in the finish area. Registration closes on 23.09.2026.

name: Bleckeder Storchenlauf
description: The 1st Bleckede Stork Run takes place on September 27, 2026, offering runners and walkers a choice of distances in the countryside around the sports field in Bleckede. The routes pass through wooded areas and open spaces, with small to moderate hills providing varied running conditions. Race numbers and timing chips must be collected 30 minutes before the relevant start. The event is organized by VfL Bleckede von 1862 e. V. and is open to participants of all ages, including a Bambini run for the youngest runners.
course_highlights: Routes through the countryside, neighboring woodland, and open spaces
Small to moderate hills on the running and walking routes
Various distances from 600 m to 17.4 km for running and walking
additional: Race numbers and timing chips must be collected 30 minutes before the start. Start times are staggered: 10:00 a.m. Bambini run, 600 m; 10:15 a.m. walking, 6.0 km and 10.4 km; 10:30 a.m. running, 17.4 km; 10:45 a.m. running, 6.0 km and 10.4 km. Running and walking routes through nature, with small to moderate hills and various distances.

name: City-Lauf Lübeck
price_range: siehe Text (6-30 € je nach Wettbewerb und Anmeldezeitraum)
description: The City Run Lübeck 2026 takes place on September 27 and offers a varied program for runners of all ages. The event includes a Bambini run, student races, unicycle races, a 5 km run and walk, and the 10 km main race. The routes lead through Lübeck city center, with current construction work taken into account to ensure attractive and safe running routes. The City Run is open to everyone, including people who are not members of a club, and offers team scoring as well as a friendly atmosphere for recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Route through the historic city center of Lübeck
5 km and 10 km races with outer loops along Mengstraße
Separate age-appropriate routes for Bambini runners, students, and unicyclists
additional: Late registration is possible until 26.09.2026; on event day, registration is available only for the 10 km race, from 9:00 to 10:30. Protective gear is mandatory for unicyclists (helmet, wrist guards, and knee pads). Team scoring is available in the student and 5 km races. Bib numbers must not be altered. T-shirts for late registrants are available while supplies last. Terrain: city run, not officially measured; registration online, by mail, or on-site; bib numbers required; team and individual scoring; various age groups.

name: Crosslauf Friedrichsruh mit Kreismeisterschaft
description: The Crosslauf Friedrichsruh with County Championships is a cross-country running event in Geestland, Germany, held at the Sportzentrum Nordeschweg. The event is organized by TV Langen von 1908 e.V. and offers distances ranging from 0.5 km for the youngest participants to 25 km. Alongside the county championship races for children, young people, and adults, there are also open supporting races over distances from 2.5 km to 10 km. The event is distinguished by its friendly club atmosphere and focus on local running.
course_highlights: Cross-country race at the Sportzentrum Nordeschweg
Distances from 0.5 km (Mini Cross) to 25 km
Cuxhaven County Championships included
additional: The youngest U8 runners take part in the accompanied 500 m Mini Cross. Special KM Cuxhaven cross-country races are held for school and youth age groups. The event typically takes place in mild September weather, with temperatures around 19 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Cross-country running, county championships, registration via LADV, various age groups, including races for children and young people

name: Crosslauf und Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder
description: The Cross-Country Run & Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder takes place on Sunday, September 27, 2026, and is organized by SV Grün-Weiß Birkenwerder e.V. Several running distances from 400 m to 8.6 km are offered, as well as a Nordic Walking competition, for which proper pole technique is mandatory. The event is open to various age groups, from Bambini to seniors, and all participants receive a printable certificate; medals are awarded to places 1 to 3. Registration is online, with a limit of 500 places. Late registration is possible through the day of the event.
course_highlights: Several running distances from 400 m to 8.6 km for different age groups
Nordic Walking competition with proper pole technique required
Venue: sports field at Summter Straße 26 in Birkenwerder
additional: Participation is at your own risk; the organizer accepts no liability for accidents or damage. Late registration runs from September 24 through the day of the event and is available online. A total of 500 places are available. All participants receive a printable certificate, and medals are awarded to places 1 to 3. Proper pole technique is mandatory for Nordic Walking. Distances: cross-country run from 400 m to 8.6 km. Online registration; water and changing facilities available on site; medals for certain races; bib number distribution from 09:30.

name: Elmshorner Stadtlauf
description: The Elmshorn City Run is a long-standing running event for the whole family in Elmshorn. The officially measured 5 km loop runs mainly on paved roads through the city centre. Alongside the main 5 km and 10 km races, children’s races over 600 m and 1.5 km are also offered. The event is also the SHLV State Championships and offers a lively atmosphere, with refreshments and a supporting programme at Rathausplatz.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km loop through the city centre
Paved course with a flat profile
Children’s races over 600 m and 1.5 km
additional: The 10 km race starts at 9:30 a.m.; the 5 km races start between 11:15 and 11:20 a.m.; the children’s races start between 11:20 a.m. and 12:45 p.m. Late entries are also possible on the day of the event. The event is a fundraising event for the renovation of the Nikolaikirche church tower. Refreshments including sausage, cake and drinks are available at Rathausplatz. A temporary no-parking restriction applies at the railway underpass on race day. The race routes run on paved roads through the city centre; training sessions are offered before the event; registration is available until shortly before the event; medals are awarded to children.

name: Eper Michaelislauf
description: The Eper Michaelislauf is a traditional, family-friendly race around the town festival in Gronau-Epe. It is recognized as a DLV race and offers low entry fees and affordable refreshments. The event is known for its pleasant atmosphere, appealing to both competitive and recreational runners. Due to possible run-off elections, the race takes place on Saturday in some years.
course_highlights: Loop course around the town festival
Family-friendly course
Low entry fee and affordable refreshments
additional: The Michaelislauf is a DLV race and takes place around the town festival. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere, low entry fees, and affordable refreshments. Due to possible run-off elections, the race may take place on Saturday. The race is held as part of the town festival in Epe, with refreshments and a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: Herdorfer Götzelauf
description: The Herdorfer Götzelauf is a local race in Herdorf, organised by DJK Herdorf and included in the official German race calendar (laufen.de). The event offers two distances, 500 metres and 10 kilometres, and is aimed primarily at the local community and regional runners. DJK Herdorf is an active sports club with regional partnerships, making the race a down-to-earth, community-oriented event. Official DLV rankings may be maintained for some races.
course_highlights: Two distances: 500 m and 10 km
Local race in Herdorf associated with DJK Herdorf
Part of the official German race calendar (laufen.de)
additional: Typical September weather: around 19 °C high, 10 °C low, approximately 45 mm of precipitation, and mostly cloudy. The start location is Herdorf; detailed directions are available. Open to all age groups. No detailed course information is available. The event is part of the Ausdauer-Cup 2024.

name: Herner St. Martini City-Lauf
description: The Herner St. Martini City Run takes place on September 27, 2026, on Boulevard Bahnhofstraße in Herne. The event offers various races for all age groups, from Bambini to adults, with distances of approximately 400 m to 5 km. The courses are officially measured and held under official supervision. Timing is electronic via easychip, and all participants receive a certificate. The event is organized by IG Herne City e.V. and TV Wanne 1885 e.V.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses with official supervision
A range of distances from approximately 400 m to 5 km for all age groups
Start and finish on Boulevard Bahnhofstraße in Herne
additional: Late entries are possible on the event day until 1 hour before the respective race, for an additional fee of €3. Race packs can be collected in advance on September 24 and 25, 2026, at the Sports Department in Herne. Timing is electronic via easychip provided by davengo, Berlin. Results lists can be purchased at the race office for €3. Changing rooms are available in schools. The event includes children's races, school competitions, and running distances for all ability levels. Registration is via an Excel form, and the event emphasizes community and sporting challenge.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The Volkswandertag in Wymeer on September 27, 2026, invites everyone who enjoys running and hiking to discover the varied landscape around Wymeer. Runs of 6 km, 12 km and 21 km are offered, suitable for everyone from beginners to half-marathon enthusiasts. There are also opportunities for hiking, Nordic walking and cycle touring on well-marked routes with refreshment points and friendly volunteers. After the sporting activities, participants can enjoy a varied selection of food and drinks and round off the day in good company. The Volkswandertag promotes community, outdoor exercise and showcases the region’s most beautiful spots.
course_highlights: Runs of 6 km, 12 km and 21 km for everyone from beginners to half-marathon enthusiasts
Hiking, Nordic walking and cycle touring through a varied landscape
Well-marked routes with refreshment points and friendly volunteers
additional: Registration is available online or in person on the day of the event from 8:00 a.m. Hearty food and cake will be available after the sporting activities. The event is open to individuals, families, friends and clubs. It’s an opportunity for the whole family to get active and enjoy the nature around Wymeer.

name: Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Arena Gdańsk Operator Sp. z o.o.
description: Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Gdańsk, featuring a 21.0975 km course. The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The race is open to mass participation, with starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time, and participants can also enter 4-person relay teams. The organizers provide professional timekeeping, medical support, refreshments and water along the course. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, and helps raise the profile of Gdańsk in Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: A 21.0975 km half-marathon course in Gdańsk
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk
Starting corrals assigned according to declared finish time
additional: The start and finish are located at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The start is divided into time-based corrals according to declared finish time (red, blue, green and yellow). Relay teams start from the blue corral. The race package includes a waterproof bib with a chip, timekeeping, medical support, water at refreshment points, refreshments after the finish and a medal. The full race package is guaranteed for payments made by 30.08.2026. The bib must be attached horizontally to the front of the shirt. Passing the bib to another person without the organizer’s consent is prohibited. The event includes various distances, including a half marathon and 5 km race, with a participant limit of up to 10,000. Registration takes place online, and fees can be paid via Przelewy24 or by traditional bank transfer. Races for children and teenagers are also available.

name: 13. Garmin Półmaraton Gdańsk Nocna Piątka
location: Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
organizer: Akademicki Związek Sportowy COSA Oddział w Gdańsku
description: Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon is an annual running celebration in the heart of the Tricity, taking place on September 26–27, 2026. The program will feature a new event, the Night Five: an evening 5 km run with light displays, fireworks, and cheers from spectators. The main event is the 13th edition of the half marathon, covering 21.0975 km and traditionally starting and finishing at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The course is fast and suited to setting personal bests, while the race has a unique atmosphere thanks to spectator support and beautiful urban scenery.
course_highlights: A fast 21.0975 km half-marathon course suited to setting personal bests
Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk—the most beautiful stadium in Poland
Night Five: an evening 5 km run with light displays and fireworks
additional: Start and finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk. The Garmin Gdańsk Half Marathon start is divided into waves based on declared finishing time (red, blue, green, yellow). Relay teams start from the blue wave. The Night Five starts in the evening on 26.09.2026, after 20:00, with light displays and fireworks. Race packets will be distributed at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk on 26–27.09.2026. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 13:30 on the day of the half marathon. The event also includes races for children over various distances, warm-ups, awards ceremonies, and registration opening earlier, on October 7. Participants can look forward to attractive cash prizes and record bonuses.

name: Tilburg Ten Miles
description: The Tilburg Ten Miles is the most convivial running festival in Central Brabant and has been held annually since 1988. The event attracts thousands of recreational runners and elite athletes, who run through Tilburg’s decorated streets, cheered on by enthusiastic spectators and live music. With distances of 16.1 km, 10 km and 5 km, there is a suitable challenge for every runner. The atmosphere is festive, and the route offers a lovely mix of urban surroundings and distinctive local spots.
course_highlights: Run through Tilburg’s decorated streets with enthusiastic spectators
A varied course through the heart of Tilburg, with wide streets and distinctive local spots
Live music and a festive atmosphere along the course
additional: Race numbers must be collected in advance at the Koepelhal on Saturday or Sunday. Registration by 23 August 2026 includes a race number with your name, medal engraving and a limited-edition running shirt. There is a Run Against Cancer campaign where participants can create a fundraising page and receive a special shirt when donations reach €500 or more. Multiple distances are available, including walking events and children’s races; participation is possible until 16 August; special race numbers and merchandise are available; the event supports charities such as KWF.

name: Rijk Zwaan Loop
price_range: twee tarieven voor alle afstanden, vroegboekkorting tot 8 september 2026
description: The Rijk Zwaan Loop is a running race and recreational run in 's-Gravenzande, celebrating its 25th edition in 2026. The day starts with the Kids Run at 13:00, followed by various distances, including a revamped 5 km and 10 km course. This year also features a new walking event with distances of 7, 14 and 21 kilometres, with proceeds going to Team Westland. The organisers invite runners of all levels to take part in this festive and sporting day.
course_highlights: Revamped 5 km and 10 km course, starting on Langestraat
Water stations along the route and post-finish refreshments including fruit, vegetables, sports drink and water
Walking event with route directions and a coffee stop; proceeds go to Team Westland
additional: The Kids Run starts at 13:00 and is limited to 450 participants. Race numbers are distributed in advance for those who register early. SAW chips are used for timing the 5 km and 10 km. Changing facilities are available at ISW College, at your own risk. Post-finish refreshments include fruit, vegetables, sports drink and water. The Kids Run has separate categories by primary school year group and age. The walking event is at participants' own risk and includes a coffee stop along the route. The Kids Run starts at 13:00, with a maximum of 450 children; location near Sand-Ambachtstraat and ISW College; no on-site registration.

name: Geuzenloop Zoetermeer

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voorinschrijving is mogelijk tot zaterdag 26 september 2026, 18:00 uur

description: Geuzenloop Zoetermeer is an annual running event taking place for the 22nd time on Sunday, September 27, 2026. It is Zoetermeer’s largest running race, with distances ranging from a half mile to a half marathon. The start and finish are at Pilatusdam in Zoetermeer’s historic center. The courses pass through both Old and New Zoetermeer, including the former Floriade site and Balijbos. There are also Geuzen walking tours of 6 to 25 kilometers, organized by Road Runners Zoetermeer and Sportief Wandelgroep Zoetermeer.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Pilatusdam in Zoetermeer’s old center
Courses pass through Old Zoetermeer, New Zoetermeer, the former Floriade site, and Balijbos
Walking tours of 6 to 25 kilometers through natural areas with historical significance
additional: Geuzenloop is inclusive and accessible: buddies accompanying visually impaired runners and walkers can participate for free after registering. All running routes and the 6 km walking tour are wheelchair accessible. Each distance has a cut-off time to ensure the course remains clear. Finishers receive a unique medal made from a tree trunk slice by people distanced from the labor market. The finish closes at 15:00. Registration opens on May 1, 2026; medal made from pruned wood; option to change distance; closing run and after-party on September 30; no medal option for all participants.

name: Earth Race
location: Amsterdam Forest, Amstelveen, North Holland, Netherlands
distance_verbose: 128 km, Marathon, Halve marathon, 10 km, 5 km
description: Earth Race Forest Edition is a multi-themed endurance event held in the beautiful Amsterdam Forest near Amstelveen. The race offers distances from 5 km up to an ultra 128.8 km, winding through woodland trails, ponds, and open meadows with scenic views of this urban nature reserve. The event combines sport with environmental impact, supporting rainforest protection and local nature projects. Participants enjoy a festival atmosphere with hydration stations, medical support, and a unique afterparty experience.
course_highlights: Routes wind through 1,000 hectares of Amsterdam Forest with woodland trails and pond paths
Well-marked courses with clear signage throughout
Regular hydration and nutrition stations with medical support from ‘Het Witte Kruis’
additional: Official entry and time registration included. Medal awarded to marathon and ultra finishers. Performance shirt for ultra-distance participants. Special superfood recovery drink provided. Pre-events include monthly boot camps and clinics led by professional athletes. Impact Expo and family activities on race day. Money-back guarantee, excluding the donation portion and safety-related cancellations. 25% of proceeds support Amazon rainforest protection, 20% support local Amsterdamse Bos projects, and 55% are invested in future events. Endurance races in nature, support for rainforest protection, pre-event training at the Olympic Stadium.

name: 42 ste Joustermerkeloop
distance_verbose: 16.2 km, 10 km, 7 km, 1500 meter, 1 km, 0.5 km

name: Jasperloop

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voor iedereen die mee wil doen en niet lid is, kost de inschrijving € 1.

description: The Jasperloop is a monthly running race held in the beautiful woodland near Keelven in Someren. The race is open to everyone, young and old, and features a 2.5 km loop on semi-paved paths and sandy trails. Participants can choose how many laps to run, up to a maximum of six. The race starts at 10:00, and registration is available at the starting location from 9:30. The Jasperloop is a friendly, accessible event that has been organised for many years.
course_highlights: A 2.5 km loop through woodland near Keelven
Semi-paved paths and sandy trails
Up to 6 laps, chosen by participants during the race
additional: Registration is available from 9:30 at the starting location near Keelven. Times are recorded and published on the website later that day. Parking is available at bosrandweg 6, 5711 RJ Someren, with clear signs from the provincial road. The race is held on the last Sunday of every month, except in December. The Jasperloop includes various distances and is known for its friendly atmosphere, with families and training runs. Other events, such as training sessions and fireworks, are also organised around the race.

name: Sport 2000 Sparta Westvlietloop op zondag 27 september 2026
location: Sportpark Westvliet, Voorburg, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The Sport 2000 Sparta Westvlietloop is a running race organized by AV Sparta in Voorburg, taking place on Sunday, 27 September 2026. The event offers several distances, including 1 km and 2.5 km junior races, and 5 km and 10 km adult races. The race starts from the athletics track at Sportpark Westvliet. The route passes through varied surroundings, with sections along Westvlietweg and Schrepelpad, over a cycle bridge, past the ADO stadium and through cycle tunnels. Runners in the 10 km race complete two laps. The organizers welcome members and non-members alike to take part and learn about the club.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the AV Sparta athletics track at Sportpark Westvliet
Route along Westvlietweg and Schrepelpad, over a cycle bridge and past the ADO stadium
10 km runners complete two laps; 5 km runners complete one lap
additional: The race is made possible in part by Sport 2000 on Julianaplein in Voorburg. There are 1 km and 2.5 km junior races, and 5 km and 10 km adult races. The organizers hope both members and non-members will take part and get to know AV Sparta. The location is Groene Zoom 20, 2491 EH The Hague. The race takes place on and around the athletics track at Sportpark Westvliet, with routes along Westvlietweg and Schrepelpad, over a cycle bridge, past the ADO stadium and through cycle tunnels.

name: Runway Run for KiKa - Twente Airport
organizer: Stichting Runway Run voor Run for KiKa
description: The Runway Run for KiKa at Twente Airport is a unique running event held on the runway of a former airbase. Participants experience a special combination of sport, atmosphere and purpose as they run along the tarmac surrounded by aircraft and music. The event offers several distances, including a Kidsrun, 5 km and 10 km, and is a great opportunity to take action together against childhood cancer. The flat courses are ideal for both beginner and experienced runners looking to push their limits.
course_highlights: Run along the runway at Twente Airport
Super-flat course, perfect for record attempts
Timing provided by myLaps
additional: After the finish, participants receive a medal and a drink. There is an opportunity to enjoy a drink or a bite to eat at Vliegveld Twenthe Evenementenlocatie. There is a business team competition with a leaderboard and a prize for the winning team. The start and finish are at Vliegveld Twenthe Evenementenlocatie. Run on an airport runway. Distances: Kidsrun, 5 km, 10 km

name: Marathonblokken - Run Your City
description: Marathon Blocks is a series of running training sessions organised by Hardloopnetwerk in partnership with PUMA to help runners prepare for their marathon. The sessions take place in several cities, including Amsterdam, Soest and Utrecht, where participants run together at marathon and half-marathon pace. Participants can test PUMA shoes and try sports nutrition during the sessions. The event offers an energetic, social atmosphere, ideal for both beginner and experienced marathon runners looking to improve their performance.
course_highlights: Training at marathon and half-marathon pace on traffic-free, safe routes
Laps around the Sloterplas in Amsterdam, wooded cycle paths near Soesterduinen, and traffic-free loops on Het Lint in Utrecht
The opportunity to test PUMA running shoes and use sports nutrition during the training sessions
additional: Each session has a limited number of places (150 for Amsterdam and Soest, 300 for Utrecht). Changing and shower facilities are available at the venues. The Utrecht session has water stations, gels to try, and the option to leave your own bottles. The sessions are intended to help runners prepare for a spring marathon and provide a social, motivating environment. Sessions take place at various locations in the Netherlands, with facilities such as changing rooms and showers; the event combines sport, running-product testing and social activities.

name: duurlopen met hazen
price_range: 5 euro per training of gratis voor 'jaarleden'
description: Duurlopen met hazen is a running event in Amstelveen where participants can train with pacers in a relaxed atmosphere and enjoy refreshment stations. The loops vary in distance and take place at scenic locations such as the Amstel area and Amsterdamse Bos, often on the Amsterdam Marathon course. The start is usually at 10:00, but in warm weather it is moved earlier to protect participants. Facilities such as ice water and sponges help runners cool down during the run.
course_highlights: 6.0 km and 5.5 km loops in Amsterdamse Bos
Amstel area location on the Amsterdam Marathon course
Refreshment stations with ice water and sponges to cool down
additional: The maximum running time is 3 hours. At temperatures of 26 degrees or higher, the event starts at 9:00. The start location is the car park along the Amstel, just past Rozenoordbrug (Ouderkerkerdijk 150). Participants can cover different distances by running different loops (6.0 km and 5.5 km). There are several pace groups. Endurance training sessions last 60–95 minutes and focus on stamina and technique, with locations including Amsterdamse Bos and Waterleidingduinen.

description: The Heyu VathorstRun takes place on Sunday, September 27, 2026, in Hooglanderveen. The event offers three distances: 5 kilometres for beginners, the classic 10 kilometres sponsored by MONI, and a new distance of 10 English miles (16.1 km). The route runs through Vathorst, a beautiful area for running and enjoying sport and a friendly atmosphere together. The organisers invite everyone to take part and offer a special discount through Heyu.
course_highlights: 5 kilometres — perfect for getting started
10 kilometres — the classic distance through Vathorst
Heyu 10 English miles (16.1 km) — a new, challenging distance
additional: Use discount code HEYU20 for 20% off registration. Heyu is the main sponsor and also sponsored the 10-kilometre race last year, with 40 Heyu shirts at the start. The organisation is the data protection officer (FG014854). Register with discount code HEYU20; sponsor: Heyu; location: Hooglanderveen; multiple distances, including a KidsRun for all ages.

name: 12e Halve van Alphen
location: Alphen aan den Rijn, South Holland, Netherlands
organizer: Alphen a/d Run en CAS Alphen
description: De Halve van Alphen is a lively autumn classic taking place on Sunday, 27 September 2026, in Alphen aan den Rijn. The 21.1 km half marathon takes you past green spaces, parks and nature reserves in the Groene Hart on a course that is almost traffic-free. As well as running, you can take part in relay teams, skate, cycle, walk or even bring a leashed dog. The start and finish are at Sunset Beach Bar by the Zegerplas, where a welcoming atmosphere and an after-party await participants and spectators.
course_highlights: An almost traffic-free course past green spaces and nature reserves in the Groene Hart
Routes through parks and the Zegersloot area
Start and finish at Sunset Beach Bar by the Zegerplas
additional: Registration is available only in person and is free, from 08:00 until 15 minutes before the start of your distance. Start times: 21 km walk at 08:30, half marathon (21.1 km) at 10:00, 10 km at 10:30 and 5 km at 11:00. Parking is limited; cycling is recommended. There are no changing facilities or showers. A supervised bag drop is available, but it is not continuously monitored. There is a water station at 13 km and water at the finish. Wear your race number on your chest at all times. An after-party with food and drinks will be held at Sunset Beach Bar. De Halve van Alphen is not a race, but a personal-record event. The route follows public roads and cycle paths, with traffic marshals on hand. Distances: 21 km, 10 km and 5 km; registration in person; limited parking, so come by bike.

name: Uiterwaarden Run Nederasselt
price_range: 4, 9 of 11 euro afhankelijk van de afstand

tiers.label: tier_1

description: On Sunday, September 27, 2026, the Uiterwaarden Run Nederasselt takes place, a running event in the beautiful floodplains of Nederasselt. Participants can choose from three distances: 1.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km. The routes include sections along the Maasdijk, through nature, and past the lock. The start and finish are at the Dorpshuis Nederasselt, which has facilities including toilets and a hospitality venue. The event has a sporty, friendly atmosphere and is suitable for all ages and abilities, from beginners to experienced runners, with professional timing and prizes for the fastest runners in each distance.
course_highlights: Run along the Maasdijk
Route through nature in the floodplains
Past the lock
additional: Start times: 1.5 km at 10:00, 10 km at 10:30, and 5 km at 12:00. Start and finish at Dorpshuis Nederasselt, with facilities including toilets, changing rooms, and a hospitality venue. Drinks station along the route for the 5 km and 10 km. Every participant under 12 receives a medal. Professional timing using tags attached to race numbers. Award ceremony after the 5 km for the three fastest women and men in each distance. Distances: 1.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km; start times: 10:00, 10:30, and 12:00; free entry for the 1.5 km; medal for participants under 12; awards for the fastest participants.

name: Vechtstreek in Beweging Lopen
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km
price_range: 7,50 euro volwassenen, gratis voor jeugd t/m 13
description: De Vechtstreek in Beweging Lopen is a friendly, well-organized running series in the Utrecht region, organized by athletics club OSM’75 Atletiek & Recreatiesport Maarssen. The races take place in the wooded Maarsseveense Plassen recreational area, on a fully paved, traffic-free course around the large lake. Participants can choose their own distance and pace, making the event suitable for both beginner and experienced runners. Pacers are available at different speeds to support everyone.
course_highlights: 5 km laps through the wooded Maarsseveense Plassen recreational area
Fully paved, traffic-free course around the large lake
Pacers available at speeds of 5:00 to 6:20 min/km
additional: Registration opens one month before the race and closes on the Saturday before race day. Late registration is possible, but the specific rules and fees are unknown. Pacers run distances of 10 km, or 15 km if there are enough runners following them. On 27 April, the shortened 2.5 km distance is not available. Registration opens one month before the race; on-site registration is also possible, with payment preferably by debit card. Participation is free for children up to and including age 13.

name: HooilandRun
description: The HooilandRUN is a friendly running race in and around the ’t Hooiland neighbourhood in Lichtenvoorde, suitable for beginner and experienced runners, children and adults. The course combines semi-paved walking paths with paved surfaces, including rolling paths and two short climbs. Several distances are offered, including 1 km and 2 km for children, and 5 km and 10 km for adults. The organisers provide chip timing, water stations and prizes for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Course featuring semi-paved walking paths and paved surfaces
Rolling walking paths with two short climbs (viaduct and butterfly bridge)
1 km loops for the shorter distances and 5 km loops for the longer distances
additional: Chip timing; chips are handed out at registration and must be returned after the race. Changing facilities are available, but there are no showers. A water station is provided on the 10 km route, with an additional station in warm weather. All children receive medals; trophies are awarded to the three fastest children in each short-distance race and to the three fastest men and women in each adult-distance race. The race takes place on a course with varied surfaces and short climbs, and is held at Wijkgebouw de Schoppe. There are no shower facilities.

name: MaatGarant Run Bke Marathon
description: The MaatGarant Run Bike Marathon is an accessible, sporty event where teams of 2 to 4 participants cover a marathon distance of 42.195 km together. Each team member runs about 10 kilometres while the others cycle, making it ideal for anyone with a reasonable level of fitness. Organised by AV Spirit in Oud-Beijerland, the event is all about achieving something together, having fun and team building, rather than focusing on winning. The marathon takes place on Sunday, 27 September 2026, and offers a friendly, personal atmosphere, similar to the RopaRun but on a smaller scale and closer to home.
course_highlights: Teams take part together: one person runs while the others cycle
The 42.195 km distance is shared among team members
Start and finish at the AV Spirit event grounds in Oud-Beijerland
additional: Teams start at 60-second intervals, with the fastest runners setting off last so that all teams finish at about the same time. All participants receive a medal and a keepsake. Prizes are awarded to teams finishing in 5th, 10th and 15th place, not just to the three fastest teams. There is ample parking at the start/finish location. Team building, accessible, sporty and fun; suitable for groups and companies.

name: Dobbeloop
distance_verbose: 15 km, 12 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3.2 km, 1500 meter, 0.8 km

description: The Dobbeloop is a monthly recreational running event organized by the Nootdorp Ice Club, held in the natural area around Dobbeplas between Pijnacker and Nootdorp. The course is almost entirely traffic-free and paved with asphalt, with guidance from cyclists, arrows, and staffed checkpoints. The start is at the Nootdorp Ice Club clubhouse at Oudeweg 74 in Nootdorp. There are various distances for children and adults, with on-site registration and a friendly atmosphere in the clubhouse.
course_highlights: Course around Dobbeplas in a natural area
Fully paved asphalt course that is almost entirely traffic-free
Distances from 3.2 km to 15 km over multiple laps
additional: The children’s run for ages 5 and under (750 meters) starts at 10:30, the youth run for ages 6–12 (1,500 meters) starts at 10:45, and the other distances (3.2, 5, 10, and 15 km) start at 11:00. The clubhouse opens at 10:00, with changing and shower facilities available. Registration takes place on site. Children receive a memento if they participate at least 6 times out of 10 during the season. Results are usually published on the website the same day. Because of congestion around the start/finish area, participants are asked to come on foot or by bicycle if possible. Traffic-free course, start and finish at the clubhouse, on-site registration, start times may differ for the half marathon.

name: HeteRUN
location: Het Hart van Heteren, Heteren, Gelderland, Netherlands
description: HeteRUN is Heteren’s running event, taking place on Sunday, September 27, 2026. The event offers distances for all ages, including kids’ runs of 500 and 1,000 metres, as well as challenging 5 km and 10 km running routes. The routes are suitable for both experienced and advanced runners and take place in the heart of Heteren. The organisers provide a friendly atmosphere and good facilities, including changing rooms and first aid on site.
course_highlights: 5 km route for experienced runners, sponsored by REDDY Keukens Heteren
10 km route for advanced runners, sponsored by Dekker groep BV
KidsRUN distances of 500 and 1,000 metres for different age groups
additional: The start location is the square in front of the ‘living room of Heteren’ (Kwadrant 2, Heteren). Timing is by shoe chip. Collect your race number and chip from 13:00 for the 5 km and from 14:00 for the 10 km at Het Hart van Heteren. Changing rooms are available at Massage Praktijk Beleef. A toilet trailer is available; there are no showers. First aid is available. Registration is open until Saturday at 20:00; there is no registration on the day itself. Registration opens on June 1, 2026, and closes at 20:00 on the Saturday before the event, with no option to register on the day itself. The event is held on the square in front of the ‘living room of Heteren’ and includes facilities such as toilets, but no showers.

name: Euromast Trappenloop

description: The Euromast Stair Climb is a unique sporting challenge in which participants climb the 589 steps of Rotterdam’s iconic Euromast. This second edition, on September 27, 2026, offers an unforgettable experience with official timing, an exclusive medal, and spectacular views over the city. The race is suitable both for athletes aiming for a personal best and for anyone ready to take on the challenge. Afterwards, participants can relax at the Brasserie, and friends and family can also enjoy the Euromast with a discount code.
course_highlights: Climb 589 steps, rising 96 metres
Multiple start waves for a smooth flow of participants
Spectacular views over Rotterdam from the observation platform
additional: Access to the Euromast observation platform is included with the ticket. After the race, participants can unwind at the Brasserie. Multiple start waves help ensure a smooth flow of participants. Participants receive a discount code for friends and family to visit the Euromast. The race includes climbing 589 steps, access to the observation platform at the top, and post-race facilities. Participants can register via the official website, and the event offers a unique way to experience the Euromast through sport.

name: Raamvallei Duomarathon
location: Land van Cuijk, North Brabant, Netherlands
description: The Raamvallei Duomarathon is a unique duo event in which teams of two cover a marathon course of over 42 kilometres together on one bicycle. One partner runs while the other cycles, and they can switch whenever they like. The route passes through the beautiful Land van Cuijk, along the Raam and by distinctive places such as Landgoed de Barendonk, forests, meadows and historic windmills. The event is all about teamwork, enjoyment and the experience, with no timing or race rankings. Along the way, participants can enjoy local snacks and drinks and live music. The festive finish features a red carpet and a traditional Brabant sausage roll.
course_highlights: Route of over 42 km through the Raamvallei, past forests, meadows and historic sites
Start and finish at Landgoed de Barendonk
Refreshment stations with local snacks and drinks, and live music
additional: The Duomarathon has no timing or race rankings; it is about sporting achievement and enjoyment. Refreshment stations are located every 5–7 km, alongside 'smikkelplatskes' serving local treats and music. A special 'smokkelroute' lets supporters visit several points along the course. Around 80 volunteers help organise and support the event. The festive finish includes a red carpet, ceremonial arch, champagne and a traditional Brabant sausage roll. The route winds through forests and meadows, with culinary treats, festive anniversary decorations, and supporters and volunteers helping make the event special.

description: The Broekstaclerun is a challenging and sociable obstacle run in Broekland, featuring a unique mix of running, mud and obstacles. The event has a cosy, down-to-earth character and a varied course through nature, where pushing yourself and having fun go hand in hand. It is accessible and organised sustainably, and is suitable for participants of different ages and abilities. The atmosphere is always festive, and the event is supported by enthusiastic volunteers and local landowners.
course_highlights: Natural obstacles and muddy challenges
A varied course through the Broekland forests
Three distances: 3.5 km (for children), 5 km and 10 km
additional: Children aged 7 and under must be accompanied by an adult who is also registered. You can run together by using a group name to start in the same wave. Shirts can be ordered during registration until 6 September. Registration transfers are possible until 1 week before the event. The race includes mud, obstacles and a course through Broekland; registration is open for multiple distances.

name: 100 Bruggenloop
description: The 100 Bridges Run in Leiden is a unique walking and running event in which participants cross 100 bridges, ranging from centuries-old stone arch bridges to modern bridges in Singelpark. The route follows rivers, canals, tow canals and waterways, passing some of the most beautiful places in the historic city centre, including the Netherlands’ oldest university, Hortus Botanicus and various monuments. The walking event takes place on Saturday 26 September 2026, and the running event on Sunday 27 September 2026. Several distances are available, so both recreational walkers and runners can take part.
course_highlights: Cross 100 bridges over rivers, canals, tow canals and waterways
Pass historic sights such as the oldest university and Hortus Botanicus
Route through Singelpark, harbours, city gates and distinctive architecture
additional: Walkers start on Saturday between 08:00 and 11:00 from Van der Werfpark. Runners start on Sunday from 08:00 at Stadhuisplein/Vismarkt. The walking time limit is 16:15 and the running time limit is 11:15. Support is available along the route, with checkpoint stations, first aid and a commemorative medal. Dogs are allowed on a leash, except in Hortus Botanicus. Children under 12 may participate only when accompanied. The city is not closed to traffic; the route runs along pavements and pedestrian areas. Late registration is possible on the day, with a €2.00 surcharge. The event provides practical information about registration, times and facilities. The route includes a variety of surfaces, such as gravel, shell paths, brick, cobblestones, wood, concrete and asphalt, and is accessible to people with reduced mobility.

description: The Ehrmann Posbankloop is a unique running event through the beautiful natural surroundings of the Veluwezoom, with challenging elevation and a breathtakingly beautiful course. The 30th edition takes place on Sunday, 27 September 2026, in Velp and offers several distances, including a 15 km main distance, a 6 km race and a walking tour. The route passes iconic places such as the Posbank and the Emmapiramide, with the challenging “Muur van Aalbers” as a special competition within the competition. The Posbankloop is suitable for both recreational and dedicated runners and is known for its lively finish with large crowds.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural surroundings of the Veluwezoom with plenty of elevation
Climb of the Posbank and the “Muur van Aalbers” (Emmapiramide)
Start and finish in the centre of Velp, near the station
additional: Race numbers must be collected well before the start at Gezondheidscentrum Velp, Rozendaalselaan 34. The time limit is 55 minutes for the 6 km race and 120 minutes for the 15 km race. The “Muur van Aalbers” is a special segment, with watches awarded to the first man and woman to reach the top. For registrations made before 17 September, the participant’s name will be printed on the race number. Water and fruit are available at the finish, along with a discount voucher for running shoes at Run2Day Arnhem/Nijmegen. The start/finish is close to Velp station and easily accessible by train and bicycle. Anniversary edition featuring a walking tour and children’s clinics; location: Velp; event date: 27 September 2026.

name: 7-loop Zevenhoven
location: SV Zevenhoven, Zevenhoven, Nieuwkoop, South Holland, Netherlands
description: The 7-Loop is a running event with a rich tradition spanning more than 35 years in the Municipality of Nieuwkoop. It takes place in Zevenhoven and is known as a true autumn classic, with scenic courses through the polders of the Green Heart. The 7-Loop is part of the Nieuwkoops Circuit and brings the circuit to a close with an exciting final ranking. There are various distances for both children and adults. Children can take part for free and receive a shiny medal.
course_highlights: Scenic courses through the polders of the Green Heart
Children’s races of 400m and 800m around the football fields
The 7-Loop is the final event in the Nieuwkoops Circuit
additional: The start and finish area is at Stationsweg 23, Zevenhoven. Free parking, changing rooms, showers and catering facilities are available. The children’s races start between 11:30 and 12:00, and the adult races start between 12:30 and 13:00. The children’s races are free and take place around the finish area and football fields. The 7-Loop is a compulsory race in the Nieuwkoops Circuit, and participants must register online in advance to score points in the circuit. Course through the polders of the Green Heart, including children’s races and various distances, free participation for children, registration through 24 September 2026.

description: CityRun Nijverdal is a fun running event for all ages, taking place on Sunday, 27 September 2026. The event offers four distances: KidsRun, 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km, plus a G-Run for participants with disabilities. The fast course is KNAU-certified and runs right through the centre of Nijverdal, with plenty of music and encouragement from spectators. The organisers are committed to making it a sporting event that brings participants and spectators together.
course_highlights: Fast, KNAU-certified course through the centre of Nijverdal
Precisely measured 5 km and 10 km routes with multiple laps
Music and encouragement along the course
additional: Start times by distance: G-Run at 12:45, KidsRun from 13:00 in age groups, 10 km at 14:30 and 5 km at 16:00. Race numbers include a transponder for timekeeping. Post-finish refreshments include water, sports drink and fruit. The Red Cross will be present with 6 staff members and 2 cyclists. There are no showers, but an unsupervised changing area is available. A special running shirt can be ordered for €12,95. The school with the most participants wins free ice cream. The course is fast and KNAU-certified; start time 16:00. Registration is open until 13 September 2026, with a discount. A medal and race number are included. A special running shirt can be ordered. Parking is available at the market square and at Albert Heijn. Train connections run from Zwolle and Almelo. Refreshments include drinks and fruit. There are no showers. Timekeeping is by transponder.

description: The Texel Half Marathon is a unique running event with a nautical character, taking place on Sunday, 27 September 2026. The start is special: runners set off from the TESO ferry, with the ship’s horn signalling the start. There are three distances: the half marathon, quarter marathon and eighth marathon, all finishing in the centre of Den Burg. A Kidsrun organised by Sportstichting Texel takes place beforehand for younger runners. Participants receive an original T-shirt, a medal and refreshments along the way.
course_highlights: Start from the TESO ferry, with the ship’s horn signalling the start
Choose from the half marathon, quarter marathon or eighth marathon, all finishing in the centre of Den Burg
Nautical character and a unique island setting
additional: All distances start at 12:25 when the TESO ferry’s ship’s horn sounds. The half and quarter marathons can start either from the ferry or from the island. The eighth marathon starts in Den Hoorn. All distances finish in the centre of Den Burg. A Kidsrun takes place in the centre of Den Burg before the half marathon. Cycling is not permitted on the beach or in the forest; bike rentals are available on the island. Every participant receives an original T-shirt, a medal and refreshments along the way. Registration details can be changed via a personal dashboard until 20 September 2026. T-shirt changes can be submitted until 31 May. Registration opens on 1 February 2026 via the website, with payment by iDEAL, Bancontact or Sofort. Minimum ages range from 12 to 18 years, depending on the distance. Overnight accommodation and team registration are available. The start is at 12:25; participants can choose to start from the ferry or from the island.

Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit 2 lopen

description: The Zorg en Zekerheid Circuit is a running series consisting of nine varied races in the Groene Hart. It starts on 1 November 2026 and runs until April 2027. The series offers a platform for both beginner and experienced runners, where taking part is more important than winning. Participants can enjoy a range of distances, including 5 km, 10 km, 10 English miles and a half marathon, as well as an original free running shirt and a great end-of-series gift for taking part in 8 or 9 races. The circuit fosters a friendly, sporting atmosphere and attracts a growing number of participants.
course_highlights: A range of distances: 5 km, 10 km, 10 English miles and a half marathon
A course alongside the picturesque Kromme Mijdrecht river and through Wickelhofpark
A family run and G-Run for children up to age 12 in the sports park next to the sports hall
additional: Circuit participants can switch between the short and middle distances as often as they like at the information desk. Switching to the long distance is not possible without a separate entry. Changing rooms, showers and limited bag storage are available. Replacement race numbers can be obtained at the information desk if yours is lost. Prize ceremonies take place in the sports hall. Coffee, tea and soft drinks are available for collection in the sports hall. Multiple distances, a series of races over 6 months, participation discounts for insured members, a free running shirt, and an end-of-series gift for taking part in 8 or 9 races.

description: The Nightrun on Friday evening, 2 October, is a vibrant sponsored run organized by SAV and SSV to celebrate the opening of the renovated athletics track in Grootebroek. The track is lit with candles, LED lights and atmospheric lighting, while a DJ provides music and energy. Each participant has one hour to run as many laps as possible and can seek sponsorship per lap or for a fixed amount. The Nightrun is suitable for all ages, with special start groups and a unique blend of sport, sociability and club spirit.
course_highlights: Illuminated athletics track with candles, LED lights and atmospheric lighting
Music and energy provided by a DJ throughout the evening
Each participant runs as many laps as possible for up to one hour
additional: A maximum of 75 participants per hour. Race numbers can be collected up to 15 minutes before the start. There are several start groups: 19:00 (children up to 12 years old), 19:30 (special relay run for invitees), 20:00, 21:00 and 22:00 (75-minute anniversary group). Participants may take part in costume. Tickets are non-refundable. By participating, entrants agree to the use of images on social media.

name: Westenholterun

description: The Westenholterun 2026 takes place on Friday evening, 2 October, at Sportpark de Weidesteen in Zwolle. The event offers a friendly, sporty atmosphere and several distances, including a Kids Run, 4 English Miles, a 10-kilometre run and a 10 km Powerwalk. All entry proceeds go to Hospice Zwolle, a small-scale home for people in the final stage of life. The start and finish are at WVF, where an awards ceremony and raffle will also take place afterwards.
course_highlights: Course through the Westenholte neighbourhood in Zwolle
Water stations halfway through and after the finish for the 4EM and 10 km
Shared course for the 10 km run and Powerwalk
additional: Race numbers can be collected at WVF from 17:00 until 30 minutes before the start. Changing rooms are available at the sports park. After the event, there will be an awards ceremony and a raffle for participants in the 4EM, 10 km and Powerwalk. Participants are advised to come by bicycle if possible. The bicycle parking area by the entrance is closed, but an alternative bicycle parking area is available at the sports park. Registration opens at 17:00, with a raffle afterwards. The event supports the charity Stichting Nikai 4 Life.
