name: Ekerumsloppet
description: Welcome to Ekerumsloppet, an autumn cross-country race around Ekerum and Rällaskogen on Öland, organised by Högby IF Friidrott. The race offers 10 km for adults and approximately 1.3 km for young runners, starting at 11:00 and 10:00 respectively. The start and finish are at Ekerum Resort. The registration deadline is 26 September 2026; late registration is available at race-number collection from 09:00 on race day. The race follows cross-country trails through the forest around Ekerum and Rällaskogen.
course_highlights: Cross-country trails through the forest around Ekerum and Rällaskogen
Start and finish at Ekerum Resort
Two distances: 10 km for adults and approximately 1.3 km for young runners
additional: A cross-country race through the forest around Ekerum and Rällaskogen; Start and finish at Ekerum Resort; Registration deadline: 26 September 2026; Late registration at race-number collection from 09:00 on race day

name: Tidaholm Marathon
description: Tidaholm Marathon is a running event in Tidaholm, Sweden, organized by Motionsloppet. Official information and results are published on motionsloppet.se. The event is promoted on Motionsloppet’s Facebook page and listed as Tidaholm Marathon on the municipality’s events page, suggesting it is a recurring race in the area.
additional: Results are available on motionsloppet.se; the event has been promoted via the municipality’s Facebook events page (Tidaholm Marathon).

name: Rya Åsar Trail Run 2025

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 295 kr jubileumspris max 100 platser eller till och med 31 mars

description: Rya Åsar Trail Run is a family-friendly trail race in the Rya Åsar Nature Reserve in Borås, with several distances for both competitive runners and recreational participants. The race features beautiful trails, challenging hills and stunning views of lakes and cliffs. The event is a festival at the start and finish area, with music, exhibitors and a runners’ lounge. It has been held since 2017 and offers both children’s races and sanctioned competitions.
course_highlights: Beautiful trails and challenging hills, including Djävulsbacken/Björbotoppen
Scenic views and sections by Rya Klint and Fjällsjön; the 24 km course has approximately 685 metres of elevation gain
Varied terrain: technical trails, gravel roads and a final downhill stretch
additional: Race bib collection is available Friday 13:30–18:00 at Glasögonmäster and Saturday 09:45–12:45 at the event area. Chip timing is provided by Eq Timing; bags can be left at the start/finish area. Parking is available on Almenäsvägen, at Ryda Sportfält and in Knalleland; nearby bus stops have good connections. The runners’ lounge and food/coffee are available on site; changing facilities and showers are available at Borås Camping. Aid stations: the 24 km course has 4 stations and the 12 km course has 2 stations (Umara sports drink). Recommended equipment: mobile phone, elastic bandage and trail shoes (especially for 24 km). Sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association; part of the Trailtour. Start time: 13:00. The 2025 race was moved to 5 October due to a weather warning. Contact and registration: info@ryaasartrailrun.se. Results are published on the race results page.

name: John Bauer Trail Run
distance_verbose: 18 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km, 2 km, 0.4 km
price_range: 18 km: 400–700 kr; 10 km: 320–600 kr; 5 km upplevelseloppet: 160–300 kr; 5 km Stortrollens lopp: 120 kr; 2 km Knattetrollens lopp: 120–250 kr; 400 m: ej angivet
description: John Bauer Trail Run is a tough, hilly trail race held from the IKHP cabin on Huskvarnaberget. The race offers several distances (18 km, 10 km, 5 km, and several children’s/youth classes) and runs partly on trails and partly off-trail, with significant elevation gain and technical descents. A special feature is Strutsabacken, where climb times are recorded and the Bergatroll award goes to the fastest ascent. The event is family-friendly, with food and activities at the start/finish, as well as changing rooms and showers in the IKHP cabin.
course_highlights: Tough, hilly trail sections on both trails and off-trail terrain
Strutsabacken (the ski slope), with a separately timed climb and the Bergatroll award
Views over Lake Vättern and a technical descent through Ulvadalen
additional: Late registration is available on race day between 9:00 and 11:00. Race bibs with timing chips must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:15 and worn visibly at the front during the race; the chip does not need to be returned. Aid stations are located along the course (with kilometre markers for each distance). Changing rooms and showers are available in the IKHP cabin, valuables can be stored in a locked area at bib collection, and food is available at the start/finish. After finishing, participants are treated to a “troll menu” by the organiser (show your race bib). Hamburgers are served after the race; aid stations are available along the course; changing rooms and showers are available; Startklar insurance is available (175 kr/year); maximum 500 participants; race bibs must be collected from the IKHP cabin by 11:00.

name: Broloppet Motala
description: Broloppet Motala returns with a familiar yet new course, starting and finishing in Stadsparken in central Motala. The race is organised by Motala AIF Friidrott and offers short recreational distances suitable for a wide range of participants: both 5 km and 10 km are available. Promoted as one of Sweden’s most beautiful recreational races, the event welcomes recreational runners and runners of all levels to take part on 3 October.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Stadsparken in central Motala
A familiar yet new course through central parts of Motala
Short recreational distances (5 km and 10 km) suitable for recreational runners
additional: Organiser: Motala AIF Friidrott. The event is described as “Sweden’s most beautiful recreational race”. The website encourages visitors to save 3 October in their calendars and notes that prices apply until 28/9 (the next price increase). There are four distances: 10 km, 5 km, 1.5 km (youth) and 400 m (children’s race). Race numbers can be collected at Team Sportia on 2–3 October. The prize ceremony takes place in Stadsparken at approximately 14:30.

name: Korschenbroicher Waldlauf
location: Waldstadion Korschenbroich, Korschenbroich, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 21st Korschenbroich Forest Run takes place on October 3, 2026, at the Waldstadion Korschenbroich. The event offers races over distances from 400 to 10,000 meters, as well as walking, and is open to all age groups. It includes a new 2,300-meter race for young people in age groups U14 to U18. Alongside the sporting competition, there will be a cafeteria and a raffle in aid of the youth department. Held on German Unity Day, the race combines sporting commitment with a good cause.
course_highlights: Distances from 400 to 10,000 meters, plus walking
New 2,300-meter race for age groups U14 to U18
Event at the Waldstadion Korschenbroich on German Unity Day
additional: Cafeteria and raffle in aid of the youth department; NEW-Group is the new main sponsor; registration opens in early 2026; the event takes place on German Unity Day. Courses run across the sports field and forest paths; spikes are not allowed. Registration opens in early 2026; sponsored by the NEW-Group.

name: RheinEnergie Kinderlauf Köln
description: The RheinEnergie Children’s Run Cologne takes place on October 3, 2026, at Roncalliplatz by Cologne Cathedral. The event offers several child-friendly races over distances from 500 m to 2,000 m. Most of the course is closed to traffic and secured by course marshals. Before the run, there is a children’s church service at Cologne Cathedral, after which the children start their races together. Children born between 2015 and 2021 are eligible to participate. There is no timing; the focus is on having fun and taking part.
course_highlights: The route passes Cologne Cathedral
Start and finish at Roncalliplatz
Closed course with course marshals
additional: Race bibs can be collected on October 3, 2026, from a tent at Roncalliplatz. On-site registration is also available on race day from 9:00 to 12:15. Depending on the number of participants, the children start in several waves, divided by age group and/or gender. There is no timing, and children should be able to complete the course without parental accompaniment. Several races with different distances; no timing; participation open to children born in 2015 or later; limit of 1,000 children; online registration available; race bibs collected on race day.

name: Rothaarwaldlauf
location: Rothaargebirge, Bad Berleburg-Aue, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Rothaar Forest Run organized by TSV Aue-Wingeshausen is a popular, scenic forest run in the Rothaar Mountains, taking place on 3 October 2026. The event offers a range of distances, including loop courses and point-to-point routes, appealing to both competitive athletes and recreational runners. The races are part of the Rothaar-Laufserie AOK-Cup, which is celebrating its 25th anniversary this year. The course passes through beautiful woodland with moderate climbs. Excellent refreshments and bus transfers to the start points of the longer routes are provided.
course_highlights: A range of distances from 400m to 28km, including loop courses and point-to-point routes
Start and finish at the Aue-Wingeshausen sports ground, with bus transfers to the start points of the longer routes
Scenic forest routes with moderate climbs and good refreshments
additional: Start times vary by distance; for example, the main race starts at 13:30. A bus transfer runs from the Aue-Wingeshausen gymnasium to the start points of the longer routes (15km and 28km). Race packs can be collected at various locations until shortly before the start. Showers and changing facilities are available at the gymnasium. Late entries are possible at the start points until 30 minutes before the start. The event is part of the Rothaar-Laufserie AOK-Cup, which is celebrating its 25th anniversary. Participants can enjoy shuttle bus transport and refreshments including cake, waffles and fries, as well as an established tradition on the running calendar.

name: Saerbecker Kirmeslauf
price_range: Bambinilauf € 1,00; Schülerläufe 1,2 km und 2 km € 3,00; 5 km Jedermannlauf € 8,00; 10 km Hauptlauf € 10,00
description: The Saerbeck Kirmes Run takes place on October 3, 2026, at Sparkassen Stadium Saerbeck. The course is entirely paved and flat, and runs along well-maintained secondary roads, allowing for fast times. The event offers races for various age groups, with transponder timing and results determined by finish order. Children receive medals, and awards are presented for the overall and age-group results. Participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Well-maintained, fully paved course
Flat secondary roads for fast times
Start and finish at Sparkassen Stadium Saerbeck
additional: Timing is recorded using a transponder attached to the back of the race bib. Finish order determines the results. Online certificates are available to all participants. The course is monitored by volunteers, but traffic rules must still be observed. Every child receives a medal in the children's races. Liability for theft is excluded. Participants must confirm that they are in a healthy state of training. Online registration is available; late entries are accepted on the day of the event for a fee; the event is held under official supervision in accordance with DLV/IWR rules.

name: 16. Köhlbrandbrückenlauf
description: The Köhlbrandbrückenlauf is Germany’s largest bridge run and crosses the landmark in the Port of Hamburg. The event offers runners the unique opportunity to cross the impressive Köhlbrand Bridge and experience the harbor atmosphere up close. The race attracts numerous participants each year and is known for its distinctive course and great atmosphere along the route.
course_highlights: Run across the impressive Köhlbrand Bridge in the Port of Hamburg
Unique harbor atmosphere with views of the water and ships
A distinctive route crossing a Hamburg landmark
additional: Registration opens on December 3, 2026, and typically fills up quickly. There is a race-entry exchange for sold-out races. The event offers bag storage with a coupon, and every finisher receives a medal. Optional medal engraving can be booked during registration for €10.00. Public transport is recommended, as parking is limited. The race is known for its special location in the Port of Hamburg; participation is limited, and the event attracts many runners from across Germany. Medal engraving is also available for a fee, and the event takes place annually in October.

name: 26. Bismarck-Gedenklauf
description: The Bismarck Memorial Run is an annual road and trail race in Schönhausen (Elbe), Saxony-Anhalt, held on German Unity Day. Organized by SV Preussen 27 Schönhausen, it is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP and offers 6.5 km and 13 km races, as well as shorter runs for children and young people. The course starts at the club’s sports center, follows paved roads into the forest and past Kollerberg, and the longer distance is run twice. The event honors Otto von Bismarck, Schönhausen’s most famous son, and concludes with an awards ceremony and refreshments at the sports center.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center of SV Preussen 27 Schönhausen
Course follows paved roads and passes through the forest by Kollerberg
The longer distance (13 km) consists of two laps of the 6.5 km course
additional: Children’s races: 900 m for U8 to U12, and 3 km for older children and young people. Refreshments and an awards ceremony at the sports center after the race. The event is part of the regional ELBE-OHRE-CUP. Distances: 6.5 km, 13 km, and children’s races; held on October 3; included in the ELBE-OHRE-CUP; weather-dependent, with temperatures typically around 14°C in October.

name: 28. Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
description: The 28th Alfelder Leinetal Run takes place on Saturday, October 3, 2026, in Alfeld, Lower Saxony. Various distances are offered for adults, including 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, all finishing at Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, marked courses are ideal for maintaining a steady pace. There are also races for children and teenagers, making for a varied program.
course_highlights: Flat, marked courses
Shared finish area at Hindenburg Stadium
Various distances for adults and children
additional: The 5 km race starts in the morning, the half marathon about 30 minutes later, and the 10 km race starts around midday. Typical October weather is around 14°C, with a low of 6°C and mostly cloudy skies. Courses: 600 m, 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; finish at Hindenburg Stadium; average October weather: 14°C, approximately 40 mm of precipitation.

name: 49. Warburger Oktoberwochen Volkslauf
location: Sportzentrum Diemelaue, Warburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 49th Warburger Oktoberwochenlauf takes place on October 3, 2026, at the Diemelaue Sports Center in Warburg. The event offers a 5 km corporate competition and is also open to young people and school students. Registration is by SEPA direct debit via RaceResult. Further details about the race announcement will be shared with participants later.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Diemelaue Sports Center
5 km course with a corporate competition
Event on October 3, 2026
additional: The entry fee is collected by SEPA direct debit via RaceResult. A corporate team consists of three people. Further information will be provided later in the race announcement. Corporate competition, online registration only, results on the website and RaceResult, race at the Diemelaue Sports Center

name: Alfelder Leinetal-Lauf
location: Hindenburg-Stadion, Alfeld, Hüllhorst, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Alfelder Leinetal Run takes place on Saturday, October 3, 2026, in Alfeld, Germany. The event offers 5 km, 10 km, and half-marathon races, all finishing at Hindenburg Stadium, which serves as the shared finish area throughout the day. The flat, marked courses are ideal for maintaining a steady pace. There are also races for children and teenagers, making for a varied program.
course_highlights: Flat, marked courses
Shared finish area at Hindenburg Stadium
Races for children, teenagers, and adults
additional: The 5 km race starts in the morning, the half marathon 30 minutes later, and the 10 km race starts around midday. October weather is typically around 14 °C, with lows of around 6 °C; it is mostly cloudy, with average precipitation of 40 mm. The courses are suitable for competitive races, including children’s and teenagers’ races; the event is part of the club program.

name: Burgentrail Unterfränkische Traillaufmeisterschaften
description: The Burgentrail in Ostheim is a challenging trail running event hosting the Lower Franconian Trail Running Championships on October 3, 2026. The course follows varied forest and meadow paths, passing historic castle ruins such as Lichtenburg and Königsburg, and features technically demanding trails with roots and steep descents. The scenic setting, with views across the Grabfeld, makes this a special experience for trail enthusiasts of all ability levels. SC Ostheim/Rhön warmly invites all running enthusiasts to take part in this sporting highlight.
course_highlights: Start at the school sports field, followed by forest and meadow paths
Passage by Lichtenburg castle ruins, with views across the Grabfeld
Technically demanding trails with roots and steep descents to Königsburg
additional: The Burgentrail is part of the Trailrunning Cup Rhön 2026, which consists of three events. Participants who take part in all three races are included in the overall standings. Every finisher receives an online certificate. The course includes technically challenging sections with roots and steep trails that require coordination and concentration. Trailrunning Cup Rhön 2026, courses with elevation gain, registration via the website, GPS data available for download, varied trails through forests and mountains.

name: Cross der deutschen Einheit
price_range: 5 € Nachmeldegebühr, Bambini- und Staffellauf ohne Startgeld
description: The Cross of German Unity in Weißensee is a traditional cross-country race organised by the Blau-Weiß 1921 Weißensee e.V. sports club. This race is being held for the 35th time and offers various events for all age groups, including Bambini races, youth races, a 3.5 km race, a 10.5 km race, a half marathon, and walking/Nordic walking. The course loops around the gondola pond, with varied sections including climbs and stairs, and offers a sporting challenge for runners of all ability levels. A jubilee relay race rounds off the programme; it requires no registration and has no entry fee.
course_highlights: Course around the gondola pond, with flat and hilly sections
3.5 km race with two laps, each featuring two climbs (a hill and stairs)
Half marathon consisting of 2 x 10.5 km laps, with a marked start/finish area
additional: On-site registration is possible until 03.10.2025 at 10:00, with a late registration fee of €5 / €2 for children. The Bambini race and jubilee relay race are free and require no registration. Parking is available directly at the gondola pond; signs point to the Chinese Garden car park. Courses range from flat to hilly; on-site registration is available, with parking at the gondola pond.

name: Duvenstedter Dorflauf
description: The Duvenstedter Dorflauf is a traditional race around Alt Duvenstedt, held annually on German Unity Day. With several distances for children, teenagers, and adults, it offers a suitable challenge for all age groups. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere, volunteer commitment, and wonderful village community. The course is well marked and offers varied running scenery in and around Alt Duvenstedt.
course_highlights: Course with color-coded sections and a split on the main race at approximately 6.5 km
Start and finish at Alt Duvenstedt Primary School
GPX files of the courses available for sports watches
additional: Timing is provided using transponders loaned free of charge (a €40 deposit is required if one is not returned). Changing and shower facilities are available in the sports hall, but there are no lockers. After the race, each participant can receive a free drink, cake, or sausage by handing in their voucher. Children and teenagers up to age 14 can enter free of charge. Terms and conditions, privacy policy, right to object, online registration from August 1, 2026; no late entries accepted.

name: Krautsander Insellauf
location: Drochtersen, Elbinsel Krautsand, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Krautsand Island Run is a long-standing running event on the Elbe island of Krautsand near Drochtersen. Organized by SV Dornbusch and TV Wischhafen, the event offers an appealing course in a natural setting. It is open to runners of all ability levels and takes place annually on October 3. The event is organized by the Kehdingen Athletics Association, which ensures everything runs smoothly.
course_highlights: Run on the Elbe island of Krautsand through natural surroundings
An appealing course for runners of all ability levels
A traditional event on German Unity Day
additional: Registration deadline: October 1, 2024; category: off-stadium events; registration, results, photos, accommodation information

name: Langeooger Sanddornlauf 2026
description: The Langeoog Sea Buckthorn Run takes place on 3 October 2026 on the island of Langeoog and offers races for different age groups. The main distances are 5 km and 10 km on paved paths and roads, ideal for islanders and visitors. Young runners can take part in dedicated 400 m (Bambini) and 1000 m (youth) races. The event marks the end of the island running series and is supported by the island school. The awards ceremony takes place in front of the Haus der Insel, where runners gather after finishing.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Haus der Insel on Langeoog
5 km and 10 km on paved paths and roads
Dedicated children’s races: 400 m Bambini race and 1000 m youth race
additional: The event is considered the season finale of the island running series. Children from the island school help as course marshals. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Running event on 3 October 2026 with 400 m, 5 km and 10 km distances; includes children’s races; finale of the year’s running series; October weather around 14 °C, with possible rain; start and finish at the Haus der Insel.

name: Stimberg-Haardlauf
description: The Stimberg-Haardlauf is a traditional race in Oer-Erkenschwick, starting and finishing at Stimbergpark. Various distances are offered for children, teenagers and adults, including 500 m, 4.9 km and 9.4 km. The adult courses have varied terrain, offering a change from flat road races. The event includes individual and team classifications and is aimed at club runners, local teams, and young and adult athletes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stimbergpark in Oer-Erkenschwick
Varied-terrain adult courses of 4.9 km and 9.4 km
Shorter distances for children and teenagers, such as 500 m
additional: The schedule is organised by age group and event, with categories such as forest runs and short and long cross-country races. Individual entries and team classifications are available. Typical October weather is around 14 °C, with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The race features varied terrain with rolling hills. Online registration is available until shortly before the event, with different categories for various age groups and ability levels.

name: Strausseelauf
description: The Strausseelauf in Strausberg is a traditional annual running event. It gives runners of different ability levels the opportunity to compete and enjoy the beautiful surroundings of Lake Straussee. The event is organized by Kultur- und Sportclub Strausberg e.V. and takes place at Theodor-Fontane-Gymnasium in Strausberg. It is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.
course_highlights: Run around Lake Straussee
Start and finish at Theodor-Fontane-Gymnasium
Traditional event with a friendly atmosphere
additional: The race announcement and flyer for the Strausseelauf are available; results are published on the official website.

name: 4 Moore Ultratrail-Marathon
description: The 4 Moore Ultratrail Marathon is a non-commercial 53-kilometre ultratrail landscape run around Langenhagen. The route crosses varied moorland and heathland, including Kananoher Forst, Schwarzes Moor, Otternhagener Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Große Heide and Bissendorfer Moor. The course is unmarked and navigated by GPS; the final GPS track and a briefing are sent by email in advance. Three aid stations provide drinks and snacks, and participants must bring their own drinking containers and cups. Participation is limited to 50 starters, and the time limit is 9 hours.
course_highlights: 53 km ultratrail through moorland and heathland near Langenhagen
Route passes through Kananoher Forst, Schwarzes Moor, Otternhagener Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Große Heide and Bissendorfer Moor
Unmarked course; GPS navigation is required, with the track provided in advance
additional: Maximum 50 starters. Time limit: 9 hours. Three aid stations with cola, water, fruit and snacks; some are unattended. Bring your own water bottle and cup. Coffee, cake, bratwurst and drinks at the finish. Participants must be at least 18 years old. Participation is at your own risk; the organiser accepts no liability. Trail sections, GPS navigation, 3 aid stations, maximum 50 participants, 9-hour limit, start in Kaltenweide

name: XXXVII Oskie Biegi im. Krzysztofa Malinowskiego
Pieken+Dalen Festival
location: RCN het Grote Bos, Doorn, Utrecht, Netherlands
description: On Saturday, October 3, 2026, the very first Pieken+Dalen Festival will take place at RCN het Grote Bos in Doorn, organized by Stichting DiabetesPlus. This unique event combines walking and running over a range of distances, from a 5-kilometer loop to a marathon, in the beautiful Utrechtse Heuvelrug. After the effort, a warm welcome awaits at the festival grounds, with opportunities to meet, music, a Buddy Tent, a Q&A with diabetes researchers, a TechTent, and various food trucks. The festival offers a special opportunity to face the peaks and valleys of blood sugar together with friends, family, and fellow athletes in a welcoming and inclusive setting.
course_highlights: A range of walking and running distances from 5 km to a marathon
The beautiful, hilly natural landscape of the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
Festival grounds with music, a playground, and diabetes technology
additional: After the sporting activities, the festival grounds feature a Buddy Tent, a Q&A with diabetes researchers, a TechTent showcasing the latest diabetes technology, musical performances by people with type 1 diabetes, a playground for children, a prize raffle, and various food trucks serving food and drinks. Walking and running activities, technology and social activities, food trucks, family- and child-friendly

name: 11e Molenloop (Molensmooiste) Alblasserdam-Kinderdijk
description: Molensmooiste is a unique running race taking place on Saturday, 3 October 2026, at the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Kinderdijk. Participants run past all the area’s iconic windmills. The 10 English Miles consists of two laps, while the 5 English Miles is one lap. The start and finish are in the heart of the windmill area, making for a special and atmospheric experience. With a limit of 1,500 participants and organised under the auspices of AAA Atletiekvereniging Alblasserdam, it is an event for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: The route really does pass all the windmills of Kinderdijk
The 10 English Miles consists of two 8 km laps through the windmill area
Start and finish in the heart of the UNESCO World Heritage Site
additional: The start and finish are in the heart of the windmill area, with pace-based waves because the start path is narrow. Race numbers and shoe tags can be collected from 07:00 in the runners’ village, no later than 09:00. There is one drinks station per lap. The Kids Run takes place on Wednesday, 30 September 2026, at the AAA Atletiekbaan Alblasserdam and is free; registration is available on site. The race includes wave starts for different distances, is part of the Grote Rivieren Loopcircuit, and registration is open until maximum capacity is reached. Late registration is not possible.

name: Kûbaarder Hurdrindei
description: The Kûbaarder Hurdrindei is a well-known running and recreational running event in Friesland, held annually on the first Saturday of October. The course follows quiet, low-traffic paths and roads, including the historic Slachtedijk and the “griene dyk” dating from 1200. There are three distances: 5 km, 11.2 km and a half marathon of 21.1 km, plus a free Kidzzrun for children over 1 and 2 km. After the run, participants can relax with a cup of hot broth and enjoy a friendly chat. The event attracts 120 to 140 participants each year and is open to runners of all levels, including people with disabilities.
course_highlights: Course along the historic Slachtedijk (the old Middelzee dike, dating from around 1100 AD)
Quiet, low-traffic paths and roads
Routes along the winding “griene dyk” dating from 1200
additional: Maximum of 250 participants. Race numbers can be collected on 3 October from 11:30 to 12:30 at Petronella Moenstrjitte 22. Late registration is available at the village hall between 12:00 and 13:00; late registration closes at 13:00. The Kidsrun starts at 13:00; all other distances start at 13:10. Race numbers are colour-coded by distance. Medals can be collected after the event. Event date: 3 October 2026; approximately 100 participants in 2025; weather conditions can be challenging.

name: Midden Drenthe Loop
location: Camping Midden Drenthe, Zwiggelte, Midden-Drenthe, Drenthe, Netherlands
description: The Midden Drenthe Loop is an annual running race organised by Loopgroep Westerbork, with its 36th edition scheduled for Saturday, 3 October 2026. The event offers two distances, 5 and 10 kilometres, and starts and finishes at Camping Midden Drenthe in Zwiggelte. The routes pass through the beautiful countryside of Midden Drenthe. The 5 km route is entirely paved, while the 10 km route includes a short stretch of sandy path. The race is open to participants aged 12 and over, and finishers receive a medal.
course_highlights: The 5 km route is entirely paved
The 10 km route includes a short stretch of sandy path
Start and finish at Camping Midden Drenthe in Zwiggelte
additional: The minimum age to participate is 12. Participants receive a medal at the finish. Cancellations are free of charge up to 14 days before the race. Results are based on net time, measured using a timing system. Pets and baby carriers are not allowed. The route passes through Midden Drenthe and includes paved sections and a sandy path. Registration is via an online form.

name: Molens Mooiste
description: Molensmooiste is a unique running race taking place on Saturday 3 October 2026 at the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Kinderdijk. Participants run through the iconic windmill area, with the start and finish in the heart of this beautiful landscape. The race offers two distances, 5 English Miles (8 km) and 10 English Miles (16 km), with this year’s routes passing all the windmills of Kinderdijk. Starts take place in waves because of the narrow start path, so everyone can make the most of the windmill experience. The event is organised under the auspices of athletics club AAA Alblasserdam and attracts around 1,500 participants.
course_highlights: Route passes all the windmills of Kinderdijk
Start and finish in the heart of the UNESCO World Heritage Site
100% asphalt course with one drinks station per lap
additional: Race number and shoe tag will be ready at the runners’ village; collect them by 09:00 at the latest. Starts take place in waves because of the narrow start path. The runners’ village opens at 07:00. After finishing, participants receive a medal and a windmill map. Optional extras: an event shirt (€24,95) and a running cap (€14,95); order by 19 September 2026 at the latest. Registration is open while places remain, up to a maximum of 1,500 participants. The event starts at 09:30 and offers a unique experience through a landscape of windmills and UNESCO World Heritage.

name: Rondje Lindewijk
description: Rondje Lindewijk is a friendly running event in rural Lindewijk, Drenthe, taking place on October 3, 2026. The race offers various distances from 0.5 km to 16.1 km, including special kids’ runs and racerunner categories, making it accessible to runners of all ages and levels. The course is flat and runs through the village, ideal for building a steady pace. The organizer, Start78, creates a warm village atmosphere and offers the option to order a unique Rondje Lindewijk shirt when registering.
course_highlights: Flat course through the village of Lindewijk
Distances ranging from 0.5 km to 16.1 km
Special racerunner categories
additional: Order your Rondje Lindewijk shirt in good time when registering to make sure you receive it. Flat course through the village; registration via the official page; includes kids’ runs and racerunner categories.

name: Rondje om de Koepel
location: Recreatiecentrum De Goudsberg, Lunteren, Gelderland, Netherlands
organizer: Marijke Steenbergen, Henk van Voorst, Alwin Grubben, Gert van Dalen

description: Rondje om de Koepel is a popular running event in Lunteren and the surrounding area. The route takes participants past the Centre of the Netherlands, over the Goudsberg and through the Lunteren Community Forest, with its distinctive Koepel. The event offers three distances: a 1 km Kids’ Run, a 5 km run and a challenging 10 km run. The course is mostly on forest trails, with climbs and descents. The event is professionally supported, with warm-up sessions and care provided by Therapeutisch Centrum Lunteren. It also supports local charities, making it both a sporting and community-minded event.
course_highlights: Run past the Centre of the Netherlands
Forest-trail course with climbs and descents
Run through the Lunteren Community Forest and over the Goudsberg
additional: A warm-up led by Therapeutisch Centrum Lunteren begins 10 minutes before each start. Changing facilities are available at recreation centre De Goudsberg. Parking is available nearby, with traffic marshals; participants from Lunteren are encouraged to cycle. First-aid providers and traffic marshals are stationed along the course to ensure safety. €3.50 of each participant’s entry fee is donated to a local charity; this year, it is Woonzorgcentrum De Honskamp. Run past the Centre of the Netherlands on a route through woodland with climbs and descents. Advance registration is available. The start location is recreation centre De Goudsberg, where parking and changing facilities are available.

name: Valley Run
location: Winkelcentrum de Ellekoot, Veenendaal, Utrecht, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1.2 km
description: The Schuiteman Valley Run is a running event in Veenendaal, starting at the Ellekoot shopping centre. The 10th edition has been moved to Saturday, 3 October 2026, due to extremely high temperatures. Five distances are offered, including the 1.2-kilometre Etos Bijl Kids Run and a new half marathon, the Davelaar Sport Half Marathon. The event offers a great opportunity to experience the Utrechtse Heuvelrug and is suitable for a range of ages and fitness levels.
course_highlights: Start at the Ellekoot shopping centre
Five distances, including a kids’ run and a half marathon
Experience the Utrechtse Heuvelrug
additional: Five distances are available, including a 1.2 km kids’ run and a new half marathon. The start is at the Ellekoot shopping centre. The date has been moved to 3 October 2026 due to extremely high temperatures. The event promotes community spirit and fitness, with both the start and finish in Veenendaal.

name: Hoge Veluwe Wandeldag
location: Nationale Park De Hoge Veluwe, Otterlo, Gelderland, Netherlands
distance_verbose: Halve marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km
organizer: Het Nationale Park De Hoge Veluwe
description: The Hoge Veluwe Walking Day takes place in the beautiful Hoge Veluwe National Park, a green treasure trove of the Netherlands with varied landscapes, unique flora and fauna, and distinctive art and culture. On this day, walkers can enjoy the park’s many walking routes, including special anniversary routes and the historic Boundary Marker Route. The park offers a unique combination of nature and culture, with iconic places such as the Kröller-Müller Museum and St. Hubertus Hunting Lodge. The Hoge Veluwe Walking Day is an ideal opportunity to discover nature and enjoy a day of peace and inspiration.
course_highlights: Varied landscapes and rare plant and animal species
A range of walking routes, including anniversary routes totalling 90 km
Historic and cultural attractions such as the Kröller-Müller Museum and St. Hubertus Hunting Lodge
additional: Walking in the park is permitted only on official roads and paths. Walking routes suitable for people with disabilities are available. Walking maps can be purchased at entrances and information points. Dogs are welcome if kept on a leash, but are not allowed in museums or on guided tours. The park also offers free White Bicycles and a variety of activities throughout the year. Routes are suitable for all ages and ability levels. You can reserve a picnic bag, register in advance or on the day, and use facilities such as water points and toilets. You can also visit the museums and sculpture garden.

name: Brekeld Runners Trail
description: The Brekeld Runners Trail is a challenging trail run in the wooded surroundings of Rijssen, organised by Atletiek Vereniging Rijssen. The 2026 edition takes place on 3 October and offers 10, 15, 20 and 30 kilometre routes, mostly on unpaved terrain and with several climbs. The courses pass through forests, heathland, meadows and sandy areas, with scenic viewpoints such as the Friezenberg. Aid stations and volunteers are available along the way to support runners.
course_highlights: Routes are mostly unpaved and pass through forests, heathland, meadows and sandy areas
Several climbs and notable viewpoints such as the Friezenberg
Marked with orange ribbons, with mountain bikers rarely on the route
additional: Routes of 10, 15, 20 and 30 km, with at least one aid station on each route. Parking at the De Koerbelt sports park. Accommodation options at Stadshotel Rijssen and Camping de Biesterij. Volunteers and traffic marshals will be present. Routes pass through forests, heathland, meadows and sandy areas; parking at the De Koerbelt sports park; accommodation options at Stadshotel Rijssen and Camping de Biesterij; registration is open via the website.

description: Höstruset is a fast 5 km race in Örebro, starting and finishing at Björkhagaskolan. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation and is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series. There is also a 700 m children’s race for ages 3–7. Information on the website is preliminary and will be updated ahead of the 2026 edition.
course_highlights: Fast 5 km course on cycle paths around Varbergaskogen
Start and finish at Björkhagaskolan (changing rooms and showers are available)
Course measured and certified (measurement date: 2024-09-08); timing by ankle transponder
additional: Late registration from 29 September (at an increased fee) is available through the registration system and on race day (Swish only). Race bibs are distributed on race day. Timing is recorded using an ankle transponder, which must be returned (a fee of SEK 400 is charged for a lost transponder). Parking at the school is very limited; carpooling or parking at Karlslunds Motionscentral is recommended. The race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Federation and is part of the Södra Svealand Running Series. Parking at the school is very limited; carpool or cycle to the area. Late registration incurs a higher fee, and Swish is used on race day. Register via anmalmig.nu; results are available online via Hug Timing.

name: Vånga Mountain Xtreme
description: FK Göingarna welcomes runners and spectators to Vånga Mountain Xtreme on 4 October 2026. Choose between 8, 16 or 40 km of trail running with 300, 600 and 1,500 m of elevation gain respectively; the course features the steep Vångabacke, winding trails through wilderness, and views of small lakes and quarries. The race is billed as both beautiful and very challenging, and one that leaves a lasting impression. The youngest runners can take part in VMX Kids, with free registration on site.
course_highlights: The steep, classic Vångabacke, a short but powerful climb
Winding trails through wilderness, past small lakes and deep quarries
Total elevation gain: 300 m (8 km), 600 m (16 km), 1,500 m (40 km)
additional: Online registration via the website is open until Wednesday 30 September 2026 at 23:59. Late registration is available at the venue, subject to availability, until approximately one hour before the start; on-site payment is by Swish. Registration is binding, and refunds of the entry fee are available only through valid insurance (for example, Startklar). The races are sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association. Organizer: FK Göingarna. VMX Kids: free registration on site. Maximum number of participants: 800; online registration until 2026-09-30 at 23:59; start time: VMX Kids starts at 12:15; time limits: 3 hours (16 km) and 7 hours (40 km); Startklar insurance is recommended; VMX Kids has free registration on site; the race is sanctioned by the Swedish Athletics Association.

name: 25. Benther-Berg-Lauf
location: VSV Benthe Sportplatz, Am Hammfeld, Ronnenberg-Benthe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Benther-Berg-Lauf takes place on 3 October 2026 in Ronnenberg-Benthe and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover. The event offers various race distances for all age groups, from Bambini and children's races to a half marathon over 21.8 km. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Benther Berg and offers an enjoyable running experience for both competitive runners and recreational athletes. Race numbers and transponders can be collected from 8:30 a.m. in the VSV Benthe gymnasium. Late entries are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start.
course_highlights: 21.8 km long-distance race (half marathon) through Benther Berg
A variety of distances, from the 550 m Bambini race to the 21.8 km long-distance race
Part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass der Region Hannover
additional: Race numbers and transponders can be collected from 8:30 a.m. in the VSV Benthe gymnasium. Late entries are possible on the event day up to 45 minutes before the respective start, with an additional late-entry fee of €5 (€2 for the Bambini and children's races). Parking is available in a designated car park behind the sports facility; access on the event day is only possible as far as the cul-de-sac. Groups of 5 or more people can request a discount by email. Course map, online registration until 02.10.2026, parking behind the sports facility, participation in the Laufpass possible, various race distances, children's and Bambini races

name: 31. Geiseltalseelauf
description: The Geiseltalsee Run is a long-standing running event in Braunsbedra that welcomes runners of all ability levels. The route passes through the scenic surroundings of Lake Geiseltal and offers a sporting challenge across varied terrain. The event is very popular and attracts numerous participants every year. Alongside the competition, the sense of community is also a central part of the event.
course_highlights: Route around Lake Geiseltal
Varied terrain with scenic views
Half marathon with a course record set the previous year
additional: Late entries are possible on race day up to 1 hour before the start. The event also includes children’s and youth races as well as walking events. It takes place in Braunsbedra at Lake Geiseltal and is part of the Landescup. The exact start and finish locations can be found on the official website.

name: Essener Seelauf 2026
description: The Essen Seelauf is a traditional running event at Lake Baldeney in Essen. The 14.2 km course follows well-marked cycle paths and passes through the bird sanctuary. There are two refreshment stations, and the race starts at 10:00 a.m. The event is held in accordance with the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is open to runners with or without a DLV competition licence. Late registrations are possible up to one hour before the start, subject to availability.
course_highlights: 14.2 km course at Lake Baldeney
The course passes through a bird sanctuary and over Lantermannsfähre
Two refreshment stations at km 5 and km 9.5
additional: Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start, with a late-entry fee of €3, payable in cash. Changes of registration are possible only until 30.09. by email to teamessen@gmx.de. Race numbers must be worn visibly on the chest. The use of technical devices such as smartphones with headphones is prohibited. The course is not measured by the DLV, but every kilometre is marked. The 14.2 km race is not measured by the DLV. There are two refreshment stations at km 5 and km 9.5, manual timekeeping, race numbers worn on the chest, parking at the Regattaturm, and changing rooms and showers in the Regattahaus.

name: NRZ Klosterlauf
location: Kloster Kamp, Kamp-Lintfort, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The NRZ Kloster Run takes place on German Unity Day, 3 October 2026, around Kloster Kamp in Kamp-Lintfort. With races over 5,000 metres and the half marathon, the event offers suitable competitions for runners of all abilities. The detailed race information and schedule will be published once planning is complete. The run is an established event organised by SV Alemannia Kamp-Leichtathletik and warmly invites runners to take part on this special day.
course_highlights: Run around the historic Kloster Kamp
Races over 5,000 metres and the half marathon
Event on German Unity Day
additional: The race information and schedule will be published online once the final planning is complete. Competitions are held over 5,000 metres and the half marathon. The event is part of SV Alemannia Kamp-Leichtathletik and takes place annually on 3 October. Distances include 5 km, 10 km and the half marathon; the event takes place on 3 October 2026; on-site registration is available; part of the regional running events in the Lower Rhine region.

name: Ortsstraßenlauf
description: The TV Marienhagen Ortsstraßenlauf has been held annually on German Unity Day since 1990 and is the club’s largest sporting event. The routes run along roads inside and outside the village, as well as paved forest and field paths. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Laufcup and offers categories for Bambini, schoolchildren, young people and seniors. The event is open to everyone; club membership is not required. Advance registration is no longer available—registration is only possible on site. Refreshments are provided during and after the event, and every participant receives a certificate.
course_highlights: Routes on roads and paved forest and field paths
10 km run and 7.5 km Nordic walking on out-and-back courses
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Laufcup
additional: Registration is only possible on site, no later than 45 minutes before the start. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Every participant receives a certificate. Children and young people may not enter more than one event. Refreshments are provided during and after the race at the village community centre by the sports field. The route passes through the village; advance registration is not available. Refreshments are available on site, and all participants receive certificates.

name: Sparkassen-Phoenix-Halbmarathon
description: The Sparkassen-Phoenix Half Marathon in Dortmund is a popular half marathon held annually on October 3. The 21.1 km course runs through southern Dortmund, past Phoenix Lake, Phoenix-West, Westfalenpark and Rombergpark. It is officially measured, making it suitable for personal bests. In addition to the individual half marathon, there are relay races and a KNAX Fun Run for children. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with refreshments, cheer zones and a rendezvous point for relay runners shortly before the finish.
course_highlights: The course passes Phoenix Lake, Phoenix-West, Westfalenpark and Rombergpark
Officially measured 21.1 km course, eligible for rankings
Relay exchange zones at kilometers 7 and 14, with shuttle bus connections
additional: Bib pickup on October 2 from 14:00 to 17:00 and on race day from 8:30. Bibs are printed with participants’ names and sent by post. Online late registration is available until October 3 at 10:00; after that, registration is possible on site for a fee. Relay teams receive a timing baton, which can be collected on race day upon presentation of ID. Refreshments are available at kilometers 4, 11 and 17, as well as in the finish area. Changing rooms, toilets and bag drop are at the Sparkassen Academy by Phoenix Lake. Shuttle buses take relay runners to the exchange zones. A rendezvous point for relay runners is located approximately 150 m before the finish. Course through parks and industrial areas, registration, advertising opportunities, race on October 3

name: Treiser Volkslauf
description: The Treis Volkslauf will take place for the 34th time on October 3, 2026, in Staufenberg-Treis. The event welcomes runners, walkers, and hikers of all ability levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a large cake buffet and delicious pea soup. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a popular running series in Hesse and the surrounding area. Registration opens on August 1, 2026, via Race Result.
course_highlights: Part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a regional running series
A variety of routes for running, walking, and hiking
Large cake buffet and pea soup
additional: Registration for the Volkslauf opens on August 1, 2026, via Race Result. A large cake buffet and pea soup are available for participants. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup running series, which includes several events in the region. The club also offers regular running and walking meetups, as well as beginner courses. Running, walking, and hiking event; community activities; refreshments including a cake buffet and pea soup

name: Volks - und Feuerwehrlauf Rhede
price_range: 2,00 EUR (zusätzliche Gebühr bei Voranmeldung bis Limit)
description: The Volks- und Feuerwehrlauf Rhede is a traditional running event organized by the Rhede Fire Department. Held annually, it gives runners the opportunity to take part in a friendly and safe atmosphere. The races start at Rhede School Center and follow a varied route through the town. Prizes are awarded to the first four finishers in each category, and certificates and live results are available on site and online.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rhede School Center, Büssingstraße 14
Varied route through Rhede
Live results on monitors in the finish area and online
additional: Late registration is possible for a fee of 2.00 EUR until 30 minutes before the relevant start. Registration is available on 02 October from 18:00 to 19:00 and on 03 October from 09:00 at the registration office. MP3 players are prohibited for safety reasons. Baby joggers and dogs are not allowed. Prizes are awarded to the first four finishers (male/female). The event takes place at Rhede School Center. Registration is on 2 and 3 October. Participation rules include safety requirements such as not using MP3 players and not bringing strollers or dogs. Results are available live and online.

name: 26. Generali Köln Marathon
organizer: Kölner Marathon Veranstaltungs- und Werbe GmbH
description: The Generali Cologne Marathon is a unique running experience that combines elite and recreational sport with carnival, a street festival and a running festival. The course passes through lively Cologne neighbourhoods such as Rodenkirchen, Lindenthal, Ehrenfeld and Nippes, and finishes spectacularly at Cologne Cathedral. With up to 15,000 participants, the marathon offers an exhilarating atmosphere, supported by thousands of spectators along the course. The event also places great importance on sustainability and offers a varied programme of activities.
course_highlights: Start in Deutz at Ottoplatz, with panoramic views of Cologne Cathedral and the Old Town
Pass Rudolfplatz three times, with strong spectator support
Course through diverse neighbourhoods such as Südstadt, Ehrenfeld and Nippes
additional: The marathon starts in Deutz at Ottoplatz and passes several relay and school-marathon changeover zones. There are 11 refreshment stations for the marathon and 6 for the half marathon. The marathon is limited to 15,000 participants. The course passes well-known Cologne landmarks and neighbourhoods, and the finish is at Cologne Cathedral. The event values sustainability and offers a varied programme of activities featuring carnival and a running festival. Registration is open; various race disciplines, limited entries, special competitions for students, sustainable event

name: Soester Stadtlauf
price_range: abhängig von der Distanz (Infos im Anmeldeportal)
description: Experience the traditional Soest City Run, a sporting highlight for young and old in the historic city centre of Soest. Whether you’re a recreational runner, a competitive athlete or running with your family, together you’ll make the day an unforgettable experience, with a unique atmosphere along the course. The event offers various race distances, an appealing supporting programme, and refreshments for all participants and guests.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the heart of the historic old town
Atmospheric run through Soest city centre
Commentary, music and refreshments along the course
additional: Race distances: children’s races 475m (start 12:00), school races 950m (born 2016–2018, start 12:45) and 1450m (born 2006–2015, start 14:15), main races 4km (start 15:00) and 10km (start 15:45). Parking available on the outskirts of town, with a shuttle service. Drinks and snack stands for participants and guests. An appealing family programme and on-site commentary. Various race distances, start and finish in the heart of the old town, refreshments, shuttle service, awards ceremony immediately after the races.

name: 14. Burgdorfer Spargel-Lauf
price_range: Kinder: 5 €, 2.500 m-Lauf: 8 €, 5.000 m-Lauf: 10 €, 10.000 m-Lauf: 12 €, Nordic Walking: 10 €
description: The Burgdorfer Asparagus Run is an annual running event held as part of the Oktobermarkt city festival in Burgdorf. The 14th edition of this popular event takes place on October 4, 2026, and welcomes recreational runners of all ages. The routes follow the Aue and pass through the town centre, with the start and finish at the Auebrücke, Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße. Events include 2.5 km, 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking, and a children’s race.
course_highlights: Route along the Aue and through Burgdorf town centre
Start and finish at the Auebrücke, Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße
660 m children’s race through central streets of Burgdorf
additional: Timing is electronic, using a chip attached to the race bib. Online certificates are available for all participants. Late registration is possible on the event day from 12:30 to 13:30 for an additional fee of €4. Parking is available, among other places, at the train station, Schützenplatz and Rathaus II. The awards ceremony takes place at the Auebrücke after the main races. The event takes place in all weather. The route runs through Burgdorf along the Aue, Schlosspark and Stadtpark; registration is open until October 2, 2024; the race takes place in all weather; parking is available nearby.

name: 23. Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The 23rd Central German Marathon on October 4, 2026, offers a unique running experience through the Central German metropolitan region, starting in Leipzig and finishing in Halle (Saale). The route passes through two federal states and two cities. The marathon starts at the Sportforum in Leipzig and finishes in Halle, a cultural capital with a history spanning more than 1,200 years. Alongside the marathon, there are other events, including the Händel Run Half Marathon, the half-marathon relay, the 10 km run, 10 km walking, the Salzwirker Run and the AOK Taster Run. The event combines a sporting challenge with cultural highlights and green running routes in the city of Händel.
course_highlights: Start in Leipzig at the Sportforum; finish in Halle at the Marktplatz
Route through two federal states and two cities
Run through the green heart of the city of Händel and Halle city centre
additional: Start and finish are in different locations: start in Leipzig at the Sportforum, finish in Halle at the Marktplatz. Various events include a relay and walking. Late entries and changes of registration are possible. Race materials are distributed in Leipzig. The event combines a sporting challenge with cultural and scenic highlights. Several distances, with starts and finishes at Halle – Marktplatz and Leipzig – Elsterflutbecken; routes are subject to approval. October weather is usually mild, with temperatures around 14°C.

name: Boitzer Herbstlauf
description: The Boitzer Autumn Run is a local autumn race with walking in Walsrode, Lower Saxony, organised by the sports club SV Kirchboitzen. In 2026, the event will be held in person for the 19th time and is open to runners and walkers of all ages. Participants can get the most important information directly from the organising team on site. Further practical information is provided by SV Kirchboitzen.
course_highlights: Distances: 800 m and 14 km
Typical October weather, around 14°C and mostly cloudy
Event in the Walsrode region, Lower Saxony
additional: The event is a local club race with walking. The organising team will provide the main information on site, with further details available from SV Kirchboitzen. Participants are advised to check the event details with the organiser before registering. The event takes place in autumn weather, with temperatures around 6–14°C and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. It is aimed at runners and walkers who want to enjoy the autumn atmosphere.

name: Cottbuser Oktoberlauf
description: The Cottbus October Run is a traditional running event held at the Cottbus Sports Centre, in the athletics stadium and mainly in the woods on firm paths and cycle paths. The event offers various distances ranging from 400 metres to a half marathon (21.1 km), with some paved and unpaved sections. Children and young people can take part in special runs featuring obstacles and varied sections. Participants receive a commemorative medal and can access their certificates online. The event is part of the Sparkassen Running and Walking Cup and offers trophies and prizes to the top runners in various age groups.
course_highlights: Courses at the Cottbus Sports Centre, with the start and finish in the athletics stadium
Woodland sections on firm paths and cycle paths, with some unpaved trails
Refreshment points at the Spree Bridge on the longer distances
additional: Timing uses an ankle transponder, which must be returned after the race (a 20 EUR fee applies if it is lost). The race bib must be worn visibly on the chest. Trophies, certificates and prizes are awarded for age groups and overall results. Please note the course changes for the 5, 10.5 and 21.1 km distances. Late registration is available online until 3.10.2025 and on site until one hour before the start. Start time: 10:50. The event is part of the Sparkassen Running and Walking Cup. Online registration is available. Categories include children’s races and a Bambini run.

name: Gaudilauf 14
organizer: Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Gaudilauf is a traditional race taking place on October 4, 2026, in Bad Liebenwerda. The route runs from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda and back to Munich, offering a scenic course along the Elster. The event has a friendly atmosphere, with competition taking a back seat. Refreshments are provided every 5 kilometers, and a relaxed celebration with drinks and grilled food awaits participants at the finish. A bus transfer from the finish back to the start is available on request.
course_highlights: Route from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda and back
Refreshments approximately every 5 kilometers, including drinks and apples
At the finish: a Maß of beer or another drink, and a festival tent with grilled food
additional: Bib pickup is available at the respective start location until the start time. A bus transfer from Munich to Bad Liebenwerda is available when registering (departure at approximately 9:10 a.m.). Luggage transfer from the start to the finish is offered. Free entry to the festival tent on race day; grilled food is available for a small fee. Due to the current situation, the start in Schweinfurth has been canceled. 14 km run/walk, registration by email, bus transfer from Munich, no official timing.

name: Gaudilauf 27
description: The München-BaLi-München, formerly known as Gaudilauf, is a 27 km road race in Munich, Germany. The race typically takes place in early October, with a morning start. The event is organised by LWV 05 Bad Liebenwerda, suggesting a club-organised race with a modest field of fewer than 100 runners. The event offers good organisation and value for money, although the course receives an average rating for scenery.
course_highlights: 27 km road race in Munich
Morning start in early October
Small field of fewer than 100 runners
additional: The race is organised by the club LWV 05 Bad Liebenwerda. The field is small, with only a few finishers recently. October weather is typically cool and cloudy, averaging 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, with around 40 mm of precipitation. 27 km road race, early October, small field, registration via the website, scenic route with an average rating

name: Herbstlauf
description: The autumn run in Ovenhausen is a traditional race organized annually by TuS Ovenhausen on the first Sunday in October. The event offers various distances for different age and ability groups, including a challenging 20.8 km tour through forests and hills, as well as shorter races for young athletes. The course is varied, with sections on cycle paths, in the Grubestadion and in the forest. The race is suitable for both competitive runners and recreational athletes, and usually takes place in pleasant autumn weather.
course_highlights: 20.8 km tour through forests and hills near Ovenhausen
Sections on cycle paths and in the Grubestadion
Forest run over varied terrain
additional: The race traditionally takes place on the first Sunday in October. There are various age groups and distances, including a 1,000 m run for children and a 4.5 km run, which also counts as the district forest-running championship. The event is organized by TuS Ovenhausen, which works closely with HLC Höxter. Forest-trail races, district championships, distances from 1 km to 20.8 km; start and finish locations visible to RUNME Premium members only

name: Luftschifflauf
location: Flughafen Essen/Mülheim, Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The TURCK Airship Run at Essen/Mülheim Airport offers a unique running experience on the airport runway. The flat, fast course, with no tight turns or elevation gain, is ideal for setting personal bests. The highlight is the spectacular finish inside the impressive WDL airship hangar, making the race an unforgettable event. This family-friendly event offers various distances for children, teenagers and adults and takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on the airport runway
Spectacular finish inside the WDL airship hangar
Laps around the airship hangar on wide taxiways
additional: Staggered start times: 11:30 a.m. Bambini races, 1:00 p.m. youth and open races, 1:30 p.m. 4 x 2.5 km relay and 10 km race. 1,500 start places in total. Changes to entries are possible up to 15 minutes before the respective start. The event takes place in all weather conditions and is cancelled only if a severe weather warning is issued. Family-friendly event with refreshments available on site. Run on an airport runway, family-friendly, Bambini race, refreshments available on site, online registration, held in all weather conditions, parking available outside the grounds.

name: Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The Mitteldeutscher Marathon is a special running experience in the heart of Germany, connecting the Mitteldeutschland metropolitan region on a fast course between Leipzig and Halle (Saale). The classic marathon course, on which the first German marathon was held in 1925, runs from the Bach city of Leipzig to the cultural capital of Halle. In addition to the marathon, there are other events, including the Händellauf Half Marathon, the half-marathon relay, the 10 km run, 10 km walking and the Salzwirkerlauf. The event offers a varied programme and is suitable for runners of all ability levels.
course_highlights: Fast marathon course between Leipzig and Halle (Saale)
Start in the Bach city of Leipzig, finish in the cultural capital of Halle
Run through one of Germany’s greenest cities
additional: Pacers are available for the marathon with target times of 3:30, 3:45, 4:00 and 4:15 hours. The race bib includes a Mitteldeutscher Verkehrsverbund ticket for one free outward or return journey on event day between Halle and Leipzig in the relevant fare zones. Intermediate time limits must be met, otherwise runners will be disqualified. Race packs can be collected from various registration offices. Late entries and changes to registrations are possible. The event includes various running disciplines, starts in Halle and Leipzig, and offers a varied route through the Central German region, with villages, forests and floodplain landscapes.

The organisers provide professional medical support, timekeeping and a comprehensive race pack. It is a special sporting celebration, with enthusiastic support from Poznań’s spectators and a rich tradition.

The classic marathon distance of 42.195 km
A jubilee 25th edition with a rich tradition and enthusiastic support from local spectators
additional: The race pack includes a race number with a chip, safety pins, sponsor materials, professional timekeeping, medical support, and refreshment stations offering isotonic drinks, water, chocolate, fruit and sugar. The organiser provides free overnight accommodation for 600 people in POSiR sports halls on 3–4 October 2026; participants must bring their own mats and sleeping bags. There are numerous car parks near the Poznań International Fair grounds, with different rates. OK Poznań programme participants receive a 25% discount, while people aged 60 and over receive a 50% discount. The official marathon T-shirt can be ordered until 1 September 2026 for PLN 70. Registration is open until 1 October 2026. Discounts are available for seniors and programme participants, along with official merchandise and sportswear. Side events include Poznań Run Expo and the Kids Marathon.

All participants receive a commemorative medal. Prize-giving takes place shortly after each distance next to the finish.
