name: 57e Langs de Gouweloop
description: The 57th Langs de Gouweloop takes place on Sunday, October 4, 2026, in Waddinxveen, with the start and finish at Gouweplein by the shopping centre. This annual family running event, organised by Sportclub Antilope, offers something for everyone: a 1.3 km Kids Run for children up to 12 years old and 5 km and 10 km races for runners aged 12 and over. The route is a 5-kilometre loop, run twice for the 10 km. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and sporting achievements, and welcomes both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: A 5-kilometre loop, run twice for the 10 km
Start and finish at Gouweplein at Winkelcentrum Waddinxveen
Suitable for all ages, with a Kids Run and races
additional: Race numbers can be collected at Sporthal De Dreef, opposite the shopping centre. On-the-day registration is available until half an hour before the start. There is no electronic timekeeping; times can be read from a clock at the start and finish. Parking is available at Sporthal De Dreef and in the car park beneath the shopping centre, with the first two hours free. Course along Gouweplein, discounted registration, family-friendly event

name: Warburger Stundenlauf 2026
description: The 34th Warburg Hour Run takes place on October 7, 2026, in Warburg. The competition is aimed at adults and offers both individual and team categories. The course is flat and the event lasts one hour. There are also competitions for children and young people; details can be found in the organizer’s official announcement.
course_highlights: Flat course
Duration: 1 hour
Individual and team categories available
additional: A competition for children and young people is also offered. The start and finish are at Hüffertsportplatz; exact location details require RUNME Premium. The event is part of the RUNME race calendar. Participants receive certificates and trophies; registration is online; the event takes place in October, weather permitting.

name: Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried
price_range: 10,00 € Nachmeldegebühr für Erwachsene/Jugend U18 bis U20
description: The Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried is a short autumn cross-country race held on the grounds of the Bergfried in Saalfeld, Germany. Distances range from 800 m to 4.8 km and are designed for fast off-road running, not long road races. The race takes place outside the stadium and is classified as both a hill race and a cross-country race. The Saalfelder Leichtathletikverein has organized the event for many years, with separate races for children and adults as well as different age groups.
course_highlights: Terrain around the Bergfried in Saalfeld
Distances from 800 m to 4.8 km
Combination of hill running and cross-country running
additional: The race includes categories for youth, open class, masters, and local runners from Saalfeld-Rudolstadt. Around 200 children and young people took part in a previous edition. Typical October weather is around 14 °C during the day and 6 °C at night, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation and mostly cloudy skies. The race takes place outside the stadium and includes children’s and adults’ categories, off-road and hill running. Registration deadline: September 29, 2026.

name: BKK Walking am Baldeneysee mit Mini-Marathon
description: BKK Walking at Lake Baldeney is part of the Westenergie Marathon weekend in Essen and offers a varied program for walkers, Nordic walkers and runners. The main marathon runs twice around Lake Baldeney, with an additional turnaround section, and features a flat profile and fast cycle paths. The marathon has been held annually since 1963, making it Germany’s oldest event of its kind. The event is organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with the support of numerous volunteers. The number of participants is limited to 3,000 to avoid bottlenecks on the course.
course_highlights: Flat course around Lake Baldeney
Two laps, with an additional turnaround section on the first lap
Fast cycle paths and early autumn weather
additional: The number of participants is limited to 3,000 because of bottlenecks on the course. The walking program offers routes of up to 14 km. The event takes place annually on the second Sunday in October. Organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with support from volunteers. Distances: 1.1 km, 7 km, 42.2 km; participant limit of 3,000; October weather around 14°C, cloudy; registration with the organizer recommended.

name: Coesfelder DJK - Citylauf
description: The 32nd Coesfeld City Run takes place on October 10, 2026, in Coesfeld. The event is organized by DJK Eintracht Coesfeld e.V. and gives runners of all ages the opportunity to take part in sport. The city run combines recreational, competitive, health and rehabilitation sports and is an established event in the region. Online registration is available via the official website.
course_highlights: Measured, flat city courses through the historic town center
A variety of race distances for all age and ability groups
Attractive prizes, certificates and trophies for top runners and teams
additional: The organizer’s office is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 12:00 and 14:30 to 18:00. The office is closed on December 24 and 31 and on public holidays. The website credits photos to photobello and provides entry lists for the individual races. Road/cross-country run, registration open, various race distances, start and finish in Coesfeld town center, age categories for children, recreational runners, club members and older participants

name: Wadersloher Volkslauf
description: The Wadersloh Volkslauf is a long-standing running event in Wadersloh, welcoming runners of all ages and ability levels. Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses are available and are eligible for rankings until 2029. There are also shorter races for children and walking routes. The event takes place at the Sportpark on Winkelstraße and offers a family-friendly atmosphere, with a start-number deposit and timekeeping.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km courses are officially measured and eligible for rankings until 31.12.2029
600 m Bambini run and 1000 m schoolchildren’s race on the synthetic track at the Sportpark
7.5 km walking and Nordic walking route available
additional: A start-number deposit of 2.00 EUR is collected by SEPA direct debit when registering online and refunded in cash on the event day when the start number with chip is returned. The 5 km and 10 km races are officially measured and have DLV approval until 2029. Photos and videos are taken and published as part of the event. Measured courses, online registration, start numbers with chips, sponsors

name: Büdelsdorfer Eiderlauf
description: The Büdelsdorf Eiderlauf is a traditional autumn race in Büdelsdorf, Schleswig-Holstein, organized by SG Athletico Büdelsdorf. It offers classic local road-race distances, including 5 km and 10 km, on flat, manageable courses that are ideal for recreational runners and beginners. The start and finish are often at Eiderstadion, giving the event a friendly, informal atmosphere. The race attracts children, young people, and local club runners, and is a fixture on the regional autumn running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat road-race distances
Start and finish at Eiderstadion
Family-friendly local club race
additional: The race takes place in typical October weather, with daytime temperatures around 14 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Distances range from 1.5 km to 11.1 km, including children's races. After a break during the COVID-19 pandemic, the format was adjusted to incorporate the start and finish in the stadium. Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, 5.8 km, 10.9 km, 11.1 km; flat courses; autumn event; start and finish in the stadium; open to all age groups

name: Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof-Lauf 2026
location: Schloss Erbhof, Kirchwiehe, Thedinghausen, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Thänhuser Schloss Erbhof Run takes place on October 11, 2026, in Kirchwiehe, directly opposite Schloss Erbhof in Thedinghausen, Lower Saxony. Organized by TSV Thedinghausen, the road race has welcomed children, young people, active adults, and masters since 2016. Distances offered are 10 km, 5 km, and an 800 m children’s run, which takes place in the tree park near the start and finish. The course is a measured, flat 5 km loop that is also suitable for Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Measured, flat 5 km loop
The 10 km course completes the loop twice
800 m children’s run in the tree park directly by Schloss Erbhof
additional: The 5 km course is also suitable for Nordic walking. October weather is typically 14 °C, with lows around 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The children’s run, “Löwenlauf,” is designed specifically for the youngest participants and takes place near the start and finish area. Start and finish in Kirchwiehe opposite Schloss Erbhof; children’s run in the tree park; October weather with temperatures around 14°C low and 6°C high, 40 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy.

name: Westenergie Marathon
description: The Westenergie Marathon in Essen is a traditional race around the picturesque Baldeneysee. In addition to the classic marathon, the event offers the Westenergie Seerunde, the AllbauTeamStaffel, a mini-marathon for children, and a Walking Day. The course is known for its scenic beauty and proximity to the lakeshore, making the race a special experience for runners of all ages. The event is very well organized and attracts numerous participants every year.
course_highlights: A run around the Baldeneysee with picturesque lakeside scenery
Start and finish at Seaside Beach in Essen
Sections with lake views and through the Heisinger Aue nature conservation area
additional: The start and finish are at Seaside Beach on the Baldeneysee. Late registration on the event day is paperless and uses a QR code. Children can take part in a 1.1 km mini-marathon, with a prize and medals for all participants. Photobello offers race photos. The Walking Day routes include various distances with beautiful lake views and also pass through the Heisinger Aue nature conservation area. The marathon is Germany’s oldest continuously held marathon, with a flat, fast course, several race disciplines, and support for the region. Results and certificates are available online.

name: ASML Marathon Eindhoven
description: The ASML Marathon Eindhoven is the largest two-day sporting event in North Brabant and takes place annually on the second weekend of October. The event offers a wide range of running distances, including the marathon, half marathon, quarter marathon and various other runs for all ages. The course is flat, wide and atmospheric, with a finish in the center of Eindhoven, making for fast times and a unique experience. The city is entirely focused on sport, innovation and connection, with enthusiastic supporters lining the course. This makes the ASML Marathon Eindhoven a festive and internationally acclaimed running event.
course_highlights: Flat, wide course with a finish in the center of Eindhoven
Atmospheric course with enthusiastic crowd support
Route past iconic spots in the city
additional: Participants receive a unique medal. A limited-edition running shirt is available. Special “Run Against Cancer” initiatives allow participants to raise funds and receive a unique shirt. Race bibs for participants from the Netherlands are available until September 1. The finish is on the lively Vestdijk in the center of Eindhoven. This two-day event offers registration for various distances, with the start and finish in the center of Eindhoven, and includes an urban walk and children’s activities.

name: Veluwepoortloop - najaarseditie 2026
description: The Veluwepoortloop is a road running event in Nijkerk held annually, with an autumn edition on 10 October 2026. Participants can choose between distances of 5 km and 10 km. The event is organized by AV Nijkerk and combines a sporting challenge with a playful element, allowing participants to compete for the title of “ruler of Nijkerk.” The race takes place on a Saturday and offers a great opportunity to meet running friends and achieve your personal goals.
course_highlights: Road race in Nijkerk
Distances of 5 km and 10 km
Organized by AV Nijkerk
additional: The event features a game element called “Run Risk,” in which participants can compete to become ruler of Nijkerk. No entry tickets are currently available. Participants can register in advance via the website, and the event takes place in the rural countryside of Nijkerk. No information is available about entry fees or the prize schedule.

name: 90e Sloterplasloop
description: The Sloterplasloop is a traditional road running event in Amsterdam, taking place for the 90th time in 2026. Participants can choose between the 5 km and 10 km distances, with special kids’ runs also available for young runners. The race is part of Rondje Mokum and is organized by AAC Amsterdam. The event takes place around the Sloterplas and offers a scenic running experience in an urban setting.
course_highlights: Road race around the Sloterplas in Amsterdam
5 km and 10 km distances available
Kids’ runs for young runners
additional: The event is organized by AAC Amsterdam and is part of Rondje Mokum. No entries are currently available. Participants can register for prizes and records, with start times from 9:30 a.m. The event is easy to reach by public transport and takes place in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

description: The MHB Overbetuweloop is the Betuwe’s running event, held in Elst on Sunday, October 11, 2026. The event offers five distances, including the challenging MHB 5 km and Rabobank 10 km, both certified by the Atletiekunie. There are special KidsRuns for children over 400 m and 800 m, as well as a new 1300 m teen run. The course passes through Elst’s picturesque centre and the beautiful countryside along the Linge, making it suitable for the whole family. Start times have been moved earlier to avoid running during the hottest hours of the day.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Elst’s centre and the countryside along the Linge
5 km and 10 km certified by the Atletiekunie
Safe, fast KidsRun course named after Olympic athlete Femke Bol
additional: Race bibs can be collected on Sunday, June 21, 2026, from 09:00 at the Town Hall, Dorpsstraat 67. First aid is available, and there are water stations along the course. After the finish, participants receive water and something to eat. Physiotherapists/sports massage therapists will be present. The 5 km and 10 km start together, with an extra-wide start area and space at the front for competitive runners. Electronic timing is used. Children aged 4–7 may run the 400 m KidsRun with a parent/guardian. Medals are included for children; adults can order a medal when registering for €2.50. Dansstudio Kerima will lead a KidsRun warm-up. Extra cooling will be provided in extremely hot weather. The course is certified by the Atletiekunie; medals and prizes for top finishers; sustainable medal options; start and finish in Elst; registration until June 20; volunteers wanted; sports clinics and facilities such as first aid and physiotherapy.

name: Esbjerg City Half
description: Experience Esbjerg in your running shoes at Esbjerg City Half, featuring both a half marathon and a 10 km route. The course takes you through the city, the harbor, and the forest.

name: Skrylle Challenge
location: Skryllegården, Skrylle naturreservat, Södra Sandby, Sweden
description: Skrylle Challenge is a trail-focused race organised by Björnstorps IF, with the start and finish at Skryllegården. For 2026, the organiser is introducing a new, more trail-focused loop course, with the option to run one or two laps: 12.5 km (one lap) or 25 km (two laps). The race is promoted as a nature-close and challenging experience on the area’s best trails, and information will be updated throughout the spring. Early bird entry is available, and there is also a 600 m children’s race.
course_highlights: Loop course starting and finishing at Skryllegården
More trail—the course uses the area’s best trails
Cut-off for the 25 km: pass the 12.5 km point by 12:15 (based on a 10:30 start)
additional: You can register online until 60 minutes before the start, or register on site. On race day, name or distance changes can be made for an administration fee of 100 SEK (changing from 12.5 km to 56 km costs 200 SEK). On-site payments are accepted by Swish only. The 600 m children’s race is free, includes a medal and does not allow pre-registration; race numbers can be collected when checking in on race morning. Parking at Skryllegården will be limited, so the organiser encourages carpooling or cycling. The first start for 12.5 km is at 11:00 and the 25 km start is at 10:30. The 25 km has a cut-off at the lap point at 12:15. Online registration is open until 60 minutes before the start; distance or name changes are allowed for a fee. You can also register on site on race day and pay by Swish. Race numbers can be collected at Löplabbet in Lund before the race or at Skryllegården on race day. Bag drop is available, and the 600 m children’s race is free.

name: Bromöllamilen
description: Bromöllamilen is organised by Ryssbergets IK and offers several races on the same race day: 10.0 km, 5.0 km, a 2.0 km children’s race, and a Walk - Jog - Run option. Registration is via the club’s registration page, and course maps for the 10.0 km and 5.0 km races are published on the website. The club encourages participants to review the age/class categories and volunteer information in advance. The organiser shares practical information on an ongoing basis via its website and contact email.
course_highlights: 10.0 km and 5.0 km courses (course maps are available on the website)
2.0 km children’s race and a Walk - Jog - Run option
Age/class categories (see the categories on the website)
additional: Course maps for the 10.0 km and 5.0 km races are published on the website. There is a volunteer registration option—the organiser is seeking volunteers, and volunteering affects the handling of entry fees (see volunteer registration). Contact details and postal address: Ryssbergets IK, Kyrkvägen 1, 29535 Bromölla; tel. 0705876711; email info@ryssbergetsik.se. Results are published after the race.

name: Å-stadsloppet
price_range: 5 km: 150–300 kr; 10 km: 250–400 kr; 21,1 km: 300–450 kr; KidsRun: Gratis
description: Å-stadsloppet is a road race in Örebro that showcases the city at its best along the Svartån. On 10 October 2026, participants can choose from 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km and the Ullmax KidsRun for children. The race is organised by KFUM Örebro Friidrott, with the start and race services at Tybblelundshallen. Information is updated regularly on the organiser’s Facebook page. The race courses are officially measured, and the event is held in accordance with the rules of the Swedish Athletics Association.
course_highlights: Runs along the beautiful Svartån
Passes the scenic Rynningeviken and Wadköping
The 5 km, 10 km and 21.1 km courses are officially measured (course measurer Bertil Sundin, 2024-09-22)
additional: Race numbers are distributed on race day at Tybblelundshallen (no ID is required, and you can collect them for multiple participants). Timing uses transponders attached to the foot or ankle, which must be returned at the finish or if you withdraw; a lost transponder is charged at 400 kr. Some participants receive disposable chips attached to their race numbers, which do not need to be returned. Changing facilities and valuables drop-off are available at Tybblelundshallen. Water stations, toilets and medical assistance are available along the course; water and sports drinks are provided on the 10 km and 21.1 km courses and at the finish. Parents may run with their child in the KidsRun at no charge. Half-marathon participants must turn 17 during the year; there is no age limit for the 5 km or 10 km. Register at anmalmig.nu; timing is transponder-based, and race-number collection is at Tybblelundshallen. Water stations are located along the course. The half-marathon has a minimum age of 17; there is no age limit for the 5 km or 10 km.

name: Göteborg Marathon
description: Göteborg Marathon is a classic race taking place for the 52nd time in 2026, offering marathon and half marathon distances, with the start and finish inside the historic Slottsskogsvallen. The course was officially measured in 2024. It is a flat, straight out-and-back course that follows the cycle path along the old railway embankment by the coast, with the turnaround at Lilla Amundön. Half marathon runners complete one lap and marathon runners two, offering good opportunities for fast times. The race is organised by Solvikingarna, with the race centre at Friidrottens hus.
course_highlights: Flat, straight out-and-back course along the old railway embankment by the coast, turning at Lilla Amundön
Half marathon = 1 lap; marathon = 2 laps. Every kilometre is marked
Aid stations every four kilometres with water, sports drink, Coca-Cola, bananas and raisins
additional: The race centre is Friidrottens hus (bib pickup and race-day registration). Start groups: 10:00 Marathon; 10:30 Half marathon (estimated time under 1:45); 10:45 Half marathon (estimated time over 1:45). Aid stations are located at approximately 4.2 km, 8.4 km, 12.6 km and 16.8 km, offering water, sports drink, Coca-Cola, bananas and raisins. After finishing, all participants receive a drink, a banana, coffee/tea and a sandwich. Personal drinks/energy can be transported to the aid stations. The registration deadline is race day, 2026-10-10 at 09:00, if the race is not full; it is possible to transfer or sell a place through MittLopp until 2026-10-07 for a fee of 100 kr. The distance can be changed until 2026-10-07 or on race day up to one hour before the start (any difference in the entry fee may apply). Participants must be at least 17 years old during the year. Distances: marathon and half marathon. In 2025, more than 500 people started (514 participants, 354 finishers), according to the results page. The race takes place in October. The start and finish of Diabetes Wellness Göteborg Marathon 2025 were at Slottsskogsvallen.

name: Varberg Halvmarathon
description:
FK Friskus-Varberg invites you to a running race on Saturday, October 18, with the start and finish at Friskusstugan.

The course takes you past large parts of Varberg. You’ll run along the beach in Apelviken and up on Hästhagaberget, with magnificent views over the sea. The route also passes through several parks and urban forests, including the lovely Påskbergsskogen and Brunnbergsskogen. In addition to the half marathon, an 11.5 km course is also offered.

All information and registration: https://varberghalvmarathon.se

name: Bohusläns Bästa
location: Havstenssund, Tanum Municipality, Västra Götaland County, Sweden
description: Bohusläns Bästa is a coastal 22 km trail race from Havstenssund to TanumStrand. The race is the final event in Outnorth Trailtour and is expected to bring together Sweden’s trail-running elite for the deciding contests. The course is hilly and features rocky outcrops, winding trails and sweeping sea views along Bohuslän’s distinctive coastline. The organiser also recommends accommodation and the banquet at TanumStrand to round off the weekend.
course_highlights: 22 km of trail running along the coast from Havstenssund to TanumStrand
Rocky outcrops, jetties and coastal views with the scent of seaweed
Winding trails through fishing villages and varied terrain (mountains, forest and sea)
additional: Final event in Outnorth Trailtour; part of Trails of SWE c/o Dacia; recommended accommodation and banquet at TanumStrand Spa & Resort; newsletter offers from partners (including 20% off Asics trail shoes via Outnorth). Start in Havstenssund, with buses to the start from TanumStrand; orange course markings; some sections are narrow and technical, and water levels may be affected by high tide; shoes with metal spikes are not allowed; bag drop costs 30 kr; name changes cost 200 kr; dogs are not allowed; toilets, showers and changing facilities are available at TanumStrand Spa & Resort.

name: Running Lights Alingsås 2026
description: Running Lights is an evening race held during the Lights in Alingsås festival, offering a magical, illuminated urban setting. The event has distances for all ages—from Maxi-Knatte and youth races to 5 km, 10 km and a 3×1660 m relay. The start and finish are at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan), and the courses pass through beautifully illuminated areas in central Alingsås. Running Lights is family-friendly and is part of the Västsvenska löparcupen.
course_highlights: Courses through illuminated urban areas during Lights in Alingsås
Start and finish at the top of Stora torget (Kungsgatan)
Distances: Maxi-Knatte 300 m, Energiloppet 600 m, youth race 1660 m, relay 3×1660 m, 5 km (1 lap), 10 km (2 laps)
additional: Start times: Maxi-Knatte 16:00, Energiloppet 16:30, Ungdomsloppet 16:45, the relay 17:05, 5 km 18:00, 10 km 19:00. Start and finish at Stora torget (Kungsgatan). The 5 km is one lap; the 10 km is two laps. The races are part of the Västsvenska löparcupen. Part of the Västsvenska löparcupen; registration and race pack collection 9–10 October; running expo with free admission; After Run starts at 19:00 with the discount code 'runninglights' for 15% off.

name: Nordiska Mästarnas Backyard Ultra
description:
Location:
Fyskompaniet Training Center at Rattens gränd 1, Bromölla

Event venue:
The event venue is next to the entrance to Fyskompaniet. The area is paved. We will not know until early October whether we can use a large indoor warehouse or set up a large event tent outside on the paved area. The start and finish will be outside on the paved area, where there is room to put up your own small tents.

Course:
The course has been carefully designed to allow as many laps as possible and is currently certified for 81 laps. Asphalt 2,530 m, lawn 152 m, trail 1,301 m, gravel/farm road 2,700 m, wooden bridge 23 m, with approximately 30 metres of elevation gain.
Trash bins are located at approximately 1, 3 and 6 km.
Take a look at the course in this YouTube video: www.youtube.com/watch?v=GBX3idm2zDo. However, the start will differ slightly from the video, depending on how we arrange the start in October. In addition, the whole course is beautifully coloured by all the shades of autumn.
The entire course is marked with reflective fabric markers. Arrows are also placed at every junction and anywhere the route may be unclear.

Aid station:
There will always be a well-stocked aid station with water, sports drinks, food, snacks and anything else you can think of that you might need for a long run.

We will also serve:

Dinner: after the 17:00 lap
Evening sandwiches: after the 20:00 lap
Breakfast: between 05:30 and 07:30, starting Sunday
Lunch: after the 11:00 lap, starting Sunday
And so on...
We always have vegan and gluten-free options.

Changing rooms, showers, sauna and toilets:
The changing rooms are close to the event venue. There are spacious changing rooms for women and men, with several showers and a sauna. Toilets are also available there.

Toilets in the event area will be portable toilets, accessible both before and after the start.

Start:
Saturday 11/10 at 10:00

Finish:
When the last runner runs their final lap.

Rules:
We follow the official rules, which you can find here: ultrasignup.com/register.aspx?did=113992

Timing / results:
Timing is done with a chip attached around the ankle. Your time is recorded at the lap timing gate after each completed lap.

Accommodation:
We have a couple of accommodation suggestions for those travelling from further away.

Hotell Iföhus
Approx. 1.3 km from the event venue
hotellifohus.se/

Bromölla Camping & Hostel
Approx. 0.8 km from the event venue
bromollacamping.se/

Camping is not permitted within the event area.

Spectators:
Come and cheer on your friends. The easiest place to follow them is from the start area. Käsebron and the northern sections along Lilla Kungsleden are also nice places to watch.

name: Billingen Trail
description:
We invite you to enjoy running on Billingen. This year, the start and finish will be at the Stadium in the Billingen recreation area.
The long course is just over 47 km with approximately 930 metres of elevation gain. It goes all the way around northern Billingen, along beautiful trails by the edge of the mountain. Runners will experience varied terrain, including deciduous forest, mountain ravines, meadows and spruce forest, with beautiful views across the landscape in several places. The surface ranges from easy running to about 6 km of asphalt and some more challenging sections.

The intermediate course, 21 km, follows the northern part of the Billingeleden trail and has approximately 500 metres of elevation gain. It includes a mix of trails, meadows and roads.

Our shortest distance, 12 km, has just over 200 metres of elevation gain and follows trails of varying difficulty, with some shorter sections on roads.

Course information and markings may change.

Start:

47 km, 10:00, Stadium, Billingen Recreation Area, Skövde.
21 km, 10:45, Björnasäter, Lerdala. Bus departs from the Billingen Recreation Area at 10:05.
12 km, 11:30, Stadium, Billingen Recreation Area, Skövde.

Finish:

At the Stadium, Billingen Recreation Area, Skövde.

All finishes are at the stadium.
course_highlights: 47 km around all of northern Billingen — just over 47 km and approximately 930 metres of elevation gain
Varied terrain: deciduous forest, mountain ravines, meadows, spruce forest and sections of asphalt (about 6 km)
The 12 km course has just over 200 metres of elevation gain; the 21 km course follows the northern part of Billingeleden and has approximately 500 metres of elevation gain

name: Isaberg500
description:
Isaberg 500 is the race we love running ourselves and the foundation of the entire trail weekend. It’s a perfect mix of trails, hills, sweat and tears that brings to mind spectacular races in both the Swedish mountains and the Alps. Isaberg 500 also features switchbacks, long, enjoyable downhill stretches and fantastic views. In between, you can enjoy winding trails through enchanting forests. Isaberg 500 includes at least 500 metres of elevation gain and is perfect for anyone training for a mountain marathon or similar race.

NEW FOR 2025!
When Isaberg500 started, Jättestigen was a big talking point. A few years later, it was closed due to the risk of landslides. In 2025, Jättestigen returns as part of Isaberg500, but under a new name — Jättetrappan...

Isaberg500 is a race in the Outnorth Trail Tour 2025.
course_highlights: Trail race with varied trails and hills, with a technical character reminiscent of races in the mountains and the Alps
Multisport around the Isaberg summit: kayaking, mountain biking and trail running — Solo and Duo categories

After approximately 7.7 km, the courses join again, and runners can enjoy the beautiful riverside path in Nybroskogen.

description:
What is Backyard Ultra?
Backyard Ultra takes place on a marked 6,706-metre loop, and each participant has one hour to complete it. A new start takes place at the top of every hour, and as long as you can complete the loop within an hour, you remain in the race. You win by being the most enduring and ultimately getting to run one final lap alone! A fun race and concept with a very welcoming, community-minded atmosphere, where many participants set their distance records!

description: The Sandnesløpet is a fun run suitable for everyone who enjoys running. It takes place on March 22, 2025, starting at Sandnes Idrettspark. Participants can choose between several distances: half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and a children's race. The courses traverse beautiful surroundings on gravel, cart paths, and bike trails, and there are prizes for the top three men and women in the half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km, as well as draw prizes based on race numbers. All participants receive a medal.

description: On Wednesday, April 12, the first race of this year's Trail Running Series takes place in the beautiful Haraldsvang nature park. The courses primarily run on gravel paths but also include some terrain with forest cover (about 200m per lap out of 620m). The start and finish for all courses are at the stage/pavilion inside Haraldsvang. name: Ekeberg Backyard Ultra
description: We are repeating the success from previous years and welcome you to a classic backyard ultra in Oslo's "central park" at Ekeberg. In the midst of the dark and cold time of the year, there is no reason for the running season to come to a halt. Here, you have the chance to run alongside people from the ultrarunner family in delightful surroundings, beautiful nature, with Oslo's skyline and the Oslofjord in the background. Ekeberg Backyard Ultra follows the "Last One Standing" format where the race continues until one runner completes a lap alone, with laps of 6.7 km starting every hour.
course_highlights: You will receive a bib number and a tracker for automatic live recording of lap times.
Medal for everyone who completes at least one lap.
Live music by Jon (backyard singer) and a great atmosphere with the ultra family.

name: Parkløpet
description: Sign up for the Park Run 2023, which takes place on Saturday, April 1st. We have three different distances: Miniparkløpet – 600m (without electronic timing), Miniparkløpet – 1.975km, and Parkløpet – 7.0km. The race runs through beautiful and easy-to-run surroundings in Sandvedparken to Ganddal and back. The surface is mostly gravel, with some asphalt at the end loop in Ganddal.
course_highlights: The park run is also being held this year on Palm Saturday🐣.
Bring the whole family and join this fun race in the beautiful Sandved Park 🌳🌲.
The race stretches 3.5 km along the waterway Storånå from Sandnes city center to Stokkelandsvatnet in Ganddal.

name: Frozen Lake Marathon
description: Find your inner Elsa at the Frozen Lake Marathon – an extraordinary running experience. Join an icy adventure on Lake Tisleifjorden in Norway, which is situated 819 meters above sea level. Here, you will have the opportunity to test both endurance and balance on the beautiful, ice-covered Tisleifjorden, where the ice is about 80 cm thick and can support 30 tons. The race consists of one or two 21.1 km laps on a course made of 100% ice, with no inclines, just fantastic views.
course_highlights: Frozen Lake Marathon is the winter's major highlight for running enthusiasts from around the world.
Run on pure ice – no uphill sections, just fantastic views!
A secure course is outlined by a dedicated support team that monitors the track closely.

name: Norgestesten
description: The Norgestest is organized by volunteers from the Jessheim Running Group and Ull/Kisa Athletics, with the proceeds going towards promoting sports for children and youth. The race takes place in Jessheim with a mass start, on a flat and efficient course that is 3,146 meters long. Participants can choose between distances from 3 km to half marathon, and there are many experienced pacers to help you find the right pace. The event focuses on the participants and is efficiently held on Sundays at 10:00 AM.
course_highlights: The course is 3,146 m long and flat, which makes it easy to run.
Distances from 3 km to half marathon are offered, with a mass start for all participants.
Simple logistics with parking and restrooms just 300 meters from the start, as well as self-service pickup of race numbers.

name: PåskeHareMaraton
description: In brilliant Easter sunshine, 70 runners chose to kick off the Easter holiday by running 42.2 marathon kilometers from Ski to Sandvika. Geir Frykholm, an ultrarunner and head of Løplabbet in Sandvika, has followed up with the Easter Bunny Marathon, where the route goes from Ski to Sandvika. This is a social run with no focus on time, but Øyvind Wang from SkiLøperne became this year's fastest Easter bunny with a time of 3 hours and 17 minutes.
course_highlights: Seventy runners participated in the race, celebrating the Easter holiday with a marathon.
The route for the Easter Bunny Marathon goes from Ski to Sandvika, and the course is reversed compared to the Ribbe Marathon.

name: Sandtangstafetten
description: This year's Sandtang Relay takes place on Thursday, April 3rd at 6:00 PM in Bryne. It may be beneficial to arrive 45 minutes before the start, as the relay typically lasts for 1 hour and 15 minutes, and it's important to have time to review the course and check the exchange points. The relay features 4 legs for the short course (ages 7-10) and the long course (ages 11 and up), where participants can experience the scenic areas of Gjesdal municipality. The Sandtang Relay is open to everyone, regardless of skill level, and promotes joy in sports and community among participants.
course_highlights: The relay has 4 legs and for the short course (7-10 years): leg 110 m grass + forest floor, leg 100 m forest floor, leg 100 m forest floor, leg 110 m forest floor + gravel + grass.
The long course (11 years - senior) consists of the segments: 370 m grass + forest floor, 620 m gravel section, 160 m gravel section, 420 m grass + forest floor + gravel + grass.
The race offers participants a unique opportunity to experience the beautiful nature while they compete.

name: Påskemaraton
description: The Easter Marathon in Drammen has gradually become a tradition that marks an early season start for many runners in the Eastern Norway region. Organized for the 11th time by Tom-Rune Bertelsen, this year the race attracted a record number of 170 participants, who enjoyed beautiful spring conditions along the nearly flat course by the Drammenselva. Even though there was some snow and ice in certain parts of the route, the experience was nonetheless fantastic for the participants.
course_highlights: Kenneth Antonsen set a new "personal world record" in the half marathon with a time of 1:41:28.
The winner of the half marathon was Gerhard Sletten from Oslofjord Triathlon, with a time of 2:55:26.
Øystein Mørk from the Lier club SK Kraft won the half distance with a strong time of 1:10:28.

More than 500 runners participated last year, and the courses are either one lap of 7 kilometers or 21 kilometers, which is a half marathon.

description: Tyn_deg Children's Carousel, starting in 2026, is a low-threshold mastery arena for children and youth in Kristiansand, where running is the simplest form of activity. The goal is to take children seriously and provide them with a platform to push themselves, with a race number on their chest, outdoors and close to their homes. The Children's Carousel is free for all children and youth, allowing them to participate regardless of their parents' income, and offers an alternative to team sports where they can have regular matches and competitions.

The course, known as one of Europe's fastest, has an elevation gain of 22 meters and provides a pleasant experience regardless of skill level.

name: Sparebanken Sør Terrengkarusell
description: Welcome to the Sparebanken Sør Trail Carousel 2024! Everyone is welcome to the Trail Carousel – whether you want to walk, jog, or run. This year's season kicks off on Tuesday, April 9th at Dømmesmoen, with 16 races in varied terrain. The races take place on Tuesdays with a mass start at 6:00 PM (long) and 6:05 PM (short), along with a children's race at 5:30 PM. The week's course will be open and marked from Tuesday at 12:00 PM to Thursday at 7:30 PM.

Join us for a social and fun outing with your dog, alongside other dog lovers. You can choose to participate with or without timing, and every participant will receive a medal. Welcome to the whole family – both two-legged and four-legged!

You can choose with or without timing.

name: Vestfold Løpskarusell
description: Vestfold Running Carousel offers several distances for runners in beautiful surroundings, with races starting at 6:00 PM. Participants can choose between different laps and lengths, depending on which course they are participating in. Each course has its own character, with start and finish points near parking areas or well-known landmarks. Welcome to 8 fantastic races in the Tønsberg region, where everyone can participate, with or without timing.
course_highlights: All races start at 6:00 PM, and the timing will be electronic with results published via eqtiming.
Participants can choose to compete alone, with friends, family, or colleagues, and there are always several distances to choose from.
Come and experience the atmosphere, camaraderie, and joy of running together with a lot of wonderful people.

name: Skjalgstafetten
description: Welcome to the traditional Skjalg Relay, which is being held for the 53rd time this year in the Mosvann area. The relay is for children and young people aged 10 to 16, with participant prizes for the categories 10-12 years. The course is flat, and it is the same lap that is run a total of three times.
course_highlights: The relay is for children and young people between the ages of 10 and 16, with a participation prize in the 10-12 age categories.
The course is flat, and it is the same loop that is run a total of three times.
The EIK team participated for the first time in many years and finished third in their class, just one second behind the team that came in second.

name: Sandnes Ultratrail
description: In 2021, the adventure of Sandnes Ultratrail began. The race features distances of 100 miles, 50 miles, 43 km, 23 km, and 10 km, as well as a children's race. The trails wind through beautiful and varied nature, ranging from mountains with stunning fjord views to quiet forest paths, and there are opportunities for swimming in several lovely lakes along the routes. On the longest distance, participants traverse no less than 28 mountains and peaks, and all routes are technically challenging, adding an extra dimension to the experience.
course_highlights: The trails go through beautiful natural landscapes with a mix of technical terrain, forest, and gravel paths.
There are several aid stations along the routes, where experienced volunteers provide nourishment and care.
At the finish line, fantastic Jæder burgers, meat or vegan, are served straight from the grill, and we invite everyone to gather around the bonfire.

name: Tunnelløpet Bergen
description: The Tunnel Run Bergen is organized on a voluntary basis by BFG Bergen Running Club and Fyllingen Athletics. Any potential surplus is shared between the organizing clubs and will be fully used to promote sports activities under the two clubs' auspices – from children's and youth sports to recreational runners and athletes at a high national level. The race starts and finishes at Oasen Center in Fyllingsdalen, Bergen, and offers a distance of 5 km.
course_highlights: The Tunnel Run Bergen is organized by BFG Bergen Running Club and Fyllingen Athletics.
The proceeds from the race go towards promoting sports activities under the clubs' management.
The race starts and ends at Oasen Center, Fyllingsdalen, Bergen.

There are two different classes competing in the cross-country relay: Women Senior and Men Senior.

name: Oslo Løpsfestival
description: Oslo Running Festival consists of eight races along the capital's beautiful trails and scenic roads. You can run whenever you like – alone or together with others. You can participate individually in the SOLO category, or in the team competition as a DUO or TRIO, where you can compete in the women's, men's, and mixed classes. Each race is announced on Friday at 12:00, and the course is open until Sunday at 11:00 the following weekend, with a mass start precisely at 11:00.
course_highlights: You can run whenever you want – alone or together with others.
You can participate alone in the SOLO class, or in the team competition as a DUO or TRIO.

name: Skjold på tvers
description: Skjold Across is a hiking event suitable for everyone, providing a fantastic nature experience in the village of Skjold. Participants meet at Skjold Arena for registration before being transported by bus to Hodnafjellet. Here, they walk through beautiful terrain with grand views via 9 peaks and back to the finish line at Skjold Arena, covering a distance of 23.8 km. There is also the option to walk half of the course, where participants are driven by bus to or from Dalavik, depending on where they choose to start.
course_highlights: You meet at Skjold Arena for registration, then the journey continues by bus to Hodnafjellet in the west.
You traverse beautiful terrain with grand views through 9 peaks and 23.8 km back to the finish line at Skjold Arena.
Buses run between 8:00 AM and 11:30 AM from Skjold Arena to Hodnafjellet.

description: The Perseløpet is a low-threshold street race that offers a flat loop of just under 2.7 km, designed for records and AIMS-certified. Participants have the opportunity to test Synergy's so-called "Superfood Performance Beets" before the start, which is a concentrated beetroot drink. Results are available right after finishing, and there is free parking.

name: Fjellhamarstafetten Ungdomsstafett
description: The Fjellhamarstafetten is a relay with eight stages that is very well suited for our long-distance runners, as several of the stages are hilly and allow them to leverage their running strength. Bøler's runners completed the relay in 26:54 minutes, which earned them a 4th place in the senior men's category. This has been the most important relay in terms of team selection for the Holmenkollstafetten, and several victories have been achieved in both the senior and veteran categories.

name: Baksjøløpet
description: The Baksjøløpet was first held in 1981 and is a traditional race that takes place every year in Åbogen in Eidskog. The main course is 11 km, which partly runs on gravel and asphalt roads, while participants who walk without timing can choose an alternative route of 6 km. The event mobilizes about 100 volunteers and attracts over 700 participants, creating a special atmosphere characterized by community spirit and togetherness. Showers and changing rooms are available, and the race is known for its friendly atmosphere and good organization.
course_highlights: The Baksjø race has a main route of 11 km, and participants can choose an alternative route of 6 km.
The event mobilizes more volunteers than there are people living in the village, which contributes to a unique and pleasant atmosphere.
The race costs only 150 kroner, making it accessible to many, and various prizes are awarded each year.

course_highlights: Congratulations to the winners Mads Berge (10:05) and Helle Kristensen (12:33) in the 2025 edition of the race!
The Oppdal Carousel features several races throughout the year, with various distances and routes.

name: Halden Byløp
description: Halden City Run is suitable for all ages with officially measured courses for 5 km and 10 km through the city center. There are 400/800/1500 m courses at Halden Stadium for children and youth. The start and finish line is inside Halden Stadium, and the 5 km loop is run twice for those participating in the 10 km. The course is mostly flat, except for a small hill just before the finish, allowing for fast times.
course_highlights: Halden City Run includes distances of 1500m, 5 km, and 10 km.
The course is well marked with course marshals at every intersection, ensuring a safe and clear racing experience.
Halden Sports Club, which was founded in 1912, organizes several track meets and is also the organizer of the City Race and the Cannon Race.

name: Fløibanen Opp
description: Fløibanen Opp is a spectacular uphill race taking place on April 20, 2026, when the Fløibanen is halted to give you the chance to make your way up to Fløyen along the tracks. This grueling race has a distance of approximately 820 meters with a brutal ascent of 310 meters in elevation, without any variation or breaks. The race offers an intense challenge in the heart of Bergen, and with limited spots available, it is an exclusive opportunity for both experienced runners and beginners looking to test their limits.
course_highlights: On April 20, 2026, the Fløibanen will be stopped for the only time of the year so that YOU can make your way up to Fløyen, along the tracks!
With a distance of approximately 820 meters and an elevation gain of 310 meters, the race offers an intense challenge in the heart of the city.
The audience has access along the entire course, creating an energetic and supportive atmosphere for the participants.

Shorter races are also organized, such as the 800 m on the track. This provides participants with the opportunity to choose a distance that suits their skill level.
course_highlights: The Stomperud Carousel includes several distances and laps, including the Light Trail, Aasgaard Loop, and Bingen Loop.
Shorter races are also organized, such as the 800 m on the track.

name: Terrengløpskarusell 1
description: The Athletics Group in Oppegård IL is also organizing a cross-country running series this year. The races are open to everyone, regardless of age and ambitions, and will take place on May 6, May 20, June 3, August 26, and September 9 at the Clubhouse, Østre Greverud. Participants can register for 200 NOK for all the races or 80 NOK per individual race. The cross-country races will take place during the training sessions for the athletics group's athletes, and there will be no regular training at Sofiemyr Stadium on the relevant days.
course_highlights: Before the 1st heat begins, there will be group warm-up sessions, where participants will run through the course, ensuring that everyone who is going to race becomes familiar with the layout of the course.

Distribution of race numbers will take place from the stage inside Haraldsvang starting at 5:00 PM, and we ask that the coaches for the groups take responsibility for distributing to their group to avoid congestion.
Oppegård IL Athletics encourages all children, young people, and adults of all ages to join this year's running carousel!

name: Ålgårdstafetten
description: Gjesdal IL invites you to the Ålgård Relay 2025 on Thursday, April 24. Registration must be completed by April 21, and the entry fee is 200 NOK per team with 4 legs and 300 NOK per team with 6 legs. For participants aged 13 and older, a yearly license or a one-time license purchase is required. The relay has categories for both children and adults, with legs of 1000, 1800, 470, 1400, 470, and 400 meters, and all exchanges take place at the athletics stadium or in the surrounding area.
course_highlights: The Ålgård Relay is a relay race where several people get their very first experience of running a leg at an adult age.
The relay's legs are adapted for both women and men, and the course consists of segments of 1000, 1800, 470, 1400, 470, and 400 meters.
In 2019, over a hundred teams participated, with Sandnes IL fielding 21 teams, and prizes were awarded to all participants up to 10 years old.

name: ASICS Sentrumsløpet
description: ASICS Sentrumsløpet is an annual race in Oslo with distances of 10 km, 5 km, and a children's race. The 10 km race is open to everyone who turns 12 in 2025 and older, while the 5 km race is for those who turn 10 in 2025 and older. The children's race is available for kids who turn 3-11 in 2025. The course for the 10 km starts on Karl Johans gate and includes hilly sections around Frognerparken, as well as an exciting route down towards Oslo City Hall.
course_highlights: The Sentrumsløpet traditionally starts on Karl Johans gate, with a tough uphill stretch towards the Palace.
The course runs in a loop around Frogner Park, where it is gently undulating with opportunities to make up time heading down towards Bygdøy Allé.
Along the way, there are several water stations, as well as lively streets that provide extra motivation for the final kilometers.

description: Røyse Ultra is an annual ultramarathon held in Røyse, in the Hole municipality. The race was first organized in 2015, and it takes place in April. Participants run the Hytteplanmila eight times over the course of a day, totaling 80 km. The race consists of 10 kilometers every three hours, making it an ultra interval race.

The race is 8 x 10 km, as they run the Hytteplanmila eight times over the course of a day.

name: Fjordkraft Bergen City Marathon
description: Welcome to the Fjordkraft Bergen City Marathon (FBCM) on Saturday, April 25, 2026. This will be the 15th edition of the race, and we look forward to another day filled with the joy of running, community, and urban life at its best. The start and finish line, as usual, will be at Bryggen, where the atmosphere sets the tone for a memorable experience. The course will take you through some of Bergen's most characteristic areas – from Old Bergen and the views along Fjellveien to the new walkway around Store Lungegårdsvann. The Bergen City Marathon 2026 offers a course filled with life, views, and the city's unique atmosphere.

We are proud to be the main sponsor of a race that focuses on camaraderie, achievement, and inclusion.
The race provides support for a special cause through the event, with support for Downs Syndrome Westland in 2025.

name: Monolittløpet
description: Welcome spring with a traditional trail run in spectacular surroundings along Iddefjorden in Halden. The Monolith Run is scheduled for April 25, 2026, and has become a tradition for many since the first race was held in 2013. Participants will experience 9 km of challenging yet scenic terrain, starting at the velodrome in Ystehede and finishing at the square in Halden city center. The course features significant elevation and some steep sections, but offers a fantastic nature experience. The race passes through areas where the raw stone for the Vigeland sculpture Monolith was quarried, reminding us of the important stone industry that provided livelihoods for many in the early 20th century.
course_highlights: The Monolith Race has already become a tradition for many, and there is good reason for that.
You can choose whether you want to run, jog, or walk the Monolith Race.
The route of the Monolith Run goes through the areas where the raw stone for the Vigeland sculpture, the Monolith, was quarried.

description: Backyard Ultra is a form of ultramarathon where participants complete one lap (typically 4.167 km) every hour for as long as they can. There is no set distance for the race; it continues until only one participant remains. This format creates a unique challenge where both physical endurance and mental strength are crucial.

There is no set distance for the race; it continues until there is only one participant left.
The format demands both physical endurance and mental strength.

description: VOM DOGRUN is a pleasant activity for everyone who wants to be active together with their dog. Participants can choose to participate with or without timing, and the event is a social activity for the whole family. The start and finish are at the (old) Dog Meadow in Frogner Park, where participants can choose between two classes: Dogrun, which is a 7 km race with timing (two laps), and Dogwalk, which is a 3.5 km walk without timing.
course_highlights: The Vom Dogrun is a social activity for the whole family, for those who wish to walk, jog, or run with their dog.
The start and finish are at (old) Hundesletta in Frogner Park.
Classes: Dogrun: 7 km race with timing (two laps), Dogwalk: 3.5 km walk without timing.

name: Aron Opp
description: We are excited to present the fall's most intense challenge - Aron Opp! This is a hill climb race organized by Bedriftsidretten Buskerud and Vestfold in collaboration with Skimore Drammen and Arontunet Lodge. The start takes place at the bottom of the ski slope and follows the road in a loop up to the top, where the finish line is at the lift house. The course is approximately 1.7 km, where the fastest runners take about 10 minutes, and it takes 30-45 minutes at a brisk walk. New this year is the relay, which will be conducted in stages with a total of 5 legs of 350 meters each.
course_highlights: The course follows the gravel road in a loop along the ski slope from the bottom to the top.
The fastest runners complete the race in about 10 minutes, while it takes 30-45 minutes to walk up.
The relay consists of 5 legs, each measuring 350 meters.

name: Begbyløpet
description:
On Sunday, April 26, 2026, at 12:00 PM, a 10 km race will start in hilly terrain on gravel and asphalt in beautiful surroundings in Begby, Fredrikstad. Timing will be provided by EQ timing.

At 11:00 AM, a 1 km race for children up to 12 years old will begin (this race is free).
additional: There is a mass start for women and men, meeting at the Begby clubhouse.
course_highlights: 10 km for the biggest and 1 km for the smallest.
Save the date and stay tuned for information about registration.
Release an exciting race course.

name: Jæren Sparebank Sentrumsløp
description: On Tuesday, April 29, Gjesdal IL invites you to the brand new Jæren Sparebank City Run in Ålgård center. Participants can choose between two distances: 700 meters and 5 kilometers, with the 5 km run taking place on a 1.25 km loop that is repeated four times. The start and finish are on Torgveien, and the course goes over the completely new Liv Godin bridge. The course is flat and nice, with large sections on gravel.
course_highlights: Participants can choose between two distances: 700 meters and 5 kilometers.
The course is 1.25 km long and is run 4 times.
There is a special offer at Norwegian Outlet Stavanger for participants who show their race number after the event.

name: Terrengløpskarusellen løp
description: The Cross-Country Running Carousel Race 1 is part of a series of three races organized by Haugesund Idrettslag. The courses mostly run on gravel paths, but there is some terrain with forest cover (approximately 200m per lap on the 620m courses). The start and finish for all courses are at the stage/pavilion inside Haraldsvang, and there will be an awards ceremony after the final race from the stage in Haraldsvang.
course_highlights: Race numbers are distributed by class on stage inside Haraldsvang by the coaches.
It is important that the participants take care of their race number throughout all three races.
The cross-country running series has been a tradition since 1972 and has seen a growing interest over the years.

name: Sørdalskarusellen Kringsjåløpet
description: The Kringsjåløpet is 2.71 km long and starts and finishes at Nordre Ål school. The start is on Gamle Kringsjåvei on the bridge over Skurva right by Nordre Ål school, and the route follows Kringsjåveien northward, takes the footpath down to Ekromskogen, goes through the upper section southward, and follows Teigveien back to Nordre Ål school. The race is being organized for the 43rd time in 2024, featuring both a mass start and a virtual race. The results will be sent to Kondis.no for statistical recording.
course_highlights: There will be a virtual race from Saturday to Tuesday and a mass start on Wednesday, April 24th at 7:00 PM.
Hoka will have a booth in the start area with great offers, and Sport 1 is sponsoring sports drinks for all participants at the finish line.
The course is officially measured at 3 km, but this year it is 70 meters shorter than last year.

name: Søndagsløpet Sarpsborg
description: The Sunday Run is a popular race that takes place in Kalnesskogen in the municipality of Sarpsborg, and was started in 2014. The race is held every Sunday from April to mid-October, featuring three courses of varying lengths: the yellow at 7.05 km, the green at 8.87 km, and the red at 10.2 km. The courses vary in difficulty, with the red course having steep climbs, especially between 5 and 6 km. The Sunday Run is free to participate in and is suitable for all levels, from recreational runners to elite athletes.
course_highlights: The race has three different courses: yellow, green, and red, each offering unique challenges for various levels of runners.
Participants can expect well-organized conditions, with opportunities to set personal records and compete against others.
The Sunday race is free to participate in and has been a part of the running community in Sarpsborg for many years.

name: Grue Halvmaraton
description: Grue Half Marathon is a race that takes place in Grue, Norway, on May 1, 2024. Participants have a maximum time of 2:30 hours, and the race accounts for train crossings. There will be 6 aid stations evenly distributed along the course, with energy drinks and water available. The course has pace setters for different finishing times, and all participants will receive a medal.
course_highlights: The race includes both men's and women's classes for the half marathon as well as 10 kilometers.
Participants can expect a challenging and scenic course.
There are 6 aid stations evenly distributed along the course.

name: Sabbaløpet
description: The Sabbaløpet (8.3 km) is traditionally organized by SK Vedavåg on May 1st. This race takes place at home in Vea, where participants can enjoy a beautiful route. One of the participants, along with his father Lars, completed the race in an impressive 47 minutes.
course_highlights: The Sabbaløpet (8.3 km) at home in Vea with his father Lars (left) in an impressive 47 minutes.
It is May 1st, and as tradition dictates, SK Vedavåg organized the Sabbaløpet.

name: Tinestafetten SI
description: The effort was undeniable during the Tinestafetten at Stavanger stadium. While over 1300 children and young people raced on the track, this group ensured top-notch entertainment on the sidelines. The race consists of 8 legs of 200 meters, and it’s a great opportunity for young athletes to showcase their skills.
course_highlights: The effort was undeniable during the Tinestafetten at Stavanger stadium.
Over 1300 children and young people ran their hearts out on the track.
Top-notch entertainment was provided on the sidelines.

name: mailøpet
description: We welcome you to the mail race on May 11 and the junior festival on May 12, where both races start at 8:00 AM. The 58th mail race had great running weather and good conditions for both runners and spectators, with a total of 141 participants, including 38 in junior, senior, and veteran classes. The men's winner was Vetle Uhre Hammersvik from Førde with a time of 9:55, while the women's winner was Eli Karin Sjåstad Åsebø from Volda with a time of 14:08.
course_highlights: It was the young man Vetle Uhre Hammersvik from Førde, but with close roots from Selje, who decided the 1st mail race of 2016 in a fierce duel against last year's champion Eirik Voksøy Bringvor from Sandsøy, winning by just one second.
We welcome you to the mail race on May 11 and the junior festival on May 12. Entrance is 150,- per day or 200,- for the whole weekend. Children under 12 get in for free.
The men's winner this year, as last year, was Vetle Uhre Hammersvik from Førde with a strong time of 9:55. The women's winner was Eli Karin Sjåstad Åsebø from Volda with 14:08.

name: Strandamilå
description: Strandamilå 2023 was held for the 43rd time and was finally back as a family race! Despite less than favorable weather conditions, there was an impressive turnout with over 550 participants across all distances, and the registration nearly matched the best numbers of the last 15 years with 125 sign-ups. We are very pleased with the event and look forward to new heights next year! Stay tuned on social media for photos from the race when they are ready.
course_highlights: Strandamilå has proud traditions dating back to 1980 and is always held on May 1st.
Over 550 participants in all our distances is very good, and the Strandamilå itself matched the best registration in the last 15 years with 125 sign-ups.
There will be pictures on social media as soon as they are ready from our photographer.

name: Jentejoggen Lillestrøm
description: The Girls' Run is organized at Skedsmohallen in Lillestrøm, about a 10-minute walk from Lillestrøm station. This day is filled with laughter, crazy experiences, and positivity, and we leave all our everyday tasks at home. The Girls' Run is a low-threshold race that promises an unforgettable running celebration for women, having gathered up to 12,000 participants, which creates a festive atmosphere and engagement in the local community.
course_highlights: The Girls' Run is a hugely popular event that has gathered up to 12,000 participants.
The event creates a festive atmosphere and engagement in the local community.
The surface for running is primarily gravel, with some asphalt, set in scenic surroundings.

name: Skogvokteren Ultra
description: Welcome to the fourth edition of the Skogvokteren Ultra! This is a low-threshold, unmarked race with 100% trail magic, where we gather in the forests of Grenland to celebrate spring and compete for honor and glory. Skogvokting is about appreciating the local environment, community, and celebrating the ability to move efficiently through the terrain. We hope to see you sharp and ready at five o'clock on Saturday, May 4, 2024, when the race kicks off in Porsgrunn.
course_highlights: The Skogvokteren Ultra is Grenland's annual ultra celebration with a low-threshold and authentic profile on spring trails during the transition from April to May.
The race is a UTMB Index event at 100K with a distance of 88.00 km and an elevation gain of 3700 meters.
We focus on mastery and progression, but we also facilitate performance.

description: IL Giv Akt is organizing a running festival at Vigeland on May 3, 2025. This event will include race distances for all ages and fitness levels, starting and finishing at Kulturtorvet. Audnamila 2025 offers participants the chance to experience a unique running experience in Farsund, Vest-Agder.
course_highlights: Race distances for all ages and fitness levels.
Start and finish at Kulturtorvet in Vigeland.
Part of a larger celebration in Farsund, Vest-Agder.

name: CC-Løpet Hamar
description: The CC Race Hamar is a fun run for everyone, with or without timing, taking place on May 3, 2025, starting and finishing at CC Hamar. The race is 2.8 km long, and participants can run, jog, walk, or push a stroller. The main prize is 25,000 kroner, and the winner must donate the prize to a cause specified at registration, which can be a charitable cause or a trip for the team. The more people who participate for the same cause, the greater the chance of winning.
course_highlights: The race is 2.8 km long, and participants can run, jog, walk, or push a stroller.
The grand prize is 25,000 kroner.

name: Råskinnet
description: Råskinnet is a trail race of about 9 km that offers a challenging and fun terrain, much off the beaten path, with ups and downs in an old ski jump and a loop around Sognsvann. This race takes participants through an emotional spectrum from hell to heaven, and it is an experience one will never forget. Everyone who finishes is a true Råskinn!
course_highlights: RÅSKINNET👉 approximately 9km of terrain👉 challenging and fun surface, much off-trail.
Up and down an old ski jump.

name: Sunnhordland Løpsfest
description: Stord Athletics welcomes you to a proper running festival in Leirvik center on Saturday, May 4, 2024. The event, which was previously named Sunnhordland Marathon, is coming back in a new format as Sunnhordland Running Festival. It includes distances such as 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, children's race, and a super race for individuals with reduced mobility. The start and finish will be on Borggata at Vikjo, and the new route for the 5 km will be announced in the spring.
course_highlights: Sunnhordland Running Festival is a major running event with participation from hundreds of runners.
The event includes several distances, such as five kilometers, ten kilometers, and half marathon, attracting both locals and visitors to participate.
It is a community celebration with activities for the whole family, including children's races, and there is great enthusiasm among the participants and the audience.

name: Sundvolden Challenge
description: The Sundvolden Challenge puts both recreational runners and elite athletes to the test. First, everyone gets the chance to experience the power of Kleiva – a hill that demands both willpower and endurance. Then comes the superfinal for the strongest competitors. With 338 meters of elevation over 5 km, the Sundvolden Challenge is a brutal challenge for all participants.
course_highlights: The Sundvolden Challenge tests both recreational runners and elite athletes.
Everyone gets the chance to experience the power of Kleiva – a hill that demands both will and endurance.
With 338 meters of elevation over 5 km, this is one of the year's toughest uphill races.

name: Lierløpet 3 & 4
description: Lierløpet is one of Norway's fastest courses and takes place in the Drammen area. This exciting race offers several distances for participants of all ages and skill levels, providing a great opportunity to compete, have fun, and enjoy the community with fellow running enthusiasts. The race takes place on a wide pathway that is well-used by both runners and joggers, creating a friendly and inclusive environment.
course_highlights: The Lier Race is a popular running series that takes place several times throughout the year.
The courses run through beautiful surroundings, and the event always has a high level of participation and enthusiasm.
It is a great opportunity for both experienced runners and beginners to participate.

name: Voss Løpskarusell 2
description: We welcome joggers and runners from 9 years old to a new race series in 2026. The races will take place on Mondays starting at 7 PM, with the following dates in 2026: April 13, May 4, June 1, June 22, August 3, and September 21. The course is 5 km, starting and finishing at the sports field, followed by a loop in Prestegardsmoen, then along the waterfront promenade and back to the sports field.
course_highlights: The run takes place on Mondays starting at 7 PM.
The dates in 2026 will be: April 13, May 4, June 1, June 22, August 3, and September 21.
The course is 5 km, with the start and finish at the sports field.

name: Jentebølgen - Oslo
description: SPAR Jentebølgen is a fun run over five kilometers, and this year the event will be held in 24 locations across Norway. Oslo is participating for the first time. Jentebølgen is a race for all women and girls, filled with great vibes and music.
course_highlights: SPAR Jentebølgen is a 5-kilometer fun run for girls of all ages.
Oslo is included in the program for the first time.
Jentebølgen – A race for all women and girls! 5-6 km filled with great vibes, music,...

name: Jentebølgen Kristiansand
description: Join the Girls' Wave in Kristiansand! A public health run in collaboration with Mental Health Youth. We are coming to Kristiansand on May 5, 2026, and we invite you to join us! The course is between 5 and 6 km long, and you decide whether you want to walk, jog, or run. Be part of the community celebration when the Girls' Wave arrives in Kristiansand!
course_highlights: The course is between 5 and 6 km long.
There are course maps available in every city with the exact distance.
Remember that you decide whether you want to walk, jog, or run👟.

name: Vom Dogrun - Ålesund
description: The VOM Dogrun is organized in Spjelkavik on the grounds by Tufteparken, where the start and finish area is located. This event is for everyone who wants a pleasant activity with their dog, and participants can choose to compete with or without timing. All participants receive a medal, a participant prize, as well as a great Vom Dogrun dog bowl. There will also be tastings of VOM ACTIVE & VOM PUPPY, fantastic prizes, and trophies for the fastest in the competitive class.
course_highlights: Everyone receives a medal and a participant prize.
Great Vom Dogrun dog bowl, bib number, and medal for all participants.
Trophies for the fastest in the competition class.

name: Stavanger 5K
description: Stavanger 5K takes place on May 3, 2025, and offers a 5 km course – the golden middle ground! Short enough to go all out, but long enough to feel like a real achievement. The course is flat, fast, and located in the heart of the city, perfect for both personal records and a lovely spring run with your running shoes. The race starts at 09:00 and runs along Strandkaien past the Oil Museum and Straenkaien past the concert hall.
course_highlights: The course is flat, fast, and right in the heart of the city!
Perfect for both personal bests and a lovely spring outing with your running shoes.
Spirit Athletics Club aims to attract 2000 participants to the start of a brand new race in downtown Stavanger.

name: Søreideløpet
description: The Søreide Race 2025 will be held on Wednesday, May 7th, and is an inclusive event where the whole family can participate. All participants will receive a medal and bottled water from Rema1000 at Søreide, and there will be great prizes drawn from the start numbers. The race is open to everyone, and we encourage teams to dress alike. There will also be distribution of start numbers from 5:30 PM, a joint warm-up at 6:10 PM, and a separate start for those who wish to challenge the course record at 6:30 PM, before the main field starts at 6:35 PM.
course_highlights: All participants will receive a medal and bottled water from Rema1000 at Søreide.
There will be a number of prizes drawn based on the starting number, including a membership at Sportybilletter for the Trond Mohn Games and gift cards from Søreide IL.
There is a prize of 5000 NOK for the team in Søreide IL with the highest percentage of participation.

name: Bølerstafetten
description: The Bøler Relay 2025 will be held on Wednesday, May 7 at 6:00 PM by the Athletics Group in Bøler IF. This is the 62nd time the relay is taking place, with the start and finish at the Haraløkka sports facility in Bøler, Oslo. The running course is on park paths and asphalt, and there are two different courses; the 6-9 year age group runs a shorter course with 5 legs, while the 10-13 year, 14-16 year, and 15-19 year age groups run a longer course with 6 legs.
course_highlights: Class 6-9 years runs a shorter course with 5 segments that was used for the first time in 2022.
Classes 10-13 years, 14-16 years, and 15-19 years run a longer course with 6 stages, which has been in use for many years.
Stage times are recorded for the 10-13 years, 14-16 years, and 15-19 years categories.

name: Strandløpet
description: On Tuesday, the famous beach race took place in Etape Bornholm, which is quite unique in its kind. It is the shortest of the stage races, only 5.8 kilometers long, but also the most difficult and challenging for many. 4 of the kilometers are on sandy beach along the water's edge or in loose sand dunes, much like in a desert. Either you really like this very special race, or you hate it.
course_highlights: Norwegian Vikings, however, mastered the unusual terrain very well.
The course turns inward and through the large sand dunes, up and down in the loose sand, until some steep inclines must be tackled.
This is a spectacular race in incredibly beautiful surroundings.

name: Jentebølgen - Drammen
description: Jentebølgen 2026 will take place on Wednesday, May 20, at Bragernes Torg. Warm-up begins at 6:00 PM, and the race starts at 6:30 PM. There will also be prizes and gift cards drawn based on the participant numbers. There will be a group warm-up with catchy music and professional instructors.
course_highlights: Warm-up at 6:00 PM and the race starts at 6:30 PM.
Prizes/gift cards will be drawn based on the participant number.
Group warm-up with catchy music and professional instructors.

description: The Alby Race is organized from the Main Gate at Alby, Jeløy, on Friday, May 3, 2024. The course length is the same for all runners, with a distance of 3 km. The wave start begins at 6:30 PM, with the youngest participants starting first, while the recreational class has its last start at 6:55 PM. Bib numbers will be distributed from 5:00 PM, so it is recommended to arrive early to pick up your bib number.
course_highlights: Same course length (3 km) for all runners.
Wave start, with the first start at 6:30 PM.
The recreational class has its last start at 6:55 PM.

name: Askøy på langs
description: Askøy lengthwise is a long trail with very varied terrain, where our volunteer team continually improves the path. There are still wet and muddy sections along the way, but large parts of the trail run on nice paths and hiking trails. In the northern part of the island, some smaller sections of the distance are on asphalt, such as at Skråmestø and from the water tower at Merkesvik to Herdlabroen. All participants take part at their own risk and should make a conscious decision in advance about whether they are fit enough to walk or run such a long distance. The route will be marked from start to finish with red pictograms and ribbons.
course_highlights: The course is long and features very varied terrain, with both wet and muddy sections.
Large parts of the course run on nice trails and hiking paths, with some sections of asphalt.
The course will be marked from start to finish with red pictograms and ribbons.

name: Holmenkollstafetten
description: The Holmenkollen Relay is the world's largest relay race and Norway's biggest sporting event, run through the streets of Oslo. This unique relay race features 15 stages, each with its own challenges and distances, attracting both amateur and professional runners. Welcome to the Holmenkollen Relay on Saturday, May 10, 2025, where we expect a record number of participants with 5000 teams and more than 70,000 participants.
course_highlights: The Holmenkollen Relay is known for its unique route and participation from various teams.
The race attracts both amateur and professional runners.
With 15 stages and 60,000 participants, the Holmenkollen Relay is spring's most beautiful adventure.

name: Grunnlovsmila
description: The Constitution Mile is a free fun run that takes place from Elverum to Heradsbygd. The race is organized every year before May 17th to celebrate community, health, and the festive spirit of May 17th in running shoes. Participation is open to everyone, and more details about the event will be announced closer to the race date.
course_highlights: The Constitution Mile is a free fun run, organized in celebration of the national day.
The race goes from Elverum to Heradsbygd and is 10 km long.
The race signifies community, health, and a 17th of May spirit in running shoes.

description: Fløyen - Knarvik, (formerly Bergen Fjell og FjordTur) is a hiking march/run of approximately 26 km. The route goes from Fløyen to AMFI Knarvik, and large parts of the journey follow the old postal road and continue on sidewalks/roads/trails over the Nordhordland Bridge, Flatøy, and Hagelsund Bridge. If you do not want to walk the entire distance, you can start from IKEA in Åsane (13 km). The course has been modified from Falkanger down to Tellevik and now goes through terrain instead of on asphalt/gravel.

name: Åsaneløpet
description: Join the race festival in Åsane! Participate in a fun run for the whole family with options of 5 km and 10 km, as well as a kids' race for the youngest participants. All children who take part in the kids' race will receive a medal, and the first 800 participants will get a stylish t-shirt. The Åsaneløpet is a community celebration in the heart of Åsane, where Sports Without Alcohol will also have a booth and a good atmosphere.
